jobs.title: Account Director, Higher Education
jobs.description:
About the Role

As an Account Director for Higher Education in AMER, you will own strategic relationships with colleges, universities, and higher education systems as they move from AI experimentation to responsible, institution-wide transformation. You will work with presidents, provosts, CIOs, CTOs, academic and administrative leaders, researchers, security teams, and procurement stakeholders to define priority use cases, build the technical and governance foundation for deployment, and translate institutional goals into a multi-year AI transformation roadmap.

You will own the commercial and customer journey end to end—from territory strategy, pipeline creation, and executive alignment through evaluation, procurement, deployment, adoption, consumption, value realization, and expansion. This is a deeply technical, consultative sales role. You will be expected to understand AI capabilities and limitations, integration patterns, data governance, privacy, security, and change management; partner effectively with technical experts; and remain accountable for measurable customer and revenue outcomes after signature.

In this role, you will:

 - Own and execute the AMER higher education territory and account strategy, prioritizing institutions where OpenAI can support meaningful, responsible, and scalable transformation.

 - Create pipeline and lead complex, multi-threaded new-business and expansion opportunities from first engagement through procurement, deployment, adoption, and value realization.

 - Engage credibly with presidents, provosts, CIOs, CTOs, academic leaders, researchers, administrators, security teams, legal, procurement, finance, and end-user champions.

 - Lead cross-functional pursuit and account teams across Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Product, Research, Security, Legal, and other functions to design evaluations, pilots, technical validation, executive business cases, production deployments, and adoption plans.

 - Translate AI model and platform capabilities, limitations, integration approaches, governance requirements, privacy, security, and safety considerations into clear institutional value, credible technical plans, and practical transformation roadmaps.

 - Own new-business, subscription, and consumption revenue; forecast pipeline and usage-based growth; and use adoption, value realization, and expansion signals to manage the business.

 - Develop durable executive relationships and a broad coalition of institutional champions across decentralized stakeholder groups.

 - Bring structured market insight from higher education customers into product, policy, partnership, and go-to-market strategy.

 - Represent OpenAI as a thoughtful partner at executive forums, industry events, customer advisory discussions, and the broader higher education ecosystem.

Qualifications:

 - 10+ years of experience selling platform-as-a-service and/or software-as-a-service solutions, with a sustained record of meeting or exceeding meaningful revenue targets through complex, multi-year enterprise sales motions.

 - Direct experience selling to higher education institutions or systems, with a strong understanding of decentralized decision-making, academic and administrative stakeholders, governance, procurement, privacy, security, and change management.

 - Demonstrated ownership of consumption- or usage-based revenue, including forecasting usage, driving adoption, creating new use cases, and converting customer outcomes into expansion.

 - The technical depth to learn complex AI products, lead effective discovery, partner closely with technical teams, explain technical concepts accurately at both executive and practitioner altitudes, and translate them into academic, operational, research, and commercial outcomes.

 - Experience leading strategic transformations rather than isolated point-solution sales, including governance, change management, adoption, and measurable operational, academic, research, or user outcomes.

 - Strong executive presence, structured communication, and the ability to earn trust across senior leaders, technical experts, faculty, administrators, and end users.

 - Excellent account planning, qualification, negotiation, forecasting, and cross-functional orchestration skills.

 - High judgment, curiosity, resilience, and comfort operating through ambiguity, product change, and evolving customer needs.

 - A mission-driven approach to deploying AI responsibly and helping institutions build durable capability rather than short-lived pilots.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Are customer-centric and start with the institution’s mission, users, constraints, and desired outcomes rather than a predetermined product pitch.

 - Can move fluidly between a boardroom conversation about institutional strategy and a working session about architecture, data, governance, rollout, and measurement.

 - Treat the signature as the beginning of the work and are energized by adoption, usage growth, value realization, and expansion.

 - Are a builder who creates repeatable plays while adapting to the distinctive culture and operating model of each institution.

 - Bring informed optimism about AI alongside the rigor to surface risks, tradeoffs, and implementation realities.

jobs.title: Sales Development Manager, Construction
jobs.description:
Hover helps people design, improve, and protect the properties they love. With proprietary AI built on over a decade of real property data, Hover answers age-old questions like “What will it look like?” and “What will it cost?” Homeowners, contractors, and insurance professionals rely on Hover to get fully measured, accurate, and interactive 3D models of any property — all from a smartphone scan in minutes.

At Hover, we’re driven by curiosity, purpose, and a shared commitment to serving our customers, communities, and each other. We believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives and are proud to cultivate an inclusive, high-performance culture that inspires growth, accountability, and excellence. Backed by leading investors like Google Ventures and Menlo Ventures, and trusted by industry leaders including Travelers, State Farm, and Nationwide — we’re redefining how people understand and interact with their spaces.

Why Hover wants you

Some of the largest roofing, exteriors, and remodeling companies in the country rely on Hover to measure, design, and sell jobs. We're looking for an SDR Manager to own the top of the funnel for our Construction sales organization and lead the team that opens doors at those companies. This is a chance to step into people leadership with real impact: you'll report directly to our VP of Sales, partner with executives and sales leaders across the business, and build a team that grows as Hover grows. If you've been a top SDR, love coaching others, and want to own a number that directly drives company growth, we'd love to meet you.

You will contribute by

You’ll lead and grow our Construction SDR team and own the pipeline behind our bookings goals. Most of your time goes to your team: call reviews, 1:1s, performance, and hiring and ramping new reps as we build to full headcount. You’ll also work with sales leaders and our Partnerships team to open doors with key contractors. You’ll represent Hover at industry events. And you’ll stay hands-on with our top 75 strategic accounts, leading the approach to the largest construction companies alongside our sales managers.

  • Own top-of-funnel for the Construction sales org and hit the team’s goal for bookings generated from SDR-sourced pipeline
  • Coach, manage, and develop the SDR team through call coaching, 1:1s, and clear weekly targets
  • Hire, onboard, and ramp new SDRs as we scale the team to full headcount
  • Lead strategy and outreach on the largest of Hover’s top 75 construction accounts, setting qualified meetings for $100K+ opportunities
  • Partner with Construction Sales Managers on account strategy, lead quality, and meeting handoff
  • Represent Hover at in-person events and conferences, and work with our Partnerships team to turn them into pipeline
  • Use Salesforce, Gong, and AI tools to improve team productivity, insight, and meeting quality
  • Build AI into how the team works, from account research and personalized outreach to call review and coaching

Your background includes

  • A proven track record as a top-performing SDR or BDR, with consistent quota attainment
  • Experience leading, managing, or formally coaching SDRs (as a team lead, player-coach, or manager); typically 3+ years in sales development overall
  • A history of setting meetings that turned into $100K+ opportunities with large, complex organizations
  • Strong command of Salesforce, Outreach (or similar sequencing tools) and Gong, as well as  hands-on experience using AI tools to improve prospecting and coaching
  • Strategic, problem-solving mindset: you look past activity metrics to find the plays that move pipeline
  • Clear, confident communication with executives, sales leaders, and reps alike
  • Ability to work from our New York City office with the team

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience selling into construction, roofing, exteriors, home services, or building products
  • Experience running field events or partner-driven pipeline programs
  • Experience hiring SDRs and building a team from the ground up

Benefits

  • Compensation - Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a fast-growing company
  • Healthcare - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and dependents
  • Paid Time Off - Unlimited and flexible vacation policy 
  • Paid Family Leave - We support work/life balance and offer generous paid parental and new child bonding leave 
  • Mandatory Self-Care Days - A day set aside each month to allow employees to recharge 
  • Remote Wellbeing Resources - We provide recurring fitness classes, meditation/ mindfulness tools, virtual therapy, and family planning assistance 
  • Learning - We encourage continued education and will help cover the cost of management training, conferences, workshops, or certifications

Hybrid roles at Hover

Hover has Hubs in San Francisco and New York City, where we expect that all employees living within a 50-mile radius of our offices will come into their local Hover office at least three times a week to build rapport and foster organic connection. At this time, Hover is not considering fully remote roles. This role is based out of our NYC hub.

jobs.title: Rotational Development Program
jobs.location: Chicago, Illinois, United States; Los Angeles, California, United States
jobs.description:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Build the operational and technical skill set that runs global trade

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. We're shaping the future of a $10T industry with technology and people who understand it end to end. The Rotational Development Program (RDP) exists because that combination — real supply chain fluency plus the ability to build and automate — doesn't exist at scale in the market today. So we're building it ourselves.

This is an 18-month program, not a rotation for rotation's sake. Every assignment is live, revenue-generating work. Every participant leaves with a certification in AI and low-code tooling running alongside their operational and commercial training. And every graduate places into a role with real scope: primarily Account Management, with paths into Automation Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering/Consulting, Sales Engineering, or a traditional Ops/Sales/Customs track.

What you'll do

You'll rotate through three functions, six months each, with AI/low-code curriculum running continuously across all three:

  • Gateway Ops (Air or Ocean). Own the shipment lifecycle. Execute bookings, manage exceptions, and hold data integrity to Flexport's standard. Build your first automation and reporting skills through structured coursework running in parallel.
  • Customs. Become a global trade expert by navigating the complex world of customs regulations to ensure goods comply with international laws. Simultaneously, move into applied technical work: SQL, workflow automation, Lean process improvement, etc.
  • Sales / Account Management. Take on go-to-market work and build client-facing skills, operating with more independence. Your capstone: identify a real business problem in the function you're sitting in and build the tooling or process fix that solves it. You'll present it to leadership at graduation.

Throughout the program, you'll get:

  • A day-to-day manager in your current rotation and a Rotation Program Manager tracking your development, with mid-point and end-of-rotation evaluations at every stage.
  • Certifications in AI/low-code tooling, from foundational bootcamp through applied builds to a capstone project.
  • Bi-weekly cohort touchpoints and a standing alumni mentor community.
  • Increased earning potential as you clear program benchmarks

This role is for you if you

  • Are on track to graduate, or recently graduated, and want to build a career at the intersection of supply chain operations and technology — not just run one or the other.
  • Are genuinely curious about AI and low-code tooling and want to build real fluency, not just check a resume box.
  • Can operate with minimal supervision, prioritize a high volume of work, and communicate clearly under pressure.
  • Want real ownership fast? This program hands you live client and business work from the very beginning — it is not a shadowing or classroom based program.
  • Have a "compliance-first" mindset. We operate in a heavily regulated industry, and that matters in every rotation.

Ready to build the future of global trade — and the skill set to run it?

Apply now.

jobs.title: Sr. Field Service Engineer
jobs.description: About Rivian Rivian is on a mission to keep the world adventurous forever. This goes for the emissions-free Electric Adventure Vehicles we build, and the curious, courageous souls we seek to attract. As a company, we constantly challenge what’s possible, never simply accepting what has always been done. We reframe old problems, seek new solutions and operate comfortably in areas that are unknown. Our backgrounds are diverse, but our team shares a love of the outdoors and a desire to protect it for future generations. Role Summary The Sr. Field Service Engineer acts as the technical bridge between real-world vehicle usage and Rivian’s engineering and product development teams. You will drive field issue detection, structured root cause analysis, and corrective action implementation, ensuring every customer experience informs our continuous product improvement journey. This role supports diagnostic and repair strategies, champions product feedback from the field, and enables scalable quality solutions across all Rivian vehicle systems. Responsibilities Act as a field product expert across Rivian’s vehicle platforms (HV Battery, Drive Units, Infotainment, ADAS, Chassis Systems, etc.). Lead structured field investigations for early-life failures, durability issues, and emergent customer trends. Partner with Field Service Technicians and Service Engineering to deliver advanced diagnostics, while capturing field learnings for upstream product corrections. Drive root cause analysis efforts using formal methodologies (5-Whys, Fishbone, Fault Tree) and close quality loops with Engineering and Reliability teams. Develop rapid diagnostic and repair plans that prioritize customer uptime and serviceability, including software and hardware solutions. Create detailed field diagnostics and technical documentation to inform Service and Design loops. Collaborate with Diagnostic Engineering, Diagnostics Specialists, and Quality teams to streamline diagnostics, improve detection methods, and refine repair procedures. Support the development of remote diagnostic and field data capture tools to proactively monitor vehicle performance and identify trends. Mentor and train service locations on best practices for advanced diagnostics and early issue detection. Implement incident response protocols for critical field events requiring immediate data gathering or technical resolution. Drive field validation initiatives to ensure corrective actions and new product updates are effective under real-world conditions. Champion a culture of product ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement across field service and engineering functions. Frequent travel (up to 75%) is required. Must be able to travel in your region on a weekly basis. Qualifications 7-10+ years as ASE Certified Master Level Technician highly desired Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or related technical discipline (preferred) and 2-5 years of direct experience in automotive product engineering, service engineering, field quality engineering, or reliability engineering. Deep technical understanding of complex vehicle systems including electric drive systems, HV batteries, infotainment, and embedded controls. Strong experience in diagnosing system-level failures and collaborating on design or process improvements. Skilled in formal problem-solving tools and root cause methodologies (8D, 5-Whys, Fault Tree Analysis). High proficiency with vehicle diagnostic tools, CAN tools, and data analysis platforms (Databricks, Tableau, etc.). Coding or scripting experience (Python, C/C++) is highly desirable for tool development and automation. Knowledge of Linux, Android-based systems, and OTA update processes is a plus. Hands-on field experience supporting vehicle diagnostics and repairs. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills with Product Development, Manufacturing, Reliability, and Quality organizations. Effective communicator, able to clearly present complex technical issues to engineering and non-technical audiences. Passion for innovation, adventure, and making a real-world impact through sustainable product development. Commitment to travel up to 75% throughout Northern California and Northwest Nevada. jobs.description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Everpure is building a dedicated Financial Solutions practice to change how our largest customers fund and consume technology. In this role, you will partner with Enterprise and Strategic sales teams and customer finance leaders to own the financial side of the sale, turning capital and balance-sheet considerations into deal structures that create and accelerate opportunities.   • Build the business case: Develop TCO, ROI, and cash-flow models that show senior finance stakeholders the financial value of Everpure solutions and resolve financial objections before they stall a deal.
  • Design the structure: Create tailored commercial and financing structures, including flexible payment schedules, third-party financing, and subscription models, that improve customer cash flow while balancing Everpure’s business objectives.
  • Lead conversions and coordinate execution: Guide customers from CapEx purchases to Evergreen//One, and align Finance, Legal, Operations, and external financing partners to move complex transactions from first conversation to signature.

  • Executive engagement: Experience working directly with CFOs, Treasury, finance, and procurement leaders and translating technical value into financial outcomes.
  • Proactive sales partnership: A record of working with enterprise or strategic sellers to create opportunities and advance complex, multi-stakeholder deals rather than only responding to requests.

jobs.title: Lead Data Center Operations Technician - Memphis
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

LEAD DATA CENTER OPERATIONS TECHNICIAN

As a Lead Data Center Operations Technician at SpaceXSI, you are the floor’s technical authority and the operational owner of the work queue for your assigned area or shift. You remain fully hands-on across physical-layer work, OS remediation, RMA, inventory, and incident response while owning prioritization, sequencing, and real-time direction of teammates so the floor delivers consistent throughput and tenant SLAs.

You drive mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to repair (MTTR) not only through your own technical work, but by turning the ticket queue into clear priorities, directing teammates to the right racks/zones/goals, running shift huddles, rebalancing work as conditions change, and delivering clean handoffs and status to the Supervisor. You do not manage people (performance management, career development, and formal authority remain with the Supervisor); you lead the work. This role is based in Southaven, MS / Memphis, TN (or site-specific).

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own prioritization and sequencing of tickets, projects, and maintenance for the assigned area or shift. Direct teammates toward specific racks, zones, goals, or ticket batches so the floor hits the right outcomes
  • Run shift huddles; track progress and blockers in real time; rebalance work as conditions change; deliver clean handoffs and concise status to the Supervisor
  • Serve as the on-floor technical escalation and hands-on resource. Remain fully capable of all physical-layer, RMA, inventory, and OS remediation work
  • Act as incident commander for floor operations during sev events: run the technical response, sequence recovery, coordinate hands-on work, and contribute the technical core of post-incident write-ups
  • Set floor standards, assist in SOP training, and propose new SOP and Notion documentation. Recognized site SME in at least one domain (power, liquid cooling, or fabric) on top of broad senior scope
  • Own and deliver complex projects: site-wide rollouts, sev-recovery programs, and cross-team infrastructure initiatives. Support the supercompute team on advanced technical issues
  • Collaborate directly with external vendors on advanced troubleshooting and RMA escalation. Interface with Facilities, Engineering, and other teams as needed
  • Set the excellence bar for tenant (customer) cluster support: escalate high-level maintenance on customer-facing capacity, sequence work to tenant requirements, and ensure zero-surprise execution.
  • Surface recurring patterns or capacity issues early. Turn the queue into consistent throughput
  • Perform all core Datacenter Operations Technician duties: troubleshooting and monitoring of servers and network infrastructure; rack and stack; fiber/optics labeling and troubleshooting; power supply cabling; hardware receipt, installation, and decommissioning; warehouse inventory and asset management; spare-parts management; vendor returns; Jira ticket management; and documentation of tasks and SOPs

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High school diploma or equivalency certificate
  • 5+ years of experience working with server, storage, compute, and network hardware
  • 5+ years of experience troubleshooting and repairing servers and networking infrastructure
  • 5+ years of experience in inventory management, including ordering, receiving, and shipping server and network equipment

PREFERRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize and sequence high-volume work queues and direct teammates toward specific goals without formal people-management authority
  • Strong Linux skills, including shell navigation, file manipulation, process management, log analysis, and basic scripting
  • Experience being on-call and responding to critical events
  • Experience leading data center infrastructure projects or shift-level work coordination
  • Excellent prioritization, time management, and real-time decision-making skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high technical quality
  • Detail-oriented with strong documentation and handoff habits
  • 2+ years of experience in structured cabling (copper/fiber)
  • 2+ years of experience in power and cooling concepts inside the data center
  • Experience as a site SME in power, liquid cooling, or fabric on GPU/hyperscale platforms
  • Familiarity with internal tools (Rackman, Loony, BMC/Redfish/IPMI, Grafana, Ignition/SCADA, Jira) and GPU failure domains (XID, NVLink, BER/FEC)
  • CompTIA, Linux+, or NVIDIA data-center technician training

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Position is subject to pre-employment drug and random drug and alcohol testing
  • Position is subject to pre-employment and annual post-employment background checks
  • Work is often performed in tight quarters and physical dexterity is necessary
  • Ability to lift up to 35 lbs unassisted
  • Comfortable working at elevated heights (up to 50 feet) with appropriate safety gear
  • Comfortable working in an environment requiring exposure to noise
  • Available to work evenings and weekends; flexibility required as schedule varies with site operational needs

jobs.title: Staff Global Supply Manager - Solar, Energy Storage
jobs.description:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

Position Summary:

The Staff Global Supply Chain Manager, Solar is an advanced-level individual contributor role that directs sourcing strategy for solar cell and solar module commodities supporting Redwood’ novel energy storage and generation products. The role owns the supplier landscape, total cost of ownership, and commercial agreements for these commodities, and determines sourcing methods on new assignments where no established precedent exists. Working with Engineering, Finance, and Manufacturing, the role aligns supplier selection and delivery plans with design, ramp, and cost targets. This is a fully on-site role at 100 Hooper, with approximately 10-25% international travel to supplier sites.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Develop and direct the sourcing strategy for solar cell and module commodities, including supplier landscape assessment, make-vs-buy, dual sourcing, and localization decisions
  • Understand and broadcast the ever-evolving landscape of tariffs, duties, production credits, etc. related to solar cell and module commodities in the U.S. and broader international impacts
  • Identify, qualify, and develop strategic suppliers of solar cells, modules, and related components
  • Lead RFQ and RFP efforts, negotiate commercial terms, and establish master supply agreements, statements of work, and pricing agreements
  • Build and maintain should-cost and total cost of ownership models to inform negotiations and reduce landed cost
  • Guide Engineering and Manufacturing on supplier readiness for new product introduction builds and mass production ramp
  • Monitor supplier performance and resolve escalations in quality, cost, and delivery
  • Advise cross-functional partners on lead time, inventory, and supply risk across the product lifecycle

Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, Economics, or a related technical field (Master's degree or MBA preferred)
  • 8+ years of sourcing or supply chain management experience (6+ years with a Master's degree), ideally in solar, energy, EV, or electronics manufacturing
  • Working knowledge of solar cell and module manufacturers and the global solar supplier landscape
  • Working knowledge of solar cell and module manufacturing processes, cost drivers, and process constraints
  • Experience building cost models and negotiating commercial and technical terms with suppliers using should-cost fundamentals
  • Experience developing commodity strategy and sourcing agreements for new products moving from development to volume production
  • Ability to travel internationally to supplier sites approximately 10-25% of the time

 

In accordance with California pay transparency laws, the salary range for this position is listed below. Actual compensation may vary based on a variety of factors, including experience, education, and skills. 

California Pay Range:
$162,500—$215,000 USD

The position is full-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

This is a fully on-site role at the San Francisco R&D Space, with 30% international travel to supplier sites. You will be responsible for ensuring all parts provided by your suppliers meet dimensional, functional, and reliability requirements. You will support ramping suppliers with detailed capacity analysis, process approvals, part qualifications, NPI builds, and ongoing supplier performance and audits. You are a doer, excited about getting your hands dirty and working in a dynamic, fast-paced setting with new technologies. The SIE will work closely with cross-functional partners in Supply Chain, Engineering, Finance, and Manufacturing to ensure that design and customer success targets are met.

 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Support supplier audits (process, system, product) and risk assessments to help qualify new sources and ensure readiness for mass production
  • Partner with GSMs, Design Engineering, and suppliers to align specifications, tolerance stack-ups, test coverage, and process controls
  • Review dimensional and quality reports, first article inspections, and other process control data to ensure part compliance
  • Execute PPAP/FAI activities and help define incoming inspection criteria based on part criticality, GD&T, and critical-to-quality key characteristics
  • Support supplier non-conformance resolution, drive 8D investigations, and follow through with verification of effectiveness activities with vendors
  • Maintain supplier scorecards with clear KPIs such as yield, PPM, delivery performance, and DFM responsiveness
  • Support NPI builds and DFM/DFA feedback loops through early supplier engagement and pilot line walkthroughs
  • Help build and define a strong and capable network of vendor partners with robust process, technical capability, reliability, and capacity
  • Support make-vs-buy, dual sourcing, and localization efforts across global supply chains
  • Contribute to sourcing decisions, lead-time analysis, and manufacturing footprint strategies

Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities

  • B.S. in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, Economics or equivalent technical background
  • M.S. in Industrial Engineering, Engineering Management, Supply Chain, and/or MBA a plus
  • 3+ years of supplier quality, industrial engineering, process controls, or other related experience, ideally in automotive, industrial hardware, or other high-volume electronics manufacturing environments
  • Strong understanding of mechanical fabrication processes: CNC machining, casting, injection molding, extrusion, sheet metal, riveting, welding, plating, etc.
  • Familiarity with PCBA manufacturing processes (SMT, through-hole wave and selective soldering, reflow oven profiles, test strategies, etc.)
  • Proficiency reading engineering drawings and applying GD&T; familiarity with dimension metrology (CMM, calipers, gauges) and statistical process control
  • Familiarity with APQP, PPAP, SPC, DFMEA/PFMEA, and ISO quality systems
  • Highly collaborative, data-driven, and proactive; capable of thriving in fast-paced startup environments

jobs.title: Senior/Principal Product Manager, Video Generation (Roblox Reality)
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators. 

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there. 

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

The mission of the Foundation AI group is to enable Roblox Creators to accelerate their workflows and to put GenAI in the hands of millions of users. We envision a future in which experiences on Roblox leverage generative text and speech capabilities to enable new forms of interaction, generative 3D and 4D capabilities to enable new ways to create, and generative video to give creators a level of visual fidelity and motion that has never been available at this scale.

We shipped our 3D foundation model, which takes text prompts as input and generates production ready 3D objects and worlds. We are now building the Roblox Video Model; the Super Upsampler at the heart of Roblox Reality, our hybrid architecture that pairs the structured simulation of the Roblox Game Engine and Roblox Cloud with the photorealism of Video World Models. The engine stays the source of truth for the data model: state, physics, collision, logic, and multiplayer consistency. The video model generates the pixels: higher fidelity textures, realistic lighting, secondary motion, fluid dynamics, and the unscripted detail of a real world. A world model paired with our engine, enables persistent, multiplayer, photorealistic worlds that any creator can build and any player can join.

As the Senior/Principal Product Manager for Video Generation, your job is to put that in the hands of our community. You will take the Roblox Video Model out of the lab and into creator early access, then to a platform capability available to everyone, running on cloud edge GPU infrastructure, scaling toward tens of millions of concurrents, and keeping agency firmly with the creator. You will own the strategy and vision, define how creators direct and control the model.

You will:

  • Build a vision and strategy for real-time video generation that delights creators and players and leads to industry-defining innovation in world models.
  • Own the launch to our community — from lab demo, to creator early access, to scaled platform capability — and earn the trust of a community with real concerns about AI in creation by shipping in the open and proving the model serves them.
  • Define the creator control surface: how creators condition, direct, and constrain the model so their game rules, art direction, and systems are never overridden.
  • Deeply understand the model capabilities our creators need — temporal coherence, multiplayer consistency, avatar fidelity, prompt and style adherence — and shape the research roadmap against them.
  • Develop comprehensive evaluation for our models, combining automated metrics with creator and player feedback, and own the quality, latency, and cost curve with research and infrastructure so this scales affordably.
  • Work across the company — with engine, rendering, creator, safety, and economy — to make generated pixels safe, age-appropriate, and a core part of gameplay.
  • Manage from vision through the product life cycle, prioritizing by working with creators and analyzing how our model is used, while providing insights to non-technical audiences and holding your own with world-class AI researchers.

You have:

  • A track record of solving hard problems.
  • Proven experience building, shipping, or supporting generative media products — video, image, or world models — or real-time rendering and graphics technology at scale.
  • Experience productizing research: turning model capabilities into product and product signal back into research priorities, with fluency in the tradeoffs that define this space — quality, latency, inference cost, and compute.
  • A deep understanding of the product life cycle and a history of collaborating with engineering teams and other stakeholders to deliver complex technical products on time.
  • Experience shipping to large consumer or creator communities, ideally in gaming, UGC platforms, or creative tools.
  • A Masters degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Graphics, 3D Animation, or Games Production, or a similar technical field.
  • Passion for driving user-centric product decisions with an inclusive and strategic mindset, comfort in a fast-moving and ambiguous environment, and a high degree of independent drive.

jobs.title: Director, Commercial Deals & Pricing
jobs.description:
The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world’s leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more. 

Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly.

The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you.

The Director, Commercial Deals & Pricing is the hands-on operational leader who partners directly with Sales and Business Development to structure, evaluate, and move individual deals through to approval. You are fluent in pricing, deal terms, commercial incentive structures, and margin math, and you're the person a seller calls when a deal needs to evolve from transactional discounting to a strategic value exchange partnership.  

You'll work closely with Sales/BD, Finance, and commercial leadership to make sure deals are well-structured, properly documented, and move through approval efficiently, without compromising on margin or deal quality. The ideal candidate has strong deal finance instincts, experience working on enterprise-level accounts, and is equally comfortable partnering on complex, custom deals and driving teams to standardized models. 

What you'll do 

Deal-by-deal commercial support 

  • Serve as the primary strategic partner for Sales/BD on individual deal structuring, including pricing, packaging, discounting, credits, and non-standard terms. 
  • Review and stress-test deal economics (rate, spend commitments, margin impact) before deals move to approval. 
  • Advise sellers in real time on how to structure a deal using deal model templates and account data. 
  • Operate within existing commercial guardrails where possible, identify when a deal needs escalation or an exception, and drive alignment on a resolution. 

Deal desk operations & approvals 

  • Own day-to-day operation of the deal approval process: intake, triage, documentation review, and routing deals to the right approver based on the delegation of authority framework. 
  • Prepare individual deals for executive review, including your clear, data-driven recommendations. 
  • Track deals through the pipeline to resolution, following up with Sales, Finance, and approvers to keep things moving and unblock stalled deals. 
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date records of deal terms, approvals, and exceptions in Salesforce and supporting tools. 

Cross-functional coordination 

  • Work closely with Finance/Deal Finance to validate margin and spend assumptions on individual deals. 
  • Partner with Legal as needed on non-standard terms within specific deals. 
  • Escalate deals that fall outside existing guardrails to commercial leadership with a clear recommendation and supporting analysis. 
  • Act as a feedback channel from the field back to commercial leadership, surfacing recurring deal patterns, friction points, or gaps in existing guidance. 

Quality, consistency & tooling 

  • Ensure every deal that reaches approval has complete, standardized documentation. 
  • Use and help refine existing deal templates, calculators, and reporting tools. Development new frameworks where needed. 
  • Identify recurring issues or bottlenecks in the deal review process and suggest practical fixes. 

What you bring to the table 

  • 8+ years of experience in deal desk, commercial operations, deal finance, or a related function, ideally in SaaS or ad tech. 
  • Strong, hands-on experience structuring and reviewing individual commercial deals, including pricing, discounting, incentive structures, and non-standard terms. 
  • Comfort working at deal volume, managing multiple live deals at once with strong attention to detail and turnaround time. 
  • Solid financial acumen. You understand margin math, spend commitments, and rate structures, and can explain the details clearly to sellers and approvers. 
  • Experience working directly with Sales/BD in a deal-support capacity; able to push back constructively on deal terms while maintaining a good working relationship. 
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce and standard deal/commercial tooling. 
  • Clear, direct communication skills. You are comfortable summarizing deal recommendations for approvers, including senior leadership.

jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager - Talent Acquisition
jobs.description:
The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world’s leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more. 

Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly.

The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you.

Who We Are

Recruiting Operations is capable — but capability without trust does not scale. Our engagement model exists to make our "how" explicit, consistent, and stakeholder-centered. We operate through two deliberately separated motions: RUN, which delivers predictable execution of repeatable work, and CHANGE, which designs and delivers the programs, tooling, and process improvements that scale globally. The separation is on purpose, so urgent service work never crowds out strategic improvement.

The Projects & Programs pillar is where CHANGE gets delivered. It combines the Recruiting PMO — cross-functional delivery and rigor — with Recruiting Enablement — process, knowledge, adoption, and intake. It also owns the single front door: the one intake channel through which every TA Ops request arrives, is routed, and is made visible.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who operates as a technical program manager. You will own strategic projects and programs end to end, and you will be hands-on in the systems those programs depend on. The person who succeeds here is equally credible running a prioritization forum with senior stakeholders and sitting in the system admin console building the workflow that forum just approved. You will not have direct reports; your leverage comes from delivery rigor, technical fluency, and earned trust.

What You’ll Do

Recruiting PMO — Cross-Functional Delivery & Rigor

  • Own strategic programs end to end. Lead a portfolio of high-visibility, cross-functional TA Ops programs from scoping through launch, adoption, and measurement, including work with no established playbook.
  • Bring delivery rigor. Build and maintain project plans, milestones, dependency maps, RAID logs, and operating rhythms that keep stakeholders aligned and accountable.
  • Drive execution across teams. Coordinate work across Recruiting, People, Legal, Procurement, Finance, Business Engineering, and TA Ops pillars, escalating risk early with clear recommendations.

Intake, Prioritization & Roadmap Formation

  • Own the single front door. Design and improve the intake experience, including routing, request quality, acknowledgement, ownership assignment, deflection, and status visibility.
  • Run prioritization with transparency. Support the alignment forum, score requests on value versus effort, and make tradeoffs clear when work is sequenced, deferred, or declined.
  • Turn demand into roadmap themes. Use intake patterns, escalations, and recurring pain points to inform the Now / Next / Later roadmap with success measures attached.

Enablement — Process, Knowledge, Adoption & Change

  • Design process, not just documentation. Map current state, identify friction, design future state, and land the change in a way teams can adopt.
  • Own SOPs and change management. Create standards, runbooks, communications, and launch materials that make changes stick beyond launch week.
  • Build the knowledge and adoption layer. Develop training, self-serve content, and feedback loops that reduce tickets, improve adoption, and shorten time to resolution.

Hands-On Systems Configuration

  • Configure in the ATS. Build and test requisition and job templates, interview plans, scorecards, approvals, offer workflows, custom fields, automations, and notifications in partnership with Rec Tech.
  • Lead implementations and migrations. Own requirements, data mapping, configuration, test planning, UAT, cutover, and post-go-live hypercare as a program.
  • Support the delivery stack. Configure and administer tools like Smartsheet, Jira, Confluence, and SharePoint within governance, compliance, and change management guardrails.

Measurement & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Instrument what you build. Define success measures for speed, quality, adoption, satisfaction, and risk, and confirm the data exists before launch.
  • Build clear reporting and recommendations. Create portfolio, intake, and roadmap reporting that turns data into decisions, not just dashboards.
  • Strengthen stakeholder trust. Provide clear ownership, transparent prioritization, predictable communication, and follow-through while gathering feedback from Recruiting Leadership and cross-functional partners.

Who You Are

  • 7+ years in Talent Acquisition Operations, Recruiting Operations, People Technology, or technical program management supporting a talent or HR function.
  • Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of complex, cross-functional programs at global or multi-region scale — programs you scoped, built, launched, and measured, not projects you tracked.
  • Hands-on ATS administration and configuration experience. Greenhouse strongly preferred; comparable depth in Workday Recruiting, SmartRecruiters, Lever, iCIMS, or Ashby considered. You must be able to speak to configuration you personally built.
  • At least one system implementation or migration led end to end, including requirements, data mapping, testing, cutover, and post-launch support.
  • Process design and change management experience: turning an ambiguous, undocumented way of working into a documented, adopted standard.
  • Working fluency with reporting and analytics — defining measures, building dashboards, and reasoning about data models and data quality. Comfort with BI tooling required; SQL a strong plus.
  • Strong written communication. You can produce an executive one-pager, a status narrative, and a decision document a busy leader can act on without a meeting.
  • A track record of influencing senior stakeholders without formal authority, including saying no with context and holding the line on scope, sequencing, and quality.
  • Comfort with ambiguity: able to take a vague, politically complex problem and return a scoped plan.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Join Anthropic's Customer Success team in a high-visibility & high-impact role driving AI adoption across a small number of enterprise accounts in our Enterprise Tech segment. As our dedicated Customer Success Manager for Enterprise Tech Customers you’ll be their partner and trusted advisor helping them harness the full potential of all our Claude capabilities - API, Claude Code, Cowork, and other surface areas.

You'll work with a book of global technology leaders to actively deploy AI and reshape the technology landscape. You’ll be working with key partners who are moving fast and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with LLM technology. Your role will entail developing genuine partnerships with the customer and key stakeholders, gaining a deep understanding of their multi-pronged business objectives, strategic direction, AI vision, and technical needs. You'll draw on both your business acumen and technical expertise to serve as a strategic advisor throughout their journey with us.

In partnership with the broader account team, you will help customers identify the right Claude capabilities for their specific business objectives, working closely with them to provide best practices and guidance while supporting them as their usage grows and evolves.

Your role focuses on helping customers scale their usage effectively, drive model and use case optimizations, implement change management strategies, and maximize the value of their investment through expanded use cases across their organization. The insights you gather from your customers will directly inform our research priorities, product development, and go-to-market strategies — making you a key voice in shaping how we build and deliver ongoing value as a business.

Responsibilities:

  • Build trusting, strategic relationships with key customer decision makers in complex, matrixed organizations; understand their business and objectives and identify opportunities for optimization and expansion

  • Own customer operations across the lifecycle of each account, maintaining a structured operational assessment (customer readiness, operational health, strategic alignment, enablement strategy, adoption intelligence) that grounds comprehensive account and success plans and Executive Business Reviews

  • Become an expert in Anthropic's products across API, Claude Code and Cowork, understanding the technical nuances and best practices for each to guide customers to the right solutions

  • Leverage your deep knowledge of each customer, and the patterns you see across your other Tech accounts, to proactively drive consumption planning and the value story behind it, developing credible ROI hypotheses and quantifying outcomes that build the case for continued and expanded investment.

  • Monitor usage patterns and identify optimization opportunities across Claude surface areas (API, Claude Code, Cowork) to drive full value from contracted commitments

  • Serve as the customer’s thought partner, enhancing their knowledge of Claude products by socializing Anthropic’s product roadmap, driving awareness on new products and engaging Product PMs

  • Develop and execute change management strategies to drive end-user adoption and maximize value within customer organizations, including Train the Trainer programs, Center of Excellence development, and organizational enablement

  • Ruthlessly prioritize across the account's many business units and workstreams, building programmatic, repeatable motions

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • 6+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, or Strategy Consulting

  • Experience working with F500 technology companies, SaaS platforms, or digital-first businesses at the exec level—ideally including high-growth and established tech companies.

  • You understand what it means to lead organization-wide change or adoption programs (multiple functions, hundreds of users) for a product that requires C-suite sponsorship

  • Technical fluency with ability to understand and articulate AI/ML concepts, API integrations, and software implementation patterns across a set of diverse stakeholders—from developers and product managers to executives and end users

  • Proven track record managing a portfolio of accounts while maintaining strong relationships and driving measurable outcomes — you can run multiple enterprise motions in parallel without letting any account go quiet.

  • Cross-functional collaborator who represents the customer in a positive, proactive manner, rallying everyone around paths forward that solve customer needs

  • Passion for AI and interest in responsible development of advanced systems. You have built with Claude Code, automating your own workflows with agents, skills, and tooling.

  • A knack for bringing order to chaos and an enthusiastic "roll up your sleeves" mentality

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$200,000—$265,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Battery Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril is seeking an experienced Engineer with expertise in energy storage subsystem development. Looking for a self-starter with technical experience in defense, aerospace, industrial or electrification industries to apply their skills to meet Anduril’s unique set of challenges. This individual will be responsible for energy storage development and integration, from concept to production, while ensuring alignment with strategic business goals. The engineer could also be involved in managing key vendor relationships, and ensuring performance and reliability in our cutting-edge technologies.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Develop energy storage system (ESS) architecture; guiding design decisions in ESS venting, thermal management & shielding, interconnects & harnessing, housing and encapsulation.
  • ESS bring-up, test, debug and integration with the system.
  • Provide support and collaborate within others for mission profile constraints.
  • Vendor interactions and evaluation to support sourcing for ESS components.
  • Participate in cross-discipline design reviews involving ESS systems.
  • Support root cause analysis in field operations.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or fundamental Physical Sciences with applied application focus on energy storage technologies, with 5+ years of experience designing, testing, and troubleshooting energy storage systems.
  • Understanding of UN38.3, NAVSEA S9310 and/or equivalent (UL, IEC) secondary battery safety standards.
  • Competence with test equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, thermal chambers, current-probes, and automation of tests.
  • Familiarity with common electrochemical energy storage materials, technologies and boundaries of operation.
  • Knowledge of modern battery management system capabilities, failure mode protections and theories of operation.
  • Experience in battery characterization methods: pulse power characterization across SOC, cycle life, safety features, etc.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Graduate Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or fundamental Physical Sciences with a focus on energy storage technologies
    Understanding and familiarity with MIL-STD-882, MIL-STD-810, MIL-STD-704, MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464
US Salary Range
$142,000—$188,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

 

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. 

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

 

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/. 

 

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Senior L&D Specialist
jobs.location: Atlanta, GA - Hybrid; Denver, CO - Hybrid; New York, NY - Hybrid; San Francisco, CA - Hybrid; Scottsdale, AZ - Hybrid
jobs.description:
About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role:

Our CX Learning & Development team is dedicated to building an exceptional customer experience by equipping our CX professionals with the skills they need to thrive. This role carries real scope and visibility in a fast-paced environment. You will own our new hire program from design through results, facilitate live cohorts both in person and virtually, and work directly with senior leaders to align learning with business priorities. We are looking for someone with a proven record in robust course design, live facilitation, program management, and stakeholder partnership, who uses data to measure impact and continuously improve what they build. You will also help integrate AI-enabled approaches into our learning programs, evaluating where they add value and measuring the results.

About the Team:

This role is part of our Learning & Development team, within our Customer Experience organization. Gusto’s CX organization is the linchpin of a world-class customer experience, with industry-leading NPS and more than 500,000 customers who rely on us for payroll, benefits, and HR. With their passion, insight, and customer advocacy, the CX team keeps small businesses running with confidence, and our L&D team makes sure every person on it is set up to do their best work. We strive to positively influence millions of businesses and hundreds of millions of employees across the country.

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

Facilitation

  • Facilitate in-person, virtual, and hybrid learning sessions, including live new hire cohorts, across at least six distinct and complex knowledge areas, demonstrating a deep understanding of subject matter and the ability to tailor delivery for various audience levels, including mid & senior leadership participants.
  • Take the lead in creating an inclusive and dynamic learning environment that challenges participants to apply critical thinking and problem-solving skills in real-world scenarios.
  • Actively engage learners through interactive techniques, real-world examples, and structured activities that reinforce course content and objectives.
  • Provide feedback & coaching to learners in real-time, offering guidance and support to enhance their understanding and skills development.
  • Design and facilitate sessions that teach CX teams how to use AI tools responsibly and effectively in their daily workflows.
  • Leverage AI-assisted tools to enhance participation and personalization during live training.
  • Uses insights from AI-driven learning platforms to tailor discussions, provide targeted feedback, and reinforce learning outcomes.

Instructional Design & Communications

  • Lead comprehensive course design efforts, driving innovation and continuous improvement in learning materials and methods to ensure they meet the evolving needs of the CX team and broader business.
  • Take full ownership of content development, acting as the final point of quality control for course content updates and ensuring that all learning materials are aligned with strategic business goals.
  • Develop and manage high-level communication strategies for learning initiatives, collaborating with leadership and cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and stakeholder buy-in.
  • Integrate AI-enabled design approaches into curriculum development to improve personalization, scalability, and learner engagement.
  • Uses AI-enabled authoring tools to rapidly prototype, script, and iterate on training materials.

Program Management

  • Manage complex, high-visibility learning programs from end to end, with full accountability for program success, continuous improvement, and alignment with business outcomes.
  • Oversee multiple new hire cohorts, including CX Academy, simultaneously, ensuring efficient cohort management and providing strategic guidance on program implementation and learner success.
  • Monitor participant progress and engagement, proactively identifying and addressing potential barriers to success.
  • Identify and drive improvements across programs, utilizing feedback from participants and stakeholders to evolve learning offerings and ensure continued alignment with business goals.
  • Operationalize AI tools to automate repetitive program administration tasks where appropriate.
  • Implement AI-assisted project tracking, communication, and reporting tools to streamline coordination and status visibility.

Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as a primary contact for high-level stakeholders, developing and maintaining strategic relationships to ensure learning programs are aligned with business priorities.
  • Collaborate with senior leadership and department heads, providing expert consultation to design learning initiatives that directly support organizational growth and CX effectiveness.
  • Influence and negotiate with stakeholders at all levels, ensuring alignment between learning objectives and business needs, while also representing the voice of the CX L&D team in broader strategic discussions.
  • Use AI-supported data visualization and summary tools to synthesize stakeholder feedback and present actionable insights.
  • Communicates the value and limitations of AI-assisted solutions to stakeholders, ensuring transparency and alignment with organizational standards.

Data & Analytics

  • Own the learning data strategy for key programs, using sophisticated data analysis to assess program effectiveness, identify trends, and provide strategic insights to leadership.
  • Lead data-driven decision-making by tracking key performance indicators (KPIs) such as learner progress, program impact, and ROI, using this data to continuously optimize learning experiences.
  • Support other team members in developing their data analysis skills, helping them to understand and apply the Kirkpatrick Model of Training Evaluation data to their own work.
  • Leverage AI-derived insights to personalize learning and measure AI-enabled program effectiveness.
  • Leverages AI-powered analytics dashboards to identify learning trends, skill gaps, and opportunities for performance support.
  • Translates AI-derived insights into clear, actionable recommendations for program optimization.

Here’s what we're looking for:

  • 5+ years of L&D experience required.
  • Ability to travel up to 50% of the time.
  • Proactive, solution-oriented mindset with excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Adaptability and a continuous learning mindset, demonstrated by adjusting programs and sessions in real time, incorporating feedback and data, and managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.
  • Proven experience in learning program design, development, and facilitation across multiple knowledge areas, including building content from scratch with a learner-centered view of how it shapes the learner experience.
  • Strong coaching skills, with the ability to mentor learners and participants as well as junior team members.
  • Expertise in managing end-to-end learning programs, including cohort management, tracking learner progress, proactive outreach to at-risk learners, and continuous improvement.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with a track record of building strong relationships and aligning learning initiatives with business goals.
  • Data-driven mindset, with the ability to analyze program outcomes and use insights for continuous enhancement.
  • Strategic thinker with a passion for driving business impact through learning and development.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • ​​Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and evaluating AI-enabled learning solutions.
  • Demonstrated experimentation with AI applications in learning, communication, or content design.
  • Technical and AI-related skills:
    • Practical experience with modern AI tools and workflows used in L&D. Familiarity with LLMs, prompt engineering, and APIs/integrations.
    • Familiarity with AI tools that support content creation, data analysis, or learner engagement.
    • Ability to prompt and fine-tune AI tools to produce high-quality, relevant, and brand-aligned outputs.
    • Skilled in balancing automation with human creativity, ensuring learning experiences remain empathetic and human-centered.
    • Experience evaluating or implementing AI-enabled learning platforms.

Our cash compensation amount for this role is $85,955/yr to $107,000/yr in Denver, Scottsdale & Atlanta, and $110,640/yr to $130,000/yr for San Francisco & New York. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate location, experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.

At Gusto, we don't use titles the traditional way, as a signal of rank or hierarchy. Instead, our titles describe two things at once — your craft (what you do, e.g. Engineering, Design) and your scope of ownership (what you're accountable for) — which is why you'll see something like "Head of X" instead of a rank word like "Director" that tells you neither. Because of this, the title on this posting may look different from what you'd expect based on the scope and seniority of the role, and from how similar roles are typically titled elsewhere. If you have questions about how this role compares to your current title or level, your recruiter can help translate.

Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.

Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas.
