jobs.title: Senior Commercial Paralegal - Contracts Manager
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators. 

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there. 

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Roblox is seeking a collaborative, service-minded Senior Commercial Contracts Manager to draft and negotiate NDAs and SOWs and to help improve how the business submits contracts to Legal. This role reports to the Director, Commercial Contracts and focuses on drafting, contract lifecycle management (CLM) and process improvements. You will work closely with cross-functional teams including Finance, Security, and Privacy, and you may be the first and only point of contact many colleagues have with Legal, so strong soft skills are essential to your success. 

You Will:

  • Draft, redline, and execute NDAs and SOWs using approved templates, playbooks, and fallback positions, escalating to attorneys when needed.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams including Finance, Security, and Privacy to gather approvals, streamline the contract submission process, and remove bottlenecks for clients.
  • Collaborate seamlessly across internal company divisions (such as Engineering, Infrastructure, Marketing, and People Ops) and engage with internal partners from frontline support and EAs to C-level executives setting clear expectations and keeping them informed.
  • Manage the contract lifecycle through DocuSign, run related-party and export control checks, and maintain the contract repository and templates.
  • Partner with Legal Ops to scope and build AI Agents that automate contract intake, review and search. 

You Have:

  • Bachelor’s degree, paralegal certificate or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years drafting and negotiating commercial contracts (NDAs, SOWs) in a corporate legal or tech environment, with sound judgment about when to escalate.
  • Hands-on experience with CLM and intake tools (such as Zip, DocuSign, and Glean) and a track record of improving contracting workflows. 
  • Experience with AI or automation tools (such as Claude or GC-AI).
  • Working knowledge of privacy, data protection, and security considerations in commercial contracts.

You Are:

  • Responsive, collaborative communicator with a strong customer-service orientation, who translates complex legal concepts into clear, actionable guidance for business partners and works effectively with minimal supervision. 
  • Detail-oriented, structured problem-solver who prioritizes effectively, moves efficiently from issue to resolution, and keeps work on track without losing sight of the end goal. 
  • Nimble, high-throughput contributor who excels at managing a steady influx of requests, applying quick-judgment, light-touch evaluations to unblock cross-functional partners efficiently.
  • Curious, continuous learner who identifies opportunities to streamline workflows, reduce unnecessary friction, and improve operational efficiency.  

For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page.

Annual Salary Range
$131,820—$161,490 USD

Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.

For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

jobs.title: Entry-level Auto Technician
jobs.description:
We’re looking for Automotive Mechanics with a minimum of 6 months of professional automotive repair experience to join us at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500.

As an Entry-Level Technician, you’ll be expected to perform light maintenance, fluid checks, and/or conduct the initial inspection on our vehicles to look for any imperfections or repairs that may be needed throughout the reconditioning process.

At Carvana, you’ll receive a competitive wage and amazing perks – including a 401(k) with Carvana match and even a vehicle purchase discount – all while using state of the art tools in one of our high-tech Inspection Centers (click here to learn more). If you’re joining us in an entry-level position, we offer training programs to make sure your skills and pay progress along with the company.

Other perks of the Job

  • 100% company-paid healthcare premiums
  • Generous paid-time off and your birthday is a holiday!
  • ASE and tool reimbursement programs
  • Tuition reimbursement and student loan repayment

We do everything we can to deliver an exceptional customer experience, and that includes delivering great vehicles when expected. If we're in a pinch, mandatory overtime is one way in which we can follow-through on this commitment to our customers. We're looking for team players who are all in on our mission and are able to work mandatory overtime based on our business needs. 

How To Get Started
Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 508-4749, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM MST.

Not a match for this role?
We have a variety of Technician roles in our Inspection Centers, depending on your level of experience - take a look below to see what you’ll be doing to help us get our low-mileage, late-model cars ready for our customers:

  • Entry-Level Auto Technician (min 6 months professional experience): perform light maintenance, fluid checks, and/or conduct the initial inspection on our vehicles to look for any imperfections or repairs that may be needed throughout the reconditioning process.
  • Brake and Tire Technician (min 1 year professional experience): perform light maintenance or repairs, including changing brakes and tires
  • Mid-Level (Mechanical Repair / Build / General) Technician (min 3 years of professional experience): perform light to medium automotive repairs and minimal diagnostics on our vehicles
  • Experienced Technician (min 5 years of professional experience): perform extensive repairs and heavy engine work, as well as advanced vehicle diagnostics on all makes and models, including electric and hybrid vehicles

We also have a variety of other automotive roles available in one of our 18 locations across the country – take a look at our Careers site to apply for one of the following roles:

  • Auto Body roles: Paint, Prep/Body work, Wheel Repair, Airbrush, Interior Repair, Glass Repair, and PDR (Paintless Dent Repair) roles
  • Auto Technician/Mechanic roles: Lube and Oil, Inspection, Brake and Tire, Mechanical Repair / Build, and Master Technician roles
  • Entry-Level roles: Detailing, Inventory Associate (Car Porters), Photo, Parts Associate, Inspection, and Coordinator/Administrator roles

General qualifications and requirements

  • Ability to physically operate vehicle equipment and tools - must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently
  • Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Some positions may be subject to an Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check
  • An ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing production environment while sometimes being exposed to excessive weather conditions (heat/cold)
  • Use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment

About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Information Security
jobs.description:
About Carvana

At Carvana, we’re changing the way people buy and sell cars. With an ambitious vision and a fundamentally different approach designed to be fun, fast, and fair, Carvana became the fastest-growing automotive retailer in history. We expanded nationally, went public on the New York Stock Exchange, sold our 1 millionth car, and reached the Fortune 500, all in just eight years.

Today, with 4 million retail customers and counting, Carvana is both the fastest-growing and the most profitable public automotive retailer, and we’re just getting started. We continue to raise the bar for our customers as we tackle the enormous opportunity still ahead in the largest consumer vertical.

Working here means being part of a team that embraces change, celebrates creative problem solving, and always strives to be better. At Carvana, you’ll have the opportunity to take on meaningful challenges, learn quickly, and help shape the future of automotive retail. About the team and position

You will be responsible for evaluating, managing and maintaining our security technologies. 

What you’ll be doing

  • Design and document security architecture patterns, reference designs, and standards for cloud, application, data, identity, and network environments.
  • Perform security architecture reviews of new products, platforms, and vendor solutions, and turn findings into practical, risk-based guidance for engineering and business partners.

  • Contribute to the security technology roadmap and align architecture decisions with business priorities and risk appetite.
  • Maintain various security technologies across the enterprise to ensure that the technologies are operational and providing value to the organization.
  • Leverage the information from disparate security technologies to improve our security risk posture.
  • Engineer solutions that can drive automated response to known security risks, when appropriate.
  • Leverage artificial intelligence (AI) to build and optimize our security technologies, including detection, triage, enrichment, and response workflows.

  • Define security architecture and guardrails for enterprise AI adoption, including access control, data handling, logging, monitoring, and human oversight.
  • Partner with engineering, data, legal, and privacy teams to establish practical AI security standards that enable the business to move fast with managed risk.
  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to drive risk reduction using a risk-based approach.
  • Identify and address risks in the organization and partner with teams to close the gaps.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and determine whether new investments are required.
  • Identify and implement additional use cases to automate repetitive or operational tasks using our agentic AI solution.

What you should have

  • Proven experience in managing a diverse and wide range of enterprise security technologies. 
  • Strong proficiency in scripting and software development languages for API integration.
  • Experience designing AI-driven automation or integrating AI/LLM capabilities into operational workflows. 
  • Demonstrated experience in security architecture, including threat modeling, reference architecture design, and architecture reviews across cloud and enterprise environments.
  • Working knowledge of AI and LLM security risks and frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework.
  • Ability to communicate risk and design tradeoffs clearly to both technical teams and business leaders.
  • Deep understanding of RESTful APIs and experience integrating various security tools.
  • Proven experience in securing a complex, diverse, distributed technology footprint. 

It would be great if you also had

jobs.title: Manager, PLG & Agent-led Growth
jobs.description:
Manager, PLG & Agent-led Growth

People no longer have to learn complex systems anymore. They ask Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and then let them set it up for them. Supabase says over 60% of its new databases are launched by AI tools, and agent-created databases at Neon are at 80%.

SingleStore is still built for a person clicking through our portal. AI & Agents do not reach for us often enough, and when they do, they struggle to sign up, load data, and get to a working query without a human. That is the problem this role exists to solve.

You will own product-led growth and agent-led growth at SingleStore. That means making SingleStore the database that AI answer engines recommend, that agents pick, and that agents and people can get running on their own data in minutes. You will also turn that usage into revenue through data & product-led sales.

You will report to our VP of Growth, work closely with our Chief Marketing Officer and product team, and have visibility into the CEO. On the growth team, you will partner with our Senior GTM Engineer, Lifecycle Ops, and marketing team members.

Role and responsibilities:
Own agent-led growth end to end: agent preference (agents know, trust, and pick SingleStore) and agent experience (an agent can sign up, set up, load data, and reach a working query without our UI).Own answer engine optimization (AEO) strategy so ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity name and cite SingleStore correctly, and turn those findings into content, docs, and product work.
Drive AI-assisted onboarding with product to ensure users have the option
Write PRDs and work with Product, Engineering, Design, and Docs on the work that makes us agent-ready: our MCP server and its listings, connectors and integrations with AI app builders, and docs an agent can follow.
Improve the journey from web to sign up to self-serve revenue
Run product-led sales with our SEs and Sales team: use trial and on-demand usage signals to start conversations that deliver value, like a tuned query, and turn them into pipeline and revenue.
Create or direct technical content that drives AEO and agent preference, such as sample apps on GitHub, technical videos, and database comparisons, with our content team.
Help drive product marketing positioning across marketing campaigns
Define hypotheses, run experiments, and report on the growth metrics that matter: MQLs, active users, agent-created orgs, AI share of voice, and new logo pipeline.
What success looks like in your first 90 days
SingleStore's mention and citation rate in AI answers is up across our tracked prompts, with correct positioning.
SingleStore is listed where agents look for tools, including the official MCP registry and AI connector directories.
Agents complete most steps of a headless SingleStore setup, locally and in the cloud, and we can report agent-created orgs as their own segment.

Position requirements:
5+ years in product management or product marketing, growth, or technical growth roles, with at least 2 years in product-led growth or self-serve B2B software
Hands-on with AI agents and coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and MCP. You build prototypes yourself, even if you vibe code them
A track record of shipping onboarding, acquisition, or monetization experiments with measurable results
Proficient with AI tooling
Strong analytical skills, comfortable with data analysis and product analytics tools like Mixpanel
Able to write clearly and lead R&D
Understands how developers evaluate infrastructure, and how SEO, AEO, and technical content influence that evaluation
Excellent communication skills, able to work across Product, Marketing, and Sales and synthesize insights for executives
Comfortable in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment where curiosity and a bias for action are valued
Flexible schedule, as teammates work across PST, CST, EST, GMT, and WET time zones
Nice to have: experience at a database, data infrastructure, or developer tools company, or with product-led sales

About us:

SingleStore delivers the cloud-native database with the speed and scale to power the world’s data-intensive applications. With a distributed SQL database that introduces simplicity to your data architecture by unifying transactions and analytics, SingleStore empowers digital leaders to deliver exceptional, real-time data experiences to their customers. SingleStore is venture-backed and headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Sunnyvale, Raleigh, Seattle, Boston, London, Lisbon, Bangalore, Dublin and Kyiv. 

Consistent with our commitment to diversity & inclusion, we value individuals with the ability to work on diverse teams and with a diverse range of people.

To all recruitment agencies: SingleStore does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to SingleStore employees. SingleStore is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company.

SingleStore is the real-time database for AI, apps, and analytics. Teams use it to transact, analyze, and search their data in one place, in real time, so their applications and AI agents act on fresh data at scale. Customers worldwide, including Fortune 500 companies, run real-time AI applications and analytics on SingleStore. We are headquartered in San Francisco, with teams across the Americas, Europe, and Asia. 

We are committed to diversity and inclusion, and we value people who do their best work on diverse teams and with a diverse range of people.

Remote: UK, Europe, or USA

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Anduril Rocket Motor Systems (RMS) team is on a mission to build next generation solid rocket motors for a safer, more connected world. To achieve our vision of becoming a large-volume provider of tactical rocket motors, we will develop differentiated products and services that maximize our customers’ capabilities, and we will establish and maintain a reputation of Quality and Reliability.

ABOUT THE JOB

As the Sr. Electrical Engineer, you will specify, design, develop and install devices used to collect data on solid rocket motor burn performance. Additionally, you will design custom electronic solutions—including PCBs, firmware, and FPGA code—needed to manufacture and test solid rocket motors, which will include working with integrated safety-critical designs. This position also requires the ability to configure data collection systems and develop software applications used to collect the data. It is expected that you may oversee technicians during the instrumentation installation and during rocket motor testing/development. The right person for this role has direct, hands-on experience with the design, development, and installation of sensors used to collect a variety of metrics related to testing of solid rocket motors. If you are a hands-on leader, have an entrepreneurial spirit, and enjoy being the point person for collecting valuable performance data, then this role is for you. You will assist in the testing solid rocket motors which will include working with integrated safety designs used to initiate the motor.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Develops comprehensive safety data packages, hazard analyses, and compliance matrices; presents and defends ESAD/ISD architectures before government and customer safety review boards (e.g., FSRB, AFSRB, SSSTC, or Range Safety).
  • Plans, executes, and oversees developmental and formal qualification test campaigns (thermal, vibration/shock, EMI/EMC, vacuum, and functional) for ESAD and ISD hardware in accordance with military and aerospace standards.
  • Ensures full lifecycle traceability and flow-down of system-level safety requirements into hardware architectures in strict alignment with MIL-STD-1901A and other relevant specifications .
  • Collaborates with other electrical engineers to execute the safe arming and initiation of rocket motors under test.
  • Creates detailed block diagrams schematics and simulated models to test designs; optimizes designs for performance, reliability, and cost.
  • Acts as project engineer for design, prototype fabrication, and manufacturing development for ISD and ESADs designs.
  • Develops required cable drawings to interface to various low- and high-voltage systems connections to ISDs and ESADs
  • Drafts and presents formal technical documents, reports, and testing results to manager for approval.
  • Provides training related to devices to employees and/or customers.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.Demonstrated working knowledge and application of MIL-STD-1901 (Munition Rocket and Missile Motor Igniter Safety Criteria) and related safety design standards (e.g., MIL-STD-1316, MIL-STD-882, or STANAG 4187).
  • Prior experience authoring safety compliance documentation (SARs, hazard reports, fault trees) and successfully presenting to DoD/Service Safety Review Boards (e.g., Igniter/Fuze Safety Review Boards).
  • Proven track record leading or supporting the formal qualification process for Ignition Safety Devices (ISD), Electronic Safe and Arm Devices (ESAD), or comparable safety-critical energetic firing systems.Experience in directing high-voltage PCB layout and circuit design for motor initiation, including capacitor charging/discharge circuits, high peak-current switching, and creepage/clearance management
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite and proficient with computer-aided design software.
  • Ability to write and understand Python
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Advanced degree in engineering
  • Experience with circuit simulation tools (spice)
  • Experience using EDA tools such as Altium/Or CAD
  • Familiar with real-time computer architectures and their OS’s

 

US Salary Range
$87,000—$170,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

 

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. 

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

 

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/. 

 

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Software Test & Validation
jobs.description:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

Position Summary: 

At Redwood Materials, we are moving beyond battery recycling to build the most advanced, circular energy ecosystem on the planet—shifting the industry from static, hardware-heavy infrastructure toward agile, software-defined energy assets. The Software Test and Validation organization is the ultimate gatekeeper of quality, reliability, and operational readiness across our entire hardware and software portfolio. 

As the Senior Manager for Software Test & Validation, you will build and lead the engineering teams responsible for four mission-critical pillars: Power Electronics and Site-Level SIL/HIL Simulation, Manufacturing Test Software, Site Commissioning Tooling, and Fleet Data Analytics for Preventive & Predictive Maintenance. You are the bridge between pure code, factory production, and long-term grid reliability. We are looking for a hands-on technical leader who can architect high-fidelity real-time simulation plants, scalable factory test frameworks, and predictive fleet health models alongside their engineers—driving quality across multiple concurrent hardware programs from R&D bring-up through volume manufacturing and multi-year field operations. 

This position is based in our San Francisco office and operates on an onsite work model. 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities 

Multi-Level SIL & HIL Validation Architecture 

  • Power Electronics & Site-Level Simulation: Direct the architecture and scaling of our Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) infrastructure (Typhoon HIL, Opal-RT) across both sub-microsecond power conversion stages and multi-asset, site-level controllers. 
  • Custom HIL Hardware & Plant Modeling: Oversee the design of custom signal-conditioning interface hardware, fault-injection panels, and high-fidelity virtual plant models (battery arrays, resonant DC/DC and multi-level AC/DC converters, and dynamic grid conditions) to stress-test embedded firmware and site software before field deployment. 
  • Continuous Verification & CI/CD: Integrate automated SIL and HIL regression suites into containerized CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions/Jenkins, Docker), serving as the definitive release gate for all production-bound embedded Rust, C/C++, and site-level software. 

Manufacturing Software & Factory Test 

  • Production Line Software: Lead the development of automated manufacturing test software and end-of-line (EOL) functional test frameworks for multiple Redwood hardware product lines, including our custom Power Conversion Systems (PCS) and energy storage enclosures. 
  • Factory-to-Engineering Integration: Build reliable firmware flashing, hardware calibration, serialization, and automated pass/fail diagnostics systems that scale from low-volume prototype builds (EVT/DVT) to high-volume factory production. 

Site Commissioning & Predictive Fleet Analytics 

  • Commissioning Tooling: Architect and deliver intuitive, automated field commissioning tools that streamline site bring-up, verify hardware-software wiring and communications (CAN, Modbus TCP, Ethernet, SPI), and execute automated site acceptance testing (SAT) for new energy storage deployments. 
  • Preventive & Predictive Maintenance Analytics: Lead the architecture of fleet-wide data analytics frameworks and time-series observability pipelines (e.g., InfluxDB, Prometheus, Grafana, Python) that ingest continuous telemetry from deployed field assets to drive preventive and predictive maintenance.

jobs.title: Senior Battery Data Engineer
jobs.description:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

Position Summary: 

The Senior Battery Data Engineer develops the software stack that powers Redwood's battery characterization program, spanning data pipelines, hardware control services, and workflows that connect test data to downstream modeling and analysis. This is a fully on-site role at 100 Hooper. As the software stack matures, this role has the opportunity to shape it into a deterministic tool-calling layer, leveraging it to build an AI agent co-pilot that accelerates the characterization workflow, with evals co-developed alongside battery domain experts. This role sits at the intersection of data infrastructure and systems automation, building the foundational software that powers battery modeling, algorithm, and qualification efforts.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities 

  • Own the data infrastructure that serves large-scale battery time-series data from battery cyclers to cloud storage
  • Contribute to the software services that orchestrate testing using commercial lab battery cyclers and in-house field-level power converters located at production sites
  • Develop and maintain the tool layer for battery testing, such as structured protocol schemas, cycler control APIs, real-time battery test anomaly detection, and digital twin simulation
  • Partner with battery test and algorithm engineers to identify inefficiencies, then design and build software or agentic workflows to automate them, utilizing the deterministic tool layer above
  • Collaborate with domain experts to define agent eval suites and correctness criteria as agentic automation is introduced 

Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities  

  • BS or MS in Engineering (Mechanical, Chemical, Materials, Electrical), or a related field
  • Strong software development skills in Python, including building production services, data pipelines, and APIs
  • Familiarity with battery testing and cycler platforms (e.g., Arbin, Maccor, Neware)
  • Experience with cloud data infrastructure (e.g., AWS, GCP, or Azure) for storing, processing, and serving large-scale time-series data
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills; proactive in working directly with stakeholders to identify workflow bottlenecks and turn them into actionable software priorities
  • Bonus: proficiency in Rust for building production services; experience building AI agent harnesses and eval suites; understanding of lithium-ion cell behavior and safety considerations; experience with AI coding assistants like Cursor or Claude Code 

In accordance with California pay transparency laws, the salary range for this position is listed below. Actual compensation may vary based on a variety of factors, including experience, education, and skills. 

California Pay Range:
$172,500—$198,000 USD

The position is full-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

We collect your PI for our purposes, including performing services and operations related to your potential employment. If you have additional privacy-related questions, please contact us at privacy@redwoodmaterials.com.

jobs.description:
About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About the Role:

We're looking for an experienced, hands-on leader to build, coach, and scale a team of Startup Account Executives focused on growing and scaling our largest and fastest-growing startup customers. These companies are often doubling usage in months, shipping AI-native products, and making decisions that will shape their architecture for years. Your team will be their strategic partner through that growth.

You'll hire, mentor, and develop top talent, and roll up your sleeves to work deals alongside the team. You'll help customers deepen adoption, expand into new use cases across Vercel's platform and Agent Stack, and move to commercial structures that fit their scale. By using AI and automation to maximize your team's impact, you'll turn expansion wins into repeatable playbooks across the startup segment.

If you’re based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday. If you're located beyond that distance, the role is fully remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.

About Startups at Vercel:

Vercel Startups partners with founders from the first line of code through hypergrowth. Startups move faster than ever, and the infrastructure decisions they make early either unlock scale or become long-term constraints. The Install Base team partners with our largest and fastest-growing startup customers, helping them scale on Vercel as usage, teams, and ambitions grow, and making sure Vercel stays the foundation they build on as they move toward enterprise.

We're a talent-dense team of former founders, engineers, and go-to-market operators. Many of us have sat on the other side of the table making architectural tradeoffs under real constraints, and we bring that perspective into every conversation. We operate with high trust, high agency, and shared ownership: curious, resilient, and willing to push through hard problems to help startups win.

 

What You Will Do:

  • Scale the business

    • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Solutions Architects, Product, Marketing, RevOps, and the Activations and Greenfield teams so customers get what they need to grow and succeed on Vercel.
    • Data-Driven Management: Use usage and growth signals to prioritize accounts, track performance against goals, forecast accurately, and drive continuous improvement in execution.

About You:

  • 5+ years of SaaS sales experience, ideally in mid-market or high-growth segments, including 2+ years managing Account Executives.
  • A full-cycle seller who has generated outbound pipeline, run proofs of concept, and multi-threaded across technical and business stakeholders. You have a history of closing large, complex six-figure-plus SaaS deals.
  • A proven track record of hiring, coaching, and developing high-performing sales teams.
  • A hands-on leader who thrives as a player-coach.
  • Confident leading conversations about AI, infrastructure, and technical products. You don't need to be an engineer, but you must be credible with technical buyers.
  • Curiosity about AI-native development and the ability to operate in a fast-paced environment, balancing strategy with execution.

 

Bonus If You:

  • Have driven multi-product adoption within existing accounts, growing single-product customers into platform customers.
  • Have experience with usage-based or consumption pricing models.
  • Have strong cross-functional instincts, from scaling a sales motion to sharing insights company-wide.

 

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Inclusive Healthcare Package.

  • Flexible Time Off.

Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. jobs.title: Parts Lead Supervisor - Plainfield - (2nd Shift) - Mon to Thurs
jobs.description:
About Carvana

At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period. To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website. Using our Carvana Certified 150-point inspection process, we’re able to verify that every vehicle meets our rigorous mechanical and cosmetic standards. 

We strive to provide only the highest quality vehicles to our customers in our mission to deliver a no-hassle, better car buying experience. We are actively looking for passionate and talented individuals who can help us deliver on that promise. 

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Keep reading below to see what we’re looking for!

Position Overview:

Automotive Parts Line Lead Supervisor is a front-line supervisor role, responsible for directly managing and developing a team of hourly associates in an Inspection Center to regularly achieve production targets.   Supervisor Reconditioning opportunities include: 

What you will be doing: 

  • Production Line Management: Coordinate and oversee daily operations across multi-stage production lines, ensuring safety, efficiency, and daily output targets are met.

  • Cross-Functional Workflow: Manage the seamless movement of automotive inventory and materials through various phases of the production cycle, from initial technical assembly to final finishing and quality inspection.

  • Team Leadership: Lead, train, and mentor a diverse team of technicians, operators, and specialists across multiple workstations, fostering a culture of high performance and accountability.

  • Quality Control & Finishing: Enforce rigorous quality assurance standards, ensuring all products meet exact aesthetic, structural, and functional specifications before final documentation and release.

  • Process Optimization: Monitor production pipelines to identify bottlenecks, optimize material staging, and streamline transitions between different operational zones.

  • Continuous Improvement: Actively participate in and champion process improvements, workflow standardizations, and root-cause problem solving on the floor.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Proven supervisory or lead experience within a high-volume manufacturing, production, or assembly environment.

  • LEAN Manufacturing Experience: Working knowledge of LEAN principles (e.g., 5S, Kaizen, Six Sigma, Kanban) with a demonstrated ability to identify waste and implement continuous improvement initiatives on the production floor.

  • Experience overseeing diverse operational processes, including mechanical assembly, inventory handling, and aesthetic/finishing stages.

 

What the job requires:
 

Basic Prerequisites You must be at least 18 years old with a High School Diploma or GED, basic computer skills, and a valid driver’s license with a clean record (no DUIs and a maximum of two moving violations in the last three years). 

Physical Demands & Work Environment This is a hands-on, physically active role. You will need to independently lift up to 60 pounds and stand for extended periods while frequently walking, stooping, reaching, and pushing or pulling. The production environment can be loud, wet, and subject to extreme temperatures, vehicle fumes, or odors. You will be required to wear standard personal protective equipment, such as non-slip shoes, gloves, and safety eyewear.

Professional Skills & Scheduling Expect a fast-paced, high-volume operation. You must be able to multitask, delegate workloads effectively, and resolve complex issues with guidance. Clear, professional communication—both written and verbal—is essential for interacting with your team. Flexibility is required, as you must be available to work variable schedules, including overtime and weekends as needed.

Carvana provides reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

 

What we’ll offer in return:

  • Full-Time Position with a competitive salary
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
  • 401K with company match
  • A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more
  • A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy, both physically and mentally
  • Access to opportunities to expand your skillset and share your knowledge with others across the organization
  • A company culture of promotions from within, with a start-up atmosphere allowing for varied and rapid career development
  • A seat in one of the fastest-growing companies in the country

Legal stuff

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check.  This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer.  All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.  Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

jobs.description:

About Carvana

At Carvana, we believe buying a car the old-fashioned way sucks — so we're rewriting the playbook. Yes, we're the vending machine people. Yes, we built that on purpose. And yes, we're just getting started.

We're looking for people who want to thrive in an environment of impactful change. Team spirit shows up in everything we do — every day, our passion and creativity drive the kind of innovation that moves an industry. We take big swings, set ambitious goals, and challenge each other to make data- and process-driven decisions in everything we do. Here are a few of our stories. We've been changing the game since 2013, and we're not letting up. Want the full story? Check it out here.

About the team and position

Our Safe & Secure team is the heartbeat of every Carvana location. You're the people we trust to protect our associates, our customers, and the thousands of vehicles that flow through our gates every day. Rain, shine, ice, or 110° heat — the mission doesn't change, and neither does the standard.

This is a boots-on-the-ground role. We bring the strategy; you bring the hustle. From clearing snow during a winter storm to running heat-safety protocols in July, you'll be the reason our site stays open, safe, and moving. Some days you'll be at the gate — the literal face of Carvana to every associate, vendor, and visitor walking through it. Other days, you'll be out on the lot scanning vehicles, knocking out safety audits, or restocking the supplies that keep this place humming.

You won't just monitor a perimeter — you'll own it. That means spotting hazards before they become incidents, building real relationships with the folks on site, and stepping up when something needs your attention. You'll be trained and trusted to act in emergencies, partner with our Inspection Center and Logistics teams, and feed sharp, accurate intel back to your Safe & Secure leadership. Hourly position, reporting to your Safe & Secure Functional Lead or Manager.

What you’ll be doing

  • Lead with a service-first mindset in every interaction.
  • Live the Carvana values — and make sure they're felt by everyone you work with.
  • Be the face of Carvana at the gate for associates, vendors, and visitors.
  • Communicate like a pro — clear, calm, active listener, no missed signals.
  • Use our Unified Security Platform to monitor live cameras, review footage, and investigate intrusion alerts so nothing on site catches us off guard.
  • When things get hot, keep it cool. De-escalate, win with partners, and remember — we're all in this together.
  • Run point at the gate using the Safe & Secure App (SAS App) and RFID tech, enforcing ingress/egress procedures every single time.
  • Manage and document vehicle movement through the Inspection Center entrance and exit gates.
  • Show up when the team needs you. You'll be trained and certified in first aid, CPR, and AED — and we expect you to use it when the moment calls for it.
  • Know our emergency protocols cold so you can act decisively when seconds count.
  • Keep the site operational in any weather — snow removal in winter, heat-safety protocols in summer, no excuses, no shortcuts.
  • Drive a safety-first culture by spotting environmental hazards, running safety audits, and reinforcing best practices with the people around you.
  • Scan thousands of vehicles a day to keep operational flow tight — between mobile rover tech and manual handheld scans, every car gets accounted for.
  • Cover ground. This role involves serious walking to reach restricted or hard-to-access areas of the lot.
  • Run vehicle location research and deliver clean, detailed reports to leadership when operational questions come up.

Key Metrics: 

  • Unit Loss Rate versus Plan
  • Safe & Secure App Execution
  • Inventory Control/Accuracy and Tracking 
  • Safety Incident Performance

What you should know/have

  • 1–2 years in a customer service environment
  • Strong verbal and written communication
  • A track record of solid decision-making in a complex, fast-moving environment
  • Ability to build strong working relationships and connect with people quickly
  • Ability to organize, plan, and execute multiple tasks at once in a fast-paced setting
  • Ability to handle conflict in a positive, productive way

We’d love it if you also have

  • Familiarity with CCTV, RFID, Card Access, or other Safe & Secure technology
  • Previous experience supporting an OSHA / Safety Team program
  • Experience with crisis prevention and/or response plans

What we’ll offer in return

  • Full-time hourly position with a competitive wage
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
  • 401(k) with company match
  • A stack of perks — student loan support, vehicle discounts, pet benefits, and a lot more
  • A wellness program built to keep you healthy, physically and mentally
  • Real opportunities to grow your skills and share what you know across the org
  • A promote-from-within culture with a startup feel — career paths can move fast around here
  • A seat at one of the fastest-growing companies in the country

Other requirements

To do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you:

  • Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English
  • Must be at least 18 years of age
  • This position is designated as a safety-sensitive position
  • Must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently; the majority of lifting from knee to shoulder heights; other lifting required from various levels
  • Must be able to carry and transport up to 60 pounds up to 20 feet
  • Requires standing for extended periods of time with frequent stretching, reaching, walking, stooping, pushing, and/or pulling in an environment that may be cold, hot, noisy, and wet, and may have fumes or odors due to vehicle maintenance
  • Requires excellent visual acuity and manual dexterity
  • Requires use of safety equipment that may include, but is not limited to, face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment
  • Requires frequent driving and computer data entry
  • Must adhere to regular and predictable attendance
  • The facility is a 24/7 operation, and gates must be manned at all times

Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

Legal stuff

jobs.description:

The Product team listens to our customers’ needs and translates those insights into a clear product vision. About the role

Millions of people use the Affirm Card, but we don’t yet give them a reason to keep coming back beyond the product itself. You’ll build our consumer loyalty program from scratch: what people earn, how they move up, and why Affirm becomes their default way to pay.

What you’ll do

  • Own the vision and roadmap for Affirm’s consumer loyalty program, setting the hypotheses, success metrics, and sequencing across multiple quarters

  • Launch the first version of rewards and tiers, including earn mechanics, member benefits, redemption, and the surfaces that make the value obvious in app, at checkout, and after a purchase

  • Build the engagement loops (progress, milestones, personalized offers) that turn a one-time borrower into someone who reaches for Affirm every week

  • Own the program economics: reward liability, funding mix across merchant-funded offers, interchange and network incentives, and the case for incremental GMV against cost per member

  • Set up the measurement foundation for loyalty, including holdouts, incrementality testing and long-run LTV, then tune earn and burn rates and tier thresholds off what the data says

  • Partner with Risk, Credit, Legal, Compliance, Finance and Marketing to design rewards that are compliant and clearly disclosed, with no hidden fees or fine print that surprises people

  • 8+ years in Product Management, with a track record in consumer mobile apps, fintech, or neobanks

  • Built or scaled a loyalty, rewards or engagement program: card rewards, points, tiers, subscription benefits, or something equivalent. You know earn and burn mechanics and what makes a program pay for itself

  • History of launching products from scratch, not just optimizing what already exists

  • Owned repeat usage, cohort retention or share of wallet as a primary metric, and know which levers actually move them

  • Comfortable building the financial model yourself and defending reward cost, funding mix and payback to Finance and leadership

  • Strong UX instincts and a high bar for design. You know the difference between a reward that feels good and a badge buried in a settings menu

  • Deep fluency in experiment design, incrementality/attribution, and LTV measurement; data chops (SQL/Amplitude-level self-serve) and a bias for shipping, learning and iterating quickly

  • Track record shipping consumer financial or regulated products; comfort partnering with Risk/Credit, Legal, and Compliance

  • Excellent cross-functional leadership, including experience leading without authority

  • AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and others to research, analyze and prototype, and help develop better product vision

What you will be doing: 

  • Production Line Management: Coordinate and oversee daily operations across multi-stage production lines, ensuring safety, efficiency, and daily output targets are met.

  • Cross-Functional Workflow: Manage the seamless movement of automotive inventory and materials through various phases of the production cycle, from initial technical assembly to final finishing and quality inspection.

  • Team Leadership: Lead, train, and mentor a diverse team of technicians, operators, and specialists across multiple workstations, fostering a culture of high performance and accountability.

  • Quality Control & Finishing: Enforce rigorous quality assurance standards, ensuring all products meet exact aesthetic, structural, and functional specifications before final documentation and release.

  • Process Optimization: Monitor production pipelines to identify bottlenecks, optimize material staging, and streamline transitions between different operational zones.

  • Continuous Improvement: Actively participate in and champion process improvements, workflow standardizations, and root-cause problem solving on the floor.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Proven supervisory or lead experience within a high-volume manufacturing, production, or assembly environment.

  • LEAN Manufacturing Experience: Working knowledge of LEAN principles (e.g., 5S, Kaizen, Six Sigma, Kanban) with a demonstrated ability to identify waste and implement continuous improvement initiatives on the production floor.

  • Experience overseeing diverse operational processes, including mechanical assembly, inventory handling, and aesthetic/finishing stages.

Basic Prerequisites You must be at least 18 years old with a High School Diploma or GED, basic computer skills, and a valid driver’s license with a clean record (no DUIs and a maximum of two moving violations in the last three years).

jobs.title: Hardware Reliability Engineer - Battlespace Awareness
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM:
The Reliability Engineering team partners across Anduril's engineering, manufacturing, and operations organizations to ensure our autonomous systems survive real-world conditions and deliver consistent performance for our customers. Our mandate spans the complete product lifecycle - from early concept design through production scale-up and fielded operations. We use data, statistical methods, and engineering analysis to forecast how our systems will perform over time and influence design decisions, including part selection, redundancy strategies, and maintenance approaches. We establish tailored reliability frameworks by program and partner with Quality to drive design robustness, failure prevention, and rapid response to issues in the field. In Battlespace Awareness, Reliability sits alongside Quality and covers both new products moving through design reviews and products already in production and deployed with customers.

ABOUT THE JOB:
We are seeking an experienced Reliability Engineer to join our team in Fort Collins, CO, driving reliability for our Battlespace Awareness product line. This is a hands-on role focused on embedding reliability into early product architecture and detailed design - from early concept trade studies through design validation and transition to manufacturing. On new product introduction (NPI) programs, you will embed reliability into product architecture and detailed design, from concept trade studies through Critical Design Review, design validation, and transition to manufacturing. On products already in production and in the field, you will own the reliability data: MTBF tracking, field failure analysis, sparing, and the reliability growth that comes from closing the loop with design and production. You'll be the reliability champion throughout the design and development process, working closely with mechanical, electrical, and software engineering teams to ensure designs are robust. Your responsibilities will include conducting reliability predictions and allocations during architecture trades, leading design FMEAs and fault tree analyses to identify and mitigate failure modes, developing and executing design verification test plans, planning and running HALT, HASS, and ESS campaigns, performing stress-derating analysis and parts selection reviews, and assessing design changes for reliability impact throughout the development cycle.
 
The right person for this role brings deep technical knowledge of hardware reliability and failure mechanisms, has practical experience on product development programs, and can engage credibly with design engineers, Anduril's subcontractors, and customer-facing teams on technical details while maintaining focus on system-level reliability outcomes. This role demands someone who can embed early in design cycles, influence engineering decisions with data and analysis, and take ownership of reliability outcomes as designs mature from concept to launch readiness and through years of fielded operation.
 
WHAT YOU'LL DO:
New product introduction (NPI)
  • Own the reliability campaign for each NPI program: plan and execute HALT to find design margins before qualification, then define the HASS and ESS profiles that screen production units, with gates tied to the program's design reviews.
  • Build the reliability evidence for design reviews (PDR, CDR, MRR/PRR): reliability allocations and block diagrams, DFMEA/FMECA, FTA, reliability test plans, and closure of reliability-related review actions.
  • Performing Failure Modes Effects and Criticality Analyses (FMECA) and Fault Detection/Fault Isolation (FDFI) analyses and collaborating cross-functionally to implement product improvements for reliability.
  • Performing predictive reliability analyses to forecast probability of field failures and MTTF/MTBF utilizing Anduril requirements, specifications and relevant industry standards (i.e. MIL-HDBK-217Plus).
  • Partner with Quality, Manufacturing, and contract manufacturers on electronics and PCBA reliability, including derating, parts selection, and screening of new suppliers.
Fielded and production products
  • Own the MTBF methodology for fielded products end to end: what counts as a relevant failure, how operating hours are calculated from fielded-unit records, and a single reported number that internal teams and customers agree on.
  • Run a FRACAS that ties every field failure to a nonconformance or quality ticket and to failure analysis results, including a path for hardware that is replaced in the field and never returns, so failure data stays traceable by serial number.
  • Developing Maintainability prediction models using MIL-HDBK-472 and support the development of Preventative Maintenance and Sparing Plans, including data-driven sparing ratios for deployed systems.
  • Developing and communicating RAM (Reliability, Availability, Maintainability) reports internally and to external parties.
  • Reviewing field failure data and performing Weibull analyses utilizing that data to determine gap to initial model in order to further fine tune and adjust it for further predictions.
  • Collaborate with HW teams and Failure Analysis (FA) labs to investigate the root causes of time-based failures and guide design iterations.
  • Track and model physical and functional degradation parameters (e.g., parameter drift, mechanical wear) over time to predict end-of-life thresholds before actual failures occur.
  • Develop statistical models to project future warranty claims, sustainment costs, and field failure rates, providing data-driven risk assessments across various teams.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
  • 5+ years experience in a hardware-focused Reliability Engineer role, Design/Development Engineer role or Quality Engineering role, with a strong emphasis on life data analysis.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Statistics, Materials Science, or a related technical field.
  • Experience or Familiarity with MIL-STD-810, MIL-HDBK-217, MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-516C, and MIL-STD-1629.
  • Experience setting up a Reliability Engineering framework for a product or program, including support of production testing, field testing, data acquisition, and data analysis.
  • Expertise in reliability analysis techniques, including FMEA/FMECA, predictive modeling, Weibull analysis, and Fault Tree Analysis.
  • Hands-on experience planning and running HALT, HASS, and/or ESS on electronic hardware, and turning the results into design changes and production screens.
  • Experience owning reliability for products already in the field: MTBF tracking, FRACAS, and scrubbing field failure data so the numbers hold up with customers.
  • Familiarity with structured root-cause analysis and problem-solving methodologies (e.g., 8D, 5 Whys, Fishbone diagrams, Kepner-Tregoe) within a CAPA or FRACAS framework.
  • Eligibility to obtain and maintain a US Security Clearance.
  • Design Review Experience (PDR, CDR, MRR) and confident in presentation skills across all levels of leadership.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
  • M.S. Degree in Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Statistics, Materials Science or a related technical field.
  • ASQ Certified Reliability Engineer (CRE).
  • Experience with DO-254, DO-178, MIL-HDBK-217Plus, MIL-HDBK-472, ARP-4754.
  • Experience with Environmental Testing and/or Mechanical Testing.
  • Demonstrated experience with radar, RF, or EO/IR systems.
  • Experience with systems that operate continuously outdoors at fixed sites, and with sparing and sustainment for deployed fleets.
  • Experience working with contract manufacturers on PCBA and box-build reliability. 
US Salary Range
$123,000—$162,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.
