jobs.title: Head of Strategic Accounts, Solutions Architecture
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA or New York, NY or Remote
jobs.description:
Who We Are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the Team

The Solutions Architecture team partners with Stripe’s users to design and build transformative solutions that unlock growth, modernize business models, and shape the future of commerce. We work with executives, product leaders, and engineering teams at the world’s largest and most innovative companies, helping them translate ambitious strategies into scalable solutions on Stripe.

Strategic Accounts Solutions Architecture serves Stripe’s most complex and consequential users. The team combines deep technical expertise, commercial judgment, and customer empathy to solve problems that often have no established playbook. Its work not only helps individual users grow; it also surfaces emerging needs and opportunities that can inform Stripe’s product strategy and create value for users at global scale. These Solution Architects are deeply embedded in these users and are working along as their technical co-founders.

The Head of Strategic Accounts, Solutions Architecture will lead a team of senior architects who are trusted partners to strategic, key, and major accounts. This leader will set the vision for the team, develop exceptional technical talent, and work closely with account leadership to deepen and grow Stripe’s most important relationships. They will also build a strong partnership with Product and Engineering, turning insights from leading-edge customer engagements into the next wave of innovation across Stripe.

This is a highly technical, hands-on leadership role. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between executive conversations, account strategy, architecture reviews, product discussions, and direct support for the team’s most complex engagements. They will be AI-enabled in how they lead and operate, highly curious about new technologies and business models, and committed to helping their team and Stripe continuously raise the bar.

What You’ll Do

Responsibilities

  • Set the vision, strategy, and operating model for Strategic Accounts Solutions Architecture, aligning the team’s priorities with Stripe’s user, product, and business objectives.
  • Recruit, lead, coach, and retain a world-class team of senior Solutions Architects supporting Stripe’s strategic, key, and major accounts.
  • Partner with account leaders to develop and execute technical account strategies that deepen customer relationships, unlock new use cases, and drive durable growth.
  • Lead from the front in the team’s most complex and high-impact engagements, including architecture workshops, executive briefings, solution design, technical evaluations, and critical escalations.
  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor to senior executives, product leaders, and engineering leaders at the world’s largest and most innovative companies.
  • Build a close, durable partnership with Stripe Product and Engineering teams; synthesize patterns from strategic accounts, influence product priorities, and help translate customer needs into scalable capabilities for all Stripe users.
  • Create mechanisms for senior architects to share technical insights, reusable patterns, and field learnings across Stripe.
  • Establish a culture of technical excellence, curiosity, accountability, experimentation, and continuous learning.
  • Champion AI-enabled ways of working across the team, using AI to improve insight generation, solution development, team productivity, and the quality and speed of customer outcomes.
  • Develop talent through clear expectations, thoughtful coaching, meaningful feedback, and opportunities for architects to expand their technical, commercial, and leadership impact.
  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Technical Account Management, Partnerships, Marketing, Product, and Engineering to deliver cohesive outcomes for users.
  • Build processes and metrics that measure the team’s impact on customer outcomes, account growth, product influence, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Anticipate changes in technology, customer needs, competitive dynamics, and industry structure, and translate those signals into action for the team and Stripe.
  • Represent Stripe in executive forums, customer business reviews, industry events, and other strategic engagements.

Minimum Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience leading technical pre-sales, solutions architecture, sales engineering, or comparable customer-facing architecture teams aligned to strategic, key, or major accounts.
  • A track record of hiring, developing, and leading senior technical talent in a complex, high-growth environment.
  • Deep technical fluency and the ability to remain hands-on—quickly understanding architectures, APIs, data flows, integration patterns, security and reliability considerations, and emerging technologies.
  • Experience partnering directly with senior customer executives, product leaders, and engineering leaders on complex, business-critical initiatives.
  • Demonstrated success connecting technical strategy to account growth, customer outcomes, and long-term partnerships.
  • Strong experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmaps, shape requirements, and turn customer insights into scalable product innovation.
  • An AI-enabled approach to leadership and problem-solving, with practical experience using AI tools to increase the quality, speed, or scale of work.
  • Exceptional curiosity and learning agility, including a strong desire to explore new technologies, business models, and ways of working.
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to make complex technical and business topics clear to audiences at every level.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to lead through ambiguity, balance competing priorities, and make high-quality decisions in fast-moving environments.
  • A collaborative leadership style and a demonstrated ability to align stakeholders across Sales, Product, Engineering, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Willingness to travel as needed to engage with strategic customers and collaborate with internal teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with payments, financial infrastructure, fintech space

jobs.title: Sales Compensation Manager Systems and Analytics
jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

 

About the Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

 

We’re looking for a As the Manager of Sales Compensation Systems and Analytics, you’ll operate at the center of go-to-market execution —- owning the systems, data, and analytics that power how Fivetran + dbt labs pays its sellers and measures performance against quota. You’ll build and scale the compensation infrastructure, deliver accurate and timely commissions, and provide insights that inform plan design and executive decisions. You’ll partner closely with Sales Leadership, Revenue Operations, Sales Strategy, Revenue Accounting, Payroll, Legal, and Analytics.

 

This role reports to the Sr. Director, Global Sales Compensation and blends sales compensation administration, systems ownership, data analytics, and operational execution. You’ll drive the automation and accuracy of our commission processes, help scale our compensation platform for a hybrid pricing motion that includes both subscription contracts and usage-based (consumption) revenue, and support high-visibility initiatives across the function.

 

This is a high-impact role ideal for someone who is passionate about leveraging systems, data, and analytics to motivate sales performance and drive operational excellence in a high-growth, cross-functional environment.

 

This is a full-time role with opportunities to connect and build as a team.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Compensation Systems Ownership: Own the configuration, administration, and roadmap of our sales compensation platform (e.g., Xactly, CaptivateIQ, Varicent, or similar), including plan builds, crediting rules, quota and territory loads, and integrations with Salesforce, the data warehouse, and HRIS/Payroll. Partner with Systems and IT on releases, testing, and enhancements.
  • Commission Operations: Oversee the end-to-end monthly and quarterly commission calculation, validation, and payout cycle, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with plan documents, including crediting for subscription and consumption-based bookings, overages, and renewals
  • Plan Design Support: Partner with Sales Strategy, Finance, and GTM leadership to model, build, and launch annual and in-year compensation plans, quota structures, and SPIFs; quantify cost of sales and the financial impact of plan changes.
  • Analytics & Insights: Deliver analysis on plan effectiveness, attainment distribution, pay-for-performance alignment, quota capacity, and comp cost as a percent of ARR/bookings to inform decisions by the CRO, CFO, and Sales Leadership.
  • Accruals & Forecasting: Partner closely with Revenue Accounting and FP&A on commission accruals, ASC 340-40 capitalization, variance analysis, and forecast-to-actual tracking of variable compensation expense.
  • Governance & Controls: Own SOX-compliant controls, audit readiness, plan documentation, and dispute resolution processes; ensure data integrity and reconciliation between source systems, the comp platform, and payroll.
  • Automation & Reporting Infrastructure: Use AI tools, SQL (BigQuery), or Python to automate data pulls, build repeatable and auditable processes, and improve the accuracy, speed, and transparency of commission calculations; partner with Analytics, AI Transformation, and Systems on data quality and self-serve reporting.
  • Seller Experience & Reporting: Create automated, executive-ready dashboards and statements (e.g., Looker, Tableau) that give sellers and managers clear, real-time visibility into attainment, earnings, and pipeline-to-pay, and that distill trends into actionable recommendations for GTM leadership.
  • Team Leadership: Provide technical guidance, review work, and help raise the process and analytical standards of the Sales Compensation team

 

Skills We’re Looking For

  • 5-7 years of experience in sales compensation, sales operations, revenue operations, or FP&A, with hands-on administration of a compensation platform
  • Expert-level analytical modeling: builds compensation models from scratch, including cost-of-program scenarios, pay-positioning analysis, attrition and retention-risk modeling, and sensitivity and tradeoff analysis
  • Built with AI: has personally used AI tools (LLMs, assistants, or automation and agent platforms) to build compensation tools, models, or workflows others rely on, and can explain how they work and how outputs were checked for accuracy
  • Technical aptitude: working proficiency in SQL, Python, or similar scripting; experience with Salesforce, BI tools (e.g., Looker), and data warehouses (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake) 
  • Must have CaptivateIQ
  • Statistical judgment: knows when market data is credible or a sample is too small, and presents ranges without false precision
  • Compensation expertise: job architecture, compensation frameworks, market pricing, pay cycles, global compensation practices, and pay-for-performance design, with knowledge of competitor compensation at high-growth tech companies
  • Reasons from first principles: balances best practice with what the business needs and can rebuild a framework when the standard approach does not fit
  • Trusted advisor to senior leaders on sensitive, high-stakes compensation decisions (offers, promotions, retention, org changes), influencing outcomes through data and judgment rather than authority
  • Operational excellence: connects systems, stakeholders, and programs to deliver compensation end to end, accurately and on time
  • Clear communicator: turns complex analysis into a crisp recommendation an executive can act on in one conversation
  • Experience with usage-based or consumption pricing models and the associated compensation design challenges strongly preferred

 

Bonus Skills​

  • Experience with Tableau or other BI tools, or building dashboards for leaders
  • Experience supporting GTM or sales organizations at a high-growth tech company
  • Experience scaling compensation programs through hypergrowth, IPO, or major organizational change
  • Background in a quantitative field (e.g., finance, statistics, engineering), or equivalent experience

 

Perks and Benefits

  • 100% employer-paid medical insurance*
  • Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.
  • RSU stock grants*
  • Professional development and training opportunities
  • Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
  • Monthly cell phone stipend
  • Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.

*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information

  • Use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment

jobs.title: Senior Product Quality Engineer, Core Tech Actuators
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Core Technology is the engineering backbone of Anduril's hardware platforms — the shared systems, components, and infrastructure that power products across every division. The team develops and sustains the critical electromechanical systems, drive systems, propulsion, actuation, and embedded electronics that make Anduril's autonomous systems work.  The Quality team works with our customers, internal teams, and suppliers to ensure the deployment of reliable products that meet all mission requirements. We develop cutting-edge Quality processes and methods to secure scalable, long-term business success. As a Senior Product Quality Engineer, you will work inside and outside the organization to define and execute processes that deliver reliable products. The right person for this role has knowledge of manufacturing, product development, and continuous improvement as well as some experience with electromagnetic warfare systems such as RF countermeasures, electromagnetic energy, electronic masking, probing, reconnaissance, and intelligence along with electronic security, emission control, spectrum management. If you are someone who loves to build world-class Quality processes, work hands-on, and be accountable for results, then this role is for you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own the elimination of product risk to improve reliability across the product lifecycle with a key focus on PCBA product quality. Lead Quality activities from concept through development and manufacturing to field use.
  • Define, execute, and continuously improve product and process requirements. Partner with production to establish and refine incoming material inspection, process control plans, and end of line test to capture the essential quality requirements for successful customer shipments.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment to define and execute product quality requirements. Serve as the quality authority for your product line, influencing engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and program stakeholders.
  • Lead Root Cause and Corrective Action (RCCA) and Material Review Board (MRB) activities for critical PCBA and system level interactions. Coach junior engineers on investigation methodology. Review the effectiveness of actions and drive lessons learned across the product team and broader quality organization.
  • Lead containment actions to segregate nonconforming parts on the production line. Establish containment protocols and ensure rapid response across shifts and work centers.
  • Lead product health data analysis and improvement activities. Define quality metrics, dashboards, and reporting cadences. Support customer quality issues and refurbishment testing and quality control.
  • Support change control board by identifying quality risks related to engineering changes of production parts. Provide data-driven risk assessments to inform disposition decisions.
  • Drive the continuous improvement of the Quality Management System. Define and improve required documentation, processes, and activities. Identify systemic gaps and lead initiatives to close them.
  • Mentor and develop junior quality engineers and inspectors. Set technical standards and best practices for the product quality team.
  • Support investigations, initiatives, and projects as needed, at the team or organization level.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or similar technical field
  • 5+ years of experience in product quality, manufacturing quality, or reliability engineering for electronic systems or PCBA products
  • Strong working knowledge of AS9100 based Quality Management System requirements
  • Develop and execute quality management strategies of Printed Circuit Board Assemblies (PCBA)
  • Demonstrated experience working with RF and/or electronic systems with particular experience in PCBA design, development, and sustainment
  • Understanding of Gerber Files and reading schematics
  • Design and developing integrated electromechanical products to satisfy actuation needs
  • Handles hands-on testing, automated test system development, and data analysis for actuation hardware
  • Usage of electrical instrumentation to assess RC in PCBA's such as, multimeter, Oscilloscope, Logic Probes, Thermal Cameras.
  • IPC 610/620 and J-STD-001 knowledge - certification
  • Strong working knowledge of product development methodologies such as Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), and Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T)
  • Experience leading RCCA and MRB activities with demonstrated results in defect reduction or yield improvement
  • Strong working knowledge of mechanical and/or electrical manufacturing processes
  • Proven track record in Engineering, Manufacturing, or Quality in aerospace/defense, automotive, medical device, or similar complex hardware
  • A strong ownership mindset with demonstrated capability to drive cross-functional projects from start to completion
  • Ability to obtain and hold a US Security Clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or similar
  • Experience with the design and development of safety-critical circuitry of Ignition Safety Devices (ISD) and Electronic Safe and Arm Devices (ESAD)
  • Experience with RF test systems, data collection, analysis, and optimization for production control
  • Defense, national security or RF communication systems familiarity through industry or education
  • Delivered electronics warfare, RF or electronics products into production
  • Active TS/SCI clearance
  • Experience with low volume, high complexity manufacturing
US Salary Range
$147,000—$196,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

 

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. 

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

 

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

jobs.title: Researcher, AI Evaluations
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA • New York, NY • United States
jobs.description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

We’re hiring a Researcher, AI Evaluations to join AI Insights within Figma’s Research team. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, reporting to the AI Insights lead and working directly with AI Research within AI Platform. You’ll strengthen the team’s model, agent system, and evaluation work through hands-on studies, clear rubrics, and reliable measures of quality that reflect user needs, and your findings will guide model and product improvements.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Own evaluation research for priority AI Research workstreams. Define quality criteria, design studies, analyze results, and recommend actions
  • Build rubrics, representative evaluation datasets, benchmarks, and quality thresholds that reflect user needs and expert design judgment
  • Work with AI Research and Modeling Platform engineers to integrate validated methods into repeatable evaluations and regression tests
  • Explain quality, failure patterns, and uncertainty. Recommend actions that guide model selection, model improvements, product priorities, and release decisions
  • Validate automated graders against human ratings, including LLM-as-judge methods that use a large language model to score outputs. Identify bias, gaps, and uncertainty
  • Connect user research with AI Research’s model development work. Share reusable methods, review work, and mentor peers

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

  • 7+ years of experience in research, applied research, or a related field, with a proven track record of independently leading complex evaluation projects and delivering measurable impact
  • Hands-on experience evaluating AI products, with demonstrated ability to translate evaluation findings into meaningful model and product improvements
  • Expertise in designing human evaluations, scoring rubrics, datasets, and benchmarks, including measuring inter-rater agreement and validating automated graders
  • Strong qualitative and quantitative research skills, with the ability to analyze data, interpret uncertainty, and draw actionable insights into model behavior and performance
  • Excellent problem-solving and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, prioritize risks, balance speed with rigor, and deliver recommendations that influence cross-functional decisions

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience integrating automated evaluations and regression testing into engineering workflows, with familiarity in tools such as Braintrust, LangSmith, DeepEval, or equivalent platforms
  • Proven ability to develop scalable, reusable evaluation frameworks and drive the adoption of consistent quality standards across teams
  • Background in product design, product management, data science, or engineering, with familiarity in Figma or similar design and developer tools
  • Strong statistical expertise in sampling, significance testing, and agreement metrics, with experience conducting experiments or analyzing performance metrics for AI-powered features
  • Advanced training in a quantitative or behavioral discipline, gained through formal education or equivalent hands-on experience

jobs.title: IT Network Infrastructure Technician
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

IT NETWORK INFRASTRUCTURE TECHNICIAN

SpaceX technicians work in a complex environment supporting a variety of critical production, launch, and landing activities. The IT network infrastructure team installs and supports the cable infrastructure used for all types of telecommunications in support of our production facilities, launch infrastructure and spacecraft support systems, including the layer 1 fiber and copper data network cabling, operational voice (both wired and wireless systems), video, ground-side vehicle and payload interface RF systems, ground stations, telemetry and optical tracking systems, marine communications, readiness testing, and other systems involved in real-time communications and operations for Falcon, Dragon, Starship and other missions.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Install, terminate, test, troubleshoot, and document test results for fiber, network, audio, video, and RF cabling
  • Install, test, and troubleshoot audio, video, and RF equipment
  • Install cable pathway systems (cable trays, cable racks, J-hooks or D-rings)
  • Install, terminate, test, label, and document horizontal, backbone and other cables
  • Build out telecommunication and equipment rooms
  • Install connectors, connector pins, terminals, and lugs
  • Perform continuity checks, locate and correct wiring errors using measuring instruments
  • Investigate, diagnose, correct, and document instrumentation or system malfunctions
  • Perform complex technical assignments involving communications systems, instrumentation and data acquisition/processing systems
  • Collaborate with team members to troubleshoot failures and issues derived from test data
  • Read and interpret planning documents, schematics, wiring diagrams, specifications, drawings, manuals, blueprints, and engineering sketches

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High school diploma or equivalency certificate
  • 2+ years of experience installing, testing, troubleshooting, and repairing: fiber optics, copper cabling (RF, Ethernet), network and telephony installation, and audio/video systems

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • 3+ years of raceway installation (conduit, cable tray installation, PVC installation)
  • Ability to install, terminate and test low voltage cables and fiber optical cables to include twisted pair, coaxial, stranded and solid conductor low voltage cables, single mode and multi-mode fiber optical cables
  • Strong knowledge of industry standards (BICSI, NEC, TIA/EIA); different types of fiber (MM, SM) for interior and exterior usage; Cat5E, Cat6 and Cat6A data cabling; and cable pathways such as conduit, fire penetrations and cable trays
  • Knowledge of the telecom network best practices and concepts including network security, network architecture design, technical standards and deliverables, troubleshooting tools (e.g., line analyzers, breakout boxes, and network traces), software and hardware installation and configuration, network hardware, and protocols (e.g., TCP/IP, DLC, and ASYNC)
  • Working knowledge of audio, video, and wireless systems and corresponding physical means of delivery (i.e. analog, digital, AoIP, VoIP)
  • Operational knowledge of oscilloscopes and multi-meters, soldering wires and connectors, various crimping tools, wire stripping techniques, Ohm’s law, continuity testing, pinning out a military type connector, routing and tie wrapping cables, drilling and tapping holes, and building junction boxes 
  • Experience with DC power supplies, DC-DC converters, heat shrink tubing, cable harnessing, lacing, and proper strain relief concepts
  • Experience with IP and HD-SDI video cameras and infrastructure
  • Comprehension of modern networking architecture and what is necessary for physical layer inter-connectivity
  • Experience operating articulating boom lifts, fork lifts, scissor lifts, and other work site machinery

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must have valid driver's license
  • Ability to distinguish between different colors and possess manual dexterity to complete fine motor tasks
  • Ability to work at elevated heights and/or tight spaces
  • Physical effort including standing, lifting and carrying moderately heavy materials or equipment up to 25 lbs 
  • Regularly exposed to work in extreme outdoor environments – heat, cold, rain
  • Work occasionally performed in an environment requiring exposure to fumes, odors, and noise
  • Available to work overtime hours, nights and weekends when required by mission milestones
  • Ability to travel (up to 40%) as required to other SpaceX locations
  • Typical 50 hour work weeks with overtime as required; schedule varies depending on site operational needs; flexibility is required

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $26.00 - $32.00
Level 2: $30.00 - $38.00
Level 3: $35.00 - $44.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.  

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

jobs.title: Asset Protection & Safety Associate I/II - 2nd Shift
jobs.description:
Schedule: (Open Availability Highly Preferred)

  • 2:00p-10:30p Wednesday-Friday, 12:00p-2030p Saturday & Sunday
  • 2:00p-10:30p Saturday-Wednesday

Pay Range: $17 hourly

About Carvana

At Carvana, we believe buying a car the old-fashioned way sucks — so we're rewriting the playbook. Yes, we're the vending machine people. Yes, we built that on purpose. And yes, we're just getting started.

We're looking for people who want to thrive in an environment of impactful change. Team spirit shows up in everything we do — every day, our passion and creativity drive the kind of innovation that moves an industry. We take big swings, set ambitious goals, and challenge each other to make data- and process-driven decisions in everything we do. Here are a few of our stories. We've been changing the game since 2013, and we're not letting up. Want the full story? Check it out here.

About the team and position

Our Safe & Secure team is the heartbeat of every Carvana location. You're the people we trust to protect our associates, our customers, and the thousands of vehicles that flow through our gates every day. Rain, shine, ice, or 110° heat — the mission doesn't change, and neither does the standard.

This is a boots-on-the-ground role. We bring the strategy; you bring the hustle. From clearing snow during a winter storm to running heat-safety protocols in July, you'll be the reason our site stays open, safe, and moving. Some days you'll be at the gate — the literal face of Carvana to every associate, vendor, and visitor walking through it. Other days, you'll be out on the lot scanning vehicles, knocking out safety audits, or restocking the supplies that keep this place humming.

You won't just monitor a perimeter — you'll own it. That means spotting hazards before they become incidents, building real relationships with the folks on site, and stepping up when something needs your attention. You'll be trained and trusted to act in emergencies, partner with our Inspection Center and Logistics teams, and feed sharp, accurate intel back to your Safe & Secure leadership. Hourly position, reporting to your Safe & Secure Functional Lead or Manager.

What you’ll be doing

  • Lead with a service-first mindset in every interaction.
  • Live the Carvana values — and make sure they're felt by everyone you work with.
  • Be the face of Carvana at the gate for associates, vendors, and visitors.
  • Communicate like a pro — clear, calm, active listener, no missed signals.
  • Use our Unified Security Platform to monitor live cameras, review footage, and investigate intrusion alerts so nothing on site catches us off guard.
  • When things get hot, keep it cool. De-escalate, win with partners, and remember — we're all in this together.
  • Run point at the gate using the Safe & Secure App (SAS App) and RFID tech, enforcing ingress/egress procedures every single time.
  • Manage and document vehicle movement through the Inspection Center entrance and exit gates.
  • Show up when the team needs you. You'll be trained and certified in first aid, CPR, and AED — and we expect you to use it when the moment calls for it.
  • Know our emergency protocols cold so you can act decisively when seconds count.
  • Keep the site operational in any weather — snow removal in winter, heat-safety protocols in summer, no excuses, no shortcuts.
  • Drive a safety-first culture by spotting environmental hazards, running safety audits, and reinforcing best practices with the people around you.
  • Scan thousands of vehicles a day to keep operational flow tight — between mobile rover tech and manual handheld scans, every car gets accounted for.
  • Cover ground. This role involves serious walking to reach restricted or hard-to-access areas of the lot.
  • Run vehicle location research and deliver clean, detailed reports to leadership when operational questions come up.

Key Metrics: 

  • Unit Loss Rate versus Plan
  • Safe & Secure App Execution
  • Inventory Control/Accuracy and Tracking 
  • Safety Incident Performance

What you should know/have

  • 1–2 years in a customer service environment
  • Strong verbal and written communication
  • A track record of solid decision-making in a complex, fast-moving environment
  • Ability to build strong working relationships and connect with people quickly
  • Ability to organize, plan, and execute multiple tasks at once in a fast-paced setting
  • Ability to handle conflict in a positive, productive way

We’d love it if you also have

  • Familiarity with CCTV, RFID, Card Access, or other Safe & Secure technology
  • Previous experience supporting an OSHA / Safety Team program
  • Experience with crisis prevention and/or response plans

What we’ll offer in return

  • Full-time hourly position with a competitive wage
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
  • 401(k) with company match
  • A stack of perks — student loan support, vehicle discounts, pet benefits, and a lot more
  • A wellness program built to keep you healthy, physically and mentally
  • Real opportunities to grow your skills and share what you know across the org
  • A promote-from-within culture with a startup feel — career paths can move fast around here
  • A seat at one of the fastest-growing companies in the country

Other requirements

To do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you:

  • Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English
  • Must be at least 18 years of age
  • This position is designated as a safety-sensitive position

Our goal is to shift the industry from static, hardware-heavy infrastructure toward agile, software-defined energy assets. The Software Validation team ensures that these complex systems are safe, resilient, and ready for grid-scale deployment. 

As a Software Validation Engineer, you are the bridge between pure code and physical reality. You will design and maintain the environments—Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL)—that allow us to stress-test our power electronics and site controllers. Your mission is to build the automated frameworks that catch edge cases before they hit the field, ensuring every product we ship meets the highest standards of reliability.

jobs.title: Senior People Analytics Lead
jobs.description:
About Coursera + Udemy

Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI. Read more about the combined company by visiting our blog.

Why join us now?

AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them.

Shape what comes next

By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.

How we work

We let you choose the best way to work, whether it’s from home, an office, or a collaboration space. We’re a globally distributed team that comes together intentionally for collaboration, complex problem-solving, and key milestones — creating opportunities for teams to come together.  If you’re ready to make a global impact, help scale unique products across Coursera + Udemy, and grow your career, apply below.

About this role

You’ll shape how the organization understands and manages its workforce. Reporting to the Director of People Operations & Technology, you’ll own the people analytics roadmap, build trusted data and reporting, and turn insights into practical improvements across the employee lifecycle. You’ll partner with People Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, Employee Relations, and People leadership, and work with HRIS, IT, and Finance to connect data and strengthen governance.

This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role with broad influence across the People team.

About Your Skills

People Data Foundations
Building trusted, well-governed people data through reliable pipelines, consistent metric definitions, and quality checks that make reporting and analysis dependable.

Process & Performance Analytics
Using data to find bottlenecks, errors, and manual work in People processes, set baselines, and measure whether improvements, including AI and automation, deliver results.

Insight to Decision
Applying the right analytical methods to workforce questions and turning findings into clear recommendations and dashboards that senior leaders act on.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the analytics roadmap. Prioritize the People organization’s most important workforce, talent, and operational questions, and balance immediate needs with foundational work like data quality, consistent metrics, and reliable reporting.
  • Build trusted people data. Partner with HRIS and data owners to maintain reliable datasets and pipelines, with clear metric definitions, quality checks, and documentation.
  • Improve People processes. Analyze onboarding, employee changes, case management, and offboarding to find bottlenecks, errors, and manual work. Set baselines, recommend improvements with process owners, and measure results.
  • Measure operational performance. Develop metrics for service demand, cycle times, resolution quality, and rework to inform capacity, self-service, and automation priorities.
  • Deliver workforce and talent insights. Work with People Business Partners and Finance on headcount, workforce costs, org structure, hiring, retention, internal mobility, and succession, and connect findings to workforce plans.
  • Apply advanced methods. Use statistical analysis, forecasting, and predictive techniques, and clearly communicate assumptions and limitations.
  • Tell the story. Build dashboards that leaders actually use, streamline recurring reporting, and run a quarterly workforce insights review that highlights changes, risks, and recommended actions.
  • Advance AI and automation responsibly. Identify, validate, and measure practical AI and automation opportunities. Embed privacy, access controls, and responsible-use practices, and partner with Legal and IT on sensitive data.
  • Build capability. Set analytical standards and coach People colleagues on using data confidently.

 

Qualifications

  • 8+ years in people analytics, HR analytics, or a related field, with substantial experience applying analytics to People data and processes.
  • Strong understanding of HR operations, employee lifecycle processes, and workforce and talent metrics.
  • Experience with Workday or a similar HRIS, including how system configuration and business processes affect data quality.
  • Experience integrating complex HR datasets and building sustainable pipelines with HRIS, IT, or data engineering teams.
  • Advanced SQL and strong Python or R skills.
  • Advanced proficiency in Databricks, Tableau, or similar platforms, with a track record of building reporting that leaders use to make decisions.
  • Strong grounding in statistical methods, with the judgment to match the approach to the question and the data.
  • Demonstrated success translating analysis into measurable improvements in efficiency, service quality, data accuracy, or employee experience.
  • The ability to scope ambiguous requests, prioritize competing needs, and deliver independently.
  • Clear, compelling communication with senior People and business leaders.
  • Sound judgment with sensitive employee data and a commitment to privacy, fairness, and responsible AI.

 

Compensation

Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more. 

Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly.

The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. Where our core team manages established holding company and national brand relationships, the Growth team builds new ones: signing direct agreements with specialty and independent healthcare agencies, bringing emerging and midsize pharma brands onto the platform, and turning first partnerships into multiyear joint business plans. This is a builder role for someone who wants to shape a new team from the ground up.

jobs.title: Tech Lead Manager, Motion Planning
jobs.description:
Kodiak AI, Inc. (Nasdaq: KDK), founded in 2018, is a leader in Physical AI, developing driverless technology that powers machines that move. Its Kodiak Driver is a vehicle-agnostic autonomous driving system that combines AI-powered software with modular hardware. Today it operates in long-haul trucking, industrial trucking, and defense. In 2024, Kodiak launched commercial Driver-as-a-Service operations with no one in the cab, and plans to launch driverless long-haul service between Dallas and Houston by the end of 2026.

Kodiak has partnered with many of the biggest names in freight, including Bosch for scaled hardware production, AWS, and leading customers including Atlas Energy Solutions, IKEA, Bridgestone, Werner Enterprises, C.R. England, Roehl Transport, and General Dynamics Land Systems.

Kodiak is recruiting a Tech Lead Manager to lead motion planning and prediction for Kodiak driverless trucks. The role combines technical leadership with people management, and provides scope and visibility to create the roadmap for the entire motion planning stack, including behavior planning, trajectory generation, mission commanding, and prediction.

This is an opportunity to collaborate with Product, Perception, Controls, and other cross-functional teams in order to improve overall autonomy performance. Customers interact with Kodiak trucks through mission assignments, making this a key engineering position to achieve product excellence.

The team’s responsibilities span the full range of the motion planning and prediction domain, from routing to decision-making to optimization. The planning and prediction stack utilizes both conventional and learned approaches. 

In this role, you will:

  • Lead and grow a team of engineers building motion planning and prediction for driverless operation on public roads
  • Set the technical direction and long-term roadmap and architecture for motion planning
  • Identify metrics to orient engineering teams toward product excellence
  • Study the product for opportunities to delight our customers
  • Manage, mentor, and develop engineers at all levels: set expectations, give regular feedback, support career growth, and raise the bar for engineering excellence
  • Hire and onboard top engineering talent, and build a collaborative, inclusive team culture
  • Prioritize and plan team work, balancing roadmap commitments, technical debt, and operational needs
  • Integrate onboard and offboard driving logic
  • Automate and expedite truck launches and landings
  • Partner cross-functionally with Perception, Controls, Systems, Simulation, and Product teams to define interfaces, requirements, and system behavior
  • Solve difficult real-world problems involving highways, surface streets, and open, unstructured environments!

What you’ll bring:

  • Experience managing or mentoring engineers, with a record of growing and retaining strong teams
  • 6+ years of experience developing production-level robotics software
  • Strong facility with modern C++ and the ability to guide design and review code
  • Expertise in motion planning, including one or more of: computation geometry, graph theory, numerical optimization, or machine learning
  • Track record of leading teams to deliver complex autonomous systems
  • Leadership to guide the team through ambiguous, real-world challenges

Bonus points if you have:

  • Deployed software on autonomous vehicles

  • Improved system performance (latency, throughput, reliability) in production environments

jobs.title: Program Director, Missiles
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Air Dominance and Strike Division is one of Anduril’s fastest growing, most technically complex divisions. We develop and build collaborative combat aircraft, missiles, and the software that powers these autonomous weapons. We are looking for a Program Director to lead one of Anduril’s largest development programs across various stages of the contract lifecycle from early R&D to contract capture and close. As a Program Director you will lead the development and integration of Anduril products and technologies alongside the Chief Engineer and will be directly responsible for all elements of cost and schedule to ensure successful delivery of the program.

ABOUT THE JOB

Success in this position hinges on three key facets:

  1. Systems and engineering mindset - the ability to understand and assess technical concept. Identifying system dependencies, interfaces, technical risks and the impact of key architectural decisions with the engineering team.
  2. Execution focused - digging into the details, charting the path and owning the outcome. You will be expected to utilize your technical aptitude in conjunction with your program management, and leadership skills to deliver the best outcome for Anduril and the customer.
  3. Collaborative partnership - managing customer relationships and shaping the future of the program with the government.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • In partnership with the Chief Engineer, own the development and deployment of Anduril’s Air Dominance & Strike technologies to meet the operational needs of the Department of Defense
  • Develop strong, trusting relationships with Anduril’s DOD customers, ensuring we have tight feedback loops that enable us shape solutions, rapidly iterate, and ultimately field solutions faster
  • Autonomously execute on broad and/or ambiguous requirements from internal engineering, customers, and third party corporate partners to own successful delivery of outcomes on multiple programs simultaneously
  • Monitor and manage program progress across cost, schedule, and resource allocation, making tradeoffs that enable us to deliver best-in-class solutions to our customers on-time and on-budget
  • Develop and implement lightweight processes, tools, and metrics for program planning, scope management, risk management, and customer communication to enable Anduril to move rapidly
  • Be high ownership on all pieces of work and become a trusted partner and advisor to Anduril’s engineers
  • Foster a creative, high-performance culture within the team, and proactively assess team skills versus needs, identifying personnel development or recruitment opportunities to strengthen the team’s capabilities
  • Collaborate with finance and business development teams to develop novel pricing strategies for proposals that set Anduril up for long term financial and operational success
  • Collaborate with senior management to develop and refine the strategic roadmap for Anduril Air Dominance & Strike R&D investments that underpin the success of our programs

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Top Secret security clearance
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field (technical background preferred)
  • Minimum of 8 years experience managing the development of complex technical systems throughout the product lifecycle
  • Proven track record of successfully managing complex, multi-million-dollar projects and driving their on-time, on-budget completion
  • Strong strategic thinking, analytical, and problem-solving abilities with the ability to move seamlessly between tactical and the 30,000 ft level
  • Experience coordinating multiple internal and external teams within a complex engineering or technology-focused organization
  • Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely to diverse audiences
US Salary Range
$220,000—$292,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

 

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. 

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

 

Data Privacy

jobs.title: Art Director
jobs.description:
About the Role

Abnormal is built to look and feel like nothing else in security: precision-engineered, a little rebellious, and a few steps ahead of now. We protect more than 5,000 customers, including 30% of the Fortune 500, with a platform that stops the attacks everyone else misses. We need someone to make it look like the future it is.

We're looking for an Art Director who is first and foremost an artist. This is not a creative production role. You will own Abnormal's aesthetic direction, a singular visual identity with a bold and cinematic sensibility, and communicate that vision clearly to every team, vendor, and collaborator who executes creative work. You'll work closely with our CEO, CMO, VP of Product Marketing, and VP of Revenue Marketing to internalize Abnormal's worldview, then make it your own, ideally pushing it further than we imagined.

This role is distinct from our creative services function, which runs the production engine. Your job is to set the vision, protect its integrity, and elevate it. At Abnormal, you'll do the most exciting work of your career because you'll be shaping how the future of cybersecurity is seen, in a company where AI is at the core of the product and the way we work.

The ideal candidate is a concept artist at heart, someone who has spent their career in sci-fi film, cyberpunk or sci-fi video games, or similarly high-craft visual storytelling environments. Specifically, we want someone who knows how to design computer interfaces, holograms, and imagined future worlds, with the kind of detail that maps to a visionary technology company and its products: the in-world UI of a sci-fi game or film, the readout on a futuristic digital weapon, the menu architecture of a spacecraft. Not characters. Not atmospheric environments. Designed systems and objects with detail and intention. You see and express vision. You don't just execute.

What You Will Do

  • Define and own Abnormal's visual aesthetic direction
  • Lead visual ideation for high-stakes moments: major product launches, experiential events (RSA, Black Hat), and brand campaigns
  • Contribute hands-on concept work when the moment demands it. This is a vision-first role, but your craft should be evident
  • Build a shared creative language across the org so the aesthetic direction scales without bottlenecking through you
  • Serve as the creative authority and taste-setter for all visual output, from brand identity to campaigns to experiential environments
  • Translate the CEO's and leadership's vision into a clear, communicable aesthetic that others can execute without needing you in every room
  • Partner with creative services to keep production output style-consistent, setting guardrails and reviewing work rather than running the factory
  • Develop mood boards, concept art, and visual references that define "in the zone" creative for recruiter screening, vendor briefs, and internal alignment

Must Haves

  • 10+ years of experience in concept art, visual design, or art direction, with a body of work that shows artistic progression and a distinct point of view
  • Shipped credits on AAA game titles, major film productions, or equivalent high-craft visual projects in sci-fi, cyberpunk, or adjacent genres, with work focused on interface design, in-world UI/UX, holographic displays, or designed objects (virtual weapons, vehicles, technology systems) rather than characters, creatures, or natural environments
  • A portfolio that demonstrates genuine aesthetic vision, not just execution. Your work should show world-building expressed through designed objects and systems: architecture, vehicles, digital weapons, futuristic technology, UI. Detailed, intentional, engineered creative work. Painterly or landscape-driven portfolios are not the profile we're hiring
  • Experience as the sole or lead visual voice on at least one significant project: not just a contributor, but the person who owned the aesthetic direction end to end
  • Ability to articulate and document a visual language clearly enough that others can execute it without you present
  • Experience collaborating directly with senior leadership or creative directors and translating their vision into something tangible
  • Craft fluency across visual mediums: digital, environmental, editorial, motion
  • Proven ability to work as an individual contributor in a fast-moving tech company. You operate with autonomy, take feedback, and collaborate cross-functionally. You want to stay close to the work, and you're here to bring the vision, not manage a team
  • Strong communication and presentation skills. You can defend and sell a creative direction with clarity and confidence

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in B2B tech, cybersecurity, or enterprise software, or a demonstrated ability to quickly internalize a technical domain and translate it visually
  • Familiarity with experiential or event design (large-format, spatial, environmental)
  • Experience working alongside or managing a creative production team
  • Comfort with AI-assisted design and prototyping tools

jobs.title: Data Policy & Governance Lead
jobs.description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

 

THE ROLE

Data Primacy only holds if enterprise data can be verified, classified, and trusted across every downstream application and AI model. As Data Policy & Governance Lead within CX Platforms and Delivery Innovation, you will build and scale programmatic governance-as-code across Everpure’s enterprise data estate—running Everpure on Everpure—and translate those proven practices into scalable customer advisory. Partnering closely with Data Architecture, Security, Privacy, Legal, and Field Deployed Engineering, you will safeguard the integrity of customer, product, and operational data while accelerating AI adoption. Your work establishes the foundation of trust, verifiable compliance, and automated data policy that powers mission-critical CX workflows and customer AI initiatives globally.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Implement Governance-as-Code: Design and deploy automated policy, sensitivity classification, and access controls programmatically into data pipelines, replacing manual review boards with continuous, code-based verification.
  • Operationalize Everpure on Everpure: Apply Everpure Data Intelligence and our platform technologies to discover, classify, and contextualize our own data, making Everpure customer zero for every governance pattern we sell.
  • Embed Governance into Data Contracts: Partner with Data Architecture to codify ownership boundaries, lifecycle quality gates, and contextual entitlements directly within enforceable data contracts across core platforms including ServiceNow, CRM, and MDM.
  • Preserve Verifiable Data Truth: Establish authoritative, single-record governance that prevents fragmentation and localized duplication as autonomous agents, data products, and analytics models scale across business units.
  • Deliver High-Impact Customer Advisory: Partner with Field Deployed Engineering teams to translate validated internal frameworks into enterprise customer offerings, conducting maturity assessments, executive workshops, and best-practice advisory for AI-era data risk.

jobs.title: Data Scientist (Starlink)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

DATA SCIENTIST (STARLINK)

At SpaceX, we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the globe. As a Data Scientist, you will be responsible for developing the strategy, key metrics, tools, software services, and processes for assessing how well key aspects of Starlink are scaling and how effective the Starlink Network is itself, in serving tens of millions of users around the globe. You will work with operators, subsystem responsible engineers, software engineers, and network engineers inside the Starlink organization as well as key contacts with various major external partners to help ensure the growth of this program.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Build and maintain mission-critical infrastructure, tools, processes, and custom software to objectively assess growth areas for the Starlink program
  • Lead technical investigations about chronic network-level issues
  • Automate the aggregation of metrics and detection of widespread application issues across Starlink
  • Establish and maintain relationships with key engineering stakeholders
  • Apply data analytics, models, and techniques to data products created by space vehicles
  • Build ground-based software systems that ingest, transform, and store data
  • Fuse data from multiple sources to create usable information

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, physics, mathematics, or a STEM discipline
  • 1+ years of professional data/software engineering experience (internship experience is applicable)
  • Development experience in an object-oriented programming language (i.e. C, C++, Python)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Professional experience in analytics, data science, or machine learning
  • Ability to take on projects that require taking initiative and developing new expertise
  • Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment that includes working with changing needs and requirements
  • Experience building solutions with in-stream data processing of structured and semi-structured data
  • Experience building predictive models and machine learning pipelines (clustering analysis, prediction, anomaly detection)
  • Experience in custom ETL design, implementation, and maintenance
  • Familiarity with the Open Systems Intercommunication (OSI) model and other common networking principles
  • Experience using AI tools to accelerate  

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed
COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $125,000.00 - $165,000.00
Level 2: $145,000.00 - $200,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.  

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

jobs.title: Senior Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Field Marketing Manager to drive regional demand generation, pipeline growth, and revenue impact through integrated field and account-based marketing programs. This is a senior, hands-on role requiring deep collaboration with sales, strong program ownership, and a proven ability to translate corporate marketing strategy into high-impact regional execution.

The ideal candidate brings 10+ years of experience in high-tech field marketing, preferably within enterprise B2B or SaaS organizations, and has a strong track record of delivering measurable pipeline and revenue results.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and execute regional field marketing strategy aligned with corporate objectives and sales priorities
  • Design and deliver integrated field programs including events, roadshows, executive engagements, webinars, and ABM initiatives
  • Partner closely with sales leadership to support territory plans, pipeline creation and acceleration, and account expansion
  • Manage end-to-end program execution: planning, budgeting, logistics, promotion, execution, and post-event follow up and measurement
  • Drive demand generation and pipeline contribution through targeted campaigns and personalized experiences
  • Collaborate with digital, content, product marketing, and partner marketing teams to ensure consistent messaging and execution
  • Analyze program performance and pipeline impact; provide regular reporting and insights to marketing and sales leadership
  • Manage regional marketing budgets and ensure strong ROI across all initiatives
  • Work with external vendors, agencies, and partners to scale execution and impact
  • Continuously optimize programs based on performance data, market feedback, and evolving business priorities
  • Support NiCE’s annual user conference by being the conduit to the field regarding discounted + free passes.  Communicate, inform and educate the field and Senior Sales leadership on the user conference including the conference structure and sessions.

 

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in field marketing within a high-tech, B2B, SaaS, or enterprise software environment
  • Proven experience driving pipeline and revenue through field and account-based marketing programs
  • Strong alignment and partnership experience with enterprise sales teams and sales leadership
  • Demonstrated success managing complex, multi-channel field programs across regions or territories
  • Experience with marketing automation and CRM platforms (e.g., Marketo, HubSpot, Salesforce)
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to measure, report, and optimize marketing impact
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting enterprise and / or strategic accounts
  • Familiarity with ABM platforms and intent data tools
  • Prior experience working with channel, GSI’s or alliance partners
  • Global or multi-region field marketing experience

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent, measurable contribution to sales pipeline and revenue
  • Strong alignment and trust with sales leadership and reps
  • High-quality field programs that elevate brand presence and customer engagement
  • Clear reporting and insights that inform marketing and sales strategy

 

About NiCE

NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions.

Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries.

NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.
