jobs.title: Data Architect
jobs.description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

 

THE ROLE

Everpure is building its Data Products portfolio on a fundamental Data Primacy thesis: data is the durable enterprise asset, and applications are the fuel consumed and replaced over time. As Data Architect within CX Platforms and Delivery Innovation, you will establish governed sources of truth across Everpure’s enterprise ecosystem—running Everpure on Everpure—and translate those proven architectures into repeatable offerings for customers. Working at the intersection of internal engineering build and customer-facing strategy, you will partner directly with Field Deployed Engineering, Product, Services, and the Digital Transformation Group. Your work establishes the mission-critical foundation of governed, reusable data and AI pipelines that powers every CX workflow, partner interaction, and customer transformation.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Architect Everpure on Everpure: Design and operationalize the internal data estate on Everpure technologies, establishing Everpure as Customer Zero to prove and refine reference architectures before they enter the market.
  • Stand Up Governed, Enforceable Data Products: Establish authoritative "one passport, many consumers" data products and schema-enforced data contracts across core enterprise platforms (including CRM, MDM, and ERP) to eliminate data silos and accelerate analytics and AI delivery.
  • Drive the CX Transformation Roadmap: Lead the architectural vision that balances strategic transformation with iterative agile delivery, shipping production-grade code, data models, and contracts that deliver measurable operational value.
  • Advise Enterprise Customers in the Field: Partner with Field Deployed Engineering teams to deliver high-impact technical advisory, design reviews, and modern lakehouse/streaming reference architectures for enterprise customers scaling their data foundations on the Everpure Platform.
  • Productize Field and Internal Innovation: Package validated internal architecture patterns into scalable CX service offerings while funneling field insights directly back into core Product and Services roadmaps.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Demonstrated track record of architecting and shipping production data platforms, lakehouse systems, and streaming pipelines using technologies such as Databricks, Snowflake, Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, Kafka, Spark, or dbt.
  • Proven expertise designing data products and implementing enforceable data contracts, domain-driven ownership models, and robust master data management across enterprise application ecosystems (e.g., Salesforce, ServiceNow, Reltio, Oracle).
  • Strong technical communication and advisory capabilities, with demonstrated success guiding cross-functional stakeholders and enterprise technical leaders through complex architectural decisions.
  • Practical experience leveraging modern AI development tools and automated workflows to accelerate data modeling, pipeline engineering, and contract governance.

jobs.title: Asset Protection & Safety Associate I/II
jobs.description:
Schedule (Open Availability Highly Preferred):

  • Mon-Fri 12A-8:30A
  • Sun–Thu 10:00 PM–6:30 AM

Pay Range: $19-$20 hourly

About Carvana

At Carvana, we believe buying a car the old-fashioned way sucks — so we're rewriting the playbook. Yes, we're the vending machine people. Yes, we built that on purpose. And yes, we're just getting started.

We're looking for people who want to thrive in an environment of impactful change. Team spirit shows up in everything we do — every day, our passion and creativity drive the kind of innovation that moves an industry. We take big swings, set ambitious goals, and challenge each other to make data- and process-driven decisions in everything we do. Here are a few of our stories. We've been changing the game since 2013, and we're not letting up. Want the full story? Check it out here.

About the team and position

Our Safe & Secure team is the heartbeat of every Carvana location. You're the people we trust to protect our associates, our customers, and the thousands of vehicles that flow through our gates every day. Rain, shine, ice, or 110° heat — the mission doesn't change, and neither does the standard.

This is a boots-on-the-ground role. We bring the strategy; you bring the hustle. From clearing snow during a winter storm to running heat-safety protocols in July, you'll be the reason our site stays open, safe, and moving. Some days you'll be at the gate — the literal face of Carvana to every associate, vendor, and visitor walking through it. Other days, you'll be out on the lot scanning vehicles, knocking out safety audits, or restocking the supplies that keep this place humming.

You won't just monitor a perimeter — you'll own it. That means spotting hazards before they become incidents, building real relationships with the folks on site, and stepping up when something needs your attention. You'll be trained and trusted to act in emergencies, partner with our Inspection Center and Logistics teams, and feed sharp, accurate intel back to your Safe & Secure leadership. Hourly position, reporting to your Safe & Secure Functional Lead or Manager.

What you’ll be doing

  • Lead with a service-first mindset in every interaction.
  • Live the Carvana values — and make sure they're felt by everyone you work with.
  • Be the face of Carvana at the gate for associates, vendors, and visitors.
  • Communicate like a pro — clear, calm, active listener, no missed signals.
  • Use our Unified Security Platform to monitor live cameras, review footage, and investigate intrusion alerts so nothing on site catches us off guard.
  • When things get hot, keep it cool. De-escalate, win with partners, and remember — we're all in this together.
  • Run point at the gate using the Safe & Secure App (SAS App) and RFID tech, enforcing ingress/egress procedures every single time.
  • Manage and document vehicle movement through the Inspection Center entrance and exit gates.
  • Show up when the team needs you. You'll be trained and certified in first aid, CPR, and AED — and we expect you to use it when the moment calls for it.
  • Know our emergency protocols cold so you can act decisively when seconds count.
  • Keep the site operational in any weather — snow removal in winter, heat-safety protocols in summer, no excuses, no shortcuts.
  • Drive a safety-first culture by spotting environmental hazards, running safety audits, and reinforcing best practices with the people around you.
  • Scan thousands of vehicles a day to keep operational flow tight — between mobile rover tech and manual handheld scans, every car gets accounted for.
  • Cover ground. This role involves serious walking to reach restricted or hard-to-access areas of the lot.

jobs.title: Robotics Intern, Teleoperation and Spatial Computing
jobs.description:
At Toyota Research Institute (TRI), we’re on a mission to improve the quality of human life. We’re developing new tools and capabilities to amplify the human experience. To lead this transformative shift in mobility, we’ve built a world-class team advancing the state of the art in AI, robotics, driving, and material sciences.
This is a paid 12-week internship opportunity and is a hybrid, in-office role.
Here’s a glimpse into the Internship experience from some of our TRI interns!


The Team
Our goal is to revolutionize the field of robotic manipulation, enabling long-horizon dexterous behaviors to be efficiently taught, learned, and improved over time in diverse, real-world environments.

Our team has deep cross-functional expertise across simulation, perception, controls, and machine learning, and we measure our success in terms of fundamental capabilities development, as well as research impact via open-source software and publications. Our north star is fundamental technological advancement in building robots that can flexibly perform a wide variety of tasks in diverse environments with potential for human collaboration. Come join us and let’s make general-purpose robots a reality.
The Internship

We are seeking a Robotics Intern passionate about teleoperation, VR/AR, and spatial computing to help advance TRI’s next-generation telerobotics platform. You will design, implement, and test systems that enable humans to control and teach robots through immersive interfaces, contributing to TRI’s mission of extending human capability through robotics. Working closely with cross-functional teams in mechanical design, perception, controls, and UX, you’ll develop real-time software prototypes that integrate robot hardware, motion capture, haptics, and 3D graphics—creating intuitive experiences that blend spatial computing with advanced robotic capabilities.
Your work will involve developing and refining VR/AR interfaces for robot control, building tools for 3D scene reconstruction, and creating interactions for physical AI such as visualizing and communicating policy intent. You’ll also have opportunities to run user studies, contribute to open-source codebases and research publications, and demonstrate prototypes that push the boundaries of human–robot interaction.

What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. jobs.title: Lead Battery Disassembly Technician
jobs.description:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

Supervisor Responsibility:

This role provides technical guidance, training, and mentorship to Battery Disassembly Technicians on the floor. It does not have hiring, firing, or performance review authority; it is an individual contributor position, not a people-management role.

Position Summary:

 Redwood Materials is seeking a Lead Battery Disassembly Technician to perform the full scope of safe, efficient, and high-quality disassembly of EV battery packs and modules within a high-volume manufacturing environment, while serving as the floor-level subject matter expert and trainer for the team. The position requires strict adherence to high-voltage safety protocols, standardized work instructions, and continuous process improvement, and is responsible for training and mentoring technicians, verifying the quality and safety of completed work, and escalating non-routine issues to Supervision and Engineering. The Lead also monitors day-to-day compliance with floor conduct standards — including break/lunch adherence and personal device use — and serves as the floor-level point of contact for operational questions when Supervision or Management is offsite, escalating any issue outside established procedure. This is an individual contributor role that does not carry formal hiring, firing, or performance management authority.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

 Leadership, Training & Mentorship:

    • Serve as the floor-level subject matter expert on disassembly procedures, high-voltage safety, LOTO, and rigging/lifting operations.
    • Train, mentor, and onboard new and existing technicians on standardized work instructions, safety protocols, and proper use of tools and material handling equipment.
    • Verify the quality, safety, and completeness of teammates' disassembly and rigging work, and coach corrective action where gaps are identified.
    • Monitors adherence to floor conduct standards (behavioral etiquette, break/lunch scheduling, personal device use) and escalates repeated or serious violations to Supervision.
    • Acts as the floor-level point of contact for routine operational questions when Supervision or Management is offsite, escalating decisions outside standard procedure.

EV Battery Pack & Module Disassembly:

    • Perform controlled disassembly of EV and stationary storage battery packs, modules, and subcomponents in accordance with established work instructions and safety procedures.
    • Safely isolate, and when deemed necessary, de-energize and verify absence of voltage prior to handling high-voltage systems.
    • Disassemble battery systems down to module and component level, including removal of BMS components, wiring harnesses, busbars, cooling systems, and structural elements.
    • Identify, sort, and route components for reuse, recycling, or disposal in alignment with production and environmental standards.
    • Handle lithium-ion battery materials, including damaged or degraded units, using approved containment and safety methods.
    • Serve as the escalation point for non-routine or first-time disassembly scenarios, providing hands-on guidance to less experienced technicians.

High Voltage Safety & Material Handling:

    • Strictly follow all high-voltage safety protocols, lockout/tagout (LOTO), and PPE requirements when working with energized or potentially energized systems.
    • Utilize appropriate insulated tools and electrical testing equipment (e.g., multimeters) to verify system status.
    • Safely transport and store battery packs, modules, and hazardous materials using approved material handling equipment.
    • Respond to thermal, electrical, or chemical hazards in accordance with emergency procedures and EHS guidelines.
    • Must meet all requirements for use of a full-face respirator, including medical clearance and fit testing, in accordance with OSHA and company standards.
    • Audit teammates’ adherence to high-voltage safety protocols, LOTO, and PPE requirements, and coach corrective action on any gaps.

Production Operations & Process Flow

    • Execute standardized work in a high-throughput production environment, meeting or exceeding daily and hourly disassembly targets.
    • Maintain workflow efficiency by adhering to takt time, minimizing bottlenecks, and supporting continuous flow operations.
    • Track and document production output, material disposition, and process data accurately within required systems (e.g., Excel, in house tracking).
    • Identify process inefficiencies and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives to optimize safety, quality, and throughput.
    • Lead root-cause discussions on throughput, quality, or safety misses and drive corrective actions with supervision and Engineering.

Tooling & Technical Skills:

    • Utilize a range of hand tools, power tools, and electrical diagnostic equipment in a safe and effective manner.
    • Demonstrate working knowledge of mechanical fastening systems, electrical connections, and component-level disassembly techniques.
    • Perform basic electrical verification and troubleshooting as needed during disassembly operations.
    • Maintain tools and equipment in proper working conditions and report any deficiencies.
    • Train technicians on proper tool use, mechanical fastening systems, electrical diagnostic equipment, and component-level disassembly techniques.

Cross-Functional Support & Field Operations:

    • Collaborate with Manufacturing, Engineering, EHS, and Maintenance teams to improve disassembly processes and safety controls.
    • Support field operations as required (up to 10% travel) for battery system decommissioning, including on-site disassembly and material recovery.
    • Work with internal and external teams to safely process large-scale energy storage systems in non-production environments.
    • Act as the team’s primary point of contact for Manufacturing, Engineering, EHS, and Maintenance on process and safety improvements, and represent the technician team in cross-functional planning.

Rigging, Lifting & Heavy Material Handling:

    • Perform rigging and controlled lifting of large-format EV battery packs and energy storage systems using approved lifting devices and techniques.
    • Operate a variety of material handling equipment, including forklifts (sit-down, stand-up, pallet jacks), hoists, cranes, and other lifting apparatus to safely move high-voltage assemblies.
    • Inspect rigging equipment (slings, chains, shackles, lifting fixtures) prior to use and ensure compliance with established safety standards and load ratings.
    • Execute lifts in accordance with defined rigging plans, center-of-gravity considerations, and facility safety procedures to prevent load shift or damage.
    • Coordinate with team members during lifts to ensure safe positioning, communication, and control of suspended loads.
    • Prior rigging and heavy material handling experience is strongly preferred; however, training and certification will be provided for candidates with foundational mechanical aptitude.
    • Review and sign off on rigging plans and lift execution for complex or high-risk lifts, and certify newly trained technicians on rigging fundamentals.

General Manufacturing Expectations:

    • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment in alignment with 5S standards.
    • Perform repetitive physical tasks, including lifting 30–50 lbs and standing for extended periods (up to 12-hour shifts).
    • Operate material handling equipment and mechanical lifts (training provided).
    • Adapt to dynamic work conditions, including indoor and outdoor environments and varying temperatures.
    • Ensure shift readiness through proper workstation setup, organization, and handoff communication.
    • Model shift-readiness and 5S standards for the team, and coach less experienced technicians on workstation organization and handoff communication.

Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities:

  •  4-6 years of battery disassembly or related high-voltage/mechanical experience, with demonstrated proficiency across all disassembly work instructions.
  • Demonstrated ability to train, coach, and explain technical procedures to technicians at varying skill levels.
  • Requirements to participate high voltage training and certifications.
  • Operate a variety of material handling equipment and mechanical lifts (training provided).
  • Perform repetitive lifting (30-50lbs) and support ergonomic and 5S improvement initiatives.
  • Ensure shift readiness by preparing and organizing workstations for incoming teams.
  • Thrive in dynamic environments, including outdoor and variable-temperature conditions.
  • Ability to travel up to 10% of the time to support field decommissioning work, including guiding technicians through unfamiliar, on-site scenarios.
  • Strong communication skills for shift handoffs, cross-functional coordination, and technical escalation to supervision and Engineering.
  • Stand and perform physical tasks for the majority of a 12-hour shift in both indoor and outdoor environments.

The position is full-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

Position Summary:

Redwood Materials is looking for a best-in-class electronics Supplier Industrialization Engineer (SIE) to help scale our printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs) suppliers to meet our aggressive production ramp schedules for our novel energy generation product. This is a fully on-site role at the San Francisco R&D Space, with 30% international travel to supplier and CM sites. You will be responsible for ensuring all parts provided by your suppliers meet dimensional, functional, and reliability requirements. You will support ramping suppliers with detailed capacity analysis, process approvals, part qualifications, NPI builds, and ongoing supplier performance and audits. You are a doer, excited about getting your hands dirty and working in a dynamic, fast-paced setting with new technologies. The SIE will work closely with cross-functional partners in Supply Chain, Engineering, Finance, and Manufacturing to ensure that design and customer success targets are met.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Support supplier audits (process, system, product) and risk assessments to help qualify new sources and ensure readiness for mass production
  • Partner with GSMs, Design Engineering, and suppliers to align specifications, tolerance stack-ups, test coverage, and process controls
  • Review dimensional and quality reports, first article inspections, and other process control data to ensure part compliance
  • Execute PPAP/FAI activities and help define incoming inspection criteria based on part criticality, GD&T, and critical-to-quality key characteristics
  • Support supplier non-conformance resolution, drive 8D investigations, and follow through with verification of effectiveness activities with vendors
  • Maintain supplier scorecards with clear KPIs such as yield, PPM, delivery performance, and DFM responsiveness
  • Support NPI builds and DFM/DFA feedback loops through early supplier engagement and pilot line walkthroughs
  • Help build and define a strong and capable network of vendor partners with robust process, technical capability, reliability, and capacity
  • Support make-vs-buy, dual sourcing, and localization efforts across global supply chains
  • Contribute to sourcing decisions, lead-time analysis, and manufacturing footprint strategies

Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities

  • S. in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, Economics or equivalent technical background
  • S. in Industrial Engineering, Engineering Management, Supply Chain, and/or MBA a plus
  • 5+ years of supplier quality, industrial engineering, process controls, or other related experience, ideally in automotive, industrial hardware, or other high-volume electronics manufacturing environments
  • Strong understanding of PCBA manufacturing processes (SMT, through-hole wave and selective soldering, reflow oven profiles, test strategies, etc.)
  • Strong proficiency in statistics, reading schematics, component drawings, and developing manufacturing processes for high volume capacity and quality targets
  • Familiarity with APQP, PPAP, SPC, DFMEA/PFMEA, ISO, and AECQ quality systems
  • Highly collaborative, data-driven, and proactive; capable of thriving in fast-paced startup environments
  • Willingness to travel internationally to supplier and CM sites as needed (30%)

$147,500—$197,500 USD

The Senior Field Quality Engineer, Energy Storage is responsible for the quality, reliability, and safety of deployed battery energy storage system (BESS) assets, independently owning failure analysis and corrective action tracking for issues identified in the field. The role works closely with operations and maintenance teams, which perform routine monitoring and maintenance, and with service engineering, which owns advanced technical escalation, as well as with design, manufacturing, and supplier quality. The position identifies systemic quality issues, conducts structured investigations, drives corrective and preventive actions, and communicates fleet performance through statistical reporting and trend analysis.   • Leads structured investigations into recurring failures, abnormal trends, and field incidents in collaboration with operations and maintenance, service engineering, design, and manufacturing 
  • Performs root cause analyses using established methods such as 5 Whys, fishbone diagrams, and fault tree analysis, supported by clear problem statements, field evidence, and data 
  • Defines, tracks, and verifies corrective and preventive actions, confirming effectiveness through follow-up inspections, audits, and data analysis 
  • Analyzes and reports fleet performance using reliability statistics such as Weibull analysis and Nevada charts to identify failure trends and forecast field returns

  • Drives continuous improvement initiatives that reduce operational burden on operations and maintenance and improve system reliability

  • Experience working safely on high-voltage AC and DC systems, including applicable electrical safety practices 
  • Working knowledge of root cause analysis methods and corrective and preventive action processes 
  • Working knowledge of reliability statistics, including Weibull analysis, Nevada charts, and failure rate trending

You'll act as a detective and problem-solver discovering payroll discrepancies, researching tax laws, and identifying the root cause of notices. You will be working closely with tax agencies as well as our cross-functional partner teams to reach the best outcomes for our customers and provide feedback on tools that streamline the resolution process and prevent similar issues in the future. 

This role is very hands-on, with an emphasis on research and analysis, excellent communication skills, and first-principles problem-solving. A strong work ethic and desire to be part of the team is critical for success, as well as the ability to retain and apply large amounts of critical information. You must also possess and take pride in high attention to detail, organization, and task management, and be comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven business environment.

Tax Resolution exists to ensure impeccable delivery of key customer needs. There are thousands of critical operational tasks that are completed for our customers accurately and on time, every time, in a proactive and scalable manner. We collaborate, help each other, and work cross-functional in a positive environment.

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

  • Provide exceptional service to our customers.
  • Interact professionally with our customers via email and/or phone, simplifying the tax notice experience for our customers.
  • Research and resolve payroll tax notices on behalf of our customers with guidance from more experienced team members.
  • Provide clear and concise case documentation.
  • Collaborate with our Compliance, Engagement, and Tax Operations teams.
  • Communicate with government agencies to represent Gusto and advocate for our customers under supervision.
  • Manage your time effectively to meet set goals.
  • Actively use current AI tools in workplace applications
  • Handle a queue of tax notices daily, including updating cases as needed, informing customers of any changes, and seeking assistance from peers on escalated issues.
  • Participate in team meetings and provide support to fellow TaxRes Advocates.

Here’s what we're looking for:

  • 2-4 years of payroll experience, notice resolution experience is a plus.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
  • AI Fluency: Capable of using current AI tools and have a mindset to help create and shape new AI tool functionality. 
  • Capability to manage multiple priorities within a high-volume, fast-paced environment and adapt to shifting priorities daily.
  • Commitment to personal high standards and a desire to contribute to team and company goals.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with guidance to resolve issues from complex variables.
  • Team player who enjoys collaborating and contributing to team success.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to simplify complex topics.
  • Highly organized and proactive in improving processes.
  • Dedicated to providing an exceptional customer experience during key moments in our customers' journey.

jobs.title: Principal Customer Success Manager
jobs.location: Denver, Colorado, United States; San Francisco, California, United States
jobs.description:
About Checkr
Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a date. Customers include Uber, Pennymac, Airbnb, Doordash, and Anthropic.

We’re a team that thrives on solving complex problems with innovative solutions that advance our mission. Checkr is recognized on Forbes Cloud 100 2025 List and is a Y Combinator 2024 Breakthrough Company.

Checkr Trust and Checkr Insurance are fast-growing businesses inside Checkr, serving insurance carriers, marketplaces and other verticals that touch our everyday lives. Demand is building, our customer base is expanding, and we're scaling toward $100M. We're looking for a Customer Success Manager who can help us get there by turning strong customer relationships into deep adoption, durable retention, and meaningful expansion.

You will own a portfolio of strategic accounts and be accountable for:

  • Adoption
  • Retention
  • Expansion
  • Executive alignment
  • Long-term value realization

This is a proactive, commercially minded CSM role. You'll be the trusted partner our customers rely on and the owner of outcomes across your book of business. You'll join a team with momentum, playbooks to build on, and room to make them better as we scale. As the business grows, so will the opportunities for you, with real room for personal and career growth.

What You'll Do

Own Strategic Accounts End-to-End:

  • Serve as the primary post-sale owner for high-impact, high-visibility customers
  • Drive executive-level alignment on business goals and measurable outcomes
  • Ensure customers move from contract to meaningful production usage quickly

Drive Adoption & Commercial Growth:

  • Identify underutilization and remove barriers to deeper adoption
  • Surface expansion opportunities tied to customer workflows and risk exposure
  • Partner closely with Sales on renewals and strategic growth motions
  • Be accountable for retention and expansion revenue across your portfolio
  • Use AI tools to work smarter and scale your impact across accounts

Translate Product Into Business Impact:

  • Understand customer workflows well enough to connect product capabilities to operational and financial outcomes
  • Lead quarterly business reviews that demonstrate ROI and strategic value
  • Turn performance data into actionable insights that shape customer strategy
  • Leverage AI to turn data into insights
  • Bring the voice of the customer to Product and leadership through structured feedback

Help Us Scale:

  • Apply and refine our segmentation, engagement models, and risk signals as the customer base grows
  • Strengthen repeatable frameworks for onboarding, renewals, and expansion
  • Contribute to the processes and best practices that let the team support more customers without losing quality
  • Raise the bar on what great customer partnership looks like as we grow

What You Bring:

You likely have:

  • Experience managing a book of enterprise accounts in Customer Success, Strategic Account Management, or a similar post-sale role in B2B SaaS
  • Experience owning enterprise or high-growth accounts with meaningful revenue responsibility
  • A track record of driving both retention and expansion
  • Comfort working with executive stakeholders as well as customer technical teams
  • Experience in a high-growth environment
  • Curiosity about AI and a habit of experimenting with it in your workflows
  • An A-player mindset with a strong bias for action: you raise the bar, move with urgency, stay resilient through change, and take ownership of outcomes

You don't need a technical background or a history in a technical account management role. You do need to be sharp and technically comfortable enough to:

  • Learn our product and data deeply and explain it clearly to customers
  • Work with customers' teams to understand their workflows and what's slowing adoption
  • Speak confidently with product and technical stakeholders
  • Work in tools like Zendesk, Salesforce, Google Apps, Lovable, and Claude, and BI tools like Looker and Omni

Behaviorally, You:

  • Take full ownership of revenue and outcomes
  • Push customers forward when momentum slows
  • Balance empathy with accountability
  • Stay calm and effective in a fast-moving, high-growth business
  • Prefer building scalable systems over maintaining the status quo

People describe you as gritty, commercially sharp, resilient, and proactive.

Why This Role:

  • You'll play a direct role in scaling a high-growth business toward $100M
  • You'll work with sophisticated customers solving complex trust and safety problems
  • You'll have real, visible commercial impact on retention and expansion
  • You'll help shape how Customer Success scales as the business grows
  • You'll have room to grow your own career, with expanded scope and new opportunities as the company grows

This role is demanding. It requires urgency, discipline, and ownership, and it's highly rewarding for someone who wants to grow with a business that's winning.

We use geographic cost of labor as an input to develop ranges for our roles and as such, each location where we hire may have a different range. If this role is remote, we have listed the top to the bottom of the possible range, but we will specify the target range for an exact location when you are selected for a recruiting discussion. On-target Earnings OR Base Salary range (San Francisco, CA)
$169,000—$199,000 USD

$143,000—$168,000 USD

What We Offer

  • A fast-paced and collaborative environment
  • Learning and development allowance
  • Competitive cash and equity compensation, and opportunity for advancement
  • 100% medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Up to $25K reimbursement for fertility, adoption, and parental planning services
  • Flexible PTO policy

At Checkr, we believe an in office work environment strengthens collaboration, drives innovation, and encourages connection. Our hub locations are Denver, CO; San Francisco, CA; Nashville, TN; and Santiago, Chile. Individuals are expected to work from the office 3+ days a week. In-office perks are provided, such as lunch five times a week, a commuter stipend, and an abundance of snacks and beverages. COMPENSATION & PERKS

Full-Time Salary Position
100% Company paid medical for employee, plus family discounts
Paid Time Off (Including your birthday!)
401k with Company Match                       
Pet Benefits
Tuition Reimbursement after 6 month

This management level position oversees multiple teams at the assigned Logistics Field Operation location, and may supervise warehouse and inventory teams as needed. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Oversee day-to-day transportation operations needs at assigned locations in coordination with other site leaders.
  • Participate in the development of site specific goals and objectives, and ensure alignment and effective execution within the site.
  • Review and evaluate daily route schedules and work with Logistics Operations Planning and Scheduling to address issues and deficiencies.
  • Providing mentoring and accountability to, direct reports and succession planning through coaching, leadership development and training, and performance management.
  • Ensure work areas meet or exceed applicable workplace safety standards, including yard cleanliness and, completing GEMBA walks. (Gemba translates to “where the work is”).
  • Ensure timely and effective communication with internal teams.
  • As needed, coordinate and monitor the movement of inventory on the ground through the warehouse workflow; evaluate and distribute work and assigned shifts to meet business needs.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Knowledge of DOT compliance/regulations
  • 2+ years of people leadership experience
  • 3+ years of logistics or supply chain experience
  • Preferred: Bachelor's Degree in related fields.
  • Demonstrable experience leading or developing people (in either formal or informal roles), including managing CDL drivers.
  • Transportation experience, which may include driving a vehicle transporter or tractor trailer, or equivalent Military experience preferred.

Other Requirements: Loader certification required; must complete Carvana's loader training and certification program

WORKING CONDITIONS
Ability to safely perform physical requirements of the position, including: frequently move in and out of vehicles; frequently stand, bend, twist, stoop, and squat; regularly walk 75’; regularly climb ladders and ramps of up to 10’; regularly work up to 10’ above ground; continually sit for 10 hours; regularly push, pull and lift 20 lbs, and periodically lift up to 60 lbs.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, 1: Many Merchant Growth
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Consumers across the globe need safe, transparent financing while merchants want to provide users with their preferred way to pay and convert more buyers. To help achieve this vision, we are hiring a Senior Product Manager for our 1:Many Growth team.

Affirm's Distribution Partnerships program - internally called "1:Many" - is one of the highest-leverage growth levers at the company. Instead of integrating merchant by merchant, we integrate once into a platform merchants already use, and every merchant on that platform becomes reachable through that single integration. This role is responsible for:

  • Own and grow Affirm's partner portfolio - making it easier and more frictionless for merchants to onboard and offer Affirm as a payment method to their customers. This includes taking product ownership of Affirm's existing vertical software partnerships, and growing the broader portfolio of platform partners still being stood up.

  • Partner Acceleration Strategy - building the durable capabilities that make every future partner integration faster to launch and easier to scale, rather than solving the same problem one partner at a time.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will work closely with cross-functional teams including commercial, merchant risk, design, product analytics, and engineering to define, launch and grow integrations with platform partners. Effective stakeholder management and ability to successfully navigate organizational dynamics are a must for success. You should be outcomes-driven with a very high bias for action.

What You'll Do

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, launch, and grow integrations with payment and platform partners.
  • Build durable, repeatable capabilities through a Partner Acceleration Strategy that makes future partner integrations faster to launch.
  • Build relationships with platform partners to gather feedback and insights on product performance, and use it to drive merchant growth.
  • Define and prioritize product features and requirements to improve the customer, partner, and merchant experience.
  • Create and manage the product roadmap for the broader 1:Many growth team.
  • Develop success metrics/OKRs to measure the effectiveness of these initiatives.
  • Partner with commercial and product marketing teams to develop go-to-market strategies for new partner integrations and features.

 

What We Look For

  • 5+ years of product management experience
  • Proven ability to multiple technical software products from kickoff to post-launch, driving meaningful business impact you can clearly articulate. 
  • Skilled in cross-functional collaboration — diving into technical details with engineers, iterating with designers in Figma, and analyzing funnel performance with data analysts.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills to navigate complex dynamics and drive alignment. 
  • Execution-oriented with a proactive approach to overcoming obstacles and blockers.
  • Adept at transforming incomplete or conflicting inputs into clear, actionable plans.
  • Demonstrated track record of shipping high-quality products on time. 
  • Comfortable engaging in the commercial aspects of product development, including representing the product externally, setting expectations, and influencing outcomes that benefit both Affirm and its partners. 
  • Bonus points: Experience in Fintech, Lending, ecommerce, or BNPL.

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Role

The Foundation and Fleet team own many critical frontend technologies for us to provide unique user experiences and mission control our fleet of > 1.8 million online cameras.  Examples include user interfaces for new camera hardware initiatives (eg. our remote camera), Unified Event Timeline, our cameras home page, camera grids, and camera analytics dashboards.

You’ll be a part of a highly adaptable and dynamic team environment where we assess incoming user facing product requirements along with internal quality initiatives. Our philosophy is to best align what interests you with the company priorities and work together as a team to support each other in delivering the highest quality product possible.

This role requires that you are on-site 5 days a week.

What You'll Do

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Autonomy Core Frameworks
jobs.description:
About the Company 

At Torc, we have always believed that autonomous vehicle technology will transform how we travel, move freight, and do business. 
A leader in autonomous driving since 2007, Torc has spent over a decade commercializing our solutions with experienced partners. Now a part of the Daimler family, we are focused solely on developing software for automated trucks to transform how the world moves freight. 
Join us and catapult your career with the company that helped pioneer autonomous technology, and the first AV software company with the vision to partner directly with a truck manufacturer. 

Meet the Team 

The Senior Autonomy Core Frameworks Software Engineer plays a critical role in architecting and advancing the foundational frameworks that underpin Torc's autonomous driving stack. This role helps in owning technical direction for the software in core autonomy components, helping to raise the bar on code quality, and driving improvements across the autonomy software. 

As a senior technical leader, you will collaborate closely with the Behavior and Perception teams within Autonomy to design robust, composable architectural patterns that serve as the foundation for safe, performant, reliable autonomous operation. This position demands deep technical expertise in software architecture and autonomous vehicle fundamentals. 

What You’ll Do 

  • Lead the architecture, design, implementation, and evolution of core frameworks that serve as the foundation for Torc's autonomous driving stack, including state management, inter-component communication, abstraction layers, and common utilities used across all software systems.
  • Drive the technical direction for real-time C++ architectural components and patterns responsible for reliable system-wide data flow, component coordination, error handling, and operational observability.
  • Establish scalable architectural patterns and abstractions that enable autonomous driving capabilities while driving technical tradeoff discussions and long-term design decisions that shape the entire platform.
  • Collaborate across Behavior and Perception teams to keep integration boundaries clean and shared abstractions coherent.
  • Lead architecture reviews, design discussions, and code reviews while establishing engineering standards that improve reliability, maintainability, testability, and scalability across the platform.
  • Mentor software engineers through technical coaching, architectural guidance, and day-to-day collaboration while raising engineering standards and fostering technical excellence across the organization.
  • Champion architectural quality through systematic validation, comprehensive testing strategies, observability frameworks, and production readiness practices that ensure platform robustness at scale.
  • Contribute to root cause analysis of complex platform-level issues and drive architectural improvements that enhance system reliability, performance, and operational resilience.
  • Define and evolve simulation and validation frameworks that enable rigorous testing of core architectural components across diverse operational scenarios and edge cases.
  • Evaluate emerging architectural patterns, systems research, and advanced techniques that can strengthen the platform's foundation and enable future autonomous driving capabilities.
  • Communicate complex architectural concepts and technical vision effectively across engineering teams, product, and leadership while building consensus around platform direction and technical strategy. 

What You’ll Need to Succeed 

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or related technical discipline with 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, or
  • Master's degree with 6+ years of professional experience, or
  • Demonstrated success designing and evolving complex, production software platforms with ownership of architectural decisions
  • Deep experienced with C++17 and recent standards
  • Comfortable with using Python to help script and glue systems together
  • Experience working across autonomous systems/robotics, distributed systems, or complex embedded environments using middleware with pub-sub communications patterns
  • Strong experience with testing, continuous integration, and build systems
  • Deep experience with systems-level software design, including experience managing technical debt, refactoring large codebases, and evolving platforms while maintaining stability and performance.
  • Experience mentoring engineers through technical leadership, architecture reviews, code reviews, and establishing engineering standards that scale across organizations.
  • Strong mastery of software engineering fundamentals including modular/composable architecture, design patterns, concurrency, testing strategies, and long-term maintainability. 

Bonus Points 

  • Experience architecting, maintaining, and using robotics middleware's (E.g., ROS 2)
  • Deep expertise in distributed systems design, including consensus algorithms, state synchronization, event-driven architectures, deterministic replay, etc.
  • Familiarity with ISO 26262, SOTIF, ASPICE, or other safety-critical software development standards.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions and Jenkins
  • Experience with Bazel and Bazel-based build systems
  • Experience designing or building observability, logging, and monitoring systems for complex distributed systems.
  • Experience working with simulations for regression testing
  • Experience managing versioning and conversion of data schemas at scale 

Perks of Being a Full-time Torc’r 
Torc cares about our team members and we strive to provide benefits and resources to support their health, work/life balance, and future. Our culture is collaborative, energetic, and team focused. Torc offers:    
 

  • A competitive compensation package that includes a bonus component and stock options
  • 100% paid medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees
  • 401K plan with a 6% employer match
  • Flexibility in schedule and generous paid vacation (available immediately after start date)
  • AD+D and Life Insurance 

At Torc, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We celebrate the uniqueness of our Torc’rs and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, or disabilities. 
Even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications listed for this opportunity, we encourage you to apply. 

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several geographic markets. Pay is based on a number of factors and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Torc's total compensation package will also include our corporate bonus and stock option plan. Dependent on the position offered, sign-on payments, relocation, and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits.

jobs.title: Employee Experience Associate
jobs.description:
Who we are 

Atoms is building the machines that power the next era of progress.

Over the last decade, software has transformed the digital world. But the physical world, where food is made, minerals are mined, goods are moved, and industries are run, remains far less intelligent, far less efficient, and far more constrained. We’re changing that.

Atoms builds Physical AI— real-world robots for the industries that move civilization forward, starting with food, mining, and transport. Our systems are designed to understand, predict, and control the real world with precision, turning complex physical operations into something more reliable, more scalable, and more productive.

This work requires more than robotics. It requires deep integration across hardware, software, AI, operations, manufacturing, and real estate. We don’t just build machines in a lab. We deploy them into real environments, operate them, learn from them, and improve them until they work at scale.

We are roboticists, engineers, operators, and builders. We believe the next great technology companies will not only transform information, but the physical systems that shape everyday life.

If you want to work on hard problems with real-world impact, join us.

 

About the role

The Employee Experience Associate is a key member of our Employee Experience team,  focused on delivering exceptional, consistent support to our W-2 employee drivers. You will prioritize the employee experience by assisting off-the-road drivers with general support, policy clarification, and scheduling questions, via phone, chat, and tickets. This includes ensuring each interaction is clear, consistent, and centered on a positive, high-quality “white glove” experience for our employees, who are at the core of our service. Your role plays an important part in setting our employees up for success. 

While the core role is supporting our employees, this role may also support our customers (riders) during peak times or team absences by managing support channels, monitoring trips, and proactively communicating with customers impacted by service delays or account issues.

This role will be expected to work a Tuesday - Saturday schedule, with some evening hours required to support business needs. 

 

What you’ll do

  • Employee Support: Deliver exceptional off-the-road support to employees via phone, chat, and Zendesk ticketing, focusing on scheduling, attendance, and policy clarification, and appropriately redirecting HR or Payroll-related issues.
  • Ticket & Queue Management: Manage Zendesk queues, ensuring timely responses, maintaining SLA adherence, and delivering accurate and thorough resolutions for all employee and customer inquiries.
  • Employee Appeals: Review and document employee appeals related to safety scores or policy violations, escalating findings to the appropriate departments when necessary.
  • Data Security: Handle all employee information, disciplinary documentation, and Personally Identifiable Information (PII) with the utmost discretion and compliance with Atoms’ data privacy and security standards.
  • Driver Feedback Tracking: Document and accurately categorize customer-reported driver complaints, ensuring each instance is logged for Market Operations follow-up.
  • Customer Support: When necessary, handle inbound customer calls and texts for (via Hubspot and UJET), professionally addressing and resolving trip-related or account concerns.
  • Team Engagement: Actively participate in required team meetings to share trends, process improvements, and updates on driver and customer sentiment.

 

What we´re looking for

  • 1+ years of experience in a high-touch customer and/or internal support role.
  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a desire to help others.
  • Superior written and verbal communication skills. Ability to articulate complex policies clearly while conveying empathy and confidence to both customers and employees.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a demonstrated ability to consistently and accurately interpret, apply, and defend complex company policies (e.g., attendance, scheduling, safety appeals).
  • Commitment to discretion & integrity when managing sensitive information (PII, disciplinary records, etc),  ensuring full compliance with Atoms’ data privacy and security protocols.
  • Tech-savvy and comfortable navigating multiple software systems simultaneously (CRM, scheduling, timekeeping)
  • Proven ability to manage high-volume support queues while consistently meeting team goals and SLAs
  • Ability to work atypical hours when needed, including evenings and/or Saturdays. 
  • Bilingual in Spanish and English

Bonus Points (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Associate’s degree
  • Direct experience working with core CRM systems such as Zendesk, HubSpot, or UJET.
  • Direct experience supporting internal employees or drivers on operational, scheduling, or timekeeping topics.

 

Why join us

At Atoms, you’ll work on one of the defining challenges of our time—bringing automation into the physical world to drive real, lasting impact. We exist to uncover valuable unknown truths and turn them into progress, which means constantly pushing beyond what’s known and building what doesn’t yet exist. The work is ambitious and often challenging, but it’s grounded in a shared sense of purpose and a team committed to seeing it through together. Our work only matters if it serves others, and we know that meaningful progress depends on the trust of the people we serve and the strength of our team—so we invest in both, creating an environment where you can do your best work and grow.

 

What else you need to know

This role is based in our Dallas office. Atoms is a company driven by invention and continuous change - we are constantly reimagining our industries, building new products, and refining how we operate. We do our best work together. That’s why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week.

The base salary range for this role is $50,000 - $70,000 per year.

Actual compensation will be determined on an individual basis and may vary depending on experience, skills, and qualifications.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package. You may also be eligible for equity awards.

Benefits Summary (USA Full-Time Exempt Employees):

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, and Life Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Account / Health Savings Account Options
  • 401(k)
  • Equity
  • Sick Time, Unlimited Flexible Time Off, and Paid Holidays
  • Paid Parental Leave 
  • Pre-Tax Commuter Benefit Plan

Benefits are subject to change at the company's discretion.
Atoms accepts applications on an ongoing basis.

 

Ready to join us as we serve those who serve others?

jobs.description:

About Us

ADESA, a Carvana-owned company, currently operates in over 50 locations throughout the US. Our auto auctions, some up to 200 acres, provide a wide array of vehicle services including repair, reconditioning, and auction remarketing, and many of our sites serve as market hub distribution centers. Our inventory comprises hundreds of thousands of vehicles across North America from retail to commercial, OEM & more.

We work in a service industry and embrace a “we” versus “I” culture – help others, and they will help you. Our industry is fun, fast-paced, and competitive – and filled with the best people who are passionate about what they do.

We’re excited about the future! As an industry leader, ADESA is poised for a multi-year expansion including huge investments in facilities, massive sales growth, and an ever-increasing inventory of vehicles! We are looking for great people who want to take this journey with us! Get a sneak peek into life at ADESA!

Role and Team

Reporting to the Vehicle Inspection Manager or Lead, this role supports customers by inspecting vehicles for condition, wear, tear, neglect, missing parts, mechanical issues, previous repairs and damage/structural damage.  Complete required vehicle inspection promptly and accurately including imaging and uploading results of the vehicle condition. Interact with dealers and consumers as needed professionally as the face of ADESA and its collective businesses.   

Responsibilities

  • Communicate in a professional manner with customer (dealer or consumer)
  • Resolve any customer inquiries in a friendly, courteous and professional manner; advise management of all complaints or incidents
  • Ensure internal and external customers receive prompt, efficient and courteous attention
  • Inspect vehicles for signs of wear, tear, neglect, damage, previous repair or structural damage
  • Complete inspection of vehicles and ensure adherence to the defined program for the customer.
  • Capture data accurately on a mobile device, work comfortably with software and technology.
  • Deliver results in a timely manner
  • Maintain productivity levels as set forth by management.
  • Deliver consistent, accurate inspections with minimal rate of errors in accordance with reasonable expectations set forth by management. 
  • Collaborate with Manager and sales team members on customer needs with insights to improve services provided
  • Maintain equipment and tools properly and advise manager of any needed equipment maintenance or breakdown
  • Ensure vehicles are in clean condition with radios, seats, mirrors and other convenience items in the same position as when the vehicle arrived  
  • Submit completed condition reports using the appropriate technology made available to you to complete the vehicle inspection

Complete road test if required by contract or inspection typeKeep current on technology updates, new releases and product development

  • Understand the functionality and ability to use tools such as paint meters, OBD scanner etc.
  • Develop and maintain knowledge and expertise in areas of competitor products 
  • Any other duties assigned by the designated manager

Skills and Attributes

  • Critical Thinking / Problem Solving
  •  Ability to enter data on a hand held device
  • Team player who can collaborate well with multiple departments, customers and vendors
  • Strong customer service skills
  • High degree of safety focus
  • Proven ability to multitask while maintaining attention to detail
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • Must be 18 years of age and have a valid driver’s license that meets the requirements
  • Able to safely drive a variety of make/model/sizes of vehicles
  • Proficiency with computer systems and applications

ADESA Values

  • We’re All in This Together: The company is unified by the shared goal of providing fantastic customer experiences, achieved through mutual trust, respect, and understanding.

  • Don’t Be a Richard: A simple guiding principle to act appropriately and professionally.
  • Stay Scrappy: This value rejects mediocrity and "good enough," pushing employees to do more with less to pass savings on to customers.

ADESA Benefits and Perks

Competitive Pay | Quality Benefits | Holiday and Paid Time Off | Education and Equipment Reimbursement Programs | Matching 401(k) | Career Path Opportunities | And More!

Other Requirements

To be able to do your job at ADESA, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you. Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs. 

  • The physical activity requirements of the position range from Light to Medium Physical Work.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Scale
jobs.description:
You've helped run a scale or pooled CS model before, or you've been inside one long enough to know what works and what doesn't. You know that scale CS done badly is just support with a fancier title, and done well it's a system that delivers consistent value to hundreds of customers. You want to join and help build the good version.

Expel is an MDR company. Our customers are security teams who depend on us to find and stop threats. We're launching a scale model for a segment of our customer base, and we're building it from scratch: the playbooks, the automation, the operating model, the measurement framework. You won't inherit a finished system. You'll be a primary contributor to designing it.

That means you're not just executing motions. You own specific programs within the model (new customer/onboarding cohorts, renewal campaigns, segment outreach), you exercise judgment on the edge cases the playbook doesn't cover, and you identify patterns across hundreds of customer interactions that tell you where the model needs to improve. When something breaks, you fix the process, not just the situation.

Your success is measured by the team's retention outcomes across the scale segment, the quality of your execution, and the motions you build and improve.

What Expel can do for you

  • Put you at the center of building a scale CS model from scratch inside a security company, with the latitude to shape how it works
  • Give you a company transforming security operations from industry-leading 20-minute outcomes toward 20-second outcomes with AI and automation, the kind of product story that makes CS conversations genuinely interesting
  • Surround you with experienced CS leadership that has built scale models before and knows the difference between good and bad
  • Connect you with customers who genuinely care about their security programs
  • Offer a clear path to grow professionally as our scale program and company grow

What you can do for Expel

  • Help design, execute and continuously improve playbook-driven customer interactions across the scale segment: new customer/onboarding, health checks, renewals, proactive outreach
  • Own specific motions or programs within the model, from design through execution and measurement
  • Exercise judgment on edge cases, distinguishing between situations that fit the playbook, situations that need a creative solution, and situations that require escalation
  • Design and lead one-to-many customer engagements: webinars, digital campaigns, scaled communications
  • Identify patterns in customer interactions and translate them into process improvements that make the scale function stronger
  • Maintain technical credibility in every interaction, speaking knowledgeably about Expel's service, security operations, and common integration patterns
  • Provide coaching and guidance to associate-level team members on process execution and customer handling
  • Contribute to the design of the scale operating model itself: systems requirements, automation workflows, measurement frameworks

What you should bring with you

  • 2+ years of customer success, account management, or customer-facing experience
  • At least 2 years in the security industry (operations, products, consulting, GRC, or incident response)
  • Experience in a scale, scaled, or digital CS model is strongly preferred
  • Experience designing or significantly improving customer-facing processes or playbooks
  • Strong comfort with high-volume, queue-based work and frequent context-switching
  • Excellent written communication skills, clear, efficient, and adaptable across customer segments
  • Judgment to distinguish between what fits the playbook, what needs creativity, and what needs escalation
  • Solid security domain fluency: MDR, EDR, SIEM, NDR, cloud security, and how a real security program fits together
  • Familiarity with CS platforms, ticketing systems, and automation tools, with opinions about what works

Additional notes

The base salary range for this role is between $93,900 and $136,200 + bonus eligibility and equity.

We believe in paying transparently and equitably. Your salary will ultimately be based on factors such as your experience, skills, team equity, and market data. You’ll also be eligible for unlimited PTO (which we model and encourage), work location flexibility, up to 24 weeks of parental leave, and really excellent health benefits.

We're only hiring those authorized to work in the United States.

We're an Equal Opportunity Employer: You will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

We’ll ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please let us know if you need accommodation of any kind.

As an Entry-Level Technician, you’ll be expected to perform light maintenance, fluid checks, and/or conduct the initial inspection on our vehicles to look for any imperfections or repairs that may be needed throughout the reconditioning process.

At Carvana, you’ll receive a competitive wage and amazing perks – including a 401(k) with Carvana match and even a vehicle purchase discount – all while using state of the art tools in one of our high-tech Inspection Centers (click here to learn more). If you’re joining us in an entry-level position, we offer training programs to make sure your skills and pay progress along with the company.

Other perks of the Job

  • 100% company-paid healthcare premiums
  • Generous paid-time off and your birthday is a holiday!
  • ASE and tool reimbursement programs
  • Tuition reimbursement and student loan repayment

We do everything we can to deliver an exceptional customer experience, and that includes delivering great vehicles when expected. If we're in a pinch, mandatory overtime is one way in which we can follow-through on this commitment to our customers. We're looking for team players who are all in on our mission and are able to work mandatory overtime based on our business needs. 

How To Get Started
Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 508-4749, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM MST.

Not a match for this role?
We have a variety of Technician roles in our Inspection Centers, depending on your level of experience - take a look below to see what you’ll be doing to help us get our low-mileage, late-model cars ready for our customers:

  • Entry-Level Auto Technician (min 6 months professional experience): perform light maintenance, fluid checks, and/or conduct the initial inspection on our vehicles to look for any imperfections or repairs that may be needed throughout the reconditioning process.
  • Brake and Tire Technician (min 1 year professional experience): perform light maintenance or repairs, including changing brakes and tires
  • Mid-Level (Mechanical Repair / Build / General) Technician (min 3 years of professional experience): perform light to medium automotive repairs and minimal diagnostics on our vehicles
  • Experienced Technician (min 5 years of professional experience): perform extensive repairs and heavy engine work, as well as advanced vehicle diagnostics on all makes and models, including electric and hybrid vehicles

  • Auto Body roles: Paint, Prep/Body work, Wheel Repair, Airbrush, Interior Repair, Glass Repair, and PDR (Paintless Dent Repair) roles
  • Auto Technician/Mechanic roles: Lube and Oil, Inspection, Brake and Tire, Mechanical Repair / Build, and Master Technician roles

General qualifications and requirements

At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website.

jobs.title: Production Technology Deliver Lead
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Job

Production Technology (ProdTech) enables Anduril's end-to-end production processes through technology, drives system adoption and adherence, and owns the roadmap for our production enterprise systems. The Delivery Lead serves as the voice of the product line or division, bridging the gap between production teams and technology, owning the health, adoption, and compliance of the digital tools that keep Production running. The Delivery Lead does not need to be a deep technical specialist; however, they will require working understanding of each production function and what tools are used to execute production needs, in order to advocate relentlessly on behalf of end users.

This role reports directly to Production Technology leadership with a dotted line relationship to the product line Head of Production or divisional VP of Production.

What You'll Do

Serve as the point of contact for the wellness, adoption, and compliance of digital tools across your product line(s). Conduct recurring check-ins with functional leaders to identify and track the top issues affecting the business. Maintain a current view of overall systems health and collaborate with technical stakeholders to address issues plaguing your user base. Feed quantifiable signal to our Global Operations team, clearly articulating the top issues, their impact, and the path to resolution.

As needed, act as the primary liaison for new enterprise technology initiatives. Be a trusted partner for ProdTech and CorpTech stakeholders, driving the readiness of your site(s) and user base based on the projects demands. For example, driving the completion of system testing, training, or data readiness for an upcoming implementation. You will need to have an appetite to get into the details with end users, but also the altitude to communicate business needs to executives.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience in program management or a similar cross-functional operations role.
  • An appetite to go deep with subject matter experts to understand their needs. You don’t need to be the expert, but you need to learn from them quickly.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with a comfort level presenting to senior leadership and escalating issues with appropriate urgency.
  • The ability to synthesize information from multiple sources into a clear, concise picture of systems health. We value data over vibes.
  • Familiarity with digital tools and production technology ecosystems, with an emphasis on adoption and implementation.
  • A bias toward action and accountability — this role was born out of a real operational need. It will require someone who can drive outcomes, not just track them.

Preferred Qualifications

  • You have 5+ years of experience in management consulting, internal operations, a business analyst role - or some other experience where you just had to figure out how to get stuff done.
  • Project work in software, systems, manufacturing engineering, supply chain, or production planning. Ideally with digital systems such as MRP, ERP, WMS, PLM.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance strategic vision with tactical execution.
  • You have an appetite to build clear frameworks to structure messy, complex problems.
  • You are self-driven and relentlessly proactive. You don’t need someone to tell you to “move”. You just move. We’d rather have to tell you to slow down than to speed up.
  • Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities.

 

US Salary Range
$167,000—$222,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

 

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. 

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

 

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/. 

 

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources.
