jobs.description:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

Position Summary:

The Senior Supply Chain Program Manager, Energy Storage is a career-level individual contributor role that owns program management across all commodities supporting the Energy Storage business. The role builds and maintains the integrated supply chain schedule across commodity owners, suppliers, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Finance, tracks supplier milestones and risks, and drives material readiness for new product introduction builds and production ramp. The role works independently and is reviewed at critical points. This is a fully on-site role in our San Francisco R&D space, with approximately 10% international travel to supplier sites.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead the integrated supply chain program plan across all Energy Storage commodities (for example, electronics PCBAs, mechanical components, energy equipment, solar panels, and harnesses), tracking milestones, dependencies, and resources across suppliers and internal teams
  • Serve as the liaison between Supply Chain commodity teams and Programs, Engineering, Manufacturing, Finance, and leadership, communicating program status, key milestones, and risks
  • Identify supply and schedule risks early, and devise and drive mitigation plans with commodity owners and suppliers
  • Coordinate supplier readiness for new product introduction builds and production ramp, including capacity, qualification, and delivery plans
  • Track supply chain program metrics (cost, lead time, delivery performance, inventory) across commodities and report results to leadership
  • Resolve cross-functional issues and escalations that affect program schedule, cost, or quality
  • Develop and improve program management tools, templates, and processes for supply chain programs

Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, Operations Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of program management, supply chain, or sourcing experience (3+ years with a Master's degree), ideally in energy storage, battery, EV, or electronics manufacturing
  • Working knowledge of new product introduction, production ramp, and supply chain operations across electronic, mechanical, and electromechanical commodities
  • Experience building and managing integrated schedules, milestone trackers, and risk registers across multiple stakeholders and commodity teams
  • Ability to analyze supply chain data (cost, lead time, delivery, inventory) to identify trends and risks
  • Ability to communicate program status and risks clearly, in writing and verbally, to cross-functional partners and leadership
  • Ability to travel internationally to supplier sites approximately 10% of the time

$135,000—$180,000 USD

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Furthermore, this is a dedicated people leadership role where you will have the mandate to develop the next generation of product talent at Pinterest.

jobs.description:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

 

Chemical Operator

The chemical operator works in a team effort to operate, monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot all plant processes. The responsibility of all plant systems lies with the technician while on shift. In-process analyses may be required to ensure operations are within acceptable parameters. In-process analytical and instrumentation provide the technician with the information needed to evaluate the need for process adjustments to maintain a high-quality finished good. Chemical Operators will own the equipment and will be the most important resource to ensure a safe working environment for all stakeholders. 

Responsibilities will include:

  • Remedy unsafe conditions when found, e.g., tripping hazards and spills, and report conditions where immediate action cannot be accomplished. 
  • Day-to-day operations of a continuously running production line, including sampling, forklift driving, and performing actions on Ignition and other HMIs. 
  • Work in a team environment to start up, shut down, monitor, inspect, operate, and adjust plant equipment while meeting customer expectations. 
  • Analyze trends in various plant parameters such as temperature, pressure, pH, and flow to respond appropriately to process deviations with the goal to maintain product specifications and safe conditions 
  • Operate production equipment including, but not limited to, holding tanks, centrifugal pumps, leaf filters, heat exchangers, electrodeposition machines, metering pumps, wastewater treatment systems, utility manifolds, centrifuges, filter presses, kilns, bulk material conveyance, evaporators, crystallizers, mills, mixers, and logistical equipment. 
  • Perform routine product samples to submit for analysis and verify results are within expected parameters. 
  • Work with Engineering and Manufacturing teams to ensure instructions are executed and communicated effectively across shifts. 

Desired Qualifications:

  • Basic working knowledge of chemical plant operations and process equipment (6 months of experience preferred). 
  • Demonstrated ability to follow procedures precisely while maintaining situational awareness and sound judgment. 
  • Willingness to speak up, escalate issues early, and challenge unsafe conditions respectfully. 
  • A passion for sustainability and making the world a better place!

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods while monitoring operations. 
  • Ability to work for long periods (up to 12 hours) in a PAPR
  • Ability to climb stairs and ladders and work in a multi‑level industrial facility. 
  • Ability to bend, twist, lift, and carry materials and tools (up to approximately 50 lbs).

jobs.title: Head of Corporate Accounting
jobs.description:
Scale is looking for a Head of Corporate Accounting to lead its global Corporate Accounting function. Reporting directly to the Global Controller, you will own general ledger, cost, and international accounting and consolidation, leading a team of functional leads across each area. This role will be instrumental in optimizing our month-end close process, reducing inefficiencies and risk, and scaling the processes, controls, agentic workflows and systems that support Scale's growth.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader with deep U.S. GAAP expertise, extensive experience running a multi-entity global close, and a proven track record of leading process improvement projects that deliver measurable results.

You will:

  • Own the close: Lead the month-end close across all entities, ensuring timely and accurate financial results in accordance with U.S. GAAP
  • Lead the Corporate Accounting team: Manage and develop the GL, Cost, Revenue, and International Accounting leads and their teams, setting clear priorities and building a culture of ownership, accuracy, and continuous improvement
  • Treasury operations: Manage the company’s day-to-day treasury operations, including daily cash positioning and monitoring, bank account administration and banking relationships, intercompany funding and cash movements
  • Policies and controls: Own key internal policies related to corporate accounting (fixed assets, prepaid expenses, accrued liabilities, capitalized internal-use software, etc.) and maintain an effective controls environment that reduces financial reporting risk
  • General ledger: Oversee the review of journal entries, account reconciliations, and flux analyses, and maintain the general ledger in accordance with U.S. GAAP

jobs.title: Market Strategy & Pricing Manager
jobs.description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com http://OpenGov.com.




JOB SUMMARY

We are seeking a Market Strategy & Pricing Manager to lead our effort to build out or pricing motion and leverage quantitative approaches to inform our market strategy. This role will partner with executive stakeholders across Product, Finance, and GTM to define our TAM / SAM, build in depth models of our market and the competitive landscape and price our products to win in the market.  The ideal candidate is a self-starter who is comfortable operating with ambiguity, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and relishes the opportunity to own a critical capability from end to end. This person will have a high degree of visibility with senior leadership, including Executive and VP leaders across Finance, Product, GTM functions so must be skilled at synthesizing complex information into decision ready recommendations.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Strategic Analysis & Recommendations: Lead analyses that inform product development, partnerships, and M&A, translating findings into clear recommendations with options and tradeoffs for leadership.

 - Pricing: Partner with Product and Product Marketing to price new products for sale and update pricing on existing products to win in the market. Own discounting analysis and pricing recommendations delivered to leadership.

 - Market Diligence: Direct market diligence to size opportunities, assess product-market fit, and model pricing and sales forecasting to support direct product investment or M&A initiatives.

 - Market Intelligence Integration: Integrate TAM/SAM models, pricing insights, and field intelligence into product planning and prioritization.

 - Executive Communication: Package and present insights to leadership teams on both recurring and ad-hoc bases, tailoring depth and framing to the audience.

 - Deliverable Ownership: Own deliverables across pricing, TAM/SAM, and strategic analysis, ensuring quality, and consistency.

 


REQUIREMENTS

 - Bachelor’s degree in business, economics, finance, or a related field; MBA or other advanced degree preferred.

 - 6 – 8 years of experience in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, competitive intelligence, or pricing/market strategy roles, ideally within B2B SaaS or enterprise software.

 - Demonstrated experience leading pricing strategy, TAM/SAM sizing, and market or competitive analysis that directly informed executive decision-making.

 - Experience supporting M&A processes, including market diligence, opportunity sizing, and pricing and sales forecasting.

 - Strong financial modeling, quantitative analysis, and forecasting skills.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of presenting complex analysis to senior executives and translating it into clear, actionable recommendations.

 - Ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams and balance short-term deliverables against multi-quarter strategic initiatives.

 - Comfortable operating with ambiguity in a fast-paced environment; strong ability to influence cross-functionally across Product, Finance, and GTM.

 - Proficiency in SQL and statistical programming languages (e.g., Python, R) for analytics, statistical modeling, or data manipulation.

 - Demonstrated experience using AI tools for research, analysis, and synthesis




COMPENSATION

Boston, MA: $150,000 - $168,000



On target ranges above include base plus a portion of variable compensation that is earned based on company and individual performance.

 

The final compensation will be determined by a number of factors such as qualifications, expertise, and the candidate’s geographical location.

 




WHY OPENGOV?



A Mission That Matters. 

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust.  Some people say this is boring.  We think it’s the core of our democracy.



Opportunity to Innovate

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.



A Team of Passionate, Driven People

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.



A Place to Make Your Mark

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.



Benefits That Work for You

Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

 - Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families

 - Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays

 - 401(k) with company match

 - Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions

 - Professional development and growth opportunities

 - A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

jobs.title: Material Handler
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

The material handler will be responsible for the receipt, warehousing and issuance of material and components against work orders to support the production of rocket motor systems and comply with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR). This individual will be a key contributor in the flow of components and subassemblies to production for assembly. This role will report to the Warehouse Manager or Supervisor and collaborate with the inventory and purchasing groups to ensure that material is being consumed, replenished and stored according to plan. Key performance indicators for this role include on-time delivery, inventory accuracy, part quality and the implementation of continuous improvement initiatives.  The role subject to demands of production and ability to work overtime or off-days is required.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3+ years working in a contract manufacturing or warehouse setting (aerospace, defense or chemical industry preferred)
  • Experience with shipping/receiving, inventory management, cycle counting and kitting
  • Ability to read and understand bills of lading, stock transfers and pick lists
  • Familiarity with ERP systems (NetSuite, Fishbowl Manufacturing, Odoo, etc.)
  • Basic computer skills (Word, Excel, email, etc.)
  • Strong organization and communication skills
  • High integrity and a commitment to excellence
  • Must be a team player and maintain positive attitude and strive for world class customer service
  • Must uphold a positive attitude and foster strong relationships with facility customers
  • Ability to lift 30 lbs
  • Ability to be on your feet throughout the day
  • Ability to multitask with little supervision and with a sense of urgency
  • Ability to obtain hazardous materials certifications and ability to work safely with hazmat and energetics
  • S. Person status is required as this position needs to access export controlled data

PREFERRED REQUIREMENTS

  • High school degree or GED
  • Familiarity with 5S, lean manufacturing principles
  • Experience in an AS9100 quality system
  • Experience working in new model launch or start up environments
  • Forklift, pallet jack and/or cherry picker experience desired
  • Experience with handling government property under the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR)
  • Collaborating with receiving and quality to ensure that production components are transferred to inventory and placed in discrete storage location in a timely manner
  • Using pick lists to pick and kit components/subassemblies against manufacturing orders in accordance to the production schedule
  • Cycle counting components and reporting inventory discrepancies or replenishment signals to the responsible parties
  • Utilizing the ERP system and scanning to execute material transfer or goods issue orders
  • Experience with proper packaging, labeling, and storage per material requirements
  • Experience maintaining material traceability, inventory locations, and accuracy
  • Understanding of Warehouse KPI’s to drive performance and customer service

 

 

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

 

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. 

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

 

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/. 

 

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Data Center Technician - Sandusky, OH
jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

About the Team

Our Data Center Operations team is at the physical core of our business, responsible for building, maintaining, and operating the infrastructure that powers the cloud. We are seeking Data Center Technicians across a range of experience levels to ensure service availability, physical reliability, and operational excellence across our facilities.

In this salaried, 100% on-site position, you will perform hands-on hardware and network diagnostics, equipment installations, structured cabling, and physical repairs. Your responsibilities and level of autonomy will match your experience, with opportunities to build technical skills and take on more complex work. Candidates will be leveled during the interview process based on technical expertise, depth of experience, and problem-solving ability.

This role requires participation in a rotating on-call schedule. You must live within 60 minutes of the site to support on-call responsibilities and be able to travel up to 15% to other data center locations as needed.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Data Center Operations & Maintenance: Assemble, rack, stack, and maintain data center server, storage, and networking hardware. Maintain hot/cold aisle containment, conduct inventory audits, and perform routine physical maintenance.
  • Diagnostics & Repair: Conduct hardware and network diagnostics on live and offline systems. Troubleshoot issues reported through tickets, replace components, and perform physical repairs.
  • Equipment Deployment: Support equipment installations, device provisioning, and operating system installations, taking on more complex troubleshooting and deployment work as your experience grows.
  • Structured Cabling & Security: Maintain high standards of cable management and structured cabling, and follow physical and cybersecurity protocols.
  • Process & Documentation: Maintain accurate inventory records and ticket updates. Contribute to standard operating procedures (SOPs), technical documentation, and process improvements.
  • Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing: Collaborate with local and cross-functional teams to support operational readiness. Share knowledge and contribute to team training and development.
  • On-Call & Response: Participate in a rotating on-call schedule and be available to arrive on-site within 60 minutes when an incident requires hands-on support.

Qualifications:

  • Hardware Foundation: Hands-on experience or coursework in computer hardware assembly, installation, and physical and logical troubleshooting.
  • Operating Systems & Networking: Familiarity with Linux operating systems and fundamental networking concepts.
  • Problem-Solving & Judgment: Ability to follow established procedures, prioritize tasks, troubleshoot technical issues, and recognize when to ask for guidance or escalate.
  • Communication & Teamwork: Strong organizational and communication skills, a collaborative and curious mindset, and a commitment to high reliability standards.
  • Learning & Development: Willingness to build technical skills, learn new systems, and take on responsibilities that match your experience.
  • Physical Requirements: Ability to perform the following essential duties, with or without reasonable accommodation:
    • Move and position equipment weighing up to 50 lbs.
    • Remain in a stationary position for extended periods while performing diagnostics and repairs.
    • Access equipment in confined spaces, under-floor areas, and on ladders.
    • Handle small hardware components, connectors, and cabling with precision.
    • Work in data center environments with hot/cold aisle temperatures ranging from 60°F to 90°F.

Preferred Skills:

  • Associate’s degree, bachelor’s degree, or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Networking, or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience in enterprise or commercial data center environments.
  • Experience with Linux OS administration, command-line tools, and device provisioning.
  • Scripting and automation experience with Python, Bash, or shell scripts.
  • Networking experience with Cisco IOS, Juniper Junos, or enterprise switch/router configurations.
  • Industry certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, Server+, or Linux+.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

  • Be Curious at Your Core
  • Act Like an Owner
  • Empower Employees
  • Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
  • Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organization’s growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

Compensation & Benefits

The base salary range for this role is $65.000 to $85,000. The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

What We Offer

The range we’ve posted represents the typical compensation range for this role. To determine actual compensation, we review the market rate for each candidate which can include a variety of factors. These include qualifications, experience, interview performance, and location.

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our US-based offerings for full-time employees; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. These include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance - 100% paid for by CoreWeave
  • Company-paid Life Insurance 
  • Voluntary supplemental life insurance 
  • Short and long-term disability insurance 
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • Health Savings Account
  • Tuition Reimbursement 
  • Ability to Participate in Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)
  • Mental Wellness Benefits through Spring Health 
  • Family-Forming support provided by Carrot
  • Paid Parental Leave 
  • Flexible, full-service childcare support with Kinside
  • 401(k) with a generous employer match
  • Flexible PTO
  • Catered lunch each day in our office and data center locations
  • A casual work environment
  • A work culture focused on innovative disruption

California Consumer Privacy Act

All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

jobs.description:

This role will require a founder’s mindset as we grow Toast’s presence in this new vertical with a new offering: the Toast Retail platform. 

As a Retail Account Executive, you will be part of a founding team that is transforming the way convenience stores, grocery stores, and bottle shops operate. Using a consultative approach, you will prospect, build relationships, and sign up new accounts. By understanding their unique needs, you will develop a customized solution that helps their business thrive. We need your passion, sales expertise, and entrepreneurial spirit to help us build the Toast brand in an assigned geographic territory.

  • Use a consultative approach to prospect, build relationships, and sign up new convenience stores, grocery stores and bottle shops
  • Generate lists of prospective convenience stores, grocery stores, and bottle shops and manage the entire sales cycle from initial call to close 
  • Conduct demos and develop a solution that best meets the prospect’s needs 
  • Partner with teams across the business to ensure that expectations set during the sales process are met in delivery 
  • Leverage Salesforce (our CRM) to manage all sales activities

  • Proven track record of success in meeting and exceeding goals

Lives in or in proximity to market and willingness to travel 25% or more

Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. $128,000—$205,000 USD

jobs.title: Senior Technical Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
Description

MongoDB’s Compliance team leads the strategy, execution, and maintenance of the company’s global security certifications and regulatory requirements. The team translates complex obligations into scalable operational processes and maintains an audit-ready posture across a broad portfolio of frameworks and markets.

The Senior Compliance Analyst is a senior individual-contributor role that leads high-stakes audits and specialized compliance workstreams. 

We act as the primary interface between external auditors and our internal Product, Engineering, and Legal teams. Our goal is to translate complex regulatory requirements into scalable operational processes, maintaining a compliant and audit-ready posture across our diverse portfolio.

Senior Technical Compliance Analyst (Public Sector) is a senior-level individual contributor role responsible for the lifecycle management of our most sensitive US government authorizations. This role acts as a lead for high-stakes workstreams involving FedRAMP High, DoD IL5+, CJIS, and ITAR. Unlike the Analyst level, this role takes full ownership of complex federal assessments and leads the continuous monitoring strategy for our Atlas for Government product. This role is a key resource for interpreting NIST 800-53 controls and translating them into technical requirements for our engineering teams. A requirement for this role is to be a US Citizen. 

This role will be based remotely in United States.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end external audits and certifications, coordinating scoping, audit plans, evidence, auditor engagement, findings, and final outcomes
  • Own internal audit cadences and remediation tracking; establish clear accountability for findings, milestones, dependencies, and resolution timelines, and drive timely follow-through with technical teams
  • Serve as a lead point of contact for auditors and enterprise customers during security reviews and audit deep-dives; explain MongoDB’s control environment with clarity and confidence
  • Map regulatory requirements to the central control framework and conduct gap analyses for new frameworks, jurisdictions, and market expansions
  • Assess compliance-program maturity and report material risks, gaps, trends, and delivery status to team and business leaders
  • Author and review customer-facing security documentation and audit evidence, ensuring it accurately reflects MongoDB’s controls and architectural guardrails
  • Lead cross-functional workstreams that advance the ARC roadmap; identify risks and dependencies early and recommend practical improvements to processes and tooling
  • Build and maintain executive and operational dashboards and Jira workflows for control performance, audit findings, and remediation progress; mentor stakeholders on compliance practices
  • Lead the end-to-end execution of federal assessments, coordinating with Third Party Assessment Organizations (3PAOs), agency sponsors, and the FedRAMP PMO
  • Manage the federal continuous monitoring (ConMon) program, including the timely analysis and reporting of vulnerabilities and the maintenance of the POA&M
  • Lead the annual update and technical review of core FedRAMP artifacts, including the System Security Plan (SSP), Contingency Plan (ISCP), and Incident Response Plan (IRP)
  • Act as a technical advisor to Engineering and Operations teams to ensure cloud configurations (e.g., FIPS 140-2, boundary protection, and access control) meet federal and DoD IL5+ mandates

Expectations

  • Operate independently in ambiguous, complex situations and exercise sound judgment with minimal supervision
  • Take accountability for program outcomes—not only task tracking—and proactively surface risks, trade-offs, and decisions that require escalation
  • Influence technical and business stakeholders across teams and levels to deliver sustainable compliance outcomes
  • Communicate regulatory intent and technical control requirements in concise, actionable language for both technical and non-technical audiences

Scope and Complexity

The role manages overlapping audit cycles and compliance work across international jurisdictions and across highly regulated sectors such as financial services, healthcare, and government. Work ranges from complex evidence and control assessments to interpreting emerging requirements and identifying how controls can satisfy multiple standards.

The scope is deeply technical and specialized for the US Federal, State, and Local Government markets. 

You will navigate the complexity of mapping shared controls across multiple specialized frameworks, ensuring a single remediation effort satisfies FedRAMP, CJIS, and ITAR requirements simultaneously.

Authority and Impact

The Senior Compliance Analyst has the authority to lead federal assessment project streams and represent MongoDB in technical reviews with 3PAOs and federal agencies.Your work directly enables MongoDB to secure and maintain the authorizations required to serve the Department of Defense and civilian agencies, protecting a critical revenue stream.

Expertise and Leadership

The role develops deep subject-matter expertise in assigned frameworks and in how MongoDB’s cloud architecture satisfies their requirements. It serves as a trusted resource for mapping technical evidence to regulatory intent, leads complex projects such as internal audits and framework renewals, and mentors colleagues and partner teams on effective compliance practices.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field (such as Information Systems, Computer Science, or Cybersecurity), or equivalent practical experience
  • 7+ years of experience in GRC, Information Security, or IT Audit, preferably in a SaaS or cloud environment, with a heavy focus on US Public Sector frameworks (FedRAMP, DoD SRG, CJIS)
  • Demonstrated experience leading technical audits or compliance programs 
  • Strong understanding of cloud security principles, risk management, and how controls operate in a cloud-native environment across AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure
  • Deep understanding of NIST 800-53 and NIST 800-171 controls and how they are implemented within cloud architectures (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
  • Proven track record of managing federal audits from kickoff through to the issuance of an Authorization to Operate (ATO)
  • Exceptional ability to explain complex security configurations to government auditors and internal technical teams
  • Advanced proficiency in Jira and Confluence to track control performance data and manage large-scale federal documentation projects
  • Practical experience performing control mapping, gap analyses, remediation oversight, and program or control-maturity assessments
  • Advanced proficiency with Jira or similar tools for managing audit findings, control data, and high-volume remediation workflows
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to lead auditor/customer discussions and translate technical requirements for non-technical audiences
  • Certifications such as CISA, CRISC, CISSP, or ISO Lead Implementer are preferred

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. 

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB, Inc. provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type and makes all hiring decisions without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Salary is one part of MongoDB’s total compensation and benefits package. Other benefits for eligible employees may include: equity, participation in the employee stock purchase program, flexible paid time off, 20 weeks fully-paid gender-neutral parental leave, fertility and adoption assistance, 401(k) plan, mental health counseling, access to transgender-inclusive health insurance coverage, and health benefits offerings. jobs.title: Site Leader - Memphis
jobs.description:
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen.  Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period. To make sure our car’s are in first-rate condition,  we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website. Using our Carvana Certified 150-point inspection process, we’re able to verify that every vehicle meets our rigorous mechanical and cosmetic standards. 

We strive to provide only the highest quality vehicles to our customers in our mission to deliver a no-hassle, better car buying experience. We are actively looking for passionate and talented individuals who can help us deliver on that promise. 

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Keep reading below to see what we’re looking for!

 

About the team and position

The Inspection Center General Manager is responsible for the overall performance of the center. Providing leadership for up to 500 associates working multiple shifts in a lean manufacturing environment. Maintaining a culture of continuous improvement and high associate engagement while ensuring the facility meets quality, production, and cost objectives.

Compensation Range: $160k-$200k 

What you’ll be doing

Leadership 30% 

  • Leads strategic planning to ensure the facility will have the capability to meet future demands.
  • Provides strategic vision and guidance to the location
  • Ensures management beliefs and behaviors are in line with the Carvana culture
  • Frequent visits to the shop floor to ensure connection with the realities of the business and model leadership behaviors throughout the organization
  • Positively challenge and engage the team to continuously improve quality production and cost performance
  • Live the Carvana values

Production Management 30%

  • Lead production planning for the Inspection Center
  • Ensure the Inspection Center has adequate capacity to meet production targets
  • Oversee weekly performance review meetings for each area and report out on the Inspection Centers performance
  • Identify problems impacting the Inspection Center’s performance. Prioritize problems, allocate resources, and ensure the resolution of issues
  • Ensure operating standards such as standardized work, operating rules, 5S, and visual management tools are consistently executed
  • Ensure compliance with all health and safety and loss prevention guidelines

People Management 30%

  • Participate in the selection and hiring process, ensure a pipeline of associates to fill current and future positions
  • Maintain a bench of candidates for each leadership position
  • Ensure progression path training and certification process is consistently executed
  • Model effective teamwork and ensure it’s embraced at all levels of the organization
  • Provide competency-based feedback and ensure leaders throughout the organization are also providing appropriate feedback
  • Mentor reconditioning managers

Continuous Improvement 10%

  • Lead the selection of continuous improve events, allocate resources to support events, and hold the team accountable for results
  • Participate in and lead continuous improvement efforts
  • Train and mentor reconditioning managers on problem-solving
  • Other duties as assigned.

What you should have

  • Minimum of 8 years of management experience either in automotive or a lean manufacturing environment leading multiple work groups
  • A valid driver’s license 
  • Valid unrestricted driver’s license with a clean driving record in the last 3 years
  • Knowledge of lean manufacturing principles
  • Proven track record of leading and developing associates
  • Proven ability to obtain project deliverables and company metrics
  • Ability to work a flexible work schedule
  • An ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing production environment while sometimes being exposed to excessive weather conditions (heat/cold)
  • Excellent communications skills, oral and written
  • Ability to work with and through teams to achieve results
  • Strong analysis and decision making ability
  • Proficient computer skills

What we’ll offer in return

  • Full-Time Position with a competitive salary
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
  • 401K with company match
  • A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more
  • A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy, both physically and mentally
  • Access to opportunities to expand your skillset and share your knowledge with others across the organization
  • A company culture of promotions from within, with a start-up atmosphere allowing for varied and rapid career development
  • A seat in one of the fastest-growing companies in the country

Other requirements

To be able to do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you.

  • Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English
  • Must be at least 18 years of age
  • Must have a valid driver's license 
  • A clean driving record with no more than two moving violations or DUI’s in the last three years
  • The physical environment requires the employee to work both inside and outside in heat/cold, wet/humid, and dry/arid conditions
  • Will be required to use personal protective equipment to prevent exposure to hazardous materials
  • May be requested to work overtime and weekends for special programs and events.
  • Frequent standing and sitting with varying periods of each
  • May at times require working different shifts
  • Lift up to 40 pounds frequently
  • Walk up to three miles each day

jobs.title: Senior Specialist Field Engineer - Networking
jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

What You’ll Do:

The Customer Experience (CX) Organization at CoreWeave is dedicated to ensuring every client running AI workloads at scale has a seamless, reliable, and high-performance experience. This team supports the infrastructure that powers the AI revolution—working across data centers, hardware systems, and customer workloads to maintain the integrity of our cloud platform. The CX organization aligns closely with the internal and customer engineering teams, offering valuable insights from the field and having the chance to contribute to the CoreWeave product roadmap and development.About the role

CoreWeave runs some of the largest GPU clusters in the world, and the network has a lot to do with how well they perform. As a Senior Specialist Field Engineer for Networking, you'll help customers get the most from the GPU fabric, the front-end network, and the links between data centers. You'll work closely with the Networking product and engineering teams, and what you learn in the field will help shape what they build.

In this role, you will:

  • Design network architecture for complex customers (multi-cloud, multi-region, hybrid Kubernetes, bare metal, Direct Connect), including how it fails and what each failure affects.
  • Troubleshoot problems that span many nodes and VPCs, from the Linux kernel and the CNI up through the data-center fabric and HPC interconnects (InfiniBand, RoCE).
  • Find where the product falls short for real workloads and work the gap through with engineering, as an extended member of the Networking team.
  • Lead customer technical overviews, proofs of concept, and customer workshops, with occasional travel.

Who You Are:

  • B.S. in Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years building or operating large-scale networks, as a network, systems, or software engineer, or in a deeply technical networking-focused field role.
  • Solid working knowledge of network protocols such as BGP, VXLAN/EVPN, and DNS.
  • Deep understanding of Kubernetes networking, including CNIs such as Cilium or Calico.
  • Expertise in cloud connectivity: VPCs, peering, dedicated interconnects, and VPNs such as WireGuard or Tailscale, and the trade-offs between them.
  • Very comfortable going below the tooling to analyze packet captures, kernel routing tables, interface and fabric counters.
  • You explain technical problems clearly to engineers and executives, and you build trust with customers.

Preferred

  • Expertise with InfiniBand and RoCE, including fabric diagnostics, subnet management, and partition-based tenant isolation.
  • Experience with NVIDIA GPUs, especially GB200/GB300 platforms.
  • First-principles debugging through the Linux kernel network stack, eBPF, FRR, and OVS.
  • Diagnosing distributed failures across hundreds of nodes, such as ECMP blackholing across fabric planes.
  • Large Direct Connect designs: per-VPC BGP sessions, prefix strategy, and cloud provider limits.
  • Contributions to networking open source (kernel, FRR, Cilium, OVS) or published work on fabric design or network debugging.

Wondering if you’re a good fit?

We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk. 

  • You'd rather look at a packet capture than guess.
  • You're comfortable saying "I don't know yet," and then you go find out.
  • You like working on a hard problem alongside the customer and the engineering team, and you share the credit.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast!  We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values: 

  • Be Curious at Your Core
  • Act Like an Owner
  • Empower Employees
  • Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
  • Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and provides the opportunity to develop innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for take off, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

jobs.title: Threat Intelligence Analyst, Threat Disruption
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. Essential Duties:

As an early member of a new engineering team, you will be responsible for designing, executing, and analyzing tests that simulate extreme conditions and misuse scenarios to ensure the safety of our new product.  

Collaborating with design and manufacturing engineering, you will identify potential failure modes and then intentionally abuse complex electromechanical and electrochemical systems (via short circuit, overvoltage, overheat, overcharge, and forced thermal propagation) in a controlled, well-instrumented, well-documented environment in order to stress those failure modes and ensure our products are robust to real world abuse.  

You’re a doer, excited about getting your hands dirty and working in a dynamic, fast-paced setting, and want to shape a new department at Redwood.  

If necessary, we will adjust the job level to suit your experience and responsibilities. 

Responsibilities Will include:

  • In addition to performing tests, you’ll help define and build the test infrastructure that will allow us to test swiftly, safely, and with excellent documentation
  • You will also use your experience and understanding of failure mechanisms to help design new products to be as intrinsically robust to abuse as possible
  • Designing, executing, and analyzing tests that simulate extreme conditions and misuse scenarios to ensure the safety of our new product
  • Identify potential failure modes and then intentionally abuse complex electromechanical and electrochemical systems (via short circuit, overvoltage, overheat, overcharge, and forced thermal propagation) in a controlled, well-instrumented, well-documented environment in order to stress those failure modes and ensure our products are robust to real world abuse

  • Bachelor’s degree in physics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
  • Strong understanding of physics and the physics of failure
  • Proven experience with abuse tests, specifically UL9540a and related thermal propagation testing
