jobs.title: Sr People Business Partner — AI-Powered People Strategy, Global BP Team & Corporate Functions
jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

Most HR teams are talking about AI. At Zscaler, we're building with it — and we want someone who'll help lead that build, not just adopt it.

As Senior People Business Partner, you'll sit inside our People Business Partner Leadership team with a mandate few PBP roles offer: co-design how our entire global PBP function operates, then put your own designs into practice with the leaders you support across Finance, Legal, Biz Dev, and People & Culture. This isn't a "use the new tool we bought" role — you'll help decide which agentic workflows, automations, and data products the function builds next, pilot them yourself, and scale what works across 30+ global PBPs supporting 9000 executives, managers and employees globally. This is a hybrid role, based out of our Santa Clara, CA HQ. 

If you're the person on your current team who's already experimenting with AI before anyone asks you to, who gets more energized by "how do we 10x this" than "how do we maintain this," this is built for you.

How You’ll Make an Impact (Role Expectations)

  • Architect Scalable Solutions: you'll design and pilot our first agentic workflow for performance across the organization, ensuring People Business Partners and managers are taking actionable steps to drive intended talent outcomes.
  • Design and roll out other AI-augmented practices and global frameworks, such as Organizational Health scorecards and People Plans that empower People Business Partners enterprise-wide to spend less time on administration and more time driving strategic impact.
  • Empower & Coach Leaders: Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leaders and people managers, enabling data-led coaching on performance management, career progression frameworks, and high-performing team dynamics.
  • Drive Strategic People Programs: Lead end-to-end execution for key People & Culture initiatives—including bi-annual performance and compensation planning cycles, engagement surveys, and talent reviews—tailored for global impact.
  • Turn Workforce Data into Action: Analyze key workforce metrics (attrition, hiring trends, mobility, team engagement) to uncover actionable insights and proactively solve organizational challenges before they arise.
  • Champion Culture & Resolution: Partner with People Relations and business leaders as a trusted, neutral advocate to resolve complex employee relations matters with empathy, fairness, and absolute discretion.
  • Optimize the Employee Journey: Pinpoint friction points across employee lifecycles and streamline operational workflows, elevating the overall employee and manager experience.

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a creative and curious problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
  • You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • AI & Tech Fluency: You have demonstrated, hands-on experience leveraging AI/ML tools, automation platforms, and modern enterprise software (Google Workspace) to optimize HR processes and enhance domain outcomes.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources Management, Organizational Development, Business Administration, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Progressive HR Leadership: 10+ years of progressive HR/PBP experience managing end-to-end talent strategies and employee lifecycle programs.
  • High-Growth Tech Agility: Proven track record of success navigating and delivering results within fast-paced, high-growth technology organizations.
  • Innovative Mindset: Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, or scaling innovative talent solutions and technology-enabled HR initiatives.

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience utilizing generative AI tools or advanced predictive workforce analytics to design data-driven talent mapping, augment performance workflows, and optimize organizational health across technical teams
  • Direct HR experience partnering with complex engineering, product, or technical functions
  • Functional knowledge of technical operating models, including Sprint cycles, DevOps methodologies, and AI production workflows

jobs.title: Staff Global Supply Manager, Construction
jobs.description:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

Staff Global Supply Chain Manager, Construction

Redwood Materials is looking for a Staff Global Supply Chain Manager, Construction to lead construction procurement for energy storage projects within our Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) team. In this role you will direct sourcing strategy and execution for all construction scopes, including civil, trenching, cable, and cable tray, from bid through contract award and change management. You will work closely with construction, engineering, and project controls teams, and you will set the procurement methods and standards used for construction buying across the function. Your decisions will directly affect project cost, schedule, and supplier risk. This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco, California.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Direct sourcing strategy for all construction scopes on energy storage projects, including civil, trenching, cable, cable tray, and electrical balance of system
  • Develop and run request for quote and request for proposal (RFQ/RFP) events for construction subcontractors and materials, including bid leveling, scope alignment, and award recommendations
  • Negotiate construction contracts, master service agreements (MSAs), and change orders with subcontractors and suppliers
  • Develop should-cost models and cost benchmarks for construction scopes to support project budgets and pricing
  • Guide EPC construction, engineering, and project controls teams on procurement strategy, schedule risk, and supplier capacity
  • Build and maintain the construction supplier base, including qualification, performance tracking, and risk mitigation
  • Establish procurement processes and standards for construction buying across the EPC function

Desired Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Construction Management, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • 8+ years of construction procurement or EPC supply chain experience
  • Working knowledge of construction contract types (lump sum, unit price, and time and materials), subcontractor scopes, and change order management
  • Working knowledge of civil and electrical construction scopes, including medium-voltage and low-voltage (MV/LV) cable, trenching, and cable tray
  • Ability to build cost models and level bids in Excel, with experience in ERP and procurement systems such as Workday
  • Ability to negotiate with subcontractors and suppliers and to influence senior internal stakeholders
  • A passion for sustainability and making the world a better place!

Working Conditions:

  • Quarterly travel to Reno, Nevada, and to project sites as needed

$186,000—$215,000 USD

jobs.title: Talent Mobility Specialist
jobs.description:
Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!

At Duolingo, you’ll join a team that cares about educating our users, experimenting with big ideas, making fact-based decisions, and finding innovative solutions to complex problems. You’ll have limitless learning opportunities and daily collaborations with world-class minds — while doing work that’s both meaningful and fun.

Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world. 

Read our blog to learn more.

About the role...

We’re hiring a Talent Mobility Specialist to help Duolingo’s global talent navigate immigration and relocation with clarity, care, and confidence. You will own the day-to-day operations of our Global Mobility program, manage immigration and mobility matters from assessment through completion, partner with candidates, Duos, and cross-functional teams, and oversee external providers. You’ll also improve policies, processes, and reporting so our programs stay compliant, competitive, and scalable as Duolingo grows globally.

🧠  You will...

  • Own the day-to-day operations of our Global Mobility program. Administer relocation policies, packages, eligibility, and exceptions consistently and efficiently. When something falls outside policy, bring a clear recommendation.
  • Manage employment-based immigration matters from initial assessment through filing, approval, and renewal, coordinating with employees, managers, Talent Acquisition, People Business Partners, Legal, and outside counsel.
  • Assess immigration and mobility needs for hiring, internal transfers, and changing business requirements, and advise partners on timelines, risks, costs, and available options.
  • Champion our mobility program with candidates. Partner with Talent Acquisition during the offer stage to walk candidates through their relocation package, answer their questions with confidence, and help them picture their move. This plays a real part in helping us close top talent.
  • Guide candidates and Duos through their immigration and relocation journey. Explain packages and processes, set clear expectations, coordinate key milestones, and communicate clearly at every stage, acting as a steady, empathetic point of contact through what is often a stressful transition.
  • Manage domestic and international relocation cases, including vendor coordination, service delivery, issue resolution, and post-move support.
  • Oversee immigration counsel and relocation and tax vendors, managing service delivery, SLAs/KPIs, costs, escalations, and performance. Use performance data and Duo feedback to hold partners accountable so every candidate and Duo gets timely, high-quality support.
  • Run business travel programs and onboarding-related logistics, making sure processes, communications, and vendor support run smoothly.
  • Monitor case progress, work authorization expirations, and policy requirements, escalate risks, and recommend appropriate actions.
  • Maintain accurate case records, process documentation, and reporting while protecting confidential employee information.
  • Use data to make our programs better. Track case volume, cycle times, mobility activity, spend, vendor performance, exceptions, recurring issues, and Duo feedback, and turn it into insight that informs workforce planning and finds ways to improve.
  • Develop and improve immigration and mobility policies, workflows, playbooks, communications, self-service resources, and training that support consistent decisions and a positive Duo experience.
  • Stay current on the immigration and mobility landscape, including regulatory and tax developments, market practices, and relocation trends, and use what you learn to keep our program compliant and competitive.

✅  You have...

  • 5+ years of experience managing corporate immigration, global mobility, relocation, or related programs.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. employment-based immigration processes and experience coordinating cases with outside immigration counsel.
  • Experience managing domestic or international relocation cases and working with third-party mobility providers.
  • Ability to explain complex immigration and mobility requirements clearly to employees, candidates, managers, and People partners.
  • Strong case and project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple time-sensitive matters with accuracy and follow-through.
  • Sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential information and evolving regulatory requirements.
  • Experience using case data, service metrics, and employee feedback to identify risks and improve programs.
  • Strong cross-functional partnership skills and the ability to recommend practical solutions in complex or ambiguous situations.

⭐  Exceptional candidates will have...

  • Experience supporting immigration and mobility programs across multiple countries or regions.
  • Experience designing or scaling immigration, relocation, or global mobility policies and processes.
  • Experience managing immigration counsel, relocation providers, or other global mobility vendors.
  • Familiarity with immigration or global mobility case-management technology and HR information systems.
  • Experience supporting international transfers, permanent residency matters, or mobility-related tax and payroll coordination.

Unlock Your Earning Potential!

  • Diagnostics & Repair: Conduct hardware and network diagnostics on live and offline systems. Troubleshoot issues reported through tickets, replace components, and perform physical repairs.
  • Equipment Deployment: Support equipment installations, device provisioning, and operating system installations, taking on more complex troubleshooting and deployment work as your experience grows.
  • Structured Cabling & Security: Maintain high standards of cable management and structured cabling, and follow physical and cybersecurity protocols.
  • Process & Documentation: Maintain accurate inventory records and ticket updates. Contribute to standard operating procedures (SOPs), technical documentation, and process improvements.
  • Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing: Collaborate with local and cross-functional teams to support operational readiness. Share knowledge and contribute to team training and development.
  • On-Call & Response: Participate in a rotating on-call schedule and be available to arrive on-site within 60 minutes when an incident requires hands-on support.

Qualifications:

  • Hardware Foundation: Hands-on experience or coursework in computer hardware assembly, installation, and physical and logical troubleshooting.
  • Operating Systems & Networking: Familiarity with Linux operating systems and fundamental networking concepts.
  • Problem-Solving & Judgment: Ability to follow established procedures, prioritize tasks, troubleshoot technical issues, and recognize when to ask for guidance or escalate.
  • Communication & Teamwork: Strong organizational and communication skills, a collaborative and curious mindset, and a commitment to high reliability standards.
  • Learning & Development: Willingness to build technical skills, learn new systems, and take on responsibilities that match your experience.
  • Physical Requirements: Ability to perform the following essential duties, with or without reasonable accommodation:
    • Move and position equipment weighing up to 50 lbs.
    • Remain in a stationary position for extended periods while performing diagnostics and repairs.
    • Access equipment in confined spaces, under-floor areas, and on ladders.
    • Handle small hardware components, connectors, and cabling with precision.
    • Work in data center environments with hot/cold aisle temperatures ranging from 60°F to 90°F.

Preferred Skills:

  • Associate’s degree, bachelor’s degree, or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Networking, or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience in enterprise or commercial data center environments.
  • Experience with Linux OS administration, command-line tools, and device provisioning.
  • Scripting and automation experience with Python, Bash, or shell scripts.
  • Networking experience with Cisco IOS, Juniper Junos, or enterprise switch/router configurations.
  • Industry certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, Server+, or Linux+.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel, Employment
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Senior Legal Counsel, Employment, you will be tasked with providing strategic, practical employment legal advice across a global organization. This role will partner closely with the People team and cross-functional stakeholders, with a primary focus on the United States while supporting other jurisdictions outside of the US as needed. 

This is a hybrid role, with in-office collaboration one day per week at our Mountain View, CA office.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Act as a trusted advisor on the full employee lifecycle, including complex hiring, performance management, executive compensation, and sensitive terminations.
  • Partner closely with the People team and other internal stakeholders to identify, assess, and mitigate employment-related risks.
  • Own the development, review, and rollout of employment policies, templates, employee handbooks, practices, and best-in-class frameworks that scale globally while accounting for local requirements, including addressing complex or high-risk matters, sensitive employee issues, and strategic initiatives.
  • Lead and take initiative on internal investigations, including employee complaints, workplace conduct matters, and policy violations, and advise on and support any required remediation efforts.
  • Leverage data and analytics to track employment trends, manage operational spend, and present clear insights to legal and People leadership, supporting data-driven decision-making across a complex matrix organization.
  • Manage outside counsel relationships, including invoice review and approvals, spend monitoring, rate negotiations, and maintaining a matter tracker, to control costs and improve outcomes.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • A JD (or an equivalent) with 8+ years of employment law experience, including significant in-house experience
  • Familiarity with and experience advising on key employment law frameworks such as non-competes, separations, disability claims, and hiring practices (including background checks and pay transparency)
  • Well-grounded knowledge of US employment law
  • Comfort working with data: building metrics, spotting trends, and presenting clear, concise insights to senior leaders
  • Sales Compensation Experience: Practical experience drafting, reviewing, and resolving disputes around sales incentive/commission plans, including state and local wage-and-hour compliance (e.g., earning rules, draws, clawbacks, and payouts upon separation).
  • Executive Compensation Exposure: Familiarity with structuring executive employment agreements, equity arrangements, retention packages, and severance terms.
  • Sound and practical business judgment
  • Ability to organize, prioritize, and manage a high-volume workload in a fast-paced and demanding work environment, with excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • A bias and drive for action, learning and problem solving
  • High responsiveness with a service-focused approach
  • Both a collaborative teammate and able to work independently
  • Preferred: 4+ years of in-house experience at a technology company
  • Preferred: Experience advising on employment matters across multiple jurisdictions, ideally including APJ and Israel
  • Preferred: Experience advising on sales commission plans and other sales compensation matters
  • Preferred: Familiarity with employee benefit plans and related compliance
  • Preferred: Experience with the employment side of M&A, integrations, and restructurings
  • Preferred: Experience with AI tools to streamline research, analyze data trends, and scale legal support across a growing global team

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

  • Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

  • Flexible time off
  • Paid company holidays and paid sick time
  • Gender-neutral parental leave
  • Grandparent leave

Insurance & Financial Security

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Life and disability insurance
  • Health and dependent care FSA
  • Voluntary benefits (hospital, accident, critical illness)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • ARAG pre-paid legal
  • Nationwide pet insurance

Work Perks & Flexibility

Wellness & Lifestyle

  • Wellness coach
  • Wellness/gym reimbursement
  • Fertility coverage
  • Adoption & surrogacy reimbursement

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Information System Security Manager
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Air Defense team builds robots that find other robots and knock them out of the sky. At a time when air superiority can no longer be taken for granted, the Air Defense team provides mission critical capabilities to warfighters. From detection to tracking, identification, deterrence, and defeat, our family of networked sensors and effectors enables our customers to rapidly close the kill chain against a broad range of UAS threats. Working across product, engineering, business development, logistics, operations, and mission success, the Air Defense team develops, tests, deploys, and sustains the Anduril Air Defense Family of Systems in challenging operational environments worldwide.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril's Air Defense division is seeking a Cybersecurity Information System Security Manager (ISSM) to own the cyber compliance posture of our command and control (C2) software systems. This role sits at the intersection of mission-critical software delivery and government cybersecurity accreditation — you will be responsible for building and maintaining the full cybersecurity authorization lifecycle, from policy development through artifact delivery, ensuring our systems meet the rigorous security standards required for Department of Defense deployment.
You will serve as the primary cybersecurity authority for your program, driving the end-to-end Enterprise Mission Assurance Support Service (eMASS) accreditation process, enforcing security standard operating procedures, managing Plans of Action and Milestones (POAMs), and ensuring continuous compliance across development and operational environments. This is not a checkbox role — you will work directly with engineers, program managers, and government stakeholders to embed security into the development lifecycle while keeping pace with rapid software delivery.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead the development, submission, and management of all government cybersecurity authorization artifacts within eMASS, including System Security Plans (SSPs), Security Assessment Reports (SARs), and supporting documentation required for Authority to Operate (ATO)
  • Serve as the program Information System Security Manager (ISSM), maintaining continuous monitoring activities and ensuring compliance with Risk Management Framework (RMF) requirements
  • Develop, implement, and enforce cybersecurity standard operating procedures across the program, ensuring engineering teams adhere to security policies throughout the software development lifecycle
  • Pull, tailor, and validate Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) applicable to program systems, coordinating remediation efforts with development teams
  • Manage and execute application and infrastructure code scans, triaging findings and coordinating remediation with engineering
  • Create, track, and manage Plans of Action and Milestones (POAMs), including risk assessments, mitigation strategies, and closure activities
  • Advise program leadership on cybersecurity risk posture, emerging threats, and compliance status
  • Interface directly with government cybersecurity stakeholders, Authorizing Officials (AOs), and Security Control Assessors (SCAs) throughout the accreditation lifecycle
  • Collaborate with software engineers to integrate security controls into continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • United States citizenship with an active Secret or Top Secret security clearance
  • Minimum 5 years of experience serving as an Information System Security Officer (ISSO) or in an equivalent cybersecurity compliance role
  • Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience with eMASS, including artifact creation, submission, and package management
  • Demonstrated experience delivering complete RMF authorization packages through to ATO
  • Strong working knowledge of NIST Special Publication 800-53, NIST 800-37, and DoD cybersecurity policies (DoDI 8510.01)
  • Experience pulling, applying, and validating STIG checklists across operating systems, applications, and network devices
  • Experience with vulnerability scanning and code analysis tools (for example, Nessus, ACAS, SonarQube, Fortify, or equivalent)
  • Proficiency in POAM creation, management, and closure processes
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with networking, communications systems, or command and control architectures
  • DoD 8570/8140 certification (for example, Security+, CISSP, CISM, CAP, or equivalent)
  • Experience supporting software-intensive programs with agile or DevSecOps development methodologies
  • Familiarity with container security, cloud security architectures, or zero-trust frameworks
  • Prior experience supporting air defense, missile defense, or integrated battle command systems
  • Experience working with cross-functional engineering teams in a fast-paced, iterative development environment
  • Experience with red team, blue team, or penetration testing methodologies

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

 

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. 

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

 

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/. 

 

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Operations Specialist, Information Security
jobs.description:
About Carvana

At Carvana, we’re changing the way people buy and sell cars. With an ambitious vision and a fundamentally different approach designed to be fun, fast, and fair, Carvana became the fastest-growing automotive retailer in history. We expanded nationally, went public on the New York Stock Exchange, sold our 1 millionth car, and reached the Fortune 500, all in just eight years.

Today, with 4 million retail customers and counting, Carvana is both the fastest-growing and the most profitable public automotive retailer, and we’re just getting started. We continue to raise the bar for our customers as we tackle the enormous opportunity still ahead in the largest consumer vertical.

Working here means being part of a team that embraces change, celebrates creative problem solving, and always strives to be better. At Carvana, you’ll have the opportunity to take on meaningful challenges, learn quickly, and help shape the future of automotive retail. If you’re driven to grow and make an impact as part of a collaborative team, you’ll fit right in. Learn more about what it’s like to work here from the people that already do. 

About the team and position

We are looking for an Operations Specialist, Information Security to join our Information Security Team. In this role, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding our digital infrastructure by deploying, maintaining and managing various security technologies deployed within the organization to identify, protect, detect, respond and recover from cyber risks, threats, and exposures. A successful candidate will be able to effectively integrate and manage multiple enterprise security technologies across our technology stack, drive significant risk reduction and enhance our overall security risk posture. 

This Operations Specialist, Information Security role is built for someone early in their career who is curious, hungry to learn, and excited to get their hands on real security tooling across a modern cloud environment. You'll be mentored by experienced engineers while contributing real work from day one.

What you’ll be doing

  • Support the day-to-day operations of our security tool stack - learning how each technology works, why it matters, and how to keep it healthy and producing actionable signals.
  • Help correlate and analyze data across multiple security platforms to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities to reduce risk using a pragmatic, risk-based approach.
  • Assist in triaging vulnerability and bug bounty findings, collaborating with engineering and product teams to track and drive timely remediation.
  • Contribute to automation projects that eliminate repetitive manual tasks, including building and refining workflows in our agentic AI security platform.
  • Support the evaluation of new security technologies by researching capabilities, documenting findings, and participating in proof-of-value testing.
  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to communicate risk clearly and help prioritize remediation using a risk-based approach.
  • Explore how AI can be applied to optimize existing security capabilities and surface insights faster  and bring ideas to the team.
  • Learn from senior engineers through structured mentorship, code reviews, and collaborative incident response exercises.
  • Other duties as assigned. 

What you should have

  • At least 1 year of experience in information security, Information Technology, or a closely related field - internships, academic projects, and home labs all count.
  • Basic familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI) and an eagerness to learn cloud-specific threats and defenses.
  • A foundational understanding of common attack techniques and the concepts behind defending against them.
  • Exposure to scripting or automation in Python, Bash, or PowerShell, and curiosity about using AI coding assistants to build tooling.
  • Strong analytical thinking - you enjoy breaking down a problem, forming a hypothesis, and testing the solution.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills; you can explain a technical concept to a non-technical stakeholder.
  • Self-motivated with a bias toward action - you don't wait to be told what to do next.
  • A genuine curiosity-driven mindset: you read security blogs, chase CVEs for fun, or tinker with capture-the-flag challenges.

Optional Requirements

  • An entry-level security certification such as CompTIA Security+, Google Cybersecurity Certificate, or equivalent coursework or degree.
  • Hands-on experience managing or configuring a security tool (SIEM, EDR, vulnerability scanner, etc.).
  • Participation in CTF competitions, bug bounty programs, or security research of any kind.

What we’ll offer in return

  • Full-Time Salary Position with a competitive salary.
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits.
  • 401K with company match.
  • A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more.
  • A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy both physically and mentally.
  • Access to training and conference opportunities as well as great on-the-job training.
  • A company culture of promotions from within, with a start-up atmosphere allowing for varied and rapid career development.
  • A seat in one of the fastest-growing companies in the country.

Other requirements

To be able to do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you.

  • Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English.
  • Requires excellent visual acuity and manual dexterity.

Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs. 

Legal stuff

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check.  This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer.  All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.  Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Please note this job description is not designed to contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

jobs.title: Sr. Model Engineer, RL Training Framework
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

SR. MODEL ENGINEER, RL TRAINING FRAMEWORK

The RL infrastructure team is looking for an engineer to help develop our RL training framework.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design and implement the systems backing all RL workloads at SpaceXSI, from small scale ablations to production training runs
  • Profile, debug, and optimize end-to-end training performance
  • Improve scalability and observability of the RL stack

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience writing production-quality code in Python, PyTorch, JAX, Rust, or C++
  • Experience training large models (e.g., pre-training, post-training, fine-tuning, or RL training of neural networks with 1B+ parameters)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience building, debugging, and optimizing efficiency of large-scale distributed systems
  • Experience with large scale LLM training infrastructure
  • Experience with RL numerics
  • Strong knowledge of reinforcement learning techniques
  • Comfortable diving into unfamiliar areas and solving problems at all levels of the stack

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

$220,000 - $357,000 USD

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Software Engineer,  Financial Data & Payments
jobs.location: Denver, CO - Hybrid; New York, NY - Hybrid; San Francisco, CA - Hybrid; Seattle, WA - Remote
jobs.description:
About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role:

We’re hiring seasoned engineers to join our teams that work on the financial backbone of Gusto's money movement — the ledger, reconciliation, and reporting systems that account for every dollar, and the payment profile that determines how employers fund payroll and how employees and contractors get paid. As a Gusto Software Engineer at this level, you’ll be guiding projects end-to-end by driving large technical architectural decisions (focusing on scale and modularity), understanding how to take existing systems closer to desired end states, executing on projects, and maintaining code that powers core experiences. If you’re interested in building elegant software with far-reaching effects in our modern economy, join us!

About the Team:

Financial Data & Payment Profile (FDPP) sits inside Gusto's Payments organization, which moves money safely between partners, employers, employees, government authorities, and Gusto. FDPP owns the two things that every one of those movements depends on.

Financial Data is the system of record for the money itself: the ledger and subledger behind every payment, the reconciliation that proves our books agree with our banks and partners, the investigation of the variances that surface when they do not, and the financial reporting that Accounting, Finance, and Compliance depend on. When Gusto needs to answer where a dollar is — and prove it — the answer comes from systems this team builds.

Payment Profile is what makes a payment possible in the first place: the payment methods available to a customer, the bank accounts and connections behind them, the verification that makes those accounts trustworthy, and the profile state that decides whether a payment can happen at all. Hundreds of thousands of businesses depend on this being right the first time — and on it recovering gracefully when a bank account, a connection, or a preference changes.

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

  • Design, build, and test the financial data systems that record every dollar Gusto moves — the ledger and subledger that serve as the system of record, the transaction models underneath them, and the financial reporting that Accounting, Finance, Compliance, and our partners rely on to close the books
  • Build reconciliation at Gusto's scale: prove that our internal records agree with bank, processor, and partner statements, and make the breaks that fall out of that comparison traceable rather than mysterious
  • Lead variance investigation end-to-end — the tooling, instrumentation, and runbooks that turn "the numbers don't tie" into a specific root cause, and then into a fix that eliminates the whole class of break
  • Own the payment profile: how employers are set up to fund payroll and how employees and contractors are set up to be paid — the payment methods available and the rules that govern which apply to whom, the bank accounts and connections behind them, and the verification state that determines whether money can move at all
  • Make setup and verification something a small business can finish on its own — instant bank verification, graceful handling of broken or revoked connections, and a clear path back to a payable state when something changes
  • Help scale one of the largest Ruby/Rails and TypeScript/React applications in the world
  • Collaborate on complex and ambiguous problems with partnerships from Engineering, Product Management, Design, Data Science, Accounting, Finance, Compliance, Operations, and other cross-functional teams
  • Mentor and grow fellow engineers working to create holistic and scalable solutions

Here’s what we're looking for:

  • Successful applicants have at least 10+ years of experience and the enthusiasm for a collaborative, test-driven environment
  • Experience building fault-tolerant, mission-critical software as well as designing and developing robust, distributed systems using multiple general-purpose programming languages
  • Experience influencing and guiding the work of multiple teams on scaling, refactoring, and optimizing legacy products 
  • Experience architecting, building, and testing large-scale production level code that is maintainable, structured, and well-documented
  • An aptitude and interest in bringing clarity and simplicity to complex and ambiguous problems
  • Ability to communicate technical complexity and help facilitate informed tradeoffs
  • Experience in one or more of these domains is strongly preferred: ledger or subledger design, financial reconciliation, accounting systems, or payments infrastructure
  • Comfort with double-entry accounting concepts — journal entries, chart of accounts, debits and credits, and tying a subledger out to the general ledger — and the ability to work with accountants and controllers in their own vocabulary
  • Experience building systems where correctness, auditability, and immutability matter more than raw throughput, and where a silent data error is worse than an outage
  • Bonus: Experience with bank account verification, payment rails (ACH, wire, RTP), or third-party banking data and verification providers
  • Bonus: Experience with Ruby on Rails, Typescript, and React

 

Our cash compensation amount for this role is targeted at $183,000-$200,000 /yr in Denver & most remote locations, and $222,000-$245,000 /yr for San Francisco, Seattle & New York. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

 

At Gusto, we don't use titles the traditional way, as a signal of rank or hierarchy. Instead, our titles describe two things at once — your craft (what you do, e.g. Engineering, Design) and your scope of ownership (what you're accountable for) — which is why you'll see something like "Head of X" instead of a rank word like "Director" that tells you neither. Because of this, the title on this posting may look different from what you'd expect based on the scope and seniority of the role, and from how similar roles are typically titled elsewhere. If you have questions about how this role compares to your current title or level, your recruiter can help translate.

Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.

Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas. 

When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees.

Reliable, consistent presence: We expect regular and predictable attendance, whether you're working in-office, hybrid, or fully remote, so that you stay closely connected to your team, customers, and stakeholders in real time and ensure colleagues and customers receive the timely support and responsiveness they deserve.

Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto. 

Gusto is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Gusto considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Gusto is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. We want to see our candidates perform to the best of their ability. If you require a medical or religious accommodation at any time throughout your candidate journey, please fill out this form and a member of our team will get in touch with you.

Gusto takes security and protection of your personal information very seriously. Please review our Fraudulent Activity Disclaimer.

Personal information collected and processed as part of your Gusto application will be subject to Gusto's Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Role

As a member of our Business Systems Engineering team, you will build or improve tools that are used daily by Go to Market teams. Our goal is to find bottlenecks and friction points, and drive process improvements as well as come up with technical solutions. Our team is the custodian of data that is used by sales, order, finance, support teams. We emphasize automation over operation, metrics over anecdotes, iteration over perfection and being proactive over responsive.

We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires you to be onsite at our HQ in San Mateo, CA.

What You'll Do

  • Engineer and maintain platforms and data pipelines that read, mutate and write data at scale. 
  • Determine architecture for systems that deal with multiple external vendors as well as internal systems.
  • Collaborate with different GTM teams and advise on the right engineering solution to business problems.
  • Improve operational excellence on existing systems.
  • Contribute to the long term roadmap on keeping GTM data quality high.
  • Use LLMs to help evaluate data state and create artifacts for users to quickly consume data.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.
  • 5+ years of software engineering with a focus on data systems
  • In-depth expertise in distributed systems and data processing
  • Passion for observability and reliability
  • Advanced skill in Python and SQL.
  • Must be willing and able to work onsite five days per week.
  • Bonus: Familiarity with GTM facing vendors such as ZoomInfo, Outreach, Marketo, Clay, Rox.

  • Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage
  • Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options
  • Expanded mental health support
  • Paid parental leave policy & fertility benefits
  • Time off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays, firmwide extended holidays, flexible PTO and personal sick time
  • Professional development stipend
  • Wellness/fitness benefits
  • Healthy lunches provided daily
  • Commuter benefits

Additional Information

We do sponsor and take over sponsorship of employment visas for this role. If we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa.

Annual Pay Range

At Verkada, we want to attract and retain the best employees, and compensate them in a way that appropriately and fairly values their individual contribution to the company. With that in mind, we carefully consider a number of factors to determine the appropriate starting pay for an employee, including their primary work location and an assessment of a candidate's skills and experience, as well as market demands and internal parity. jobs.title: Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

What You'll Do:

CoreWeave is the AI Hyperscaler™ — an AI-first cloud where every layer is purpose-built for AI workloads. The Global Field Organization owns our technical customer relationships and partners hands-on with some of the most advanced AI teams in the world. CoreWeave Federal, the newest team within the GFO, brings this platform to U.S. government agencies, the Intelligence Community, and the Defense Industrial Base — where some of the hardest and most consequential AI deployment problems live: real-time geospatial analysis, intelligence at scale, autonomous systems, and secure multi-agent workflows, all under the toughest compliance constraints in the industry. We hire field engineers who want to apply the stack powering frontier AI labs to missions that matter for national interest.

The Account Solutions Architect, Federal is the named technical partner for U.S. government agencies across CoreWeave's full platform — spanning infrastructure to inference. You'll work alongside federal customers to design AI workloads that meet mission requirements while aligning with federal AI compliance standards. You'll lead proofs of concept end-to-end, partner with Account Executives and federal teams on technical strategy, and serve as the bridge between mission needs and our engineering, security, and compliance organizations.

In this role, you will:

  • Serve as the named technical partner for federal customers across CoreWeave's full platform
  • Provide technical guidance on running AI workloads in regulated environments, including FedRAMP, DoD Impact Levels (IL2–IL6), and emerging AI-specific federal standards
  • Represent the voice of the federal customer internally — distilling requirements, compliance gaps, and federal use case patterns back to Product, Security, and Engineering
  • Build reference architectures and enablement content for federal engagements, raising the technical bar of the federal field organization as it scales

Who You Are:

  • U.S. Citizenship and an active U.S. government security clearance (Secret minimum; TS/SCI strongly preferred); must be eligible to obtain and maintain higher levels of clearance
  • 5+ years in a solutions engineer, solutions architect, or technical field engineering role, with at least 3 years supporting federal customers
  • Strong Python proficiency and hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, evaluating, and deploying modern deep learning models, including LLMs; experience designing and deploying production agentic applications for real customer use cases
  • Working knowledge of federal cybersecurity frameworks and authorization processes, plus familiarity running AI workloads on at least one major cloud platform (AWS/GovCloud, Azure/Government, or GCP/Government)

Preferred:

  • Active TS/SCI clearance, ideally with a current CI or Full Scope Polygraph

About Stack:

Stack is developing revolutionary AI and advanced autonomous systems designed to enhance safety, reliability, and efficiency of modern operations. Stack's autonomous technology incorporates cutting-edge advancements in artificial intelligence, robotics, machine learning, and cloud technologies, empowering us to create innovative solutions that address the needs and challenges of the dynamic trucking transportation industry. The firmware team is responsible for developing and maintaining the embedded software that bridges hardware and high-level applications in the Stack AV autonomous vehicle system. Our work ensures that sensors, actuators, and compute platforms operate reliably, and in real-time, forming the foundation of safe and intelligent trucking.

As a Senior Embedded Software Engineer, you will design, develop, and validate software for our safety-critical embedded platform. You will architect firmware that interfaces directly with sensors, compute modules and the base vehicle, ensuring deterministic and safe behavior.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop embedded software architectures - develop scalable, modular, and real-time embedded systems for our autonomous vehicle platform.
  • Mentor and guide team members - provide technical leadership, conduct code reviews, and lead by example.
  • Ensure compliance with safety standards - apply safety guidelines to build safety-critical software with robust fault handling.
  • Coordinate tasks amongst team members to achieve on time delivery.
  • Support vehicle testing and field deployments - diagnose and resolve embedded software issues in real-world scenarios.

Qualifications: 

  • Expert in C++ for embedded systems development for safety critical systems.
  • Strong understanding of RTOS concepts / programming (e.g. FreeRTOS, SafeRTOS).
  • Experience with safety-critical standards such as ISO 26262, DO-178C, IEC 61508, IEC 62304 or similar.
  • Hardware abstraction layer (HAL) and BSP development.
  • Multithreaded and real-time software design.
  • Good understanding of CAN and ethernet communication protocols, ideally in an automotive context.
  • Has taken at least one product through to production, including maintaining the product with paying customers.

jobs.description:

Our US Marketplace Strategy & Operations team is responsible for building, scaling and improving the way in which we provide Restaurant delivery. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

We are seeking a skilled Sales Financial Analyst to join our Finance team. You will work on a high-performing, high-impact team that delivers CFO-level partnership and sophisticated analytics to our Chief Business Officer and their global leadership team. Within the Finance organization, you’ll support Sales Finance Managers, our Senior Manager of Sales Finance, Senior Director of Sales Finance, and Senior Sales & XFN Stakeholders on aspects related to revenue forecasting, insights, and goal-setting.  You will partner with Sales leaders on ideas to improve their P&L. The Sales Finance team’s mandate is to optimize value creation for Pinners, advertisers, and Pinterest through disciplined business leadership and seamless financial execution. We do this by developing financial forecasts, providing decision support through analyses, generating internal reports, monitoring key performance indicators, and scaling financial processes. We are looking for an expert in Finance & Strategy who uses an analytical, collaborative, results-oriented approach to drive progress.

  • Exceptional spreadsheet skills (Google Sheets and/or Excel) with experience creating financial models and dashboards.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist Field Engineer, Federal Security
jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

What You’ll Do:

The Customer Experience (CX) Organization at CoreWeave is dedicated to ensuring every client running AI workloads at scale has a seamless, reliable, and high-performance experience. This team supports the infrastructure that powers the AI revolution—working across data centers, hardware systems, and customer workloads to maintain the integrity of our cloud platform. The CX organization aligns closely with the internal and customer engineering teams, offering valuable insights from the field and having the chance to contribute to the CoreWeave product roadmap and development. 

About the role:

As a Specialist Field Engineer at CoreWeave, you will play a vital and dynamic role. You will have the opportunity to demonstrate thought leadership and engage hands-on throughout our customers' entire lifecycle. From establishing their Kubernetes environment to developing proofs of concept, onboarding, and optimizing workloads, you will lead innovation at every turn. If you're driven by innovation, thrilled by the possibilities of what specialized compute can enable, and eager to be part of a team that's shaping the future, then CoreWeave is the place for you. Join us and let's embark on this adventure together!

In this role, you will:

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for customers, establishing strong technical relationships and ensuring their success with CoreWeave's cloud infrastructure offerings, focusing on securing Kubernetes workloads within regulated cloud infrastructure environments
  • Act as the lead security technologist for federal engagements, partnering with DoD, Intelligence Community, and civilian agency customers as well as defense primes, systems integrators, and SLED organizations  to architect accredited AI/HPC environments that meet their mission and compliance requirements
  • Collaborate closely with customers to understand their unique business needs and create, prototype, and deploy tailored solutions that align with their requirements
  • Translate federal security and compliance requirements collaboratively with our federal compliance team; FedRAMP Moderate/High, FISMA, NIST SP 800-53 and 800-171, DoD Cloud Computing SRG Impact Levels (IL4/IL5/IL6), CMMC, and DISA STIGs  into concrete Kubernetes and GPU infrastructure architecture and controls
  • Support Authorization to Operate (ATO) efforts under the NIST Risk Management Framework: contribute to control narratives, System Security Plans, POA&Ms, and continuous monitoring evidence, and serve as the customer-facing technical authority during assessor and AO engagements
  • Lead proof of concept initiatives to showcase the value and viability of CoreWeave's solutions within specific environments, including work in classified and controlled enclaves and air-gapped or disconnected deployments
  • Drive technical leadership and direction during customer meetings, presentations, and workshops, addressing any technical queries or concerns that arise, including briefings to key customer stakeholders, their leadership, and other program stakeholders
  • Act as a virtual member of CoreWeave's Security product and engineering teams, identifying opportunities for product enhancement and collaborating with engineers to implement your suggestions, and channel federal customer requirements into the roadmap for CoreWeave's government offerings and compliance posture
  • Offer valuable insights on product features, functionality, and performance, contributing regularly to discussions about product strategy and architecture
  • Conduct periodic technical reviews and assessments of customer workloads, pinpointing opportunities for workload optimization and suggesting suitable solutions, and identifying compliance drift or control gaps in regulated environments
  • Support our federal compliance teams in enabling security compliance automation for both internal and external reporting requirements
  • Stay informed of the latest developments and trends in Kubernetes, cloud computing and infrastructure, and in federal cloud security policy, including zero trust mandates and emerging guidance on securing AI systems, sharing your thought leadership with customers and internal stakeholders
  • Lead the prototyping and initiation of research and development efforts for emerging products and solutions, delivering prototypes and key insights for internal consumption
  • Represent CoreWeave at conferences and industry events, with occasional travel as required, including travel to customer and government facilities

Who You Are:

  • U.S. citizen with an active Top Secret/SCI clearance or active Secret with ability to obtain TS/SCI. Willingness to support work in SCIFs and other secure facilities as required
  • B.S. in Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience
  • 7+ years of proven experience as a Solutions Architect, engineer, researcher or forward deployed engineer  in cloud infrastructure focusing on building distributed systems or HPC/cloud services, with an expertise focused on securing Kubernetes workloads
  • 3+ years of that experience directly supporting federal customer and/or Defense Industrial Base (DIB) engagements — DoD, IC, or civilian agency — in a customer-facing technical role
  • Hands-on experience delivering systems into accredited federal environments, with demonstrated fluency in at least one of: FedRAMP authorization, DoD Impact Level accreditation, RMF/ATO packages, and/or CMMC readiness
  • Fluency in cloud computing concepts, architecture, and technologies with hands-on experience in designing and implementing cloud solutions
  • Proven track record with building customer relationships, communicating clearly and the ability to break down complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Familiar with NVIDIA GPUs typically used in AI/ML applications and associated technologies including networking
  • Deep understanding of administrating Kubernetes clusters including controls such as RBAC, admission controllers, container security, etc.
  • Proven experience describing security concepts clearly, along with best practices and an understanding of the security tooling landscape in Kubernetes environments
  • Working knowledge of hardened container supply chains in regulated environments — image provenance and signing, SBOMs, FIPS 140-validated cryptography, STIG-compliant baselines, and secure/air-gapped design patterns

Nice to have:

  • Experience with DoD network environments (NIPR/SIPR/JWICS) or IC cloud programs
  • Prior work at a Cloud Service Provider, defense prime, or federal systems integrator supporting a FedRAMP or DoD authorization boundary
  • Certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CMMC RP, CCA, CCA, or equivalent
  • Experience securing AI/ML training and inference workloads for national security missions

Export Control Compliance

This position requires access to export controlled information. To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency.  CoreWeave may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Customer Lifecycle
jobs.description:
Who we are

In the past, to be a successful restaurateur, you simply had to have a passion for food and a passion for people — but to succeed as a digital restaurateur you also need to have a passion for technology. We believe in the joy of serving others, and that's why we created Otter – to help restaurateurs succeed in online food delivery. Restaurants around the world, both large and small, including Chick-fil-A, Ben & Jerry's, KFC, and Eataly trust our software to power their delivery business. We increase sales, reduce order issues, and decrease delivery headaches.

 

What you'll do

As a Software Engineer on the Otter Customer Lifecycle team, you'll build the platform that every other team at Otter depends on — the core systems that define what a restaurant is in our product, and the services that get merchants from signup to serving orders.

  • Build and own the merchant platform: the core services and data models behind stores, facilities, brands, and the entitlement-driven configuration that determines what each merchant can access.
  • Design onboarding services that take a new restaurant from signup to live and serving orders, reliably and without manual intervention.
  • Build the backend for self-serve growth — signup, activation, and conversion flows that let restaurants adopt Otter without touching a salesperson.
  • Design offboarding and lifecycle cleanup so that when a merchant leaves, the systems behind them shut down cleanly instead of quietly running and costing money.
  • Own your services end-to-end: design, build, instrument, debug, and improve reliability and performance.

 

What we're looking for

We value diversity of experience and are looking for engineers excited to own complex, high-impact systems. We look for a strong sense of ownership — people ready to take their work from idea to production and take responsibility for outcomes.

Basic Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Java or Go, writing production backend services.
  • Solid foundation in distributed systems, microservices, and API design (gRPC and/or REST).
  • Experience with databases (e.g. PostgreSQL, CockroachDB) and writing performant queries.
  • Experience designing data models and core domain objects that other teams build on top of.
  • Experience operating services in production, and a collaborative, product-minded approach.

Nice to Have

  • Workflow orchestration (e.g. Temporal, Cadence) or event-driven architectures (Kafka).
  • Authentication, authorization, permissions, or entitlements systems.
  • Experience with API modernization or migrating services off a legacy stack.
  • Marketplace, merchant platform, subscription, or billing systems experience.
  • Cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) and containers (Docker, Kubernetes).

 

Why join us

  • Demand for online food delivery is growing really fast! In the last 5 years, just in the US, the overall market has expanded 10X from $10B to $100B, and could expand to $500bn-$1T by 2030.
  • Changing the restaurant industry: You'll be part of a team that helps restaurants succeed in online food delivery.
  • Collaborative environment: You will receive support and guidance from experienced colleagues and managers, helping you to learn, grow and achieve your goals, and you'll work closely with other teams to ensure our customer's success.

 

What else you need to know

This role is based in our Mountain View office location. As a company driven by innovation and continuous change, close collaboration is essential. We're constantly reimagining our industry, creating new products, and refining our processes, and we do our best work together. That's why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week.
