jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators. 

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there. 

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

WHY SAFETY?

At Roblox, we strive to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and the Safety organization’s mission is to become the leader in civil immersive online communities. We systematically detect, remove, and prevent problematic accounts, content and behavior, and we make Roblox accounts secure and free from compromise. We cover a broad area of the tech spectrum, including machine learning, classifiers for 3D models, experimentation, automation, detection workflows, and AI-powered text filters. Aligned and partnering with product teams, we use this toolbelt to discover new opportunities, influence and shape the product roadmap and prioritization, build safety products, and measure the impact on our community of users and developers. In doing so, we keep Roblox safe, civil, and inclusive, and we foster positive relationships between people around the world.

WHY ACCESS & CONTROLS?

Roblox operates globally across a huge number of jurisdictions, each with their own laws and regulations. Every user’s platform experience is tailored based on their age, location, parental consents, and more to ensure that Roblox is safe and compliant for them. The Access & Controls pod owns the systems that make this possible. Our platforms allow internal teams to set feature access rules based on compliance requirements and let users customize their platform experience within those boundaries.

Our services are some of the highest-traffic systems at the company, sitting in the hot path of nearly every user action across billions of accounts and millions of requests per second. As international regulations evolve and new features are built, our systems are how Roblox enforces, manages, and gives visibility into consistent behavior across dozens of features.

You Will:

  • Design, build, and operate high-throughput, low-latency services that shape what every Roblox user can see and do. The pod owns the full stack end-to-end, from gRPC services to caching, data pipelines, and client integrations.
  • Help set the technical direction for how feature access and user settings work across Roblox, evolving our systems as the platform and the regulatory landscape grow.
  • Partner directly with feature teams across Roblox to onboard them onto our platforms and turn evolving regulatory requirements into consistent product behavior. Past examples of this team’s contributions include:
    • Policy Deployment: Access rules used to ship as dynamic configuration, with no visibility into what was running in production and no way to revert without a code change. The team replaced that with a purpose-built deployment system with a custom UI, partial rollouts, shadow traffic, and one-click rollback. Policy deployment went from a source of anxiety to a routine, low-risk operation for the dozens of feature teams that depend on it daily.
    • Age-Checked Comms: In late 2025, Roblox introduced platform-wide Age Checks for all Communication features, including restrictions that only allow users to communicate with others in similar age ranges. Our access platform was the backbone of this rollout, giving every feature one centralized place to answer: Is this user Age Checked? Are they eligible to Age Check? Can these two users communicate?
  • Own the reliability, performance, and observability of systems that nearly every feature at Roblox depends on.
  • Mentor other engineers and add to the team’s culture of knowledge sharing, project retros, and bottoms-up technical decision-making.

You Have:

  • 5+ years of industry experience building and operating backend or distributed systems at scale.
  • Strong fundamentals in service design, caching, data modeling, and performance. You know how to build systems that stay fast and correct under millions of requests per second.
  • A track record of leading projects from design through launch, including projects that span multiple teams or customers.
  • Bonus: Experience with authorization or access control systems, policy engines, configuration or feature-flag platforms, or regulatory compliance (e.g., age assurance, privacy, parental controls).
  • Educational Background: BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

You Are:

  • Someone Who Thrives in Ambiguity: You take full ownership of problems that don’t come with a clear spec. When requirements are shifting or incomplete, you define the problem, make the call, and drive it to an outcome.
  • Innovative: You spot friction in existing processes, look for simple abstractions that remove a whole class of work, and turn your ideas into prototypes that shape where the team goes next.
  • Reliability-Focused: You understand what it means to own hot-path infrastructure. You make changes safe through rollouts, validation, and fast rollback.
  • Collaborative: You enjoy working across teams and product areas, and you’re comfortable translating ambiguous policy or regulatory requirements into concrete technical designs.
  • Mission Oriented: You care about keeping Roblox safe and compliant for users of all ages around the world.

jobs.title: RF Test Automation Engineer, Electronic Warfare
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril’s Electromagnetic Warfare (EW) team is seeking experienced software test and automation engineers to scale up our development and production infrastructure. As a test and automation engineer, you’ll develop software integration with RF test equipment, collaborate with product engineering to define the interfaces necessary to implement end-to-end automated EW product testing, and work with RF engineers, digital systems engineers, and manufacturing engineers to design and implement the production testing systems that ensure our customers are delivered a flawless product. You will apply state of the art software construction techniques to ensure the timely delivery of correct mission critical code.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Define and implement systems to perform automated development and production testing.
  • Integrate state-of-the-art RF equipment with our testing infrastructure.
  • Own RF test strategy and coverage for EW systems across development and manufacturing.
  • Drive improvements in RF test architecture, with a focus on tactically-relevant mission-focused testing.
  • Create and support electrical test systems through the full lifecycle of development, implementation, scaling, and refinement.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Strong engineering background from industry or school, ideally in areas/fields such as Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or Physics.
  • Experience with integrating hardware systems, especially automated test equipment.
  • Experience with automating engineering and production tests.
  • Experience with automating RF test equipment.
  • Experience with Python.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.
US Salary Range
$129,000—$171,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

 

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. 

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

 

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/. 

 

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there. 

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

The Economy ML team is building the machine learning backbone for Roblox’s virtual economy - from intelligent pricing and personalized storefronts to dynamic layout optimization and avatar content understanding. We partner closely with Marketplace, Payments, and Developer Monetization to deliver ML systems that drive long‑term value across engagement, retention, and creator earnings.

As a Senior ML Software Engineer on the team, you will build the infrastructure and backend services that train, serve, and integrate the models powering ranking, personalization, and pricing across Roblox’s economic surfaces, including Marketplace, Developer Monetization, and Payments. Your work determines how quickly we can take new models from idea to production, and how well they perform once they are serving millions of users.

You Will

  • Build and operate the training infrastructure behind Economy ML’s ranking, recommendation, and pricing models: distributed training jobs, efficient data loading, and reproducible pipelines from raw data to trained model.
  • Co-design models and systems with ML engineers: profile and optimize training and inference for our ranking and recommendation models, improving GPU utilization, memory, throughput, and latency (e.g., moving models to GPU serving, request batching, mixed precision, faster request-time feature processing).
  • Design and build the backend services and APIs that bring model predictions into Marketplace, Payments, and Developer Monetization, with clear latency budgets and graceful fallbacks.
  • Build and scale the batch and real-time data and feature pipelines that feed training and serving, with a focus on freshness, correctness, and training/serving consistency.
  • Own the path from trained model to production serving: packaging, deployment, versioning, shadow and canary rollouts, and integration with A/B experiments on Roblox’s ML platform.
  • Make the systems you own reliable and observable, and set the team’s best practices for logging, monitoring, alerting, and on-call across ML services.
  • Partner with Roblox’s central ML platform and data infrastructure teams, and with Marketplace / Economy backend teams, to adopt shared infrastructure and contribute improvements back to it.
  • Contribute to the technical direction of the Economy ML team: help shape our training and serving stack, infrastructure roadmap, and the tradeoffs between model quality, latency, and cost.
  • Mentor other engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on guidance, helping raise the technical bar of the broader Economy organization.

You Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including 2+ years building and operating ML infrastructure or ML-backed production services at high scale. Experience with recommendation, search, or ads systems is a strong plus.
  • Solid engineering fundamentals in Python and at least one other backend language, with a track record of designing and operating distributed, low-latency services.
  • Hands-on experience training and serving deep learning models in production with PyTorch, including scaling training across GPUs and nodes and deploying models on GPU inference servers. Comfortable profiling and optimizing for utilization, memory, latency, and cost.
  • Experience building batch and streaming data pipelines and feature stores (e.g., Spark, Flink, Kafka), with attention to data quality and training/serving skew.
  • You build systems that are easy to debug and operate, and you take ownership of production health, from monitoring and alerting to incident response.
  • You enjoy working closely with ML engineers, platform teams, product managers, and data scientists across Marketplace, Payments, and Developer Monetization, and you can drive alignment in complex, multi‑stakeholder environments.
  • You understand how infrastructure choices (latency, freshness, cost) affect model quality and product metrics, and you prioritize work by its impact on users, creators, and the business.
  • BS, MS, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

We’re hiring a Senior People Business Partner to be the senior people strategist for User. You'll sit on the group leadership team as a trusted advisor to the group's senior engineering leader and their staff. You'll own the multi-year people strategy that lets User ship an ambitious roadmap while growing the leaders and builders who deliver it. You'll partner with a People Business Associate who supports frontline managers, so your time goes to org design, leadership bench, and group health, not straightforward manager and employee questions.

User is the group that builds what most people think of as “Roblox”. The app they open on their phone, console, or desktop, the friends they find and keep, the ways they chat and share moments, and the communities and first party live events they experience. It's a large, engineering-heavy group of engineering, product, design, and data science teams working across the Social (Communication, Community, Connection, Sharing), Consumer Apps, and Live teams. The work is highly interdependent, what one team ships usually depends on several other teams and functions.

You’ll join the People Business Partner team in People & Systems and report to the Senior Director, People Business Partner Lead.

You will

  • Co-create User's multi-year people strategy - Work with group leadership to turn product strategy into an annual people plan and a multi-year talent roadmap covering capability gaps, succession, future skills, and where to invest
  • Diagnose and improve the system, not treat the symptom - Analyze User's operating model, org design, spans and layers, and talent systems to find friction and misalignment with the business strategy. Then build the case for structural change and see it through
  • Orchestrate change across teams - Lead large, multi-team changes, including reorgs, team integrations, and new operating rhythms, so leaders can keep shipping while the org evolves
  • Build the leadership bench - Partner with senior leaders on a long-term plan for leadership capability and succession across the group. Make sure development plans are real and in use, and treat RoGRO as one input, not the endpoint
  • Bring data to the leadership table - Combine internal people data (engagement, attrition, performance, progression) with external research to produce forward-looking insights that change decisions. Help leaders read the signal, not just the dashboard or report
  • Use AI to work differently - Use AI tools to speed up analysis, synthesis, and program design. Help User's leaders think through how AI changes team design, skills, and the work of managers
  • Shape culture with leaders - Use people data to find systemic barriers to engagement and inclusion, and design interventions that reflect Roblox's values. Hold senior leaders to their people commitments, courageously and constructively
  • Make User a place great builders choose - Shape hiring programs, capacity planning, and employer brand for the group so User attracts and keeps the talent it needs

You have

  • 10+ years in HR, people strategy, or organizational effectiveness, including significant time as a senior PBP/HRBP partnering with VP-level leaders in engineering-centric, product-driven technology organizations
  • A track record of org design and change at scale: reorgs, operating model shifts, or integrations affecting hundreds of people, with outcomes you can measure
  • Built and owned multi-year talent strategies: succession and bench planning, workforce planning (build / buy / borrow), and leadership development that moved readiness metrics
  • Strong analytical judgment. You're comfortable working directly with people data, partnering with People Analytics, and turning complex findings into a clear narrative for senior leaders
  • Hands-on use of AI tools in your own work, and curiosity about how AI is changing team design and the role of managers
  • Executive presence and courage: you influence senior technical leaders through credibility and evidence, and you'll tell them what they need to hear
  • Discretion with highly confidential information, and comfort operating in ambiguity at the pace of a founder-led company

Nice to have

  • Experience supporting consumer, social, or communications products at scale, or mobile and cross-platform app organizations
  • Background in I-O psychology, organization development, or an equivalent evidence-based approaches to how people work
  • Experience in a PBP/associate (or HRBP/HR generalist) partnership model where you have mentored and partnered closely with partner functions

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Infrastructure Engineer, Matchmaking
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators. 

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there. 

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Matchmaking is a critical stage downstream of Discovery and Search. Once a player chooses a game to play, matchmaking assigns them to a server for that game. That decision shapes who they play with, the network latency they experience, and the quality of their session. By matching players to servers that fit their needs and each developer’s game, matchmaking helps turn discovery into satisfying play, repeat visits, and long-term engagement, making it a direct lever for Roblox’s growth.

As a Senior Machine Learning Infrastructure Engineer, you’ll build scalable, reliable, and high-performance infrastructure that powers ML systems across our organization. You’ll operate at the scales of tens of billions of scorings, and redefine how we match hundreds of millions of users to millions of games.

You will:

  • Work at the intersection of model architecture and ML infrastructure, partnering closely with core modelers, data and AI infrastructure engineers, and product teams to push the boundaries of large-scale training and serving. 
  • Design and own large-scale data engineering and streaming systems that power ML, including real-time event ingestion, streaming feature computation, training-data generation, and data quality and freshness guarantees. This includes building low-latency pipelines with technologies such as Kafka, Flink, Spark Structured Streaming, and Ray, and keeping online and offline features consistent.
  • Build online and continual learning systems that let models adapt to user behavior and content shifts in near real time. This includes incremental and streaming training, online model updates and fast model refresh, embedding and parameter-server synchronization, delayed-feedback and label-joining pipelines, and safe deployment through monitoring, drift detection, and automated rollback.
  • Investigate model, data, and systems tradeoffs end to end, from streaming data pipelines and distributed training to low-latency inference and production serving. This includes designing efficient cache strategies, applying pruning and quantization, optimizing GPU utilization and memory efficiency, and developing custom kernels where needed.
  • Own the architecture, establish engineering best practices of scalability, reliability, and cost-effectiveness of ML infrastructure (e.g., training, serving, feature). You have deep production experience with low-latency key-value stores and feature registries like Redis, Feast, Tecton, or Cassandra.
  • Work closely with data scientists, ML engineers, platform teams, and product stakeholders to design, implement, and operate robust ML platforms that accelerate model development and deployment.
  • Stay abreast of industry trends in machine learning and infrastructure to ensure the adoption of leading-edge technologies and practices.

You have:

  • 5+ years of experience designing, building, and deploying large-scale machine learning and data systems in production environments.
  • 3+ years of experience tech-leading ML infrastructure or data engineering teams.
  • Hands-on experience with large-scale streaming and data processing systems (e.g., Kafka, Flink, Spark, Beam) and real-time feature pipelines.
  • Experience building or operating online, incremental, or continual learning systems for recommendation, ranking, or search is a strong plus.
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach to problem solving.
  • BS, MS, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer, Ground Maneuver
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril Ground Maneuver is the business line that brings Anduril's sensors, effectors, communications, command and control, and Lattice to military ground vehicles. Our work covers wheeled and tracked platforms, from light tactical vehicles to armored vehicles. Our customers range from Army and Marine Corps program offices to the units that operate these vehicles in the field.

We're hiring the lead systems engineer for a new product that will be fielded across many vehicle types. You'll join early, while the architecture is still taking shape, and carry it through design reviews, integration and test, and into production. You'll define how the system installs on a vehicle, how it gets and distributes power, and how it connects to the vehicle and the network. You'll also define how other Anduril teams and outside partners integrate with it. Other products will be built around those interfaces for years, so they need to be right.

You'll work closely with mechanical, electrical, software and mission systems engineers. You'll also work with product teams in other Anduril business lines and with government engineers and operators. Experience designing vehicles or major vehicle systems at an OEM, supplier or defense prime is valuable in this role. You'll report to the Ground Maneuver Chief Engineer and work day to day with the product and program manager.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own the system architecture across vehicle classes, so one design scales across many platforms instead of being redone for each vehicle.
  • Define and own the interface standard between the base kit and the mission kits: power, data, network and mechanical.
  • Own the vehicle power budget: what the kit draws, what the vehicle can supply, and how the system behaves when power runs short.
  • Define the interfaces to vehicle data buses (CAN, J1939, vehicle Ethernet) and to the Army systems already installed on the vehicle.
  • Turn product and customer needs into system requirements, with traceability and a verification method for every requirement.
  • Write and maintain the interface control documents (ICDs), and get each one an owner and sign-off on both sides.
  • Lead the technical content of design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR), including the entrance and exit criteria and the evidence that the design meets them.
  • Run trade studies on compute, power and packaging, and bring clear recommendations to the Chief Engineer.
  • Work directly with engineers in other Anduril business lines whose products will ride on the kit. Understand their needs and hold the line on the standard.
  • Keep the technical risk register with the Chief Engineer and program team.
  • Work hands-on in the lab and on vehicles during integration and test.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • B.S. in Electrical, Mechanical, Systems or Computer Engineering, or a related field
  • 7+ years of systems engineering experience, including leading systems engineering on a hardware development program through at least PDR
  • Experience integrating electronics onto military or commercial ground vehicles
  • Working knowledge of vehicle electrical power systems and MIL-STD-1275
  • Experience with vehicle networks and data buses (CAN, J1939, Ethernet)
  • Experience writing ICDs and owning an interface across teams or companies
  • Familiarity with MIL-STD-461 and MIL-STD-810
  • Track record of making architecture tradeoffs and defending them to engineering leadership and customers
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience on Army ground vehicle programs (Stryker, JLTV, AMPV, Abrams or similar) or with DEVCOM GVSC
  • Familiarity with VICTORY, CMOSS or other open-architecture standards for vehicles
  • Experience architecting a product line or platform that ships in multiple variants
  • Experience with vehicle power distribution, power conversion or energy storage design
  • Experience with Cameo or another SysML tool
  • Hands-on experience with harnessing, lab instruments and vehicle integration builds
  • Active U.S. Secret security clearance
US Salary Range
$132,000—$198,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

 

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. 

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

 

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/. 

 

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Safety Threat Investigator, Safety Investigations
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators. 

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there. 

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Every day, millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect. Our Safety Investigations team helps make those experiences safer by identifying and disrupting severe abuse, understanding the actors and networks behind it, and turning complex investigative findings into clear action.

As a Safety Threat Investigator on the Safety Investigations team, you will primarily support Roblox’s Core Investigations capability: the operational backbone for repeatable, high-sensitivity matters that require speed, consistency, evidence discipline, and strong documentation. You will independently manage investigations from intake through resolution and produce clear, defensible work product that supports high-confidence safety decisions.

You will also identify when a matter requires deeper attribution, network-centric analysis, cross-platform research, proactive threat hunting, or externally meaningful work product, and partner with or escalate to Specialized Investigations as appropriate. At the CL9 level, you will own a defined safety-risk domain or pod-level workstream, improve investigative processes and standards, serve as a subject-matter expert, and mentor other investigators with limited day-to-day oversight.

Please note: This role may require reviewing graphic, controversial, and offensive content in accordance with Roblox’s handling policies. It may also require participation in an on-call rotation during weekends and holidays.

You Will

  • Own repeatable, high-sensitivity investigations involving serious safety threats, including child exploitation, violent extremism, organized fraud, compromised accounts, coordinated abuse, and other high-risk matters.
  • Apply structured investigative methods, evidence checklists, common templates, and approved data pulls to produce timely and consistent case outcomes.
  • Gather, preserve, analyze, and corroborate evidence while maintaining accurate provenance, confidentiality, and auditability.
  • Define investigative questions, scope, hypotheses, evidence plans, milestones, risk controls, and exit criteria for sensitive or ambiguous matters.
  • Conduct focused account, entity, and timeline linkage as needed, and identify when a case requires deeper attribution, network mapping, or cross-platform investigation.
  • Escalate cases to Specialized Investigations when they develop meaningful attribution complexity, broader network risk, external actionability, or a need for deeper synthesis.
  • Prepare clear case summaries and standardized downstream work product for partners such as Legal, Safety Intelligence, Trust & Safety Operations, Law Enforcement Operations, or NCMEC, as appropriate.
  • Track recurring patterns, operational pain points, and escalation trends, and translate findings into recommendations for Policy, Product, Engineering, Detection, Legal, and Safety Operations.
  • Lead or contribute to durable improvements such as investigation playbooks, evidence standards, intake criteria, triage processes, tooling requirements, and quality-review mechanisms.
  • Represent Safety Investigations with cross-functional stakeholders, explain and defend investigative decisions, navigate disagreement, and maintain alignment on sensitive matters.
  • Mentor investigators, provide constructive feedback on casework, and raise the team’s standards for investigative rigor, documentation, and inclusive collaboration.
  • Maintain strong case hygiene, document decisions and approvals, and ensure investigations are closed with clear outcomes, residual-risk ownership, and follow-up actions.

You Have

  • 4+ years conducting sensitive investigations involving severe safety, abuse, fraud, security, threat, or other high-risk matters.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage investigations end-to-end, including intake, scoping, evidence development, analysis, findings, recommendations, and follow-through.
  • Experience using SQL and/or Python, large datasets, and open-source intelligence in an investigative context.
  • Strong investigative judgment and the ability to distinguish facts, inferences, allegations, unknowns, assumptions, and analytical conclusions.
  • Experience with attribution, account or entity linkage, network analysis, open-source intelligence, external intelligence, or cross-platform research.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear, concise, and defensible work product for investigators, leadership, Legal, Product, Engineering, and external-facing stakeholders.
  • Ability to turn ambiguous questions into precise investigation plans and drive complex, multi-week or multi-quarter initiatives with minimal oversight.
  • Systems-oriented thinking and the ability to connect individual cases to policy, product, process, detection, legal, reputational, and user-trust considerations.
  • Experience influencing partners and creating alignment in high-stakes or time-sensitive situations.
  • Demonstrated mentorship, informal leadership, or subject-matter expertise that helps other investigators grow.
  • Sound judgment, discretion, curiosity, resilience, and a commitment to evidence-based, fair, and proportionate investigations.

Success in This Role

Within your first year, you will be expected to independently manage Core Investigations matters from intake to completion, deliver consistent and defensible work product, identify cases that warrant escalation, provide practical insights from your investigations, and own a meaningful process-improvement project or risk domain.

You will be successful when you:

  • Deliver rigorous, timely, and consistent outcomes on high-sensitivity investigations.
  • Apply sound judgment in triage, lane assignment, escalation, and case closure.
  • Improve the team’s investigative methods, operating processes, templates, and quality standards.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Ledger
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators. 

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there. 

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

What You’ll Do:

Join the Roblox Ledger team and build the system of record for a global economy. Our north star is that all movement of value on Roblox is tracked on the Ledger, and that every unit of value — virtual currency, fiat, or digital asset — is accurately tracked, perfectly balanced, and fully auditable. That makes the Ledger the trusted foundation for our users, creators, and economy.

We are the source of truth for the economy in both directions: every write of value, and every read of it. The same authoritative record that settles a transaction also has to answer the questions people ask about it — balances, history, statements, reconciliation, and analytics — so that read paths do not drift from the book of record. Robux already runs entirely on our zero-balanced, double-entry ledger, and Creator Wallets launch in December 2026. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, build, and scale the systems that make this true, in a domain where correctness is the product rather than a feature.

You Have: 

  • 4+ years of backend software engineering experience, demonstrating proficiency in designing, building, and maintaining robust and scalable systems (e.g., microservices, APIs).
  • Strong problem-solving skills and experience debugging complex issues in distributed systems.
  • Experience in managing projects, planning and executing work across different workstreams.
  • Strong collaboration skills, ability to work across teams and organizations, mentoring and guiding junior engineers.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a similar technical field.
  • Experience in financial infrastructure, ledgers, accounting, or another domain where accuracy is non-negotiable is highly desirable. Experience building a ledger or double-entry system at another company is a strong plus.
  • Experience with large-scale data or analytical systems (OLAP, event-driven pipelines, or similar) is a plus but not a requirement.

You will:

  • Work closely with Finance, product, and other economy engineering teams to make every movement of value correct at the source.
  • Architect, design, implement, and operate the ledger services that record every movement of value on Roblox.
  • Proactively identify and address correctness, performance, auditability, and operational risks in systems where a single bad entry is a financial incident.
  • Design idempotent, exactly-once write paths, plus the reconciliation that proves the books balance and the precision guarantees other teams build on.
  • Own both sides of the ledger: the write path that records value, and the read path that serves balances, history, and analytics from the same source of truth.
  • Uphold high standards for code quality, test coverage, and maintainability, fostering the culture of engineering excellence.

jobs.title: Group Product Manager, GenAI Creatives
jobs.description:
About Moloco:

Moloco is an AI-native performance advertising company, bringing the power of AI advertising to the open internet. Founded in 2013 by machine learning engineers who had built AI advertising systems inside the world's largest technology companies, Moloco began from a shared mission: to build that same engine for the open internet.

Today, Moloco is one company with two businesses, built on the same compound AI system. Moloco Ads is our AI-native performance advertising platform, helping mobile app marketers acquire, retain, and re-engage high-value users across the open internet. Moloco Commerce Media is our AI-native retail media platform, enabling retailers and marketplaces to turn their platforms into thriving ad businesses. Both are powered by CARA (Compound Ad Recommendation Architecture), the AI system behind every Moloco product.

At Moloco, we bring together those who've already solved hard problems and those with the drive to. Here, we work on some of the complex problems in AI advertising, at a scale and level of sophistication very few companies can offer. Come build what's next.

The Impact You'll Be Contributing to Moloco

Moloco is building the next generation of AI-powered creative optimization.

As a Group Product Manager, you will define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for one of Moloco's most strategic AI investments. You will work at the intersection of Generative AI, machine learning, experimentation, creative intelligence, and advertising performance to build products that transform creative signals into measurable business outcomes.

This is a highly ambiguous, 0-to-1 opportunity that requires strong product judgment, technical curiosity, and the ability to create clarity in an emerging space where customer needs, technical capabilities, and market expectations are evolving rapidly.

What You Will Do

  • Define and drive the product strategy for AI-powered creative generation, optimization, and learning systems.
  • Define how creative quality, advertiser outcomes, and AI system performance should be measured, evaluated, and optimized.
  • Partner closely with engineering and machine learning teams to translate emerging technical capabilities into differentiated customer value.
  • Use customer insights, experimentation, product intuition, and market signals to identify opportunities and guide investment decisions.
  • Drive product discovery in areas with limited precedent, rapidly testing hypotheses and refining strategy based on new learnings.
  • Influence stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, GTM, and executive leadership to align on vision, priorities, and execution.
  • Partner with GTM teams to shape customer narratives, proof-of-concepts, adoption strategies, and feedback loops.
  • Help define how Moloco brings AI-powered creative optimization to market and establishes leadership in this emerging category.

The Opportunity

This is a rare opportunity to own an early-stage product area at the center of one of the most significant shifts in advertising.

The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity and enjoys tackling problems that do not yet have established solutions. This is not a maintenance or optimization-focused PM role. Success will require creating structure where there is limited data, forming conviction without overfitting to incomplete signals, and helping the organization make high-quality decisions in a rapidly evolving technological landscape.

You will have the opportunity to shape both the product strategy and the category itself as Moloco defines the future of AI-powered creative optimization.

How Do I Know if the Role is Right For Me?

  • You have a track record of leading 0-to-1 or highly ambiguous product initiatives where the problem space, customer needs, or technical capabilities were still emerging.
  • You are comfortable creating clarity and direction when there is limited data, incomplete information, or no established playbook.
  • You have strong product fundamentals, including customer obsession, prioritization, experimentation, metric design, decision making, and end-to-end ownership.
  • You use data, research, customer feedback, and product judgment to make decisions, while recognizing that not every important decision can wait for perfect evidence.
  • You can develop a strong point of view on product strategy and communicate it effectively to diverse stakeholders, including senior leaders and highly technical teams.
  • You have experience building products in technically complex domains, working closely with engineering, machine learning, or data science teams to translate emerging capabilities into customer value.
  • You have led strategic initiatives across multiple teams and stakeholders, building alignment and momentum even when priorities, incentives, or data were not fully aligned.
  • You are energized by rapid learning and enjoy exploring new technologies, customer behaviors, and market opportunities.
  • You can balance long-term vision with pragmatic execution, making progress in uncertain environments while continuously refining strategy based on new learnings.
  • You have experience partnering with go-to-market teams to shape product narratives, customer education, proof-of-concepts, feedback loops, and adoption strategies.
  • You have strong customer instincts and can deeply understand user workflows, motivations, and pain points, even in unfamiliar domains.
  • You are excited by the challenge of balancing customer needs, business outcomes, and emerging AI capabilities in areas where there is often no obvious right answer.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building AI-powered products, particularly Generative AI, machine learning, or recommendation systems.
  • Experience with creative tools, content creation workflows, visual intelligence, or multimodal AI systems.
  • Experience designing experimentation, measurement, or optimization systems.
  • Experience in advertising, marketing technology, marketplaces, search, recommendation, or other data-driven decision systems.

You do not need prior adtech experience to be successful in this role. We are looking for product leaders who can learn quickly, reason rigorously, and help define the future of AI-powered creative optimization.

Compensation & Benefits

U.S.-based employees have access to medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company match, short-term and long-term disability coverage, basic life insurance, and well-being benefits and perks. U.S.-based employees also receive up to 12 scheduled paid holidays per calendar year and one Thrive Day off per quarter. Additionally, all employees have Flexible Time Off (FTO).

  • Uncapped Growth Mindset: We see all situations as opportunities to learn, grow, and improve as individuals and as an organization. We seek diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and promote experimentation to push the boundaries of what’s possible.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Power Electronics Controls and Software
jobs.description:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

Position Summary: 

As the Senior Manager for Power Electronics Software & Controls, you will serve as the technical anchor and organizational leader for the team building the digital intelligence behind our next-generation Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and mixed-asset energy sites. We are looking for a deeply technical player-coach, someone who can go deep with our engineers on stability margins, modulation schemes, and multi-core cycle budgets, while driving multiple programs from ideation through volume production and field maintenance. 

You will unify advanced control theory and bare-metal embedded firmware under a single architectural vision. From modeling high-order resonant tanks in PLECS to deploying deterministic, safety-critical Rust and C code onto ARM Cortex-R/M silicon, your team will ensure that heterogeneous, second-life, and new battery assets operate in seamless synchronization to stabilize the grid at industrial scale. 

This position is based in our San Francisco office and operates on an onsite work model. 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities 

  • End-to-End Program Leadership: Own the software and controls technical roadmap and delivery across multiple concurrent power electronics program, driving systems from first-principles concept and topology selection through EVT/DVT/PVT, mass manufacturing, utility commissioning, and in-field fleet diagnostics/OTA maintenance. 
  • Advanced Control Systems & Topologies: Guide the theoretical design, discrete-time synthesis, and optimization of closed-loop controllers for bidirectional DC/DC and AC/DC stages, including resonant topologies (DAB, LLC, CLLC) and multi-level architectures (Flying Capacitor, ANPC). 
  • Grid-Scale & Multi-Asset Synchronization: Direct the development of advanced grid-forming (GFM) and grid-following (GFL) algorithms, virtual synchronous machine (VSM) dynamics, black-start capabilities, and active power/thermal balancing across heterogeneous, recycled, and new battery arrays. 
  • Bare-Metal & Multi-Core Firmware Architecture: Oversee the firmware architecture for real-time control targets (ARM Cortex-R, Cortex-M, and DSPs), enforcing deterministic execution, sub-microsecond interrupt latency, high-resolution PWM synchronization, DMA-driven ADC sampling, and zero-overhead hardware abstraction in Rust and C. 
  • Safety-Critical & Resilient Systems: Establish rigorous architectural standards for functional isolation, freedom from interference (FFI), memory protection, and fault-tolerant state machines across multi-core environments, ensuring compliance with UL 1741, UL 1973, and IEEE 1547. 
  • Hardware-Software Co-Design: Partner directly with power electronics hardware, magnetics, thermal, and site-controller leaders to optimize switching frequencies, dead-time compensation, thermal derating curves, and semiconductor loss balancing. 
  • Field Telemetry & Fleet Reliability: Build closed-loop feedback systems from deployed field assets back to R&D—leveraging high-resolution fault capture and time-series telemetry to root-cause elusive grid-interaction anomalies and deploy fleet-wide control refinements.
  • Talent & Culture: Recruit, mentor, and retain an elite team of controls engineers and embedded firmware architects, fostering a culture of deep technical rigor, first-principles problem-solving, and high velocity.

Construction Quality Assurance/Quality Control Manager

Redwood Materials is seeking a Construction Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) Manager to join our internal Engineering, Procurement, & Construction (EPC) team, which designs and builds battery recycling and battery materials manufacturing facilities. The QA/QC Manager will be embedded on the Engineering team and serve as the owner’s quality representative, ensuring that all construction—whether self-performed or executed by subcontractors—meets the intent of design drawings, project specifications, and applicable codes. This role spans the full project lifecycle, from design through construction completion and turnover, and is expected to engage proactively during design to identify quality requirements, constructability concerns, and inspection hold points before construction begins. The QA/QC Manager will also contract and coordinate third-party special inspections where required by code or contract. This role works closely with project management, infrastructure engineering, project controls, and procurement, and interfaces directly with construction managers, site superintendents, construction engineers, and subcontractors.

Responsibilities will include: 

  • Lead and develop the project QA/QC function, including direct oversight of internal inspectors, QC coordinators, and third-party inspection personnel; set priorities, review performance, and provide day-to-day technical direction 
  • Review engineering drawings and specifications during the design phase to identify constructability concerns, inspection hold points, and quality requirements before construction begins; provide proactive QA/QC feedback to design engineers 
  • Develop project-specific Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs) and coordinate scheduling of third-party special inspections (e.g., structural steel, welding, concrete, fireproofing) to ensure inspection resources are in place ahead of construction activities 
  • Contract and manage relationships with third-party special inspection agencies; ensure their scopes, qualifications, and schedules align with project needs 
  • Perform daily site walks to identify risks, discrepancies, and non-conformances; document findings, evaluations, and inspections using company-prescribed procedures and software 
  • Perform system verifications on completed systems to confirm correct installation per design specifications and contract documents; assist with development and maintenance of quality protocols, qualification requirements, and validation procedures and documentation 
  • Audit contractor and self-perform quality turnover documentation, including MTRs, weld maps, weld logs, PWHT reports, NDT reports, concrete placement records, bolt tensioning records, and other civil/structural QC documentation 
  • Track and report on quality metrics, non-conformance trends, and inspection status to project leadership; support resolution of day-to-day quality issues in the field 

Desired Qualifications: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, or a related technical discipline; an Associate’s degree or technical diploma with significant additional field experience may be considered in lieu of a Bachelor’s 
  • Minimum 8–10 years of experience in construction quality control/assurance, inspection, or a closely related field, including prior experience leading or supervising QA/QC personnel 
  • Current CWI (Certified Welding Inspector) certification, or ability to obtain CWI within 12 months of hire 
  • Working knowledge of ASME B31.3 (Process Piping) and AWS D1.1 (Structural Welding Code – Steel) 
  • Ability to read and interpret civil, structural, mechanical, and piping engineering drawings and specifications; experience developing or executing Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs) 
  • Valid driver’s license; strong organizational and communication skills 
  • Demonstrated leadership and mentoring ability, including experience directing inspectors, subcontractor QC staff, or third-party inspection agencies; strong sense of ownership 

Preferred Qualifications:

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

HUMAN DATA MANAGER

You will ensure engineering teams get the right data they need—high-quality tasks and evaluations—by crafting and executing high-value Human Data projects. You sit at the intersection of model teams and data operations: partnering with engineering, designing projects that capture meaningful signals, and driving measurement of data impact. This is a hands-on role for people who understand training and evaluation deeply and want to influence data strategy.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Partner with model and engineering teams to understand needs and translate them into high-value data projects and evaluation strategies
  • Own end-to-end delivery of critical data and evaluation projects that capture meaningful training signals and support rapid model development
  • Leverage AI agents and existing platforms to measure data effectiveness and quantify impact (data yield, eval lift, usage)
  • Maintain rigorous data integrity and truthfulness, including validation processes for factual accuracy; prioritize quality over quantity
  • Research and apply techniques for data collection, annotation, generation, and multi-modal integration
  • Shape Grok’s behavior and domain performance through targeted data work; improve annotation workflows using agents and no/low-code approaches where helpful
  • Manage plans that shape model behavior via data management, optimization, and analysis, including resources and timelines

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Mobile Experience and Platform
jobs.description:
About Stitch Fix, Inc.

Stitch Fix (NASDAQ: SFIX) Stitch Fix is redefining retail by combining human creativity with advanced data science and Generative AI. As we build the future of personalized shopping, we’re equally committed to building yours.  We believe in investing in our team as much as our technology. Join us to be a trendsetter in the industry and help us redefine what’s possible for our clients, while we help you reach your full potential.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead our Mobile Experience & Platform team at Stitch Fix. This team of approximately 12 engineers drives native iOS development, maintains our Android application, and builds the shared mobile foundations that enable exceptional client experiences. Our Android application primarily delivers web-based experiences within a native wrapper and is focused on ongoing maintenance, reliability, and operational health.

This is a unique engineering leadership opportunity that combines people leadership, platform strategy, and shared product leadership. Our mobile engineers are highly skilled, operate with significant technical autonomy, and contribute to initiatives across multiple product teams. Your role is to create the clarity, alignment, and organizational structure that enables them to do their best work.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead and develop an experienced team: Coach, mentor, and support approximately 12 engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous growth.
  • Shape the mobile experience and platform roadmap: Develop a compelling mobile vision and partner with Product and Engineering leadership to prioritize investments that balance native client experiences, platform modernization, and long-term engineering health.
  • Lead shared product strategy: In the absence of a dedicated Mobile Product Manager, play a key role in identifying opportunities for mobile-first innovation, leveraging native device capabilities (such as push notifications, widgets, and Live Activities), and using data and client insights to shape investments.
  • Orchestrate engineering capacity: Partner with leaders across multiple product teams to understand priorities, anticipate demand, allocate engineers effectively across concurrent initiatives, and communicate delivery commitments and tradeoffs.
  • Drive platform and operational excellence: Ensure the reliability, performance, and long-term sustainability of our mobile applications. Oversee native iOS development infrastructure, testing, release management, and platform modernization, while ensuring Android remains stable, secure, and well-maintained.
  • Empower technical experts: Create an environment where senior and staff engineers have the autonomy, context, and support to make sound architectural and technical decisions aligned with business goals.
  • Build cross-functional alignment: Collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, Design, Algorithms, and other partners to align priorities, navigate dependencies, and deliver cohesive client experiences.
  • Advance engineering effectiveness through AI: Champion practical AI adoption in engineering workflows to improve developer productivity, software quality, and delivery effectiveness.
  • Create operational clarity: Establish lightweight processes for portfolio visibility, capacity planning, and prioritization so engineers and stakeholders understand commitments and dependencies.
  • Collaborate as a distributed team: Work effectively across a distributed US team leveraging modern tooling (GitHub, Slack, Zoom) within an organization that treats data as a first-class citizen.

About You

  • Proven People Leadership: You have significant experience leading and developing software engineers—including senior and staff levels—with demonstrated success managing teams holding broad technical and organizational responsibilities.
  • Product-Minded Engineering Leader: You combine engineering leadership with strong product instincts. You are comfortable shaping roadmaps, building business cases, and guiding product direction without a dedicated product manager.
  • Data-Informed Decision Maker: You use quantitative data, client insights, and key engineering metrics across adoption, engagement, reliability, and performance to identify opportunities and evaluate outcomes.
  • Resource and Delivery Orchestrator: You have demonstrated success managing engineering capacity, expectations, and delivery across multiple concurrent initiatives, product teams, and stakeholders.
  • Empowering and Trust-Oriented: You build trust, delegate effectively, and create high accountability without micromanaging technical decisions.
  • Strategic and Technically Sound: You possess strong technical judgment and can partner effectively with senior engineers on architecture, performance, security, and trade-offs. You balance near-term delivery needs with long-term platform health.
  • Clear Communicator and Influencer: You excel at navigating ambiguity, communicating tradeoffs transparently, and influencing decisions across organizational boundaries.
  • Forward-Looking Technologist: You have practical experience adopting AI tools and workflows to enhance engineering effectiveness.
  • Domain Background: You bring experience in mobile application development, client-facing engineering, developer platforms, or similarly complex engineering environments.
  • Team-Centric Mindset: You care deeply about fostering inclusive, healthy, and high-performing engineering cultures where people grow and do their best work.

You’ll love working at Stitch Fix  because you will…

  • Fuse human creativity and styling expertise to redefine personalized retail.
  • Set a high bar for our craft and drive measurable impact across fashion, tech, and data science.
  • Actively leverage AI and modern tech to evolve how work gets done.
  • Lead with innovation, think boldly, and aren't afraid to challenge conventional retail norms.
  • Win together in a collaborative, low-ego environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated.
  • Be client obsessed by putting our customers at the heart of every decision to deliver unmatched personalization and trust.
  • Support our team with competitive compensation packages, comprehensive benefits, and meaningful career growth.

Compensation and Benefits

This role will receive a competitive salary, benefits, and equity. The salary for US-based employees hired into this role will be aligned with the range below, which includes our three geographic areas. A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, location, and performance. This position is eligible for an annual bonus, and new hire and ongoing grants of restricted stock units, depending on employee and company performance. In addition, the position is eligible for medical, dental, vision, and other benefits. Applicants should apply via our internal or external careers site.

Salary Range
$151,900—$253,000 USD

When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you.

What we do:


The Payroll Specialist will be responsible for accurate, timely payroll processing for Canada and U.S. employees across multiple states, from time collection through final processing and reconciliation. The Payroll Specialist reports to the Manager, Regional Payroll. This role also uses AI tools to improve the accuracy, speed and insight of our payroll operations.

What you'll do:

  • Act as the first point of contact for employee payroll inquiries via the ticketing system, ensuring timely, accurate resolution with a strong service focus and escalating complex issues as needed
  • Support end-to-end payroll processing across Canada and U.S. employees across multiple states on schedule, from time and attendance collection and validation through data entry, calculation review, pre-transmission audit and post-payroll reconciliation
  • Reconcile payroll registers, tax liabilities and general ledger postings, and validate confirmation reports; research and correct variances
  • Perform 401(k) reconciliations each pay cycle, tying employee deferrals, employer match and loan repayments to recordkeeper files, and resolve discrepancies and process corrections
  • Process garnishments, levies, child support and other involuntary deductions, including calculating withholdings within federal and state limits, setting up orders, remitting payments on time and maintaining documentation
  • Apply state and local tax withholding and unemployment (SUI) requirements for multi-state employees, track work-location changes, and support new state registrations with guidance from the Payroll Manager

  • Support accurate taxation and reporting of employer-paid benefits and equity compensation, including RSU vesting, NSO exercises, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) and Incentive Stock Option (ISO) events, in partnership with senior team members
  • Load and validate import files and prepare ad hoc payroll reports as requested

  • Support internal and external audits and respond to requests for supporting documentation

  • Ability to prioritize and work under deadline pressures

jobs.title: Staff Systems Integration Engineer, Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL)
jobs.description:
Who we are 

Atoms is building the machines that power the next era of progress.

Over the last decade, software has transformed the digital world. But the physical world, where food is made, minerals are mined, goods are moved, and industries are run, remains far less intelligent, far less efficient, and far more constrained. We’re changing that.

Atoms builds Physical AI— real-world robots for the industries that move civilization forward, starting with food, mining, and transport. Our systems are designed to understand, predict, and control the real world with precision, turning complex physical operations into something more reliable, more scalable, and more productive.

This work requires more than robotics. It requires deep integration across hardware, software, AI, operations, manufacturing, and real estate. We don’t just build machines in a lab. We deploy them into real environments, operate them, learn from them, and improve them until they work at scale.

We are roboticists, engineers, operators, and builders. We believe the next great technology companies will not only transform information, but the physical systems that shape everyday life.

If you want to work on hard problems with real-world impact, join us.

About the role 

We are seeking a Senior Systems Integration Engineer to develop and maintain the hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) test benches used to validate our autonomy stack off-vehicle. In this role, you will be responsible for building, instrumenting, and commissioning physical test benches, implementing automation scripts, and supporting daily execution for our software and autonomy teams. This is a deeply hands-on role where you will assemble and wire bench hardware, integrate interface tooling, write reliable test automation, and maintain clear documentation and troubleshooting guides.

What you’ll do

  • System Bench Design & Fabrication: Design, build, and commission hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) test benches, including schematic capture, component selection, harness fabrication, and mechanical layout. Validate and document correlations between bench and vehicle behavior, noting any hardware fidelity limits or test divergences.
  • Vehicle & Network Simulation: Implement vehicle bus and controller simulations across CAN, CAN-FD, and Automotive Ethernet so autonomy compute interacts with complete simulated systems. Set up power/ignition sequencing, drive-by-wire responses, and gateway override interfaces to command specific vehicle test states.
  • Sensor Data Replay: Implement and maintain open-loop sensor and telemetry data replay into compute hardware at full rate and time-synchronized to original log timestamps. Assist with integrating interfaces and data pipelines to support repeatable bench testing and future closed-loop test capabilities.
  • Test Automation & CI Integration: Develop and maintain automated test scripts and execution pipelines that trigger bench tests from code commits, support release regression testing, run unattended, and generate clear pass/fail test reports.
  • Fault Injection & Safety Validation: Implement and execute fault-injection tests—including power loss, communication drops, and degraded-mode behaviors—to validate failsafe handling against safety requirements.
  • Vendor & Equipment Coordination: Evaluate, bring up, and maintain commercial bench hardware and software tools. Coordinate with vendors and suppliers on lead times, component orders, and toolchain updates.
  • Cross-Functional Triage & Debugging: Support autonomy, software, and hardware engineers using the bench by maintaining bench uptime and tracking issues. Debug bench failures across sensor timing, harnesses, drivers, and compute, documenting root causes and collaborating with engineering teams on fixes.
  • Documentation & Best Practices: Maintain comprehensive bench schematics, harness drawings, wire labeling, and operating guides. Train engineers and technicians on bench operation and standard troubleshooting procedures.

What we’re looking for

  • Education & Experience: Bachelor’s in EE, CE, ME, CS, or related field with 5+ years of experience.
  • HIL & Bench Build: Proven track record building, wiring, and commissioning HIL benches, including schematic review, component sourcing, harness fabrication, and bring-up.
  • Vehicle Networks: Hands-on experience with CAN, CAN-FD, LIN, and Automotive Ethernet, including restbus simulation, DBC/LDF editing, and bus analysis tools (e.g., Vector CANoe, PCAN, Wireshark).
  • Plant & Sensor Modeling: Experience configuring and deploying real-time plant, actuator, sensor, or power models onto real-time target hardware (e.g., Speedgoat, dSPACE, NI).
  • Software & Automation: Strong Python for test automation, working familiarity with C/C++ in Linux, and experience integrating test suites into CI pipelines.
  • Robotics Middleware & Interfaces: Practical familiarity with ROS/ROS2 (logging, rosbag, replay), high-speed camera links (GMSL/FPD-Link), lidar/radar interfaces, and PTP/gPTP synchronization.
  • Fault Injection & Safety: Hands-on execution of fault injection and off-nominal testing (frame drops, signal loss, degraded sensors, power cuts) against safety requirements.
  • Execution & Communication: Ability to deliver in fast-moving, evolving hardware/software environments, paired with clear documentation skills for wiring schematics, test procedures, and debug logs.

Why join us

At Atoms, you’ll work on one of the defining challenges of our time—bringing automation into the physical world to drive real, lasting impact. Our work only matters if it serves others, and we know that meaningful progress depends on the trust of the people we serve and the strength of our team—so we invest in both, creating an environment where you can do your best work and grow.
