jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA; New York City, NY; Seattle, WA
jobs.description:
About the Team

At DoorDash, design means making experiences for the people who order, the people who prepare, and the people who deliver.

As a Designer at DoorDash, you want to build things that matter to real people. You're at your best when you can move from idea to shipped product quickly, bringing experiences to life that reach and influence users at massive scale. You'll care about whether the product you make solved a real problem for real people, or changed how someone experiences their day.

You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with Engineering and Product Management, dig into the data, and use LLM-powered tools alongside traditional design tools. If the LLM powered tools don’t exist yet, you build them.

About the Role

Restaurants are the heart of every neighborhood, yet most run on a patchwork of disconnected tools. We’re building DashOS, the operating system for the restaurant of the future. It’s one platform that connects delivery, in-store dining, reservations, and loyalty, across software, kiosk and POS hardware, and agentic experiences that take work off operators’ plates.

As Principal Visual Designer, you’ll set the look, feel, and identity of DoorDash’s merchant products. You’ll own the visual direction for DashOS and give merchants a recognizable identity across every surface, including hardware, where no design conventions exist yet. These products already work. Your job is to make merchants love using them.

Visual craft is the center of this role, and you’ll ship it yourself. You’ll prototype and use AI tools like Cursor and Claude to generate and refine UI, so your ideas reach production with full fidelity. You’ll also define the visual foundation of the design system (tokens, components, guidance, and examples) so designers, engineers, and AI tools all produce on-brand, high-quality UI. Engineering partners build and maintain the tooling, and you set the rules and the quality bar.

You’ll report to the Senior Director, Product Design for Merchant. This role is hybrid, with 1–2 days a week in a Design Hub.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Set the visual direction for merchant products across DashOS and bring multiple teams around a shared vision, so the work compounds instead of duplicating.

  • Ship high-craft interfaces with a clear point of view, turning complex, data-dense workflows into screens merchants can read at a glance in a busy kitchen or at the counter.

  • Own the visual foundation of the design system: define the tokens, components, usage rules and examples that both people and AI tools apply. Review generated UI against that bar, record what good looks like, and improve the system based on how teams actually use it.

  • Design for new surfaces. Create visual systems for points-of-sale, handhelds and agentic experiences where no existing paradigm applies.

  • Influence through the work. Earn trust with prototypes and shipped products instead of decks, and keep your prototypes production-ready.

  • Raise the bar across the team. Mentor senior designers, help close strong hires, and help people sharpen their sense of what to build and why.

We’re excited about you because…

  • You’ve designed interfaces that defined or reshaped a product’s look and feel, and your portfolio shows top-of-bar visual craft with range across brands and styles.

  • You can build what you design. You work in React, TypeScript or similar, and use AI tools to explore directions and refine UI faster than you could by hand.

  • You’ve set direction across a product area, and people adopted your work because it was good, not because you told them to.

  • You’d rather build a visual system that makes 20 designers faster and more consistent than ship one great screen yourself.

  • You’ve worked on complex, information-dense products such as point-of-sale, fintech, marketplaces or platform teams, and you’ve shipped with product and engineering partners, including pushing back constructively.

  • Bonus: you’ve designed for devices or contexts with no existing design paradigm and built the visual system from scratch.

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act).   • ASE and tool reimbursement programs

Schedule: 

We do everything we can to deliver an exceptional customer experience, and that includes delivering great vehicles when expected. Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 690-7853, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM PT (9AM to 7PM ET).

You’ll work with Product and Engineering to understand how we use our partners’ infrastructure today, find where deeper technical collaboration could improve our platform or economics, and turn those opportunities into executable partnership strategies. At the same time, you’ll build joint go-to-market motions that create pipeline, accelerate enterprise deals, and make Vercel more strategic to our partners’ field organizations.

  • Lead negotiations and cross-functional execution across Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Legal, from concept through agreement, launch, and growth

  • Negotiated complex agreements: cloud commitments, marketplace terms, co-sell structures, or joint product initiatives
  • Technical fluency across modern cloud infrastructure and application delivery, enough to understand architectures, ask incisive questions, and earn credibility with product and engineering teams

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Program Manager, ADAS Validation
jobs.description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience. 

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

Role Overview 

Lucid Motors is seeking a Sr Engineering Program Manager – ADAS/AD Validation to drive planning and execution for assigned Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) and Advanced Driving (AD) validation programs. This senior individual contributor will translate validation priorities into executable plans, coordinate cross-functional delivery, and proactively manage dependencies, risks, and readiness reporting.

The role partners with validation engineering leads, who own technical test strategy and acceptance criteria, and works within priorities established by validation leadership. The role is on‑site at Lucid’s Southfield, MI office and reports to the Staff Engineering Program Manager of ADAS/AD Validation. 

Key Responsibilities  

  • Validation Execution & Resource Coordination: Drive day-to-day cross-functional execution for assigned validation programs. Coordinate vehicle availability, equipment, software readiness, transportation, and on-road, proving-ground, and simulation test schedules with engineering and operations owners. Identify capacity conflicts and recommend trade-offs for leadership approval. 
  • Validation Planning: Develop and maintain integrated validation execution plans with engineering leads, including scope, milestones, deliverables, accountable owners, dependencies, and entry and exit criteria. Align plans with approved technical validation strategies, stakeholder requirements, and vehicle program milestones; assess the impact of scope or schedule changes. 
  • Program Tracking & Communication: Partner with ADAS program and feature delivery managers to align validation commitments with development and integration schedules. Run execution reviews, maintain action and decision logs, and publish clear status updates covering planned versus completed testing, coverage gaps, blockers, and milestone readiness using tools such as Jira and Confluence. 
  • Software Release Readiness: Coordinate validation timing with digital integration and software release teams for OTA (over-the-air) cycles. Consolidate test completion status, open defects, regression results, and outstanding evidence for readiness reviews. Track closure of agreed actions and escalate gaps; technical sign-off and release approval remain with designated engineering and release authorities. 
  • Dependencies, Risks & Issue Resolution: Maintain a program risk and dependency register, identify critical-path impacts, and drive mitigation actions with accountable owners. Facilitate cross-functional issue triage and defect follow-up, tracking issues through resolution and retest. Resolve execution blockers within the assigned scope and escalate priority, resource, or technical decisions with clear options and recommendations. 
  • Lifecycle Support & Continuous Improvement: Manage assigned validation deliverables across applicable development phases, from concept through start of production (SOP) and post-launch updates. Improve execution workflows, reporting, and traceability within the assigned scope, and capture lessons learned for subsequent validation cycles. 

Qualifications & Skills 

  • Demonstrated experience independently managing complex engineering program workstreams, preferably in automotive ADAS/AD, software integration, or verification and validation, with accountability for schedules, dependencies, risks, and deliverables. 
  • Working knowledge of ADAS/AD systems, vehicle and software development lifecycles, and verification and validation methods, including vehicle testing and simulation or hardware-/software-in-the-loop testing. Ability to work with technical owners to understand test coverage, acceptance criteria, and applicable safety and regulatory dependencies. 
  • Ability to build and maintain integrated schedules, identify critical-path constraints, assess resource needs, and adapt execution plans as requirements and software readiness evolve.

  • Build repeatable co-sell, pipeline-generation, and joint GTM plays that scale across relationships rather than being rebuilt per partner
  • Evaluate program and partner performance with data and partner feedback, and recommend where to expand, simplify, or retire

  • 6+ years in partnerships, partner programs, ecosystem enablement, or GTM strategy in AI or developer tooling
  • Built and scaled partner programs with measurable results
  • Strong understanding of the developer, modern web, and AI agent ecosystem
  • Hands-on experience with PRM systems, marketplaces, or partner ecosystem tooling
  • Turned ambiguous strategy into concrete, scalable programs with measurable execution
  • Drove cross-functional alignment across Partnerships, Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success without direct authority

jobs.title: OT Support Operator
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Factory Systems builds and runs the technology that keeps Anduril's factories producing, including the devices, networks, and systems on the floor and the people who use them. Our footprint is growing quickly, and the team is building the operational foundation to support that growth.

We are looking for an OT Support Operator to be our boots on the ground. You will provide hands-on support to the people who build things, answering tickets, fixing broken hardware, and deploying new devices. You will also keep the hardware itself moving, from procurement through receiving, stocking, and shipping. This role is ideal for someone who likes fixing things, likes getting things where they need to go, and takes ownership without waiting to be told what's next.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Work the support queue in Jira: triage, resolve, and close tickets within response and resolution targets
  • Diagnose and repair broken hardware (workstations, scanners, printers, and peripherals), or coordinate vendor RMAs when repair isn't practical
  • Image, configure, and deploy new devices to users and production floor stations, and confirm they work before handoff
  • Support factory floor users in person, including on-site troubleshooting and device swaps
  • Handle account, access, and software requests within your permissions, and escalate to Systems Administrators when a request is outside your scope
  • Execute procurement for defined hardware needs: create purchase requests, place and track orders, follow up with vendors, and keep stakeholders informed on delivery status
  • Receive shipments at the dock, verify that what arrived matches what was ordered, and record receipts and discrepancies
  • Stock, stage, and organize inventory so the right hardware is findable and ready to deploy, tracking it in our asset management and ticketing systems
  • Run reverse logistics and sustainment: swaps, refreshes, RMAs, vendor returns, and end-of-life retirement, with records closed out at every step
  • Perform regular inventory counts and flag shortages before they stall a deployment or a build
  • Keep asset records accurate as devices are repaired, reassigned, shipped, or retired
  • Document fixes and recurring issues, and flag patterns to the team so root causes get addressed rather than ticketed repeatedly

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 2+ years of experience in IT support, helpdesk, desktop support, or a hands-on IT operations role (or equivalent experience)
  • Experience with an asset management or ERP system or with asset management tools
  • Hands-on experience troubleshooting and repairing laptops, desktops, and common peripherals
  • Experience with a ticketing system such as Jira Service Management
  • Comfort with physical work, including receiving and moving shipments and working on a warehouse or factory floor 
  • Strong organization and follow-through: you close loops, keep accurate records, and notice when numbers don't match
  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the patience to support users of varying technical comfort
  • Ability to work in a fast-moving environment with competing priorities and to take ownership of your work

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with shipping, receiving, inventory management, or purchasing in a manufacturing, warehouse, or logistics setting
  • Experience with barcode scanners, label printers, or other industrial and OT devices
  • Familiarity with Active Directory/Entra ID, Okta, or similar identity management tools
  • Experience in a manufacturing, defense, or other regulated hardware environment
US Salary Range
$84,000—$111,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

 

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. 

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

 

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/. 

 

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Senior Training Specialist, EHS
jobs.description:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

Senior Training Specialist, Environment, Health, And Safety 

 

As a Senior EHS and Training Engineer, you will be responsible for overseeing the EHS and Training programs for Redwood’s Energy Services business unit.  This position will support power electronics manufacturing and assembly, power electronics R&D, project site commissioning, product certification testing and field service and maintenance operations. You will translate regulatory and company requirements into hands-on programs that operators, technicians, and engineers can apply immediately. This role is primarily performed in a plant and production environment, with regular presence on the operating floor and periodic travel to support the R&D team and field service operations. 

 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

 

  • Partner with process and manufacturing engineering during production line design, ramp, and changes to eliminate hazards at the design stage (Design for EHS) before equipment is released to production. 
  • Provide EHS support to Redwood's R&D power electronics development team, including lab and prototype safety reviews, electrical safety practices, and hazard assessments for engineering builds. 
  • Support field service and maintenance teams with EHS guidance for on-site and field work, including lockout/tag-out, work on energized equipment, and site-specific hazard controls. 
  • Maintain the EHS training matrix and learning management system records tied to Pack Manager assembly, R&D power electronics, and field service roles so required training and certifications remain audit-ready, and report completion and certification metrics to leadership.
  • Support audits and regulatory inspections related to Energy Services processes, and revise EHS content as equipment, standards, and floor feedback require. 
  • Develop and deliver relevant training to Energy Services team members including, LOTO, Electrical Safety, forklift operations, etc. 
  • Deliver 10-hour general industry safety training to new hires and production personnel supporting PACK Manager assembly, and coordinate 30-hour training for supervisors and leads.
  • Create work instructions, visuals, and toolbox talks that translate work requirements into training content for a diverse production workforce.

jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Staff Program Manager – Product Operations & NPI. This is a Hybrid (Santa Clara, CA office 3 days a week) role, reporting to the Vice President of Product Operations & NPI in the Product Management department. This role offers a massive opportunity to champion innovation and make a significant mark on the planning and product roadmap at the forefront of the world’s cloud security leader by delivering never-before-seen capabilities in threat prevention, visibility, scalability, and business enablement.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Leading and orchestrating the execution of multiple product development and launching programs to ensure timely delivery and high-quality outcomes.
  • Acting as a central liaison for cross-functional alignment, addressing program risks, and resolving bottlenecks proactively to maximize the impact of Zscaler Product Innovation for internal/external stakeholders as well as sales/technical teams.
  • Providing consistent updates to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure alignment on objectives and milestones.
  • Optimizing operational processes to improve collaboration, scalability, and organizational impact
  • Fostering a culture of iterative improvement by ensuring feedback is integrated into process refinements

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
  • You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving.
  • 8+ years of experience in Product Operations, Program Management, or NPI; preferably in SaaS or cybersecurity industries
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex new product introductions and programs via Strong cross-functional coordination skills with exceptional communication.
  • An exceptional communicator skilled in aligning cross-functional stakeholders while providing clear updates to senior leadership.

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications) 

  • Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency.
  • A strategic thinker, focused on business outcomes, with a proven ability to orchestrate complex programs from inception to delivery while being an advocate for continuous improvement.
  • A proactive problem-solver who identifies and mitigates risks, efficiently resolving bottlenecks to ensure program success while continuously supporting  Zscaler Practice.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Developer Ecosystem
jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

About the Team

Reddit's developer ecosystem is one of the biggest opportunities to make Reddit more useful, expressive, extensible, and valuable. Today, most people who build on Reddit are developers: they write code, use Devvit, work with APIs, and ship apps or games through a relatively technical workflow. That ecosystem is growing quickly and remains critical.

But the future is bigger than developers alone. AI-assisted building is changing who can create software. The next generation of Reddit apps, games, tools, community agents, content formats, and workflows should be buildable by many more people: developers, technically curious creators, moderators, community builders, game designers, data partners, and eventually people who can describe what they want without needing to code it by hand.

The Developer Ecosystem team owns the product systems that help this broader set of builders discover opportunities, create successfully, launch high-quality apps and games, reach the right users and communities, adopt new platform capabilities, and keep improving after launch. This includes surfaces and systems like developers.reddit.com, AI-assisted creation, app review, developer and creator onboarding, app marketplace experiences, platform capabilities, best practices, and support for emerging creator categories.

About the Role

We are looking for a Staff Product Manager to lead Reddit's Builder Ecosystem product strategy. This person will define the roadmap for how Reddit moves from a developer-only ecosystem to a broader builder ecosystem where AI-assisted and no-code creation become first-class parts of the platform.

The role spans developer growth, creator onboarding, AI-assisted building, app quality, ecosystem incentives, platform capabilities, app marketplace strategy, operational tooling, feature adoption, and new builder categories.

This is a high-ambiguity platform role with direct business, product, and community impact. The right PM will be able to bridge two worlds: they should understand the needs of serious developers and platform engineers, while also having strong conviction that Reddit can unlock a much larger wave of builders by making creation more accessible, guided, AI-native, and outcome-oriented.

What You'll Do

  • Define the product strategy for Reddit's Developer Ecosystem, including the transition from code-first developers to a broader base of AI-assisted creators.
  • Own the roadmap for developers.reddit.com as the primary builder portal, including onboarding, docs, app management, analytics, review status, feature access, education, examples, templates, and AI-assisted creation entry points.
  • Lead strategy for AI-assisted app creation, including prompt-to-app workflows, AI building tools, no-code or low-code experiences, reusable templates, generated scaffolds, and systems that help creators turn ideas into useful Reddit-native apps.
  • Build the product approach for an App Marketplace that helps users, moderators, communities, and internal teams discover high-quality apps, games, agents, tools, and community experiences.
  • Improve app review and ecosystem operations through tooling, automation, and AI-assisted workflows, including LLM-powered app review, policy checks, quality signals, and reviewer efficiency.
  • Partner with Engineering to prioritize core platform capabilities and performance improvements such as webhooks, webviews, APIs, SDKs, tooling, observability, and other primitives builders need to create reliable apps.
  • Drive more successful, retentive, and popular apps and games by identifying best practices, improving templates, shaping incentives, and creating clearer paths from idea to launch to growth.
  • Identify and support new creator and developer categories
  • Partner with internal teams such as Contribution, Community Builders, Games, Search, Recommendations, Safety, and Ads to help them launch new functionality through the developer ecosystem.
  • Define and improve feature adoption programs so builders understand, test, and successfully use new platform capabilities.
  • Work with developer relations to establish the measurement system for the ecosystem, including weekly active developers/creators, NPS/CSAT, app launches, app retention and more
  • Create clear frameworks for when Reddit should build platform primitives, launch templates, fund builders, partner with external teams, promote apps, or shut down low-quality or low-trust ecosystem behavior.
  • Lead cross-functional alignment across Product, Engineering, DevRel, Community, Data, Safety, Legal, Policy, Support, BD, and senior leadership.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience leading high-ambiguity platform, developer ecosystem, creator ecosystem, marketplace, gaming, AI tooling, or developer experience products.
  • Strong product judgment for creation platforms: understanding what makes a platform powerful for advanced developers, approachable for new creators, trustworthy for communities, and worth sustained investment.
  • Comfort with code, APIs, developer tools, technical platform tradeoffs, and engineering conversations, paired with strong conviction that AI-assisted and no-code creation will expand who can build on Reddit.
  • Ability to reason across multiple sides of the ecosystem: developers, creators, users, moderators, communities, internal teams, partners, and Reddit's business priorities.
  • Experience improving developer or creator onboarding, docs, portals, SDKs, APIs, marketplaces, app review, app distribution, AI creation tools, or app-building workflows.
  • Strong analytical judgment and comfort defining metrics for ecosystem health, builder productivity, app quality, retention, distribution, and business impact.
  • Ability to partner deeply with Engineering on platform capabilities, performance, reliability, primitives, observability, and build-vs-buy decisions.
  • Strong product sense for apps, games, agents, content creation tools, community-native experiences, and the kinds of lightweight software that should exist inside Reddit communities.
  • Comfort working with AI-assisted creation tools, LLM-based workflows, prompt-to-app systems, or other emerging ways of helping more people build software.
  • Excellent written communication and decision frameworks that help teams make crisp investment decisions in ambiguous spaces.

jobs.description:
About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

Our Retrieval team builds shared machine learning capabilities that help Pinterest connect people with relevant ideas. We are looking for a Staff Machine Learning Engineer to advance how we develop those capabilities through agentic AI.

Your primary focus will be Reflex, our effort to automate and accelerate recommendation research and development. You will own a major technical area, building agents that investigate opportunities, implement changes, run experiments and learn from their results. You will work closely with other technical leaders while remaining hands-on with the hardest engineering and modeling problems.

You will also contribute to generative retrieval, with a particular focus on Semantic IDs: learning structured representations of content that recommendation models can generate and use to retrieve relevant items. This role combines applied AI research, production engineering and technical leadership, with opportunities to improve both our recommendation models and the way engineers build them.

What you'll do:

  • Own and advance a major technical area in automated recommendation research within Reflex, collaborating with other technical leads and partner teams.
  • Build LLM agents that connect hypothesis generation, implementation, experiment execution, evaluation and learning from previous results.
  • Develop rigorous evaluations for agent behavior and research outputs, and use them to improve quality, reliability and efficiency.
  • Contribute to generative retrieval models, particularly Semantic ID learning, evaluation and integration into production recommendation systems.
  • Take promising ideas from research and prototypes through offline evaluation, online experimentation and production launches.
  • Build reliable integrations with ML development infrastructure and make informed tradeoffs across model quality, iteration speed, compute cost and operational complexity.
  • Raise technical quality through hands-on implementation, design and code reviews, documentation and mentorship.
  • Work with research, recommendation and ML infrastructure teams to shape technical approaches, resolve dependencies and support adoption.
  • Identify and apply relevant advances from research, and contribute new methods where existing approaches fall short.

What we're looking for:

  • Bachelor's in Computer Science, Machine Learning or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Minimum 8 years of experience building and shipping ML or AI systems, including substantial hands-on engineering and technical leadership.
  • Demonstrated experience building LLM agents or other agentic AI systems for complex tasks, with a clear approach to evaluating and improving their performance.
  • Strong ML fundamentals and depth in one or more relevant areas, such as applied LLMs, representation learning, recommendation systems, retrieval or ML systems.
  • Experience taking research ideas into reliable production systems and evaluating their impact through meaningful experiments.
  • Strong software engineering skills, including the ability to design maintainable systems, implement difficult components and conduct thorough technical reviews.
  • Experience leading a substantial technical area, making decisions under ambiguity and collaborating effectively across teams.
  • A track record of mentoring engineers and raising the quality of a team’s technical work.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to different audiences.
  • A disciplined approach to using AI in your own work, including verification of generated code, analysis and conclusions.

We'll teach you our stack and our products, and we're committed to your continued growth as a technical leader. This is an individual contributor role; prior people management isn't required.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Bioinformatics
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a Senior Engineer on the Life Sciences team, you'll build biology software that our own scientists and the wider research community can depend on, and you'll be one of the main people representing that work to computational biologists outside Anthropic.

The Life Sciences team works to accelerate progress in biology with AI, combining frontier models with hands-on computational and experimental research. We want the tools, pipelines, datasets, and benchmarks we build in genomics and structural biology to be useful beyond our own projects, so we plan to release them to the community. Computational biology has a long tradition of open, shared software, and we want to contribute to it well. Every release should be something a researcher can install, run on their own data, and trust: correct on real inputs, validated against reference data and established methods, documented, versioned, and maintained after launch.

You'll own that standard. You'll write a large share of the code yourself, decide when something is ready to ship, and stay with it once people start using it. You'll also be an active member of the biology software community: maintaining public repositories, answering issues, speaking at conferences and workshops, and bringing what you hear from researchers back into what we build next.

We use Claude and AI coding agents heavily to build software, and we expect you to do the same across design, implementation, testing, and review. Code written by an agent is held to the same standard as code written by hand: you should understand it, test it, and measure its performance before it ships. We're looking for someone with deep software engineering experience who already works this way.

The shape of the role is flexible. You might spend most of your time as an individual contributor, or you might lead a small group of engineers and scientists while continuing to contribute directly. Your focus can be genomics, structural biology, or both. Experience in other areas of computational biology is welcome, and we expect the work to range more widely over time. 

What matters most is a record of biology software that other people have adopted and relied on.

This is a chance to shape how AI is put to work in biological research, on problems that matter for human health and scientific understanding. If building software that scientists trust is the work you want to do, we want to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain biology software in genomics and structural biology (libraries, command-line tools, pipelines, datasets, and benchmarks) for use by researchers and AI agents, inside Anthropic and externally

  • Own the path from research code to public release, including testing, validation against reference data and established tools, benchmarking, documentation, and packaging, and make the call on when something is ready to ship

  • Maintain what we release: triage issues, review outside contributions, and manage breaking changes

  • Represent the team in the biology community through conferences, workshops, tutorials, and direct work with researchers and maintainers, and turn what you learn about their needs into priorities for the team

  • Partner with the team's computational and experimental scientists to turn research code into well-tested, reusable software

  • Lead the technical direction of the projects you own through design review, code review, and mentoring, and, depending on your interests and the team's needs, lead a small team

  • Build with Claude and AI coding agents as your default way of working, hold agent-written code to the same standard as your own, and set the team's practices for reviewing and validating it

Minimum qualifications

  • Have built, released, and maintained biology software that researchers outside your own group use, with evidence of adoption you can point to (for example public repositories, package downloads, citations, or use in other groups' pipelines)

  • Have deep working expertise in genomics or structural biology, including the data types, file formats, standard tools, and common failure modes of at least one of these fields

  • Are proficient in Python and comfortable working with large datasets in Linux and cloud or cluster computing environments

  • Practice rigorous testing and release engineering: unit and integration tests, continuous integration, validation against reference data, packaging, and versioning

  • Use AI coding tools as a central part of how you build software, and can show how you verify the correctness and performance of code you did not write by hand

  • Have led a technical project with multiple contributors, setting direction and reviewing others' work while continuing to write code yourself

  • Can explain technical work clearly to both biologists and engineers, in writing (documentation, tutorials) and in person (talks, workshops)

Preferred qualifications

  • Depth in both genomics and structural biology

  • A record as the creator or a core maintainer of a widely used open-source tool in computational biology

  • Experience managing or formally leading a team of engineers or scientists

  • A graduate degree in computational biology, bioinformatics, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent experience

  • Proficiency in a systems language such as Rust, C++, or C, and experience with performance work on large biological datasets

  • Experience building software in other areas of computational biology, such as phylogenetics, proteomics, cheminformatics, or high-throughput screen analysis

  • Experience shipping software built largely with AI coding agents, building agentic systems on large language models, or training machine learning models on biological sequence or structure data

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$300,000—$320,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.

jobs.title: Design Criteria Engineer (Starshield)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

DESIGN CRITERIA ENGINEER (STARSHIELD)

Starshield leverages SpaceX’s Starlink technology and launch capability to support national security efforts. While Starlink is designed for consumer and commercial use, Starshield is designed for government use, with an initial focus on earth observation, communications, and hosted payloads. On the Starshield Design Criteria Engineering team, you will ensure that our satellites achieve mission success with high reliability. This team draws from diverse engineering backgrounds to become deeply familiar with hardware from the vehicle system to individual components. As a design-focused member of this team, you will apply your technical expertise from initial conception of major design revisions and define the path through design maturation, validation, safe launch, and initial operation in orbit. This high-impact phase rewards creativity and innovation but demands foresight and mitigation of risks along the way. We are looking for passionate engineers with excellent technical fundamentals who thrive in fast-paced development environments to deliver rigorous improvements to the way we develop satellites.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop and own design criteria, requirements, and verification approaches for new satellite systems. Continuously improve these processes with stakeholder engagement.
  • Perform critical peer review of hardware designs during design reviews, and of acceptance and qualification test campaigns, and approve plans based on the strength of technical justification that hardware is ready for launch.
  • Guide engineers through the SpaceX design process and ensure design criteria/requirements are being followed for satellite design, manufacturing, and test activities.
  • Provide development input such as analysis or test recommendations on a wide range of engineering problems encompassing electrical, structural, and radio frequency systems.
  • Leverage involvement in broad spectrum of development efforts to be an expert resource for defining vehicle maturity status in key program reviews and communications.
  • Proactively identify development risks, then implement and track mitigation plans.
  • Develop and own long-term strategy to enable satellite and infrastructure changes, while providing daily engineering support and surge coverage for critical issues.
  • Leverage comprehensive expertise in the satellite system architecture to ensure vehicle-wide and atomic changes improve rather than degrade the satellite.
  • Review analysis and test validation approaches across a range of disciplines including electrical, mechanical, and radio frequency systems to build strong justifications for all changes.
  • Own configuration management for the satellites to ensure bill of materials accuracy for both as-designed and as-built configurations and all changes therein.
  • Provide critical input to ensure change implementation across the fleet of satellite variants is efficient and practical; ensure scope and impacts across design, manufacturing, supply chain, and test are identified and assigned; and follow-up to confirm thorough closure.
  • Serve as the primary expert for tracking and conveying history of all changes and other system-level considerations in key program reviews and investigations.
  • Develop specialized tools that enable design, analysis, and milestone tracking.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline.
  • 1+ years of experience in an engineering role (professional, project team, internship, or extracurricular experience all apply).

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Advanced degree in an engineering discipline.
  • 5+ years professional experience in an engineering role (design, analysis, test, or manufacturing).
  • Ability to be self-motivated in a demanding start-up atmosphere.
  • Experience with aircraft, launch vehicles, spacecraft, or other aerospace systems.
  • Experience with electrical or mechanical system design, analysis, testing, and fabrication for use in safety-critical or high-manufacturing-rate applications.
  • Experience with make versus buy decisions for system components.
  • Scripting and data analysis experience using Visual Basic, SQL, Matlab, Python, or Excel.
  • Experience in using or maintaining enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organization, attention to detail, and thoroughness.
  • Must have an ongoing drive for continuous improvement in all aspects of work.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Active Top Secret, Top Secret SCI, OR ability and willingness to obtain a Top Secret clearance is desired but not required. An active clearance may provide the opportunity for you to work on sensitive SpaceX missions; if so, you will be subject to pre-employment drug and random drug and alcohol testing.
  • Ability to work extended hours and weekends as necessary.
  • Ability to travel up to 10% of the time.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $100,000.00 - $130,000.00
Level 2: $115,000.00 - $160,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

Those with an active clearance will receive a 10% differential, up to an additional $20,000 annually, once officially briefed into a classified program.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Forecasting & Real-Time Optimization
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive. 

Marketplace teams are at the heart of Lyft’s products and decision-making. We’re looking for passionate, driven engineers to build systems that empower our users (both drivers and riders) to make the most effective use of Lyft’s products and experiences by making them more predictive, personalized, and adaptive. The ideal candidate enjoys solving problems with distributed computing for ML and forecasting models, and finding patterns and insights in real-world data while building reliable systems, and is excited about working in a fast-paced, innovative, and collegial environment.

The Forecasting and Real-Time Optimization Platform (FORTOP) team in Lyft’s Rideshare Experience & Marketplace (REM) org provides reliable, real-time market supply and demand signals and forecasts that power the systems making critical automated decisions for Lyft’s business. These signals feed many of Lyft’s most important marketplace products, including Dynamic Pricing, Real-Time Supply Management, Fulfillment, and more.

As a Senior Software Engineer on FORTOP’s forecasting team, you’ll lead the design and operation of the production systems that turn streaming marketplace data into accurate, reliable forecasts: real-time feature pipelines, model training and inference infrastructure, backtesting and evaluation tooling, and the serving layer that downstream products query continuously. You’ll work closely with our scientists to take models from prototype to production, and with downstream teams to define the contracts and reliability guarantees they build on. The work involves forecasting both rider demand and driver supply as they shift with traffic, holidays, and major events, and keeping systems correct and fast during the peaks when they matter most.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead projects end to end: Drive multi-engineer projects from proposal and technical design through launch. Break work into milestones, align dependencies with partner teams, and own estimates.
  • Architect ML systems: Design and evolve streaming feature pipelines, training and inference workflows, and signal serving, and lead design reviews with attention to latency, correctness, scalability, and cost. Reduce complexity by consolidating or sunsetting components.
  • Partner with science to ship: Partner with scientists to design/productionize ML models. Build the rollout tooling (shadow, canary, rollback) and the backtesting and experimentation infrastructure that make launches safe and fast.
  • Own signal contracts: Define and maintain the interfaces, data contracts, and SLAs between forecasting signals and downstream consumers such as Dynamic Pricing and Driver Incentives.
  • Operate what you build: Monitor system health (latency, freshness, error rates) and signal quality (accuracy, bias, drift), and prepare systems for peak events. Take part in on-call, lead post-incident investigations, and drive action items to completion.
  • Code quality: Write well-tested, maintainable code and give code reviews that improve the work of others. Coach teammates on testing and engineering practices.
  • Collaborate across functions: Work with Product, Science, and partner engineering teams to frame problems, shape the roadmap, and make clear tradeoffs between accuracy, latency, and complexity.
  • Grow the team: Mentor engineers, take part in hiring and onboarding, and share knowledge through design docs, runbooks, and tech talks.

Experience:

  • 5+ years of software engineering industry experience, including building and operating backend or data systems in production
  • BS/MS or equivalent in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field or relevant work experience
  • Experience designing and leading delivery of large-scale distributed systems, and owning their reliability through monitoring, on-call, and incident response
  • Solid distributed systems fundamentals: fault tolerance, delivery semantics, and consistency tradeoffs
  • Track record of leading ambiguous, multi-engineer projects and mentoring other engineers
  • Clear written communication, including design docs that align stakeholders
  • Preferred: Experience building production ML models and infrastructure, such as model choice, feature engineering and pipelines, training and inference pipelines, model serving, or ML platforms 
  • Preferred: Hands-on experience with stream or large-scale batch processing (Flink, Beam, Spark, or similar) and distributed messaging (Kafka, Kinesis, or similar) 
  • Preferred: Experience with time series forecasting systems, or familiarity with backtesting and forecast evaluation (error metrics, bias, calibration)
  • Preferred: Experience with online experimentation or real-time decision systems such as pricing, dispatch, or marketplace balancing
  • Preferred: Comfort using AI-assisted development tools to move faster without compromising quality

Benefits:

  • Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled
  • Mental health benefits
  • Family building benefits
  • Child care and pet benefits
  • 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future
  • In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off
  • 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible
  • Subsidized commuter benefits
  • Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership

Lyft is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Lyft highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office 3 days per week on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in-office perks Lyft offers. Additionally, hybrid roles have the flexibility to work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year. #Hybrid

The expected base pay range for this position in the Seattle area is $136,160 - $170,200, not inclusive of potential equity offering, bonus or benefits. Salary ranges are dependent on a variety of factors, including qualifications, experience and geographic location. Your recruiter can share more information about the salary range specific to your working location and other factors during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Customer Solutions Architect (NYC)
jobs.description:

With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

Customer Solutions Architect 

 

About the role

The Customer Solutions Architect (CSA) is the primary post-sales technical owner for our existing customers, helping them get the most value from the combined Fivetran and dbt platform. Working alongside Account Executives (AEs) and Solutions Engineers (SEs), the CSA makes sure customers not only deploy successfully, but keep scaling and expanding their usage over time.

This role operates as a technical account manager and strategic advisor, bridging the gap between onboarding success and long-term growth. The CSA owns the technical narrative after go-live: monitoring an existing book of business, leading technical discussions, uncovering new data challenges, and guiding customers through architecture evolution, adoption, and expansion through live demos and technical workshops.

Unlike implementation-focused roles, the CSA is accountable for both retention and growth, and is measured on incremental ARR, Net Revenue Retention (NRR), and Gross Revenue Retention (GRR). You will act as a trusted advisor, advocate, and accelerator, ensuring customers derive maximum value from their data investments while aligning their technical roadmap with the platform's capabilities.

Location: New York City, NY (hybrid). This is a full-time position, and candidates must be located in the greater NYC area and able to work in the office two days a week (Tuesday and Thursday).

 

What you'll do

Product Adoption and Customer Value Realization

  • Own post-sales technical engagement across a portfolio of assigned Commercial and Enterprise accounts
  • Drive adoption, optimization, and ongoing usage of the platform, moving customers after initial deployment to sustained, scalable success

Expansion and Growth

Stakeholder Engagement and Account Planning

Internal and Partner Collaboration

Thought Leadership

  • Work closely with Regional and Product Marketing teams to support field and industry events

What you bring

  • 2+ years of experience in a post-sales, customer-facing technical role, such as Solution Architect, Technical Account Manager, or Customer Success Engineer
  • Strong ability to own and drive customer outcomes after the sale, including adoption, renewal, and expansion
  • Solid technical background, with experience designing scalable data architectures, a firm understanding of modern data warehousing and the analytics stack, and SQL proficiency
  • Ability to translate business objectives into technical solutions and measurable outcomes
  • Strong stakeholder management skills across technical and non-technical audiences, and a high degree of comfort presenting to diverse audiences
  • A proactive, self-sufficient, and highly organized approach to managing multiple accounts
  • Comfort operating strategically while also engaging in deep technical discussions
  • Ability to operate in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment and think on your feet in customer conversations

What Will Make You Stand Out

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:

As an Account Executive on the Growth team, you will help Dropbox expand how we bring our Product Suite and emerging AI products to new customers.

You’ll work with prospects to understand their needs, learn which use cases resonate, and help create successful outcomes.  You’ll be expected to execute consistently, manage your pipeline effectively, and contribute feedback that helps improve our sales motion, messaging, and approach over time.

jobs.title: Director, Data Science & Engineering, Finance
jobs.description:
Role Description

This is a critical leadership role at the intersection of data science, data engineering, finance, and AI. As Director, Data Science & Data Engineering for Finance, you will lead a small, high-impact team that enables Finance to make better decisions through trusted data, robust analytical systems, applied modeling, and increasingly AI-powered capabilities.

You will manage two direct reports: a data scientist and a data engineer. Together, the team supports the financial organization across recurring business operations, driver-model maintenance, knowledge coordination, analytical insights, and the development and operationalization of AI and machine-learning use cases. The role requires enough technical depth to guide both disciplines, while maintaining a clear focus on business outcomes, reliability, and team growth.

You will partner closely with Finance leadership, Engineering, Data, Product, and other cross-functional stakeholders to establish priorities, improve the quality and accessibility of financial data, and shape a forward-looking roadmap. You will be expected to move the team beyond request-driven execution: identifying the highest-leverage opportunities, clarifying the problems worth solving, and creating the operating mechanisms needed to deliver durable impact.

This is an opportunity to shape how Finance uses data and AI at a time when the underlying technologies, operating models, and expectations are changing quickly. The successful candidate will bring a growth mindset, a strong background in either data science or data engineering, and the ability to lead effectively across both disciplines.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and grow a multidisciplinary team: Lead, coach, and develop a data scientist and a data engineer, creating clear expectations, meaningful development plans, effective delegation, and a strong culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
  • Set the team’s strategy and priorities: Translate Finance and company goals into a focused portfolio of work. Prioritize ruthlessly across strategic initiatives, recurring operational responsibilities, model maintenance, knowledge coordination, and technical debt.
  • Provide technical leadership across data science and data engineering: Guide problem framing, analytical and modeling approaches, data architecture, pipeline quality, testing, monitoring, documentation, and production readiness. You do not need to be the deepest expert in both disciplines, but you must be able to ask the right questions, recognize trade-offs, and raise the technical bar.
  • Advance AI and modeling capabilities: Identify high-value opportunities to apply AI, machine learning, automation, and advanced analytics to Finance workflows. Establish appropriate standards for experimentation, evaluation, interpretability, human oversight, privacy, and ongoing monitoring.
  • Build trusted data foundations: Partner with data engineering and Finance stakeholders to improve source-of-truth datasets, data quality, lineage, observability, documentation, and reliability. Ensure that recurring reporting, driver models, and downstream analyses are based on accurate and well-governed data.
  • Own analytical and modeling outcomes: Ensure the team develops, maintains, evaluates, and improves models and analyses that support financial planning, forecasting, business-driver understanding, and decision-making. Connect technical work to measurable business outcomes rather than treating model delivery as the finish line.
  • Create scalable operating mechanisms: Establish lightweight processes for intake, prioritization, roadmap planning, model and pipeline reviews, incident response, documentation, knowledge sharing, and stakeholder communication. Reduce dependency on individual heroics and make the team’s work easier to understand and extend.
  • Influence Finance and senior stakeholders: Communicate complex data, model, and engineering considerations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Present implications, recommendations, risks, and trade-offs in a way that enables timely decisions.
  • Partner across functions: Work effectively with Finance leaders, analysts, data scientists, data engineers, software engineers, product partners, and executives. Seek diverse perspectives, lead productive debate, and align stakeholders when priorities or approaches differ.
  • Improve the team’s scope and effectiveness: Look continuously for ways to eliminate low-value work, automate recurring tasks, improve service levels, and increase the team’s strategic contribution. When the current operating model is insufficient, make the case for change and lead the team through it

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Significant experience applying data science, machine learning, analytics, data engineering, or a combination of these disciplines to business problems.
  • Experience directly managing and developing technical professionals, ideally including both data scientists and data engineers or closely adjacent roles.
  • A strong professional foundation in either data science or data engineering, with demonstrated ability to work effectively across the other discipline.
  • Experience leading a portfolio of projects from problem definition through delivery, adoption, measurement, and ongoing operation.
  • Experience with data quality, data pipelines, analytical datasets, model development or maintenance, experimentation or evaluation, and production or operational support.
  • Demonstrated ability to use data and technology to influence business decisions and deliver measurable impact.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts, uncertainty, and trade-offs to Finance and executive audiences.
  • Demonstrated growth mindset: actively seeks feedback, learns new technologies and domains, adapts to changing conditions, and creates an environment where the team does the same.
  • Ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy and ownership in an ambiguous, fast-changing environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Finance, financial planning and analysis, forecasting, corporate strategy, accounting, or other business functions with high standards for accuracy and control.

jobs.title: Director of Pricing and Packaging
jobs.description:
Role Description

As Director of Pricing and Packaging at Dropbox, you will lead the strategy that determines how we package, price, and monetize our products across product-led growth (PLG) and sales-led growth (SLG) motions. Reporting to Head of Product Marketing, you will lead a small team and partner closely with Product, Finance, Sales, Marketing, Data Science, and senior executives to make pricing and packaging a durable driver of customer value and profitable growth.

This is a highly visible opportunity to help reinvent Dropbox’s monetization approach as we expand our sales-led business and build for the AI era. You will develop a holistic pricing and packaging architecture across products, customer segments, and routes to market—balancing customer adoption, competitive positioning, revenue growth, cost to serve, and margin. You will translate complex analysis into clear strategic choices, build alignment among senior leaders, and establish the capabilities and operating rhythms needed to make consistently strong monetization decisions.

You will have significant exposure to Dropbox’s senior leadership team and the opportunity to shape some of the company’s most consequential growth decisions. Your work will directly influence how customers experience and value Dropbox, how our products go to market, and how the business grows over the long term.

Responsibilities

  • Define and lead Dropbox’s company-wide pricing and packaging strategy across PLG and SLG motions, customer segments, product portfolios, and geographies.
  • Design the next generation of Dropbox’s packaging and monetization architecture, including approaches for AI-powered products and capabilities, while balancing customer value, adoption, revenue, cost to serve, and margin.
  • Build rigorous business cases and financial models to evaluate pricing and packaging opportunities, incorporating demand, willingness to pay, competitive dynamics, usage patterns, unit economics, and potential customer and revenue impacts.
  • Partner with Product, Finance, Sales, Marketing, Data Science, and Operations leaders to translate strategy into executable plans, including research, experimentation, rollout, enablement, measurement, and iteration.
  • Advise senior executives on high-impact monetization decisions by synthesizing complex quantitative and qualitative evidence into clear recommendations, tradeoffs, and decision frameworks.
  • Establish pricing and packaging governance, operating rhythms, performance metrics, and experimentation practices that improve the quality and speed of decision-making across Dropbox.
  • Lead, develop, and inspire a small team of pricing and packaging professionals while expanding the organization’s broader monetization capabilities.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in pricing, packaging, monetization, growth strategy, strategic finance, product strategy, management consulting, or a related discipline, including substantial experience in B2B SaaS.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and implementing pricing or packaging strategies that produced measurable business or customer outcomes.
  • Experience with both product-led and sales-led business models, including an understanding of their distinct customer journeys, routes to market, and monetization considerations.
  • Experience building pricing business cases and financial models that connect customer behavior and willingness to pay with revenue, cost to serve, unit economics, and margin.
  • Working knowledge of SaaS and AI monetization models, including subscription, seat-based, usage-based, consumption-based, and hybrid approaches.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence executive-level decisions and align senior cross-functional stakeholders around complex, high-impact initiatives.
  • People-management experience, including hiring, coaching, and developing high-performing team members.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading a major pricing or packaging transformation for a multi-product or global SaaS company.
