jobs.title: Integrated Campaign Strategist
jobs.description:
Role Description

Dropbox is hiring an Integrated Campaign Strategist to architect and orchestrate marketing campaigns for priority product launches and evergreen marketing motions. This role turns business priorities, audience insight, and product positioning into a clear campaign strategy that defines the audience, narrative, journey, channel roles, activation sequence, and measurement plan.

You will be the steward of how these campaigns show up in market across owned, earned, and paid channels. Working across Product Marketing, Brand and Creative, Comms, Web, Lifecycle, Paid Media, Content, Events, Marketing Operations, Analytics, and Sales, you will align teams around one integrated plan, connect individual activations into a coherent enterprise buyer experience, and guide the campaign from brief through launch, optimization, and learning.

This is a senior individual contributor role for a strategist who can lead through influence, make tradeoffs in ambiguity, and balance strong market storytelling with measurable business impact. You will help Dropbox bring important product stories to enterprise audiences with greater consistency, relevance, and effectiveness.

Responsibilities

  • Campaign strategy architecture: Translate mid-market and enterprise business goals, product positioning, audience insight, and market context into integrated campaign strategies for key launches and evergreen motions, including objectives, audience, narrative, journey, channel roles, phasing, and measurement.
  • Cross channel orchestration: Build and manage the integrated activation plan across owned, earned, and paid channels so that web, lifecycle, content, social, communications, events, partner, and media programs work as one connected campaign rather than separate channel plans.
  • In-market stewardship: Own the campaign through launch and sustainment, protecting the strategic throughline while ensuring creative, messaging, timing, and audience experience remain coherent across touchpoints and regions.
  • Cross-functional leadership: Establish the brief, operating rhythm, decision rights, milestones, dependencies, and readiness criteria that align Product Marketing, Brand and Creative, Communications, channel owners, Marketing Operations, Marketing Data Science, regional partners, and Sales.
  • Audience and journey design: Define target audiences and buying groups, map the role of each touchpoint across the customer journey, and ensure campaign experiences respond to buyer needs, market moments, and stages of consideration.
  • Performance and optimization: Partner with Marketing Data Science and channel owners to define full funnel success measures, synthesize owned, earned, and paid signals, identify what is driving or limiting performance, and recommend changes to audience, narrative, creative, sequencing, or channel mix.
  • Portfolio learning and scale: Capture campaign insights, codify reusable plays, distinguish enduring strategy from launch specific execution, and apply learning across the enterprise campaign portfolio to improve future launches and evergreen motions.

Requirements

  • 8+ years B2B marketing experience in integrated campaigns, enterprise marketing, product marketing activation, brand to demand, or a related discipline, ideally in SaaS or technology.
  • Direct experience building out campaign strategy and accountable to the outcome (pipeline generation, revenue generation).
  • Demonstrated ownership of complex integrated campaigns from strategy and brief through activation, optimization, and post campaign learning.
  • Strong campaign architecture skills, including audience definition, narrative development, buyer journey design, channel planning, phasing, and measurement.
  • Experience orchestrating owned, earned, and paid programs and understanding the distinct role each plays in building awareness, consideration, demand, and customer growth.
  • Ability to translate product positioning and enterprise customer insight into a cohesive market story and connected audience experience across multiple teams and touchpoints.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Customer Programs
jobs.description:
Role Description

Dropbox is looking for a Senior Program Manager, Customer Programs to lead complex, cross-functional programs that deepen how we engage, learn from, and deliver value to our customers.

This role sits at the intersection of customers, GTM, and Product. You will lead programs that bring customers into important moments across the product and customer lifecycle - from early product learning and customer validation to launches, adoption, advocacy, and strategic customer engagement. You’ll ensure we are engaging the right customers for the right purpose, creating a coordinated experience across Dropbox, and turning what we learn into clear actions for the business.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with significant autonomy and executive visibility. You’ll take high-priority initiatives that often span multiple functions, have evolving requirements, or lack an established operating model and turn them into well-run programs. You’ll define the objective, determine the right program approach, align stakeholders, establish ownership and decision points, manage dependencies and risks, and drive execution through measurable outcomes.

A critical part of the role is representing the customer experience across the entire program, not simply coordinating internal teams. You’ll think deliberately about who we engage, why we are engaging them, what we are asking of them, how Dropbox shows up across touchpoints, and how we close the loop on their participation. The customer should experience one coordinated Dropbox program even when many internal teams are involved behind the scenes.

You’ll work across Sales, Customer Success, Product, Research, Design, Engineering, Product Marketing, Customer Marketing, Analytics, and other teams depending on the program. Over time, you’ll also help Dropbox build more repeatable ways to run customer programs - creating playbooks and operating mechanisms that allow successful approaches to scale without creating unnecessary process.

Responsibilities

  • Lead complex customer programs end-to-end, translating ambiguous business priorities into clear objectives, operating plans, milestones, decision points, owners, risks, and measurable outcomes.
  • Create a coordinated customer experience across Dropbox by partnering with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and other teams to ensure customers receive clear expectations, thoughtful engagement, and appropriate follow-through.
  • Lead large cross-functional teams through competing priorities, dependencies, and ambiguity, driving decisions and accountability without relying on formal authority.
  • Connect customer signal to action by ensuring feedback, behavior, and program results reach the right Product and GTM owners and translate into decisions, changes, or clearly documented next steps.
  • Build practical and scalable program infrastructure - including workbacks, decision rights, readiness criteria, status mechanisms, risk/escalation paths, measurement, and reusable playbooks - while avoiding unnecessary process.
  • Provide clear executive-level synthesis of program health, customer signal, risks, tradeoffs, decisions, and recommendations.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in program management, customer programs, strategy & operations, GTM operations, product operations, or a related field, with demonstrated ownership of complex cross-functional programs.
  • Demonstrated ability to take a highly ambiguous initiative from problem definition through execution, measurement, and outcome, operating independently with limited direction.
  • Experience leading programs involving customers or customer-facing teams, with strong judgment around customer selection, engagement, communications, expectations, and experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple senior stakeholders and functions with different priorities, dependencies, and decision rights while maintaining momentum and accountability.
  • Strong operating judgment: able to determine the appropriate level of structure for a problem, make tradeoffs, simplify where possible, and build repeatable mechanisms where needed.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex qualitative and quantitative information into concise recommendations, decisions, and executive updates.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate as a hands-on senior IC, moving comfortably between strategic problem-solving and the detailed execution required to deliver a program successfully.

jobs.title: Senior Corporate Enterprise Platform Engineer, Windows
jobs.description:
Role Description

As a Senior Client Platform Engineer on CorpFleet Engineering, you will own and improve Dropbox’s Windows endpoint platform. You will bring deep Windows and Intune expertise, make patching and application delivery more reliable, and build automation that reduces recurring work for the team.

This is a hands-on role combining Windows technical ownership with the development of a more code-managed endpoint platform. You will help evaluate and adopt FleetDM, osquery, infrastructure-as-code, and GitOps practices where they improve reliability, visibility, and maintainability. You will strengthen the current environment while building and validating the path forward—not assume that replacing a tool is the answer.

You will work with CorpInfra, IAM, Security, and support teams to make practical technical decisions, lead multi-phase improvements, and clarify ownership. You will also mentor teammates through pairing, code review, and shared operational practices. This is an individual-contributor role, not a people-management position.

Responsibilities

  • Own endpoint reliability and lifecycle management. Improve provisioning, application delivery, updates, security configuration, and troubleshooting across the endpoint environment.
  • Make patching predictable and safe. Strengthen update workflows through testing, controlled rollouts, and remediation.
  • Make fleet health trustworthy and actionable. Improve reporting on device health, patching, and configuration, with clear ownership for resolving issues.
  • Build maintainable automation. Turn recurring work into reliable, tested workflows that other engineers can operate.
  • Advance code-managed endpoint operations. Adopt tools and practices that improve configuration management, validation, and deployment.
  • Lead cross-functional platform improvements. Define practical roadmaps, resolve dependencies, and balance security, reliability, employee experience, and team capacity.
  • Strengthen the team’s capability. Mentor teammates, review code and designs, and document reusable practices that improve coverage across the endpoint team.

Requirements

  • Significant experience engineering and operating Windows endpoint environments, with personal ownership beyond ticket handling or routine console administration.
  • Deep hands-on Intune experience across device lifecycle, configuration and compliance policies, application management, update workflows, and relevant Entra ID dependencies.
  • Strong Windows troubleshooting skills across operating-system behavior, services, logs, networking, certificates, identity, and security controls. Able to distinguish reported management status from actual endpoint health.
  • Recent ownership of Windows and third-party application patching, including staged deployment, user-impact validation, failed-device handling, exceptions, and recovery.
  • Strong practical PowerShell skills and familiarity with at least one additional programming language, such as Python, Go, or C#. Experience building and maintaining production automation or systems integrations.
  • Demonstrated use of version control, code review, automated checks, and controlled deployment for operational changes. Able to explain safe retries, failure handling, secrets management, and configuration drift.
  • Ability to independently define and deliver multi-phase work, prioritize under ambiguity, partner across teams, and mentor other engineers.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including concise technical decisions, incident updates, runbooks, and effective asynchronous collaboration.

As the Senior Manager of Lifecycle Marketing, you will own Dropbox’s lifecycle marketing strategy across onboarding, engagement, retention, monetization, expansion, cross-sell, and re-engagement. You will lead a team of lifecycle marketers and build a portfolio of programs that help customers discover value, expand their use of Dropbox, and deepen their relationship with our products over time.

You will set the lifecycle strategy and roadmap, determine where the team should invest, establish how programs are prioritized and measured, and stay close enough to the work to raise the quality of execution and unblock the highest-priority initiatives.

You will work closely with Product Growth, Product, Product Marketing, Data Science, Marketing Operations, and other marketing teams. Lifecycle Marketing will own customer communication strategy, channel planning, lifecycle program design, and marketing execution.

The opportunity is broader than running an email program. Dropbox has a large global customer base, multiple products, and both product-led and sales-assisted customer motions. The Head of Lifecycle Marketing will define how those pieces connect across the customer lifecycle and build the operating model needed to move from individual campaigns toward scalable growth programs.

jobs.title: Customer Solutions Architect (Denver)
jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

Customer Solutions Architect 

 

About the role

The Customer Solutions Architect (CSA) is the primary post-sales technical owner for our existing customers, helping them get the most value from the combined Fivetran and dbt platform. Working alongside Account Executives (AEs) and Solutions Engineers (SEs), the CSA makes sure customers not only deploy successfully, but keep scaling and expanding their usage over time.

This role operates as a technical account manager and strategic advisor, bridging the gap between onboarding success and long-term growth. The CSA owns the technical narrative after go-live: monitoring an existing book of business, leading technical discussions, uncovering new data challenges, and guiding customers through architecture evolution, adoption, and expansion through live demos and technical workshops.

Unlike implementation-focused roles, the CSA is accountable for both retention and growth, and is measured on incremental ARR, Net Revenue Retention (NRR), and Gross Revenue Retention (GRR). You will act as a trusted advisor, advocate, and accelerator, ensuring customers derive maximum value from their data investments while aligning their technical roadmap with the platform's capabilities.

Location: Denver, CO (hybrid). This is a full-time position, and candidates must be located in the greater Denver area and able to work in the office two days a week (Tuesday and Thursday).

 

What you'll do

Product Adoption and Customer Value Realization

  • Own post-sales technical engagement across a portfolio of assigned Commercial and Enterprise accounts
  • Drive adoption, optimization, and ongoing usage of the platform, moving customers after initial deployment to sustained, scalable success
  • Educate customers on new products and features as they launch, and on existing capabilities they may not be using
  • Deliver enablement sessions, workshops, and best-practice guidance
  • Monitor account health signals (usage, performance, support trends) and proactively intervene to address churn or contraction risks, including running implementation reviews and healthcheck sessions

Expansion and Growth

  • Identify, validate, and execute expansion opportunities across business units, regions, and use cases, including opportunities to bring both Fivetran and dbt into an account
  • Translate customer initiatives into scalable data workloads and technical solutions
  • Partner with account teams to drive incremental ARR through expansion plays.
  • Replicate successful use cases across the organization to accelerate growth
  • Provide strategic input on the customer lifecycle and renewals process

Technical Strategy and Architecture

  • Define and maintain Enterprise Reference Architectures aligned to customer environments, ensuring architectural consistency and scalability across implementations
  • Guide customers on best practices for data pipelines, transformation, automation, and platform adoption
  • Maintain technical artifacts such as architecture documentation, design patterns, and knowledge bases

Stakeholder Engagement and Account Planning

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with technical, operational, and executive stakeholders, using stakeholder maps and multi-threaded engagement strategies
  • Run regular technical cadence calls, business reviews, and roadmap sessions
  • Contribute to Mutual Account Plans and own Mutual Success Plans, mapping whitespace opportunities across business units, subsidiaries, and use cases
  • Align customer technical strategy with business objectives and commercial plans

Internal and Partner Collaboration

  • Act as the technical orchestrator across Sales, Professional Services, Product, and Engineering, keeping delivery teams aligned with long-term expansion strategy
  • Advocate for customer needs internally, influencing the product roadmap and priorities
  • Collaborate with technology partners (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, GCP) to drive joint value

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

The Maneuver Dominance team at Anduril develops operationally relevant, multi-asset autonomy. We are focused on building the next generation of autonomous capabilities by leveraging existing Anduril platforms like Ghost or Altius, bringing 3rd party platforms into Anduril's Lattice ecosystem, and developing breakthrough systems that will shape the future of the battlefield. If you are interested in working in an extremely innovative and fast paced environment, where your work directly makes an impact and difference in the products that are fielded this a fantastic opportunity.

As a Senior UAS Flight Test Engineer you will plan, execute and report on developmental and operational flight Test & Evaluation (T&E) activities. You will work alongside a team of engineers and test specialists assisting in the wider management and coordination of test and evaluation within the US, UK and Europe under both civil and military approval schemes.

What You'll Do

  • Conduct rigorous testing and evaluation of Group 5 UAS to ensure performance and reliability.
  • Deploy to remote test sites within the US, with opportunity to support trials in overseas locations.
  • Participate in weekly stand-ups and provide progress reports to program and T&E leadership.
  • Develop and execute focused test plans for internal and customer trials.
  • Develop and implement baseline safety plans to mitigate risks during testing.
  • Communicate effectively within the team and across the organization.

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical field.
  • 8+ years of experience in UAS integration, testing, and project management.
  • Ability and willingness to travel >75% time to remote locations in the US and overseas.
  • Understanding of the National Airspace System and UAS regulations.
  • Practical experience with large UAS testing and development.
  • Strong grasp of engineering principles and technical concepts.
  • Ability to organize, coordinate work effectively, and document thoroughly.
  • Familiarity with rotary-wing and fixed-wing aerodynamics and flight control systems.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently and in teams.
  • Flexibility to work extended hours as needed.
  • FAA Part 107 certificate holder.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Top Secret security clearance
  • In this role, you will be subject to pre-employment and randomized substance screening, as required by the Company.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in engineering, robotics, computer science, or a related field.

jobs.title: Head of Technology Partnerships
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As Head of Technology Partnerships, you will make Claude's ecosystem of technology partners a primary engine of distribution, customer retention, and product innovation. This is a senior leadership role with no inherited playbook. You are a high agency leader and have a track record of building new functions and capabilities. You will set the strategic technology partner strategy, hold the senior relationships with partner executives, drive high-stakes strategic partnerships, build and scale joint businesses, manage technology partner leads, and drive business impact. You are highly commercial and fluent with technical capabilities. You will collaborate with Sales, Business Development, Product, Applied AI, Partner Programs, and Partner Marketing.

Key responsibilities

  • Set Anthropic's technology partner strategy: priority partners, investment levels, and business goals across strategic partners.
  • Hold the executive relationships with our most strategic technology partners, establish joint business plans, and lead the highest-impact partnerships
  • Define the "better together" story with each strategic partner, including the products, use cases, and industries we will take to market together, the ones we will not, and how we handle overlap between our products and theirs.
  • Create repeatable co-build, co-sell, co-market, and marketplace motions.
  • Shape partnership structures with Business Development and account teams across product integration, commercial terms, distribution, and joint go-to-market, then take accountability for outcomes once agreements are signed
  • Represent technology partners inside Anthropic: shape product requirements for connectors, plugins, and Marketplace, and influence developer experience, partner economics, and program design.
  • Build the measurement system for evaluating partner health and business impact.

Minimum qualifications

  • Have built and led a technology partnerships, alliances, or strategic partnerships function, including hiring and managing partner leads and owning the organization's revenue or consumption target
  • Have personally led strategic partnerships with large enterprise software companies at the executive level
  • Have delivered on complex partnerships that combine product integration, commercial terms, distribution, and joint go-to-market, working alongside legal, finance, and product
  • Understand AI platforms, SaaS and consumption business models, cloud marketplaces, and enterprise go-to-market well enough to design a joint solution with a partner's product and field leaders, and to explain how Claude is embedded in and consumed through a partner's product
  • Have credibility with partner C-level executives and with internal product, engineering, sales, finance, legal, and marketing leaders, and lead through influence in a matrix where account executives own the customer relationship
  • Care about the safe and beneficial development of AI, and want the partnerships you run to reflect that

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience standing up an ecosystem business or partner function from scratch at a high-growth company and scaling it from first hires to a multi-team organization
  • Experience leading partnerships, marketplace, or ecosystem with enterprise SaaS, data platform, or cybersecurity companies
  • Experience building industry-specific or use-case-specific go-to-market plays with a partner and taking them to production at joint customers
  • Working familiarity with how AI applications and agents are built on model APIs, agent SDKs, and the Model Context Protocol
  • 12+ years in technology partnerships, business development, platform ecosystems, or enterprise software, including several leading teams

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$365,000—$425,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

This person will also be responsible for championing the Yext culture!

jobs.title: Asset Protection & Safety Associate I/II - 3rd Shift
jobs.description:
Schedule (Open Availability Highly Preferred):

Sun-Thurs 10PM-6:30AM

Pay Range: $17 hourly

About Carvana

At Carvana, we believe buying a car the old-fashioned way sucks — so we're rewriting the playbook. Yes, we're the vending machine people. Yes, we built that on purpose. And yes, we're just getting started.

We're looking for people who want to thrive in an environment of impactful change. Team spirit shows up in everything we do — every day, our passion and creativity drive the kind of innovation that moves an industry. We take big swings, set ambitious goals, and challenge each other to make data- and process-driven decisions in everything we do. Here are a few of our stories. We've been changing the game since 2013, and we're not letting up. Want the full story? Check it out here.

About the team and position

Our Safe & Secure team is the heartbeat of every Carvana location. You're the people we trust to protect our associates, our customers, and the thousands of vehicles that flow through our gates every day. Rain, shine, ice, or 110° heat — the mission doesn't change, and neither does the standard.

This is a boots-on-the-ground role. We bring the strategy; you bring the hustle. From clearing snow during a winter storm to running heat-safety protocols in July, you'll be the reason our site stays open, safe, and moving. Some days you'll be at the gate — the literal face of Carvana to every associate, vendor, and visitor walking through it. Other days, you'll be out on the lot scanning vehicles, knocking out safety audits, or restocking the supplies that keep this place humming.

You won't just monitor a perimeter — you'll own it. That means spotting hazards before they become incidents, building real relationships with the folks on site, and stepping up when something needs your attention. You'll be trained and trusted to act in emergencies, partner with our Inspection Center and Logistics teams, and feed sharp, accurate intel back to your Safe & Secure leadership. Hourly position, reporting to your Safe & Secure Functional Lead or Manager.

What you’ll be doing

  • Lead with a service-first mindset in every interaction.
  • Live the Carvana values — and make sure they're felt by everyone you work with.
  • Be the face of Carvana at the gate for associates, vendors, and visitors.
  • Communicate like a pro — clear, calm, active listener, no missed signals.
  • Use our Unified Security Platform to monitor live cameras, review footage, and investigate intrusion alerts so nothing on site catches us off guard.
  • When things get hot, keep it cool. De-escalate, win with partners, and remember — we're all in this together.
  • Run point at the gate using the Safe & Secure App (SAS App) and RFID tech, enforcing ingress/egress procedures every single time.
  • Manage and document vehicle movement through the Inspection Center entrance and exit gates.
  • Show up when the team needs you. You'll be trained and certified in first aid, CPR, and AED — and we expect you to use it when the moment calls for it.
  • Know our emergency protocols cold so you can act decisively when seconds count.
  • Keep the site operational in any weather — snow removal in winter, heat-safety protocols in summer, no excuses, no shortcuts.
  • Drive a safety-first culture by spotting environmental hazards, running safety audits, and reinforcing best practices with the people around you.
  • Scan thousands of vehicles a day to keep operational flow tight — between mobile rover tech and manual handheld scans, every car gets accounted for.
  • Cover ground. This role involves serious walking to reach restricted or hard-to-access areas of the lot.
  • Run vehicle location research and deliver clean, detailed reports to leadership when operational questions come up.

Key Metrics: 

  • Unit Loss Rate versus Plan
  • Safe & Secure App Execution
  • Inventory Control/Accuracy and Tracking 
  • Safety Incident Performance

What you should know/have

  • 1–2 years in a customer service environment
  • Strong verbal and written communication
  • A track record of solid decision-making in a complex, fast-moving environment
  • Ability to build strong working relationships and connect with people quickly
  • Ability to organize, plan, and execute multiple tasks at once in a fast-paced setting
  • Ability to handle conflict in a positive, productive way

We’d love it if you also have

  • Familiarity with CCTV, RFID, Card Access, or other Safe & Secure technology
  • Previous experience supporting an OSHA / Safety Team program
  • Experience with crisis prevention and/or response plans

What we’ll offer in return

  • Full-time hourly position with a competitive wage
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
  • 401(k) with company match
  • A stack of perks — student loan support, vehicle discounts, pet benefits, and a lot more
  • A wellness program built to keep you healthy, physically and mentally
  • Real opportunities to grow your skills and share what you know across the org
  • A promote-from-within culture with a startup feel — career paths can move fast around here
  • A seat at one of the fastest-growing companies in the country

Other requirements

To do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you:

  • Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English
  • Must be at least 18 years of age
  • This position is designated as a safety-sensitive position
  • Must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently; the majority of lifting from knee to shoulder heights; other lifting required from various levels
  • Must be able to carry and transport up to 60 pounds up to 20 feet
  • Requires standing for extended periods of time with frequent stretching, reaching, walking, stooping, pushing, and/or pulling in an environment that may be cold, hot, noisy, and wet, and may have fumes or odors due to vehicle maintenance
  • Requires excellent visual acuity and manual dexterity
  • Requires use of safety equipment that may include, but is not limited to, face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment
  • Requires frequent driving and computer data entry
  • Must adhere to regular and predictable attendance
  • The facility is a 24/7 operation, and gates must be manned at all times

Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

Legal stuff

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check.  This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer.  All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.  Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any protected category.

Please note that this job description is not intended to be a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

jobs.title: Assistant Site Manager, DashMart - [Charlotte, NC]
jobs.description:
About the Team

DashMart is a local-fulfillment center owned and operated by DoorDash, offering customers household essentials and other items to their doorsteps with speed, reliability, and quality. 

About the Role

In this role, you’ll work within a 5-15k sq ft distribution center, will assist in leading the local warehouse operating team, and in some locations, includes preparing food in a light-prep kitchen, and help the Site Manager ensure we maintain high quality for our customers. 

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Lead: You’ll demonstrate compassion and commitment to inclusivity as you lead a team of hourly Operations Associates and Shift Leads. You’ll hire, coach and develop high-performing team members, while building a safety-first culture where employees are excited to drive success, personally and for the team. You’ll serve as a leading change agent for your site, helping your team to navigate new initiatives and growth projects. You’ll tackle onsite escalations, including coordination with cross-functional partners. 
  • Operate: With your thumb on the pulse of all outcomes for your team, you will be directly responsible for driving results in one or more specific focus areas or a specific shift for your site. To achieve your performance targets, you’ll drive success through effective scheduling and by executing inventory management processes and deploying best practices from across the network. You’ll engage cross-functional partners as needed for support. 
  • Strategize: Within the focus area(s) assigned by your Site Manager, you’ll analyze data and make strategic recommendations and execute actions regarding resource allocation, workflow, warehouse organization and when to engage cross-functional partners. You may also lead some process improvement projects. 
  • Delight: We are customer-obsessed. You’ll coach and empower your team to provide a highly quality customer experience with every order. Quality metrics such as order accuracy and fulfillment speed will be key measurements of success for your team. You’ll also work cross-functionally with central teams from our inventory to training teams to ensure your team has the tools and resources they’ll need to deliver. 

We’re excited about you because… 

  • You’re a proven leader. You have managed high-performance teams of 5+ employees with successful performance and employee development outcomes.
  • You relish ownership. You’re excited to have ownership in a new and rapidly growing business. No problem is too big or too small for you, and you’re ready to show up however needed for your team. 
  • You solve problems from first principles.  You’re excited to solve problems in innovative ways, and you resist “this is how it’s always been done” thinking.
  • You’re unafraid of ambiguity.  Rapid change and learning is exciting to you, and you thrive in ambiguous, startup environments.
  • You’re analytical. You let data win arguments. You are a data-first problem solver and you have experience using Excel or Google Sheets to analyze data, including using basic formulas and creating pivot tables. 
  • You have 3+ years’ experience: In Operations, Warehouse Logistics, Customer Service, Retail Management, Fulfillment, or related field
  • You have 1+ years of experience managing a team 
  • You have flexibility in your schedule. As the leader of the site, you will need to ensure your team and the site is fully supported, which will include regularly scheduled late-night and weekend hours.

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See below for paid time off details:

  • For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.
  • For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).
The national base pay range for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.
$56,200—$82,700 USD

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Statement of Non-Discrimination: In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital/domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on “protected categories,” we also strive to prevent other subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (i.e., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non-binary or gender non-conforming, LGBTQIA+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. Thank you to the Level Playing Field Institute for this statement of non-discrimination.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation.

If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.

Notice Regarding Use of AI and Automated Tools: To streamline our hiring process, DoorDash utilizes an automated recruitment tool called Metaview.

How it works: Metaview assists our recruiting team by evaluating job related qualifications and characteristics in connection with hiring. The tool is designed and used to support - rather than replace - human decision-making; trained personnel make final decisions with meaningful human review and oversight, and DoorDash does not use Metaview or other AI-enabled tool  in a manner that has the effect of subjecting applicants or employees to discrimination based on any protected characteristic or proxy or for engaging in any protected activity under applicable law.

Data Retention, Privacy & Bias Audit: Data collected during this process is retained in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy https://help.doordash.com/en-us/legal/article/ax-privacy-notice and applicable state laws. About Descript

Descript makes audio and video creation as simple as editing text. Creators, teams, and enterprises use Descript to record, edit, and collaborate on podcasts, marketing videos, learning content, and more. We’re building tools that remove the friction from multimedia production so anyone can tell their story.

The role

As an early-to-mid level AI Growth Specialist (BDR) at Descript, you’ll be on the front lines of growth: sourcing and qualifying new business opportunities, building relationships with buyers across modern media, marketing, and enterprise teams, and creating pipeline for our Account Executives. You’ll be measured on activity, pipeline, and hand-offs that turn into closed revenue.

This role is highly cross-functional — you’ll work closely with Marketing, Account Executives, Customer Success, and Product to refine messaging, target the right buyers, and iterate on playbooks that scale.

What you’ll do

  • Drive outbound prospecting through email, phone, social (LinkedIn), and inbound follow-up to generate qualified meetings for the AE team.
  • Execute targeted cadences that combine personalization and scale; own the top of funnel for assigned segments.
  • Qualify deals against MEDDPICC , build and maintain a healthy pipeline, and pass consistently high-quality opportunities to AEs.
  • Hit weekly / monthly activity and pipeline targets (calls, emails, meetings, SQLs).
  • Use CRM and sales engagement tools (Salesforce / Unify / Apollo / LinkedIn Sales Navigator) to track activity and report on funnel metrics.
  • Collaborate with Marketing to test and optimize messaging, campaigns, and inbound conversion flows.
  • Be the voice of the customer — share insights about buyer pain points, competitive signals, and feature requests to Product and GTM teams.
  • Help evolve playbooks and onboarding materials for future SDR hires.

What we’re looking for

  • 1–3 years of work experience (SaaS, AI or Investment Banking experience strongly preferred).
  • Demonstrated success in outbound prospecting and meeting generation for quota-driven teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills — you can write crisp, human outreach and confidently lead discovery conversations.
  • Comfortable with high activity levels and a metrics-driven approach to improvement.
  • Experience using a CRM and sales engagement tools; comfortable learning and adopting new tooling and processes.
  • Grit, curiosity, and the coachability to iterate quickly on feedback.
  • Ability to learn our core systems to find targets within our existing customer database
  • Passion for creators, video, audio, or modern content workflows is a big plus.

Nice to have

  • Experience selling to marketing, learning & development, product, or media teams.
  • Familiarity with audio/video creation workflows or interest in multimedia production.
  • Prior experience in a startup or high-growth environment.
  • Knowledge of prospecting at enterprise accounts and navigating complex buying groups.

What success looks like (first 3–6 months)

  • Consistently hitting activity and meeting targets and contributing a predictable pipeline to the AE team.
  • Developing strong, scalable cadences that increase conversion rates from outreach → meeting → SQL.
  • Showing strong product knowledge and independently handling discovery calls with high lead quality.

  • Manager / hiring team interview (role fit & experience).
  • Live or recorded roleplay / sales exercise.
  • Final conversation with leadership or cross-functional partner.
  • Offer.

jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Solutions Architecture team works with our largest, most complex users to understand their technical requirements and map those to Stripe technology.

As a Solutions Architect, you will partner with Sales to technically qualify new business opportunities, demonstrate the art of the possible with the Stripe Platform, and design robust technical solutions to enable payment transactions, manage money movements and simplify financial operational processes.

What you’ll do

You are an experienced technologist with a blend of technical depth and strong business consulting skills. You can write code, but prefer to spend your time working with users to create Stripe solutions to support customer business objectives in complex, mission critical environments. You will think strategically about the art of the possible for the user’s business, and be able to clearly articulate that in a way that informs and builds confidence in Stripe’s technology.

You should be able to engage and motivate cross-functionally both internally and within our customer’s organisations at all levels, from Cx to Product Engineering. You will have a track record of delivering exceptional customer results as part of a pre-sales team, but a history of deep technical work that gives you the ability to be credible with any audience.

  • Lead technical discussions and solution deep dives with users on the value Stripe can provide to them.
  • Serve as an advocate for your customers internally, to ensure their needs are represented with product engineering and to influence product direction and priorities.
  • Create technical content (reference architectures, demos, etc.) to share with users as well as speak as a thought leader at industry conferences.  

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 7+ years work experience or equivalent in any mixture of roles including pre-sales, technical architecture (application, technical, systems, integration), technical consulting, application delivery or technical engineering role, with at least 2 years in a customer facing pre-sales role.
  • Possess strong technical knowledge in software architecture, have breadth across technology stacks with deep hands on skills, and comfortable talking about technical concepts and explaining how they work, both from a product feature and API architecture perspective.

  • Experience with large enterprise customers.
  • Strong verbal and written communication abilities, including presenting to large audiences in both German and English.

Preferred qualifications

  • A background in payments systems and e-commerce solutions is a plus but not a requirement.

jobs.title: Senior Production Material Planner, Energy Storage
jobs.description:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

Position Summary:

The Senior Production Material Planner is a career-level role that owns material planning for assigned electronics and mechanical commodities supporting battery energy storage system (BESS) production. The role converts production schedules into supply requirements through MRP, manages planning parameters and master data, and drives suppliers to deliver against the build plan. Working with Supply Chain, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Finance, the role identifies material constraints early, resolves shortages, and manages the inventory impact of engineering changes and new product introduction builds. 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead material planning for assigned electronics and mechanical commodities, translating production schedules and demand into MRP-driven supply requirements
  • Maintain planning parameters and master data (lead times, lot sizes, safety stock, bills of material) to reflect supplier capability and meet inventory, service level, and cost targets
  • Perform daily supply and constraint management, including clear-to-build and run-out analysis, and resolve shortages and exceptions ahead of the build schedule
  • Serve as the primary interface with assigned suppliers on delivery status, schedule changes, and issue resolution, escalating to Global Supply Chain Management, Quality, or Engineering when required
  • Manage engineering changes and product transitions to minimize excess and obsolete inventory and maintain continuity of supply
  • Support new product introduction builds by confirming material readiness from prototype through production ramp
  • Develop, track, and report material KPIs (clear-to-build, days on hand, excess and obsolete inventory, supplier on-time delivery) to Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Finance

Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of material planning, production planning, or supply chain experience (3+ years with a Master's degree), ideally in high-volume electronics, automotive, or battery manufacturing
  • Working knowledge of MRP/ERP systems, bills of material, and discrete manufacturing planning processes
  • Working knowledge of electronics and mechanical components such as PCBAs, harnesses, busbars, and machined parts
  • Proficiency in Excel and data analysis for clear-to-build, run-out, and inventory analysis
  • Ability to manage supplier relationships and secure delivery commitments from domestic and international suppliers

 

The position is full-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

AI is rapidly transforming the world. As generative AI reshapes industries, teams need powerful ways to monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize their AI systems. That’s where we come in. Arize AI is the leading AI & Agent Engineering observability and evaluation platform, empowering AI engineers to ship high-performing, reliable agents and applications. From first prototype to production scale, Arize unifies build, test, and run in a single workspace, so teams can ship faster with confidence.

Arize serves a rapidly growing customer base of 150+ leading enterprises and Fortune 500 companies. Customers like Booking.com, Uber, Siemens, and PepsiCo leverage Arize to deliver AI that works.

About Arize AI

Arize AI is an AI observability and evaluation platform helping teams build, evaluate, and improve AI applications and agents. From development through production, Arize gives AI engineering teams the tools to understand how their systems perform, identify failures, and continuously improve their applications.

Our ecosystem includes Arize AX, our managed platform for AI observability and evaluations, and Phoenix, our open-source platform built for AI engineers.

About the Role

We're looking for a Director of Content & Editorial to lead how Arize educates, engages, and builds trust with the AI engineering community.

The AI engineering market is moving quickly. Developers are building increasingly sophisticated agents, enterprises are deploying AI into production, and teams are looking for practical guidance on how to evaluate, observe, and improve these systems.

Arize is at the center of these conversations. We have deep technical expertise, strong engineering perspectives, and a growing ecosystem of builders using our products.

Your job is to turn that expertise into content that people genuinely want to read, watch, share, and learn from.

This is a hands-on editorial leadership role. We're not looking for someone who only manages a content calendar or delegates writing. We need an exceptional writer and editor who can develop a content strategy, work directly with technical subject matter experts, produce outstanding content, and build a scalable editorial program.

You'll own Arize's editorial direction across technical education, industry thought leadership, product storytelling, executive perspectives, and customer content.

What You'll Do

Own content and editorial strategy

  • Develop and execute a content strategy that builds Arize's authority in AI observability, agent evaluations, and the broader AI engineering ecosystem.
  • Establish clear editorial priorities for developers, AI engineering teams, AI product leaders, and enterprise technology buyers.
  • Build and manage an editorial calendar across technical blogs, educational guides, thought leadership, customer stories, newsletters, and other content formats.
  • Identify emerging industry trends and develop distinctive editorial perspectives that position Arize as a trusted voice.
  • Maintain high standards for technical accuracy, clarity, originality, and editorial quality.

Create technically credible content

  • Personally write, edit, and produce high-quality technical and strategic content.
  • Partner directly with engineers, researchers, PMMs, DevRel, and executives to develop content grounded in practical experience.
  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear, useful material without oversimplifying them.
  • Develop technical tutorials, explainers, deep dives, and educational resources that help developers solve real problems.
  • Build original content around product innovation, engineering insights, and emerging approaches to agent evaluation and observability.

Build thought leadership and industry authority

  • Work closely with Arize's founders and technical leaders to develop original perspectives on the future of AI engineering.
  • Identify opportunities for industry commentary, research, opinion pieces, and technical thought leadership.
  • Partner with Marketing and DevRel to amplify important ideas through publications, social channels, podcasts, speaking opportunities, and community engagement.
  • Develop content that earns attention and credibility rather than relying on promotional messaging.

Partner on SEO, AEO, and content distribution

  • Collaborate with Growth and SEO/AEO to identify high-value topics, content gaps, and opportunities to improve search and AI-answer visibility.
  • Own the editorial quality and development of content designed to support organic discovery.
  • Refresh and improve existing content to maintain relevance, accuracy, and authority.
  • Build distribution strategies that extend the reach of high-value content across web, email, social, and partner channels.
  • Use performance data and audience feedback to inform editorial decisions.

Build a scalable content operation

  • Manage freelance writers, editors, and other external content resources.
  • Develop clear editorial workflows that enable consistent, high-quality publishing.
  • Establish effective processes for working with technical subject matter experts.
  • Prioritize content based on audience value, strategic relevance, and business impact.
  • Partner across the marketing organization to support campaigns, launches, events, and major company initiatives.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years of experience in content, editorial, technical writing, or content marketing, including ownership of editorial strategy.
  • Exceptional writing and editing skills, with a portfolio demonstrating technical depth and clear thinking.
  • Experience producing content for developers, engineers, or highly technical B2B audiences.
  • Strong understanding of AI development, developer tooling, cloud infrastructure, or related technical markets.
  • Proven ability to interview technical experts and turn complex ideas into authoritative content.
  • Experience building editorial programs across multiple formats and distribution channels.
  • Understanding of SEO and how editorial content contributes to organic discoverability.
  • Experience managing freelancers, agencies, or small editorial teams.
  • Strong editorial judgment and the ability to balance technical credibility, audience interests, and business priorities.
  • Comfortable operating as both a strategic leader and an individual contributor.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on familiarity with LLM applications, AI agents, agent evaluations, and observability.
  • Experience at an AI infrastructure or developer tools company.
  • Experience writing technical tutorials or documentation-adjacent educational content.
  • Experience developing executive thought leadership and original research.
  • Familiarity with open-source communities and developer-led adoption.
  • Understanding of AEO and how content earns visibility in AI-generated answers.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 6–12 months, you'll have:

  • Established a distinctive, technically credible editorial voice for Arize.
  • Built a consistent publishing program with clear strategic priorities.
  • Produced technical content that engineers trust and return to.
  • Increased the reach and engagement of Arize's thought leadership and educational content.
  • Worked with Growth to increase organic content contribution to qualified traffic and acquisition.
  • Built a reliable network of technical contributors and freelance resources.

 

The estimated annual salary for this role is between $175,000 to $200,000, plus a competitive equity package. Actual compensation is determined based upon a variety of job related factors that may include: transferable work experience, skill sets, and qualifications. Total compensation also includes a comprehensive benefit package, including: medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, unlimited paid time off, generous parental leave plan, and others for mental and wellness support.

More About Arize

Arize’s mission is to make the world’s AI work—and work for people.
Our founders came together through a shared frustration: while investments in AI are growing rapidly across every industry, organizations face a critical challenge—understanding whether AI is performing and how to improve it at scale.

Learn more about what we're doing here:

https://techcrunch.com/2025/02/20/arize-ai-hopes-it-has-first-mover-advantage-in-ai-observability/

https://arize.com/blog/arize-ai-raises-70m-series-c-to-build-the-gold-standard-for-ai-evaluation-observability/

Diversity & Inclusion @ Arize

Our company's mission is to make AI work and make AI work for the people, we hope to make an impact in bias industry-wide and that's a big motivator for people who work here. We actively hope that individuals contribute to a good culture

  • Regularly have chats with industry experts, researchers, and ethicists across the ecosystem to advance the use of responsible AI
  • Culturally conscious events such as LGBTQ trivia during pride month
  • We have an active Lady Arizers subgroup

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships & Integrations
jobs.location: Chicago, IL; Clearwater, FL; Westlake, TX
jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

TradePMR is Robinhood's custody and technology platform for registered investment advisors (RIAs). Our integration ecosystem spans core technology partners, specialized workflow and TAMP partners, and a broader network of consultants, recruiters, and capital providers. You'll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Legal and Compliance, Marketing, Business Development, and the tactical integrations team. It's a collaborative group focused on advisor success and on building partnerships that last!

The Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships & Integrations owns TradePMR's external-facing relationships with technology partners and advisor firms across the integration ecosystem. The tactical integrations team handles vendor onboarding, data feeds, and technical implementation. You'll decide which partnerships matter most and who we should build them with. You'll advise enterprise RIAs and breakaway teams, host partner events, negotiate special agreements, and equip our sales teams with accurate partner collateral. You'll also bring partner and client insight into integration roadmap discussions, shaping priorities through influence and input rather than build ownership. This is a business and partnerships role, not a product or engineering role, and your impact will show up in the strength of our advisor and partner relationships!

This role is based in our Clearwater, FL Chicago IL, and Westlake, TX office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do

  • Serve as a direct advisor to enterprise RIAs and breakaway teams evaluating custody transitions and platform fit
  • Own and run Transition Sandbox walkthroughs, live demo environments for prospective and transitioning firms
  • Act as a trusted point of contact for advisor firms navigating the TradePMR integration ecosystem
  • Build and maintain the Partner Resource Hub, including custodial comparison sheets, integration guides, and platform one-pagers
  • Equip Practice Management and Sales with current, accurate partner and integration collateral, and keep internal teams informed of live and upcoming integrations
  • Own and execute the Center of Influence (COI) engagement cadence, including monthly strategy touchpoints, quarterly briefings, and virtual executive roundtables
  • Stand up and run the COI Advisory Council, spanning consulting, technology, M&A, and recruiting
  • Directly own relationships with core technology partners and specialized workflow and TAMP partners
  • Coordinate with Marketing and Business Development on adjacent COI relationships, such as transition consultants, M&A advisors, capital providers, breakaway recruiters, and compliance consultants
  • Plan and represent TradePMR at flagship partner events, and own regional VIP dinners and executive roundtables, including guest lists, briefing content, and follow-up
  • Negotiate custom commercial terms with strategic partners, such as portfolio-wide custodial fee schedules, custom API reporting SLAs, and enterprise onboarding SLAs
  • Partner with Legal, Compliance, and Finance on sign-off for non-standard agreements, using a template-first approach and escalating to custom terms only where justified
  • Surface partner and client integration requests and pain points into Product and Engineering prioritization discussions
  • Represent the external partner and advisor-firm perspective in integration roadmap planning, and work with the tactical integrations team so strategic priorities turn into executed integrations

What you bring

  • 7+ years in partnerships, business development, or strategic account management, ideally in wealthtech, fintech, or RIA custodial and technology services
  • Demonstrated experience managing external relationships with technology vendors and/or advisor or client firms in a regulated financial services environment
  • Comfort serving as a primary external face for the organization, including event hosting, executive-level relationship management, and negotiation
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working closely with Product, Engineering, Legal and Compliance, Marketing, and technical integrations teams
  • Familiarity with the RIA custodial technology landscape (portfolio management systems, CRM, TAMP, and financial planning tools) is a plus

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.
  • Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.
  • Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. 
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more.
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits.
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. jobs.title: Stylist
jobs.description:
About Stitch Fix, Inc.

Stitch Fix (NASDAQ: SFIX) Stitch Fix is redefining retail by combining human creativity with advanced data science and Generative AI. As we build the future of personalized shopping, we’re equally committed to building yours.  We believe in investing in our team as much as our technology. Join us to be a trendsetter in the industry and help us redefine what’s possible for our clients, while we help you reach your full potential.

About the Role

As a Stylist at Stitch Fix, you’ll help clients look and feel their best by creating personalized style experiences that go beyond the box. You’ll leverage both live and asynchronous messaging to deepen client relationships and drive retention, helping clients build confidence and trust in their personal style.

Your style expertise, warm communication, and ability to create highly personalized experiences will help clients feel like they have a trusted Stylist at their fingertips. Whether you’re offering advice for a special occasion, helping a client complete a look, or introducing new items they’ll love, you’ll deliver joy and style while helping shape the future of the Stitch Fix client experience.

This is a remote, hourly, part-time Flex Tier Stylist role requiring 10–20 hours per week, with scheduling flexibility to align with client demand as directed by Stitch Fix.

Responsibilities

  • Provide expert style guidance across evolving client channels, including messaging, chat, video, and our in-house styling platform, responding to client requests and creating personalized looks that build confidence and trust.
  • Create thoughtfully styled assortments by leveraging client profiles, preferences, past purchases, style goals, and our ever-fresh inventory, crafting unique Fixes that delight and inspire clients across all shapes, sizes, gender identities, style spectrums, occasions, and lifestyles.
  • Build meaningful client relationships through personalized interactions and a public-facing Stylist profile featuring your photo, which helps clients connect with you and may also be used in Stitch Fix marketing to showcase the human element of our service.
  • Deliver against performance, productivity, and client satisfaction goals while identifying opportunities to strengthen client retention and Stylist-client connections and sharing insights with the broader team.
  • Develop your styling expertise by participating in training and regular check-ins, staying current on company updates and fashion trends, and contributing to a supportive, collaborative styling community that embraces diverse styles and continuous feedback.

How AI and tools show up in your day-to-day work

Technology is an important part of how you’ll deliver personalized experiences at scale. You’ll use Stitch Fix’s in-house styling platform and other digital tools to understand client preferences, create personalized recommendations, communicate with clients, and work efficiently in a remote environment.

You’ll be expected to quickly learn and apply new technologies, including evolving AI-enabled tools and features, as they are introduced. You’ll use these tools to improve efficiency and outcomes while applying your own style expertise, judgment, and human connection to create an experience that feels uniquely personal to each client.

About You

This is what you’ll need to succeed in this role from day 1.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of client-facing styling or apparel experience, with enthusiasm for fashion and a demonstrated ability to create positive customer experiences.
  • Demonstrated success meeting or exceeding performance goals in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote environment where business updates, expectations, feedback, and direction are primarily communicated in writing.
  • Comfortable independently reviewing, understanding, and applying written information, staying informed of updates, and proactively seeking clarification when needed.
  • Excellent written communication skills and the ability to build rapport and trust with clients in a virtual environment.
  • Experience and confidence styling across body types, gender identities, lifestyles, style preferences, and occasions.
  • Ability to rapidly adopt new tools, technologies, and processes and integrate them into your workflow with minimal downtime.
