jobs.title: Hardware Reliability Engineer (Build Reliability)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

HARDWARE RELIABILITY ENGINEER (BUILD RELIABILITY)

The Build and Hardware Reliability organization at SpaceX is an inclusive, inter-disciplinary team that is committed to the reliability of flight components and production assemblies. Your breadth of exposure as a Hardware Reliability Engineer will be immense as you collaborate with other core groups at SpaceX, guiding the hardware from design to production and operation. You use data to understand the factors that drive reliability, and support quality objectives in design and development teams to drive improvements in reliability in manufacturing, test and flight. You have the ability to dive deep on the details to identify, understand and solve difficult technical problems and also utilize a system level approach to prioritize issues for the vehicle as a whole. You thrive in a hands-on environment and will spend time in the office, on the factory floor, and in the lab to execute on the mission to make humanity interplanetary.

RESPONSIBILITIES: 

  • Perform detailed failure analysis of avionics hardware, identifying root causes of failures and implementing corrective actions in order to quantify/reduce risk and improve reliability of designs and processes
  • Utilize schematics, test equipment, inspection processes, etc. to perform structured electrical root cause analysis of failures identified during the development and production processes to inform design/manufacturing changes
  • Partner with design, test, and manufacturing through hardware development and production to ensure the reliability of Avionics parts (i.e. flight controllers, signal front-ends, sensors, RF, power systems, solar arrays, wire harnessing, etc.)
  • Work closely with test engineers to maintain a close feedback loop, improving test assets, reducing false failures, and increasing test coverage to avoid escapes
  • Support production and field operations by providing technical guidance on failure resolution, root cause analysis, and reliability improvements
  • Responsible for tracking yield, test/inspection escapes, and ensuring past failures and lessons learned are incorporated into new product development
  • Develop, implement and validate lean test and inspection processes for new and existing products and process, ensuring that criteria are objective and that quality goals are consistently met
  • Partner with design, test, and manufacturing through product development and production to ensure the reliability of Avionics parts (i.e. controllers, RIOs, sensors, RF, power systems, solar arrays, wire harnessing, etc.)
  • Responsible for tracking yield, test/inspection escapes, and ensuring past failures and lessons learned are incorporated into NPI
  • Develop, implement and validate Lean test and inspection processes for new and existing products and process, ensuring that criteria are objective and that quality goals are consistently met
  • Monitor the success of products and processes through production ramp-up using a suite of quality and analysis tools
  • Conduct regular build quality reviews to ensure that design intent is achieved and well-communicated; identify opportunities for risk reduction and removal of complexity in designs and processes to improve manufacturability, collaborating with integrated product teams to drive improvements and address high-impact and repeating non-conformances
  • Investigate failures in production, test and flight, identifying and mitigating the immediate and underlying root causes in order to quantify/reduce risk and improve reliability of designs and processes
  • Utilize schematics, test equipment, inspection processes, etc. to perform structured electrical root cause analysis of failures identified during the development and production processes to inform design/manufacturing changes
  • Perform gage repeatability and reproducibility studies to validate test systems used for product acceptance
  • Contain suspect or known non-conforming product, providing guidance to quality inspectors, technicians, shop supervisors and engineers to assist in quarantining and rework activities
  • Support the shop floor in continuous improvement and the advancing of a Lean, autonomous production system through creation of standard rework/repair guides, removal of redundant or unnecessary inspection, and improved control and optimization of critical processes

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: 

  • Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or computer engineering
  • 1+ years in a manufacturing, quality and/or design engineering role (student project team or internship experience qualifies)
  • 1+ years in hardware development, failure analysis, manufacturing, and/or quality engineering role (student project team or internship experience qualifies)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: 

  • Strong interpersonal and collaborative skills, enthusiasm for the team’s spirit of innovation and mission of improving reliability in cutting-edge technology
  • Hands on experience designing and/or troubleshooting PCBAs
  • Experience supporting production and test of complex electromechanical assemblies
  • Knowledge of quality tools such as Lean principles, measurement systems analysis, design of experiments, statistical process control,, root cause analysis and corrective action, advanced product quality planning (APQP), metrology, process failure mode and effects analysis (PFMEA), control plans, and various problem solving approaches
  • Dedicated to adopting a Lean approach to quality without compromising safety or reliability

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS: 

  • Ability to work extended hours, weekends, and offsite as needed

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $115,000.00 - $140,000.00
Level 2: $135,000.00 - $170,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.  

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

jobs.title: Senior Recruiter, G&A
jobs.description:
About the Role

Together AI is building the AI Acceleration Cloud. We are building an end-to-end platform for the generative AI lifecycle, integrating fast, reliable inference and model-shaping services with cutting-edge AI cloud infrastructure. 

We're looking for an exceptional Senior G&A Recruiter who can help us scale our teams while keeping the bar of excellence high. You'll own end-to-end hiring across our Finance, Legal, and Business Strategy functions, from first conversation through offer close, and partner with G&A leadership to translate ambitious hiring plans into real teams.

This role is based out of our Headquarters in San Francisco.

Responsibilities

  • Own full-cycle strategic recruiting across our G&A organizations. 
  • Partner with our executives and leaders to define hiring strategies, candidate profiles, and interview processes.
  • Manage the candidate journey from sourcing handoff to offer stage, ensuring a seamless and exceptional experience.
  • Provide market intelligence, funnel metrics, and competitive insights to shape hiring strategies and influence decisions.
  • Collaborate with sourcers, coordinators, and recruiters to streamline processes and deliver a consistent, brand-aligned candidate experience.
  • Act as a strategic thought partner to leaders, scaling from concept to execution with data-driven insights, creativity, and sound judgment.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of G&A recruiting experience in high-growth tech environments, especially across Finance, Legal, and Business Strategy functions.
  • Strong ability to build and maintain relationships with leadership and hiring teams.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment with rapidly shifting priorities.
  • Expertise in designing new interview processes and hiring strategies from the ground up.
  • You adapt gracefully under pressure and navigate changing priorities with ease.
  • Ability to do more with less, you thrive in a scrappy environment and you find creative solutions to problems

About Together AI

Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high-performance inference that scales reliably, fine-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier-level specialized models, and pre-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400+ trillion tokens a month.

Compensation

We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance, and other benefits. The US base salary range for this full-time position is: $165,000 - $210,000 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job-related knowledge. 

Application Policy

Please read each role carefully and apply to the position best suited to you. Candidates are limited to 6 applications within a 90-day period, and applications beyond that limit will be automatically rejected. You may apply to additional roles 90 days after your last application.

Equal Opportunity

Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more.

Please see our Privacy Policy at https://www.together.ai/privacy

Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

We're building the next chapter of AI-native craft and creativity - where craft and technology meet. Our unified platform bridges the gap between AI capabilities and human creativity, and lets professional creatives and designers harness the power of the world’s leading AI models without losing precision, expression, or soul. Together, we’re building tools that help people move faster without sacrificing quality, precision, or craft — a platform where AI supports creativity instead of flattening it.

Figma Weave is a startup within Figma, and you will play a key role in winning new business while helping contribute to how our team sells. You will work closely with Figma AEs and cross-functional partners to understand customer needs, demonstrate relevant workflows, and guide opportunities from first conversation through close. This is an opportunity to get hands-on with a fast-evolving product, work with exciting logos as they embrace GenAI, and help shape a growing team.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

What you’ll do at Figma Weave:

  • Create and manage a pipeline of new business through outbound prospecting, inbound engagement, and Figma AE introductions to consistently exceed sales targets
  • Prioritize your book and time to focus on top priorities amongst change
  • Apply effective discovery and value-selling techniques to uncover business challenges, build relationships with key decision-makers, and connect Weave to customer priorities
  • Partner with your customers through demos to help identify high business priority use-cases and inspire what’s possible in Weave. Build your product knowledge through hands-on use of Weave.
  • Manage proposals, business cases, and negotiations, partnering with legal, procurement, finance, Figma sellers, and security teams to move deals forward

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
At Locus Robotics, we build AI-powered systems and intelligent robots that keep global supply chains running. Our platform combines advanced AI, real-time decision-making, and autonomous robotics to help leading companies improve efficiency, scale operations, and adapt to constant change.

Locus Robotics is a place to do meaningful work with real-world impact, where your ideas move quickly from concept to deployment. We invest in our people, encourage continuous learning, and give you the opportunity to grow your career while building technology that is used every day at global scale.

Play a key role in helping our customers succeed with cutting-edge robotics technology. You’ll partner with customers and teams across Locus Robotics to drive adoption, solve challenges, strengthen relationships, and deliver an exceptional customer experience. This high-visibility role is ideal for someone who combines strong project management, training, leadership, and relationship-building skills with a passion for customer success.

This role requires up to 50% US travel to customer sites.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily customer site operations, proactively addressing challenges and ensuring a seamless, high-quality experience.
  • Ensure a successful customer deployment while driving continuous improvement and customer satisfaction
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for escalated technical issues, driving timely resolution and clear customer communication.
  • Coordinate warehouse mapping, preventive maintenance, and system upgrades to maximize system performance and minimize disruption.
  • Own the change request process, aligning customers and internal teams on impacts to scope, schedule, and budget
  • Compile and analyze key performance metrics, including throughput, units per hour (UPH), and lines per hour, to track performance, identify trends, and support customer status reporting.
  • Conduct post-project evaluations to capture lessons learned, celebrate successes, and identify opportunities to improve future customer deployments.
  • Monitor customer site performance to ensure compliance with contractual requirements.
  • Scale system capabilities to support evolving customer needs, operational growth, and long-term success.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, CIS or a related technical field.
  • 5+ years' hands-on experience with 3PL, Warehouse, or logistics operations.
  • Knowledge of networking and network technology, such as routers, WIFI, switches, and firewalls.
  • Ability to communicate technical/complex information both verbally and in writing.
  • Strong ability to manage multiple priorities and respond effectively to urgent or high-pressure situations.
  • Knowledge of and interest in diverse technical topics, including software, hardware, and robotics.
  • Self-motivated and able to solve problems independently and in customer settings.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage with internal and external stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

The expected base salary range for this role is $90,000 - $140,000 annually, based on external market data, plus bonus and equity.  Actual offers will depend on factors such as the candidate’s experience, education, training, key or critical skills, geographic location, and current market and business conditions

Additional Information 

Locus Robotics is an equal opportunity employer.

Hiring decisions are not made solely by automated means unless otherwise disclosed where required by law.

jobs.title: Customer Experience Intern - Part-Time
jobs.description:
Lucid Software is the leader in AI-driven work acceleration, helping teams see and build the future by turning ideas into reality.  Its products include the Lucid Visual Collaboration Suite (Lucidchart and Lucidspark) and airfocus. The Lucid Visual Collaboration Suite, combined with powerful accelerators for cloud and process transformation, empowers organizations to streamline work, foster alignment, and drive business transformation at scale. We hold true to our core values: innovation in everything we do, passion & excellence in every area, individual empowerment, initiative and ownership, and teamwork over ego. At Lucid, we value diverse perspectives and are dedicated to creating an environment and culture that is respectful and inclusive for everyone. Lucid is a hybrid workplace. We promote a healthy work-life balance by allowing employees to work remotely, from one of our offices, or a combination of the two depending on the needs of the role and team.

Lucid Software’s Customer Operations team helps the countless users who rely on Lucid understand how to use our product, and we use the incoming user data to improve the health of these products. We're an operational team that uses both direct support interactions as well as scalable solutions to engage with our global consumers.

Responsibilities: 

  • Manage technical issues by investigating and troubleshooting problems, escalating user issues, managing issue workflows and proactively identifying consumer needs
  • Develop and maintain technical product expertise and work closely with other support and product/engineering team members to resolve user issues
  • Identify and monitor key user operational metrics to help drive improvements to our product and support offerings
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Product Management, Marketing, and other cross-functional peers on specific user-impacting issues and bugs.
  • Assist in writing clear Help Center and user education content
  • Engage with our users in the Lucid Community
  • Assist with the ongoing operations, member administration, and growth of Lucid’s power user and community programs.
  • Investigate and process customer requests for cancellation and refunds over email
  • Resolve customer concerns related to billing such as downgrades, duplicate charges, invoice changes, trial subscriptions, and declined payments
  • Research accounts in which payments have been posted and customer disputes activity
  • Develop a deep understanding of changing product offerings and account types and implement these changes into our billing processes
  • Communicate and follow up effectively with customers in a clear and timely manner

Requirements:

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree with a strong academic performance.
  • A strong sense of personal ownership and responsibility
  • Ability to translate complex technical ideas into simple, easy to understand content
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills (both internally and externally)
  • Ability to work independently, cross-functionally, and on multiple initiatives at the same time with a proven record of driving results
  • Excellent analytical capabilities and problem-solving skills combined with sound business judgment in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities
  • Detail-oriented, organized and a good team player
  • Bias towards finding solutions versus shutting down ideas
  • This position is hybrid, combining remote work with in-person collaboration at our South Jordan, UT office two days per week (Tuesday and Thursday)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience troubleshooting technical issues
  • Experience in content creation
  • Basic data analytics or statistical skills
  • Teaching or mentoring experience

jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role 

We are looking for an Account Executive, Commercial, UK to join our team. This is a greenfield role, reporting to the Sales Director in the Commercial sales department. You will join a global group of professionals passionate about cloud security leadership and driving a secure, cloud-enabled digital future. In this role, you will demonstrate the power and agility of Zscaler cloud transformation by managing a territory focused on net new logos and up-sell opportunities.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Take ownership of an assigned territory focused on net new logo and up-sell opportunities within accounts up to 750 employees
  • Demonstrate expertise in building business cases that clearly show value and differentiation at all levels of customer and prospect organizations
  • Partner effectively with Sales Engineering, Solution Architecture, Value Consulting, and Transformation teams throughout your sales cycles
  • Drive consistent pipeline generation using modern techniques, joint field marketing initiatives, and top-tier channel partners including VARs, SIs, and SPs
  • Execute a disciplined sales process from beginning to end while maintaining a high level of accountability for your territory's growth

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
  • You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
  • At least 1 year of sales experience with a revenue quota, specifically selling to commercial accounts in the UK managing a net new logo territory 
  • History of a consistent track record of over-achievement in net new logo accomplishments and a strong understanding of how to leverage channel partnerships
  • Demonstrated willingness to be coached and the discipline to follow a proven sales process from start to finish
  • Proven ability to lead 'team sales' by effectively utilizing internal resources, partners, and team members to achieve success

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience leveraging AI-powered sales intelligence tools, conversational AI, or predictive pipeline analytics to accelerate commercial deal velocity
  • Previous experience selling security, SaaS, or enterprise software solutions
  • Bachelor's degree in Business or a related field of study

jobs.title: Senior Enablement Manager - API
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

The Enterprise Operations organization is instrumental in powering Airbnb's growth and expansion at a global scale. Through AI- and people-powered operations, this team maximizes the effectiveness, utilization, and impact of our supply, ensuring hosts and guests can seamlessly connect.

The Supply Enablement & Activation team is a horizontal Center of Excellence within Enterprise Operations, serving as a strategic partner to global field and vendor teams by driving standardized strategy, tools, and best practices at scale. We turn our supply strategy into repeatable, scalable, best in class enablement deliverables – collateral, training, tools & workflows, and comms/change management -- for our sales & operator teams across each line of business: Homes, Hotels, Experiences & Services.

This role supports the API team, which sits at the heart of Airbnb's Supply strategy, managing the connectivity partners — property management software providers, channel managers, and distribution platforms — that power a significant share of our global inventory. These partnerships unlock access to millions of listings and directly shape the quality and reliability of the host and guest experience.

At the center of this work are our Connectivity Partner Managers, who own Airbnb's relationships with these third-party technology providers — PMS (Property Management System), channel manager, and revenue management tool vendors that hosts and property managers use to sync listings, calendars, pricing, and reservations with Airbnb. Connectivity Partner Managers are the primary point of contact for these partners: they ensure integrations meet Airbnb's connectivity standards, resolve sync and data issues, onboard new partners, negotiate partnership terms, drive adoption of Airbnb's APIs among software vendors, and work with Product and Engineering to prioritize roadmap improvements based on partner feedback.

The Difference You Will Make

We're looking for a seasoned Senior Enablement Manager to build and own end-to-end enablement for Airbnb's API team and Connectivity Partner Managers across AMER, EMEA, and APAC. This is a newly approved, full-time role created to close a resourcing gap: enablement support for API has historically been covered informally and part-time, and this role will stand up a sustainable, scalable enablement function from the ground up.

The core of this role is to enable our Connectivity Partner Managers to do their jobs more effectively and drive tangible impact. Connectivity Partner Managers own the full relationship with PMS, channel manager, and revenue management tool partners — from onboarding and integration standards to sync/data issue resolution, contract negotiation, API adoption, and roadmap prioritization with Product and Engineering. You will build the onboarding curriculum, training, playbooks, and certifications that ramp new Connectivity Partner Managers; keep them current on product launches, API versions, and roadmap changes; and equip them with the narratives, tools, and processes they need to manage partner relationships and escalations with confidence.

This is a highly cross-functional, more technical role than a typical field-enablement position — it requires deep, ongoing engagement with the Product roadmap and with Connectivity Partner Managers themselves, not a copy-paste of a direct-sales enablement playbook. You will own onboarding, training, and continuous development for teams supporting API partners; drive consistent acquisition, growth, and retention of high-quality supply; and localize global enablement programs for regional relevance. You'll partner cross-functionally to collect and share feedback, and use enablement tools and insights to continuously improve outcomes.

A Typical Day

  • Own end-to-end onboarding and ongoing enablement for Connectivity Partner Managers, Enterprise Account Managers and the broader API Product and Enterprise teams globally across AMER, EMEA, and APAC
  • Build the ramp curriculum, playbooks, and certifications that get new Connectivity Partner Managers and Enterprise Account Managers up to speed on connectivity standards, partner onboarding, sync/data issue resolution, and negotiation processes
  • Partner closely with the API Product team to translate roadmap priorities, new launches, and GTM initiatives into enablement content and training for Connectivity Partner Managers so they are fully equipped with managing partners effectively and shaping their behaviour 
  • Revive and scale partner-facing enablement channels, including webinars/webcasts on product releases and API versions, and enablement newsletters and comms
  • Localize global enablement content, sales pitches, and narratives to reflect regional market needs
  • Design and deliver role-based training programs and playbooks, for Connectivity Partner Management and Homes Enterprise Account Manager teams. 
  • Partner closely with Product, Sales, RevOps, Policy, and regional leaders to align enablement with business priorities
  • Drive adoption of enablement tools (e.g., Highspot, Gong) and translate insights into actionable coaching and performance improvements
  • Lead enablement, including training delivery, for new launches and GTM initiatives in-region
  • Create structured feedback loops to bring Connectivity Partner Manager, field, and partner insights back to central/product teams and incorporate them into training materials
  • Track and report on enablement impact (ramp time, performance, certification, revenue impact)

What Success Looks Like

  • A scalable, repeatable enablement function stood up end-to-end for API Product and Enterprise Enablement
  • Faster ramp time for new hires, with new hires consistently passing mock call certifications post-training
  • Validated, up-to-date sales narratives and pitches in market
  • Land successful API enabled launches inclusive of critical enablement deliverables for reps and connected hosts
  • Improved conversion, retention, and revenue outcomes aligned to annual OKRs
  • Regular, high-quality partner-facing communications (webinars, newsletters) that keep all teams current on product, technical and roadmap changes
  • High quality scores across teams based on recorded call evaluations
  • Strong adoption of enablement tools (e.g., Gong, Highspot) and a well-managed, transparent intake process
  • Trusted partnership with API Product, regional, and global stakeholders
  • Timely reporting and actionable insights that drive performance

Your Expertise

  • 8+ years of professional experience, with at least 5 years in enablement, sales operations, or related roles in a fast-paced global environment
  • Experience creating and delivering agile, AI-powered enablement content — narratives, sales pitches, talking points, objection handling, and standardized playbooks — preferably in the hospitality, travel, or tech industry
  • Experience with API ecosystems, connectivity partnerships, or two-sided marketplace dynamics
  • Comfort operating in a technical, product-driven environment; ability to engage credibly with Product roadmaps and connectivity/API partner managers
  • Strong analytical skills: proven ability to analyze large datasets, synthesize performance trends, and use data tools (Excel, Google Sheets; SQL proficiency strongly preferred) to drive decisions
  • Experience supporting or adapting programs across multiple regions (AMER, EMEA, APAC), with sensitivity to local market and cultural dynamics
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including presentation skills to all levels of the organization
  • Strong cross-functional influence and stakeholder management skills across Product, Sales, RevOps, and regional teams
  • Project management experience: managing complex operational programs with clear timelines, deliverables, and cross-functional dependencies, including intake/triage processes
  • Knowledge of go-to-market strategy and sales motions, with a solid understanding of revenue-driving metrics (pipeline, conversion, retention)
  • Ability to prioritize and multitask in a dynamic, fast-changing, entrepreneurial environment

Preferred (Great to Have)

  • Experience carrying a quota in a Technical Account Manager, Connectivity Partner Manager, or similar partner-facing role at Airbnb or another technology-enabled marketplace
  • Experience in the tech, travel, or gig/sharing economy sectors
  • Experience launching new programs or standing up an enablement function from scratch
  • Experience designing and executing quality monitoring programs (call recordings, scorecards, calibration) to drive consistent performance
  • Familiarity with enablement tooling ecosystems (e.g., Highspot, Gong) and Asana-based intake/workflow management

Your Location:

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list  If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist

jobs.title: Senior Sales Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

What You'll Do

As a Senior Sales Operations Analyst, you will be a key partner to our AMER sales leadership team to help support long-term growth. This role blends hands-on execution with a strategic lens. You will be responsible for maintaining the data and processes the region runs on today, while bringing data-driven recommendations to the table on how we should scale our processes and build the team to support continued growth.

Territory, Quota & Capacity Planning

  • Lead our annual territory carve for AMER, getting into the weeds of the underlying data to ensure accuracy and equitability, and bringing clear, data-driven recommendations on how we should structure territories to drive focus while giving reps a realistic path to hit their targets.
  • Build capacity models that translate growth targets into recommended headcount, territory coverage, and quota scenarios for leadership to evaluate.

Scaling Our Processes

  • Bring data-driven recommendations for how our sales processes need to evolve as the region and company grow, identifying bottlenecks before they slow the business down.
  • Partner with our Business Systems team to scope and prioritize Salesforce flows and automations.
  • Continuously evaluate where manual, one-off, or tribal-knowledge processes need to become documented and repeatable.

Data & Reporting Infrastructure

  • Design dashboards (Tableau, Looker, Salesforce, Clari) that give leadership real time visibility into performance.
  • Analyze sales data, KPIs, and trends to surface insights on what is working and what isn’t, and provide recommendations on where leaders should focus their attention.
  • Partner with Sales Leadership on forecasting cadences and keep forecast data clean, current, and trustworthy.

AI-Driven Process Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to use AI tools to automate manual Sales Ops workflows, such as data analysis and process improvement.
  • Design AI-driven workflows to improve efficiency across the broader sales team.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or business-oriented field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4+ years of experience in Go-to-Market Operations, Sales Strategy and Operations, or Revenue Operations at a high growth B2B SaaS company.
  • Technically savvy, with a solid understanding of how Salesforce flows and automations work and a sense for the art of the possible; you won't be building these yourself, but you'll partner closely with our Business Systems team to scope, prioritize, and validate the right builds.
  • Hands-on experience with Sales tech stack tools such as Clay, ZoomInfo, Clari, Gong, or Fullcast.
  • Proficient with Google Sheets and BI tools such as Tableau or Looker, with experience building dashboards from scratch.
  • Comfortable using AI tools to speed up analysis, data cleaning, and reporting, and curious about where AI can remove manual work from Sales Ops processes.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with the attention to detail to get into the data and make data driven decisions.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills; able to present data and findings to senior sales leaders clearly and concisely, and to build trust quickly.

jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

What You'll Do

As a Senior Sales Operations Analyst, you will be a key partner to our AMER sales leadership team to help support long-term growth. This role blends hands-on execution with a strategic lens. You will be responsible for maintaining the data and processes the region runs on today, while bringing data-driven recommendations to the table on how we should scale our processes and build the team to support continued growth.

Territory, Quota & Capacity Planning

  • Lead our annual territory carve for AMER, getting into the weeds of the underlying data to ensure accuracy and equitability, and bringing clear, data-driven recommendations on how we should structure territories to drive focus while giving reps a realistic path to hit their targets.
  • Build capacity models that translate growth targets into recommended headcount, territory coverage, and quota scenarios for leadership to evaluate.

Scaling Our Processes

  • Bring data-driven recommendations for how our sales processes need to evolve as the region and company grow, identifying bottlenecks before they slow the business down.
  • Partner with our Business Systems team to scope and prioritize Salesforce flows and automations.
  • Continuously evaluate where manual, one-off, or tribal-knowledge processes need to become documented and repeatable.

Data & Reporting Infrastructure

  • Design dashboards (Tableau, Looker, Salesforce, Clari) that give leadership real time visibility into performance.
  • Analyze sales data, KPIs, and trends to surface insights on what is working and what isn’t, and provide recommendations on where leaders should focus their attention.
  • Partner with Sales Leadership on forecasting cadences and keep forecast data clean, current, and trustworthy.

AI-Driven Process Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to use AI tools to automate manual Sales Ops workflows, such as data analysis and process improvement.
  • Design AI-driven workflows to improve efficiency across the broader sales team.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or business-oriented field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4+ years of experience in Go-to-Market Operations, Sales Strategy and Operations, or Revenue Operations at a high growth B2B SaaS company.
  • Technically savvy, with a solid understanding of how Salesforce flows and automations work and a sense for the art of the possible; you won't be building these yourself, but you'll partner closely with our Business Systems team to scope, prioritize, and validate the right builds.
  • Hands-on experience with Sales tech stack tools such as Clay, ZoomInfo, Clari, Gong, or Fullcast.
  • Proficient with Google Sheets and BI tools such as Tableau or Looker, with experience building dashboards from scratch.
  • Comfortable using AI tools to speed up analysis, data cleaning, and reporting, and curious about where AI can remove manual work from Sales Ops processes.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with the attention to detail to get into the data and make data driven decisions.

jobs.title: Head of Partnerships
jobs.description:
About Amperity—Why This, Why Now

Most customer data is a lie by omission.

Every consumer brand wants to know its customers. Unfortunately, almost none actually do. Data is scattered across a dozen systems, half of it contradicts the other half, and "insights" teams are forced to act on incomplete guesses. We started Amperity ten years ago because that gap—between what a brand believes about its customers and what is true—is the most expensive problem in the industry, and nobody had solved it.

With a lot of hard work and a little bit of luck, we did. Our patented identity resolution takes billions of messy, conflicting records and resolves them into an accurate picture of a real human being—in hours, not months. That’s not a feature; it’s the foundation everything else stands on. It’s why more than 400 brands—like Alaska Airlines, Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, DICK’S Sporting Goods, Virgin Atlantic, and Brooks Running—trust us with the one thing they can’t afford to get wrong, and why IDC named us a Leader in the category in 2026.

Now we’re doing something harder. We’re rebuilding Amperity as an AI-first company—not bolting a chatbot onto old software, but putting agents at the center of how customer data actually gets used. We shipped the industry’s first identity resolution agent, then the first enterprise Customer Data Agent that turns a plain-language question into a live segment without waiting on an engineering queue. The bet underneath all of it is simple, and we think it’s correct: The potential of AI will not be realized for a brand until it’s grounded and activated against a true, unified view of the customer. The market at-large is focused on intelligence, and we are focused on being  the ones who can make it trustworthy.

So here’s the honest pitch. If you want a tour of a category that’s already been figured out, this isn’t it. If you want to help decide what the next version of an entire industry looks like—alongside people who are remarkably exceptional at what they do, solving a problem that requires deep, sustained focus—this is one of the few places that work exists. Our goal is to build a highly impactful, generational business.

We measure our success by one standard: whether what we build moves the business. Return on cognition, not return on hype. If that’s how you want to be measured, we would love to speak with you.

The Role

The best software companies don't grow through direct sales alone — they grow through ecosystems: networks of partners who extend reach, deepen customer relationships, and deliver outcomes no single company can achieve alone. For Amperity, that ecosystem runs through the systems integrators and technology platforms.

As Head of Partnerships, you will build and run Amperity's partner motion end to end: identifying and recruiting the right SI and ISV/technology partners, structuring the commercial and technical relationships that make those partnerships work, and driving the day-to-day co-sell and enablement activity that turns a signed partnership into real, sourced pipeline. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role — you will be the one building relationships in the field, running joint GTM plays, and closing the loop between partner activity and revenue. You will report to Amperity's Chief Revenue Officer and work closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to make sure every partner-sourced opportunity is well-supported from first intro to closed-won.

Interesting Problems

Source and structure new partnerships

  • Identify, prioritize, and recruit the systems integrators, agencies, and technology/ISV partners best positioned to extend Amperity's reach.
  • Own partnership discovery, deal structuring, and the commercial framework for each relationship, from first conversation to signed agreement.

Drive co-sell and pipeline

  • Build and maintain trusted, working relationships with partner AEs, solutions engineers, and practice leads.
  • Directly source qualified introductions and run joint co-sell motions alongside Amperity's sales team: customer intros, deal reviews, and joint pitches.
  • Identify target accounts with partner field teams and execute coordinated outbound motions.
  • Serve as the connective tissue between partner field organizations and Amperity's sales team.

Build practice and enablement

  • Champion Amperity inside partner organizations and build the case for why partner sellers and implementers should bring Amperity into their accounts.
  • Partner with Amperity's enablement and product teams to develop the certification, training, and enablement assets that let partners position, sell, and deliver Amperity well.
  • Evangelize joint wins and keep partner teams current on Amperity's roadmap, competitive positioning, and win stories.

Grow marketplace and technology partnerships

  • Grow new business transacted through hyperscaler marketplaces, moving Amperity's engagement from reactive to proactive.
  • Own the commercial levers behind marketplace growth — co-sell relationships, pipeline quality, and partner funding/incentive programs.

Show up in the field

  • Engage partner events, conferences, and QBRs; host and co-host customer-facing events with partner counterparts to create pipeline moments.
  • Maintain an active cadence of partner syncs and joint co-sell calls; plan for regular travel to partner offices and industry events.

Track and report performance

  • Maintain clean, accurate partner pipeline data in Salesforce, and use tools like Crossbeam to prioritize where to invest partner attention.
  • Report on partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, marketplace transaction volume, and relationship health to sales and partnerships leadership.

What Success Looks Like

  • Pipeline: partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and closed-won business, growing quarter over quarter across your assigned partners.
  • Field engagement: partner AEs, SEs, and implementation teams actively running joint motions with Amperity, not just aware of the partnership.
  • Operations: clean, accurate partner pipeline data and a healthy, predictable partner referral flow.
  • Enablement: a growing bench of partner sellers and implementers who can represent and deliver Amperity well without Amperity in the room.

About You

  • 5-8+ years in partnerships, business development, alliances, or channel/cloud sales at a B2B SaaS company, with a track record of sourcing, structuring, and closing partnerships that drove measurable pipeline and revenue.
  • Hands-on experience with hyperscaler and data-cloud marketplaces (AWS, Databricks, Snowflake, GCP, or Azure), including the funding and incentive programs around them.
  • Experience managing relationships with systems integrators and/or agency partners, and comfort speaking to how their business and incentives actually work.
  • Comfortable managing pipeline, forecasts, and partner-sourced opportunities in Salesforce; experience with account-mapping tools such as Crossbeam is a plus.
  • Strong relationship-building instincts — you build trust quickly with partner field teams and keep relationships warm without being a pest.
  • Energized by fieldwork: comfortable with regular travel, in-person meetings, and events, not a desk-bound executor.
  • Commercially sharp — you can read a deal, identify how a partner accelerates it, and know when and why a partner motion is the right route.
  • Highly organized and self-directed, comfortable building a partner practice from the ground up and operating with autonomy in ambiguity.
  • MarTech, customer data platform, or adjacent data/analytics ecosystem experience strongly preferred.

Location

New York, NY

Amperity’s work model operates on four in-office days each week and one designated remote workday on Wednesdays. We value the collaboration, connection, and learning that come from working together in person.

Compensation

Base Salary:  $178,000-$245,000. Individual compensation within this range will depend on several factors, including your skills, experience, education/training, geographic location and the level at which you join. We also consider internal equity, market conditions, and overall business needs.

Cash Incentives: Cash incentives are also available.

Stock Options:  The opportunity for ownership is an exciting part of Amperity’s total compensation package. Every employee at Amperity receives a new-hire equity grant, commensurate with the scope of their position.

Benefits

We offer all the benefits you'd expect from a great place to work: 100% employee healthcare coverage, transportation subsidies, a comfortable work environment with plenty of snacks, and other employee experience perks like events and activities, both in-person and remote. We also offer self-managed PTO and the flexibility to do your best work in the way that works for you. We provide an inclusive environment where you'll be challenged to find and unlock your full potential, surrounded by a team of world-class people driving for excellence. For more details on our benefits, please see our US Benefits & Perks Guide.

Amperity is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and reproductive health choices), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as someone with a disability, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Job Seeker Apps
jobs.description:
We offer a hybrid work environment. Most US-based positions can also be performed remotely (any exceptions will be noted in the Minimum Qualifications below.)

Our Mission: 

To actively connect people to their next great opportunity. 

Who We Are: 

ZipRecruiter is a leading online employment marketplace. Powered by AI-driven smart matching technology, the company actively connects millions of all-sized businesses and job seekers through innovative mobile, web, and email services, as well as through partnerships with the best job boards on the web. ZipRecruiter has the #1 rated job search app on iOS & Android.

About the Team:

The Job Seeker Apps team builds the primary interfaces and proactive communication systems that guide millions of users through their job search journey. Our team focuses on transforming the job search experience from passive searching to proactive opportunity. Here’s how we do that:

  • Supporting Job Seekers Everywhere: We build interfaces and platforms to reach job seekers wherever they are. Our team owns ZipRecruiter’s mobile apps and ZipRecruiter’s interfaces to third party AI and agentic systems. We are responsible for growing these channels so job seekers can continue their job search wherever works for them.
  • Proactive Messaging and Communication: We build the critical systems for composing and sending the right information (emails, push notifications) to job seekers at the optimal time. Our goal is to transform ZipRecruiter into a personal recruiter, optimizing content, volume, and scheduling to ensure job seekers find satisfying opportunities while meeting employer hiring needs.
  • Capturing Job Seeker Wants and Offers: We help job seekers succeed in our marketplace by helping them express what they want out of their next opportunity, and what they offer to their potential employer, through experiences like the profile page and apply flow.
  • Guiding the Logged-In Experience: We own the tools and systems that guide a user's job search, including the logged-in homepage. We deliver personalized content, new job recommendations based on user history, and proactive guidance on the current state of their search to help them secure their next great role.

About the Job:

We are seeking a highly autonomous and versatile Staff/Senior Software Engineer to join our Job Seeker Apps team. In this role, you’ll support engineering leadership, driving systems thinking and end-to-end development. You’ll work closely with the teams behind job seeker profiles and our AI agent experiences, building the core systems that carry a job seeker’s information and intent into our marketplace. This is a high-impact position where you will actively collaborate with Product and Decision Science teams to shape user-facing features and AI-driven workflows.

What You’ll Do:

  • End-to-End Systems Engineering: Operate across multiple problem spaces—from data engineering to backend infrastructure and full-stack integration.
  • Cross-Functional Product Strategy: Partner closely with Product Management and Decision Science to inject engineering perspectives early in the product development lifecycle.
  • Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Act as a technical anchor, up-leveling an engineering team, guiding ICs, and keeping Engineering Managers aligned on technical execution.
  • Impact Measurement: Design and implement creative, data-driven methods to measure the real-world success of newly shipped user-facing features.
  • AI Integration: Architect how ZipRecruiter is presented in AI assistants and agentic systems, with the measurement and guardrails to run those integrations safely at scale.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of professional software development experience
  • Strong computer science fundamentals, including object-oriented programming, data structures, and algorithms
  • A track record of building user-facing products with measurable impact
  • Experience working with Product Managers to turn user problems into engineering solutions
  • Deep curiosity about the product you work on and the problems it solves

Bonus Points for Experience With Any Of:

  • Client-side development using ReactJS, TypeScript, or other modern languages and frameworks
  • A data lake stack: parquet on object storage, a data catalog such as AWS Glue, an open table format such as Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake, a data processing framework like Apache Spark or Flink
  • Product development in consumer-facing marketplaces
  • BS/MS/PhD in Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, related technical field or equivalent practical experience

As part of our team you’ll enjoy:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Exceptional benefits package
  • Flexible Vacation & Paid Time Off
  • Employer-matched 401(k) plan 

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $195,000 - $255,000. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location, and the range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location, role-related knowledge and skills, depth of experience, relevant education or training, and additional role-related considerations.

Depending on the position offered, equity, bonuses, commission, or other forms of compensation may also be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and other benefits.

ZipRecruiter is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or genetics.

Privacy Notice: For information about ZipRecruiter's collection and processing of job applicant personal data for this job, please see our Privacy Notice at: https://www.ziprecruiter.com/careers/job-applicant-privacy-notice

jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Manager of AMS Deal Desk to join our team. This is a hybrid or remote role, reporting to the Director of Deal Desk in the WW GTM Operations department. The Zscaler Sales and Go-to-Market team is a global group of professionals who are passionate about delighting our customers, nurturing trusted partnerships, and sharing their expertise to drive a secure, cloud-enabled digital future. As a Senior Manager of Deal Desk, you will be an essential part of the operations team, guiding Sales and Sales Leadership on the execution of high-value, complex deals.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Partner directly with Sales and Sales Leadership to structure non-standard, high-value, complex, and profitable deals.
  • Uphold pricing policies, revenue recognition standards, and corporate governance best practices.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally across Sales, Legal, Finance, Product, and Operations to eliminate operational bottlenecks and obtain complete deal approvals.
  • Develop and enhance team playbooks while continuously driving process optimization and reducing operational friction to support growth and scale
  • Lead, mentor, and empower a high-performing team of Deal Managers to establish subject-matter expertise on premier opportunities and ensure successful execution

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You act like an owner by letting your passion for the mission fuel your bias for action, operating with integrity, and seamlessly navigating between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a problem-solver who seeks out challenges and is energized by finding solutions, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator who is ambitious for the team, embraces a challenge culture through ongoing feedback, and knows that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork.
  • You are customer-obsessed, building deep empathy for both internal and external customers and championing their needs from start to finish because you know their success is our success.
  • You operate with urgency, maintaining a relentless focus on execution and delivering high-impact results quickly without sacrificing quality to win for the customer and the team.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving
  • 7+ years of experience leading a Deal Desk team , preferably in the high-tech industry
  • Proficiency with Salesforce.com, SFDC CPQ, Microsoft, Google Suite, and Tableau
  • Effective communication skills with the ability to breakdown complex deal structures into a digestible format
  • Ability to thrive and adapt creatively and successfully to constant change in a fast-paced and team-oriented sales environment
  • Analytical with proven critical thinking and effective decision making skills. Can do attitude, willing to roll up your sleeves and lead by example 

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Demonstrate strong AI fluency by leveraging coding assistants, LLMs, and Generative AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, solution design, automation, and customer problem-solving, while applying sound technical judgment to validate outputs
  • Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Finance, or a related field
  • Experience scaling a Deal Desk organization

jobs.title: Director of MRO Transformation
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The duty of this organization is to enable our Customers' ongoing Mission Readiness. From the moment they say "go" until the contract is fulfilled. We are only successful when the customer's mission is successful.

Mission Readiness is the post-production shared services organization for Anduril. This team supports the Business Lines and Divisions throughout the lifecycle of their product, from initial sustainment concept through delivery, installation, operation, repair and return. These service offerings also include providing technical publications, training, customer support, connectivity services and other value-added services. To the degree the Business elects, we accept the delegated responsibility for upfront and continued delivery of the committed service solutions. This team endeavors to provide the Business Lines, as our internal customers, shared mission services that are more efficient and cost effective than if they chose to provide them directly. By offering mission support capabilities and capacity that are not "core" to the Business, the Business can focus resources on addressing the next big need while we ensure existing commitments are met.

As Anduril's installed base grows across an increasing number of products and Business Lines, our MRO organization needs to move from a collection of program-specific repair processes and tools to a hardened, scalable operating model. This role is about leading that shift.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a Director of MRO Transformation to lead the modernization and scaling of Anduril's repair operations. Where our Head of MRO oversees the collective repair function, this Director role owns the transformation agenda: establishing core processes for any Business Line to leverage, selecting and implementing the tools and systems MRO runs on, and driving the change management needed to get a fast-growing collection of programs onto common, scalable rails. You will assess where today's pockets of good activity exist, build the roadmap to modernize them, and lead cross-functional teams through the change without slowing down repair turnaround for products already in the field. This is a build-the-plane-while-flying role for someone who has led operational or digital transformation in a maintenance, repair or sustainment environment before and knows how to sequence change so it sticks.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Assess and learn current-state activity, tools, data and processes across Business Lines (field sustainment systems, spares tactics, ERP, accounting methods, maintenance task tracking) then build the plan to harmonize a scalable, common operating model.
  • Project manage selection and/or design, implementation and adoption of MRO digital backbone systems including feeding the sustainment operating system. Partner with IT, Operational Excellence and Business Operations to ensure processes and digital workflows meld.
  • Design and drive change management that bring Business Lines, Production, Supply Chain, and Technical Operations onto common MRO methods that can be reapplied to enable speed on new products and new locations.
  • Partner with the Head of MRO, Director of Repair Engineering, and Business Line Production leadership to determine the path forward for various products based on their lifecycle stage and expectation, customers, technology and volumes.
  • Own the transformation roadmap and business case, including scoring and prioritizing tooling and process investments (data capture, cost visibility, configuration accuracy) against cost, schedule and repair turnaround-time goals.
  • Establish metrics and reporting that make MRO performance (repair turnaround time, backlog, cost, tool adoption) visible across the organization and track transformation progress against them.
  • Build and lead a team focused on MRO process definition and improvement, tooling and change management, separate from the engineers and operators running repair day to day. Partner with Operational Excellence team to implement and manage performance.
  • Manage change effectively across multiple teams and locations, ensuring disparate customer needs are understood and considered.
  • Represent MRO transformation priorities in cross-functional planning with Program Management, Supply Chain, Production, and Engineering.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, operations, business, or related discipline
  • 10+ years of combined experience in MRO, sustainment, operations, program management, or business/digital transformation roles, including experience standing up or modernizing MRO tools and processes
  • 3+ years of experience leading cross-functional change management or transformation initiatives
  • Ability to travel 25-50% of the time
  • This position is based in Costa Mesa, CA or Columbus, OH and requires being onsite, remote work not considered
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret or Top Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience evaluating and implementing MRO or product lifecycle tooling and leading organizations through adoption
  • Track record of consolidating fragmented, program-specific processes into a single scalable operating model in a fast-growing or matrixed organization
  • Familiarity with reliability-centered maintenance (RCM), Level of Repair Analysis (LORA), and product support analysis concepts, enough to translate engineering requirements into tooling and process decisions
  • Experience building the business case for transformation investments and defending it to cross-functional and executive stakeholders
  • Prior success leading change in a complex/matrix organization supporting multiple product families, with the ability to influence without direct authority over every team affected
  • Background in defense, aerospace, or another highly regulated hardware environment where DoD or military sustainment standards shape how transformation has to be sequenced
  • Experience with digital transformation of sustainment or logistics data (spares, configuration, maintenance history) to support fleet-wide visibility
  • MBA or advanced technical degree preferred
US Salary Range
$181,000—$240,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

 

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. 

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

 

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

jobs.title: Security Compliance Specialist
jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role
We are looking for a Security Compliance Specialist to join our team. This is a Remote to US role, reporting to the Director, Technology Risk & Compliance in the Exposure Management & Security Operations department. This role supports federal governance, risk, and compliance activities by coordinating certification and authorization efforts, executing assessments with independent assessors, and helping drive continuous monitoring across the federal environment. The role enables business growth by supporting the addition of new services into the authorization boundary and contributing to the development of scalable, effective compliance processes.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Support federal certification and authorization activities by coordinating and executing compliance assessments with independent assessors and internal stakeholders
  • Drive continuous monitoring efforts by coordinating and executing remediation efforts and ongoing compliance obligations
  • Contribute to the development, refinement, and execution of scalable compliance processes to support business growth

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity, easily building the path as you walk it and viewing a dynamic environment as a prime opportunity to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner with a strong bias for action and a deep care for the outcomes of your work, navigating seamlessly between high-level compliance strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You champion simplicity by distilling complex regulatory guidelines and technical compliance concepts into clear, actionable, and focus-driven plans.
  • You think at scale, connecting your daily efforts to the broader organization's mission and building robust compliance processes designed to support global growth.
  • You lead with integrity, holding yourself and your teammates to high standards of accountability while building trust through consistent, transparent action.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Familiarity with cloud, SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS environments, including how new products or services are assessed and incorporated into an authorized boundary
