jobs.title: Senior Manager, Business Operations - Retail Channel Management
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SENIOR MANAGER, BUSINESS OPERATIONS - RETAIL CHANNEL MANAGEMENT 

As Senior Manager, Business Operations - Retail Channel Management, known internally as Sr. Manager, Starlink Business Operations, you will run the global retail distribution function for Starlink Consumer. Regional business development leads and retail account managers win the retailers and open the doors. You make that channel healthy, and you give those teams what they need to grow it. You know how many stores we are in, how each retailer and store is performing, and what we sell in each one. 

You sit in the central Consumer Growth organization and support every region. You own the system the regional teams sell through: you help construct the demand forecast with regional leaders, the plan with S&OP and supply chain, help to set our global MSRP, how a new product is cut into a retailer, and how product is contracted and set up to sell in stores. You lead the global retail channel team, including senior managers and the retail operations leads who sit with the regions, on one set of processes and one view of the business.

RESPONSIBILITIES: 

  • Run the global retail distribution function for Starlink Consumer. Regional business development leads and retail account managers win retailers and open doors. You run the system they sell through, and you are accountable for keeping that channel healthy and able to grow.
  • Lead the global retail channel team, including the central retail operations leads. Set roles, coverage, and one operating cadence for demand planning and forecasting, order processing, invoicing and payments, and overall channel performance reporting.
  • Own one view of the channel: how many stores we are in, how each retailer and store is performing, and what we sell in each. Report sell-in, sell-through, inventory, fill rate, on-time delivery, and activation, with an owner and a date on every gap.
  • Own the global retail demand forecast. Build it from what each retailer and product is actually selling, reconcile sell-in, sell-through, and inventory; and carry retail demand into S&OP, production, and supply planning.
  • Plan the channel with S&OP and supply chain. Balance retail and online inventory, set priorities when supply is tight, and keep weeks of supply, backorders, and aged orders to plan with logistics and the regional distribution centers.
  • Set and maintain global MSRP and the retail price architecture by product and market, with finance and the regional teams, so every retailer sells from one price file.
  • Own how a new product is cut into retail: assortment, the materials for a retailer line review, item setup, forecast, first order, and the date it is available to sell.
  • Own how product is contracted and set up to sell in a store, in support of the regional owner: vendor setup, item setup, and execution of the distribution or retailer agreement. You do not own the retailer relationship. You make the listing real and repeatable.
  • Make a new door ready to sell on day one, in support of the regional team that opened it: launch checklist, initial load-in, inventory position, merchandising and fixtures, and in-store activation.
  • Hold the retail-ready standard on every product shipped to a retailer: correct part numbers, UPC and barcode quality, certification marks, packaging, and pallet integrity, caught before product leaves the factory or a distribution center.
  • Clear the issues that take product off a shelf, including production, inventory, and logistics problems, relabeling, returns, and replacements, and align what the retailer is told. Partner with product and platform teams on in-store activation, ordering integrations, and kit tracking.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

jobs.title: Asset Protection & Safety Associate I/II
jobs.description:
Schedule (Open Availability Highly Preferred):

  • OPEN AVAILABILITY

Pay Range: $21-22 hourly

About Carvana

If you like disrupting the norm and are looking to join a company revolutionizing an industry then you will LOVE what Carvana has done for the car buying experience. Buying a car the old fashioned way sucks and we are working hard to make it NOT suck. I mean, have you seen our vending machine?!

We are looking for people who are excited to thrive in an environment of impactful change. Team spirit is evident at Carvana and everyday we let our passions and creativity foster innovation. We take big swings, set ambitious goals, and challenge each other to make data- and process-driven decisions in everything we do. Here are a few of our stories! We’ve been changing the game since 2013, and we’re not taking our foot off the gas now. Want more of the story? Check out our background here. 

 

About the team and position

As a Safe and Secure Associate II, you will be an integral part of the Safe and Secure Team executing programs and processes at our facility to ensure our associates, customers, and assets are protected. Your daily duties will vary depending upon your assignment. At our gates, you will be the face of Carvana to our associates, our vendors, and our visitors. You will ensure proper protocols are followed with egress and digress procedures. You will be well versed on emergency procedures and will be able to provide assistance when needed. You will play an active role in ensuring our Inventory Control procedures are adhered to. You will be adept at utilizing Carvana technology. You will interact with our Inspection Center and Logistics Team in documenting vehicle destinations and locations. You will support vehicle location research when necessary and provide key details to the Safe and Secure Manager to assist in any inquiry. The core responsibilities are the same as an Associate I, however this level is aimed at top performing associates that are consistently performing at a “skilled’ level. This associate is established and has a solid foundation with at least 1 year of internal experience, minimal touchpoints, has the skill set to take on more complex issues that arise (i.e. inventory control, safety, and critical tracking) and start to introduce skills that will help grow into a people leader, such as, mentoring, and training. This position is hourly and reports to either the Safe and Secure Team Lead or the Safe and Secure Manager.

 

What you’ll be doing

 

  • Deliver a service first approach in everything you do.
  • Make a difference by exemplifying our Carvana values.
  • As our egress and digress “ambassador”, you will have the opportunity to positively impact the daily interactions with the majority of our associates, drivers, and vendors. 
  • At our gates, you will be the face of Carvana to our associates, our vendors, and our visitors. 
  • When appropriate, partner with your Safe and Secure Team Lead and Safe and Secure Manager to remedy the various requests we receive for badge creation, CCTV review, amongst other components. 
  • Ensure each request is delivered in a way that is timely, quality, and service oriented. 
  • Be there when the Team needs you. Each Safe and Secure Associate will be trained and certified on a variety of life saving measures such as first aid, CPR, and AED. Take action when necessary and bring those skills to the forefront when facing emergency situations. 
  • In partnership with your Safe and Secure Team Lead and Manager, promote an incident ready focus everyday at your site. Understand our Incident Response Protocol and ensure appropriate actions are taken when needed. 
  • There will be times where you face difficult situations. Always Keep it Kool. Your role is to de-escalate situations to ensure we win with partners and collaboration at the forefront. Leverage your training to remind yourself that “We are all in this together.”
  • Execute the facility Safe and Secure Principles at the entrance/exits. These Principles articulate processes to follow when allowing access and exit from the Carvana Facility/Lot.
  • Utilize our Safe and Secure Application (SAS App) and RFID Technology. 
  • Manage and properly document the movement of cars into and out of the Inspection Center entrance and exit gates.
  • Conduct routine patrols of the Inspection Center and Logistics facility yard and buildings - documenting any security and/or safety concerns.
  • Lead with effective communication with team, partners, and customers. Ensure you are a strong active listener and are incorporating effective dialogue. 

 

Other duties include: 

  • Demonstrates a clear understanding of how SAS conducts the inventory control process at the site. 
  • Plays a pivotal role in helping identify and research vehicle exceptions to support the critical tracking and inventory reconciliation processes at the site. 
  • Helps identify, document, and report vehicle and property damages occurring at the site. 
  • Actively participates in and facilitates the completion of JIRA CCTV review requests at the site and enterprise level, contributing to the overall surveillance and security measures.
  • Provides assistance in completing JIRA badge requests at the site and enterprise level, contributing to a seamless badging process across the organization.
  • Assists in the CCTV review of safety incidents at the site, contributing to the enhancement of safety protocols and incident response strategies.
  • Acts as a valuable resource for new associates by actively participating in onboarding and providing ongoing coaching and development when needed.

 

Key Metrics: 

  • Unit Loss Rate versus Plan
  • Safe and Secure App Execution
  • Inventory Control/Accuracy and Tracking 
  • Safety Incident Performance
  • JIRA Ticket Service Level Score
  • Vehicle and property damages

What you should know/have

  • Recommend 1 year of Carvana Safe and Secure experience 
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Proven track record of strong decision-making in a complex environment
  • Ability to relate well with others and establish strong working relationships
  • Ability to organize, plan, and execute multiple tasks in a fast-paced work environment
  • Ability to handle conflict situations in a positive way
  • Knowledge of CCTV, RFID, Card Access, and other Safe and Secure Technology
  • Previous experience supporting an OSHA program – Safety Team
  • Experience supporting crisis prevention and/or response plans

What we’ll offer in return

  • Full-Time hourly Position with a competitive wage.
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits.
  • 401K with company match.
  • A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more..
  • A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy both physically and mentally.
  • Access to opportunities to expand your skill set and share your knowledge with others across the organization.
  • A company culture of promotions from within, with a start-up atmosphere allowing for varied and rapid career development.
  • A seat in one of the fastest-growing companies in the country.

 

Other requirements

To be able to do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you:

  • Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English 
  • Must be at least 18 years of age 
  • This job position is designated as a safety-sensitive position 
  • Must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently; majority of lifting from knee to shoulder heights; other lifting required from various levels 
  • Must be able to carry and transport up to 60 pounds up to 20 feet
  • Requires standing for extended periods of time with frequent stretching, reaching, walking, stooping, pushing, and/or pulling in an environment that may be cold, hot, noisy, and wet and may have fumes or odors due to vehicle maintenance 
  • Requires excellent visual acuity and manual dexterity 
  • Requires use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment 
  • Requires frequent driving and computer data entry 
  • Must adhere to regular and predictable attendance 
  • The facility is a 24/7 operation and gates must be manned at all times. 

 

Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

 

Legal stuff

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check.  This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

 

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer.  All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.  Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

 

Please note this job description is not designed to contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Strategy & Operations, DoorDash for Business
jobs.description:
About the Team

DoorDash for Business provides meals solutions to companies, but we aren’t stopping there. Our mission is to become a premier benefits partner for executives, employees and administrators across the globe, leveraging the DoorDash platform to deliver industry-leading selection, quality, and customer service to every business customer, for every business use case. We are building an entrepreneurial, customer-obsessed, and fast moving team to create the right products and services for the future of work.

About the Role

As a Senior Manager, Strategy & Operations (Audience Growth & Product Strategy), you will play a critical role in shaping how DoorDash for Business grows its customer base, expands platform adoption, and identifies new product opportunities that can accelerate the business. As a senior leader on the team, you will set strategy across both the businesses we sell to and the employees and administrators who use our product, and you will lead a high-performing team to deliver it.

You will own the strategy for growing our audience of companies and the employees within them, including how we identify, prioritize, acquire, activate, and expand across key customer segments, personas, industries, and use cases in a B2B2C model. You will also own product growth strategy for our core platform, helping define how we increase adoption, engagement, retention, and customer value across existing products, including through CRM and lifecycle programs and in-app merchandising.

In addition, you will help identify and evaluate net-new product opportunities that can unlock future growth. This includes sizing opportunities, understanding customer pain points, validating demand, shaping early GTM strategy, and partnering with Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Analytics, and Finance to determine where DoorDash for Business should invest.

A core part of this role will be owning the voice of the customer. You will create structured feedback loops that capture insights from executives, administrators, employees, Sales, Customer Success, Support, and market research, then translate those insights into clear recommendations that inform product roadmaps and business priorities.

This role is ideal for a seasoned leader who thrives at the intersection of growth strategy, product strategy, CRM, in-app merchandising, analytics, customer insight, and cross-functional execution.

Reporting to the Head of Growth Strategy and Operations, DoorDash for Business, you will work closely with operators, field teams, product and other teams to make your vision a reality.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Strategize
    Set audience growth and product growth strategies for DoorDash for Business, identifying the highest-impact customer segments, personas, use cases, and product opportunities to grow the business.
  • Operate
    Partner cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Analytics, Finance, Operations, and Engineering to turn growth priorities into clear plans, experiments, launches, and measurable outcomes.
  • Build
    Create scalable growth playbooks, dashboards, research processes, and operating cadences that help the team better understand customer needs, product adoption, and expansion opportunities.
  • Grow
    Drive growth for the core platform by identifying opportunities to improve customer acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, feature adoption, and overall customer value, using CRM and in-app merchandising as core levers.
  • Explore
    Evaluate net-new product opportunities by sizing markets, understanding customer pain points, validating demand, assessing GTM feasibility, and recommending where the business should invest.
  • Champion the Customer
    Own voice-of-customer feedback loops across customer interviews, Sales and Customer Success insights, surveys, support trends, and product usage data to inform product roadmaps and business priorities.
  • Analyze
    Use SQL, AI tools, customer research, and product analytics to uncover insights, prioritize opportunities, and translate data into clear recommendations for cross-functional partners and senior leaders.
  • Construct
    Bring structure to ambiguous growth opportunities by creating the frameworks, playbooks, and processes needed to move ideas from insight to action.

We’re excited about you because…

  • You have 10+ years of experience in product growth, audience growth, GTM strategy, business operations, product strategy, commercial strategy, growth marketing, or consulting, with a proven track record at high-growth companies with growing audiences in a B2B2C business model.
  • You have an MBA from a top-tier university and/or experience at a leading strategy consulting firm, ideally McKinsey & Company, Bain & Company, or Boston Consulting Group.

You understand how to develop audience growth strategies, including customer segmentation, persona prioritization, market sizing, funnel analysis, activation, retention, and expansion opportunities.

  • You are AI-forward and use AI, automation, and emerging technologies to accelerate research, synthesize customer feedback, improve analysis, streamline reporting, and increase team productivity.

  • You thrive in ambiguity, proactively identify growth opportunities, build scalable solutions, and drive execution from concept through implementation.

jobs.title: Senior CSM, Media and Entertainment
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

As a Principal Customer Success Manager you will be a senior individual contributor owning some of our most significant customers.  Acting as a trusted SME within the wider Customer Success Department you will also be temporarily assigned to assist junior colleagues with at-risk or high opportunity accounts within their book.  As a member of the Enterprise Team you will work closely with established, big-name brands to help them realise value from their investment in Braze.

What you’ll do

  • Partner with Account Executives to ensure commercial alignment & drive client renewals, retention & net retention targets for your customers
  • Be your customers’ main point of contact and trusted advisor at Braze
  • Drive feature adoption by building a shared Success Plan with your customers, providing strategic guidance, enablement, and day-to-day advice to help them hit their objectives with Braze
  • Drive customer advocacy by building strong customer relationships and creating mutual value for your customers and Braze
  • Be a strategic thought leader for your customers, analyzing use-cases and recommending market/vertical best practices to enhance client marketing programs. 
  • Advocate for your customers, soliciting and synthesizing customer product feedback to contribute to product development
  • In addition to being a dedicated contact for strategy, product training inquiries, and non-technical support for your direct accounts coordinate with other Braze teams including Technical Support, Industry Solutions, and Deliverability Services to ensure your customers receive the support they need simply and seamlessly
  • Work with Onboarding Managers and other Customer Success Partners to seamlessly transition clients from onboarding to ongoing activity.
  • Act as a point of escalation for customers
  • Provide mentorship to colleagues, acting as a subject matter expert you will take the initiative to help them improve processes, execution, and outcomes
  • You will assist junior colleagues by taking temporary assignments to help them rescue at-risk accounts and capitalise on high opportunity accounts through mentoring and engaging directly with the customer
  • You will likely spend time onsite with customers and may travel internationally

Please note this job description cannot possibly cover every duty you may need to undertake, you may be asked by your line manager to handle other reasonable responsibilities commensurate with the role.

Who you are

You are a proven customer success professional, with an excellent track record, who finds satisfaction in helping your customers achieve great things and in helping your colleagues grow. You have an excellent track record in customer success or a related role and are excited to work with big name brands with over 1,000 staff.  You want to lead by example as a senior individual contributor. 

  • You have significant project management experience and/or formal certifications (PMP, Agile, etc).
  • You have exemplary written and verbal communication skills coupled with unparalleled follow up skills. Clients have the impression that you listen and understand their problems.
  • You’re known for being a “team player.” We just can’t emphasize this enough.
  • High level of intellectual curiosity. You see opportunity and growth in learning more about what you do and how it impacts others.
  • You have strong technical domain knowledge of two or more of the following:  SaaS, Mobile, APIs, Marketing Automation, Direct Marketing, Analytics or Programming (HTML etc).
  • 6 years+ experience managing complex international enterprise accounts (Fortune 100, FTSE, DAX, etc. - ACV of $500K or more) across multiple senior client
    stakeholders at a SaaS company
  • You have a proven track record as a Success Manager, renewing and growing customers
  • West Coast location is preferred (but not required)


For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $88,000 and $124,800/year, with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $110,000 and $156,000/year (including bonus or commission). Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

 #LI-Hybrid

WHAT WE OFFER

Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

  • Competitive compensation that may include equity
  • Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
  • Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave
  • Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend
  • A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
  • Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching
  • Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze
  • Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®

ABOUT BRAZE

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.

The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025.

Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore.

The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.

BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.

Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you.

We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you

OUR AI-POWERED BRAZE RECRUITMENT PROCESS

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Big Data, Job Understanding
jobs.description:
We offer a hybrid work environment. Most US-based positions can also be performed remotely (any exceptions will be noted in the Minimum Qualifications below.)

Our Mission: 

To actively connect people to their next great opportunity. 

Who We Are: 

ZipRecruiter is a leading online employment marketplace. Powered by AI-driven smart matching technology, the company actively connects millions of all-sized businesses and job seekers through innovative mobile, web, and email services, as well as through partnerships with the best job boards on the web. ZipRecruiter has the #1 rated job search app on iOS & Android.

About the Team:

Recommendations Ecosystem

The Recommendations Ecosystem group owns the intelligence that connects job seekers and jobs in our marketplace. We aim to understand every job and every job seeker well enough to make matches that work for both sides. We structure and enrich the jobs corpus, build the foundational models that encode jobs and job seekers, and run the matching engines that put the right opportunities in front of the right people.

What our team owns

Our group is the authoritative source for job understanding and matching intelligence, focusing on accuracy, relevance, and trust:

  • Jobs Corpus Understanding: ZipRecruiter takes in millions of job postings from employers, partners, and feeds. We own the ingestion and enrichment pipelines that turn raw postings into structured data. We use ML classifiers to infer job attributes like education requirements and pay, and we attach company and location data. We find and suppress fraudulent listings or terms of use violations, so the marketplace stays safe and worth using. The result is a canonical view of every job that recommendations, search, and employer products build on.
  • Foundational Models and Embeddings: At the core of ZipRecruiter's matching ecosystem are models that encode everything we can learn about jobs and job seekers. We build LLM-based embedding models from job content, resumes, and behavioral signals. These are the building blocks for matching and other ML models across the company, and we serve them at scale online and in batch.
  • Matching Engines: We are responsible for the ML systems that recommend jobs to job seekers and job seekers to employers across our app, website, and email. The engines cover large-scale candidate retrieval over vector DBs and orchestration that delivers fresh, personalized recommendations.

About the Job:

ZipRecruiter’s Recommendation Ecosystem Group provides the backend machine learning and data platforms that connect job seekers to the right jobs. Within this group, the Job Understanding team is the authoritative source for foundational job data, pipelines, and matching intelligence.

We are seeking an Engineering Manager to lead an experienced, high-impact engineering team. In this role, you will guide the team in modernizing core data pipelines, storage solutions, and access methods while enhancing data quality and security systems.

  • Lead, mentor, and unblock a senior team of 5 engineers responsible for core job ingestion pipelines and data stores.
  • Drive the rebuild of the job ingestion pipeline and refine how job data is exposed to consuming engineering teams.
  • Prioritize initiatives that improve underlying input data quality and handle low-structure, user-generated content.
  • Own and lead improvements to fraud detection and blocking mechanisms.
  • Partner closely with other Engineering stakeholders, Data Scientists, and a dedicated Product Manager to balance requests and roadmap priorities.
  • Ensure we can act on everything we learn about jobs in a scalable real time manner. Scale our data pipelines both for performance and maintainability so we can be ambitious about what data we collect and where we can personalize the job seeker experience. 

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience.
  • 2+ years of experience as a software engineering leader
  • Deep experience with modern big data frameworks (e.g. Spark, Hadoop, Hive).
  • Streaming technologies (Kafka, Flink, Beam).
  • Strong CS fundamentals (data structures, algorithms) and coding skills.
  • Experience with containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience working on a B2C or B2B Product
  • This role is for engineers who are talking with their Product Managers about problems to solve and turning them into engineering solutions. They are naturally curious, problem solvers, and deeply understand the product they work on.
  • Must have experience dealing with messy/unreliable data (third party data sets, data integrations, migrations) 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, Azure).
  • Modern data storage solutions (Delta Lake, HBase, Hudi).
  • Scala

As part of our team you’ll enjoy:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Exceptional benefits package
  • Flexible Vacation & Paid Time Off
  • Employer-matched 401(k) plan 

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $200,000 - $265,000. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location, and the range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location, role-related knowledge and skills, depth of experience, relevant education or training, and additional role-related considerations.

Depending on the position offered, equity, bonuses, commission, or other forms of compensation may also be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and other benefits.

ZipRecruiter is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or genetics.

Privacy Notice: For information about ZipRecruiter's collection and processing of job applicant personal data for this job, please see our Privacy Notice at: https://www.ziprecruiter.com/careers/job-applicant-privacy-notice

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

As a Principal Customer Success Manager you will be a senior individual contributor owning some of our most significant customers.  Acting as a trusted SME within the wider Customer Success Department you will also be temporarily assigned to assist junior colleagues with at-risk or high opportunity accounts within their book.  As a member of the Enterprise Team you will work closely with established, big-name brands to help them realise value from their investment in Braze.

What you’ll do

  • Partner with Account Executives to ensure commercial alignment & drive client renewals, retention & net retention targets for your customers
  • Be your customers’ main point of contact and trusted advisor at Braze
  • Drive feature adoption by building a shared Success Plan with your customers, providing strategic guidance, enablement, and day-to-day advice to help them hit their objectives with Braze
  • Drive customer advocacy by building strong customer relationships and creating mutual value for your customers and Braze
  • Be a strategic thought leader for your customers, analyzing use-cases and recommending market/vertical best practices to enhance client marketing programs. 
  • Advocate for your customers, soliciting and synthesizing customer product feedback to contribute to product development
  • In addition to being a dedicated contact for strategy, product training inquiries, and non-technical support for your direct accounts coordinate with other Braze teams including Technical Support, Industry Solutions, and Deliverability Services to ensure your customers receive the support they need simply and seamlessly
  • Work with Onboarding Managers and other Customer Success Partners to seamlessly transition clients from onboarding to ongoing activity.
  • Act as a point of escalation for customers
  • Provide mentorship to colleagues, acting as a subject matter expert you will take the initiative to help them improve processes, execution, and outcomes
  • You will assist junior colleagues by taking temporary assignments to help them rescue at-risk accounts and capitalise on high opportunity accounts through mentoring and engaging directly with the customer
  • You will likely spend time onsite with customers and may travel internationally

Please note this job description cannot possibly cover every duty you may need to undertake, you may be asked by your line manager to handle other reasonable responsibilities commensurate with the role.

Who you are

You are a proven customer success professional, with an excellent track record, who finds satisfaction in helping your customers achieve great things and in helping your colleagues grow. You have an excellent track record in customer success or a related role and are excited to work with big name brands with over 1,000 staff.  You want to lead by example as a senior individual contributor. 

  • You have significant project management experience and/or formal certifications (PMP, Agile, etc).
  • You have exemplary written and verbal communication skills coupled with unparalleled follow up skills. Clients have the impression that you listen and understand their problems.
  • You’re known for being a “team player.” We just can’t emphasize this enough.
  • High level of intellectual curiosity. You see opportunity and growth in learning more about what you do and how it impacts others.
  • You have strong technical domain knowledge of two or more of the following:  SaaS, Mobile, APIs, Marketing Automation, Direct Marketing, Analytics or Programming (HTML etc).
  • 6 years+ experience managing complex international enterprise accounts (Fortune 100, FTSE, DAX, etc. - ACV of $500K or more) across multiple senior client
    stakeholders at a SaaS company
  • You have a proven track record as a Success Manager, renewing and growing customers
  • West Coast location is preferred (but not required)


For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $88,000 and $124,800/year, with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $110,000 and $156,000/year (including bonus or commission). Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

 #LI-Hybrid

WHAT WE OFFER

Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

  • Competitive compensation that may include equity
  • Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
  • Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave
  • Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend
  • A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
  • Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching
  • Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze
  • Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®

ABOUT BRAZE

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.

The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025.

Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore.

The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.

BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.

Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Big Data, Job Understanding
jobs.description:
We offer a hybrid work environment. Most US-based positions can also be performed remotely (any exceptions will be noted in the Minimum Qualifications below.)

Our Mission: 

To actively connect people to their next great opportunity. 

Who We Are: 

ZipRecruiter is a leading online employment marketplace. Powered by AI-driven smart matching technology, the company actively connects millions of all-sized businesses and job seekers through innovative mobile, web, and email services, as well as through partnerships with the best job boards on the web. ZipRecruiter has the #1 rated job search app on iOS & Android.

About the Team:

Recommendations Ecosystem

The Recommendations Ecosystem group owns the intelligence that connects job seekers and jobs in our marketplace. We aim to understand every job and every job seeker well enough to make matches that work for both sides. We structure and enrich the jobs corpus, build the foundational models that encode jobs and job seekers, and run the matching engines that put the right opportunities in front of the right people.

What our team owns

Our group is the authoritative source for job understanding and matching intelligence, focusing on accuracy, relevance, and trust:

  • Jobs Corpus Understanding: ZipRecruiter takes in millions of job postings from employers, partners, and feeds. We own the ingestion and enrichment pipelines that turn raw postings into structured data. We use ML classifiers to infer job attributes like education requirements and pay, and we attach company and location data. We find and suppress fraudulent listings or terms of use violations, so the marketplace stays safe and worth using. The result is a canonical view of every job that recommendations, search, and employer products build on.
  • Foundational Models and Embeddings: At the core of ZipRecruiter's matching ecosystem are models that encode everything we can learn about jobs and job seekers. We build LLM-based embedding models from job content, resumes, and behavioral signals. These are the building blocks for matching and other ML models across the company, and we serve them at scale online and in batch.
  • Matching Engines: We are responsible for the ML systems that recommend jobs to job seekers and job seekers to employers across our app, website, and email. The engines cover large-scale candidate retrieval over vector DBs and orchestration that delivers fresh, personalized recommendations.

About the Job:

ZipRecruiter’s Recommendation Ecosystem Group provides the backend machine learning and data platforms that connect job seekers to the right jobs. Within this group, the Job Understanding team is the authoritative source for foundational job data, pipelines, and matching intelligence.

We are seeking an Engineering Manager to lead an experienced, high-impact engineering team. In this role, you will guide the team in modernizing core data pipelines, storage solutions, and access methods while enhancing data quality and security systems.

  • Lead, mentor, and unblock a senior team of 5 engineers responsible for core job ingestion pipelines and data stores.
  • Drive the rebuild of the job ingestion pipeline and refine how job data is exposed to consuming engineering teams.
  • Prioritize initiatives that improve underlying input data quality and handle low-structure, user-generated content.
  • Own and lead improvements to fraud detection and blocking mechanisms.
  • Partner closely with other Engineering stakeholders, Data Scientists, and a dedicated Product Manager to balance requests and roadmap priorities.
  • Ensure we can act on everything we learn about jobs in a scalable real time manner. Scale our data pipelines both for performance and maintainability so we can be ambitious about what data we collect and where we can personalize the job seeker experience. 

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience.
  • 2+ years of experience as a software engineering leader
  • Deep experience with modern big data frameworks (e.g. Spark, Hadoop, Hive).
  • Streaming technologies (Kafka, Flink, Beam).
  • Strong CS fundamentals (data structures, algorithms) and coding skills.
  • Experience with containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience working on a B2C or B2B Product
  • This role is for engineers who are talking with their Product Managers about problems to solve and turning them into engineering solutions. They are naturally curious, problem solvers, and deeply understand the product they work on.
  • Must have experience dealing with messy/unreliable data (third party data sets, data integrations, migrations) 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, Azure).
  • Modern data storage solutions (Delta Lake, HBase, Hudi).
  • Scala

As part of our team you’ll enjoy:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Exceptional benefits package
  • Flexible Vacation & Paid Time Off
  • Employer-matched 401(k) plan 

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $200,000 - $265,000. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location, and the range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location, role-related knowledge and skills, depth of experience, relevant education or training, and additional role-related considerations.

Depending on the position offered, equity, bonuses, commission, or other forms of compensation may also be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and other benefits.

ZipRecruiter is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or genetics.

Privacy Notice: For information about ZipRecruiter's collection and processing of job applicant personal data for this job, please see our Privacy Notice at: https://www.ziprecruiter.com/careers/job-applicant-privacy-notice

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Big Data, Job Understanding
jobs.description:
We offer a hybrid work environment. Most US-based positions can also be performed remotely (any exceptions will be noted in the Minimum Qualifications below.)

Our Mission: 

To actively connect people to their next great opportunity. 

Who We Are: 

ZipRecruiter is a leading online employment marketplace. Powered by AI-driven smart matching technology, the company actively connects millions of all-sized businesses and job seekers through innovative mobile, web, and email services, as well as through partnerships with the best job boards on the web. ZipRecruiter has the #1 rated job search app on iOS & Android.

About the Team:

Recommendations Ecosystem

The Recommendations Ecosystem group owns the intelligence that connects job seekers and jobs in our marketplace. We aim to understand every job and every job seeker well enough to make matches that work for both sides. We structure and enrich the jobs corpus, build the foundational models that encode jobs and job seekers, and run the matching engines that put the right opportunities in front of the right people.

What our team owns

Our group is the authoritative source for job understanding and matching intelligence, focusing on accuracy, relevance, and trust:

  • Jobs Corpus Understanding: ZipRecruiter takes in millions of job postings from employers, partners, and feeds. We own the ingestion and enrichment pipelines that turn raw postings into structured data. We use ML classifiers to infer job attributes like education requirements and pay, and we attach company and location data. We find and suppress fraudulent listings or terms of use violations, so the marketplace stays safe and worth using. The result is a canonical view of every job that recommendations, search, and employer products build on.
  • Foundational Models and Embeddings: At the core of ZipRecruiter's matching ecosystem are models that encode everything we can learn about jobs and job seekers. We build LLM-based embedding models from job content, resumes, and behavioral signals. These are the building blocks for matching and other ML models across the company, and we serve them at scale online and in batch.
  • Matching Engines: We are responsible for the ML systems that recommend jobs to job seekers and job seekers to employers across our app, website, and email. The engines cover large-scale candidate retrieval over vector DBs and orchestration that delivers fresh, personalized recommendations.

About the Job:

ZipRecruiter’s Recommendation Ecosystem Group provides the backend machine learning and data platforms that connect job seekers to the right jobs. Within this group, the Job Understanding team is the authoritative source for foundational job data, pipelines, and matching intelligence.

We are seeking an Engineering Manager to lead an experienced, high-impact engineering team. In this role, you will guide the team in modernizing core data pipelines, storage solutions, and access methods while enhancing data quality and security systems.

  • Lead, mentor, and unblock a senior team of 5 engineers responsible for core job ingestion pipelines and data stores.
  • Drive the rebuild of the job ingestion pipeline and refine how job data is exposed to consuming engineering teams.
  • Prioritize initiatives that improve underlying input data quality and handle low-structure, user-generated content.
  • Own and lead improvements to fraud detection and blocking mechanisms.
  • Partner closely with other Engineering stakeholders, Data Scientists, and a dedicated Product Manager to balance requests and roadmap priorities.
  • Ensure we can act on everything we learn about jobs in a scalable real time manner. Scale our data pipelines both for performance and maintainability so we can be ambitious about what data we collect and where we can personalize the job seeker experience. 

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience.
  • 2+ years of experience as a software engineering leader
  • Deep experience with modern big data frameworks (e.g. Spark, Hadoop, Hive).
  • Streaming technologies (Kafka, Flink, Beam).
  • Strong CS fundamentals (data structures, algorithms) and coding skills.
  • Experience with containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience working on a B2C or B2B Product
  • This role is for engineers who are talking with their Product Managers about problems to solve and turning them into engineering solutions. They are naturally curious, problem solvers, and deeply understand the product they work on.
  • Must have experience dealing with messy/unreliable data (third party data sets, data integrations, migrations) 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, Azure).
  • Modern data storage solutions (Delta Lake, HBase, Hudi).
  • Scala

As part of our team you’ll enjoy:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Exceptional benefits package
  • Flexible Vacation & Paid Time Off
  • Employer-matched 401(k) plan 

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $200,000 - $265,000. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location, and the range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location, role-related knowledge and skills, depth of experience, relevant education or training, and additional role-related considerations.

Depending on the position offered, equity, bonuses, commission, or other forms of compensation may also be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and other benefits.

jobs.title: Manager, Inventory & Cost Accounting
jobs.description:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

Position Summary:

This position is responsible for leading the inventory and cost accounting function, ensuring accurate valuation of raw materials, work in process, and finished goods across recycling and energy operations. The role owns costing, inventory reserves, and variance analysis, and partners with Operations, and FP&A to explain cost drivers and margin performance. This position oversees month-end close activities for inventory and cost of goods sold, maintains the related internal controls, and supports external audit requests. Success in this role requires strong cost accounting knowledge, analytical judgment, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. This role is primarily performed in an office environment.

 

Responsibilities 

  • Own the month-end and quarter-end close for inventory and cost of goods sold, including journal entries, account reconciliations, and flux analysis
  • Drive process and systems improvement — own inventory transaction discipline (receipts, consumption, scrap, adjustments), and report performance to business leadership.
  • Oversee inventory valuation, and excess, obsolete, and lower-of-cost-or-market reserve analyses
  • Oversee inventory accounting for battery energy storage systems (BESS), including component and module costing, and valuation of completed systems held for sale or deployment
  • Partner with Operations, and FP&A to develop cost models and support product margin, and production analyses
  • Maintain and strengthen internal controls over inventory and costing processes and support external audit requests
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of cost accountants and analysts, and drive process and ERP system improvements within the function

 

Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities 

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA or CMA preferred
  • 6+ years of progressive accounting experience, including inventory and cost accounting in a manufacturing environment, with prior experience leading or supervising others
  • Working knowledge of US GAAP as applied to inventory valuation, standard costing, and variance analysis
  • Experience with ERP and costing systems (e.g., D365, Oracle) and advanced Excel skills, including work with large data sets
  • Ability to analyze information, interpret data, and support decision-making and problem-solving
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain financial results to non-financial stakeholders
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, shifting priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment

The position is full-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Role

These elements are never afterthoughts at Verkada; they are foundational to how we design our technology and a core differentiator that enables us to earn the trust of – and successfully sell to – some of the world’s largest organizations. 

In this role, you will lead the charge in proactively establishing Verkada as the undisputed leader in how a cloud-first physical security company should approach privacy and data security. You will go incredibly deep into the weeds of our technical architecture, becoming a subject matter expert who can be strategically deployed to create customer-facing collateral, go toe-to-toe with technical experts and executive buyers, and evangelize our privacy and security posture across the entire go-to-market engine.

This role is deeply cross-functional and requires you to bring together stakeholders across the Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Communications teams. You will also partner closely with Verkada’s Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) and Chief Privacy Officer. This role will report into our Director of Product Marketing.

We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires that you be on-site at our HQ in San Mateo, CA 5 days a week.

What You'll Do

  • Hone Verkada’s privacy and security narrative: Clearly articulate how Verkada differentiates itself, our fundamental approach to data protection, and how these practices deliver value to our customers. Refine and adapt our messaging and positioning strategies in response to product developments, competitor movements, and public sentiment.
  • Drive proactive privacy thought leadership and asset creation: Author, advise on, and elevate high-impact collateral – including technical whitepapers, one-pagers, blogs, videos, and sales decks – to position Verkada as the definitive authority in the space. Take complete ownership of the Verkada Trust Hub webpage, significantly expanding its depth to turn it into a comprehensive, best-in-class destination for public transparency.
  • Serve as a cross-functional subject matter expert: Act as a definitive expert on data privacy across our product portfolio. Unite Marketing, Sales, and Product teams to drive commercial results, lead Executive Briefing Center (EBC) sessions, and directly empower our field organization to navigate complex technical privacy evaluations.
  • Enable the go-to-market engine: Partner closely with Sales, Demand Generation, Creative, and Channel Marketing teams to accelerate pipeline growth. Translate complex hardware capabilities and technical privacy frameworks into high-impact outbound marketing assets and field collateral that directly improve win rates.

What You Bring

  • 4-8 years of product marketing experience in B2B technology or IoT
  • Exceptional writing skills with meticulous attention to detail and ability to write content for a variety of audiences, including highly technical content
  • Extreme curiosity and desire to dive deep into the weeds of all things privacy and enterprise data security. Even if you do not have a technical background, you are excited to spend hours learning the intricacies of Verkada’s architecture so you can feel confident speaking with highly technical buyers
  • Self-directed and able to operate independently in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience working cross-functionally with teams including Product, Communications, Sales, Demand Generation, and Creative
  • Bachelor’s degree required

Employee Benefits

Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:

  • Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs - Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans

  • Commuter benefits

Additional Information

Annual Pay Range

jobs.title: Outdoor Security Monitoring Specialist Evening/Overnight Shifts (Starting at $21/hr, On-Site)
jobs.description:
About SimpliSafe

We’re a high-tech home security company that’s passionate about protecting the life you’ve built. So, we’ve created a culture here that cares just as deeply about the career you’re building. Ours is a no-ego culture of collaboration and innovation where those seeking their next challenge can find big opportunities, and make a huge impact on the lives of all those that we protect. We don’t just want you to work here. We want you to grow and thrive here.

Our customers are protected by live professional monitoring agents - real people who always have their back. Our professional monitoring center is open and delivers fast emergency response 24/7, and our monitoring specialists are expected to work fully onsite using our advanced technology to keep our customers’ homes secure.

Why are we hiring?

Well, we’re growing and thriving. So, we need smart, talented, and humble people who share our values to join us as we relentlessly pursue our goal of ensuring everyone feels safe in their own home.

What You’ll Do:

  • Provide top-tier monitoring support to all customers with a goal of every home secure
  • Receive and respond to multiple emergency and non-emergency camera events by interacting with customers directly or via email communication
  • Ask questions to interpret, analyze and anticipate the situation to resolve problems, provide information, dispatch emergency services, or refer callers to other point of contacts
  • Enter clear and concise data in computer system database to maintain logs and records of calls, activities and other account information
  • Efficiently review and annotate images, ensuring timely completion of assigned tasks with excellent attention to detail
  • Stay abreast of company policy changes and updates with training material within the dispatcher role
  • Obtain multiple state regulatory licensing during the new hire training program and participate in all required renewal training to maintain multiple state regulatory licenses

What You’ll Bring: 

  • High School Diploma or equivalent
  • Ability to pass multiple state licensing background checks and monitoring related exams
  • 6 months to 12 months of prior monitoring experience is preferred
  • Proficiency in basic computer programs, including Microsoft Office and Excel
  • The ability to maintain self composure while providing a level of comfort and assurance during high intense emergency situations 
  • The ability to use judgment and decision-making skills to evaluate situations, establish priorities, and resolve matters
  • Strong work ethic and the drive to contribute to company goals
  • Ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment and excellent time management skills 
  • Ability to multitask with different, and sometimes conflicting, events happening at the same time
  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.
  • Proven record of outstanding attendance and timeliness in a structured environment

Requirements for the Position 

  • Ability to be 100% onsite
  • We are currently hiring for Day, Evening, and Overnight shifts. It requires 2 weeks of day training.

Must clear background checks to meet state central station operator licensing requirements in multiple states, requiring the ability to pass state and national background checks by having no criminal convictions, guilty or nolo contendere pleas back to age 18 (including convictions that have been sealed or expunged). These state law background check requirements typically apply to the following types of offenses: felonies, class 1 or class A misdemeanors (as these are commonly referred to in many state statutes, but this may vary from state to state), offenses involving theft, sexual offenses, violence, dishonesty or crimes against a person. 

What Values You’ll Share:

  • Customer Obsessed - Building deep empathy for customers and developing strong, long-term relationships with them.
  • Aim High - Always challenging oneself and others to raise the bar.
  • No Ego - “no job too small” attitude, and open, inclusive and humble style.
  • One Team - highly collaborative approach to achieving success.
  • Lift As We Climb - A track record of investing in developing others and helping others succeed.
  • Lean & Nimble - working with agility and efficiency to experiment in an often-ambiguous environment.

The target hourly pay rate for this role is $21.

This target hourly rate represents our good-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role. We use a market-based compensation approach to set our target hourly pay rate and make adjustments annually. We carefully tailor individual compensation packages, including base pay, taking into consideration employees’ job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and other relevant business factors. 

Beyond base pay, we offer a Total Rewards package that may include participation in our annual bonus program, equity, and other forms of compensation, in addition to a full range of medical, retirement, and lifestyle benefits. More details can be found here.
