About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role:

Franchise is one of Gusto's fastest-growing partner channels, and we are looking for a Partner Manager to own it. You will recruit and sign franchisors, and manage the partnerships once they are signed. When a franchisor becomes a Gusto partner, the franchisees in its network can access Gusto's payroll, benefits, and HR platform on partner terms. Franchisors are not traditional channel partners. They protect their brand, support independent owner-operators, and operate within legal limits on how they can endorse vendors. A signed agreement does not guarantee franchisee adoption. Your job is to make Gusto easy for a franchisor to approve and recommend, and to give franchisees a clear reason to choose us.   You will own the full partnership lifecycle for our managed partners (Silver through Platinum) and lead recruiting for our entry-level (Bronze) partners. You will work with a dedicated franchise Account Executive, the Mid-Market Sales team, Partner Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Legal. This role suits someone who enjoys building relationships with brand leaders, structuring agreements that work for both sides, and turning a growing partner portfolio into measurable customer growth.

 

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

Recruit franchisor partners

  • Identify, qualify, and sign franchisors across emerging, growth-stage, and mature brands, with a focus on sectors such as health and wellness, children's businesses, and home services.
  • Run discovery on every new partner application and serve as the franchisor's main point of contact through onboarding.
  • Build outbound campaigns using prospect lists, partner referrals, franchise sales organizations, industry associations, and competitive displacement opportunities. Use AI and sales tools to research and reach decision-makers.
  • Represent Gusto at franchise industry events and trade shows, and follow up so those events turn into signed partners.

Structure and manage partnerships

  • Place each new partner in the right program tier based on their expected franchisee growth and engagement.
  • Structure and negotiate partner agreements, working with Legal and Revenue Operations on terms such as offers, revenue share, and co-marketing commitments.
  • Own the full lifecycle for managed (Silver–Platinum) partners: onboarding, joint planning, performance reviews, and renewals. Recruit and onboard Bronze partners, who are supported mainly through our partner management platform.
  • Agree on rules of engagement with each partner that set how Gusto may reach their franchisees, so outreach is welcome and the brand relationship is protected.

Drive franchisee adoption

  • Work with the franchise Account Executive and Mid-Market Sales on a shared list of target brands. Recruit the franchisor while sales works with that brand's franchisees.
  • Coordinate with Partner Marketing on co-branded assets, landing pages, webinars, and event outreach.
  • Work with franchisor headquarters teams, such as franchise support, onboarding, and training, to build franchisee awareness.
  • Explore integrations with the operating platforms franchisors use, together with our product and integrations teams.

Manage performance and operations

  • Meet or exceed monthly and annual goals by forecasting accurately and managing a pipeline of partners from first conversation to signature and beyond.
  • Use Salesforce and our partner management tools to track pipeline, contacts, agreements, and results. Report on key partner metrics to leadership.
  • Run regular performance reviews and manage contract commitments with each partner.
  • Be a thought partner to your team and to cross-functional colleagues, and help improve how we run the franchise program.

Here’s what we're looking for:

  • 5–7 years of relationship management, partnerships, business development, sales, or channel management experience. We prefer candidates with franchise industry experience, such as working with franchisors, franchisee associations, or franchise sales organizations.
  • Experience closing and structuring partnership or vendor agreements, including commercial terms such as revenue share or unit economics.
  • A track record of building a pipeline through outbound prospecting and managing it from first conversation to signed agreement.
  • Comfort with data. You can set goals, forecast, and report on performance.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills, including with senior executives.
  • Experience with Salesforce is a plus. Experience with Outreach, partner management platforms, or fintech, HR, or payroll is also a plus.
  • AI fluency: you use AI tools in your daily work to research and prioritize prospects, draft and personalize outreach, analyze partner performance, and speed up routine tasks, and you apply your own judgment to the final result. You can describe how you build, refine, and check the AI workflows you use.
  • You are a quick learner who collaborates well. You are self-directed and resourceful, and you thrive in a fast-paced, changing environment where you think strategically and execute tactically.
  • You can manage a high volume of work while staying responsive to partners and teammates.

Our cash compensation amount for this role is targeted at $120,410 - $150,000 for the Denver metro location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate location, experience, and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above. In addition to base cash compensation, this role is eligible for an annual bonus based on role and department, and may be eligible for quarterly incentive programs.

At Gusto, we don't use titles the traditional way, as a signal of rank or hierarchy. Instead, our titles describe two things at once — your craft (what you do, e.g. Engineering, Design) and your scope of ownership (what you're accountable for) — which is why you'll see something like "Head of X" instead of a rank word like "Director" that tells you neither. Because of this, the title on this posting may look different from what you'd expect based on the scope and seniority of the role, and from how similar roles are typically titled elsewhere. If you have questions about how this role compares to your current title or level, your recruiter can help translate.

Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.

Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas. 

When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees.

Reliable, consistent presence: We expect regular and predictable attendance, whether you're working in-office, hybrid, or fully remote, so that you stay closely connected to your team, customers, and stakeholders in real time and ensure colleagues and customers receive the timely support and responsiveness they deserve.

Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto. 

Gusto is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Gusto considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Gusto is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. We want to see our candidates perform to the best of their ability. If you require a medical or religious accommodation at any time throughout your candidate journey, please fill out this form and a member of our team will get in touch with you.

Gusto takes security and protection of your personal information very seriously. Please review our Fraudulent Activity Disclaimer.

Personal information collected and processed as part of your Gusto application will be subject to Gusto's Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Industry Marketing, Financial Services Lead
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

Position Overview:

The Financial Services industry operates in one of the most complex, highly regulated, and high-stakes environments, where trust is hard-earned, customer expectations are rising, and the cost of getting it wrong is significant. Success demands exceptionally high standards across security, compliance, and customer experience, all while navigating legacy systems, fragmented data, and the growing pressure to innovate at the pace of a rapidly evolving digital world.

As Industry Marketing Lead for Financial Services, you know the industry inside and out, and you understand the evolving needs of marketers in this space. An extended member of the Braze Product Marketing team, you’ll own every element of how Braze shows up in this market. You’ll set the strategy, write the industry narrative and positioning, create the plays the field can run, and develop the solutions that address the financial marketer’s unique regulatory and engagement challenges. You’ll work closely with sales, product, partnerships, customer success teams, and other Braze marketing teams to build Braze’s Financial Services business. This role’s day-to-day allows for both building strategy and hands-on execution as we continue to invest in this key industry.

Key Responsibilities:

Architect the Industry Marketing strategy:

  • Lead the development and execution of a comprehensive marketing strategy tailored to the Financial Services industry.
  • Collaborate with revenue and product teams to align Braze’s products and value proposition with industry-specific marketing objectives and business outcomes.
  • Develop a go-to-market strategy targeting key Financial Services audiences, leveraging industry insights to drive platform adoption.
  • Build a roadmap of 1:many and 1:few assets (sub-industry POVs, GTM plays, pitch narratives, demo stories) for the most important segments of Financial Services

Own and deliver the financial services narrative and point of view

  • Develop and evolve Braze’s financial services narrative, including our sub-industry narratives.
  • Pair product launches with financial services insights and use cases. Show how our new products solve real financial services problems like driving deposits, streamlining onboarding and building long-term customer trust.   
  • Write sharp, data-backed thought leadership, building with media and research partners. Develop proprietary financial benchmarks and best practices.
  • Offer technical perspectives, considerations and trends as a part of the Financial Services narratives. 

Be the field’s financial services expert

  • Represent Braze on stage at Financial Services specific events and in Financial Services publications. 
  • Bring field and customer insight back to Product, PMM, Sales and leadership to shape priorities.
  • Collaborate on key enablement and education deliverables that help educate the broader organization on the Financial Services industry.
  • Support a small set of strategic pursuits and executive business reviews. Use what you learn there to improve how we go to market. 

Turn customers and partners into proof

  • Partner with Customer Success, Sales and Customer Marketing to find, develop and publish financial services customer evidence (case studies, quotes, speakers, references).
  • Work with Partnerships to build joint Financial Services stories with technology partners and services partners. Help bring partners into our Financial Services roadmap.
  • Train Revenue teams and facilitate the ongoing exchange of knowledge and best practices.

Who You Are:

  • Financial Services native. Ideally with a consumer-facing marketing background in banking, insurance, wealth management, or FinTech. 
  • You know how Financial Services brands run. You are well versed in customer acquisition and onboarding, product cross-sell, deepening wallet penetration, lifetime value, digital-first experiences, and the KPIs leaders are measured on.
  • Executive storyteller. You can turn complicated technology, including AI, into plain language a CMO or CFO cares about. You are an outstanding writer and presenter, and you easily adapt your messaging to your audience.
  • Builds to scale. You’d rather create a play 50 sellers use than a deck one seller uses.
  • Brings people along. You build trust across Sales, CS, PMM, Partnerships, Events and Content, and you push back when something’s off.
  • Uses AI at work. You use AI tools to research, write and build faster, and you can explain AI concepts like agentic, generative and predictive to customers.

Qualifications:

  • BA/BS degree required; MBA or relevant advanced degree a plus.
  • 7+ years in B2B marketing, product marketing, financial services marketing, consulting or a strategy role, with significant time focused on Financial Services.
  • A track record of building industry or go-to-market strategies that drove pipeline and revenue.
  • Strong executive presence; experience speaking at industry events is a plus.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams and managing relationships with key stakeholders.
  • Practical experience leveraging AI-powered marketing tools and automation to improve personalization, experimentation, operational efficiency, and team productivity
  • Experience with customer engagement, martech or data platforms (CEPs, CDPs, commerce platforms, data clouds) is a plus. 



For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $125,000 and $175,000/year, with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $146,000 and $205,000/year (including bonus or commission).Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

WHAT WE OFFER

Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

  • Competitive compensation that may include equity
  • Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
  • Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave
  • Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend
  • A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
  • Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching
  • Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze

jobs.title: Facilities Technician
jobs.description:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

We are seeking an experienced Facilities Technician to work across our office and production facilities to provide support for a variety of daily projects and initiatives. In this role you will be responsible for managing daily work requests, supporting daily rounds, facilities equipment checks, and providing support for a variety of maintenance tasks across the organization.

Demonstrated industrial HVAC experience is a must for this role. 

Experience in Facilities Maintenance, building automation, electrical systems, compressors, generators, forklifts and light construction preferred.

The role requires an eye for quality and the ability to execute on multiple tasks with minimal oversight. This individual must be able to work across a wide range of teams and disciplines in a dynamic and scrappy start up environment. Great leadership skills and the ability to drive actions across multiple stakeholders is a must.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Maintain Facilities systems Compressors, HVAC and general building systems
  • Ability to operate cranes, forklifts, and small construction equipment
  • Be able to troubleshoot and provide maintenance support for systems as needed
  • Manage basic projects and provide oversite of contractors and 3rd party work
  • Create and implement basic facilities SWI's
  • Complete daily tasks list and facilities work requests
  • Troubleshoot and respond to general facilities related issues
  • Working cross functionally across our operations teams on a variety of projects to support team growth and our continuous improvement goals

Desired Qualifications

  • At least two years of experience supporting Maintenance or Production organizations
  • Physical ability to lift heavy materials
  • Background in Facilities or Maintenance
  • Basic understanding of electrical systems
  • Ability to troubleshoot and repair at a high level
  • Self-motivated, hands-on mindset, with a willingness to contribute at all levels
  • Working with and maintaining tools and equipment necessary to perform work duties
  • A passion for sustainability and making the world a better place

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to safely and successfully perform the essential job functions consistent with the ADA, FMLA and other federal, state and local standards, including meeting qualitative and/or quantitative productivity standards
  • Ability to maintain regular, punctual attendance consistent with the ADA, FMLA and other federal, state and local standards
  • Must be able to lift and carry up to 100 lbs
  • Must be able to bend, lift, and carry objects over 50 lbs
  • Must be able to walk up and down stairs carrying weight
  • Must be able to talk, listen and speak clearly on telephone

The position is full-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

We collect your PI for our purposes, including performing services and operations related to your potential employment. If you have additional privacy-related questions, please contact us at privacy@redwoodmaterials.com.

Position Overview:

The Financial Services industry operates in one of the most complex, highly regulated, and high-stakes environments, where trust is hard-earned, customer expectations are rising, and the cost of getting it wrong is significant. Success demands exceptionally high standards across security, compliance, and customer experience, all while navigating legacy systems, fragmented data, and the growing pressure to innovate at the pace of a rapidly evolving digital world.

As Industry Marketing Lead for Financial Services, you know the industry inside and out, and you understand the evolving needs of marketers in this space. An extended member of the Braze Product Marketing team, you’ll own every element of how Braze shows up in this market. You’ll set the strategy, write the industry narrative and positioning, create the plays the field can run, and develop the solutions that address the financial marketer’s unique regulatory and engagement challenges. You’ll work closely with sales, product, partnerships, customer success teams, and other Braze marketing teams to build Braze’s Financial Services business. This role’s day-to-day allows for both building strategy and hands-on execution as we continue to invest in this key industry.

Key Responsibilities:

Architect the Industry Marketing strategy:

  • Lead the development and execution of a comprehensive marketing strategy tailored to the Financial Services industry.
  • Collaborate with revenue and product teams to align Braze’s products and value proposition with industry-specific marketing objectives and business outcomes.
  • Develop a go-to-market strategy targeting key Financial Services audiences, leveraging industry insights to drive platform adoption.
  • Build a roadmap of 1:many and 1:few assets (sub-industry POVs, GTM plays, pitch narratives, demo stories) for the most important segments of Financial Services

Own and deliver the financial services narrative and point of view

  • Develop and evolve Braze’s financial services narrative, including our sub-industry narratives.
  • Pair product launches with financial services insights and use cases. Show how our new products solve real financial services problems like driving deposits, streamlining onboarding and building long-term customer trust.   
  • Write sharp, data-backed thought leadership, building with media and research partners. Develop proprietary financial benchmarks and best practices.
  • Offer technical perspectives, considerations and trends as a part of the Financial Services narratives. 

Be the field’s financial services expert

  • Represent Braze on stage at Financial Services specific events and in Financial Services publications. 
  • Bring field and customer insight back to Product, PMM, Sales and leadership to shape priorities.
  • Collaborate on key enablement and education deliverables that help educate the broader organization on the Financial Services industry.
  • Support a small set of strategic pursuits and executive business reviews. Use what you learn there to improve how we go to market.

jobs.title: Director, Manufacturing Analytics
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the role

The Director, Manufacturing Analytics owns Manufacturing Analytics globally: every site, every product line, and every Manufacturing function across Manufacturing Engineering, Manufacturing Operations, Supply Chain, Planning, and Warehousing / Material Management. The ambition is not better dashboards. It is that a division leader can tell whether they will hit rate before they miss it, and that when we argue about where to invest, the argument is settled by data rather than by whoever presents best.

ABOUT THE JOB

This is a player-coach role. You will lead the hardest analytical problems yourself, on the programs that matter most to the company, and build a team that can run several more in parallel. You will be judged on what you accomplish, not on how you operate: whether a program hit rate that would otherwise have slipped, whether a constraint got cleared because we saw it coming, whether a number leadership used to make a real decision came from this team.
We weigh approach over domain familiarity. The strongest analytics leaders we have are exceptional at how they attack a problem, even where they arrived without the functional background. Manufacturing depth is useful and listed below as preferred, but it does not substitute for analytical method, judgment about what matters, and the ability to drive a result through an organization.

What you'll do

  • Apply analytics to manufacturing’s biggest problems. Hold an evidence-backed view of what is worth the company's attention and in what order, rather than working a request list. Take the hardest two or three problems in Anduril's flagship programs and build analytics into them end to end, hands-on.
  • Make the various business units in Anduril decide earlier. Shift Manufacturing reporting from retrospective to leading: risk surfaced two months before the gate, not status recited on the day of it. Adoption is the deliverable. A correct dashboard nobody opens has failed.
  • Turn what worked into the enterprise standard. Generalize proven capabilities into supported products, standardize the definitions the work proved out, and consolidate the duplicated reporting they replace. A standard that survives contact with a program running at rate is defensible. One written in a document is not.
  • Answer what it takes to scale. Own the analytical side of a ramp from low rate to high rate, and keep a current, evidenced view of the constraints that actually bind as the company grows.
  • Build the team and the foundation. Lead the consolidated analytics organization and the managers within it. Build on and in the Manufacturing process/team rather than beside them. Hold the line that the various business units own master data quality while the analytics team builds the tooling that makes defects visible and cheap to fix.
  • Your work should produce numbers the business can trust. Where a metric is known to be wrong, it is a defect with an owner and a date, not a caveat on a slide. Fix the data before building on top of it.

Required qualifications

  • 10+ years in analytics, data, or quantitative operations, including 5+ years leading analytics or data teams, and experience managing managers or clear readiness to do so.
  • A rigorous, teachable approach to ambiguous problems. You can describe how you decide what to work on, how you structure an analysis, how you know when you're wrong, and how you install that method in a team.
  • Genuinely hands-on. Strong SQL and a modern data stack, able to get into a dataset personally, find the answer, and defend the method. This role does not succeed as pure management.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify the highest-value problem in a messy operational environment and solve it analytically.
  • A track record you can point at: specific operational outcomes your work caused, with the numbers, the program, and the skeptics named.
  • Experience shipping analytics as supported products with real users, and retiring what they replace.
  • Able to influence business unit and functional leadership peer-to-peer without authority, and to work credibly with a program team that starts out unconvinced.
  • Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance. U.S. person status required per ITAR/EAR.

Preferred qualifications

  • Operational depth in manufacturing, supply chain, or planning, including fluency with routings, work orders, MRP exceptions, and cycle counts.
  • Analytical ownership of a Manufacturing ramp from low rate to high rate.
  • Experience building an analytics function from a scattered starting point, consolidating people, standards, and tooling that previously sat under separate owners.
  • Databricks and Palantir Foundry, dimensional modeling and semantic or ontology layers.
  • High-rate or high-mix manufacturing, defense Manufacturing, or another environment scaling volume fast.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

 

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. 

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

 

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/. 

 

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

 Email Operations is currently in a transition period of rebuilding and growth, which means you will have a direct hand in determining what the future of our team looks like. We are looking for a hands-on, highly motivated self-starter who is excited to help us lay the groundwork. This is a rare chance to be a foundational building block of our team, where your voice and work will actively shape our path forward

Demand for Braze email services is rapidly increasing. Email is an established channel where there are different technical considerations than our SDK-based messaging channels, and there will be an opportunity for the analyst to learn the tools and processes, to successfully execute our email onboarding experience. You will collaborate with a diverse cast across GTM teams, Product, Sales, RevOps, Growth, Alliances, SMS Ops and our email partners. You’ll also be involved in other strategic initiatives critical to scaling our fast growing team. If you’re obsessed with problem solving, measuring success and surfacing opportunities through data, we want to meet you!

OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE

  • Manage complex email infrastructure initiatives, including IP Pool strategy, allocation processes, and capacity planning to improve scalability, reliability, and customer onboarding timelines.
  • Own and resolve high-scale technical escalations and complex customer setup challenges, serving as the ultimate subject matter expert to diagnose infrastructure anomalies, optimize deliverability, and advise internal and external stakeholders.
  • Develop deep expertise in email best practices, industry standards, compliance requirements, and evolving technologies to guide operational decisions and customer outcomes.
  • Partner closely with Email Deliverability, Product, Engineering, Sales and Success teams to influence roadmap priorities, operational strategies, and business initiatives.
  • Design, create, and maintain scalable operational frameworks, including best practices, compliance guidelines, playbooks, and enablement materials to support growth into new markets, email providers, and CDN partnerships.
  • Identify gaps in tooling, workflows, and processes; partner with internal teams to define requirements and drive improvements that increase automation and operational efficiency.
  • Establish mechanisms for tracking operational issues, trends, and root causes to improve reliability and prevent recurring challenges.
  • Provide strategic input into tooling enhancements, automation opportunities, and operational programs that improve customer onboarding, scalability, and team effectiveness.
  • Mentor and support junior team members by sharing expertise, improving operational practices, and contributing to a culture of continuous improvement.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You learn quickly and thrive in complexity, with the ability to master sophisticated systems, understand interconnected workflows, and apply sound judgment when processes or requirements are ambiguous
  • You have a high bar for quality and operational excellence, balancing speed with accuracy and consistently delivering reliable outcomes while identifying opportunities to improve the quality of the broader operation
  • You are deeply empathetic and customer-centric, able to understand customer needs, anticipate pain points, and translate customer insights into operational and product improvements
  • You are highly process-oriented and systems-minded, able to bring structure to ambiguous or chaotic environments by designing clear, scalable processes, establishing best practices, and identifying opportunities to eliminate unnecessary complexity
  • You operate independently and with strong ownership, proactively identifying problems, setting priorities, making decisions, and driving work forward with limited direction while knowing when to bring in the right stakeholders
  • You are an effective cross-functional partner and influencer, comfortable working with Services, Product, Engineering, Support, and other teams to build alignment, resolve complex problems, and drive outcomes without relying solely on formal authority
  • You embrace automation and continuous improvement, actively looking for ways to reduce manual effort, improve consistency, leverage technology, and create operational leverage at scale
  • You are motivated by building for scale, with a passion for helping Services teams evolve from manual, reactive processes toward efficient, scalable, and measurable operating models
  • You communicate with clarity and influence, adapting your communication to technical & non-technical audiences and effectively aligning stakeholders around priorities, decisions, and outcomes
  • You raise the bar for those around you, sharing knowledge, mentoring teammates, establishing best practices, and helping create a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and operational excellence

WHAT YOU HAVE

  • 5–7+ years of experience in an operational, technical, or customer-facing role supporting a technical product, ideally within a SaaS, mobile, marketing automation, or email technology environment
  • Demonstrated experience owning complex operational issues end-to-end, using sound judgment to navigate ambiguity, balance competing priorities, and deliver high-quality outcomes for customers
  • Strong understanding of email systems and/or messaging infrastructure, with the ability to diagnose issues, understand technical concepts, and partner effectively with engineering, product, support, and other technical teams
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions, build alignment across teams, communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences, and drive resolution on complex or high-impact issues
  • Proven ability to identify operational gaps and drive meaningful improvements, including developing scalable processes, improving tooling and workflows, reducing recurring issues, and raising the quality and efficiency of operational execution
  • Highly analytical and data-driven, with experience defining and monitoring meaningful metrics, using data to identify trends and root causes, and translating insights into clear actions that improve business and customer outcomes
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with a track record of independently navigating ambiguous problems, identifying root causes, evaluating tradeoffs, and determining appropriate solutions without requiring significant direction
  • Hands-on and execution-oriented, while operating with a broader ownership mindset: able to manage day-to-day operational responsibilities while simultaneously identifying opportunities to improve the systems, processes, and customer experience around them
  • Demonstrated leadership through influence, including mentoring or enabling teammates, establishing best practices, sharing knowledge, and raising the operational bar across the broader organization
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with the ability to set priorities, manage multiple workstreams, communicate risks proactively, and consistently deliver against measurable goals
  • Bonus Points:
    • Knowledge of the Braze ecosystem
    • Knowledge of SparkPost, SendGrid, and/or Amazon Simple Email Services email systems
    • Experience with other tools like FinancialForce, Tray.io, Looker, Slackbots, PagerDuty, etc

WHAT YOU HAVE

  • Minimum of 2 years of successful experience in saas or AI sales, leading a team of quota-carrying Overlay Sellers or AI/Product Specialists Sellers, ideally in the Enterprise sector  
  • A proven ability to recruit, retain, inspire, and develop top talent
  • Proven experience in leading teams through the full-cycle SaaS upsells: prospecting, whitespace mapping, upsell/cross sell execution, and long-term relationship growth
  • Ability to coordinate and work cross-functionally internally with internal constituencies, including Sales Directors, AE’s, Renewal Managers, Marketing, Customer Success, Legal, and Sales Operations
  • Experience building teams and processes from the ground up
  • Outstanding verbal and written communication skills
  • Excellent commercial and legal negotiation skills
  • Strong technical and business acumen; the ability to engage with multiple customer personas across a wide variety of industries and within both technical and marketing functional roles
  • Experience selling agentic solutions or selling Marketing Technology is a strong plus

    For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $120,000 and $165,000/year, with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $236,000 and $336,000/year (including bonus or commission).Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.  #LI-Hybrid

Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

  • Competitive compensation that may include equity
  • Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans
  • Flexible paid time off

ABOUT BRAZE

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.

The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025.

Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore.

The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.

Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you.

We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you

OUR AI-POWERED BRAZE RECRUITMENT PROCESS

At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.

This includes using AI to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. Such screening may amount to a form of solely automated decision-making. We also use AI for administrative support, like scheduling and recording interviews and summarizing interview notes. Our recruiting teams remain responsible for all hiring decisions and are involved throughout the process.

Depending on where you are located, you may have certain rights available to you in relation to Braze’s use of AI:

  • To opt out of AI-assisted review of your application, please click the “Learn More” at the end of the application form below and follow the instructions before submitting your application. Please note, if you apply to multiple roles at Braze, you will need to opt out in relation to each application.
  • To exercise other types of rights, such as rights to request further information about how AI is used in our recruitment process, to request a retroactive manual review of any decision made or to contest a decision, please contact us at talentdata.privacy@braze.com. 

Please contact us at talentdata.privacy@braze.com with any questions. To find out more about our hiring process, check out this page.

jobs.title: Experienced Automotive Technician
jobs.description:
We’re looking for automotive mechanics with a minimum of 3 years of professional automotive repair experience to join us at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500.

As an Experienced Auto Technician, you will perform a full range of automotive repairs—from light maintenance to heavy engine work—and diagnostics on our vehicles, including:

  • Performing general to complex repairs on all makes and models, ranging from timing belts and suspension systems to heavy engine work.
  • Diagnosing and repairing advanced vehicle electrical issues, including work on electric and hybrid vehicles.
  • Completing repairs for wheel bearings and axles, as well as vehicle climate control systems including ACs and heater cores.

At Carvana, you’ll receive a competitive wage and amazing perks – including but not limited to: 100% company paid healthcare, dental & vision insurance, a 401(k with a Carvana match and even a vehicle purchase discount – all while using state of the art tools in one of our high-tech Inspection Centers (click here to learn more). If you’re joining us in an entry-level position, we offer training programs to make sure your skills and pay progress along with the company.

Other perks of the Job

  • 100% company-paid healthcare premiums
  • Generous paid-time off and your birthday is a holiday!
  • ASE and tool reimbursement programs
  • Tuition reimbursement and student loan repayment

 

Schedule: 

We do everything we can to deliver an exceptional customer experience, and that includes delivering great vehicles when expected. If we're in a pinch, mandatory overtime is one way in which we can follow-through on this commitment to our customers. We're looking for team players who are all in on our mission and are able to work mandatory overtime based on our business needs. 

How To Get Started
Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 508-4749, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM MST.

Not a match for this role?
We have a variety of Technician roles in our Inspection Centers, depending on your level of experience - take a look below to see what you’ll be doing to help us get our low-mileage, late-model cars ready for our customers.  

  • Entry-Level Auto Technician (min 6 months professional experience): perform light maintenance, fluid checks, and/or conduct the initial inspection on our vehicles to look for any imperfections or repairs that may be needed throughout the reconditioning process.
  • Brake and Tire Technician (min 1 year professional experience): perform light maintenance or repairs, including changing brakes and tires

We also have a variety of other automotive roles available across our Inspection Center network. Check out our Careers site to learn more!

General qualifications and requirements

  • Ability to physically operate vehicle equipment and tools - must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently
  • Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Some positions may be subject to an Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check
  • An ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing production environment while sometimes being exposed to excessive weather conditions (heat/cold)
  • Use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment

About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM
The Structural Analysis Team ensures product integrity and performance across the company. We provide cross-product support for emerging innovations, establish the benchmark for analysis excellence, and offer critical surge support to programs requiring specialized expertise. Our team drives the adoption of unified tools and methodologies, leveraging deep expertise in static and dynamic analysis, physical testing, data collection, and signal processing to solve complex engineering challenges.

ABOUT THE JOB
We are looking for a Structural Analysis Engineer to work in Costa Mesa, CA, with In-depth understanding of statics, dynamics, mechanics of materials, and materials properties.

WHAT YOU’LL DO
  • Perform static and dynamic structural analyses across sea, ground, air, and space domains using first principles and appropriate analysis methods (hand calculations, spreadsheets, scripts, detailed FEA)
  • Develop and own FEM creation and organization at the global and subsystem level
  • Collaborate with hardware engineers to drive proper designs based on analytical results
  • Conduct and support validation testing, including instrumentation setup, data collection, and model correlation
  • Document analysis methodology and results in technical reports for internal teams and external stakeholders
  • Ensure designs meet customer requirements, industry standards, and safety regulations
  • Stay current with advancements in analysis techniques, materials technology, and industry standards
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • BS or higher degree in engineering or applied physics with a focus in structures
  • Deep understanding of statics, dynamics, mechanics of materials, and materials properties
  • Proficiency in FEA software (NASTRAN/ Abaqus preferred) solution sequences for linear and non-linear static, dynamic and buckling analyses
  • Experience with CAD tools (NX, Solidworks)
  • Proficiency in Matlab or Python (or equivalent) for developing analytical models, data acquisition, and automation
  • Highly motivated, self-starting, and able to perform duties autonomously without supervision
  • Very organized and willing to establish scope and requirements for ill- defined problems
PREFERRED QUALIFICATION
  • 5+ years of experience in a structures, dynamics, or loads related role with high ownership and accountability for hardware outcomes
  • MS or higher degree in engineering or applied physics with a focus in structures
  • Be able to obtain / maintain a U.S. Top Secret security clearance
  • Ability to develop workflow automation tools

$132,000—$175,000 USD

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

jobs.title: Brake and Tire Technician
jobs.description:
We’re looking for Automotive Mechanics with a minimum of 1 year of professional automotive repair experience to join us at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500.

As a Brake & Tire Technician, you’ll be expected to perform light maintenance or repairs, including changing brakes and tires and performing:

  • Technician services, such as routine inspections/maintenance
  • Basic mechanical repair for brake pads/calipers/rotors, tire installations, and wheel alignments


At Carvana, you’ll receive a competitive wage and amazing perks – including a 401(k) with Carvana match and even a vehicle purchase discount – all while using state of the art tools in one of our high-tech Inspection Centers (click here to learn more). If you’re joining us in an entry-level position, we offer training programs to make sure your skills and pay progress along with the company.


Other perks of the Job

  • 100% company-paid healthcare premiums
  • Generous paid-time off and your birthday is a holiday!
  • ASE and tool reimbursement programs
  • Tuition reimbursement and student loan repayment

How To Get Started
Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 508-4749, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM MST.

Not a match for this role?
We have a variety of Technician roles in our Inspection Centers, depending on your level of experience - take a look below to see what you’ll be doing to help us get our low-mileage, late-model cars ready for our customers:

  • Entry-Level Auto Technician (min 6 months professional experience): perform light maintenance, fluid checks, and/or conduct the initial inspection on our vehicles to look for any imperfections or repairs that may be needed throughout the reconditioning process.
  • Brake and Tire Technician (min 1 year professional experience): perform light maintenance or repairs, including changing brakes and tires
  • Mid-Level (Mechanical Repair / Build / General) Technician (min 3 years of professional experience): perform light to medium automotive repairs and minimal diagnostics on our vehicles
  • Experienced Technician (min 5 years of professional experience): perform extensive repairs and heavy engine work, as well as advanced vehicle diagnostics on all makes and models, including electric and hybrid vehicles

We also have a variety of other automotive roles available in one of our 18 locations across the country – take a look at our Careers site to apply for one of the following roles:

  • Auto Body roles: Paint, Prep/Body work, Wheel Repair, Airbrush, Interior Repair, Glass Repair, and PDR (Paintless Dent Repair) roles
  • Auto Technician/Mechanic roles: Lube and Oil, Inspection, Brake and Tire, Mechanical Repair / Build, and Master Technician roles

General qualifications and requirements

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive - K-12
jobs.description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Enterprise Account Executive - K-12 

Why We Have This Role

At Qualtrics, our Enterprise sales teams tackle high-stakes institutional challenges, driving digital and cultural transformation across the nation’s largest school districts and state agencies. In this role, you will lead transformative Experience Management (XM) initiatives across Tier-1 public school systems, regional educational agencies, and state DOEs to solve critical challenges—from school climate and educator retention to community engagement. You will serve as an executive strategic advisor to Superintendents, Cabinets, and elected School Boards, orchestrating complex multi-stakeholder sales campaigns. Working closely with internal deal teams—including Solutions Engineers, Education Strategists, Professional Services, and RFP Specialists—you will champion solutions that elevate student voice and reshape public education.

How You’ll Find Success

  • Consultative Executive Advising: You thrive on establishing trusted partnerships with Superintendents, CAOs, CTOs, and School Board members, aligning software solutions directly with district strategic plans.

  • Complex Deal Orchestration: You love navigating long, multi-stakeholder enterprise cycles (6–18 months) and mobilizing cross-functional experts to deliver compelling proposals.

  • Public Sector Acumen: You are energized by mastering the nuances of public procurement, including state purchasing cooperatives (e.g., Omnia, TIPS), formal RFP/bids, and federal funding streams (Title I, II-A, IV).

  • Strategic Territory Ownership: You take pride in building targeted account plans, executing disciplined land-and-expand strategies, and maintaining rigorous pipeline hygiene using MEDDPICC and Command of the Message.

  • Autonomous Drive: You excel with the operational freedom to run your territory remotely while traveling on-site (25%–40%) to lead high-impact board and cabinet presentations.

How You’ll Grow

  • Executive Leadership Pathways: Access structured leadership tracks, executive coaching, and continuous product enablement to accelerate your career.

  • Category-Defining Influence: Deepen your domain mastery by expanding the Experience Management (XM) category across the public sector and statewide education systems.

  • High-Complexity Deal Mastery: Hone your enterprise acumen by closing seven-figure, multi-year public sector agreements at scale.

Things You’ll Do

  • Drive Strategic District Penetration: Formulate and execute account-level business plans for Tier-1 districts to successfully navigate budget seasons, long sales cycles, and school board approvals.

  • Achieve ARR Impact: Meet and exceed annual seven-figure ARR targets through new logo acquisition, large-scale enterprise expansions, and multi-year contracts ($150K–$1M+ ACV).

  • Deliver Value-Based Executive Advisory: Partner with district c-suites and board members to identify critical climate, staffing, and community gaps, mapping them to Qualtrics XM outcomes.

  • Mobilize Cross-Functional Deal Teams: Lead Solutions Engineers, Education Strategists, RFP Specialists, and Executive Sponsors to craft winning, compliant public sector bids and presentations.

  • Master Procurement & Public Funding: Align enterprise deals with cooperative contracts and federal/state funding allocations (Title I, Title II-A, Title IV, state legislative grants) to accelerate contract execution.

  • Maintain Operational Rigor: Deliver reliable quarterly forecasts, disciplined pipeline tracking, and MEDDPICC qualification within Salesforce.com, Gong, and Clari.

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume

  • Enterprise Quota Attainment: A documented track record of carrying enterprise SaaS quota and consistently hitting or exceeding seven-figure annual ARR targets.

  • Complex Multi-Stakeholder Deals: Proven experience running 6- to 18-month consultative sales cycles with high ACVs ($150K–$1M+) and formal buying committees.

  • Public Sector & Education Sales Background: Direct experience selling software, data, or analytics platforms into K-12 school districts, state/local government, or public sector agencies (with established relationships across Superintendents and state agencies preferred).

  • Procurement & Bidding Competence: Demonstrated success navigating formal RFPs/RFIs, state purchasing cooperatives, and public funding mechanisms.

  • Modern Sales Stack Mastery: Hands-on experience executing with MEDDPICC or Command of the Message, alongside CRM and sales intelligence platforms (Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Gong, Clari).

  • Education & Mobility: Bachelor’s degree and ability to travel 25%–40% for client meetings and national conferences.

What You Should Know About This Team

  • Qualtrics’  K-12 Account Executive team is dedicated to changing the way our customers focus on Experience data. Forrester reports that companies generate a 674% return on investment when using Qualtrics. Now that’s a solution you can get behind!

  • As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will focus on growing new revenue through strategic, relationship-based selling, a hunter mentality, and educating prospective and current customers on the value of Qualtrics XM. Our most successful Account Executives have a track record of exceeding quota, acting as trusted advisors to clients, and being passionate teammates.

  • The challenge? Qualtrics XM is a very versatile platform, adding value to a limitless array of decision makers. If you love a strategic, analytical sales process and working with a variety of stakeholders, selling Qualtrics XM will always keep you learning and growing.

Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits

  • Salary + Uncapped Commissions and Accelerators
  • 100% Performance based promotions -- not politics or tenure
  • Catered lunch
  • Culture - Incredible work environment - you can wear jeans and bring your dog to the office, anytime
  • Quarterly team activities, winter and summer parties, and lots of Qualtrics swag

The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model: Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #Remote

jobs.title: AI Architect
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

As an AI Architect, you will accelerate adoption of BrazeAI capabilities and services by working directly with customers at critical moments to identify and prioritize use cases and activate their first AI and agentic use cases. 

Since 2025, Braze has launched a suite of Agentic AI products, including Decisioning Studio, Agent Console, Operator, and MCP capabilities. Every Braze customer is on their own AI transformation journey, with many marketers needing additional support to better understand the best application of these capabilities for their unique needs.  The AI Architects will meet these customers where they are at to educate and advise so they get the best return on their AI investments with Braze.  This includes running workshops, diagnostics, and accelerators to take marketers through ideation, prototyping, and launch of their first BrazeAI agents.

You will work collaboratively and build trusted relationships with technical and non-technical stakeholders, leading with curiosity and inspiring others to evolve their marketing strategies with AI. The role is consultative: you pair deep Braze core knowledge (Canvas, Catalogs, Content Blocks, Liquid, data ingestion) with understanding marketing strategies and effective applications of BrazeAI. 

The role requires travel, up to 25% at peak times, and is based in London.

ACTIVITIES

  • Lead customer engagements focused on driving adoption, for example:
    • BrazeAI Workshops: marketers leave with one or two agents built or prototyped and a way to measure their impact
    • AI Accelerators a 2–6 week engagement with a named objective and weekly working sessions, guiding the customer from use case ideation to the launch and initial impact reporting of the new strategy
    • AI Diagnostics: assess a customer's messaging program, data, and current BrazeAI use, benchmark their maturity, and deliver 3–5 prioritized actions and a read on readiness for our AI Expert Services add-ons

  • Demonstrate and document best practices, playbooks and AI solutions recipes to existing customers and key partners.
  • Work with customers to identify and prioritize use cases that will drive their business goals
  • Identify technical hurdles for customers looking to adopt BrazeAI, resolve organizational friction to enable decision making to drive adoption
  • Recommend Professional Services partners for additional or extended support needs, and help transition context and diagnostics to other services teams
  • Provide thought leadership - internally and externally - on how AI enables marketing teams drive better business outcomes
  • Collaborate cross-functionally (e.g., account management, customer success, professional services, AI success, product, marketing, learning and communities) to continuously improve Braze's products and externally facing materials
  • Strong written and verbal English language skills are essential

WHO YOU ARE

  • Collaborative and trusted: You are experienced working directly with enterprise customers and develop strong, consultative relationships. You lead with curiosity and have deep empathy for customers. You have a demonstrated track record of persuading others and influencing without owning the account
  • An engaging facilitator: You have had experience running workshops, hackathons, enablement programs, or embedded consulting engagements. You are an enthusiastic presenter who can run a room of marketers with very different skill levels and have them building within the hour. You’re able to adapt your message to marketers vs executives on their road to AI adoption
  • Experienced: You have 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role such as solutions consulting, sales engineering, technical account management, customer success, or marketing technology consulting
  • Braze-savvy: You have worked with Braze enough to look at a Canvas, a Catalog, or a whole strategy and be able to determine opportunities with BrazeAI that would improve business outcomes
  • Intellectual curiosity and fluency in Applied AI: You understand how generative AI and agents apply to marketing, including prompt design, guardrails, evaluation, testing and optimization. You have experience with MCP, LLM tooling, or building skills and templates for AI assistants

Value-driven: You are able to build business cases and/or measure ROI on AI investments particularly for a credit consumption model.

  • Mar-tech savvy: You understand the marketing technology ecosystem and can develop a perspective on the most effective ways to structure a customer's solution, with domain knowledge in two or more of: AI and LLMs, SaaS, marketing automation, marketing analytics, APIs, SQL and Liquid, or mobile
  • Structured and organized: You can take initiative to structure a working plan, clearly define objectives, prioritize activities across multiple engagements at one time and you’re comfortable building process while doing the work
  • A problem solver: You are able to break a complex problem into components and collaborate with the right people to efficiently get to a solution

NICE TO HAVE

  • Hands-on time with Agent Console, Operator, Decisioning Studio, or Content Optimizer; 
  • Depth in a vertical we sell into heavily, such as retail and eCommerce, QSR, gaming, media, or financial services, to help identify use cases

 #LI-Hybrid

 

WHAT WE OFFER

Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

  • Competitive compensation that may include equity
  • Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
  • Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave
  • Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend
  • A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
  • Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching
  • Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze
  • Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®

ABOUT BRAZE

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.

The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025.

Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore.
