jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer, Energy Storage
jobs.location: Carson City, NV; San Francisco, California, United States
jobs.description:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

Position Summary: 

The Senior Electrical Engineer, Energy Storage designs and develops the system controller hardware that serves as the brain of Redwood's next-generation high-power electromechanical products — power converters that interface with battery packs, battery modules, photovoltaic (PV) systems, and the grid for large-scale energy storage applications, including AI data centers. This is a fully on-site role, based at 100 Hooper or LH 2. The engineer independently owns the low-voltage (LV) electrical system architecture, including system controller PCBA design, MCU selection and communication protocols, isolated sensing circuits, auxiliary power supplies, and protective circuits (breaker/contactor drivers, E-stop loops), devising solutions to new and unusual system-integration challenges from limited precedents. The role partners extensively with Mechanical, Firmware/Controls, Systems, Compliance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Reliability teams to define requirements and take designs from concept through production. Success depends on sound engineering judgment, hands-on lab validation skills, and the ability to resolve ambiguous system-level trade-offs with limited direction. 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities 

  • Own low-voltage (LV) electrical system architecture for power electronics products, including the system controller PCBA that coordinates parallel/series-connected power converter modules 
  • Design and integrate system controller hardware, including MCU selection, communication protocols (CAN, Ethernet, etc.), and control logic for module synchronization, current-sharing, and startup/shutdown sequencing 
  • Design isolated sensing circuits (current, voltage, temperature feedback) and auxiliary power supply architecture across LV subsystems (~100W) 
  • Design and coordinate protective circuits (breaker/contactor drivers, hardware interlock/E-stop loops), ensuring insulation coordination and high-voltage safety compliance at the system level 
  • Define LV wiring architecture, grounding, and interconnect strategy across the entire product and sub power modules 
  • Lead electrical testing and validation for system controller PCBA and complete power electronics products, including power cycling, fault analysis, and performance characterization 
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Mechanical, Controls/Firmware, Validation, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Reliability, Compliance) to define system requirements, test specifications, and achieve industry certifications (e.g., IEEE 1547, UL 1741) 

Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities  

  • BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, with a focus on embedded systems, controls, or power electronics 
  • 3–5 years of experience in electrical engineering, with a strong focus on system-level control architecture for power conversion or energy storage products 
  • Hands-on experience designing MCU-based system controllers, including MCU selection, memory/peripheral budgeting, and system-level control for power converters 
  • Experience with industrial communication protocols (CAN, Ethernet) for module-to-controller and controller-to-grid/BMS interfaces 
  • Deep understanding of protection coordination (breaker/contactor drivers, hardware interlock and E-stop loops, fault detection and sequencing logic) and proficiency with circuit simulation/CAD tools (e.g., Altium Designer, LTspice, Simulink) 
  • Demonstrated ability to lay out control PCBs in noise-sensitive, high-power environments, and proficiency with lab equipment (oscilloscopes, logic/protocol analyzers, signal generators) 
  • Ability to travel up to 10% of the time 

In accordance with California pay transparency laws, the salary range for this position is listed below. Actual compensation may vary based on a variety of factors, including experience, education, and skills. 

California Pay Range:
$120,000—$155,000 USD

The position is full-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

Every Braze customer is on their own AI transformation journey, with many marketers needing additional support to better understand the best application of these capabilities for their unique needs.  The AI Architects will meet these customers where they are at to educate and advise so they get the best return on their AI investments with Braze.  This includes running workshops, diagnostics, and accelerators to take marketers through ideation, prototyping, and launch of their first BrazeAI agents.

You will work collaboratively and build trusted relationships with technical and non-technical stakeholders, leading with curiosity and inspiring others to evolve their marketing strategies with AI. The role is consultative: you pair deep Braze core knowledge (Canvas, Catalogs, Content Blocks, Liquid, data ingestion) with understanding marketing strategies and effective applications of BrazeAI. 

The role requires travel, up to 25% at peak times, and is based in Austin supporting our AMER region.

ACTIVITIES

  • Lead customer engagements focused on driving adoption, for example:
    • BrazeAI Workshops: marketers leave with one or two agents built or prototyped and a way to measure their impact
    • AI Accelerators a 2–6 week engagement with a named objective and weekly working sessions, guiding the customer from use case ideation to the launch and initial impact reporting of the new strategy
    • AI Diagnostics: assess a customer's messaging program, data, and current BrazeAI use, benchmark their maturity, and deliver 3–5 prioritized actions and a read on readiness for our AI Expert Services add-ons

  • Demonstrate and document best practices, playbooks and AI solutions recipes to existing customers and key partners.
  • Work with customers to identify and prioritize use cases that will drive their business goals
  • Identify technical hurdles for customers looking to adopt BrazeAI, resolve organizational friction to enable decision making to drive adoption
  • Recommend Professional Services partners for additional or extended support needs, and help transition context and diagnostics to other services teams
  • Provide thought leadership - internally and externally - on how AI enables marketing teams drive better business outcomes
  • Collaborate cross-functionally (e.g., account management, customer success, professional services, AI success, product, marketing, learning and communities) to continuously improve Braze's products and externally facing materials
  • Strong written and verbal English language skills are essential

WHO YOU ARE

  • Collaborative and trusted: You are experienced working directly with enterprise customers and develop strong, consultative relationships. You lead with curiosity and have deep empathy for customers. You have a demonstrated track record of persuading others and influencing without owning the account
  • An engaging facilitator: You have had experience running workshops, hackathons, enablement programs, or embedded consulting engagements. You are an enthusiastic presenter who can run a room of marketers with very different skill levels and have them building within the hour. You’re able to adapt your message to marketers vs executives on their road to AI adoption
  • Experienced: You have 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role such as solutions consulting, sales engineering, technical account management, customer success, or marketing technology consulting
  • Braze-savvy: You have worked with Braze enough to look at a Canvas, a Catalog, or a whole strategy and be able to determine opportunities with BrazeAI that would improve business outcomes
  • Intellectual curiosity and fluency in Applied AI: You understand how generative AI and agents apply to marketing, including prompt design, guardrails, evaluation, testing and optimization. You have experience with MCP, LLM tooling, or building skills and templates for AI assistants

Value-driven: You are able to build business cases and/or measure ROI on AI investments particularly for a credit consumption model.

  • Mar-tech savvy: You understand the marketing technology ecosystem and can develop a perspective on the most effective ways to structure a customer's solution, with domain knowledge in two or more of: AI and LLMs, SaaS, marketing automation, marketing analytics, APIs, SQL and Liquid, or mobile
  • Structured and organized: You can take initiative to structure a working plan, clearly define objectives, prioritize activities across multiple engagements at one time and you’re comfortable building process while doing the work
  • A problem solver: You are able to break a complex problem into components and collaborate with the right people to efficiently get to a solution

NICE TO HAVE

  • Hands-on time with Agent Console, Operator, Decisioning Studio, or Content Optimizer; 
  • Depth in a vertical we sell into heavily, such as retail and eCommerce, QSR, gaming, media, or financial services, to help identify use cases

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

  • Competitive compensation that may include equity
  • Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans

jobs.title: Manager, Solutions Architecture- T1 Platforms
jobs.description:
Who We Are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Enterprise Hunter Solutions Architecture Team aims to land new users adopt prescriptive solutions that drive their growth and success.

We work with C-level executives, finance leaders, product design and engineering teams at global brands who are building financial services solutions with Stripe. Our SA team works closely with Account Executives, Professional Services, Partners, and Product Teams to develop our strategy for winning new users. 

At Stripe, managers grow people and inspire them to do outstanding work. This leader must be a driver who loves building teams through its people and can deliver outstanding results. This role requires great interpersonal skills to work cross functionally as a trusted advisor to both our sales, partner and professional services teams. This role will also play an important role in helping shape our product and messaging with our product development and marketing teams. As a manager/leader of Solution Architecture for our new business, you will recruit, lead, and mentor a world class pre-sales engineering team to grow our user base through new deals. You will drive collaboration from cross-functional teams to influence and unify stakeholders at all levels of the organization to drive business results. You will lead from the front and drive outcomes for our users. 

What You’ll Do

Responsibilities

  • Recruit, hire, lead, and retain a world class pre sales team.  
  • Be an advocate for the solution architecture team within the organization
  • Nurture and be the role-model of a positive outlook, can-do attitude and growth mindset, while leading and keeping the SAs motivated in a fast paced and ever changing environment
  • Manage your team’s KPI’s and deliver outstanding results
  • Define and drive success for your team by strengthening their skills at landing new enterprise users
  • Partner with Sales Leaders in identifying top opportunities and helping SA’s execute on strategies
  • Align closely with Sales, Marketing and Technical Teams (Professional Services, Partners, Product, Development, etc) to develop joint go-to-market initiatives that drive positive user experience and outcomes while driving revenue retention and growth
  • Be the Technical Sponsor on key deals for Stripe’s Hunter Team and serve as an executive champion and lead Executive Business Calls with key customers
  • Demonstrate high executive engagement skills and presence, with an ability to establish strong relationships with key decision makers and build credibility at all levels.
  • Represent Stripe at industry events and conferences, customer business reviews and contribute to new ideas and industry best practices
  • Stay current on industry trends and competitive dynamics, and leverage this knowledge to shape strategy around user engagements 

Minimum Requirements

  • You must have at least 3+ years of pre-sales leadership experience
  • 10+ years’ experience within a technical sales / consulting / implementation/ GTM function
  • A track record of building and leading world-class solution architecture/ engineering  teams ideally in a SaaS, usage-based, or payments businesses
  • Energy, enthusiasm, and passion for making your team successful
  • Previous technical sales experience with APIs and/or payments industry experience
  • Strong executive presence and ability to foster deep relationships with our users
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent military experience required
  • Willingness to travel approximately 25% of the time to engage with customers and collaborate with internal teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • A background in payments is a plus but not a requirement.
  • Media & Entertainment, Gaming / Retail / Financial Services industry experience

jobs.title: Intern, Brand & Strategy
jobs.description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history: a vehicle dating back to 1960 that forged the path for generations of rugged SUVs and trucks. But Scout is more than a brand; it’s a legacy rooted in exploration, caretaking, respect, and hard work. 

As an intern, you’ll join teams dedicated to honoring that legacy the right way: 

  • Respect for the past and future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. 
  • Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. 
  • Respect for work and play with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. 
  • Respect for customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements - an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range. 

Scout Motors 2027 Internship Program 

As an intern, you'll join a team honoring the Scout legacy by reimagining an iconic American brand with modern innovation, respect for people and communities, and vehicles designed to work just as well on the job, at the campsite, or in everyday life. Our program gives current undergraduate and graduate students who live in our local market hands-on experience with talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams. You'll take on meaningful projects aligned with Scout's goals, applying your academic knowledge to real-world challenges under the mentorship of our leaders. 

  • Schedule: The 10-week program is anticipated to run Monday, June 7, 2027 to Friday, August 13, 2027 
  • This role is fully on-site, 5 days per week, at our Scout Motors location in Charlotte, NC
  • The responsibilities of this role require regular attendance at in-person meetings and events. 
  • Housing, Relocation & Sponsorship: Interns are responsible for their own housing and transportation. Scout Motors does not provide housing assistance, relocation, or visa sponsorship for internship positions. 

About the Team 

At Scout Motors, the brand is more than a logo—it’s how we show up in what we say, what we create, and who we connect with. The Strategy & Brand team brings that to life. They shape how we tell our story, how we communicate, and how we build awareness and trust with the people we want to reach. In this role, you’ll develop campaigns, create content, and build partnerships that feel natural to the brand and stand out for the right reasons. You’ll help answer a simple but important question: why Scout matters—and make sure that message is clear and consistent everywhere people experience us. This work combines creativity and strategy, and it has a direct impact on how people see and connect with the company. If you’ve ever seen something you helped create resonate with people, and want to do more of that, this is a place to do it. 

Team placement and project scope are discussed during the interview process. 

Daily Responsibilities of the Internship Program include 

Responsibilities vary by team. Depending on placement, you may:

  • Own and build a project end to end in support of your team and its cross-functional stakeholders 
  • Conduct competitive benchmarking and research on emerging trends and technologies, and translate findings into recommendations for leadership 
  • Use data and analytics to create compelling reports that support marketing, brand, and strategic initiatives 
  • Assist with writing, editing, pitching, and publishing content across intern

jobs.title: Director, Creative Brand Expression
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA • New York, NY • United States
jobs.description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

We’re looking for a Director, Creative Brand Expression to join Figma’s Brand Studio and drive critical parts of our portfolio. This role is as much about growing a team as it is about growing the work. We’re looking for someone who leads with both. This isn’t a role that executes inside someone else’s system. You’ll set the direction, pitch concepts, and lead a small, but mighty team through to final execution across a range of surfaces — from campaigns to major events.

You’ll lead, manage, and grow a team of designers, balancing hands-on creative direction with the craft instincts to jump in when the work calls for it. You care as much about how an idea is pitched and shaped in its earliest form as you do about how it lands in its final execution.

You’ll partner closely with cross-functional creative leadership across Brand Studio, Marketing, and Product to keep your brand distinct, expressive, and unmistakably Figma — balancing experimentation and surprise with clarity, intentionality, and strong system thinking.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States. 

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Manage and develop a team of 4–7 world-class designers, hiring to fill gaps as your portion of the portfolio scales
  • Partner with senior creative stakeholders, product designers, and marketers to improve team process and execution, and coach your team through setting creative direction and priorities
  • Develop a strong point of view on how Figma’s brand shows up in your area and successfully advocate for it across the organization
  • Run and improve team rituals like critiques, reviews, and creative sprints
  • Stay in the work — balancing people leadership with direct craft contribution and execution
  • Set and maintain a high creative bar through feedback, direction, and coaching

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • 3+ years of creative/design management experience with a track record of building strong, resilient team culture and developing designers across skill levels
  • Demonstrated ability to move fluidly between pitching a concept, sketching it out, and shepherding it to completion
  • A portfolio demonstrating conceptual and visual direction for campaigns — ideally motion-forward, and across a wide variety of surfaces (digital, OOH, ads, presentations, events)
  • Experience influencing teams and stakeholders through strategic thinking, storytelling, and clear communication, with comfort navigating ambiguity as priorities shift
  • A true player/coach mindset — as comfortable managing and developing people as you are getting hands-on with the work yourself

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and workflows, and a point of view on how they expand rather than flatten creative expression
  • The ability to adapt as priorities evolve, bringing a sense of humor and a proactive, solution-oriented approach
  • Comfort exploring new methodologies and continuously pushing to improve both personal and team craft
At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Pay Transparency Disclosure

Job level and actual compensation will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process (including skills and prior relevant experience, potential impact, and scope of role), market demands, and specific work location. 

Figma offers equity to employees, as well as a competitive package of additional benefits, including health, dental, and vision coverage; retirement benefits with company contributions; parental leave and reproductive or family planning support; mental health and wellness benefits; and paid time off. Figma provides paid sick leave, holidays, and other leave benefits in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the requirements of the Washington Minimum Wage Act and related regulations. Exempt employees are eligible for employer‑provided paid flexible PTO in addition to flexible paid sick leave. PTO is subject to manager approval. Additional benefits may include company recharge days, cell phone and home internet reimbursements, and a number of lifestyle spending accounts. Figma also offers sales incentive compensation for most sales roles and an annual bonus plan for eligible non-sales roles. All compensation and benefits are subject to applicable plan terms and may be modified by Figma at any time, consistent with applicable law.

Annual Base Salary Range:
$235,000—$317,000 USD

At Figma we celebrate and support our differences. We know employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, our product and our community to flourish. Figma is an equal opportunity workplace - we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity/expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to apply for a role, participate in the interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require accommodation, please reach out to accommodations-ext@figma.com. These modifications enable an individual with a disability to have an equal opportunity not only to get a job, but successfully perform their job tasks to the same extent as people without disabilities. 

Examples of accommodations include but are not limited to: 

  • Holding interviews in an accessible location
  • Enabling closed captioning on video conferencing
  • Ensuring all written communication be compatible with screen readers
  • Changing the mode or format of interviews 

To ensure the integrity of our hiring process and facilitate a more personal connection, we require all candidates keep their cameras on during video interviews. Additionally, if hired you will be required to attend in person onboarding.

By applying for this job, the candidate acknowledges and agrees that any personal data contained in their application or supporting materials will be processed in accordance with Figma's Candidate Privacy Notice.

Application limits: To help candidates focus on the opportunities most relevant to their skills and experience, Figma limits the number and frequency of applications. These limits apply to all roles:

  • Candidates may submit up to 5 applications during any rolling 30-day period.
  • Candidates may not reapply to the same role while an application is active or within 90 days of receiving a rejection.

Once the applicable days has passed, candidates are welcome to apply again.

jobs.title: Research Scientist, AI Safety and Alignment
jobs.description:
Scale Labs, Research Scientist — AI Safety and Alignment

As the leading data and evaluation partner for frontier AI companies, Scale plays a central role in understanding and safeguarding AI systems. Building on this expertise, Scale Labs has launched a new team focused on technical AI safety and policy research, to bridge the gap between frontier AI research and policy, helping policymakers make informed, evidence-based decisions about AI capabilities and risks.

 

Our research tackles some of the hardest open problems in AI safety: assessing the alignment of frontier models, developing control protocols and monitoring methods, preserving the monitorability, understanding failure modes in multi-agent systems and  recursive self-improvement. We collaborate closely with partners across industry, the public sector, and academia and regularly publish our findings. We are looking for talented researchers to join us in shaping this vision.

 

As a Research Scientist on this team, you will conduct research and build evaluations, tools, and datasets that help us understand and reduce risks from frontier AI systems. For example, you might do any or all of the following: 

  • Design and stress-test control protocols and monitoring systems that detect and limit unsafe behavior by AI models and agents in deployment;
  • Build alignment evaluations that probe for deception, sabotage, scheming, reward hacking, and other misaligned behaviors;
  • Study monitorability, including whether a model’s reasoning stays faithful and legible enough to supervise, and how training methods and deployment practices can preserve or erode it;
  • Investigate risks that emerge when multiple AI agents interact, such as collusion, coordination failures and steerability;
  • Develop threat models and evaluations for AI systems that automate AI research and development, to track progress toward recursive self-improvement and inform preparedness planning;
  • Work with government agencies and other labs to scope and design evaluations that measure and mitigate risks from advanced AI;
  • Publish research and evaluation methodologies, and write technical reports for policymakers.

 

Ideally you’d have:

  • Commitment to our mission of promoting safe, secure, and trustworthy AI as capabilities continue to advance.
  • Practical experience conducting technical research collaboratively. You should be comfortable building and instrumenting ML pipelines, building evaluation harnesses, running experiments on frontier models and agents, and quickly turning new ideas from the research literature into working prototypes.
  • Familiarity with current research in at least one of the areas above.
  • A track record of published research in machine learning, particularly in AI safety and alignment.
  • At least three years of experience working on sophisticated ML problems, in research or product development.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical findings to policymakers and work across functions.

Nice to have:

  • Experience designing evaluations and benchmarks, or building tools and pipelines to analyze model and agent trajectories at scale.
  • Experience with red-teaming or adversarial testing of AI systems, including stress-testing safeguards such as monitors and control protocols.
  • Familiarity with AI safety policy and governance frameworks (e.g., NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act, Korea AI Basic Act, frontier AI safety frameworks).

Our research interviews are crafted to assess candidates' skills in practical ML prototyping and debugging, their grasp of research concepts, and their alignment with our organizational culture. We will not ask any LeetCode-style questions. If you’re excited about advancing AI safety and contributing to our mission, we encourage you to apply, even if your experience doesn’t perfectly align with every requirement.

Compensation packages at Scale for eligible roles include base salary, equity, and benefits. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position and may be inclusive of several career levels at Scale; it will be determined during the interview process based on work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, qualifications, interview performance, and relevant education or training. Scale employees in eligible roles are also granted equity based compensation, subject to Board of Director approval. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process, and confirm whether the hired role will be eligible for equity grant. You'll also receive benefits including, but not limited to: comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits, a learning and development stipend, and generous PTO. Additionally, this role may be eligible for additional benefits such as a commuter stipend.

Please reference the job posting's subtitle for where this position will be located. For pay transparency purposes, the base salary range for this full-time position in the locations of San Francisco, New York, Seattle is:
$259,200—$324,000 USD

PLEASE NOTE: Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants.

About Us:

At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, Ernst & Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force. We are expanding our team to accelerate the development of AI applications.

We believe that everyone should be able to bring their whole selves to work, which is why we are proud to be an inclusive and equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability status, gender identity or Veteran status. 

We are committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with physical and mental disabilities. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation in the application or recruiting process due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@scale.com. Please see the United States Department of Labor's Know Your Rights poster for additional information.

We comply with the United States Department of Labor's Pay Transparency provision.

We limit the personal data we collect to that which we believe is appropriate and necessary to manage applicants’ needs, provide our services, and comply with applicable laws. Any information we collect in connection with your application will be treated in accordance with our internal policies and programs designed to protect personal data. Please see our privacy policy for additional information.

You will oversee file and block and object storage development to maximize GPU utilization across AI cloud infrastructure.   • Drive end-to-end design and operational excellence across file and block and object storage services built in Go and Rust to maximize GPU utilization.

  • 3+ years managing engineering teams plus 7+ years in hands-on systems or infrastructure engineering.
  • Technical expertise in cloud storage technologies and distributed systems such as Ceph, Lustre, MinIO and GPUDirect Storage.
  • Proven track record scaling storage engineering teams within hyper-scale cloud environments.
  • Demonstrated success operating ultra-low-latency systems across high-performance computing or AI infrastructure.
  • Proficiency in systems programming with Go and Rust.
  • Demonstrated capability in technical recruitment and team growth.

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

GSOC OPERATOR (NIGHT SHIFT) 

SpaceX is looking for experienced operators for its SpaceX Protective Operations Center (SPOC), its global 24/7 monitoring and incident response coordination center. The selected candidate will be a dedicated security professional with a demonstrated ability to work both independently and as a member of a team in a fast-paced high-tech environment. As a SPOC Operator, you will coordinate day-to-day and incident response logistics, while providing support to security officers. SPOC operators will also act as a point-of-contact for matters relating to each area facility and, as such, must coordinate closely with all operational, management, and administrative sections for area office. Areas of responsibility include: event/incident monitoring, camera/security alarm monitoring, video review, dispatching, coordinating allocation of resources, and incident response management and communications.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Investigate incidents thoroughly, coordinate information gathering with responding security personnel, and create accurate and timely incident reports
  • Notifying and coordinating with onsite first responders, stake holders and local law enforcement during any incident/emergency
  • Monitor, analyze, and report on daily global incidents that may impact SpaceX employees or offices, and escalate accordingly to security management, and subsequently to other key stake holders within the company
  • Responsible for monitoring access control alarms, video surveillance equipment, fire alarm systems, and dispatching resources to investigate any anomalous alarms and activity with security personnel, uniformed security officers, and other departments as appropriate
  • Prioritize and process all incoming security reports and requests via radio, phone, and support ticket, and track all associated shift activity accordingly
  • Identify and communicate critical incidents or events according to established notification procedures including senior leadership, internal stakeholders and external partners as appropriate, and coordinate incident response logistics, provide direction and response instructions to uniformed security forces, and create accurate and timely incident reports
  • Assist with video surveillance system reviews for key stake holders and internal investigations
  • Ensure thorough and current understanding of security operations center roles and responsibilities, applicable SpaceX policies/procedures, contract security policies/procedures and all applicable security work instructions
  • Maintain a positive, professional environment in full compliance with applicable laws, regulations, policies/procedures and act to ensure all SpaceX personnel understand and comply with all applicable security work instructions

  • Active monitoring and over watch of the Hawthorne headquarters and of satellite offices and facilities

  • High school diploma or equivalency certificate
  • 2+ years of experience as a global security operations center (GSOC) operator or corporate security role; or 2+ years of law enforcement or military experience

  • Ability to communicate professionally and effectively via telephone and email and interact with all levels of employees and visitors
  • Strong focus on attention to detail
  • Work well in a fast-paced and multi-tasking team focused environment
  • Learn, retain, and apply a variety of security related concepts, information and processes
  • Understanding of security systems (access control, video surveillance, and fire systems)
  • Ability to prioritize workload based on urgency; appropriately delegate and oversee tasks, and communicate to a range of audiences including to executive management
  • Perform continuous follow-up on pending/open projects and tasks through completion
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills
  • Experience working closely with mass communication tools
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite, specifically data analysis and use of pivot tables using Excel
  • Ability to assess, evaluate, and effectively escalate situations for proper resolution 
  • Active secret security clearance
  • Experience with geospatial analysis software (ArcGIS, QGIS, Google Earth)
  • Proficiency conducting open source intelligence (OSINT) research to identify threats to personnel, facilities, or information
  • Superior report writing skills

jobs.title: Program Manager, Maintenance
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

As we scale production across multiple sites, maintenance isn't an afterthought; it's the backbone that keeps high-throughput, automation-heavy factories running. We're standing up a central maintenance function from a blank sheet of paper, and we need a leaders to own it end to end.

ABOUT THE JOB

The Maintenance Program Manager is responsible for developing, implementing, and sustaining standardized industrial maintenance practices across manufacturing operations. This role serves as a strategic and operational partner to site leadership, providing guidance, oversight, and technical expertise to establish scalable, reliable, and high-performing maintenance organizations. Working closely with local maintenance management, Manufacturing Engineering, Operations, and business leadership, the Maintenance Program Manager will drive maintenance governance, organizational capability development, performance management, and continuous improvement. The position plays a critical role in institutionalizing maintenance standards, improving equipment reliability, developing workforce capabilities, and ensuring consistent execution of maintenance strategies across an expanding manufacturing footprint.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Maintenance Governance & Standardization

  • Develop, deploy, and maintain standardized industrial maintenance policies, procedures, and operating practices across manufacturing locations.
  • Establish minimum requirements for preventive maintenance, predictive maintenance, corrective maintenance, documentation, and equipment reliability.
  • Guide local management teams in establishing foundational maintenance practices and organizational disciplines.
  • Develop and maintain maintenance governance frameworks, including defined roles, responsibilities, accountability, and escalation protocols.
  • Support consistent implementation of maintenance standards while accommodating program-specific operational requirements.

Maintenance Auditing & Performance Management

  • Conduct periodic assessments of local maintenance organizations to evaluate operational maturity, procedural compliance, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Establish standardized maintenance audit criteria, assessment scorecards, and corrective action tracking.
  • Evaluate compliance with established maintenance KPIs, including equipment availability, MTTR, MTBF, PM compliance, schedule adherence, and maintenance backlog.
  • Audit maintenance documentation, equipment records, PM procedures, spare parts practices, and work-order management.
  • Identify organizational and operational gaps, develop corrective action plans, and monitor progress toward closure.
  • Establish consistent reporting practices and performance reviews across manufacturing programs.

Organizational Development & Scalability

  • Partner with local leadership to assess maintenance staffing requirements based on equipment complexity, asset criticality, production demands, and operational maturity.
  • Support the development of scalable maintenance organizational structures aligned with business growth.
  • Establish standardized maintenance roles, responsibilities, and technical competency expectations.
  • Assist local management teams with workforce planning, organizational readiness, and resource allocation.
  • Develop maintenance organizational maturity models and deployment roadmaps for new and expanding manufacturing operations.
  • Support maintenance readiness assessments during new equipment installations, production ramp-ups, and facility expansions.

Training, Competency Development & Career Pathing

  • Develop standardized technical training frameworks and competency matrices for maintenance personnel.
  • Establish skill requirements and proficiency expectations across maintenance technician, specialist, and leadership positions.
  • Partner with local management and training organizations to identify technical capability gaps and establish development plans.
  • Develop structured career progression pathways, including technician advancement, specialization, and leadership development.
  • Support technical onboarding, qualification, and certification programs.
  • Establish mechanisms to evaluate training effectiveness and verify demonstrated technical competency.
  • Promote knowledge sharing and technical best practices across manufacturing locations.

Maintenance Systems & Process Development

  • Support the implementation and standardization of Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS).
  • Establish requirements for asset hierarchies, equipment master data, maintenance plans, work-order documentation, and maintenance history.
  • Develop standardized processes for spare parts management, inventory controls, equipment criticality, and single-point-of-failure assessments.
  • Support the development of preventive and predictive maintenance programs based on equipment risk and operational requirements.
  • Establish maintenance documentation standards, including OEM manuals, technical procedures, equipment records, and maintenance instructions.
  • Partner with site teams to improve planning, scheduling, and maintenance execution.

Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence

  • Identify systemic maintenance performance gaps and coordinate improvement initiatives across manufacturing operations.
  • Promote reliability-centered maintenance principles and data-driven maintenance decision-making.
  • Facilitate cross-functional problem-solving and root cause analysis for recurring equipment failures.
  • Support implementation of Lean Manufacturing, TPM, and other operational excellence methodologies.
  • Establish mechanisms for sharing lessons learned, proven practices, and technical improvements across sites.
  • Track improvement initiatives and quantify their impact on equipment reliability, operational efficiency, and maintenance effectiveness.

Stakeholder Engagement & Program Execution

  • Serve as a central point of coordination between corporate maintenance leadership and local manufacturing organizations.
  • Partner with Manufacturing Engineering, Operations, EHS, Procurement, and business leaders to align maintenance capabilities with operational requirements.
  • Support the definition and deployment of maintenance service-level agreements (SLAs), performance expectations, and accountability structures.
  • Maintain program-level implementation plans, milestones, ownership assignments, and progress reporting.
  • Communicate organizational risks, capability gaps, and improvement opportunities to maintenance leadership.
  • Drive execution through influence, collaboration, and structured follow-up across geographically distributed teams.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Industrial Technology, Manufacturing, Operations Management, or a related technical discipline; equivalent relevant experience considered.
  • 7+ years of experience in industrial maintenance, manufacturing engineering, equipment reliability, or maintenance operations.
  • Demonstrated experience developing or improving maintenance processes within complex manufacturing environments.
  • Strong understanding of preventive maintenance, predictive maintenance, reliability engineering, and maintenance performance metrics.
  • Experience with CMMS platforms, maintenance documentation, and work-order management.
  • Experience assessing maintenance organizational effectiveness and identifying operational improvement opportunities.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.
  • Ability to influence local management teams and drive standardization without direct reporting authority.
  • Ability to travel to manufacturing locations as business needs require.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting multiple manufacturing locations or diverse manufacturing programs.
  • Previous experience as a Maintenance Manager, Reliability Manager, Maintenance Excellence Leader, or Maintenance Program Manager.
  • Experience establishing maintenance organizations within greenfield facilities or rapidly scaling manufacturing environments.
  • Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Total Productive Maintenance, Six Sigma, and reliability-centered maintenance.
  • Experience developing technical training programs, competency matrices, and career progression frameworks.
  • Experience implementing CMMS systems and standardizing maintenance data across multiple facilities.
  • Familiarity with automated manufacturing equipment, robotics, industrial controls, and complex electromechanical systems.
  • Experience developing maintenance governance, audit programs, and organizational maturity assessments.

 

US Salary Range
$114,000—$192,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

What You'll Do:

We're looking for a Senior Engineer, Storage (File) to help build and operate the file and block storage services at the heart of CoreWeave's Storage team — the high-performance, multi-tenant storage that our largest AI training and inference workloads and internal stateful services run on. You'll help turn CoreWeave's storage from a follower of GPU growth into a multiplier of it: owning the data path and control plane for both file and block, running them on our own hardware fleet, and shipping the customer-facing capabilities that unblock petabyte-scale deals. You'll work closely with compute, platform, and infrastructure teams to make storage fast, reliable, and effortless to consume at scale.

About the role:

Design, build, and operate highly scalable, multi-tenant file and block storage — from the data path (NFS for file; durable, high-performance block volumes) to the control plane that governs tenancy, provisioning, and data protection — running natively on CoreWeave's storage fleet and delivered through Kubernetes.

  • Own the file system data path: NFS hot-path reliability, IO resilience, and performance — including the small-file / IOPS-heavy workloads that AI pipelines depend on, and the throughput that keeps GPUs fed.
  • Build a native block storage service: durable, high-performance block volumes for customer workloads and internal stateful services — the third leg of the file/object/block triad, running on our own data path and shared storage hardware.
  • Deliver both file and block as first-class Kubernetes citizens: design and ship a backend-neutral CSI driver with dynamic provisioning, resize, snapshots, and RWO block volumes, backed by a public provisioning SLO — reusing shared control-plane and CSI patterns across file and block rather than rebuilding per service.
  • Build the control plane: multi-tenant isolation, quota, QoS, snapshots, key management (BYOK), audit, and lifecycle policy — the capabilities that unblock regulated and enterprise customers (e.g., encryption in transit, HIPAA controls).
  • Improve the reliability, durability, and observability of the storage stack; partner with operations to monitor, analyze, and optimize using telemetry, metrics, and dashboards to improve performance, latency, and resilience.
  • Work cross-functionally with platform, product, and infrastructure teams to deliver seamless storage across the stack, including tiering cold data to lower-cost object storage while preserving access.
  • Share your knowledge and mentor other engineers on best practices in building distributed, high-performance systems.

  • Experience with multi-tenant services or storage control planes — provisioning, tenancy/quota, and data-protection features (snapshots, encryption, key management).
  • Proficiency in a systems/back-end language — Go strongly preferred (C or Rust a plus).
  • Experience building on Kubernetes — controllers/operators, CRDs, and CSI (dynamic provisioning, resize, snapshots, RWO volumes).
  • Familiarity with distributed databases (e.g., CockroachDB), workflow orchestration (e.g., Temporal), and gRPC/Protobuf service design.
  • Ideally, experience with distributed or parallel storage stacks such as Ceph/RBD, Lustre, GPFS/Spectrum Scale, BeeGFS, WEKA, VAST, or DAOS.
  • Familiarity with storage observability tools and telemetry pipelines (e.g., ClickHouse, Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Bonus: exposure to high-performance data-path technologies (RDMA, GPUDirect Storage, RoCE, InfiniBand, SPDK).
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills in distributed, high-performance environments.
  • Clear communicator, able to work collaboratively across teams and share technical insights effectively.

jobs.title: Elevator Mechanic - Level 4/5
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

ELEVATOR MECHANIC - LEVEL 4/5

We are seeking a highly experienced Elevator Mechanic to join our Facilities and Infrastructure Engineering team at Starbase, TX. This role supports mission-critical operations by ensuring the reliable performance of advanced vertical transport systems, including high-rise, traction, and rack-and-pinion elevators. The successful candidate will bring deep technical expertise, leadership in troubleshooting, and the ability to operate autonomously in a high-paced, safety-focused environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on vertical transport systems, including high-rise traction elevators and rack-and-pinion lifts
  • Troubleshoot and repair mechanical, electrical, and control system issues using diagnostic tools and schematics
  • Conduct scheduled inspections in compliance with ASME A17.1/CSA B44, state codes, and local AHJ regulations
  • Lead elevator modernization projects and major repairs in coordination with facilities engineering and vendors
  • Read and interpret technical drawings, control wiring diagrams, and OEM documentation
  • Utilize CMMS platforms to document maintenance activities, inspections, and system health metrics
  • Interface with internal engineering teams and external service providers to support uptime and system upgrades
  • Train and mentor junior elevator personnel and provide safety briefings during high-risk work
  • Support emergency and after-hours maintenance operations as required

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: 

  • High school diploma or equivalency certificate 
  • 10+ years of experience as a licensed elevator mechanic with experience in:
    • Traction elevator systems
    • Rack-and-pinion elevators
    • High-rise vertical transport installations
  • Current state elevator mechanic license or certification

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Proficiency in interpreting schematics and control logic for elevator systems
  • Strong understanding of mechanical systems, electrical wiring, and PLC-based elevator controls
  • Experience maintaining elevators in aerospace, industrial, or mission-critical facilities
  • Familiarity with rail alignment, car frame adjustments, and counterweight systems
  • Advanced diagnostics using multimeters, laptops, and proprietary controller tools
  • OSHA 30 certification and experience with confined space or elevated work
  • Ability to coordinate shutdowns, safety lockout procedures, and inspections under tight schedules
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to operate independently in remote or rugged site conditions.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be able to lift 50 lbs unassisted
  • Must be able to work in tight, elevated spaces, including elevator shafts and roof-mounted lift systems
  • Must be willing to work overtime, weekends, and on-call rotations as necessary
  • Valid drivers license with a clean driving record

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. jobs.title: Director, Head of Private Equity
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Partnerships at Brex

The primary focus of the Partnerships team at Brex is to drive net new pipeline and revenue. We originate, launch, and scale partnerships across emerging distribution channels, embedded models, and other strategic bets that accelerate Brex's growth trajectory.

As Brex nears $1B in revenue, we are building a best-in-class Partnerships organization grounded in clear priorities and disciplined execution. Every member of our team directly contributes to top-line growth by expanding Brex's reach across key ecosystems, from technology platforms to financial sponsors who influence large customer networks.Within Business Development, the Private Equity Channel team is responsible for building partnerships with PE firms to drive new customer growth, generate pipeline, and increase engagement and monetization of existing customers.

Over the past 12 months, Brex's PE channel hit an inflection point, turning Tier 1 private equity firms into active referral sources for their portfolio companies due to demonstrable ROI. That model was proven through consistent in-market presence: dinners, conferences, events, and the trust that compounds across repeated value-added touchpoints. The channel is now at a critical scaling moment. With a proven playbook and a growing book of top-tier sponsor relationships, we are hiring a Director to take ownership of the entire PE channel — leading the team, sharpening the strategy, and raising the ceiling on what this channel can deliver.

What You'll Do

We are hiring a Director, Private Equity Channel to lead and scale Brex's PE partnerships organization. Based in New York, you will own the full PE channel strategy: setting direction, managing and growing the team, holding the most senior sponsor relationships, and driving the referral engine that turns PE firms into durable, high-conviction distribution partners for Brex.

This is a player-coach role for a senior operator who has both the relationship credibility to command a room with managing directors and the management instincts to build a team around them. You will inherit a functioning playbook and existing tier 1 partners, and your mandate is to manage these key relationships while building and scaling the team.

Where You'll Work

This role will be based in our Seattle office, but would involve travel to our other hub locations. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

  • Hire, develop, and manage a team of Partner Managers across East Coast, West Coast, and emerging PE geographies, setting the bar for performance and career growth
  • Own the PE channel strategy end-to-end — target firm prioritization, coverage model, engagement motion, and referral conversion — and identify new growth vectors across geographies, firm tiers, and portfolio models
  • Build the internal case for channel investment and headcount, presenting performance and roadmap to senior leadership
  • Personally own and deepen relationships with the most strategic Tier 1 PE firms, serving as escalation point and executive sponsor across the team's book
  • Represent Brex across the PE ecosystem at premier industry events, dinners, and conferences
  • Partner with Marketing on field events and content, and with Sales leadership on handoffs and referral-to-close conversion
  • Drive internal alignment with Finance, RevOps, and Partnerships on channel prioritization and metrics infrastructure during planning cycles

Requirements

  • 8–12+ years of experience in PE business development, financial services sales, partnerships, or a related senior role with consistent, demonstrable exposure to the private equity ecosystem.
  • 4+ years of people management experience; track record of hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing BD or sales talent.
  • Established senior-level relationships within the New York private equity community; credible with managing directors and partners at leading PE firms from day one.
  • Proven channel builder — experience standing up or significantly scaling a partnerships motion, not just maintaining one.
  • Strong commercial instincts; able to connect PE relationship activity to pipeline generation, ARR outcomes, and executive-level narratives.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; executive-ready in both internal stakeholder management and external partner engagement.
  • High organizational acumen — able to manage a team, a personal book of relationships, and strategic workstreams simultaneously without dropping quality.
  • Based in New York; comfortable being in-market regularly for dinners, events, and partner engagements.
  • Self-directed and entrepreneurial; able to operate with high autonomy while maintaining tight alignment with Partnerships leadership.

Compensation

The expected OTE range for this role is $316,400 - $395,500. The starting wage will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. The OTE figure listed here includes base salary and commissions, which may or may not be earned depending on performance.  Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

Over the past 12 months, Brex's PE channel hit an inflection point, turning Tier 1 private equity firms into active referral sources for their portfolio companies due to demonstrable ROI. That model was proven through consistent in-market presence: dinners, conferences, events, and the trust that compounds across repeated value-added touchpoints. The channel is now at a critical scaling moment. With a proven playbook and a growing book of top-tier sponsor relationships, we are hiring a Director to take ownership of the entire PE channel — leading the team, sharpening the strategy, and raising the ceiling on what this channel can deliver.

What You'll Do

We are hiring a Director, Private Equity Channel to lead and scale Brex's PE partnerships organization. Based in New York, you will own the full PE channel strategy: setting direction, managing and growing the team, holding the most senior sponsor relationships, and driving the referral engine that turns PE firms into durable, high-conviction distribution partners for Brex.

This is a player-coach role for a senior operator who has both the relationship credibility to command a room with managing directors and the management instincts to build a team around them. You will inherit a functioning playbook and existing tier 1 partners, and your mandate is to manage these key relationships while building and scaling the team.

Where You'll Work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office, but would involve travel to our other hub locations. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

  • Own the PE channel strategy end-to-end — target firm prioritization, coverage model, engagement motion, and referral conversion — and identify new growth vectors across geographies, firm tiers, and portfolio models
  • Build the internal case for channel investment and headcount, presenting performance and roadmap to senior leadership
  • Personally own and deepen relationships with the most strategic Tier 1 PE firms, serving as escalation point and executive sponsor across the team's book
  • Represent Brex across the PE ecosystem at premier industry events, dinners, and conferences
  • Partner with Marketing on field events and content, and with Sales leadership on handoffs and referral-to-close conversion
  • Drive internal alignment with Finance, RevOps, and Partnerships on channel prioritization and metrics infrastructure during planning cycles

Requirements

  • 8–12+ years of experience in PE business development, financial services sales, partnerships, or a related senior role with consistent, demonstrable exposure to the private equity ecosystem.
  • 4+ years of people management experience; track record of hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing BD or sales talent.
  • Established senior-level relationships within the New York private equity community; credible with managing directors and partners at leading PE firms from day one.
  • Proven channel builder — experience standing up or significantly scaling a partnerships motion, not just maintaining one.
  • Strong commercial instincts; able to connect PE relationship activity to pipeline generation, ARR outcomes, and executive-level narratives.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; executive-ready in both internal stakeholder management and external partner engagement.
  • High organizational acumen — able to manage a team, a personal book of relationships, and strategic workstreams simultaneously without dropping quality.
  • Based in New York; comfortable being in-market regularly for dinners, events, and partner engagements.

Runtime services compose the platform our customers use to apply AI to new solutions, and integrate AI models into production applications.

As a Principal Solution Specialist for Inference in AMER, you open new market opportunities across the execution layer and drive the initial adoption of these offerings with the earliest customers and industries to need them. You channel what you learn into the product roadmap, and scale your insights to make the broader sales and solution architecture organization fluent in the value runtime services create for new customers.

  • Deep understanding of how AI companies across AMER, from startups building their first production systems to enterprises scaling global AI deployments, evaluate, procure, and operationalize AI models through inference platforms, including the technical, financial, regulatory, and organizational dynamics that drive those decisions across key AMER markets.

  • Prior background in technical sales, solution consulting, or product management supporting large-scale inference infrastructure or AI platform decisions.
  • Deep understanding of cost-per-token economics, inference fleet optimization, and the commercial tradeoffs between on-demand, reserved, and spot GPU capacity for runtime workloads.

jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to join the SecOps Product team. This is a remote role based in the USA, reporting to the Sr. Director of Product Management. In this role, you will lead product initiatives that drive Zscaler's Agentic SOC & MDR business by identifying and executing on high-impact opportunities in threat detection and response. You will evaluate the evolving threat landscape and improve Zscaler's threat management products to protect customers against cyberattacks, translating complex security challenges into innovative products that customers love and that differentiate Zscaler in the market.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Own product strategy and roadmap for threat detection and response capabilities, prioritizing initiatives that protect customers against evolving cyberattacks and drive Agentic SOC & MDR business growth
  • Translate threat landscape insights into product solutions by engaging with customers, security researchers, and internal stakeholders to define problems and deliver innovative capabilities that differentiate Zscaler
  • Drive cross-functional execution of large initiatives, partnering with engineering, security research, and go-to-market teams to deliver world-class threat management products
  • Measure and optimize product impact through qualitative and quantitative analysis, ensuring solutions effectively protect customers and deliver business outcomes
  • Act as general manager of your product area, owning commercialization, technical direction, and product quality while balancing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You navigate dynamic and evolving environments with ease, viewing uncertainty as an opportunity to build meaningful, high-impact solutions from scratch.
  • You act like an owner. Driven by a strong sense of accountability and passion for the mission, you move seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are customer-obsessed. You deeply understand customer pain points and build solutions that directly address security challenges, validating assumptions through direct engagement.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You prioritize collective success, communicating with clarity to build alignment, drive action, and cultivate mutual respect across teams.
  • You are data-driven and innovative. Fueled by technical curiosity and analytics, you use metrics to find the truth and leverage cutting-edge technology to drive secure, scalable transformation.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Demonstrated ability to explore and integrate AI tools into daily workflows to enhance problem-solving and productivity
  • 8+ years of product management experience with a track record of leading large initiatives and delivering business impact
  • Deep expertise in cybersecurity, specifically threat detection, response, and the evolving threat landscape
  • B2B SaaS or enterprise security product experience with understanding of complex sales cycles and customer needs
  • Technical fluency to work effectively with security researchers and engineering teams on complex threat management systems and detection technologies
  • Strong decision-making and communication skills to drive alignment across stakeholders, make decisions without consensus, and clearly articulate product strategy and rationale

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency
  • Experience with AI/ML-driven security solutions or autonomous detection systems, particularly in SOC automation, agentic workflows, or intelligent threat response
  • Background in SOC operations, threat intelligence, or detection engineering, providing firsthand understanding of analyst workflows and the challenges security teams face
  • Prior experience at a security vendor or with security product commercialization, especially in the MDR, XDR, or SIEM/detection space
