jobs.title: Brake and Tire Technician
jobs.description:
We’re looking for Automotive Mechanics with a minimum of 1 year of professional automotive repair experience to join us at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500.

As a Brake & Tire Technician, you’ll be expected to perform light maintenance or repairs, including changing brakes and tires and performing:

  • Technician services, such as routine inspections/maintenance
  • Basic mechanical repair for brake pads/calipers/rotors, tire installations, and wheel alignments


At Carvana, you’ll receive a competitive wage and amazing perks – including a 401(k) with Carvana match and even a vehicle purchase discount – all while using state of the art tools in one of our high-tech Inspection Centers (click here to learn more). If you’re joining us in an entry-level position, we offer training programs to make sure your skills and pay progress along with the company.


Other perks of the Job

  • 100% company-paid healthcare premiums
  • Generous paid-time off and your birthday is a holiday!
  • ASE and tool reimbursement programs
  • Tuition reimbursement and student loan repayment

How To Get Started
Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 508-4749, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM MST.

Not a match for this role?
We have a variety of Technician roles in our Inspection Centers, depending on your level of experience - take a look below to see what you’ll be doing to help us get our low-mileage, late-model cars ready for our customers:

  • Entry-Level Auto Technician (min 6 months professional experience): perform light maintenance, fluid checks, and/or conduct the initial inspection on our vehicles to look for any imperfections or repairs that may be needed throughout the reconditioning process.
  • Brake and Tire Technician (min 1 year professional experience): perform light maintenance or repairs, including changing brakes and tires
  • Mid-Level (Mechanical Repair / Build / General) Technician (min 3 years of professional experience): perform light to medium automotive repairs and minimal diagnostics on our vehicles
  • Experienced Technician (min 5 years of professional experience): perform extensive repairs and heavy engine work, as well as advanced vehicle diagnostics on all makes and models, including electric and hybrid vehicles

We also have a variety of other automotive roles available in one of our 18 locations across the country – take a look at our Careers site to apply for one of the following roles:

  • Auto Body roles: Paint, Prep/Body work, Wheel Repair, Airbrush, Interior Repair, Glass Repair, and PDR (Paintless Dent Repair) roles
  • Auto Technician/Mechanic roles: Lube and Oil, Inspection, Brake and Tire, Mechanical Repair / Build, and Master Technician roles
  • Entry-Level roles: Detailing, Inventory Associate (Car Porters), Photo, Parts Associate, Inspection, and Coordinator/Administrator roles

General qualifications and requirements

  • Ability to physically operate vehicle equipment and tools - must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently
  • Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Some positions may be subject to an Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check
  • An ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing production environment while sometimes being exposed to excessive weather conditions (heat/cold)
  • Use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment

About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English.

jobs.title: Principal, GTM Solution Specialist
jobs.location: New York, NY / San Francisco, CA
jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

What You'll Do:

CoreWeave Omni is CoreWeave delivered as a service: a fully managed CoreWeave region deployed in a customer's or partner's data center, where the customer owns the physical assets and CoreWeave runs the cloud. It brings CoreWeave's control plane, managed services, and operational excellence to customers whose ownership preferences, tax incentives, regulatory obligations, or sovereignty requirements mean the infrastructure must live in their own or a partner's facility. As a GTM Solution Specialist for Omni, you are the market-maker for this offering: you identify the enterprises, partners, and sovereign programs where Omni unlocks adoption, drive the first wins, and establish the qualification frameworks, deal structures, and playbooks the broader sales and solution architecture organization uses to scale it. You turn what you learn in the field into direct input on the Omni roadmap.

About the role: As a GTM Solution Specialist for Omni, you operate at the front edge of CoreWeave's newest go-to-market motion. Your job is to create the motion, not just run it: you take Omni into accounts where asset ownership, data residency, and in-country delivery are becoming infrastructure-defining decisions, prove its value with the earliest large-scale customers, and build the repeatable patterns the rest of the field uses to win. Omni deals are large, long-term, and bespoke, and you own the judgment calls that make them work: qualifying which opportunities fit the model, structuring asset-lite economics that create durable value for both sides, and aligning engineering, operations, legal, and finance behind commitments CoreWeave can deliver. You are the field's voice into engineering, translating what early customers need around sovereignty, residency, and partner delivery models into the priorities that shape the Omni roadmap.

  • Own the commercial and technical strategy for net new Omni wins, where asset ownership, data sovereignty, regulatory requirements, or in-country delivery are the primary buying triggers.

  • Build deep expertise in the Omni delivery model: what CoreWeave operates (the control plane, fleet lifecycle management, managed services, observability, and support) versus what the customer owns (the data center, power, and physical assets), and how alignment with CoreWeave's hardware and operational standards shapes deal feasibility and timelines.
  • Translate customer requirements around data residency, sovereign controls, billing separation, and identity federation into specific product feedback that shapes the Omni roadmap.
  • Develop deal structures for asset-lite economics, including services engagements, platform licensing, long-term capacity commitments, and partner resell frameworks spanning direct, pass-through, and indirect delivery models.
  • Engage directly with C-suite, infrastructure, and data center leadership as the authoritative voice on what it takes to run a production-grade AI cloud region in a customer facility, from hardware standards and deployment through day-2 operations and support.
  • Design the commercial framework for multi-year Omni engagements, including deployment milestones, SLA structures, and capacity ramps, that de-risk delivery for CoreWeave while meeting customer commitments.
  • Partner with product, engineering, operations, legal, and finance to evaluate each opportunity against Omni's decision framework: minimizing upfront investment and operational complexity while maximizing revenue confidence and long-term margin.

Who You Are:

  • 10+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, data center services, or enterprise technology business development, with a track record of structuring and closing large, complex deals.
  • 5+ years working on hybrid, on-premises, or distributed cloud offerings (AWS Outposts, Azure Local, Google Distributed Cloud, OCI Dedicated Region, or equivalent) in a customer-facing or deal-shaping capacity.
  • Deep understanding of data center economics, including power, land, construction, and capex versus opex tradeoffs, and how ownership preferences, tax incentives, and regulation drive infrastructure decisions.
  • Working knowledge of sovereign cloud, data residency, and regulated-industry requirements, and how engineering controls, legal frameworks, and contractual structures combine to meet them.
  • Proven experience managing the full commercial lifecycle of complex technical deals exceeding $10M in contract value and multi-year terms, including multi-stakeholder negotiation, technical due diligence, and deployment planning.

  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with executives, infrastructure leaders, and partners across enterprises, service providers, and government-adjacent programs.

Preferred:

  • Experience at a hyperscaler or cloud provider bringing a dedicated, distributed, or sovereign cloud offering to market, from first customers through repeatable motion.
  • Background in partner and channel models, including resell economics, metering and billing separation, and white-label or partner-branded service delivery.
  • Familiarity with large-scale AI infrastructure (GPU clusters, InfiniBand or RoCE fabrics, data center design) and the operational model behind fleet lifecycle management at scale.

jobs.title: Sales Operations Lead
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As a Sales Operations Lead, you will be the operational and analytical partner to our Global Account Management and AI Sales leadership team, owning the planning, process, and data foundations that drive expansion at scale. This role blends hands-on execution with a strategic lens: you’ll keep today’s data and processes running, while shaping how we scale them and build the team to support continued growth.

Territory, Quota & Capacity Planning

  • Own the annual territory and account-assignment process for Global AM and AI Sales, ensuring accuracy and equitability, and recommend structures that drive focus while giving reps a realistic path to attainment
  • Collaborate with regional Sales Ops leaders to align on coverage and rules of engagement between Account Management, AI Sales, and Account Executives, including account assignment, crediting, and handoffs
  • Build capacity models that translate growth targets into global headcount, coverage, and quota scenarios, and partner with Finance and Sales Leadership on quota and comp plan inputs

Scaling Our Processes

  • Run the operating cadence and turn tribal-knowledge processes into ones that are documented and repeatable
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives from scoping to adoption to evolve our sales processes, identifying bottlenecks before they slow down the business

Data & Reporting Infrastructure

  • Define the metrics framework and reporting for Global AM and AI Sales that give leadership real time visibility into performance
  • Analyze sales data, KPIs, and trends to surface insights and provide recommendations to leaders on where to focus
  • Partner with Sales Leadership on forecasting cadences and own forecast data quality and accuracy

AI-Driven Process Improvement

  • Collaborate with Sales Ops leaders to drive the AI strategy for Sales Ops, identifying and prioritizing opportunities to use AI to automate manual workflows
  • Design AI-driven workflows to improve efficiency across the Global AM and AI Sales team, partnering with our in-house AI architect team to bring them to life and measure impact

WHO YOU ARE

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or business-oriented field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 6+ years of experience in Go-to-Market Operations, Sales Strategy and Operations, or Revenue Operations at a high growth B2B SaaS company
  • Experience with overlay or specialist sales models and supporting a global team across regions a plus
  • Technically savvy, with a solid understanding of Salesforce flows and automations; you’ll translate business needs into requirements and own prioritization with Business Systems
  • Hands-on experience with Sales tech stack tools such as Clay, ZoomInfo, Clari, Gong, Outreach, or Fullcast
  • Proficient with Google Sheets and BI tools such as Tableau or Looker, with experience building dashboards from scratch
  • Comfortable using AI tools to speed up analysis, data cleaning, and reporting, and curious about where AI can remove manual work from Sales Ops processes
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with the attention to detail to get into the data and make data driven decisions.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills; able to present key insights and the “so what” to senior sales leaders, to build trust quickly, and to push back with data when needed
  • Has built structure and process where none existed, and takes ownership of strategy and outcomes, not just tasks

    For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $94,000 and $135,900/year, with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $106,000 and $151,000/year (including bonus or commission).Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

 #LI-Hybrid

WHAT WE OFFER

Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

  • Competitive compensation that may include equity
  • Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
  • Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave
  • Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend
  • A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
  • Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching
  • Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze
  • Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®

ABOUT BRAZE

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.

The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025.

Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore.

The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.

At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.

Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you.

We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you

jobs.title: Strategy and Planning Lead
jobs.location: Hybrid - San Francisco, New York City
jobs.description:
About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About the role

As Vercel’s Strategy & Planning Lead, you’ll partner directly with the Director of Sales Planning and Strategy, owning the analytical foundations behind how Vercel plans, staffs, and quotas its go-to-market organization. You’ll build the models that translate revenue targets into headcount, ratios, and quota, and help design how the company sets and ramps quotas as it completes its shift to a consumption-based revenue model. This is a senior individual-contributor role, built for someone who wants to own the analytical backbone of a fast-growing GTM org rather than run point on day-to-day execution. This is a hybrid role with 3 in-office days per week in San Francisco or New York City.

What you will do

  • Build and maintain Vercel’s GTM capacity model, connecting headcount plans to attainment probability and revenue target coverage across Sales, SAs, BDRs, and other supporting roles
  • Develop and operationalize the “minimum deployable unit,” the supporting-role staffing needed per rep or segment, to guide hiring sequencing and investment scenarios
  • Partner with the Director on quota-setting methodology, with a focus on consumption-based quota design, translating usage-based revenue signal into fair, attainable quota and ramp assumptions
  • Build and maintain quarterly planning deliverables, including quota-setting proposals, coverage model updates, and headcount recommendations
  • Track plan versus actual on headcount, capacity, and quota attainment throughout the year, flagging divergence early and modeling the revenue impact

What you need

  • 6+ years of experience in revenue/sales operations, strategic finance, or a similar analytical GTM function at a high-growth SaaS company
  • Built headcount, capacity, or ratio-based staffing models tied to revenue targets
  • Experience with quota design and ramp modeling, including consumption- or usage-based quota structures
  • Able to build a defensible model from incomplete data and clearly explain the assumptions behind it
  • Able to translate complex modeling into clear recommendations for senior stakeholders
  • Prefers building frameworks and analytical systems over running point on day-to-day execution

Bonus if you

  • Have direct experience with consumption-based or usage-based revenue models, especially quota and compensation design in that context
  • Have worked in developer tools, infrastructure, or cloud platform companies
  • Have a point of view on how automation or better tooling can improve planning and modeling workflows

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation package, including equity.
  • Inclusive Healthcare Package.
  • Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.
  • Flexible Time Off.
  • We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $175,000 - $205,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Director, Head of Private Equity
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Partnerships at Brex

The primary focus of the Partnerships team at Brex is to drive net new pipeline and revenue. We originate, launch, and scale partnerships across emerging distribution channels, embedded models, and other strategic bets that accelerate Brex's growth trajectory.

As Brex nears $1B in revenue, we are building a best-in-class Partnerships organization grounded in clear priorities and disciplined execution. Every member of our team directly contributes to top-line growth by expanding Brex's reach across key ecosystems, from technology platforms to financial sponsors who influence large customer networks.Within Business Development, the Private Equity Channel team is responsible for building partnerships with PE firms to drive new customer growth, generate pipeline, and increase engagement and monetization of existing customers.

Over the past 12 months, Brex's PE channel hit an inflection point, turning Tier 1 private equity firms into active referral sources for their portfolio companies due to demonstrable ROI. That model was proven through consistent in-market presence: dinners, conferences, events, and the trust that compounds across repeated value-added touchpoints. The channel is now at a critical scaling moment. With a proven playbook and a growing book of top-tier sponsor relationships, we are hiring a Director to take ownership of the entire PE channel — leading the team, sharpening the strategy, and raising the ceiling on what this channel can deliver.

What You'll Do

We are hiring a Director, Private Equity Channel to lead and scale Brex's PE partnerships organization. Based in New York, you will own the full PE channel strategy: setting direction, managing and growing the team, holding the most senior sponsor relationships, and driving the referral engine that turns PE firms into durable, high-conviction distribution partners for Brex.

This is a player-coach role for a senior operator who has both the relationship credibility to command a room with managing directors and the management instincts to build a team around them. You will inherit a functioning playbook and existing tier 1 partners, and your mandate is to manage these key relationships while building and scaling the team.

Where You'll Work

This role will be based in our New York City office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

  • Hire, develop, and manage a team of Partner Managers across East Coast, West Coast, and emerging PE geographies, setting the bar for performance and career growth
  • Own the PE channel strategy end-to-end — target firm prioritization, coverage model, engagement motion, and referral conversion — and identify new growth vectors across geographies, firm tiers, and portfolio models
  • Build the internal case for channel investment and headcount, presenting performance and roadmap to senior leadership
  • Personally own and deepen relationships with the most strategic Tier 1 PE firms, serving as escalation point and executive sponsor across the team's book
  • Represent Brex across the PE ecosystem at premier industry events, dinners, and conferences
  • Partner with Marketing on field events and content, and with Sales leadership on handoffs and referral-to-close conversion
  • Drive internal alignment with Finance, RevOps, and Partnerships on channel prioritization and metrics infrastructure during planning cycles

Requirements

  • 8–12+ years of experience in PE business development, financial services sales, partnerships, or a related senior role with consistent, demonstrable exposure to the private equity ecosystem.
  • 4+ years of people management experience; track record of hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing BD or sales talent.
  • Established senior-level relationships within the New York private equity community; credible with managing directors and partners at leading PE firms from day one.
  • Proven channel builder — experience standing up or significantly scaling a partnerships motion, not just maintaining one.
  • Strong commercial instincts; able to connect PE relationship activity to pipeline generation, ARR outcomes, and executive-level narratives.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; executive-ready in both internal stakeholder management and external partner engagement.
  • High organizational acumen — able to manage a team, a personal book of relationships, and strategic workstreams simultaneously without dropping quality.
  • Based in New York; comfortable being in-market regularly for dinners, events, and partner engagements.
  • Self-directed and entrepreneurial; able to operate with high autonomy while maintaining tight alignment with Partnerships leadership.

Compensation

The expected OTE range for this role is $316,400 - $395,500. The starting wage will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. The OTE figure listed here includes base salary and commissions, which may or may not be earned depending on performance.  Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.title: People Tech Business Systems Analyst
jobs.location: Atlanta, GA - Hybrid; Denver, CO - Hybrid; New York, NY - Hybrid; San Francisco, CA - Hybrid; Scottsdale, AZ - Hybrid
jobs.description:
About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role

As a Business Systems Analyst, you'll own the systems that power our recruiting experience, including our recruiting tools and Sana. You'll work with Recruiting, People Operations, and Engineering to understand how hiring work gets done today, find where it can be faster and simpler, and turn that into configured systems and AI agents. You'll partner with engineers to design, build, and test agents that remove manual steps from recruiting processes. You'll independently lead projects from discovery through launch, set your own priorities within the team's roadmap, and serve as a trusted advisor to Recruiting leaders on systems and automation.

About the Team

You'll join the People Technology team within People Operations, Services & Technology, which builds and runs the systems and automation behind Gusto's People programs. The team works horizontally across People functions, partnering with Recruiting, HR operations, and Engineering to turn process improvements into tools Gusties and hiring teams use every day.

Here's what you'll do day-to-day:

  • Own the administration, configuration, and roadmap for recruiting tools and Sana, including integrations, access, and change management
  • Lead requirements gathering with Recruiting and write clear specs, user stories, and acceptance criteria
  • Partner with engineers to design, build, test, and launch AI agents and automations that streamline recruiting processes, and help decide when to configure, build, or buy
  • Map current-state workflows, identify friction, and drive improvements end to end, measuring their impact
  • Manage multiple projects at once, communicate status and trade-offs to senior stakeholders, and keep documentation and training current
  • Share best practices and support less experienced teammates as the team's recruiting systems and automation work grows

Here's what we're looking for:

  • 4–6 years in HRIS, recruiting systems, business systems analysis, or a related role
  • Hands-on experience owning and configuring an ATS or HR system (Greenhouse, Workday, or similar), including integrations
  • Track record of leading projects from requirements through launch with measurable results
  • Strong requirements gathering, process mapping, and documentation skills
  • Experience partnering with engineers on design, testing, and launch, and comfort with light scripting or automation tools
  • Experience with, or strong interest in, building AI tools and agents to improve a process
  • Clear communication, including presenting to senior stakeholders, and the ability to prioritize competing requests

Our cash compensation range for this role is $107,000/yr to $130,000/yr in Denver, and $130,000/yr to $160,000/yr in San Francisco, New York. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

At Gusto, we don't use titles the traditional way, as a signal of rank or hierarchy. Instead, our titles describe two things at once — your craft (what you do, e.g. Engineering, Design) and your scope of ownership (what you're accountable for) — which is why you'll see something like "Head of X" instead of a rank word like "Director" that tells you neither. Because of this, the title on this posting may look different from what you'd expect based on the scope and seniority of the role, and from how similar roles are typically titled elsewhere. If you have questions about how this role compares to your current title or level, your recruiter can help translate.

Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.

Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas. 

When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees.

Reliable, consistent presence: We expect regular and predictable attendance, whether you're working in-office, hybrid, or fully remote, so that you stay closely connected to your team, customers, and stakeholders in real time and ensure colleagues and customers receive the timely support and responsiveness they deserve.

Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto. 

Gusto is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Gusto considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Gusto is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. We want to see our candidates perform to the best of their ability. If you require a medical or religious accommodation at any time throughout your candidate journey, please fill out this form and a member of our team will get in touch with you.

Gusto takes security and protection of your personal information very seriously. Please review our Fraudulent Activity Disclaimer.

Personal information collected and processed as part of your Gusto application will be subject to Gusto's Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.description:

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

This is an Enterprise-level role within the Enterprise team in Braze's MEGS (Media, Entertainment, Gaming & Sports) organization. You will own a book spanning NHL, NBA, MLB, and MLS clubs and league-level entities — a mix of existing team/league relationships to grow and protect, combined with a very strong mandate to acquire net-new logos across all four leagues. This is one of the first dedicated, vertical-native seats built for professional sports, with a ~110-day sales cycle that is unique to how teams and leagues plan and budget.

The ideal candidate will have at least 7+ years selling SaaS solutions into enterprise accounts, with deep comfort running long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from a standing start. Experience selling into professional sports, media, or live-events organizations is a strong plus, but not required — what matters most is the ability to translate a complex, cross-departmental buying process (marketing, ticketing, digital, data/analytics, and business intelligence functions) into a coherent, value-based pitch, largely from scratch.

You'll operate as the "GM" of your book — building account strategy across a relatively small, high-value universe of teams and league offices, partnering closely with Marketing, Business Development, and Customer Success to build a pipeline that is weighted heavily toward net-new acquisition, while also growing and protecting the existing relationships already in the book.

Core to your pitch will be Braze's Fan Equity framework: every team and league shares the same lifecycle marketing problem — fan attention peaks hard around game days, season openers, trades, and playoff runs, then falls off in the gaps between. Your job is to show how Braze's cross-channel orchestration and BrazeAI-powered personalization keep fans engaged through those valleys, turning single-game buyers into season-long, multi-year relationships.

 WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Build and execute account plans across the book, mapping decision-makers across marketing, ticketing/revenue, digital, and data/analytics functions
  • Run a consultative, value-based sales process — from discovery through negotiation and close — typically over a ~110-day cycle
  • Partner with a Business Development Representative and Marketing to build and prioritize pipeline coverage across the full book
  • Develop and deliver executive-level business value assessments that connect Braze's platform capabilities to team/league-specific outcomes: ticket revenue, sponsorship activation, membership/season-ticket retention, and direct-to-fan digital engagement
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Deal Desk, Strategic Consulting, Customer Success, and Services to structure deals and ensure successful onboarding
  • Represent Braze at relevant industry events, league meetings, and sports-tech forums to build brand presence in the vertical
  • Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline hygiene in Salesforce

WHO YOU ARE

  • Background in Enterprise SaaS sales, ideally in Marketing Technology, CDP, CRM, or adjacent categories
  • Demonstrated experience in complex, multi-stakeholder solution selling
  • Training and practice in value-based selling, with an emphasis on building Business Value Assessments; experience with Command of the Message a plus
  • Genuine passion for and working knowledge of the professional sports landscape — how teams and leagues make money, and how fan engagement ties to revenue
  • Prior experience with Salesforce.com CRM or a comparable platform to manage pipeline, required
  • Demonstrated ability to quickly ramp on new product surface area and cloud tools
  • Proven track record navigating organizations with non-traditional buying committees and decision processes
  • Strong verbal, written, and executive presentation skills
  • Ability to travel for in-market meetings and industry events

You will also contribute to larger initiatives including platform cleanup, workflow consolidation, service management improvements, automation, ScriptRunner development, and Braze’s growing use of Atlassian Rovo and AI agents.

What You’ll Work On

You’ll support the operation and continued improvement of Braze’s Atlassian ecosystem, including:

  • Platform Administration and User Support:
    • Manage the day-to-day request queue for Jira, Jira Service Management, and Confluence, resolving configuration, access, reporting, and usability issues while keeping stakeholders informed.
  • Jira and JSM Configuration:
    • Configure and maintain projects, workflows, screens, custom fields, issue types, request types, queues, SLAs, forms, permission schemes, notification schemes, and customer portals.
  • Automation and Operational Efficiency:
    • Build and maintain Jira Automation rules that reduce manual work, improve consistency, and support repeatable business processes.
  • Rovo and AI Enablement:
    • Support and improve Rovo agents by maintaining instructions and knowledge sources, troubleshooting unexpected behavior, testing new use cases, and gathering feedback from users.
  • Reporting and Visibility:
    • Create and troubleshoot JQL queries, filters, dashboards, and reports that provide teams with visibility into workload, service performance, and operational trends.
  • Governance and Access Management:
    • Manage users, groups, roles, and permissions while supporting license reviews, access reviews, change management, and documentation requirements.
  • Documentation and Enablement:
    • Maintain platform documentation, knowledge articles, and training materials, including async walkthroughs that help teams self-service common Atlassian tasks.
  • Platform Improvement Initiatives:
    • Partner with the Lead Atlassian Solutions Engineer on project rollouts, workflow consolidation, JSM improvements, platform cleanup, application integrations, and other initiatives that improve the scalability and usability of the Atlassian environment.

  • Own and manage incoming Atlassian administration requests, prioritizing work based on business impact and urgency.
  • Configure and maintain Jira, Jira Service Management, and Confluence configurations across projects, workflows, fields, permissions, queues, forms, SLAs, portals, spaces, and templates.
  • Manage users, groups, roles, and access while supporting periodic license and access reviews.
  • Build and troubleshoot JQL queries, filters, dashboards, and operational reports.
  • Create and maintain Jira Automation rules for well-defined administrative and business use cases.
  • Support existing Rovo agents and assist with the creation, testing, and rollout of new agents and AI-enabled workflows.
  • Troubleshoot Atlassian Marketplace applications and coordinate with vendors or Atlassian Support when escalation is required.
  • Test configuration changes in non-production environments before implementation.
  • Maintain clear documentation for configurations, processes, and recurring administrative tasks.
  • Create training materials and async walkthroughs that enable teams to use Atlassian tools effectively.
  • Assist with ScriptRunner administration by reviewing, testing, troubleshooting, and making guided updates to existing scripts.
  • Support larger Atlassian initiatives under the direction of the Lead Atlassian Solutions Engineer, taking on increasing ownership as your technical experience grows.

Who You Are

  • Have 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience administering Jira and Confluence in a business environment, preferably using Atlassian Cloud.
  • Have working knowledge of Jira Service Management, including request types, queues, SLAs, forms, and customer portals.
  • Comfortable writing JQL and creating filters, dashboards, and operational reports.
  • Familiar with Jira Automation and understand how automation can improve repeatability and reduce administrative effort.
  • Have exposure to ScriptRunner through reading, testing, troubleshooting, or modifying existing scripts.
  • Familiar with Atlassian Rovo and AI-enabled workflows, including experience with Rovo Search, Rovo Chat, or configuring Rovo agents.
  • Comfortable troubleshooting platform issues and working through problems methodically.
  • Strong written communicator who documents changes clearly and can explain technical concepts to non-technical users.
  • Customer-focused and comfortable working directly with teams across different functions and levels of technical experience.
  • Organized and able to manage competing requests while distinguishing true business urgency from less critical work.
  • Motivated to continue developing deeper expertise in Atlassian administration, automation, scripting, and solution design.
  • Comfortable working within established change management, governance, and documentation standards.

Bonus

  • Atlassian certifications such as ACP-120 Jira Administration for Cloud or ACP-220 Confluence Administration for Cloud.
  • Experience supporting ITSM or ITIL-aligned service management processes.
  • Familiarity with Atlassian Guard, SSO, SCIM provisioning, or enterprise identity management.
  • Experience working with Jira or Confluence REST APIs.
  • Practical experience writing prompts or agent instructions and refining them based on user feedback and observed results.
  • Scripting experience with Groovy, Python, JavaScript, or similar languages.
  • Experience with adjacent enterprise platforms such as Slack, Okta, or Google Workspace.
  • Experience working in a high-growth SaaS or technology environment.

  • Demonstrating the value of Braze
  • Qualifying early stage deals

  • Configure and solution: Design, build, and maintain C360/R360 layouts, Scorecards and health models, CTAs, Playbooks, and Success Plans that operationalize CX engagement models
  • Automate workflows: Build and maintain Rules Engine jobs, scheduled runs, and Journey Orchestrator programs, and troubleshoot rule and data-load failures so automated health, lifecycle, and outreach workflows stay accurate
  • Configure and maintain AI features: Set up and tune Gainsight's AI capabilities, such as Copilot prompts and Key Definitions, and the Skills that guide Claude’s use of the Gainsight MCP, keeping both aligned as new builds and enhancements roll out
  • Report and visualize: Develop and maintain dashboards and reports for leadership, managers, and end users across health, adoption, usage, renewals, and sentiment, with accuracy and actionability, as well as reporting on internal Gainsight adoption and engagement to inform enablement and platform improvements
  • Manage data and integrations: Use Data Designer and Rules to ingest, transform, and merge data for reporting and automations; partner with Salesforce admins and Data teams on Gainsight integrations with Salesforce and Snowflake; and manage field mappings, schema changes, sync troubleshooting, and data quality and retention
  • Support security and compliance: Partner with IT, Security, and GRC on access controls, integration authentication, and security reviews for new connectors and AI capabilities, ensuring customer data is handled appropriately across internal and external users
  • Deliver net-new build: Contribute hands-on to the Gainsight roadmap, including new health-scoring models, CTAs and playbooks, dashboards, data integrations, and AI capabilities that support new and existing CX use cases, and lead QA and UAT through to release
  • Partner cross-functionally: Work with the CX Business Systems Analyst / Technical Project Manager team and CX Operations, who gather and shape requirements, and provide the hands-on-keyboard administration and execution to deliver them
  • Run and support: Manage ongoing support and hypercare, monitor system performance, evaluate and apply new Gainsight platform releases, and maintain admin documentation, release logs, configuration inventories, and technical guidance for the platform

WHO YOU ARE

  • 3+ years in Customer Experience or Customer Success Operations, Systems Administration, or Revenue Operations, including 2+ years of hands-on Gainsight administration
  • Deep, hands-on expertise across Rules Engine, Data Designer, C360/R360, Scorecards and health scoring, CTAs, Playbooks, Success Plans, Journey Orchestrator, and Gainsight reporting and dashboards
  • Solid understanding of Salesforce data models and the Gainsight and Salesforce integration, with comfort troubleshooting data syncs and load failures
  • Proven ability to translate shaped requirements into scalable, well-documented system configuration
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of data-quality and governance discipline
  • A clear communicator who partners effectively across CX, Operations, and technical teams. Strong written and verbal English language skills are essential
  • Ability to manage multiple initiatives in parallel, with varying priorities and dependencies
  • Experience with customer intelligence, sentiment, or early-warning signal tooling (for example, StaircaseAI), or the ability to ramp on it quickly.
  • Experience managing Customer Success Platforms other than Gainsight

Nice to have:

  • Gainsight NXT Administrator certification (Level 2 or 3)
  • Experience setting up and managing Staircase AI integrations
  • Experience with Snowflake and SQL, plus exposure to integration tooling and REST APIs/JSON
  • Familiarity with Gainsight AI capabilities such as Copilot, including prompt and key-term configuration, and emerging connectors
  • Experience supporting multiple business segments or partner and reseller models
  • Experience owning Gainsight alongside an operations or systems-analyst partner in a mid-to-large SaaS environment
  • Salesforce Administrator certification

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

About the Role

Braze is making AI the default way of working across the company. Our Applied AI Architects are forward-deployed practitioners who combine domain judgment with hands-on build capability: they embed with business teams, treat employees as users and workflows as product surfaces, and ship working agents on shared infrastructure. The function runs in two tracks. GTM Architects are permanently embedded in the GTM organization, each owning a portion of a customer and prospect lifecycle that spans Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Support; when they address friction in one stage, they work the surrounding levers holistically, mapping how those functions connect today and how AI could connect them better. G&A Architects rotate across corporate functions like Finance, People, Legal, and Operations, driving each cohort to self-sufficiency.

You will lead this team. That means defining how a new role category operates, owning the portfolio of engagements across the business, and answering for the outcomes: adoption that persists, workflows that measurably improve, and committed bets that read out in business metrics like sales ramp time, quota capacity, and competitive win rate.

This is a player-coach role. You will carry enough build and field surface yourself to keep your judgment current, while your primary output is the team: who they are, where they embed, what they ship, and whether it works. You inherit the hiring manager seat for all Architect roles, a unified interview loop, and an operating model with real momentum. What the function becomes from there is yours to shape, in close partnership with our Director of Applied AI Product, the CIO and CTO organizations, and the leaders of the functions your team serves.

What You'll Do

  • Build the team. Close the open Architect reqs across both tracks (GTM and G&A), then own onboarding, development, and performance for a team of senior, highly autonomous ICs operating in a role category that barely exists in the market. Define what good looks like and what the career path is.
  • Own the engagement portfolio. Decide where Architects embed, what they prioritize, and when they rotate or scale back. Balance permanent GTM surface ownership against rotational G&A engagements. Say no to good ideas so the team ships great ones.
  • Answer for the bets. Own delivery and measurement of the committed GTM bets (sales ramp time, quota capacity / customer-facing time, competitive win rate) and run the promotion pipeline for G&A candidate bets. Every bet pairs a business outcome with leading indicators; you keep both honest.
  • Run the operating discipline. Enforce the engagement lifecycle (discovery, prioritization, readout, design, build, deliver, monitor) and the cohort maturity model. Adoption is the bar: an ignored output is a bug, and your team operates what it ships until it is productized.
  • Stay hands-on. Review agent designs, specs, and output quality at the system level. Carry a build surface of your own. Your field and build credibility is what earns the team its seat in pipeline reviews and functional staff meetings.
  • Compound through the platform. Partner with the Director of Applied AI Product to move field-proven patterns into shared infrastructure, and to feed field reality back into platform requirements, evaluation criteria, and measurement frameworks.
  • Be the executive interface. Negotiate embed agreements with CRO and CBO leadership and functional executives, represent the function's results and roadmap to senior leadership, and protect your team's focus when demand outstrips capacity, which it will.
  • Write the playbook. The role category is being defined in real time across the industry. Document what works, publish it internally, and make Braze a reference point for how a scaled SaaS company runs applied AI.

Who You Are

  • A proven leader of senior technical ICs. You have built and led high-autonomy teams: forward-deployed engineering, solutions consulting or architecture, field engineering, or an applied AI/ML group. You know how to manage outcomes without hovering, and how to coach people more specialized than you.
  • A builder with current hands. You have personally built AI agents, automations, or LLM-powered tools that changed how real work gets done, and you can evaluate someone else's system design, retrieval logic, and output quality without an interpreter.
  • Credible in the field. You have spent real time in or alongside the commercial motion of a B2B SaaS company. You can sit in a pipeline review, an EBR, or a functional leadership meeting and have the room take you seriously.
  • A portfolio operator. You think in terms of impact, feasibility, and sequencing across many competing demands, and you can defend your prioritization to executives who wanted a different answer.
  • Fluent in measurement. You can design a baseline, argue a leading indicator, dollarize an efficiency gain, and tell the difference between a metric that proves a mechanism and one that flatters a narrative.
  • A zero-to-one leader. You have stood up a function, practice, or team where no playbook existed, and you are comfortable being accountable for results while the ground is still moving.

Minimum Requirements

  • 10+ years of professional experience spanning GTM-adjacent technical work (solutions consulting/architecture, field or forward-deployed engineering, technical GTM strategy) and hands-on building
  • 3+ years leading senior individual contributors, with evidence you developed and retained them
  • Demonstrated, hands-on experience building AI-powered tools, agents, or workflows that transformed real work, with concrete examples you can speak to in depth
  • Track record of standing up a new team, practice, or function and scaling it past your own personal capacity
  • Executive-level communication and stakeholder management, including negotiating priorities with senior leaders
  • Experience defining and defending business-impact measurement for a technical team

Bonus Points

  • You have led forward-deployed engineering or applied AI teams at a model lab, an AI-native company, or a scaled enterprise SaaS business
  • You have shipped with modern agentic tooling (Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, custom agent frameworks, MCP-style integrations) and enterprise GTM stacks (Salesforce, Gong, Slack, Snowflake)
  • You have run engagement- or rotation-based operating models (consulting, embedded product teams, customer zero programs)
  • You have hired for hard-to-define roles and built interview systems that actually predicted performance

Why This Role Matters

The judgment of a company's best practitioners has always been its scarcest asset. The technology now exists to encode that judgment into systems that deliver it at scale, and Braze has committed the budget, the executive backing, and the operating model to do it. What the function needs now is the leader who turns a funded plan and a strong first hire into a team the rest of the company builds its expectations around. The window to define this role category, inside Braze and across the industry, is open right now.

For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $193,000 and $276,000/year, with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $241,000 and $345,000/year (including bonus or commission).Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Braze is a leading customer engagement platform, powering relevant and memorable experiences between brands and their customers. This is a critical and visible leadership role for an experienced and visionary professional who can combine a deep understanding of business processes and best practices, with a mastery of technology to drive operational excellence and accelerate company growth.

This role will be responsible for defining and executing the strategy, roadmap, development, ownership, and maintenance of all business systems supporting our CX business domain that includes - Expert/Professional Services, Partner Led Delivery, Customer Success, and Customer/Technical Support business functions. This role demands a leader who can lead a high-performing BSA and TPM team, serve as a strategic technology partner to CX executive leadership, and drive the adoption of AI across the CX technology stack. 

Responsibilities:

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team of Business Systems Analysts (BSA) and Technical Program Managers (TPM), fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement
  • Drive delivery excellence through iterative shipping, clear acceptance criteria, UAT protocols, and comprehensive documentation (Program Charter, BRDs, FRDs, SOPs) that enable effective system adoption
  • Build strong relationships with executive stakeholders across the CX domain, translate their objectives into scalable technology strategy, and communicate decisions, tradeoffs, and outcomes transparently
  • Collaborate closely with the CX Operations and Enablement/Productivity teams to drive organizational efficiencies
  • Oversee the full lifecycle of CX systems initiatives - from initiation and vendor selection through implementation, optimization, and governance
  • Lead AI adoption across the CX technology stack - partner with stakeholders to identify high-impact use cases, evaluate AI-native tooling, and embed AI-driven automation into CX workflows (e.g. case routing, health scoring, lifecycle triggers, etc)
  • Drive AI-first transformation within the BSA+TPM team by codifying AI workflows into shared practice, setting role-level expectations for AI-enabled work, and scaling capacity and quality through agentic workflows and automated analysis
  • Partner with the Data Analytics and Growth Engineering teams to ensure CX systems are built on a reliable data foundation - aligning on data models, integrations, pipeline dependencies, and reporting infrastructure to power CX insights and AI initiatives
  • Serve as the principal advisor on CX systems, ensuring a cohesive and integrated technology ecosystem cross-functionally
  • Stay abreast of emerging CX technologies and industry trends, evaluating their potential application to enhance Braze's CX capabilities
  • Own and manage vendor relationships for CX technology platforms, optimizing value and service levels
  • Own vendor and cross-functional escalations. Drive resolution on contract and scope disputes, capacity and commitment conflicts with delivery partners, and competing prioritization, partnering with CX-Ops to balance urgency with roadmap commitments
  • Own and manage the CX systems, their budgets and resources, and make strategic decisions on technology investments and resource allocation
  • Own the CX technology transformation roadmap, including active platform rollouts and net-new platform decisions
  • Lead work intake governance, OKR definition and feasibility, charter discipline, and capacity planning against roadmap commitments
  • Partner closely with the Business Systems Delivery & Support teams to ensure seamless technical execution of CX platform enhancements

WHO YOU ARE

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field; MBA is a plus
  • 15+ years of experience in Business Systems, with at least 5 years in a leadership or management role focused on CX systems
  • Proven track record of successfully leading CX technology strategy and delivering large-scale technology initiatives, with a deep understanding of project / program management methodologies and best practices
  • Experience establishing and running new functions within existing organizations
  • Working experience in Salesforce (Service Cloud, Customer Experience Cloud), and other common CX tools, e.g., Gainsight, Certinia, RocketLane, SupportLogic, SearchUnify, etc. 
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and build consensus among diverse stakeholders at all levels of the organization
  • Strategic, data-driven mindset with a hands-on approach - equally comfortable defining the vision and guiding the team through tactical technical challenges
  • Strong business acumen and a deep understanding of the end-to-end Post Sales / CX processes for a SaaS business like Braze
  • Hands-on experience evaluating and deploying AI solutions in a CX or GTM context - including AI-native SaaS tools, workflow automation, and data-driven decision systems - with the ability to translate business outcomes into technology requirements
  • Proven ability to manage complex projects with multiple dependencies and cross-functional teams
  • Familiarity with agile development methodologies for system enhancements and implementations

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Certifications in one or more core CX technology platforms, e.g. Salesforce, Gainsight, Certinia, etc. 
  • Experience with integrations and API management
  • Familiarity with data warehousing, business intelligence (BI), and reporting tools
  • Understanding of data privacy regulations (e.g. GDPR, CCPA, etc) as they relate to CX/GTM data

Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This is a critical and visible leadership role for an experienced and visionary professional who can combine a deep understanding of business processes and best practices, with a mastery of technology to drive operational excellence and accelerate company growth.

This role will be responsible for defining and executing the strategy, roadmap, development, ownership, and maintenance of all business systems supporting our CX business domain that includes - Expert/Professional Services, Partner Led Delivery, Customer Success, and Customer/Technical Support business functions. This role demands a leader who can lead a high-performing BSA and TPM team, serve as a strategic technology partner to CX executive leadership, and drive the adoption of AI across the CX technology stack. 

Responsibilities:

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team of Business Systems Analysts (BSA) and Technical Program Managers (TPM), fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement
  • Drive delivery excellence through iterative shipping, clear acceptance criteria, UAT protocols, and comprehensive documentation (Program Charter, BRDs, FRDs, SOPs) that enable effective system adoption
  • Build strong relationships with executive stakeholders across the CX domain, translate their objectives into scalable technology strategy, and communicate decisions, tradeoffs, and outcomes transparently
  • Collaborate closely with the CX Operations and Enablement/Productivity teams to drive organizational efficiencies
  • Oversee the full lifecycle of CX systems initiatives - from initiation and vendor selection through implementation, optimization, and governance
  • Lead AI adoption across the CX technology stack - partner with stakeholders to identify high-impact use cases, evaluate AI-native tooling, and embed AI-driven automation into CX workflows (e.g. case routing, health scoring, lifecycle triggers, etc)
  • Drive AI-first transformation within the BSA+TPM team by codifying AI workflows into shared practice, setting role-level expectations for AI-enabled work, and scaling capacity and quality through agentic workflows and automated analysis
  • Partner with the Data Analytics and Growth Engineering teams to ensure CX systems are built on a reliable data foundation - aligning on data models, integrations, pipeline dependencies, and reporting infrastructure to power CX insights and AI initiatives
  • Serve as the principal advisor on CX systems, ensuring a cohesive and integrated technology ecosystem cross-functionally
  • Stay abreast of emerging CX technologies and industry trends, evaluating their potential application to enhance Braze's CX capabilities
  • Own and manage vendor relationships for CX technology platforms, optimizing value and service levels
  • Own vendor and cross-functional escalations. Drive resolution on contract and scope disputes, capacity and commitment conflicts with delivery partners, and competing prioritization, partnering with CX-Ops to balance urgency with roadmap commitments
  • Own and manage the CX systems, their budgets and resources, and make strategic decisions on technology investments and resource allocation
  • Own the CX technology transformation roadmap, including active platform rollouts and net-new platform decisions
  • Lead work intake governance, OKR definition and feasibility, charter discipline, and capacity planning against roadmap commitments
  • Partner closely with the Business Systems Delivery & Support teams to ensure seamless technical execution of CX platform enhancements

WHO YOU ARE

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field; MBA is a plus
  • 15+ years of experience in Business Systems, with at least 5 years in a leadership or management role focused on CX systems
  • Proven track record of successfully leading CX technology strategy and delivering large-scale technology initiatives, with a deep understanding of project / program management methodologies and best practices
  • Experience establishing and running new functions within existing organizations
  • Working experience in Salesforce (Service Cloud, Customer Experience Cloud), and other common CX tools, e.g., Gainsight, Certinia, RocketLane, SupportLogic, SearchUnify, etc. 
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and build consensus among diverse stakeholders at all levels of the organization
  • Strategic, data-driven mindset with a hands-on approach - equally comfortable defining the vision and guiding the team through tactical technical challenges
  • Strong business acumen and a deep understanding of the end-to-end Post Sales / CX processes for a SaaS business like Braze
  • Hands-on experience evaluating and deploying AI solutions in a CX or GTM context - including AI-native SaaS tools, workflow automation, and data-driven decision systems - with the ability to translate business outcomes into technology requirements
  • Proven ability to manage complex projects with multiple dependencies and cross-functional teams
  • Familiarity with agile development methodologies for system enhancements and implementations

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Certifications in one or more core CX technology platforms, e.g. Salesforce, Gainsight, Certinia, etc. 
  • Experience with integrations and API management
  • Familiarity with data warehousing, business intelligence (BI), and reporting tools
  • Understanding of data privacy regulations (e.g. GDPR, CCPA, etc) as they relate to CX/GTM data
