WHAT YOU’LL DO

At Braze, we use technology to humanize connections between brands and customers. We believe human beings want to be spoken to like human beings, and technology like ours can help brands do that at scale.

That’s why, as B2B marketers, how we communicate with our existing and potential customers is so important to us. Help shape how we build those connections with our audience—what we say, how we say it, where we say it.

In this role, you will lead the next evolution of Braze’s lifecycle marketing function, building and developing a high-performing team while defining strategies that drive meaningful engagement across both prospect and customer audiences. You will play a critical role in helping customers discover, adopt, and realize value from Braze’s expanding portfolio of products and AI capabilities, connecting product adoption and customer outcomes to long-term retention and growth.

This role requires a strategic, data-driven leader who can translate customer insights and business priorities into innovative, scalable lifecycle programs. You will bring a strong point of view on how personalized experiences, experimentation, and emerging technologies can transform customer engagement, while building the team, capabilities, and operating model needed to bring that vision to life.

You’ll partner closely with Product Marketing, Product, Customer Success, Revenue teams, Marketing Operations, and other stakeholders across the business to ensure Lifecycle Marketing is a strategic driver of customer value and business growth.

In this role, you will:

  • Define and lead the next evolution of Braze’s lifecycle marketing strategy across prospect and customer audiences, establishing a clear vision, priorities, and roadmap that connect engagement to measurable business outcomes
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing Lifecycle Marketing team, hiring and onboarding new talent, establishing clear ownership and operating rhythms, and fostering a culture of strategic thinking, innovation, accountability, and continuous growth
  • Own and optimize lifecycle programs spanning prospect nurturing, customer onboarding, product activation, adoption, engagement, and expansion, creating connected experiences that help audiences progress through their journey with Braze
  • Develop and scale product adoption strategies that help customers discover, activate, and realize value from Braze’s evolving portfolio of products, with particular emphasis on accelerating adoption of new AI capabilities and translating product innovation into meaningful customer outcomes
  • Partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, Customer Success, and Revenue teams to identify adoption barriers, understand customer needs, and develop targeted lifecycle programs that accelerate time-to-value, deepen product engagement, and contribute to stronger retention and expansion
  • Lead the development of sophisticated audience strategies, segmentation frameworks, and personalized customer journeys, leveraging behavioral, account-level, and product usage data to deliver relevant experiences at scale
  • Establish a comprehensive lifecycle measurement framework that connects program performance to business outcomes, including prospect conversion, pipeline contribution, product adoption, customer engagement, retention, and expansion influence. Translate insights into clear recommendations and compelling narratives for senior leadership
  • Build a rigorous culture of experimentation and continuous optimization, developing testing roadmaps that challenge assumptions, uncover new opportunities, and improve lifecycle performance across audiences, journeys, and channels
  • Serve as a strategic leader for Braze-at-Braze initiatives, exploring innovative applications of our own platform and partnering with Product and Product Marketing to demonstrate customer engagement best practices and inform product innovation
  • Champion the thoughtful adoption of AI and emerging technologies within Lifecycle Marketing, identifying opportunities to improve personalization, accelerate experimentation, increase operational efficiency, and unlock new approaches to customer engagement
  • Collaborate with Integrated Campaigns, Regional Marketing, and other Demand Generation teams to develop prospect nurture strategies that improve engagement, conversion, and pipeline progression while ensuring alignment with broader go-to-market priorities
  • Partner with Customer Advocacy and Community teams to create coordinated customer experiences that deepen engagement and reinforce the value customers realize from Braze.
  • Establish scalable processes, systems, and cross-functional ways of working that enable the team to execute with excellence, prioritize high-impact initiatives, and continuously evolve its capabilities as the business grows

 

WHO YOU ARE

You are a strategic, data-driven marketing leader who believes that exceptional customer experiences are fundamental to sustainable business growth. You understand how to translate product innovation into meaningful customer value and how to connect engagement and adoption to measurable retention and expansion outcomes.

You are equally energized by building teams and building programs. You bring a strong point of view on lifecycle marketing, but also the curiosity, collaboration, and adaptability to shape its future alongside your team and cross-functional partners.

  • A strategic lifecycle leader with a proven track record of developing and scaling programs that drive prospect conversion, product adoption, customer engagement, retention, and expansion within B2B SaaS organizations
  • A builder and people leader who thrives on developing talent, establishing clear priorities, and creating the structure and culture needed for a team to do its best work
  • A customer-centric marketer who understands the relationship between product adoption, time-to-value, customer outcomes, and long-term retention, and knows how to translate those insights into effective lifecycle strategies.
  • A highly collaborative leader who excels at building trusted relationships and influencing stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Customer Success, Sales, and Revenue teams
  • An analytical thinker who can connect customer behavior, product usage, and marketing performance to business outcomes, using data to inform strategy, guide investment, and communicate impact
  • A curious and innovative marketer who embraces experimentation, challenges conventional approaches, and actively explores how AI and emerging technologies can improve customer engagement and marketing effectiveness
  • A strategic operator who can establish a compelling vision while remaining close enough to execution to guide decisions, solve problems, and ensure high-quality delivery
  • 8+ years of experience in Lifecycle Marketing, Customer Marketing, CRM Marketing, Growth Marketing, or related fields, including experience building and leading high-performing teams.
  • Proven experience developing lifecycle strategies and programs that drive measurable business outcomes across both prospect and customer audiences, ideally within a global B2B SaaS organization
  • Strong understanding of SaaS customer journeys, including onboarding, activation, product adoption, engagement, retention, and expansion, with experience translating product capabilities into customer value
  • Experience developing product adoption and engagement programs in partnership with Product, Product Marketing, and Customer Success teams. Familiarity with AI-powered products and evolving SaaS product portfolios is highly desirable
  • Deep expertise in audience segmentation, personalization, journey orchestration, experimentation, and lifecycle analytics, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable strategies

Finally, EMs should be experts in developing relationships with customer stakeholders, as such relationships are critical for ensuring program success.

  • Lead the AI Deployment Lifecycle: You'll own the entire deployment process from start to finish. This includes leading the initial use case design, defining the engagement’s operating model, managing the technical setup, and overseeing the final user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Facilitate Technical Workshops: You will lead hands-on workshops with customers to align on key objectives, technical specs, model configuration, and optimal integration architecture. You’ll also partner with customers to configure their solution in their engagement platform.
  • Drive successful customer engagements: You'll be the main point of contact for our customers throughout the AI deployment process. You'll keep projects on track by managing customer deliverables, proactively identifying and addressing risks, and providing clear, consistent communication to all stakeholders, including senior leadership.
  • Drive Process Improvement: You will champion project management excellence by continuously improving our standardized AI deployment playbook. You'll help us refine our processes to ensure we deliver consistent, high-quality results.
  • Influence the Product Roadmap: You'll play a crucial role in shaping our product roadmap,  ensuring it remains customer-centric and evolves to meet the changing requirements of our customers and AI deployment teams.  

WHO YOU ARE

You are a highly organized and entrepreneurial leader with a strong technical background and a customer-centric mindset. You are a natural at navigating complex projects and building relationships with a diverse range of stakeholders.

  • A Technical Project Leader: You have significant experience managing technical projects from start to finish. You're a natural at bringing together technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring everyone is aligned and projects are delivered on time. Your colleagues know you as the most organized person on the team, and you communicate with exceptional clarity and persuasiveness.
  • A Strategic Client Partner: You come from a professional services background and are an expert at leading workshops with senior-level stakeholders. You excel at understanding a customer’s needs and ensuring they are met, but you are also confident in your ability to push back on requests that don't align with the program's goals.
  • A Hands-On Technologist: You possess hands-on technical experience that allows you to contribute to a use case's architectural and machine learning design at a conceptual level. You're not just an action-item tracker; you can exchange ideas with a customer's marketing, data engineering and data science teams when needed.
  • An Entrepreneurial Builder: You are proactive and resourceful, comfortable identifying unmet needs and developing new solutions. You're driven to continuously improve our processes and help build a stronger, more efficient business.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

We're looking for a Lead Product Manager to lead the Banners team, which owns Braze's in-product messaging surfaces: Content Cards and Banners.

These are the channels that reach users inside the app experience rather than outside it. They're persistent, native, and always available, with no opt-in required and no deliverability tax. Content Cards is a mature, widely adopted surface. Banners is our newest channel and our fastest growing, having gone from launch to full feature parity with Content Cards in under a year, and now serving well over a billion impressions a day.

Braze operates at massive scale, collecting hundreds of billions of data points each month and sending billions of messages to end users daily. In-product surfaces are a growing share of that. The constraint on this part of the business is no longer capability. It's adoption, programmability, and making creation genuinely fast.

The goal here is to find someone who can take a portfolio that's technically deep and commercially material, and push it into its next phase. Here's what you'd focus on in your first year:

  • Drive adoption, not just delivery. The work is turning shipped capability into activated customers and sustained usage. That means better defaults, faster time to first banner, self-serve setup, and out-of-the-box integrations with platforms like Shopify
  • Make creation faster and more intelligent. Banners already supports three ways to build: drag-and-drop, raw HTML, and AI-generated. Braze is investing heavily in Operator, our AI assistant, and a big part of this role is making sure these surfaces are ones Operator can actually work with. Marketers are shifting from building things themselves to letting AI build it for them. A core part of this role is pushing that path forward: making Operator, our AI assistant, a natural and differentiated way to act on a marketer’s intent
  • Set the measurement bar. You'd define what good looks like for adoption, usage, and performance, and hold the team to baselines and targets that are real

Main responsibilities:

  • Define and own the roadmap for Content Cards and Banners, pulling from customers, sales, support, usage data, and competitive signal to figure out what matters most next
  • Partner with engineers and designers to execute that roadmap in a lean, entrepreneurial start-up environment
  • Own the commercial outcomes for your area (adoption, consumption, expansion) and understand the unit economics well enough to make good investment tradeoffs
  • Establish and manage internal and external customer expectations, including with enterprise accounts and in renewal and expansion conversations
  • Deeply understand our technology, business, customers, and market
  • Build best-in-class infrastructure for your products, treating reliability, performance, and observability as product requirements rather than cleanup work
  • Partner across the division to build reusable capability instead of channel-specific implementations. Shared editors, shared design patterns, shared APIs

WHO YOU ARE

  • 8+ years of Product Management experience, including owning a product line at scale
  • Strong communication, collaboration, organization, and persuasion skills. This is a senior IC role with no direct reports and a lot of influence. You'll need to align engineering, design, our SDK team, and go-to-market without positional authority
  • A proactive, positive, can-do attitude. You drive projects to completion excellently, and you're always looking for new ways that processes and products can be improved
  • Comfortable being technical. You can reason about client-side rendering, SDK integration, API design, and caching well enough to make real tradeoffs with engineers rather than relaying them
  • You build rich user experiences and work closely with designers. These are content creation products, so the quality of the authoring experience is the product
  • Data-driven by instinct. You go to the adoption funnel and the usage data before the anecdote, and you're rigorous about baselines
  • Customer-focused and commercially fluent. You understand how your product area drives consumption and expansion, and you can hold a credible conversation with an enterprise customer about why they should adopt a new channel
  • Eagerness to learn and grow.

Bonus points:

  • Experience with in-product or embedded messaging surfaces. Inbox, feed, banner, or in-app content products
  • Experience building rich content creation flows. Drag-and-drop editors, template systems, or WYSIWYG authoring
  • Experience shipping AI features inside an existing authoring tool
  • Experience with products that depend on customer-side SDK integration, and the adoption dynamics that come with that
  • Strong technical experience and the ability to understand and discuss product architecture
  • Experience at a high-growth technology startup
  • Experience at a high-scale technology startup. We operate at the scale of billions of users

For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $169,000 and $266,000/year, with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $188,000 and $296,000/year (including bonus or commission). Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

jobs.title: Lead Product Marketing, AI Decisioning Studio
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

Why This Role, Why Now

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform, helping the world's most ambitious brands build absolutely engaging relationships with their customers. Decisioning Studio is our set of products that decide what happens next for every customer, at scale, in the moment.

This is the most technically demanding product area in Product Marketing at Braze, and one of the most strategically consequential. Decisioning sits at the intersection of our data foundation and our AI capabilities — it's the product that makes both of them mean something to a customer. It competes in the fastest-moving corner of enterprise software, against a set of players that changes every quarter, in front of buyers who range from a CMO to a staff data engineer.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who wants depth over breadth. You will own Decisioning Studio including positioning, messaging, marketing plans, launch motion, competitive strategy, field narrative, and you'll do it as a peer to the PMMs who carry the rest of the Braze portfolio, helping shape the overarching narrative that connects it all. 

What You'll Own

  • Decisioning Studio product marketing including positioning, messaging architecture, launch strategy and execution, competitive strategy, pricing and packaging input, and the field narrative. Every decision about how this product reaches the market runs through you.
  • Technical audience credibility. Own how Braze explains decisioning to data engineers, architects, platform owners, and technical evaluators. These are audiences that will not tolerate marketing that skates over how something actually works.
  • Competitive strategy for decisioning and AI-driven personalization. Know this competitive set cold, and turn that knowledge into positioning that wins deals rather than positioning that describes the market.
  • Your contribution to the Data & AI portfolio narrative. Decisioning Studio doesn't stand alone. You'll partner with the PMMs who own the Braze Data Platform, observability, Account Objects, Operator, and Agent Console to build the overarching story that explains why these products belong together.
  • Roadmap influence. Partner with Product Management and Engineering as a genuine strategic peer, bringing market and customer insight that shapes what gets built, not just how it gets announced.

What You'll Do

  • Translate genuinely complex technology into language that lands. Decisioning logic, large language models, agentic systems, data infrastructure — you make hard things clear without making them shallow, and you adjust register for the room without losing substance.
  • Run launches that don't stop at the launch. Take Decisioning Studio releases from positioning through field readiness, and build the sustained motion that drives adoption and expansion on an ongoing basis, not just the moment of announcement.
  • Build and own the marketing plan for your products. You will partner with our demand, brand, and communication team members to build, execute, and measure every strategy and tactic.
  • Own pricing and packaging input. Partner with Pricing, Product, and Finance on how decisioning capabilities are packaged and monetized, and make sure the story holds together for customers and for the field.
  • Enable the field to sell a technical product with confidence. Partner with the PMM GTM team to build the narratives, plays, and assets that let Sales, Solutions Consulting, and CS support our customers and prospects.
  • Spend real time with customers and the market. Treat customer and analyst time as a priority, not a luxury, and bring what you learn back into positioning, enablement, and the roadmap conversation.
  • Act as a thought leader in the market. You write content, speak at events, and show up as a voice to listen to for marketers adopting AI in new ways. You are comfortable on stage, and an engaging writer. 
  • Use AI as a practitioner, not a commentator. You market AI products and you use AI in your own work. You're credible on both because you actually do both.
  • Operate without direct authority. Get things shipped across Product, Engineering, Sales, Enablement, and Marketing by earning trust and building relationships, not by escalating.

Who You Are

  • Technically deep, and it shows. You can hold your own in an architecture conversation, ask an engineer a question that makes them think, and earn credibility with technical buyers on the substance of what you say.
  • Fluent in the enterprise AI landscape. Large language models, agentic AI, AI infrastructure, and the evolving ecosystem of AI tools and platforms — you follow this market closely and have real opinions about where it's going.
  • An exceptional writer. You write with clarity, precision, and edge, and you can compress something complicated into something sharp. 
  • Comfortable with any audience. A technical deep-dive with a data engineering team, an executive briefing, an analyst inquiry, a sales kickoff stage.
  • Execution-focused. You have strategic range and a bias for shipping. Ideas that don't reach the market don't count.
  • A craftsperson who wants depth. You're drawn to owning one hard thing completely and you take pride in the quality of the work itself.
  • Steeped in martech. You understand this market, the competitive set, and how the role of marketing is being reshaped by AI and you can speak to that change with a point of view.
  • Data-driven. You instrument your programs, know what's working, and connect PMM work to pipeline and win rates with real numbers.

How Success Is Measured

Success is measured against business outcomes, not activity: pipeline influenced, Decisioning Studio adoption and expansion, competitive win rates, and the market's understanding of what Braze decisioning does and why it's different. You'll be expected to instrument your programs and show that connection clearly and consistently.

What You'll Bring

  • 8+ years of Product Marketing experience, with an exceptionally strong background in technical and AI products.
  • Fluency in the enterprise AI landscape: large language models, agentic AI, AI infrastructure, and the evolving ecosystem of AI tools and platforms.
  • A proven track record of developing product positioning and messaging that resonates with technical audiences and accelerates revenue in competitive markets.
  • Experience partnering closely with Product Management and Engineering to understand and shape roadmap strategy through market and customer insight.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who wants depth over breadth. You will own Decisioning Studio including positioning, messaging, marketing plans, launch motion, competitive strategy, field narrative, and you'll do it as a peer to the PMMs who carry the rest of the Braze portfolio, helping shape the overarching narrative that connects it all. 

What You'll Own

Business Development Manager, Enterprise BDR

About The Role

The Business Development team shapes Braze's future revenue every day. It's the team at the forefront of identifying, understanding, and helping prospective customers build, enhance, or transform their customer engagement strategy  and it's one of the most energetic, fast-paced teams at Braze.

We're looking for a proven business development leader to manage and coach our highly ambitious Financial Services (FINS) BDR team in Chicago, driving outbound pipeline growth through hands-on coaching, disciplined operations, and a genuinely collaborative, performance-minded culture. You'll join a group of Business Development leaders who take action, share what's working, and hold each other to a high bar.

What You'll Do

Business Development is a high impact, highly visible team. Attention to detail, pace and energy are crucial. BDRs at Braze don’t just hunt to deliver meetings, they are also responsible for actively selling to prospects and qualifying opportunities against qualification criteria. Delivering a day-to-day structure and accountability, coaching cadences and value selling methodology is core to the role.

  • Coach and quality-check the daily activity and quota performance of a mixed team of BDRs to ensure key metrics are consistently met.
  • Hire and efficiently ramp new BDRs, delivering onboarding across product knowledge, buyer personas, competitive positioning, tools, and role-play practice.
  • Run a regular coaching cadence covering time management, objection handling, prospecting tactics, and active listening.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Partnerships leaders to strategize on pipeline and prospecting initiatives that support company-wide objectives, and to ensure the team has quality market coverage and penetration.
  • Build and maintain a library of prospecting resources the team can draw on, and look for ways to run outbound with greater efficiency, including where AI and automation can reduce manual workload.
  • Maintain a high-performance, team-oriented culture and morale, including performance management and succession planning as BDRs are promoted internally.
  • Own accurate management reporting, deal forecast and commit, hiring pipeline, and project updates, using tools like Salesforce, Tableau, and Looker.
  • Manage individual and team quota performance in real time, stepping in proactively rather than after the fact.
  • Maintain strong written and verbal alignment with your regional Director and cross-functional stakeholders.

Success in this role means enabling your team to generate the volume and value of pipeline required to meet or exceed your team and individual BDR quotas. Managers are evaluated on three things: quota attainment (including performance management of individual BDR quotas), operational excellence (reporting, forecasting, process, and headcount planning), and personal brand (collaboration, innovation, and thought leadership). Consistently successful Managers have a clear, coached path to their next role at Braze.

What Success Looks Like in Your First 90 Days

  • You've completed BDR onboarding yourself, living a day in the life of the rep and have a working command of Braze's messaging, pipeline strategy, and team performance metrics.
  • You've established your operating rhythm: 1:1 cadences, reporting rhythms, and a real relationship with each person on your team.
  • You're already adding tactical value, coaching, prospecting ideas, process feedback, so your team is equipped to hit their number and the team is on track for its segment quota.
  • You're building fluency in the FinS narrative and its sub-segments (banking, insurance, mortgage/real estate, fintech) . You don't need to walk in an expert, but you're visibly building toward it.
  • You've started sharing informed perspectives upward: what's working, what needs to change, and where you see opportunity in process or coverage.

Who You Are

You've done this before. You've carried an outbound number yourself, you've led people who carry one, and you know the difference between a team that's busy and a team that's productive. You bring:

Must-Haves

  • 4+ years of B2B sales experience, including meaningful time in an outbound, SaaS environment.
  • 2+ years leading a sales or business development team (Team Lead, Manager, or Director).
  • A track record of quota over-performance — both what you personally carried and what the people you led delivered.
  • Comfort managing multiple types of territories at once (high-volume outbound patches alongside higher-touch strategic ones), and across multiple strategies (breadth, persona-based, events, etc).  
  • Salesforce fluency and hands-on familiarity with modern prospecting tooling (Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Gong, DemandBase, 6sense, ZoomInfo, or similar).
  • Strong cross-functional relationship-building skills this role only works if you can align Marketing, Partnerships, Solutions Consulting, and Sales Leadership around a shared strategy.

Nice to Have

  • Financial services or fintech industry experience — helpful for speaking the customer's language faster, but not required.
  • Experience selling across multiple verticals over your career, which builds the same muscle.

How You Operate

  • Genuinely people-first: you believe leadership means taking the blame and sharing the credit, and you take real ownership of your team's number.
  • Action-oriented and relentlessly tenacious, with a player/coach mindset.
  • Data-driven about KPIs, but equally attentive to the individual coaching and career conversations that keep a team motivated.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity; FINS' go-to-market strategy is still being built, and you'll help shape it rather than inherit a finished playbook.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

This is a chance to shape the next chapter of one of our most strategically important channels — with a canvas that extends well beyond a single region. We're looking for a seasoned partnerships executive to take the reins of an already thriving agency alliance program and drive it to the next level of scale and sophistication on a global stage, anchored by our relationship with Deloitte.

Sitting within our Alliances organization and reporting to the AVP of Delivery Partnerships, you will own the Deloitte partnership strategy globally — not just execute against it. You'll be the architect of the GTM vision, deepening and commercializing the Deloitte relationship across markets while acquiring and onboarding adjacent opportunities within the account. This is a build-and-scale mandate for someone who wants ownership, visibility, and the latitude to operate as a true business leader within the partner ecosystem — with impact that reaches across every region we operate in.

You will operate at the intersection of Sales and Alliances worldwide, working shoulder-to-shoulder with Sales Leadership across regions to shape program strategy, and with Account Executives globally to convert the Deloitte relationship into a sourced and influenced pipeline. You'll also partner closely with regional Alliances leaders to ensure strategy, tooling, and playbooks stay coordinated and best-in-class across every market. Success here is measured in one currency above all others: quality pipeline that converts, at global scale.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and evolve a comprehensive GTM plan with Deloitte across regions, translating strategy into quality net-new business pipeline globally
  • Drive the sales cycle in lockstep with our sales teams worldwide — from prospecting through deal close — in true partnership with Deloitte
  • Champion differentiated value propositions and Deloitte's specialisms, telling that story with conviction internally at Braze, with Deloitte leadership, and ultimately in markets around the world
  • Hold the partnership to a standard of accountability and reciprocity, ensuring a measured flow of outsourced Braze services in exchange for net-new client opportunities
  • Bring rigor to the business — reviewing sales play metrics and effectiveness with Deloitte and Braze leadership across regions
  • Operate cross-functionally as a connector across Tech and Cloud Partnerships, Partner Marketing, and Partner Education & Enablement to ensure the Deloitte motion is fully supported everywhere we compete

WHO YOU ARE

  • 10+ years of partnerships experience in a modern cloud technology company, G/SIs, or Agency, with a track record of increasing scope and impact
  • A proven, quantifiable history of driving sourced pipeline and influenced revenue through a mature SaaS partner program — you know what great looks like because you've built it
  • Deep fluency in the G/SI and consulting ecosystem: service offering design, marketing, lead generation, and the KPIs that matter to a professional services organization
  • Firsthand experience navigating large G/SI or consultancy environments, with an intimate understanding of their org structures, business dynamics, and how to build a compelling business case with them
  • A demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, take on complex strategic and operational mandates, and scale a program across a large, distributed organization
  • The gravitas and executive presence to represent Braze credibly with senior partners and internal stakeholders, paired with the grit and resilience to keep pushing when the path isn't linear
  • Willingness to travel across the globe as needed to invest in your most strategic partner relationships

For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $128,000 and $201,000/year, with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $171,000 and $268,000/year (including bonus or commission). Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

#LI-Hybrid

WHAT WE OFFER

Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

  • Competitive compensation that may include equity
  • Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
  • Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave
  • Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend
  • A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
  • Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching
  • Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze
  • Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®

ABOUT BRAZE

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.

The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025.

Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore.

The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.

BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.

Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you.

We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you

OUR AI-POWERED BRAZE RECRUITMENT PROCESS

At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.

This includes using AI to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. Such screening may amount to a form of solely automated decision-making. We also use AI for administrative support, like scheduling and recording interviews and summarizing interview notes. Our recruiting teams remain responsible for all hiring decisions and are involved throughout the process.

Depending on where you are located, you may have certain rights available to you in relation to Braze’s use of AI:

  • To opt out of AI-assisted review of your application, please click the “Learn More” at the end of the application form below and follow the instructions before submitting your application. Please note, if you apply to multiple roles at Braze, you will need to opt out in relation to each application.
  • To exercise other types of rights, such as rights to request further information about how AI is used in our recruitment process, to request a retroactive manual review of any decision made or to contest a decision, please contact us at talentdata.privacy@braze.com. 

Please contact us at talentdata.privacy@braze.com with any questions. To find out more about our hiring process, check out this page.

Notice Regarding Automated Employment Decision Tool (NYC Local Law 144)

Our use of AI during the application review process may include the use of automated employment decision tools. Pursuant to New York City Local Law 144, for roles based in New York City, or if you reside in New York City, you have the right to request an alternative selection process or a reasonable accommodation instead of AI-assisted review. 

To opt out of AI-assisted review of your application, please click the “Learn More” button below and follow the instructions before submitting your application. Please no

jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

The Role

The best software companies don’t grow through direct sales alone. They grow through ecosystems: networks of partners who extend their reach, deepen customer relationships, and deliver outcomes no single company can achieve alone. Partner-engaged opportunities close at a significant multiple of the rate and deal size of direct-only deals, and Partner Sales Directors are essential to accelerating this model.

As Partner Sales Director, you own the direct partner sales motion across a specific territory in AMER: aligning Braze's Technology, Delivery, and Marketplace partners to the specific needs of the highest-value customers and prospects in your patch. These are the most complex accounts in the region, often involving GSIs and specialist SI partners, senior partner executives and exec sponsors on both sides. You report to the AVP, Partner Sales AMER, set the partner strategy for your territory, and are often the person other Partner Sales Managers and Senior Partner Sales Managers in the region come to for guidance.

 

What You'll Own

  • Territory and account depth. Build and maintain a deep understanding of the customers and prospects within your territory - the partners already engaged on them, and the white space where a partner introduction would change the outcome. Crossbeam, Tackle, and Salesforce are your working tools.
  • Partner activation on live opportunities. Work alongside the Account Executives in your territory to get the right Delivery, Technology or Marketplace partner into the room early enough to matter, whether that's pipeline generation, competitive displacement, or a stalled deal that needs an outside push.
  • Customer value and retention. Partner with AMs and CSMs to identify where existing customers are underusing Braze, and bring in the partner who closes that gap, whether through implementation, a composable integration or ongoing managed services.
  • Joint Business Planning. Build and run the most complex, highest-stakes JBPs in the region with your priority partners, working closely with Partner Account Directors: shared targets, clear stakeholders, and a review cadence you hold everyone to.
  • Trusted advisor to Sales leadership. Be the person your Sales Director, AVP or VP Sales calls when they need a read on the partner landscape in your territory, and the person who proactively flags where a partner relationship is an asset or a risk on a specific deal.
  • Executive partner relationships. Build and hold relationships with partner executives and exec sponsors in your territory that go beyond a single deal, rooted in a genuine point of view on martech architecture and where composability creates value for the customer.
  • Coaching the field. Bring AEs up the curve on partner engagement: which partners are incumbent where, when to bring one in, and how to run that motion.
  • Ecosystem gaps and territory strategy. Identify where your territory is under-covered by partners and lead the work to close that gap, shaping the wider partner coverage strategy you feed back to the AVP and the Partnerships team.
  • Regional mentorship. Act as the go-to person for Partner Sales Managers and Senior Partner Sales Managers in your region, and represent the market in the AVP's absence when needed.

 

What This Role Is Really About

Pipeline sourced through partners is the outcome. The actual job is knowing your accounts so well, and your partner ecosystem so well, that connecting the two looks obvious in hindsight. That only happens through account mapping and relationship depth built over time, not through a partner directory or a marketing calendar.

You are the closest point of contact between Braze's partner ecosystem and the customers and prospects who benefit from it. When partners are activated and engaged in your territory, the customer sees more value, the AE closes a better deal, and Braze's reputation with our partners gets stronger.

 

How We Show Up

  • Sets the partner strategy for your territory. You know your accounts, your partners and the overlap between them better than anyone else in the room, and you shape the strategy you feed back to the AVP rather than just executing someone else's plan.
  • Drives outcomes through others. You don't own the AE relationship or the partner contract, but you influence both, consistently, without formal authority.
  • Builds relationships that outlast a deal. Partner executives, AEs, AMs and CSMs all trust you because you've shown up for them before, not because you supported something this week.
  • Communicates with precision. You can tell a Sales Director or VP Sales exactly which partner to bring in and why, and tell a partner executive exactly what a customer needs.

 

Who You Are

  • 10+ years of experience in a partner, alliances, channel, agency or vendor-facing role at a B2B SaaS or technology company, with a track record of driving revenue through partner-engaged deals, not just partner administration
  • Direct experience with account mapping and co-sell motions using tools like Crossbeam, and comfortable working deal by deal alongside AEs
  • Strong, current relationships across the partner ecosystem in your territory (Delivery, Technology and Marketplace), including GSIs and specialist SIs, and the credibility to bring senior partner executives into a conversation quickly
  • A point of view on martech architecture and composability that lets you speak credibly to why a given partner adds value to a given customer
  • Comfortable operating without a large team around you: this is a territory-owning, high-agency role where your impact depends on your own relationships and judgement
  • A track record of building senior, executive-level partner relationships, and of influencing Sales leadership's thinking on partners, even without a direct reporting line
  • Highly organised, self-directed, and able to manage a full territory's worth of accounts, partners and JBPs without things falling through the cracks

For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $89,400 and $140,400/year, with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $149,000 and $234,000/year (including bonus or commission). Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

WHAT WE OFFER

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

  • Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
  • Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave
  • Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend
  • A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
  • Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching
  • Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze

The Role

The Partnerships department operates in a fast-paced environment with a lean team. Key priorities arise from major events like SKO or Forge Partner Day, cross-functional initiatives, and urgent executive inquiries. Top-tier partnership teams require a dedicated program manager to own these priorities, drive execution, and maintain clear visibility into project status, blockers, and ownership.

Operating across the entire department rather than within a single partner segment, this role collaborates across every functional pillar. Key responsibilities centre on establishing clear workstream visibility and managing high-priority ad-hoc projects. This includes maintaining an accurate single source of truth for ongoing department initiatives, supporting program management for flagship events such as SKO, Forge Partner Day, and the departmental kick-off, and partnering closely with the AVP, Partner Experience to maintain the departmental operating rhythm—encompassing OKRs, business reviews, strategic narratives, All Hands meetings, and internal communications.

Rapid growth has outpaced formal tracking, leaving initiatives reliant on informal ownership and tracking. We need a program manager to establish structure, seamlessly manage diverse workstreams, and build lasting, repeatable processes. Success is defined by delivering high-quality projects on time and maintaining clear, transparent visibility into overall department status.

What You'll Own

  • Workstream visibility. Maintain one view of cross-departmental initiatives: owners, status, dependencies and risks, with Jira as the source of truth. Run regular check-ins that keep it honest, raise concerns before they become surprises, and give leadership a clear picture of what is moving and what is not.
  • Ad-hoc and flagship projects. Take projects from brief to delivery: agree scope and owners, build the plan, chase the dependencies, manage the timeline and run the follow-up.
  • Company moments such as SKO and Forge Partner Day. Support the Partnerships contribution to events where the department is on stage. This may include working with leadership on the narrative and theme, briefing speakers, gathering content from pillar leads and coordinating with Marketing and Events.
  • Cross-functional initiatives. Drive initiatives that cut across teams and need a single owner for delivery, such as moving a process from one team to another or launching a change that touches several pillars. Clarify who does what, keep the work moving and close it out properly.
  • Operating rhythm. Support the department's OKRs, monthly and quarterly business reviews, quarterly narratives and monthly All Hands. Build the trackers and templates, chase inputs, prepare pre-reads and help run the sessions, so that leaders spend their time on decisions.
  • Communications and PR-FAQs. Support the cadence of department updates and the PR-FAQ tracker for major launches, so that format, tone and timing stay consistent and status is honest.
  • Planning and engagement. Support the SVP, Partnerships and Partner Operations team with annual planning, and the follow-up from the employee engagement survey in Culture Amp: tracking actions through to completion and reporting back on what changed.
  • Salesforce alignment. If the acquisition of Braze by Salesforce completes, help plan and track the work to bring the Braze partner program in line with the broader Salesforce partner program and ecosystem, and keep it visible alongside everything else in flight.

What This Role Is Really About

A department our size can't hire a specialist for every function, and shouldn't. What it needs is someone who can pick up whatever matters most this month, run it properly and leave something behind that works without them. One month that is the narrative and run of show for Forge Partner Day. The next it is an initiative that three teams each assume another team owns. The through-line is visibility: whatever you are working on, people can see where it stands.

You will not own the content or the decisions. Pillar leads own their numbers and their stories, and leadership owns the choices. You own the delivery and the clarity around it. That means asking the question that exposes a gap in a plan, noticing when a deadline will slip a week before it does, and telling a leader that their narrative buries the lead. You do this without formal authority, and you earn trust by making everyone else's job easier.

You will also see things that are sensitive: survey results, plans in progress, changes to the organisation. Discretion is part of the job.

How We Show Up

  • Drives ownership to completion. You step in to claim unassigned initiatives, assign clear accountability, and steer them through to successful execution.
  • Communicates with clarity and impact. You distill complex updates into concise, actionable briefs for leadership and facilitate decisive, productive meetings.
  • Ensures end-to-end transparency. You maintain clear and dependable tracking of progress, status, and risks, flagging delays early alongside practical solutions.
  • Leads through influence and trust. You motivate senior leaders to hit deadlines by making collaboration seamless and consistently delivering value.
  • Balances strategy with tactical detail. You seamlessly transition from managing detailed operational schedules to briefing executives on complex cross-functional dependencies.
  • Upholds strict confidentiality. You handle sensitive and unreleased information with complete discretion and earn executive trust.

Who You Are

  • 5-8 years in program management, project management or strategy and operations roles at a B2B SaaS or technology company, ideally supporting a go-to-market, partnerships or alliances team
  • Has driven cross-functional programs from brief to delivery with several stakeholders and senior people, and has run events or company moments with speakers, content and a tight timeline
  • Has built visibility across a portfolio of workstreams, using trackers, status reporting and tools such as Jira, and knows how to keep them honest without making them a burden
  • A strong writer and storyteller, able to turn updates and numbers into something leaders grasp quickly
  • Skilled at facilitation: you run meetings with senior people, keep them to time, and leave with clear actions and owners
  • Data-driven, comfortable building trackers and spotting when numbers don't add up
  • Highly organised, able to manage many deadlines and very different kinds of work at once without losing detail
  • Happy to build process from nothing, and pragmatic about keeping it light enough to survive a busy quarter
  • Comfortable with the tools that run a department, such as Google Workspace, Slack, Jira and Confluence

jobs.title: Sales Director, SMB
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

We are seeking an experienced, entrepreneurial SaaS sales leader to build, scale, and lead our Braze For Startups (SMB) sales organization. This highly visible leadership role is for someone who has successfully built and scaled an SMB or velocity-sales business within a high-growth or enterprise-scale SaaS company.

The ideal candidate combines hands-on sales leadership with the strategic and operational depth to build a repeatable growth engine. They will lead a team of SMB Account Executives and outbound prospecting professionals while defining the sales motion, coaching methodology, performance standards, hiring plan, and operating cadence necessary to scale efficiently.

This leader will have a strong understanding of the SMB buyer journey and a demonstrated ability to create demand, convert pipeline, improve sales productivity, and drive predictable new-business revenue. They will be comfortable operating with meaningful autonomy, making informed decisions quickly, and partnering cross-functionally to build the systems and programs needed to grow the segment.

The successful candidate will also bring experience developing external ecosystems that accelerate growth. This includes building relationships with venture capital firms and their portfolio companies, digital agencies, consultants, system integrators, technology partners, and other influential partners that can generate pipeline, improve customer adoption, and expand market reach.

Experience selling marketing technology, customer engagement, marketing automation, CRM, email, mobile, analytics, or related SaaS solutions is strongly preferred.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own the strategy, execution, and performance of the SMB sales segment, including revenue attainment, pipeline generation, conversion, sales productivity, and forecast accuracy
  • Build and lead a high-performing team of Account Executives
  • Create a clear and repeatable SMB sales motion across inbound, outbound, partner-led, and sales-assisted acquisition channels
  • Establish the business operating cadence, including pipeline reviews, forecast calls, deal inspection, performance management, quarterly planning, and executive business reviews
  • Recruit, onboard, coach, develop, and retain exceptional sales talent; build the management bench and career paths required to scale the organization
  • Develop sales playbooks, enablement programs, prospecting standards, qualification methodologies, discovery frameworks, and objection-handling tools that improve consistency and conversion
  • Partner with Sales Operations to design territory and account-assignment models, lead routing, pipeline definitions, capacity plans, compensation structures, dashboards, and forecasting processes
  • Work closely with Marketing to improve demand generation, campaign conversion, account targeting, lead quality, lifecycle programs, and attribution across the SMB funnel
  • Collaborate with Customer Success and Account Management to ensure smooth handoffs, strong customer activation, retention, adoption, and expansion opportunities
  • Build and operationalize relationships with venture capital firms, startup ecosystems, accelerators, agencies, consultants, system integrators, and technology partners
  • Develop partner-led and ecosystem-led growth motions, including referral, co-sell, implementation, marketplace, and portfolio-company programs
  • Represent the company with customers, partners, industry communities, and senior stakeholders; bring market, customer, and competitive insights back to the broader go-to-market organization
  • Identify opportunities to improve SMB packaging, pricing, onboarding, product adoption, and go-to-market efficiency through direct customer insight and data-driven analysis
  • Operate as a strategic business leader with the autonomy to prioritize investments, improve execution, and build the programs necessary to make SMB a durable growth engine

WHO YOU ARE

  • 7+ years of progressive SaaS sales and go-to-market experience, ideally including SMB, commercial, velocity, growth, or emerging-business segments
  • At least 3+ years of direct people-management experience leading SMB sales teams, including Account Executives and preferably SDR, BDR, or outbound prospecting organizations
  • Demonstrated success building or materially scaling an SMB sales team, sales motion, or revenue segment within a high-growth or large-scale SaaS environment
  • A strong record of hiring, coaching, developing, and retaining quota-carrying sales talent and frontline sales managers
  • Experience owning meaningful revenue targets and consistently delivering against new-business, pipeline, productivity, and forecast goals
  • Deep knowledge of SaaS sales metrics and levers, including ARR, ACV, pipeline coverage, conversion rates, sales-cycle length, quota attainment, productivity, CAC efficiency, retention, and expansion
  • Experience creating and improving sales processes, performance-management systems, forecasting cadences, qualification standards, and sales enablement programs
  • Proven ability to lead both an outbound prospecting function and a full-cycle SMB Account Executive team
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with experience partnering closely with Marketing, Customer Success, Account Management, Product, Sales Operations, Finance, and Partnerships
  • Experience building relationships with venture capital firms, accelerators, startup communities, agencies, system integrators, consultants, and/or technology partners
  • Demonstrated ability to develop partner-sourced or partner-influenced pipeline through co-sell, referrals, agency relationships, technology integrations, and ecosystem programs
  • Experience selling marketing technology, customer engagement, marketing automation, CRM, email, mobile, analytics, data, or related SaaS solutions is strongly preferred
  • Executive-level communication skills, including the ability to lead compelling customer conversations, executive presentations, QBRs, internal business reviews, and partner discussions
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to navigate complex organizations, identify economic buyers and decision-makers, and guide stakeholders through the SaaS buying process
  • A data-driven operating style, sound judgment, high accountability, and comfort making decisions in an evolving, ambiguous environment
  • Strong external presence and a natural ability to build trusted relationships through professional communities, social channels, events, and industry networks
  • Familiarity with current digital, mobile, AI, customer-engagement, and application-market trends
  • Prior experience in a startup, scale-up, or high-growth technology company is strongly preferred

Preferred Success Profile

This person is not simply a manager of an established sales team. They are a builder who can create structure without unnecessary bureaucracy, maintain urgency without sacrificing quality, and turn an evolving SMB opportunity into a predictable, scalable revenue business.

They should be equally credible coaching an AE through a strategic deal, reviewing funnel conversion with Sales Operations, shaping demand-generation priorities with Marketing, meeting with a VC platform team, or building a co-sell motion with an agency or technology partner.

For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $95,000 and $136,000/year, with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $190,000 and $272,000/year (including bonus or commission). Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

#LI-Hybrid

WHAT WE OFFER

Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

  • Competitive compensation that may include equity
  • Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
  • Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave
  • Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend
  • A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
  • Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching
  • Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze
  • Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®

ABOUT BRAZE

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.

The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025.

Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Bes

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As an Account Executive on our Emerging Enterprise General Business team, you will own the full sales cycle from prospecting to close, working as a relentless "hunter" focused entirely on net-new customer acquisition. This role is dedicated 100% to breaking into untapped logos within Braze's Emerging Enterprise segment — defined as companies with between 1,000 and 2,000 employees — with no account management or existing-customer responsibilities. You will dedicate all of your energy to identifying, prioritizing, outreaching to, and ultimately closing new business.

Braze's "General Business" segment is composed of companies that fall within several verticals, including Quick Service Restaurants (QSR), Health & Life Sciences, Travel & Hospitality, and Technology, among others. Typical new-business deal sizes range from $200K to $1M+ per year.

You will operate as a trusted advisor to prospective clients as they look to Braze to grow and scale their business, working directly with Marketing, Product, and Technical executives and their teams to help them forge human connections between consumers and the brands they love. Join a scaling, diverse, and tight-knit team united by mutual collaboration, a growth mindset, and relentless optimism in pursuit of success.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You have 5+ years of experience selling SaaS solutions to enterprise clients, plus at least 5 years of overall industry experience. Background in Enterprise Sales for Marketing Technology preferred
  • You are a true net-new hunter who thrives in a greenfield environment, with a proven track record of breaking into new logos and driving deals across the finish line
  • You excel at generating and managing your own pipeline through outbound prospecting and collaboration with internal teams — business development, marketing, and technology & agency partners — thinking both strategically and creatively about how to drive desired outcomes through effective and persistent outreach
  • Your customers describe your selling as consultative and human. You're a natural storyteller and an attentive listener, with excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills
  • You demonstrate the mechanics of a value-first conversation, including the steps necessary to get there: strong and ongoing discovery, a solid understanding of the business pain, what outcomes they are hoping to achieve, and how Braze is best positioned to provide differentiated value
  • You know how to navigate large organizations — quickly identifying key decision-makers and understanding their buying processes for substantial SaaS investments — and how to mobilize distributed, global organizations to accelerate cycles
  • You bring a proven track record of forecasting accuracy and operational rigor, ensuring forecasts and opportunity details are kept up to date, leading productive deal reviews, and keeping MEDDPICC scorecards updated regularly. You keep internal stakeholders appropriately informed on deal progress via Slack updates and/or internal notes documents
  • Experience with Salesforce.com CRM or other CRM systems is required to manage sales pipelines. You adapt quickly to new cloud applications and tools
  • Knowledge of the MEDDPICC framework; Command of the Message experience a plus
  • A proven ability to lead and strategically manage a group of internal cross-functional stakeholders as part of a complex sales motion (Solutions Consulting, executive alignment, Value Consulting, etc.)
  • You're analytical and data-driven. Your approach is grounded in examples and defined by testing and iterating. You harbor a desire to understand and make sense of complex systems and concepts
  • Being a fast-growth company, things here change pretty fast. You're comfortable learning new things (tech, process, people) and navigating high-change environments
  • Positive contributor to the team and broader Braze culture through active participation, engagement, and adding value in order to uplevel those around you

  • Work with Onboarding Managers and other Customer Success Partners to seamlessly transition clients from onboarding to ongoing activity

  • You’re known for being a “team player.” We just can’t emphasize this enough

  • You have a high level of intellectual curiosity. You see opportunity and growth in learning more about what you do and how it impacts others

  • You have excellent time management skills; ideally, you have significant project management experience and/or formal certifications (PMP, Agile, etc)

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own Operational Processes: Own and continuously improve the operational processes and business requirements within the ES and PS divisions. Serve as an expert in Services Process best practices, with strong knowledge of the B2B SaaS business operations that underpin a CX Services group (e.g., services scoping and delivery, partner enablement and qualification, resource and capacity planning, and services revenue and utilization), to proactively identify bottlenecks and manual pain points, and design scalable solutions that drive efficiency
  • Deliver Operational Improvement: Lead high-impact operational programs that improve business processes and ensure alignment with departmental and company OKRs
  • Establish Data-Driven Excellence: Collaborate with the Data Engineering Enterprise Platform team (DEEP) to establish and maintain reporting frameworks that provide senior leadership with actionable insights into operational efficiency. Champion a data-driven approach, empowering teams to leverage analytics to inform their daily operations
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as a trusted advisor and liaison between the CX business and key operational and technical teams. This includes regular partnership with leaders in CX business divisions and serving as a liaison with our Program Management team
  • Influence Stakeholder Partnerships: Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with other departments, including GTM Operations (to define and drive best-practice frameworks), and the CBO Enablement team. Collaborate with the Business Systems (BZS) team, including Salesforce Administration to support the prioritization of key initiatives for Support and Services
  • Solution Design: Liaise closely with the BZS team, building well-honed specifications and requirements documents from business cases, then working with BZS to generate elegant, scalable technical solutions. You will be responsible for defining the "what," "why," and contributing to the "how" of systems implementation. Work with Growth Engineering teams to design and build AI solutions that improve efficiency within an Operations environment
  • Change Management: Help build the change management strategy for new processes or systems, including leading internal documentation efforts and partnering with the CBO Enablement team to ensure organization-wide training and adoption
  • Technical Acumen: Possess an advanced understanding of the systems and tools used by CX, including Salesforce and other relevant platforms. Be comfortable with complex datasets and advanced analytics to support strategic process analysis
  • Lead Through Influence: Bring strong leadership qualities to a role without direct reports, working closely with both upstream and downstream teams to guide decisions, build alignment, and foster a culture of continuous improvement
