jobs.title: Senior Director, GTM Product Marketing
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform, helping the world's most ambitious brands build absolutely engaging relationships with their customers. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to AI-powered experimentation and optimization, we put market-leading AI in the hands of marketers in one of the most dynamic categories in software. We're growing fast and expanding globally, and this role sits right at the center of how we bring that innovation to market.

Our core Product Marketing team defines how the world understands our products. This role is about what happens next: turning that messaging and positioning into a field narrative that wins. You'll be the connective tissue between Product Marketing and the GTM organization — the person who makes sure everything we bring to market is visible, understandable, and sellable across Sales, Sales Engineering, Customer Success, and Partnerships.

This is a player-coach role. You'll lead a small, agile team of GTM PMMs while staying hands-on in the work yourself — and you'll have the runway to grow that team and your scope as Braze scales globally.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • The field narrative: Take the core messaging and positioning built by the PMM team and shape it into a compelling, coherent story the field can carry into every conversation — by persona, segment, and stage of the funnel
  • The playbook, and how product information reaches the field: You own the system by which our products become legible to the GTM org: the plays, narratives, assets, and channels that ensure every seller knows what we offer, who it's for, why it matters now, and how to win against the alternatives
  • Technology & services delivery partner GTM: Own how we go to market with our technology and services delivery partners — enabling them on our products and narrative, partnering strategically on launches and programs, building joint go-to-market motions, and aligning priorities so that our success and our partners' success reinforce each other
  • Braze Services Marketing: Own the GTM narrative for our in-house services — support, onboarding, and education — and articulate the distinct value of Braze-delivered services to our customers as a meaningful differentiator
  • A small, agile, growing team: Lead and develop a team of GTM PMMs, setting priorities, raising the bar on craft, and building the foundation for a function that will scale globally over time
  • Partner with field leadership every day. Work hand-in-hand with Sales, Solutions Consultants, and CS leaders to understand where deals stall, what reps need, and how to translate product value into language that moves opportunities forward
  • Translate complex technology into the language of our buyers — and coach the field to do the same: You make hard things simple without making them shallow
  • Use AI as a force multiplier — judiciously: You're AI-literate and fluent in how AI is reshaping both martech and the practice of marketing. You know when AI meaningfully accelerates the work and when human judgment has to lead
  • Prioritize ruthlessly: Focus your team's energy on the narratives, launches, and plays that move the needle for the business — and have the judgment and the spine to say no to the rest
  • Spend time with customers: You treat customer time as a priority, not a luxury, and you bring what you learn back into the messaging, the playbook, and the roadmap conversation

How Success Is Measured

You can measure and report on your work, and you hold yourself accountable to business outcomes — not activity. Success in this role is measured against pipeline, product adoption, pipeline progression, and overall program impact, and you'll be expected to show that connection clearly and consistently.

WHO YOU ARE

  • A marketer who loves working with Sales and Customer Success. You're energized by the field, not protective of distance from it. The field trusts you as a subject-matter expert; Marketing trusts you as a strategic, thoughtful partner
  • A messaging craftsperson. You can take a positioning doc and a complex product and turn it into something sharp, memorable, and sales-ready. Strong messaging chops are non-negotiable
  • Fluent in the sales motion. You understand how deals actually get done and build for the way the field really sells
  • Deeply curious. You ask why. You dig into the product, the market, the competition, and the customer until you understand them well enough to make them simple
  • An exceptional writer and presenter. You write with clarity and edge, and you can command a room — a sales kickoff stage, an exec readout, or a field enablement session
  • Steeped in martech. You bring deep experience in the martech space, including a strong grasp of AI innovations and the competitive landscape
  • A sharp prioritizer and a builder of trust across cross-functional teams
  • 10+ years of experience in Product Marketing, GTM/field marketing, or a closely related GTM function, including experience leading and developing people
  • A track record of building field-facing narratives and enablement that demonstrably influenced pipeline, deal velocity, or win rates
  • Deep experience in B2B SaaS, ideally in martech, with strong command of the competitive and AI landscape
  • Proven ability to translate complex technology into buyer-ready language — and to help a field organization do the same
  • Experience building joint go-to-market motions with technology or services delivery partners — enabling partners, aligning priorities, and partnering on launches and programs
  • Demonstrated ability to operate across functions and bring order to ambiguity
  • A genuine interest in marketing as a craft

THE DETAILS

  • Reports to: VP of Product Marketing
  • Location: Hybrid; must be based in one of our hub cities — New York (HQ), San Francisco, Chicago, or Austin
  • Travel: Up to 30%

HOW WE WORK

We move fast, we work hard, and we love our jobs. If that sounds like your kind of team, we'd love to meet you.

For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $149,000 and $224,000/year, with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $171,000 and $257,000/year (including bonus or commission). Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

#LI-Hybrid

Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

  • Competitive compensation that may include equity
  • Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
  • Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave
  • Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend

This is a player-coach role. You'll lead a small, agile team of GTM PMMs while staying hands-on in the work yourself — and you'll have the runway to grow that team and your scope as Braze scales globally.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • The field narrative: Take the core messaging and positioning built by the PMM team and shape it into a compelling, coherent story the field can carry into every conversation — by persona, segment, and stage of the funnel
  • The playbook, and how product information reaches the field: You own the system by which our products become legible to the GTM org: the plays, narratives, assets, and channels that ensure every seller knows what we offer, who it's for, why it matters now, and how to win against the alternatives
  • Technology & services delivery partner GTM: Own how we go to market with our technology and services delivery partners — enabling them on our products and narrative, partnering strategically on launches and programs, building joint go-to-market motions, and aligning priorities so that our success and our partners' success reinforce each other
  • Braze Services Marketing: Own the GTM narrative for our in-house services — support, onboarding, and education — and articulate the distinct value of Braze-delivered services to our customers as a meaningful differentiator
  • A small, agile, growing team: Lead and develop a team of GTM PMMs, setting priorities, raising the bar on craft, and building the foundation for a function that will scale globally over time
  • Partner with field leadership every day. Work hand-in-hand with Sales, Solutions Consultants, and CS leaders to understand where deals stall, what reps need, and how to translate product value into language that moves opportunities forward
  • Translate complex technology into the language of our buyers — and coach the field to do the same: You make hard things simple without making them shallow
  • Use AI as a force multiplier — judiciously: You're AI-literate and fluent in how AI is reshaping both martech and the practice of marketing. You know when AI meaningfully accelerates the work and when human judgment has to lead
  • Prioritize ruthlessly: Focus your team's energy on the narratives, launches, and plays that move the needle for the business — and have the judgment and the spine to say no to the rest
  • Spend time with customers: You treat customer time as a priority, not a luxury, and you bring what you learn back into the messaging, the playbook, and the roadmap conversation

How Success Is Measured

You can measure and report on your work, and you hold yourself accountable to business outcomes — not activity. Success in this role is measured against pipeline, product adoption, pipeline progression, and overall program impact, and you'll be expected to show that connection clearly and consistently.

WHO YOU ARE

  • A marketer who loves working with Sales and Customer Success. You're energized by the field, not protective of distance from it. The field trusts you as a subject-matter expert; Marketing trusts you as a strategic, thoughtful partner
  • A messaging craftsperson. You can take a positioning doc and a complex product and turn it into something sharp, memorable, and sales-ready. Strong messaging chops are non-negotiable
  • Fluent in the sales motion. You understand how deals actually get done and build for the way the field really sells
  • Deeply curious. You ask why. You dig into the product, the market, the competition, and the customer until you understand them well enough to make them simple
  • An exceptional writer and presenter. You write with clarity and edge, and you can command a room — a sales kickoff stage, an exec readout, or a field enablement session
  • Steeped in martech. You bring deep experience in the martech space, including a strong grasp of AI innovations and the competitive landscape
  • A sharp prioritizer and a builder of trust across cross-functional teams
  • 10+ years of experience in Product Marketing, GTM/field marketing, or a closely related GTM function, including experience leading and developing people
  • A track record of building field-facing narratives and enablement that demonstrably influenced pipeline, deal velocity, or win rates
  • Deep experience in B2B SaaS, ideally in martech, with strong command of the competitive and AI landscape
  • Proven ability to translate complex technology into buyer-ready language — and to help a field organization do the same
  • Experience building joint go-to-market motions with technology or services delivery partners — enabling partners, aligning priorities, and partnering on launches and programs
  • Demonstrated ability to operate across functions and bring order to ambiguity
  • A genuine interest in marketing as a craft

THE DETAILS

  • Reports to: VP of Product Marketing
  • Location: Hybrid; must be based in one of our hub cities — New York (HQ), San Francisco, Chicago, or Austin
  • Travel: Up to 30%

HOW WE WORK

We move fast, we work hard, and we love our jobs. If that sounds like your kind of team, we'd love to meet you.

  • Own SCA governance and milestone delivery: Lead the execution of the Braze–AWS Strategic Collaboration Agreement — steering committees, QBRs, executive sponsorship cadences, and milestone tracking — ensuring both organizations deliver against multi-year commitments

  • Own global partnership direction: Independently set the strategic direction for the AWS partnership and leverage cross-functional teams at Braze to execute against it with consistency and accountability
  • Shape product and integration priorities: Collaborate with Braze and AWS product and engineering leadership to influence roadmap direction, integration development, and joint solution design aligned to customer and ecosystem needs — including where AWS's AI/ML and data stack intersects with customer engagement
  • Set commercial ambition and targets: Define measurable goals for partner-sourced pipeline, revenue influence, Marketplace transactions, and ecosystem expansion — and hold both sides accountable to delivering against them
  • Drive commercial performance: Work with Braze Sales leadership and regional PAMs to embed the AWS partnership into active deal cycles — operationalizing co-sell mechanics (ACE pipeline sharing, opportunity registration), Marketplace private offers, and EDP burn-down positioning — translating partnership momentum into pipeline and revenue

WHO YOU ARE

  • 8+ years of experience within the SaaS/technology ecosystem
  • 3+ years of that with Partnerships experience
  • Experience partnering with or working at major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) or multinational technology enterprises on high-impact strategic initiatives.
  • Track record of managing strategic partners at a $1B+ revenue-generating organization, including joint investment frameworks, co-innovation, and milestone delivery.
  • Experience taking strategic projects from ideation through to execution
  • An established network within the AWS community
  • Deep familiarity with AWS — its GTM organization (PDMs, PSMs, ISV teams), partner programs (APN, ISV Accelerate, Marketplace), and how enterprise customers buy and expand on AWS
  • Strong understanding of the customer engagement platform landscape and how cloud infrastructure intersects with marketing technology
  • Experience driving AWS Marketplace as a commercial channel — private offers, CPPO, co-sell motions, and EDP/PPA burn-down dynamics
  • Understanding of AWS co-sell mechanics (ACE pipeline sharing, opportunity registration) and how to operationalize them at scale
  • Familiarity with AWS's AI/ML and data stack (Bedrock, SageMaker, Redshift, S3/zero-copy patterns) and where it intersects with customer engagement
  • Experience building joint GTM with AWS industry verticals (retail/CPG, media, financial services) and regional field teams
  • Track record of securing executive alignment across partner and internal stakeholders, including C-suite engagement and governance model design
  • Experience working with product and engineering teams to align on integration priorities and advance a technically grounded partnership roadmap
  • Able to operate independently in a strategic, first-in-kind capacity and embed partnership priorities into broader company-wide GTM motions
  • Comfort operating across AWS's scale and internal complexity — navigating multiple orgs (service teams, partner org, field) to get decisions made

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As a Senior Security Engineer on the Enterprise Security team, you'll protect Braze employees, their devices, and our work locations. You'll investigate malware and advanced threats, secure our SaaS applications, harden internal configurations, propose security architecture improvements, and build the alerts and reports that keep the team ahead of risk.

You'll own core security infrastructure that sits at the center of Enterprise Security operations and works closely with Cloud Security, App Security, and Information Technology. That means developing and enforcing policies, expanding our SIEM capabilities with partners across the business, and evaluating vendor and partner technologies for security gaps.

Your day-to-day spans threat and malware investigations, SaaS security, AI security,  architecture review, MDM, communications management, and vulnerability remediation. You'll secure communications, support compliance efforts, and automate wherever it reduces toil. You'll work both independently and cross-functionally, and you'll mentor junior engineers on security fundamentals. You’ll have the opportunity to implement DLP where needed as well as secure AI as it develops and is used to drive business function.

As a senior team member, you'll help build functionality for a high-scale, growing customer base, collaborate with diverse security professionals, address unique security challenges, participate in on-call rotations, and respond to critical incidents.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and operate security solutions that protect Braze's employees, devices, and infrastructure, scaling them as the organization grows
  • Expand SIEM and automation capabilities: build and tune detections, improve alerting, and automate detection and reporting pipelines, including prioritizing data ingestion and keeping systems healthy
  • Review and govern MCP and AI agent integrations, set controls for AI-assisted coding environments, and define policy for autonomous AI tooling across the company
  • Secure SaaS applications and internal systems through policy design, control enforcement, and configuration hardening
  • Lead security activities across the enterprise stack, including vulnerability testing and analysis, security event investigation, and evaluation of new tools and technologies to reduce business risk
  • Serve as a key decision maker on internal product and system deployments, and ensure teams build in line with security policy and best practice
  • Act as a secondary resource for adjacent domains, (AppSec, compliance, cloud security, system security) in a fast-moving environment

  • Experience in scripting and light coding
  • Investigate and respond to malware, social engineering, and phishing independently
  • This role is a key decision maker regarding internal product and system deployments
  • Mature our Zero Trust environment and serve as the subject-matter expert on proxy, network, and VPN considerations

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of Security Engineering experience with a strong focus on enterprise security, network security, endpoint security
  • 4+ years of experience working in a corporate security organization/environment with hands on, technical, user facing implementation
  • Prior experience working as a technical authority in a team environment, deep hands-on technical expertise, not just admin-level familiarity. You understand how the technology works internally and what goes on behind the scenes
  • Professional experience with the modern tech stack and protecting SaaS applications. Direct technical and hands on experience with securing Email, Mac endpoints, IAM ( okta and Gsuite ), Crowdstrike EDR, SOAR, Enterprise networking security ( both endpoint and infra ), and Forensics
  • Past experience conducting end-to-end security reviews of SaaS applications, Data access and movement,  Technical architecture, authentication and authorization controls, and contractual security requirements, to ensure third-party tools meet organizational security standards
  • Past experience leading the design, implementation, and continuous tuning of security programs across laptop endpoint and networks; leading policy development, incident triage, data classification alignment, and cross-functional collaboration to prevent unauthorized exfiltration of sensitive data
  • A self-starter with great communication and organizational skills

Bonus:

  • Forensics experience
  • Cloud security experience
  • Technical Security Certifications that delve deeper than high level concepts
  • Experience with being a foundational security engineer and/or building a new security team ground up

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

Braze is a modern, cloud-first SaaS company running entirely on cloud-native infrastructure — large-scale, distributed systems spanning AWS, GCP, and self-managed Kubernetes, backed by self-managed data stores such as MongoDB. We're looking for a Senior Cloud Security Engineer II to join our Security Engineering function as a senior individual contributor and technical leader for cloud security.

This is a step up from our Senior Cloud Security Engineer role. Where a Senior engineer executes and improves our cloud security controls, a Senior Cloud Security Engineer II sets the technical direction: you define the standards and reference patterns other engineers build on, lead cross-team security initiatives end to end, take on the ambiguous problems that don't yet have a playbook (and write the playbook), and raise the bar for the whole team through mentorship and review. You'll go especially deep across three areas — secure architecture and threat modeling, detection engineering and incident response, and Kubernetes and platform security — and you'll shape how Braze does cloud security across Engineering. This is a pure IC role; you lead through technical depth and influence rather than direct people management.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Set the technical direction (leadership & standards):

  • Define the cloud security standards, guardrails, and reference architectures that Infrastructure, SRE, and Product Engineering build on — turning point-in-time fixes into durable, org-wide patterns
  • Set your own objectives and roadmap for high-impact cloud security work, in partnership with Security Engineering leadership, and drive it to measurable outcomes
  • Lead cross-functional security initiatives end to end — scope, timeline, stakeholders, and delivery — guiding technical debates to a decision and owning the result
  • Mentor and uplevel other security and platform engineers through pairing, design review, and feedback; act as a force multiplier and the go-to technical resource for cloud security
  • Represent cloud security in architecture and design forums, translating complex attack paths and risk into clear, actionable guidance engineers will actually adopt

Secure architecture & threat modeling:

  • Own threat modeling as a discipline for new cloud technologies, services, and patterns adopted across Engineering — making it a repeatable, scalable practice rather than a one-off exercise
  • Partner with Infrastructure, SRE, and Product Engineering to design secure-by-default cloud architectures and build practical, scalable controls across AWS, GCP, and self-managed systems
  • Drive control-plane and IAM security strategy across AWS and GCP, including relationships with external identity providers, RBAC models, and least privilege at scale
  • Continually assess posture, surface systemic and emerging risk, and set the priorities that reduce it

Detection engineering, incident response & automation:

  • Advance our detection strategy: design high-signal detections and SIEM rules (with our SIEM Management function) and own detection coverage for cloud threats end to end
  • Serve as a senior incident responder and cloud-forensics lead for cloud and run-time security investigations across AWS and GCP — and codify what you learn into standard IR playbooks and preventative controls
  • Own and optimize security tooling such as CrowdStrike (EDR/CSPM/IR), Tenable, and native cloud security services, and lead our vulnerability management workflow — scanning, triage, prioritization, and remediation — for cloud assets

Kubernetes & platform security:

  • Own the security of our self-managed Kubernetes environments — control plane, nodes, workload isolation, admission control, run-time security, and the CI/CD supply chain feeding them
  • Set the standards for Infrastructure-as-Code and pipeline security (Terraform preferred): design and harden IaC and CI/CD automation so security is built into how we ship
  • Establish best practices for patch management, base-image hardening, and version management across containerized and VM-based environments
  • Lead the security of large-scale, distributed systems and self-managed data stores (e.g., MongoDB), accounting for their real-world operational and security implications

WHO YOU ARE

You are a senior individual contributor who leads through technical depth and influence rather than authority. You can take an ambiguous, open-ended cloud security problem, define the objective yourself, and deliver a solution that becomes the way Braze does it going forward. You translate complex cloud attack paths, IAM misconfigurations, and multi-step threat scenarios into guidance engineers adopt, and you balance strong controls with operational reality. You raise the people around you — through mentorship, review, and the standards you set — and you stay current with the cloud security landscape, tools, and threats. Above all, you can walk someone through the messy middle — what you tried, what broke, and what you'd do differently.

These are the genuinely pass/fail requirements:

  • Several years owning cloud security in production — on-call for it, not adjacent to it
  • Hands-on, not theoretical: AWS as primary cloud, working GCP, self-managed Kubernetes
  • You read and write code (Python, TF)

Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.   • Competitive compensation that may include equity
  • Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
  • Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave
  • Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend
  • A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
  • Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching
  • Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze
  • Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®

ABOUT BRAZE

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.

The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025.

Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore.

The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.

BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.

Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you.

We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you

OUR AI-POWERED BRAZE RECRUITMENT PROCESS

At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.

This includes using AI to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. Such screening may amount to a form of solely automated decision-making. We also use AI for administrative support, like scheduling and recording interviews and summarizing interview notes. Our recruiting teams remain responsible for all hiring decisions and are involved throughout the process.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Braze’s product is the control center for thousands of the world’s most sophisticated marketing teams. The Frontend Infrastructure & Experience (FIX) team builds the platform foundations that every product engineer relies on and owns key parts of the end-user experience.

The team makes it easy for engineers across Braze to build polished, accessible, and consistent UIs. FIX owns our design system and component library, internationalization stack, code generation and scaffolding tooling, and the navigation and routing layer of the product. The team also owns key customer-facing experiences including our data tables and our rich text, drag-and-drop, and code editors.

As a Senior Engineer on FIX, you will build high-impact frontend infrastructure and product experiences used across Braze. You will lead important projects from design through rollout, raise the quality bar through technical judgment and code review, and help other engineers move faster by making the product easier to build, test, and maintain.

In this role you will:

  • Design and build foundational frontend systems, components, tools, and patterns used by engineers across Braze
  • Lead large projects end-to-end, including technical design, implementation, testing, rollout, and operational follow-through
  • Improve the developer experience of working in a large TypeScript and React codebase through better abstractions, tooling, documentation, and examples
  • Build customer-facing product experiences that are polished, accessible, performant, and consistent with Braze’s product standards
  • Partner with product engineers, designers, and infrastructure teams to solve cross-cutting frontend problems
  • Mentor other engineers through code review, pairing, technical guidance, and clear communication

Recent and ongoing work on the team includes:

  • Developing the framework used to build our marketing message editors
  • Enabling our in-app AI harness to create, modify, and test messages in our Drag-and-Drop message editors
  • Migrating the navigation and routing layer to a fully React-based system
  • Extending the design system with semantic tokens and supporting a product rebrand
  • Building type-safe scaffolding and API tooling for frontend development
  • Advancing accessibility, localization, and consistency across product experiences

Parts of our stack with which you will work:

  • TypeScript, React
  • Cypress, Jest, RSpec
  • Frontend build, packaging, and code generation tooling
  • Ruby on Rails

WHO YOU ARE

  • Have 5+ years of software engineering experience with a strong track record of technical impact
  • Are highly skilled in modern frontend development, especially TypeScript and React
  • Have experience building reusable frontend systems, components, tools, or infrastructure
  • Care deeply about user experience, accessibility, performance, and maintainability
  • Are comfortable working in a large frontend codebase with many stakeholders
  • Communicate clearly, collaborate well across teams, and help raise the technical bar for those around you
  • Bonus experience
    • Experience building design systems or component libraries
    • Experience with frontend testing frameworks such as Cypress or Jest

    • Experience with Ruby on Rails

WHAT YOU'LL DO

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer II to join the Decisioning Studio Integrations team building BrazeAI Decisioning Studio™. Decisioning Studio is a reinforcement learning platform that runs continuous experiments to personalize customer engagement for each individual. Its results depend on the data it learns from and on the channels that carry its decisions to customers. Our team owns both. We ingest enterprise customer data of any schema and at a very large scale from warehouses, engagement platforms and other enterprise systems. We also deliver the recommendations from our RL pipelines across email, SMS, push, in-app and other channels. These are high-impact, customer-facing features.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead complex integration projects from design through build and rollout, and set technical direction for the Decisioning Studio integration platform
  • Design and build integrations with cloud data warehouses, customer engagement platforms and other enterprise systems, for both data ingestion and activation orchestration
  • Build ingestion pipelines that handle every way customers send data, including batch pulls, file drops, APIs and streaming, and accept arbitrary schemas without letting bad data reach our models
  • Build event-driven, fault-tolerant activation pipelines that deliver recommendations on schedule, recover cleanly from partial failures and never send twice
  • Design for multi-region deployment and compliance requirements, including data residency and PII handling
  • Own your systems in production. Instrument them with Datadog, take part in the on-call rotation, and take incidents all the way to the root cause
  • Work with data scientists, ML engineers and product managers to turn integration requirements into reusable platform capabilities
  • Mentor engineers and raise the bar for code quality, testing and design review

WHO YOU ARE

  • 6+ years of backend engineering experience building and operating distributed systems in production
  • A track record of technical leadership: owning complex projects end to end, making architecture decisions and setting direction for other engineers
  • Experience building data pipelines or integrations that move very large volumes of data between systems, including schema changes, backfills and partial failures
  • A strong grasp of event-driven architecture and reliability patterns: message brokers such as Kafka, idempotency, retries with backoff, dead-letter handling, and at-least-once versus exactly-once tradeoffs
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure (GCP preferred) and Kubernetes
  • Experience with AI coding assistants, and the judgment to know when they help and when they don't
  • A clear communicator who works well with engineering, data science and product
  • A self-starter who finds problems and works around obstacles without waiting for direction

  • Experience integrating with cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery, Snowflake or Redshift
  • Experience integrating with customer engagement platforms such as Braze, Adobe, Salesforce Marketing Cloud or Klaviyo
  • Experience building multi-region systems under data residency and compliance requirements
  • Experience running ML systems in production

About the Role


As the Senior Staff Monetization and Pricing Strategist, you will play a critical role in shaping the pricing strategy for our B2B SaaS offerings. As an individual contributor, will analyze market trends, customer needs, and competitive positioning to develop pricing models and packaging strategies that maximize revenue and enhance customer value. This role requires a strategic thinker with a strong analytical background and a deep understanding of the SaaS (MarTech preferred but not required) landscape. Also needs to be able to work cross functionally with finance, accounting, legal, product, marketing, operations, and go to market teams to ensure smooth releases of pricing updates and monetization strategies.

You will report to the Vice President, Market Strategy. This role will be hybrid for either the New York or San Francisco Office. 

What You’ll Do

  • Pricing Strategy Development: Design and implement pricing strategies that align with business objectives and market demands, ensuring competitiveness and profitability.
  • Market Analysis: Conduct thorough market research and competitive analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and potential threats in the MarTech space.
  • Customer Insights: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success, to gather insights on customer needs and preferences, informing pricing and packaging decisions.
  • Revenue Forecasting: Develop revenue models and forecasts based on pricing strategies, market conditions, and customer behavior to support financial planning.
  • Packaging Optimization: Create and optimize product packages that enhance customer value and drive adoption, ensuring clarity and simplicity in offerings.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with product management, sales, finance, legal and marketing teams to ensure alignment on pricing strategies and effective communication to customers.
  • Performance Monitoring: Establish KPIs to measure the effectiveness of pricing and packaging strategies, and make data-driven recommendations for adjustments as needed.
  • Thought Leadership: Stay informed on industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in the MarTech space to drive innovation in pricing and packaging
  • Operational Excellence: Institutionalize strategic frameworks, guidelines, and best practices to ensure operational consistency, scalability, and continuous improvement across the monetization function and key cross-functional partners; drive process improvements based on direct and indirect feedback from executives, internal team, and cross functional partners

What Success Looks Like

  • In your first 90 days: you understand our current pricing and packaging architecture and the reasoning behind it, you've built working relationships across your core partners — Finance, Product, Engineering, GTM, and Marketing, and you've identified where the biggest monetization opportunities and risks sit.
  • In your first 6 months: you're driving a meaningful piece of the monetization roadmap end to end, and you've taken at least one pricing or packaging change from analysis through cross-functional launch.
  • In your first year: executives come to you as the source of truth on how your portfolio generates revenue, and the frameworks you've put in place have made monetization decisions faster and more consistent across the company.

Who You Are:

  • 7+ years in pricing, monetization, packaging, or revenue strategy, with substantial time spent executing in-house at a B2B SaaS company, not only advising on it. A consulting or pricing-firm background is a real asset; we're looking for people who have since taken that thinking into an operating role.
  • Experience in B2B with Enterprise Customers (2000+ employees)
  • Strong analytical and financial modeling ability. You can build the model yourself, and you're comfortable working through product analytics partners to get the data behind it. You don't need to build the dashboard, but you know exactly what to ask for.
  • A proven track record of pricing and packaging changes you took to market, and evidence of what they did. We're more interested in decisions you own than frameworks you're familiar with.
  • Operational rigor. You bring structure to ambiguous, multi-team work and can drive it to completion across organizations.
  • Executive communication. You can distill complex commercial tradeoffs into a clear recommendation with senior stakeholders across Finance, Product, and Go-to-Market.
  • Bonus: hands-on experience monetizing AI products, usage- or consumption-based models, or a track record of standing up pricing and monetization from the ground up across multiple early-stage companies.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. MBA welcome, not required.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

This individual will work under Braze's Expert Services department as someone who can move naturally between delivery and technical ownership cohesively, rather than desire to stay in a single lane.

  • Own the execution of customer implementation engagements end to end, from onboarding through go live, and serve as the deep technical resource designing integrations and solutions, depending on what a given engagement needs.
  • Design and implement technical solutions, including SDK and API integrations, while managing timeline, scope, and stakeholder alignment for a project.
  • Engage with customer stakeholders, from senior staff to Braze end users, to understand business and technical goals and build credible relationships across the account.
  • Monitor progress and proactively resolve roadblocks, whether they are project risks or technical blockers, to keep engagements on time and technically sound.
  • Act as the technical conduit between Braze and the customer's product and engineering teams, translating requirements into actionable technical plans when technical ownership is called for.
  • Document stakeholder roles, technical requirements, and integration details to support a smooth handoff to the Customer Success Manager team after project completion.
  • Coordinate with the customer's agencies and third parties to keep external partners aligned with the project's goals and timeline.
  • Drive early adoption, set KPIs and success metrics, and apply best practices that help customers realize fast time to value.
  • Advocate customer use cases to product development, and stay current on Braze's platform capabilities, including technical enablement such as Decisioning Studio training.
  • Continually improve delivery and technical processes, and deliver enablement training and workshops tailored to each customer.
  • Maintain the organizational and communication discipline expected of a Delivery Manager alongside the technical depth expected of a Technical Architect, since either can be called on depending on the project you're staffed to.

Who You Are

  • You've built your career at the intersection of people and technology, comfortably managing a project timeline one day and getting hands-on with an integration the next.
  • Demonstrated interest or hands on experience with technical concepts such as SaaS, Mobile, APIs, Marketing Automation, Analytics, or programming (HTML, etc.), sufficient to own SDK/API integration workstreams directly rather than only coordinate them.
  • Highly organized and reliable, with a continuous improvement mindset and the discipline to keep project tracking consistently up to date.
  • Strong analytical and creative problem solving skills, comfortable diagnosing both project and technical issues and driving them to resolution.
  • A natural collaborator who can manage conflicting priorities, motivate stakeholders, and thrive in a fast paced, cross functional environment.
  • Strong listening and verbal communication skills, able to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences via video calls, workshops, and written communication.
  • Comfortable building with AI tools to accelerate workstreams and improve efficiency in day to day work.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field.
  • 2 to 5 years in a similar customer facing role, preferably in implementations, technical consulting, or customer success, with a track record spanning both project delivery and hands-on technical work.
  • Strong project management skills paired with genuine technical depth in APIs, SDKs, or related integration work.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Flexible paid time off
  • Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Solutions Operations is the internal capability layer behind Braze's Solutions Consulting organization. We build the tooling, systems, and telemetry that let the field move faster — so that what works in one region reaches the others while the deal is still live, and no Solutions Consultant rebuilds something that already exists.

This role exists because the work has changed. Technical Solutions Engineering was built to produce demo assets on request — custom in-app messages, Liquid, web forms, browser scripts. AI-assisted development has compressed most of that, and the field now builds a good deal of it themselves. The opportunity is no longer producing artifacts on request; it's owning the systems that make the whole organization faster, better informed, and ultimately more effective. This is an operations role with real technical depth: instead of building demo tooling, you'll build business systems, and you'll use data from across the global SolCon org to decide what's worth building at all.

You'll be based in EMEA deliberately. A core part of this role is having a point of view that spans regions — seeing how an AMER enterprise team operates versus an EMEA one, understanding why one pocket of the org wins and another doesn't, and turning that into something reusable rather than leaving it buried in a single deal or function.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Experience in an operations, go-to-market engineering, solutions engineering, or technical program management role in B2B SaaS, you've owned a system or a program, not just a queue of tickets
  • Technical enough to build: comfortable with scripting and light application development (Python, JavaScript/Node, APIs, SDKs), and fluent with AI development tooling (Claude, Cursor, agent frameworks, MCP). A CS degree is not required
  • Data-fluent: comfortable in Salesforce, Looker (or similar BI tooling) and a warehouse (Snowflake or similar), able to build your own dashboards and defend the numbers in them
  • You understand how go-to-market teams actually operate — sales cycles, presales motions, and what makes a technical evaluation succeed or stall
  • Able to build against a set of requirements, and equally able to write the requirements yourself when nobody hands them to you
  • Self-directed. Nobody is going to call you into this work; you'll identify where the leverage is and go there
  • A strong communicator who can hold a room with regional leadership and a working session with engineers
  • Curious about martech, AI tooling, and where technical evaluation is heading as the demo motion gives way to POCs and agent-driven connectivity

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Build and maintain the shared systems the field deploys into: demo automation, agent and MCP skill packages, workflow plugins, and the discoverable asset repository — built once, centrally, and reused
  • Turn field signal into a build backlog: define what we need to know from the SolCon org, instrument how it's collected, and translate it into prioritized work with a named metric attached
  • Produce insight, not reporting,  what happened, why it happened, and what changed as a result. Own a recurring readout to SolCon and sales leadership across regions
  • Reconcile what different regional teams already measure, and surface the patterns they aren't looking at, without dictating their metrics
  • Go find friction qualitatively: talk to SolCons, AEs, and regional leaders about how deals & their own processes actually run, and map how each specialist function supports the deal cycle
  • Take on high-leverage one-off requests where a bespoke build is genuinely the right call — and be the person who can tell the difference
  • Drive adoption of what the team builds: visible project posts, sprint showcases, and making reusable assets hard to ignore at the moment someone needs them
  • Partner with Field Architecture, POC Program Delivery, Security & Privacy, Tech Partnerships, and RFP Management as the connective layer between them

Braze is seeking a Staff Applied Scientist to join our Predictive and Generative AI (PGAI) team. The team's mission is to deliver a truly engaging and personalized customer experience through the creation of ML and AI enhanced marketing solutions. We own those solutions end to end, from the models and the flexible training pipelines that build them for each customer to the high-throughput APIs that serve predictions into our messaging systems. You will help set the scope of what is possible for customer engagement at scale, and from that space of possibilities you will lead solutions from prototype to product and build the ML platform that runs them.

As the Staff Engineer on the team, you will:

  • Identify and drive the transformative initiatives that change what the team can deliver, whether that's replatforming how we train and serve models, redefining how data science ships to production, or retiring a generation of infrastructure
  • Build and ship at high velocity. Staff at Braze is a hands-on delivery role; you carry the most complex initiatives yourself from design through production. Current examples include distributed model training and serving, model lifecycle management, and the pipelines that keep hundreds of customer-specific models healthy across regions
  • Own the team's technical vision and quality bar. Set direction across the product portfolio and the ML platform, define best practices, and anticipate problems before they reach production
  • Drive initiatives that span teams. Our solutions ship into messaging, analytics, and data platform surfaces, and you carry the technical relationships with those teams
  • Raise the team's engineering quality through design review, code review, and production readiness for ML systems, and mentor other senior engineers and data scientists
  • Connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes, and represent the team's technical perspective to product and engineering leadership

WHO YOU ARE

  • Systems at Scale: proven track record of building foundational data-driven systems at scale: whether streaming, real-time pipelines, or large-scale data platforms
  • Technical Leadership: skilled at driving architectural direction, scoping large efforts, and effectively managing technical debt. Known for precise communication of complex technical concepts and a willingness to drive major technical initiatives
  • Strong Fundamentals: deep understanding of software design, data structures, and algorithms
  • Self-Starter: great communication and organizational skills, with a history of thriving in team environments

  • Database Experience: previous experience with MongoDB, ClickHouse, Snowflake, or other data lake solutions
  • Cloud Technologies: experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes), and cloud services (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Architecture: experience with distributed systems, API design, monitoring, and best practices

Our web marketing team runs several parallel workstreams: SEO/AEO, CRO, and quarterly web launches — supported by specialists and cross-functional partners. During a planned leave of absence, execution of each workstream is covered by existing team members. This is a process-and-communication role managing high velocity workstreams across teams and aligning resourcing and helping leadership make decisions to keep the roadmap on schedule and on scope. You'll keep the moving pieces together so the team can stay focused on the work itself.

What You'll Own

Run the operating rhythm. Facilitate the weekly SEO/AEO/CRO meeting and keep web team standup mechanics tight: agendas, notes, and action tracking. Attend internal engineering, AEO/SEO, and web meetings and capture the requests and decisions landing on the web team. Sit on agency calls and assist with roadmap and follow ups and action items. 

Keep the roadmap visible. Assemble the written web updates broadcast to cross-functional stakeholders (reviewed by the web team lead before distribution) and help prioritize incoming work with input from workstream owners. 

Groom the backlogs. Keep the AEO/SEO and CRO backlogs current: mark items done, capture new requests for triage, and flag when runway is getting thin.

Track and chase. Follow up on action items across workstreams so nothing silently stalls.

Escalate with judgment. Spot blockers and route them to the right owner: execution questions to the web team lead, program decisions to the program owner. You'll report day-to-day to the Sr director of digital with the web experience manager and SEO/CRO managers as your first point of contact for execution questions.

About the Role

Our web marketing team runs several parallel workstreams: SEO/AEO, CRO, and quarterly web launches — supported by specialists and cross-functional partners. During a planned leave of absence, execution of each workstream is covered by existing team members. What this role owns is the connective tissue: the meeting rhythm, the follow-ups, and the cross-team communication that keep web marketing coordinated and moving.

This is a process-and-communication role managing high velocity workstreams across teams and aligning resourcing and helping leadership make decisions to keep the roadmap on schedule and on scope. You'll keep the moving pieces together so the team can stay focused on the work itself.

What You'll Own

Run the operating rhythm. Facilitate the weekly SEO/AEO/CRO meeting and keep web team standup mechanics tight: agendas, notes, and action tracking. Attend internal engineering, AEO/SEO, and web meetings and capture the requests and decisions landing on the web team. Sit on agency calls and assist with roadmap and follow ups and action items. 

Keep the roadmap visible. Assemble the written web updates broadcast to cross-functional stakeholders (reviewed by the web team lead before distribution) and help prioritize incoming work with input from workstream owners. 

Groom the backlogs. Keep the AEO/SEO and CRO backlogs current: mark items done, capture new requests for triage, and flag when runway is getting thin.

Track and chase. Follow up on action items across workstreams so nothing silently stalls.

Escalate with judgment. Spot blockers and route them to the right owner: execution questions to the web team lead, program decisions to the program owner. Deliver a weekly one-page status report to leadership so they have visibility without extra meetings. Act as the connective issue across a variety of marketing calls actively identifying which items are related for the web team and will need resourcing or prioritization. 

Support launch coordination. Keep the quarterly web launch checklist moving (owners, dates, dependencies) and partner with BizOps on timeline and strategy alignment, including occasional support materials such as slides.

Who You Are

  • 4+ years of experience as a marketing program manager or similar, with exposure to web or digital marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS. 
    • Web and demand generation experience a plus. 
  • Strong meeting facilitator who runs tight, productive sessions and leaves a clear paper trail
  • Excellent written communicator, especially in status updates and stakeholder summaries
  • Fluent with backlog and project tracking tools (Asana, Jira, or similar)
  • Comfortable working across functions and driving follow-through without formal authority
  • Organized, proactive, and reliable, you notice when something is about to stall and act before it does

Reporting Structure

You'll report day-to-day to the Sr director of digital with the web experience manager and SEO/CRO managers as your first point of contact for execution questions.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive, Healthcare
jobs.description:
Our sales team is committed to customer centricity by deeply understanding and addressing the unique needs and aspirations of every customer. We deliver exceptional value through tailored solutions, strategic partnerships, and a highly collaborative go-to-market approach. By fostering alignment across marketing, product, and customer success, we engage in value-based selling that enhances every stage of the customer journey. Together, we proactively identify and overcome technical, educational, and competitive challenges—driving long-term growth, retention, and customer satisfaction.

We’re seeking a strategic, high-impact Enterprise Account Executive to drive growth within a portfolio of large, complex organizations, with a particular focus on highly regulated sectors such as Financial Services and Healthcare. Your primary mission will be to land, expand, and deepen relationships with enterprise customers by aligning our solutions to their most critical business, compliance, and operational priorities. This role offers the opportunity to lead sophisticated sales cycles, influence executive stakeholders, and deliver meaningful business outcomes. If you're passionate about building long-term partnerships and navigating complex, regulated enterprise environments, we’d love to connect.

This role can either be fully remote depending on which US state you live in, or based in our New York, San Francisco, or Chicago office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. If based in-office: The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you’ll achieve

  • Own and grow a portfolio of Enterprise accounts through strategic account planning, expansion, and renewals.

  • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles with longer deal timelines and larger deal sizes, navigating the intricate security, legal, and compliance review processes typical of regulated industries.

  • Build and maintain trusted advisor relationships with C-level executives, IT, risk/compliance officers, and business leaders.

  • Drive revenue by aligning our solutions to customer strategic initiatives and demonstrating measurable business value.

  • Partner cross-functional with Solutions Engineering, Sales Development, Customer Success, Professional Services, and executive sponsors to execute coordinated account strategies.

  • Identify new use cases and expansion opportunities throughout the customer lifecycle, including during active terms and at renewal.

  • Collaborate closely with marketing, product, and customer success to ensure seamless onboarding, adoption, and long-term success.

About you

  • Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.

  • 4+ years of experience in a B2B closing sales role, with significant experience in Enterprise SaaS sales.

  • Proven track record of success selling into Financial Services (FinServ/FinTech) and/or Healthcare (Payer/Provider/Life Sciences) verticals.

  • Deep understanding of the unique challenges, compliance standards, and regulatory environments (e.g., HIPAA, FINRA, SEC, SOC 2) governing these industries.

  • Proven track record of consistently exceeding quota in complex, high-value deal environments.

  • Demonstrated success managing large accounts and navigating multi-threaded sales motions.

  • Strong executive presence with the ability to influence and build trust with senior stakeholders, including C-suite leaders.

  • Experience with strategic account planning, forecasting, and territory management.

  • A self-starter who thrives in ambiguity and is committed to continuous improvement.

  • Ability to quickly learn, synthesize, and consult on new products, industries, and market trends.

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

What we’ll offer

Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.

The total OTE includes a base salary range of $145,500 - $165,000 and performance-based sales incentive pay (based on the terms of the Sales Incentive Plan). jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Spend
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Why join us

Brex is the AI-powered spend platform. We help companies spend with confidence with integrated corporate cards, banking, and global payments, plus intuitive software for travel and expenses. Tens of thousands of companies from startups to enterprises — including DoorDash, Flexport, and Compass — use Brex to proactively control spend, reduce costs, and increase efficiency on a global scale.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We're committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Engineering at Brex

Engineering at Brex is about building systems that scale with speed and intention. Our teams span Software, Data, Security, and IT, and operate with high autonomy and deep collaboration. We tackle hard technical problems, own our outcomes, and push for excellence at every level — from architecture to deployment. It's an environment where engineering is a craft, and builders become leaders.

What you’ll do

Travel & Expense is one of the highest-leverage domains at Brex, and it spans several engineering teams — expenses, travel, policy, and spend controls — that have to work as one system for customers. We're looking for a Staff Engineer who operates across all of them. You won't own a single team or service. Your mandate is to find the most important problems across T&E — the ones that fall between teams, the ones nobody is holding — and drive them to a solution.

This is a leadership role without direct reports. You'll set technical direction across the group, raise the bar in design and review, and be a force multiplier for the engineers and EMs you work alongside. You'll partner closely with our existing Staff Engineers as peers, and you'll have a seat at the T&E leadership table to help shape where the org invests. If you want the influence of a senior technical leader without moving into management, this is that role.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We will require 3 days per week in the office - Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities:

  • Identify the highest-impact technical problems across Travel & Expense — including the cross-team gaps that individual teams can't see or own — and drive them to resolution.
  • Set and raise the technical bar across the group through design reviews, architecture decisions, and hands-on work where it matters most.
  • Partner as a peer with existing Staff Engineers and with EMs across expenses, travel, policy, and spend controls to align on direction and unblock execution.
  • Act as a force multiplier: mentor senior engineers, improve how teams design and ship, and grow the next generation of technical leaders.
  • Bring an AI-forward mindset to how the org builds, reviews, and operates.
  • Contribute directly to the group's technical strategy and inform where leadership invests.

Requirements:

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of technical leadership across multiple teams or a group.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify and drive ambiguous, cross-cutting problems to resolution without a defined charter.
  • Deep experience designing and operating large-scale backend systems in production.
  • Strong collaboration skills; a track record of raising the bar for engineers around you and working effectively with both ICs and managers.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.

Compensation:

The expected salary range for this role is $240,000 to $285,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.location: New York, NY / Philadelphia, PA / SF Bay Area / Seattle, WA
jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

What You’ll Do:

As Director of Field Enablement, you will define and operate a scalable enablement charter that equips Sales, Customer Experience, and GTM teams to consistently deliver for customers. This is a highly visible leadership role responsible for mechanisms, programs, and tooling that improve seller productivity, shorten ramp time, and drive predictable revenue outcomes. You will work backwards from customer and business needs, partnering closely with executive leadership to raise the bar across the revenue organization.

About the role:

  • Own the end-to-end field enablement strategy aligned to GTM priorities and long-term business growth
  • Establish durable mechanisms for onboarding, certification, and continuous learning
  • Partner with CRO, Sales, CX, Marketing, Product, and RevOps leaders to identify capability gaps and close them
  • Build scalable playbooks, sales motions, and field-ready content that improves execution in-market
  • Define, track, and inspect enablement metrics tied to revenue performance (ramp time, attainment, win rates)
  • Operate with a high bar for operational excellence, documentation, and accountability
  • Hire, develop, and lead a high-performing enablement team

Who You Are: 

  • 10+ years of experience in Field Enablement, Sales Enablement, or GTM leadership roles
  • Proven experience operating in fast-growing, ambiguous environments and scaling enablement programs
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to influence without authority
  • Data-driven operator who uses metrics to inspect performance and drive continuous improvement 
  • Deep familiarity with modern revenue tech stacks (CRM, enablement, LMS, analytics)
  • Ability to think strategically while executing with speed and discipline

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting enterprise or platform-based sales motions
  • Familiarity with consumption-based or infrastructure-oriented business models
  • Background working in highly technical or developer-adjacent GTM environments

Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk. 

  • You love to enable sales teams and build the strategic engine that powers how sales teams learn, execute, and scale.
  • You are curious about building diverse and inclusive teams that drive innovation and success
  • You are an expert in go-to-market strategies for AI, cloud, or enterprise infrastructure solutions

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast!  We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values: 

  • Be Curious at Your Core
  • Act Like an Owner
  • Empower Employees
  • Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
  • Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and provides the opportunity to develop innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for take off, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us! 

The base salary range for this role is $165,000 - $242,000. The starting salary will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

 

What We Offer

The range we’ve posted represents the typical compensation range for this role. To determine actual compensation, we review the market rate for each candidate which can include a variety of factors. These include qualifications, experience, interview performance, and location.

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our US-based offerings for full-time employees; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. These include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance - 100% paid for by CoreWeave
  • Company-paid Life Insurance 
  • Voluntary supplemental life insurance 
  • Short and long-term disability insurance 
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • Health Savings Account
  • Tuition Reimbursement 
  • Ability to Participate in Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)
  • Mental Wellness Benefits through Spring Health 
  • Family-Forming support provided by Carrot
  • Paid Parental Leave 
  • Flexible, full-service childcare support with Kinside
  • 401(k) with a generous employer match
  • Flexible PTO
  • Catered lunch each day in our office and data center locations
  • A casual work environment
  • A work culture focused on innovative disruption

California Applicants

California Consumer Privacy Act
