CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

As part of this commitment and consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), CoreWeave will ensure that qualified applicants and candidates with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations for the hiring process, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact: careers@coreweave.com.

Export Control Compliance

This position requires access to export controlled information. To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency.  CoreWeave may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.

jobs.title: People Business Partner
jobs.description:
Datadog is seeking a People Business Partner (PBP) to work closely with leadership and our People team to help support our growing global organization. This position will work closely to support the specific needs of the group’s employees while working strategically on all People programs and initiatives. Datadog has had exponential growth year-over-year and has no plans to stop - so there is a lot to learn from and contribute to our rapidly scaling team.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

 

What You’ll Do: 

 

  • Represent our global PBP team to partner on the front line with all employees and leadership
  • Advise, coach, and influence management on all things people-related, including: performance management, coaching, career pathing, employee relations, compensation, organizational development and scaling, training, culture, diversity & inclusion, and employee engagement
  • Consult with the appropriate Center of Excellence (COE) team to gather their expertise to design programs to enhance the employee experience.
  • Build, advise and consult on People policies, guidelines, and programs, in collaboration with COE colleagues
  • Provide analysis and consulting to leadership to drive data-driven people decisions and implementation of best practices
  • Assess employee development needs, make recommendations, and implement appropriate solutions aligned with the organization’s broader strategy
  • Handle complex global employee relations issues, working with leadership to implement best practices and approach

 

Who You Are:

  • Experienced in 5+ years as an HRBP or in a related HR role, preferably with experience in fast-growing technology companies
  • Able to adapt your approach and pivot your skillset from strategic, high level program implementation to granular day-to-day needs of a fast paced business
  • Strong in your analytical & reporting skills; solid experience with HRIS (Workday is a bonus!)
  • Experienced in working across business functions with first line and senior leadership
  • A master in your project management and organizational skills, with a proven ability to design clear processes, and a very detail-oriented yet flexible approach to problem solving
  • Experienced in employee relations and knowledge of global employment practices
  • Someone with a clear, direct, approachable, and friendly communication style and strong customer service orientation
  • Strong in your interpersonal and communication skills and able to build relationships and trust at all levels of the organization

 

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

 

Benefits and Growth:

  • Generous and competitive benefits package
  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
  • Continuous career development opportunities 
  • Product training to develop understanding of our product and space
  • Best in breed onboarding
  • Internal mentor and buddy program cross-departmentally
  • Friendly and inclusive workplace culture

 

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

In addition, Datadog offers a wide range of best in class, comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, dental, parental planning, and mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, paid time off, fitness reimbursements, and a discounted employee stock purchase plan.

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. jobs.title: Operations Enablement Lead
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About Ops Enablement

The Operations Enablement team builds the capabilities required to deliver fast, accurate, and high-quality servicing experiences for Affirm’s customers and merchants—while identifying opportunities to eliminate the need for them to contact us in the first place. We partner across Operations, Product, Engineering, Vendor Management, Legal, and Compliance to ensure every agent is trained, equipped, and able to deliver measurable results from day one.

Operating across the full servicing lifecycle, we translate new products, policies, and business requirements into scalable operational capabilities. Our work includes designing training and operational readiness strategies, standing up new servicing experiences, defining and measuring interaction quality, and ensuring agents can quickly access the information they need to resolve issues correctly.

We use performance insights, customer contact drivers, quality trends, and agent feedback to identify capability gaps and their root causes. We then build the learning programs, quality frameworks, knowledge systems, processes, and tools needed to close those gaps—while helping our Product and Engineering partners address friction upstream rather than requiring agents to absorb it downstream. By owning the full journey—from operationalizing new products and policies to improving existing workflows—Operations Enablement turns complex change into consistent, compliant, and high-quality servicing at scale.

One Role, Multiple Teams

We are hiring multiple Manager roles across Affirm's Ops Enablement organization through this single job posting. Rather than interviewing for one specific team, candidates will go through a shared interview process designed to assess the core skills we look for across Ops Enablement.

If selected, we will work with you to determine the best team match based on your interests, experience, strengths, and current business needs. You will have the opportunity to learn more about our teams and share your preferences as you move through the process.

Potential team placements include:

  • Fraud Enablement: Owning and improving specific fraud servicing experiences across multiple product offerings
  • Dispute Enablement: Owning and improving specific dispute servicing experiences across multiple product offerings

About the Role

As an Operations Enablement leader you will help deliver scalable, compliant, and high-quality servicing experiences across our Operations organization. In this role, you will define and execute strategies that enable our servicing operations to grow efficiently while maintaining exceptional customer and merchant outcomes.

You will set the vision for operational readiness, ensuring that people, processes, and enablement systems evolve in lockstep with Affirm’s servicing strategy. As a member of the Operations Enablement team, you will own a portfolio of cross-functional initiatives aligned to strategic priorities - driving delivery across timelines, dependencies, and measurable business outcomes. You will define and execute servicing strategies by developing clear program roadmaps and execution plans and be responsible for planning, coordination, documentation, change management and measurement across assigned initiatives to ensure operational readiness and measurable outcomes. 

This role works closely with partners across Product, Engineering, Operations, Compliance, and external vendors to align priorities and ensure readiness for key business and regulatory changes. Serving as a connector between servicing strategy and day-to-day execution, you will translate strategy into scalable operational capabilities. We are looking for a hands-on, data-driven leader who thrives in complex, regulated environments and is passionate about building durable, high-quality servicing experiences at scale.

What You'll Do

  • Own Program Performance: Lead complex cross-functional programs and initiatives, ensuring alignment with servicing strategy, OKRs, and long-term business priorities. 
  • Set Strategic Direction: Define and execute the servicing strategy developing clear program roadmaps and execution plans, tracking progress against KPIs, timelines, and budgets.
  • Lead Transformation Initiatives: Drive enterprise-wide improvements leveraging Lean Six Sigma, change management, and data-driven methodologies to unlock efficiency, compliance, and customer satisfaction.

  • Own Learning & Training Strategy: Oversee end-to-end design and delivery of training programs (onboarding, continuous learning, new product rollouts), ensuring effectiveness through measurement and feedback loops.

  • Drive Insights: Use metrics, dashboards, and qualitative feedback to continuously assess workflows, knowledge adoption, training impact, and localization quality, while influencing senior leadership decisions.

  • Expand Program Scope: Take on additional program and project management responsibilities as needed, developing working knowledge across adjacent domains to support evolving business needs.

What We Look For

  • 5+ years of experience in program management or product operations, preferably within large-scale or global operations.
  • Proven track record of setting strategy and delivering measurable impact across efficiency, compliance, and customer experience.
  • Expertise in Lean Six Sigma, project/program management, and change management (Black Belt, PMP, or Prosci certification preferred).
  • Experience implementing and scaling knowledge management and training (Salesforce, Confluence, LMS platforms, or AI-driven knowledge tools).
  • Strong background in regulated industries (financial services, fintech, or consumer lending highly preferred).
  • Exceptional influence and communication skills, with the ability to engage executives, coach teams, and align diverse stakeholders.
  • Analytical and data-driven mindset, with a focus on measurable outcomes and continuous improvement.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguous, high-growth environments with a builder’s mindset.
  • Global perspective with experience supporting vendor/partner operations and distributed teams.
  • Willingness to provide occasional support outside regular working hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, to address time-sensitive operational needs.
  • Willingness to travel as needed to support team collaboration, operational priorities, and vendor or partner engagements.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, dbt Engine
jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About the Role

We’re looking for a hands-on Senior Engineering Manager to lead the Core team behind dbt V2, dbt’s next-generation engine. This is a backfill role for an engineering leader who can combine strong software-engineering judgment with people leadership, product partnership, and the ability to navigate a highly cross-functional technical area.

The Core team is responsible for building, maintaining, and evolving the Rust-based engine that powers dbt Fusion. The team primarily works on the dbt V2 runtime itself, SQL language features powered by Static Analysis, and new ELT primitives.

The role sits at the center of several parts of the dbt product: the engine and orchestration, the IDE and developer experience, adapters and data warehouses, and our new compute offering, LakeCompute. You’ll help the team make sound technical and product decisions while keeping a stable GA product moving forward.

About the Team

The Core team is part of a broader organization that includes adapters, growth, the VS Code extension, compute, and other closely connected teams. It partners frequently with Product and with the teams responsible for orchestration, IDE experiences, adapters, and LakeCompute.

In this role, you can expect to:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a fluid team of approximately 8 engineers working on a critical part of the dbt product.
  • Establish clarity across a technically demanding roadmap with multiple product and engineering stakeholders.
  • Partner closely with Product to translate ambiguous requirements into realistic engineering scope, sequencing, and estimates.
  • Help the team balance new feature development, engine maintenance, framework modernization, documentation, and the stability of a GA product.
  • Guide end-to-end technical design across the engine and its integration points with orchestration, the IDE, adapters, warehouses, and late compute.
  • Support engineers in making sound tradeoffs across product value, technical quality, performance, compatibility, and delivery risk.
  • Actively contribute to technical design and implementation alongside the team.
  • Work with peer engineering leaders to coordinate initiatives that span multiple teams and systems.
  • Build an environment where engineers can do high-quality work, grow their scope, and take ownership of meaningful technical problems.
  • Help shape the next phase of dbt Fusion as a language-aware transformation engine used by the broader data community.

Mandatory skills

  • Experience leading teams through multiple concurrent priorities and diverse integration points.
  • Strong software-engineering fundamentals and prior experience as a senior/staff engineer, technical lead, or equivalent hands-on technical leader.
  • Ability to lead or facilitate system design from problem definition through implementation and delivery.
  • Ability to translate complex or ambiguous product requirements into credible engineering estimates, milestones, and tradeoffs.
  • Demonstrated judgment in balancing roadmap delivery with reliability, maintainability, technical debt, and product quality.
  • A hands-on technical orientation, including a willingness and ability to stay close to code and engineering details.

You are a good fit if you have:

  • Led a software team through the full development lifecycle: discovery, design, implementation, testing, release, operation, and iteration.
  • Worked on products with substantial technical complexity, integration surfaces, or platform dependencies.
  • Successfully partnered with Product and other engineering teams to create a stable roadmap and make difficult prioritization decisions.
  • Experience in data transformation, orchestration, query engines, databases, developer tools, compilers, language tooling, or a closely related area. Direct dbt experience is helpful but not required.
  • The ability to explain complex technical systems clearly to engineers, product partners, and candidates with different levels of technical depth.
  • A track record of developing strong engineers while maintaining a high technical bar.
  • Comfort operating in a fluid environment where team boundaries, priorities, and scope may evolve.

You’ll have an edge if you have:

  • Experience with Rust or another systems programming language, compilers, query planning, language servers, IDE tooling, or developer platforms.
  • Experience building or operating data transformation, orchestration, warehouse, or execution systems.
  • Contributions to open-source projects or experience working with open standards and open technical communities.
  • Familiarity with ecosystems such as Apache Arrow, Apache Iceberg, DuckDB, ADBC, or related data and execution technologies.
  • Experience with SQL semantics, query optimization, transpilation across dialects, data lineage, governance, or developer-facing language features.
  • Experience working in a remote-first or distributed organization with strong written communication practices.
  • Startup or scale-up experience and comfort wearing multiple hats while the organization evolves.

The compensation range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your location during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Field Enablement Specialist
jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

What You'll Do

CoreWeave is seeking a creative, high-energy Field Enablement Specialist to produce the internal stories, videos, and communications that connect and educate our Global Field Organization (GFO). The GFO brings together Sales, Solutions Engineering, Field Engineering, Technical Account Management, and Sales Development teams across every region, and it is on track to grow significantly in 2027. Reporting to the Field Readiness leader within Revenue Operations, you will create internal, team-facing content that does two jobs at once.

  • Field connection and community. In partnership with HR and the People team, help create positive energy, a sense of belonging, and real connection across teams, roles, and time zones by celebrating people, milestones, and the moments that make the GFO one team.
  • Educate the field. Turn our wins, customers, and use cases into engaging learning content, so team members understand why customers choose CoreWeave, how deals were won, and how to repeat that success. This content becomes part of the broader field readiness and training curriculum.

This is a hands-on creative role at a pivotal moment for CoreWeave. You will take a story from first idea to finished piece: writing the script, directing and shooting the video, editing the final cut, and publishing it where the field actually lives, across Slack, video, live and virtual events, and our learning programs. You'll bring a producer's craft, a teacher's instinct for making complex topics stick, and a community builder's warmth, with the startup mindset, agility, and bias for action that define CoreWeave. You will partner closely with HR and the People team, field leaders, Field Readiness and enablement teams, and Marketing, aligning field content with company-wide engagement programs so that every team member feels part of one GFO and knows the stories behind our success.

Key Responsibilities

Field Connection & Community

  • Field Community Programs: Plan and run GFO-specific engagement initiatives in partnership with HR, complementing company-wide programs and helping put field-focused actions into practice.
  • Slack & Internal Communications: Influence the GFO's community channels and editorial calendar. Write timely, engaging posts that celebrate wins, introduce new team members, and keep a fast-growing, globally distributed org connected and informed.
  • Recognition & Spotlights: Build repeatable formats that put field team members at the center of the story, such as wins of the week, OneTeam moments, milestone celebrations, and new-hire introductions, complementing company-wide recognition programs led by HR, so recognition is visible, frequent, and fair across regions and roles.
  • Events & Moments That Matter: Help plan and produce community moments across the field calendar, in coordination with HR and the People team, including all-hands segments, quarterly kickoffs, recognition and awards programs, regional meetups, and virtual community events. Contribute content and creative to Sales Kickoff and other flagship gatherings.

Education & Field Learning (Internal)

  • Win Stories & Customer Spotlights: Interview account teams and capture deal and customer win stories, then turn them into short, engaging videos and posts that explain the customer's problem, why they chose CoreWeave, how the team won, and what others can reuse.
  • Educational & Training Content: Script and produce learning videos and micro-content on customers, use cases, products, and field best practices, designed for the way busy sellers and engineers actually learn: short, visual, and memorable.
  • Curriculum Integration: Partner with Field Readiness and enablement teams to fit content into the broader field curriculum, including onboarding, ongoing learning paths, and launch readiness, so each piece has a clear learning objective and a home where people can find it later.
  • Subject Matter Expert Collaboration: Work with sellers, solutions and field engineers, product leaders, and executives to turn technical and commercial expertise into clear, accurate, and engaging content, coaching on-camera talent so they come across as natural and confident.

Production & Operations

  • End-to-End Video Production: Lead every stage of production, including concept, script writing, storyboarding, directing, filming, editing, motion graphics, and final delivery, across both community and learning content.
  • Content Operations & Brand Consistency: Maintain a library of reusable templates, footage, and assets that reflect the CoreWeave brand, and build lightweight processes so content ships quickly and consistently without sacrificing quality. Follow confidentiality guidelines for customer and deal information in all internal content.
  • Measurement & Iteration: Track reach, engagement, completion, and feedback across channels and learning programs, and use what you learn to improve formats over time.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor's degree (completed or expected by your start date) in Communications, Marketing, Psychology or another social science, Film/Video Production, Journalism, or a related field. This is an entry-level role for new college graduates.
  • Leadership or creative experience through extracurricular activities, such as student organizations, student media, philanthropy, or campus events, where you created content, managed social media, built community, or ran events.
  • Experience creating videos, photos, or social media content that informs and engages an audience, using tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, or Canva. Please share a portfolio or examples of your work, including social media channels you have managed.
  • Strong, energetic writer who can explain ideas simply and adapt tone for different audiences.
  • Self-starter and people person who takes initiative, builds trust quickly, and learns fast in a fast-moving environment.
  • Event planning experience and an interest in cloud infrastructure, AI/ML, or technology are a plus.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We're in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We're not afraid of a little chaos, and we're constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

  • Be Curious at Your Core
  • Act Like an Owner
  • Empower Employees
  • Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
  • Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and provides the opportunity to develop innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

The base salary range for this role is $72,000 to $95,000. The starting salary will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

 

What We Offer

The range we’ve posted represents the typical compensation range for this role. To determine actual compensation, we review the market rate for each candidate which can include a variety of factors. These include qualifications, experience, interview performance, and location.

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our US-based offerings for full-time employees; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. These include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance - 100% paid for by CoreWeave
  • Company-paid Life Insurance 
  • Voluntary supplemental life insurance 
  • Short and long-term disability insurance 
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • Health Savings Account
  • Tuition Reimbursement 
  • Ability to Participate in Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)
  • Mental Wellness Benefits through Spring Health 
  • Family-Forming support provided by Carrot
  • Paid Parental Leave 
  • Flexible, full-service childcare support with Kinside
  • 401(k) with a generous employer match
  • Flexible PTO
  • Catered lunch each day in our office and data center locations
  • A casual work environment
  • A work culture focused on innovative disruption

California Applicants

California Consumer Privacy Act 

Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

jobs.title: Manager, Account Executive (Enterprise, Grower)
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Enterprise East Sales team engages with some of the largest and fastest-growing businesses in the world to take advantage of Stripe’s solutions. You'll lead and coach high-performing sales executives dispersed along the East Coast, helping them deliver on ambitious targets, as well as roll up your sleeves to work directly with prospective Stripe customers. 

What you’ll do

Responsibilities

  • Recruit, mentor, develop, and lead a team of sales professionals while scaling our New York GTM presence.
  • Train the team in up-leveling professional skills such as collaborative pipeline generation, consultative and solution-based selling, closing tactics, adoption of MEDDIIC, and serving as a Trust Advisor to Stripe Users.
  • Develop both the long-term vision and strategy for the team and manage day-to-day operations.
  • Be accountable for operating net revenue and activation targets to grow Stripe’s revenue profitably.
  • Effectively work cross-functionally across the organization to shape Stripe’s solutions to meet client needs.
  • Inspire, motivate and enable individual development to promote career growth of direct reports.

Who you are

We are looking for a self-starting leader who is a builder and has demonstrated a track record of target attainment and success dealing with ambiguity, operating in a high-growth environment, and solving complicated problems with limited oversight. Ideal candidates will have management and leadership experience scaling a technology sales team, superior communication skills, and a knack for understanding unique customer needs. 

Minimum requirements

    • 10+ years of experience as a proven account executive and/or 5+ years of front line sales management experience within technology, SaaS, banking or payments spaces. Second line management experience is preferred 
    • Experience training, coaching, and scaling a high-performance sales team.
    • Ability to build relationships with strategic clients, industry thought leaders and alliances & channel partners.
    • Experience operating in an early stage, high-growth technology environment.
    • Demonstrated passion for Stripe’s mission.
    • Ability to clearly communicate technical concepts and build great relationships with highly technical customers.

jobs.title: Buyer, Procurement
jobs.description:
About Carvana

If you like disrupting the norm and are looking to join a company revolutionizing an industry then you will LOVE what Carvana has done for the car buying experience. Buying a car the old fashioned way sucks and we are working hard to make it NOT suck. I mean, have you seen our vending machine?!

We are looking for people who are excited to thrive in an environment of impactful change. Team spirit is evident at Carvana and every day we let our passions and creativity foster innovation. We take big swings, set ambitious goals, and challenge each other to make data- and process-driven decisions in everything we do. Here are a few of our stories! We’ve been changing the game since 2013, and we’re not taking our foot off the gas now. Want more of the story? Check out our background here.

About the team and position

The Buyer, Procurement will support procurement activity across the business. This individual  will identify and source business needs, perform data collection and analysis, assemble and publish reports, execute on purchasing activities and vendor engagements, and provide support to Category Managers and management.

This role is full onsite at our Headquarters in Tempe, AZ. You must be located in the Phoenix Area and able to commute to the office daily. 

What you’ll be doing

  • Owning the entire purchase order (PO) procurement process to ensure efficient fulfillment
  • Maintaining the status of open requests and orders and providing regular updates to stakeholders
  • Helping establish, maintain, and adhere to procurement budgets
  • Reviewing vendor performance data and contributing to vendor engagement strategy

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer, Energy Storage
jobs.description:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

Position Summary: 

You will be an early member of a new engineering team, taking a hands-on role in the design, development, and integration of a new product at Redwood. This position will lead our system engineering effort, helping our mechanical, electrical, and software engineers come together and deliver a cohesive system. You will define clear requirements, evaluate and down-select system architectures, and drive the decision throughout the engineering organization. You are a believer and practitioner of model-driven design and have right-sized system engineering frameworks for a scrappy, fast-moving engineering team. 

The ideal candidate is highly self-driven, adaptable to a startup environment, and eager to take on novel technical challenges. If you’re excited about working in a dynamic, fast-paced setting within a new department at Redwood, we want to hear from you! 

Responsibilities: 

  • Driving system architecture optimization to top-level product metrics such as cost, efficiency, energy/power density and availability. 
  • Ownership of system-level performance and functional requirements as well as development of subsystem and component requirements in partnership with design engineers 
  • Performing or defining system modeling, simulation, and testing to validate system performance against requirements. 
  • Establishing interface definitions across components and between mechanical, electrical, and software teams. 
  • Reinforce system safety and reliability through participation in DFMEAs, risk assessments, and hazard analyses to identify and mitigate potential failure modes 
  • Ensuring compliance with industry (UL) standards 

Desired Qualifications: 

  • BS or MS in Mechanical Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field and 5+ years of design engineering or system engineering experience. 
  • Excellent first-principles physics understanding of electrical and mechanical systems, power delivery, energy storage and transformation, and basic thermal mechanics. 
  • Experience with hybrid or electric powertrain development, PV system development, or energy storage systems 
  • Proficiency in system modeling tools (Python or Matlab) 
  • Experience with requitement management tools (Doors, Jama, etc) 
  • Demonstrated ability to write clear and testable engineering requirements. 
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills. 

In accordance with California pay transparency laws, the salary range for this position is listed below. Actual compensation may vary based on a variety of factors, including experience, education, and skills. 

California Pay Range:
$165,000—$210,000 USD

The position is full-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

We collect your PI for our purposes, including performing services and operations related to your potential employment. NiCE is redefining the future of customer experience through AI-powered, end-to-end service automation, and our brand plays a critical role in how enterprise and C-level audiences see us. In this high-visibility role, you will plan, build, and launch integrated brand campaigns that elevate awareness, strengthen preference, and reinforce our position as the AI leader in CX. You will turn our brand platform and messaging into compelling, multi-channel campaigns across paid, owned, and earned media, partnering closely with Creative and Design, Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Social, PR, and external agencies. The ideal candidate blends big-picture brand thinking with strong program management, is comfortable working across global teams, and uses data to measure and continuously improve brand impact.

How will you make an impact

Brand Campaign Strategy & Planning
Develop and own integrated brand campaign plans that translate the NiCE brand platform, positioning, and messaging into clear campaign objectives, audiences, and channel strategies.
Partner with brand, marketing, and business leaders to align campaign priorities with company goals, product launches, and key moments such as major industry events and NiCE flagship events.

Campaign Execution & Creative Development
Lead end-to-end campaign execution from briefing through launch and optimization, across channels including digital and social, paid media, out-of-home, video, web, events, and thought leadership.
Write clear creative briefs and work closely with Creative and Design teams and external agencies to develop on-brand concepts, assets, and messaging that resonate with enterprise and C-level audiences.
Ensure every campaign touchpoint reflects NiCE brand standards, visual identity, and tone of voice.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Activation
Collaborate with Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Field Marketing, Social, PR, and Analyst Relations to ensure consistent messaging and coordinated campaign activation across regions.
Equip regional and field teams with campaign toolkits and guidance so brand campaigns can be localized and amplified in market.
Support internal brand activation and employee advocacy programs that engage NiCErs as brand ambassadors.

Measurement, Budget & Operational Excellence
Define campaign KPIs and track performance, including reach, impressions, engagement, share of voice, brand awareness, and contribution to pipeline, sharing insights and recommendations with marketing leadership.
Manage campaign budgets, timelines, and resources to deliver strong return on investment.
Manage agency and vendor relationships, including scopes of work, deliverables, quality, and budget tracking.
Use AI tools and data insights to speed up campaign development, test new ideas, and continuously improve campaign effectiveness.

Have you got what it takes?

  • 2-5 years of experience in brand marketing, integrated campaign management, or marketing communications, ideally in B2B technology, SaaS, or AI.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Proven track record of planning and launching integrated, multi-channel brand campaigns that delivered measurable awareness and engagement results.
  • Strong creative judgment and experience writing creative briefs and partnering with creative teams and agencies.
  • Excellent program and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines, and stakeholders at the same time.
  • Analytical mindset with experience defining KPIs, measuring campaign performance, and turning data into actionable insights.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across global, cross-functional teams.
  • Resiliency and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, complex, and ever-changing environment.

Experience managing campaign budgets and agency or vendor relationships.

You will have an advantage if you also have:

Experience marketing AI, customer experience (CX), contact center, or enterprise cloud technologies.

Experience supporting a rebrand, brand launch, or large-scale global campaign in a matrixed organization.

Hands-on experience using generative AI tools in campaign development, plus familiarity with paid media, out-of-home, social, and brand measurement or brand lift studies.

 

 

Enjoy NICE-FLEX!

At NICE, we work according to the NICE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

jobs.title: Regional Vice President,  Central - Education
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Role

We are seeking an Enterprise Regional Vice President, Education with superb energy, passion and experience with a “Hands On Approach” driving new business acquisition within the Education (10k students +)  business. The role focuses on the strategic and tactical planning for the region to ensure objectives are met and aligned with the overall organization goals.  The Regional Vice President, Education will cover the East and will play an integral role in helping Verkada surpass our growth goals.

This position reports to the Vice President of Enterprise Sales, Public Sector.

You Will: 

  • Drive, Manage and assume full ownership of all bookings growth of the Central
  • Be a Public Sector Expert with a deep understanding of effectively navigating the intricacies involved in managing multiple buying stakeholders, along with a strong awareness of the specific nuances associated with government and education buying
  •  Dedicate at least 50% of your time to field-based sales activities away from the workplace, including customer meetings, site visits, and relationship-building. You will partner closely with your Regional Sales Directors and Enterprise Account Executives to  develop a robust field sales strategy. 
  • Lead a team of Regional Sales Directors and Enterprise Account Executives in the pursuit of uncovering and developing new opportunities, managing pipeline, executing on account strategies, and managing customer growth
  • Develops and execute a Focus plan to maximize revenue and growth across the region
  • Manage all aspects of the sales process to ensure delivery against key performance metrics and quota, with a strong emphasis on net new business sales. This includes prospecting and outreach to new Muni and Education business opportunities providing product demos, product trials, and strategic negotiations with customers and channel partners
  • Establish a partner ecosystem and work closely with partners to foster collaboration and create opportunities
  • Collaborate and work in unison with Enterprise Development, Sales Engineering, Channel Development and Verkada’s partners to exceed revenue goals
  • Provide a “Hands On Approach” into account strategy and execution 
  • Drives accurate team forecasting that is aligned with Executive Leadership expectations
  • Participate in strategic and tactical planning for the region and act as a Key Member of Verkada’s Enterprise Leadership team
  • Organize weekly forecast meetings with direct reports and foster the growth of Regional Sales Directors through regular one-on-one sessions each week. These individual meetings will encompass discussions on delegation, pipeline assessment, regional strategy and performance management
  • Act as an integral part of  the recruitment, onboarding and mentorship of Regional Sales Directors and Enterprise Account Executives with the support of our in-house recruiting and enablement teams

You Have: 

  • 3+ years as a 2nd line sales leader in a sales-driven technology organization and a Public Sector Expert; 3+ years of managing a high performing enterprise sales team selling a highly complex technical solution with focus on building out greenfield territories and landing new business; proven success working on complex/large Enterprise deals
  • Customer-focused with extensive experience developing customer relationships within SLED accounts. This includes relationships with Government Agencies, Higher Education Institutions, Solutions Partners, and Resellers
  • Experience managing longer, complex sales cycles. This includes navigating the complexity of multiple buying stakeholders and the nuances of government and education buying
  • Experience collaborating with an internal channel partner team to sell through and with channel partners is a plus
  • Willingness to “roll up your sleeves” with Enterprise Account Executives, actively participate in their deals and maintain a robust field presence alongside them
  • Relevant software or hardware industry experience in any of the following domains; security software or hardware, computer networking and “how the internet works”, subscription, SaaS, or Cloud software is a plus
  • Strong knowledge and execution of MEDDIC is highly preferred
  • Intellectually curious. High IQ, EQ and self-awareness
  • Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) with peers, customers, and partners
  • Thrive working in a fast paced dynamic environment with a strong sense of urgency
  • Willingness to travel up to 50%
  • BS/BA degree strongly preferred

US Employee Benefits

Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:

  • Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs - Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans
  • Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage
  • Starting January 2027, Verkada will match a portion of an employee’s 401(k) contributions based on eligible earnings. Match vests on 2 year anniversary
  • Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options
  • Expanded mental health support
  • Paid parental leave policy & fertility benefits
  • Time off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays, firmwide extended holidays, flexible PTO and personal sick time
  • Professional development stipend
  • Wellness/fitness benefits
  • Healthy lunches provided daily
  • Commuter benefits

Annual Pay Range

At Verkada, we want to attract and retain the best employees, and compensate them in a way that appropriately and fairly values their individual contribution to the company. With that in mind, we carefully consider a number of factors to determine the appropriate starting pay for an employee, including their primary work location and an assessment of a candidate's skills and experience, as well as market demands and internal parity. A Verkada employee may be eligible for additional forms of compensation, depending on their role, including sales incentives, discretionary bonuses, and/or equity in the company in the form of restricted stock units (RSUs)

Below is the annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position, comprised of base compensation and commissions (if applicable).

Estimated Annual Pay Range
$330,000—$380,000 USD

As an equal opportunity employer, Verkada is committed to providing employment opportunities to all individuals. All applicants for positions at Verkada will be treated without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

jobs.title: Customer Service Delivery Advocate- 4 Day Work Week!
jobs.description:
We're looking for Customer Advocates with at least 2 years of customer-facing experience to build an exciting career at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500!

Whether it's delivering happiness to customers on the driveway or getting involved in the local community, our Customer Advocates are leading the charge in reintroducing happiness into the car-buying process. Ready to join the 'Hauler-Life'? 

Shift Requirement: The hours for this position are from 7am - 5pm OR 11am - 9pm. We ask that team members be available to work 7 days a week. Days off will rotate between weekdays and weekend days.

Unlock Your Earning Potential!

 

We offer a competitive starting hourly rate of $20/hr with significant growth opportunities based on performance. You can boost your earnings within a short timeframe:

  • Pay Range: $20-$22 hourly
  • Starting Pay: $20/hr
  • At 3 Months: $20.50/hr
  • At 6 Months: $21/hr

In your first year, you can progress from $20/hr to $22/hr through our performance-based Careers Not Jobs program, which provides four merit opportunities annually. As part of this program, eligible team members can enjoy an additional $0.50 increase in their pay every 90 days.

And that's not all! Market Operations may offer other performance-based incentive programs specific to your location, potentially unlocking even greater earnings. 

Benefits + Perks: 

We continually invest in our team members’ success because when our team members grow, we grow. Here is how we invest in you: 

  • Compensation: Competitive, Performance-Based Compensation PLUS 401(k) with Carvana match, opportunity for overtime during busy seasons
  • Fast Track Advancement Opportunities: Stellar performers achieve higher pay rates sooner based on performance. Hard work and stellar performance won't go unnoticed.
  • Health & Wellness: 100% Company Paid Healthcare Premiums plus Dental + Vision benefits. Wellness program to support mental, physical and financial health. We know pets are family too! Benefit from our pet care savings program to keep your furry friends healthy and happy.
  • Time Off & Work-Life Balance: Generous paid time off (13 days for the first year, increases to 20 days thereafter) 
  • Education Support:  We support you depending on where you are at in your education journey - if you are looking to pursue a bachelor's degree, we offer tuition reimbursement. And if you already have your bachelors degree we have a student loan repayment program!
  • Equity: Carvana Shares is something that we grant to our team members on an annual basis where you get to be an ‘owner’ in the company. We also offer an Employee Stock Purchase Plan discount!
  • Professional Development: Extensive internal growth and professional development opportunities
  • And more!

About the Role: 

We're looking for enthusiastic, energetic, and self-motivated team players with at least 2 years of customer-facing experience to:

  • Deliver vehicles straight to customers' doors with our custom car haulers (don't worry - a commercial license is not required to drive the hauler and you will receive ample training)
  • Frequently load/unload vehicles onto the hauler (this part does require getting physical!) and regularly inspect the car-hauler to make sure the vehicle maintains safe to drive
  • Complete customer paperwork and include thorough notes in our customer tracking system
  • Consistently drive safe and maintain a clean driving record in accordance with Carvana's CMV Driver Qualification policy.

* Candidates must have (or be able to obtain) a Notary in your local jurisdiction within the first 90 days of employment (process sponsored by Carvana). This process may involve satisfying state-specific requirements. For further details, candidates can review their local state notary requirements here: State Notary Requirements.

* Candidates must be able to satisfy state-specific requirements related to access DMV/title and registration systems.

* Illinois, Michigan, Louisiana, and Missouri employees must obtain a Chauffeur's license or any other state specialty license within the first two weeks of employment (process sponsored by Carvana).

* California employees must obtain a Vehicle Verifier license within the first 90 days of employment (Process sponsored by Carvana).

General qualifications and requirements

  • Ability to perform physically demanding tasks like detailing vehicles and loading/unloading vehicles onto our haulers in indoor and outdoor conditions with occasional exposure to inclement/extreme weather (some markets may require deliveries to be made in the snow, while other markets require deliveries to be made in the summer heat).
  • Ability to walk/stand and sustain physical activity for extended periods of time (8+ hours)
  • Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English
  • Requires high and low levels of movement with the ability to reach with arms, twist, kneel, crouch, climb, balance, and squat
  • Requires the grasping, carrying, lifting, pushing, and pulling of items of 50lbs.
  • Frequent driving requires excellent visual acuity and manual dexterity. Reasonable accommodations may be granted to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions

Legal stuff

This job description is not designed to contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. 

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

All applicants must pass a drug test and obtain a DOT Medical Card. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Must be at least 21 years of age and possess a valid driver's license. Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English.”

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative, Finnish
jobs.description:
About Team & About Role:

Rubrik’s Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) form the core of our ambitious go-to-market strategy and sales pipeline engine. Through independent outbound hunting and a proportion of inbound leads, the SDR team books high-quality meetings with potential new customers for Rubrik’s sales organisation. We do this by having a targeted set of prospects that we research, personalise our messaging to, and influence to evaluate Rubrik. 

The SDR position teaches All-Star talent what it takes to be successful in the highly lucrative world of enterprise technology. Rubrik has also been recognised as a 2021 LinkedIn Top Company and Forbes Cloud 100 Company and LinkedIn Top Startup five years in a row. This is your opportunity to build a career in one of the world’s most challenging and rewarding fields.

What you’ll do:

  • Identify high-potential customers, research Rubrik’s value fit, personalise messaging to prospects, and generate high-quality new business meetings for the company
  • Responsible for outbound/inbound activities for our enterprise customer prospecting by contacting via email, social and phone calls to qualify prospects to set meetings
  • Follow up on inbound leads generated by Marketing and stay within compliance metrics, i.e. timely follow-up and attempts to connect 
  • Collaborate with the field sales team you’re aligned with and develop strategies for breaking into new accounts 
  • Stay up-to-date on market trends, competition, and industry developments – we’re seeing cybersecurity breaches daily in today’s world. Rubrik can make an impact. 
  • Be an expert on what we do and how we help our customers keep their businesses up and running.
  • Use customer relationship management (Salesforce & Salesloft) software to manage leads and sales activities
  • Own your business and your sales targets, and be able to report on your results to your stakeholders. What you put in is what you get out! 
  • Develop how to think on your feet and learn the art of sales through team pitch competitions, boot camps, training, and more – we love friendly competition! 
  • You will receive coaching and development on an ongoing basis, our managers will assist with developing your skills and approach to calls, thus improving Rubrik’s service to its customers. (Note: Telephone calls to and from prospects & customers, may be recorded, depending on region, and listened to from time to time by yourself and management.)
  • If available based on location, you will be working in-office 3-5 days a week for active coaching and peer camaraderie.

Experience You’ll Need:

  • 0-2 years of sales-oriented work, B2B sales, marketing, and/or lead generation experience
  • Native or Fluent in Finnish language
  • Exposure to customer service experience
  • Interest and ability to learn technical concepts quickly
  • A valid VISA or right to work in the UK without sponsorship
  • Desire for a successful career in sales/business development
  • Written & Verbal Communication succinct & professional email, LinkedIn, phone

What would make you successful in this role?

Curiosity, grit, goal-oriented, growth mindset

  • Organisation & Time Management ability to structure hours/days/weeks
  • Research & Business Intuition ability to interpret information and use for prospecting
  • Active Listening & Adaptability audible ready to carry conversation and react with value
  • Objection Handling ability to comprehend and overcome objections
  • Storytelling ability to paint a picture of technical pain & business value

What do our perks look like?

  • Uncapped commission structure
  • Competitive pay
  • Competitive benefits (i.e. medical/dental/vision insurance, 401(k), wellness & mental health resources, etc.)
  • Apple laptop
  • Fun in-office activities 
  • Rewards and Recognition

 

Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation

Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls.

Linkedin | X (formerly Twitter) | Instagram | Rubrik.com

Inclusion @ Rubrik

At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.

Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential.

Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:

  • Our Company: We are committed to building a merit-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here.

  • Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries.

  • Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled

Rubrik is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rubrik provides equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants in all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, promotion, compensation, training, leave, and termination.

Rubrik provides reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. If you need an accommodation to participate in the application process or to perform your job, please contact hr@rubrik.com. Accommodations may include changes to the application process, documents in an alternate format, a sign language interpreter, or specialized equipment.

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Consultant
jobs.description:
Here at Appian, our values of Intensity and Excellence define who we are. We set high standards and live up to them, ensuring that everything we do is done with care and quality. We approach every challenge with ambition and commitment, holding ourselves and each other accountable to achieve the best results. When you join Appian, you’ll be part of a passionate team dedicated to accomplishing hard things, together.

Senior Solutions Consultant

Location: West Coast| Remote, Field Work

Drive the technology evaluation stage of the enterprise sales process and act as the primary technical advisor and product advocate for Appian.

 

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Appian Solutions Consulting team bridges the gap between complex business challenges and cutting-edge technology. We work hand-in-hand with the sales organization to demonstrate how Appian’s platform delivers AI-Powered Process Automation and orchestrates critical enterprise workflows. Our mission is to win the trust of technical and business stakeholders alike under our SC 2.0 operating model, proving Appian's undisputed value in competitive enterprise market scenarios.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Senior Solutions Consultant, you have a unique opportunity to combine technical creativity with high-level business acumen. You won't just demo software; you will architect bespoke Proof of Concepts (POCs) that solve the absolute biggest operational hurdles faced by Fortune 500 companies. This role gives you a direct hand in securing high-value enterprise deals, working closely with C-level executives, mentoring junior team members, and acting as a vital feedback loop to our core Product Management teams within our Enterprise-Grade Orchestration ecosystem.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead Technical Strategy: Partner directly with Account Executives to achieve defined regional sales goals and drive the technical strategy for high-value target accounts.
  • Architect Custom Solutions: Lead the scoping, design, and delivery of high-quality, custom technical Proof of Concepts (POCs) and Proof of Values (POVs) for prospective enterprise customers.
  • Engage Executive Buyers: Present complex technical and business architectures confidently to a C-level audience, effectively positioning Appian's Enterprise-Grade Orchestration capabilities.
  • Own Technical Validation: Drive technical responses and functional strategy for RFPs, RFIs, and detailed client proposals, handling complex technical objections with credibility.
  • Influence the Product Roadmap: Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Management to convey real-world customer requirements and help shape the future software roadmap.
  • Scale the Organization: Contribute reusable assets—including architectural blueprints, frameworks, and customer stories—while mentoring associate SCs to scale best practices.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Education: Minimum of a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, Business Information Technology, or a closely related technical or business field.
  • Experience: 5+ years of experience as a Solutions Consultant, Pre-Sales Engineer, Solution Architect, Technical Consultant, Enterprise Architect, or client-facing Professional Services consultant involved in enterprise software sales scenarios.
  • Technical Fluency: Strong technical fluency in enterprise application architecture, REST APIs, databases, SQL, integrations, cloud environments, or modern development languages.
  • Execution: Proven success delivering technical demonstrations, custom prototypes, or POCs/POVs for enterprise customers alongside a mastered ability to execute deep technical discovery and requirements analysis.
  • Travel: Ability to travel to customer locations and field events as required by the assigned region or market, up to 30%–70% travel.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience designing solution architectures for highly regulated industries (e.g., Financial Services, Insurance, Life Sciences, or Public Sector).
  • Familiarity with production environments, including application servers, web servers, AI-enabled automation, or case management frameworks.
  • We value experience with enterprise platforms as these skills translate well into our Enterprise-Grade Orchestration environment.

 

#SaaS #PreSales #SolutionsArchitect #SolutionsConsulting #EnterpriseSoftware #LI-MB1 

 

The base salary range per provided represents a good faith and reasonable estimate of the range at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be dependent on a number of factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s relevant work experience, qualifications, internal peer equity, and market and business conditions that exist when extending an offer. Sales roles may be eligible to participate in a commission plan subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies. 

Appian offers a comprehensive benefits package, which may include health coverage, life and disability insurance, an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with free mental health support, an Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), lifestyle allowance, tuition reimbursement, and family-forming benefits. Benefits may vary by country. Please ask your Talent Acquisition Specialist for details on the benefits available in the location you are applying to.

Pay and benefits are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation, commission, bonus, or benefit plans.

Base Salary Range
$140,000—$215,000 USD

Tools and Resources 

  • Training and Development: During onboarding, we focus on equipping new hires with the skills and knowledge for success through department-specific training. Continuous learning is a central focus at Appian, with dedicated mentorship and the First-Friend program being widely utilized resources for new hires. 
  • Growth Opportunities: Appian provides a diverse array of growth and development opportunities, including our leadership program tailored for new and aspiring managers, a comprehensive library of specialized department training through Appian University, skills based training, and tuition reimbursement for those aiming to advance their education. This commitment ensures that employees have access to a holistic range of development opportunities.
  • Community: We’ll immerse you into our community rooted in respect starting on day one. Appian fosters inclusivity through our 8 employee-led affinity groups. These groups help employees build stronger internal and external networks by planning social, educational, and outreach activities to connect with Appianites and larger initiatives throughout the company.

Benefits

Appian offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and financial future. Benefits may include health coverage, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with free mental health support, life and disability insurance, an Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), a retirement/pension plan, wellness dollars, tuition reimbursement, family-forming benefits and more. Benefits vary by country—please ask your Talent Acquisition contact for details specific to the location you are applying to.

About Appian

Appian provides AI automation for the most important business processes at the world’s largest organizations. Our platform is known for its unique power, reliability, and scale. We’ve been automating processes for more than 25 years and have proven expertise in enterprise operations. For more information, visit appian.com. 

Follow Appian: LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, and X. 

Appian is an equal opportunity employer that strives to attract and retain the best talent. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. 

Appian provides reasonable accommodations to applicants in accordance with all applicable laws. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please contact us by email at ReasonableAccommodations@appian.com. Please note that only inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this email address.

Appian's Applicant & Candidate Privacy Notice
