jobs.title: Senior Director, Sales Engineering - Majors
jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

About the Role

As the Senior Systems Engineering Director (Senior SED) for Majors, you will lead the pre-sales engineering organization across our highest-revenue majors accounts. You are a second-line leader responsible for managing first-line Systems Engineering Directors (SEDs), Principal Architects, and senior Individual Contributors.

Partnering directly with Area Vice Presidents (AVPs) of Sales, you will own technical go-to-market execution, capacity planning, and technical win rates across the region. You will move the team beyond reactive technical demonstrations and open-ended POCs into a disciplined engineering motion: validating deals against clear C-level business metrics, generating technical pipeline, and scaling practical AI workflows across the field.

Key Responsibilities

1. Regional GTM Strategy & Capacity Governance

  • Partner with Regional Sales VPs on quarterly territory reviews, account tiering, and technical coverage planning.
  • Balance and govern SE team capacity across accounts, setting clear criteria to allocate engineering resources where win probability and deal value are highest.
  • Manage second-line operational metrics: technical win rates, POV cycle times, and resource utilization across the region.

2. Proof-of-Value (POV) Governance & Deal Execution

  • Enforce clear entry and exit criteria for all customer evaluations, requiring documented executive business goals and CISO/CIO alignment before committing technical resources.
  • Hold SE Directors and Managers accountable for operational rigor: tracking 30-day technical validation milestones, maintaining shared customer war rooms, and preventing scope creep.
  • Act as executive technical sponsor on flagship deals, partnering with account teams during late-stage negotiations and high-stakes executive playbacks.

3. SE Pipeline Generation (SE PG) & Account Expansion

  • Drive a culture of technical pipeline generation, leading teams to proactively uncover new expansion opportunities through architectural reviews, zero trust maturity workshops, and executive threat briefings.
  • Partner with Customer Success and Professional Services to identify expansion paths within existing Major accounts and protect renewal health.

4. People Leadership & Workforce Development

  • Hire, develop, and retain high-performing SE Directors, SE Managers, Principal Architects, and Senior SEs.
  • Drive structured performance management, succession planning, and leadership development across your management layer.
  • Foster a high-accountability, collaborative engineering culture aligned with our core values: Communicate. Collaborate. Continuously Improve.

5. Cross-Functional Product Feedback Loop

  • Run regular field retrospectives to synthesize product gaps, competitive threats, and integration bottlenecks encountered during POVs.
  • Deliver structured, data-backed telemetry to Product Management and Engineering leadership to prioritize roadmap decisions that directly unblock revenue.

6. Field AI Tooling & Operational Modernization

  • Drive adoption of modern AI tooling across your organization—equipping SEs to use LLMs and automation for faster RFP responses, lab automation, discovery synthesis, and solution modeling.

Success Profile

  • Operational Rigor: You build systems, cadences, and standards so that technical execution is consistent across all teams rather than dependent on individual heroics.
  • Executive Presence: You speak fluently with CISOs, CIOs, and Enterprise Architects, translating technical capabilities into business risk reduction and ROI.
  • Collaborative Leadership: You forge tight partnerships with Sales, Product Engineering, Channels, and Post-Sales services to drive seamless customer lifecycle management.
  • Decisiveness: You know when to qualify out of bad deals and pull resources from stalled evaluations to protect team focus and deal velocity.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • 12+ years of technical pre-sales engineering experience in enterprise software, cybersecurity, cloud architecture, or networking infrastructure.
  • 5+ years in a formal leadership capacity, with demonstrated experience managing managers (second-line leadership) or leading large, distributed field engineering organizations ($100M+ ARR scope).
  • Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving
  • Proven track record partnering with Senior Sales Leadership (RVPs/AVPs) on quota attainment, capacity forecasting, and complex MEDDPICC-governed sales motions.
  • Deep knowledge of Zero Trust principles, SASE/SSE architectures, cloud security, and enterprise networking.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience establishing or overhauling POV governance frameworks, reducing evaluation cycle times, and improving technical win rates.
  • Demonstrate strong AI fluency by leveraging coding assistants, LLMs, and Generative AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, solution design, automation, and customer problem-solving, while applying sound technical judgment to validate outputs.
  • Direct experience engaging with Fortune 500 / Global 2000 C-level security and IT executives.
  • Track record of incorporating modern AI-assisted engineering tools and automation into pre-sales workflows.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent enterprise experience.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion. 

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

About the Job

As an Account Executive, you will expand OpenTable’s dining network by bringing new restaurant partners onto our platform through a consultative sales approach. In this hybrid field-based role with up to 60% domestic travel, you will partner with restaurateurs to enhance their revenue potential using industry-leading front-of-house management and online reservation technology. You will serve as a trusted market expert, driving sustainable commercial growth while representing OpenTable across the hospitality community.

Responsibilities

  • Proactively identify, target, and secure top-tier restaurant partners through strategic outbound prospecting and comprehensive market mapping to expand territory presence.
  • Deliver high-quality, data-driven product demonstrations—both virtual and in-person—tailored to solve specific operational challenges and demonstrate clear value.
  • Execute strategic territory and account plans to consistently achieve monthly and quarterly acquisition and revenue targets while maintaining disciplined Salesforce pipeline management.
  • Consult with operators on industry trends, performance analytics, and competitive insights to reframe their business strategies and build long-term partnerships.
  • Structure compelling, value-based commercial opportunities and negotiate agreements that generate measurable return on investment for both restaurateurs and OpenTable.
  • Gather and translate field insights into actionable, structured feedback for Product and Marketing teams to continuously strengthen the core value proposition.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in B2B sales with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding targets in fast-paced environments.
  • Demonstrated experience in consultative selling, value-based negotiation, and articulating ROI during complex sales engagements.
  • Proven proficiency in using Salesforce CRM and Google Workspace for accurate forecasting, pipeline management, and administrative tracking.
  • Strong data analysis and presentation skills, with experience using metrics to build compelling business cases and conduct product demonstrations.
  • Ability to travel domestically up to 60% for in-person customer meetings, territory mapping, and industry networking events.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in restaurant management, food and beverage sales, or hospitality technology.
  • Demonstrated success navigating competitive sales environments and overcoming complex business objections.
  • Experience translating customer field feedback into structured insights for internal product and marketing teams.
  • Professional fluency or proficiency in Spanish and/or Korean (nice to have).
  • Must have a valid driver’s license and reliable access to a vehicle, as this role requires travel throughout the assigned territory. 

Benefits and Perks

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year
  • Focus on mental health and well-being:
    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
    • Company-paid subscription to Headspace
    • Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)
  • Paid parental leave
  • Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday
  • Paid volunteer time
  • Focus on your career growth:
    • Development Dollars
    • Leadership development
    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings
  • Travel Discounts
  • Employee Resource Groups
  • Competitive retirement and health plans 

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. On-target earnings range from $134,000 - $144,000 USD annually through a combination of base salary and uncapped monthly sales incentives. The base salary range for this United States located role is $65,000 - $75,000 USD plus uncapped commission.

In addition to a competitive base salary, roles are eligible for additional compensation and benefits including: commission-based compensation; health benefits; flexible spending account; retirement benefits; life insurance; paid time off (including PTO, paid sick leave, medical leave, bereavement leave, floating holidays and paid holidays); and parental leave and benefits.

Work Environment & Flexibility

At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. As a team member with us, you will benefit from a schedule tailored to accommodate a global workforce operating across multiple time zones. While the majority of your responsibilities may align with conventional business hours, there will be instances where you are expected to manage communications - via calls, Slack messages, or emails - outside of regular working hours to effectively collaborate with international colleagues, respond to restaurant partners, and/or address urgent matters. OpenTable will always abide by and consider local laws and regulations.

Inclusion

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. We know the best ideas come when we bring different voices to the table, so we're building a team as dynamic as the diners and restaurants we serve—and fostering a culture where everyone feels welcome to be themselves.

jobs.description:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Finance Associate to join our Energy BD Finance group in San Francisco. In this role, you'll be part of the core team that owns the commercial finance function for our energy storage business — building and maintaining project finance models and supporting the end-to-end deal development, approval, and financing processes.

What You'll Do
  • Project Finance Modeling: Build and maintain sophisticated project finance models for large-scale energy storage deployments, including scenario analysis, sensitivity testing, IRR/NPV outputs, and investor-ready presentations.
  • Deal Flow Support: Partner with Business Development to support the full deal lifecycle — from initial screening and term sheet evaluation to contract negotiation — providing financial analysis and recommendations at each stage.
  • Deal Approvals: Own the financial diligence and approval package for new energy storage transactions, structuring analysis that clearly frames risk, return, and strategic fit for executive and cross-functional review.
  • Pricing & Commercial Strategy: Develop pricing frameworks that reflect true cost-to-serve and target returns, and partner with sales and BD to stress-test deal economics before commitment.

What You'll Bring

  • 4–7 years of experience in renewables project finance with significant deal-facing responsibilities
  • Exceptional financial modeling skills — comfortable building complex, multi-scenario models from scratch in Excel
  • Ability to structure ambiguous commercial situations into clear financial frameworks that drive decisions
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with experience distilling complex analyses for executive and investor audiences
  • Self-starter mentality with high ownership and the ability to manage multiple live deal processes simultaneously

Preferred Qualifications

  • Undergraduate or professional background in Electrical Engineering or a related technical field
  • Direct experience in energy storage, battery systems, or renewable energy project development and finance
  • Familiarity with tax equity structures, ITC qualification, and government incentive programs relevant to clean energy

$115,000—$152,500 USD

The position is full-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

Ensuring growth, adoption and renewal, Federal Solution Architects act as customer champions, ensuring customers are onboarded and realizing value rapidly.

Federal Enterprise Solution Architects at Collibra Public Sector are responsible for

  • Supporting federal customer engagements by delivering mission-aligned architectural design and execution of Collibra products that adhere to Collibra Public Sector’s Delivery Models, Engagement Processes, Methodologies, and Artifacts, while ensuring compliance with applicable government regulations and security standards (e.g., FedRAMP, FISMA, GovCloud).

  • Partnering cross-functionally with Collibra Sales, Customer Engineering, Product, Support, and Executive teams to ensure alignment with federal acquisition cycles and stakeholder priorities.
  • Identifying opportunities to expand Collibra’s footprint within agencies by aligning product capabilities to evolving agency mandates, modernization efforts, and compliance requirements.
  • Meeting or exceeding utilization goals in support of federal client success, long-term program engagement, and repeatable delivery excellence.
  • Contributing to the growth of Collibra’s public sector services and licensing business through account expansion, strategic planning, and customer advocacy.

You have

  • 5-10 years of consulting experience supporting U.S. federal agencies with knowledge in the areas of Data Governance, Data Management or Data Quality.
  • An understanding of the leading PaaS providers, Data Lakes, Databases, and Integration platforms commonly adopted by federal agencies.
  • A minimum of 2 years of experience working with cloud platforms, network-based API integration (REST/JSON), and deployment automation.
  • Linux CLI proficiency.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS/Azure, Kubernetes, infrastructure and platform.
  • Experience with big data technologies such as Spark, and Hadoop.
  • Because this role supports the U.S. government business, it is required that this candidate be a U.S. citizen who resides on U.S. soil and holds active security clearance (Secret/TS/TS-SCI).
  • Familiarity in enterprise security solutions such as LDAP or Kerberos.
  • Hands-on experience with Data Quality, Data Pipelines, Data Orchestration, and/or Job Control tools.
  • Knowledgeable of at least least two or three of the following: data management processes, including data governance, data stewardship, master data management, data cataloging, and business rules management
  • Proficiency in leveraging APIs via Java, Python, or similar scripting language for custom software implementations in Enterprise Linux or Unix environments. 
  • Experience with data warehousing, ETL, data integration.
  • Skilled in developing functional and technical specifications.
  • Experienced with Collibra or comparable technologies.

You are

  • Preferably located in the Washington, D.C. metro area to support in-person federal customer engagements, with an on-site requirement of up to 25%.
  • An effective communicator across business and technical stakeholders and able to tailor to different audiences.
  • Always customer-focused and personally hold yourself accountable for the customer’s success.
  • Masterful at troubleshooting, navigating, and facilitating resolution of challenging client connectivity and technical software issues. 
  • Self-starting and interested in learning new software skills to support intricacies of Collibra’s application stack. 
  • Able to work with business and IT owners to identify and align on solutions to data challenges, advocating for the importance of preserving data governance and quality.
  • Able to lead blueprinting, design workshops, and requirements gathering activities.

Measures of success

  • Within the first 30 days of employment, be able to
    • Present the services offering to your manager understanding the different deliverables and the value provided.
    • Present the Customer Journey framework to your manager understanding the different phases and roles and responsibilities within each phase.
    • Clearily understand the roles and responsibilities of all delivery personnel including an Engagement Manager, Solution Architect, Account Program Manager, Premium Support Engineer, Sales Engineer and Account Executive.
    • Work with the account team to build project plans aligned to each assigned account.
    • Have a baseline understanding of the Collibra product and associated features.
  • Within the first 60 days of employment
    • Clearly understand and present the functions and features of the product with your manager.
    • Show an intermediate understanding of the product with the ability to architect solutions.
  • Within the first 90 days of employment be able to
    • Execute on customer project plans based on product knowledge for assigned customers.
    • Understand and convey to customers how Collibra's suite product capabilities and the projects being delivered provide value to customers.

jobs.title: Senior Enterprise Product Manager, FP&A
jobs.description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.

The Enterprise Applications and Architecture (EAA) team builds the internal platforms, systems, and workflows that help Coinbase operate effectively at scale. Within that space, this Product Manager role will focus on FP&A and adjacent finance workflows, with ownership across planning, forecasting, reporting, workflow automation, and the systems experience that finance teams rely on day to day.

This is a high-ownership L5 PM role for a leader who can bring structure to a broad problem space and partner effectively across Finance, Engineering, Business Systems, Data, and Functional Architecture. The scope spans core planning workflows like budgeting, forecasting, headcount management, and close-adjacent processes, along with reporting, variance analysis, executive visibility, and platform-level improvements that make FP&A tooling more scalable, reliable, and AI-enabled over time.

What you’ll be doing (ie. job duties):

  • Own product strategy, roadmap, and execution for FP&A product surfaces and workflows across planning, reporting, and automation.
  • Partner closely with Finance and EAA leadership to define the future-state FP&A operating model and the product investments required to support it.
  • Drive improvements to budgeting, forecasting, headcount planning, and finance operating rhythms through better systems, workflows, and user experiences.
  • Improve reporting and insight delivery for finance and business leaders by shaping dashboards, variance analysis experiences, and decision-support tooling.
  • Lead platform-level product work that improves the scalability, maintainability, and interoperability of FP&A systems and workflows.
  • Identify and prioritize opportunities to use AI and workflow automation to reduce manual effort, improve data quality, and shorten planning and reporting cycles.
  • Translate ambiguous stakeholder needs into clear requirements, measurable outcomes, and sequenced delivery plans.
  • Operate as the product DRI across multiple teams, ensuring alignment on priorities, tradeoffs, timing, and business impact.
  • Define success metrics and use quantitative and qualitative signals to continuously improve outcomes for Finance users.

What we look for in you (ie. job requirements): 

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience, including ownership of complex internal platforms, enterprise software, or workflow-heavy products.
  • Strong product judgment in cross-functional environments with multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and high expectations for execution.
  • Experience working on finance systems, planning platforms, enterprise workflows, or adjacent domains where process rigor and data quality matter.
  • Ability to deeply understand user pain points across both operational workflows and executive reporting use cases.
  • Strong analytical orientation with the ability to define metrics, evaluate tradeoffs, and use data to inform roadmap decisions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence senior stakeholders and align technical and non-technical partners.
  • Demonstrated ability to move ambiguous problem spaces toward clear product strategy and execution.
  • Demonstrates the ability to responsibly use generative AI tools and copilots in daily workflows, continuously learn as tools evolve, and apply human-in-the-loop practices to deliver business-ready outputs and measurable improvements in efficiency, quality, and cost.

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Customer Success
jobs.description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

As the Director of Enterprise Customer Success, you will lead the team responsible for Toast’s largest and most complex customers. The Enterprise segment serves brands operating 500+ locations, where a single customer relationship spans corporate stakeholders, franchise networks, and multi-year rollout programs. You will own the health, retention, and growth of this book of business and lead the leaders who deliver it.

This is a builder’s role, and an increasingly global one. As Toast's largest brands expand internationally, you will architect the Enterprise CS model that scales across markets, not just accounts.You will shape how Toast serves upmarket customers at scale, reporting to the Sr. Director of Customer Success and operating as a key member of the CS leadership team, working in lockstep with Sales, Care, Product, and Onboarding. If you are a leader who thrives on executive-level customer relationships, operational rigor, and developing high-performing teams, this role is for you.

Day in the Life* (Responsibilities)

  • Own Enterprise segment revenue outcomes: net revenue retention, churn mitigation, and expansion across a book of Toast’s largest customers
  • Build and develop a high-performing team of managers and their CSMs, setting vision, strategy, and performance standards while coaching leaders to raise the bar
  • Design and lead the global Enterprise CS coverage model as Toast expands into international markets, building coverage, escalation, and delivery patterns that work across regions rather than retrofitting a US-designed model
  • Strategic leadership - bring a clear, transformative, and innovative perspective on how to scale the post-live customer success model for a rapidly growing business unit
  • Serve as executive sponsor and senior escalation point for high-visibility accounts, building trusted relationships with corporate stakeholders at major restaurant, hotel, and sports & entertainment brands
  • Drive operational excellence, scalable systems and cadence for the segment: account planning, QBRs and strategic business reviews, renewal risk management, and escalation resolution
  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Care, Onboarding, and Product to advocate for Enterprise customer needs and close experience gaps
  • Use data to run the business: capacity and coverage models, health scoring, risk forecasting, and team performance metrics
  • Be an ambassador for the Toast culture, building a trusting, collaborative, high-performance environment
  • Travel as needed for customer site visits and executive engagements, including international travel as the global book grows

 

What You'll Need to Thrive*? (Requirements)

  • 10+ years of customer success, account management, or revenue leadership experience, with 5+ years leading teams in a SaaS or technology environment
  • Experience as a second-line leader: managing managers, developing leadership bench strength, and running performance management with rigor and care
  • Proven ownership of retention and growth targets for an enterprise or strategic customer segment
  • Executive presence and a track record of building durable relationships with C-suite and corporate stakeholders at large, complex customers
  • Experience building or leading customer success for a global or multi-region enterprise book, including designing coverage models for customers operating across international markets
  • Strong operational skills: you build systems and cadences, not just relationships, and you use data to make decisions
  • Experience navigating ambiguity and change, including org transitions, team integrations, or coverage planning
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and influencing skills

Special Sauce* (Non-essential Skills/Nice to Haves)

  • Restaurant, hospitality, or multi-unit retail industry experience
  • Experience integrating new teams or functions into an existing organization and leading through structural change
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled CS workflows and tooling
  • Experience with Salesforce CRM and modern CS platforms
  • Experience supporting franchise or multi-brand organizations expanding into new international market

 

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.


Our Total Rewards Philosophy

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits.

The base salary range for this role is listed below. The starting salary will be determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, our total rewards components include cash compensation (overtime, bonus/commissions if eligible), equity, and benefits. You can learn more about how we align pay with local labor markets in our Geographic Pay Zone Philosophy.

Zone A
$177,000—$283,000 USD
Zone B
$154,000—$246,000 USD
Zone C
$138,000—$221,000 USD

How Toast Uses AI in its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast

People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.

Apply today!

As part of this commitment, we strive to provide reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities to enable them to access the hiring process. jobs.title: Staff Security Engineer, Detection Engineering
jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

What You’ll Do

As a Staff Detection & Response Engineer & Team Lead at CoreWeave, you will drive the strategic vision, technical architecture, and execution of our threat detection and response capabilities across cutting-edge AI infrastructure. You will operate as both a high-impact individual contributor and a technical leader, guiding a team of engineers to build scalable, automated, and resilient detection systems.

As a team lead and staff-level engineer, you will:

  • Lead, mentor, and empower a team of detection engineers, fostering technical excellence, continuous growth, and an inclusive engineering culture.
  • Architect and steer long-term detection strategies at massive scale, establishing technical standards and operational best practices across the organization.
  • Drive cross-functional technical strategy, aligning detection engineering initiatives with broader security, infrastructure, and enterprise AI goals.

Core Responsibilities:

  • Detection-as-Code & Architecture: Design and build resilient, automated Detection-as-Code pipelines, maintaining high-fidelity detection logic, CI/CD testing frameworks, and continuous coverage validation.
  • Data Ingestion & Security Data Lakes: Partner with Security and Data Science to deliver scalable log ingestion pipelines and security data lake infrastructure to aggregate, parse, and analyze multi-cloud and Kubernetes telemetry at petabyte scale.
  • AI & LLM Integration: Innovate and integrate AI/LLM-driven analytics and automated triage workflows to enhance threat intelligence, anomaly detection, and incident response speed.
  • Systemic Risk Remediation: Partner with infrastructure and product teams to identify root-cause vulnerabilities, automate incident response playbooks, and systematically eliminate recurring security risks.
  • Technical Leadership & Influence: Provide mentorship and technical leadership across teams, setting a high bar for engineering standards, driving post-incident reviews, and representing detection strategy to leadership.

Investing in our people is one of our top priorities, and we value candidates who can bring their diversified experiences to our teams. Here are some qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. We'd love to talk about whether this aligns with your experience and interests and what you’re excited to work on next.

Who You Are

Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven experience in a Staff-level or Technical Lead capacity, guiding engineering teams and defining multi-year detection strategies.
  • Demonstrated track record of implementing Detection-as-Code paradigms, automated CI/CD security pipelines, and detection engineering frameworks.
  • Extensive experience designing, and utilizing security data lakes and distributed log ingestion pipelines for high-throughput cloud environments.
  • Deep domain expertise in Linux internals, Kubernetes runtime security (eBPF, Falco), and cloud-native container security.
  • Proficiency in software development and query languages (Python, Go, SQL, KQL, etc.) to build tooling and automated remediation engines.
  • Strong leadership skills with a passion for mentoring junior/mid-level engineers and establishing strong engineering practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience applying AI, machine learning, or LLMs to detection engineering, threat intelligence synthesis, or automated incident triage.
  • Active open-source security contributions or public technical research in threat detection, Kubernetes security, or cloud defense.
  • Prior leadership or team lead experience in high-growth cloud or AI hyperscaler environments.

jobs.title: Scanbox Press Shop Technician
jobs.description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience. 

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

 

The Scanbox Press Shop Technician performs dimensional inspection, CMM programming and measurement, fixture verification, data collection, and reporting for vehicle launch and series production at Lucid AMP-2. Reporting to the Dimensional Engineer, this role produces accurate, repeatable, and traceable measurement results and provides timely data to support dimensional investigations, corrective actions, and continuous improvement across vehicle manufacturing processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct dimensional inspections of Body-in-White (BIW) components, including stamped parts, sub-assemblies, and assemblies, using measurement tools and equipment such as CMMs, laser trackers, inline measurement systems, calipers, micrometers, and other precision measurement equipment.
  • Support the definition and implementation of corrective actions to reduce dimensional defects and improve process capability.
  • Document inspection results and generate detailed measurement and dimensional Quality summaries.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Production, Quality, and other cross-functional teams to investigate and resolve dimensional issues.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product Quality, measurement efficiency, and manufacturing processes.
  • Create, modify, prove out, optimize, document, and maintain CMM programs using approved CAD models, engineering drawings, GD&T, and measurement plans, including software platforms such as PC-DMIS, Calypso, or PolyWorks.
  • Operate CMM equipment using appropriate alignments, datum structures, probing strategies, feature definitions, and inspection methods.
  • Validate new and revised CMM programs through feature checks, repeatability studies, correlation, and peer review.
  • Interpret engineering drawings, GD&T, CAD models, special characteristics, measurement plans, and acceptance criteria.
  • Prepare parts and fixtures for measurement, verify identification and traceability, and confirm environmental and equipment readiness.
  • Measure stamped panels, body assemblies, closures, checking fixtures, tooling, master parts, and investigation samples.
  • Compare measurement data against CAD models, engineering drawings, and specifications to identify and communicate dimensional deviations.
  • Generate inspection reports, color maps, deviation summaries, trend charts, and measurement records and escalate abnormal results as required.
  • Support Measurement System Analysis (MSA), Gage Repeatability and Reproducibility (Gage R&R), capability studies, correlation studies, fixture buyoff, tooling verification, and dimensional audits.
  • Assist root cause investigations related to fit, gap, flush, alignment, geometry, sealing, and assembly variation.
  • Maintain CMM program revision control, backups, report templates, probe qualifications, calibration status, and measurement traceability.
  • Perform routine equipment checks and coordinate support for CMM, probe, software, or environmental abnormalities.
  • Support trial builds, safe launch activities, engineering changes, containment inspections, remeasurement, and corrective-action verification.
  • Ensure adherence to applicable safety and Quality standards during all inspection and measurement activities.
  • Maintain traceability of measurement and inspection results for audits, technical reviews, and Quality investigations.

Skills

  • Working knowledge of BIW manufacturing processes, tooling, fixtures, automation, joining processes, and Statistical Process Control (SPC).
  • Experience with dimensional measurement equipment, including CMMs, laser trackers, inline measurement systems, calipers, micrometers, and other precision measurement tools.
  • Knowledge of CMM programming and dimensional inspection software such as PC-DMIS, Calypso, or PolyWorks.
  • Understanding of GD&T, datum structures, engineering drawings, CAD models, and dimensional measurement requirements.
  • Familiarity with CAD tools, MES systems, and plant-floor digital manufacturing platforms.
  • Understanding of Design for Manufacturing (DFM), Design for Assembly (DFA), and structured Quality tools such as Global 8D and 5 Why analysis.
  • Ability to interpret dimensional data, identify deviations, and support structured problem-solving and corrective-action activities.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain accuracy and craftsmanship in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively within cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to follow written and verbal instructions in English.
  • Ability to stand for extended periods and frequently walk, sit, bend, push/pull, stoop, kneel, crouch, reach, or crawl.
  • Ability to lift objects weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Availability to work overtime, off-shifts, or weekends as needed.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Technical diploma or associate degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Automotive, Metrology, Tooling, or a related discipline.
  • 3+ years of experience in CMM programming, CMM measurement, dimensional inspection, metrology, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated ability to create, validate, and execute CMM programs and interpret measurement results against GD&T requirements.
  • Experience with common CMM programming and dimensional analysis platforms.
  • Ability to work in a metrology and manufacturing-floor environment and support production and launch priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience measuring stamped panels, body assemblies, closures, fixtures, tooling, or automotive components.
  • Experience with CMM programming platforms such as PC-DMIS, Calypso, or PolyWorks.
  • Experience with BIW manufacturing processes, dimensional inspection, tooling, fixtures, and automotive assembly.
  • Experience supporting vehicle launches, safe launch activities, containment, or high-volume automotive production.

Compensation & Benefits: Lucid offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays, paid sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan. Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off.  Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. Incentive and equity awards, if applicable, are determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.  

Equal Opportunity: At Lucid, we believe diversity strengthens everything we build. Lucid Motors is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing an inclusive workplace for all. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable state or federal laws and regulations. 

Accessibility: Lucid Motors is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need any accommodation to participate in the application process, please contact us at TA-Operations <@> lucidmotors.com. This email address is designated solely for accommodation requests and is not monitored for job applications or resume submissions. To be considered for employment, all applications must be submitted through the Lucid Motors Careers website.

jobs.description:
This is Adyen

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.

We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

 

Senior Software Engineer, Card Payments Team

The Card Payments Airlines team is dedicated to processing high-volume transactions for our global airline partners via major card networks like Visa, MasterCard, and American Express. This team is pioneering the next generation of payment solutions tailored for the unique demands of the airline industry. Our systems are mission-critical, handling millions of transactions daily. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible for leading the design and architecture of the industry’s most scalable and reliable airline processing platform. This senior role also involves coaching and guiding team members and collaborating closely with product management to define, scope, and deliver on our merchant-facing roadmap.

 

What you’ll do

  • Bring your own point of view on best engineering practices. 
  • Collaborate across teams and time zones to get projects over the finish line.
  • Lead complex technical projects from requirements analysis through design, implementation, testing and launch into production.
  • Be hands on and contribute to the implementation, but at the same time offer technical guidance and mentoring to other engineers.
  • Identify and improve parts of the platform to make it more robust and scalable.
  • Your code will be used at scale and you are expected to think in that mindset when building features.
  • We launch fast and iterate often. Concretely, this means that within your first few weeks, you will bring live functionalities that impact many merchants and shoppers.

 

Who you are

  • You have at least 8 years of professional experience as an engineer and are currently working as a Senior Software Engineer or at a similar level
  • You have great communication skills and the ability to articulate complex technical concepts in front of different stakeholders
  • You are flexible, a team player, someone with an eye for detail
  • Familiar with complex large scale distributed systems
  • Open to some domestic and international travel

 

Required technical qualifications

  • Demonstrated knowledge of building Java based web services (RESTful, SOAP)
  • Experienced in designing performant database models in PostgreSQL or other relational databases
  • Knowledgeable of various software architecture paradigms such as event-driven or message queueing systems

 

The annual base salary range for this role is $180,000 - $243,000; to learn more about our compensation philosophy, please click here.

 

Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments

Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

 

Your Impact on our Mission

As Senior Manager, Marketing Program Management, you’ll build and run the operating system that enables Marketing to focus on the most important work, make decisions quickly, and execute effectively across teams.

You’ll create visibility across Marketing’s material commitments, integrated campaigns, dependencies, and capacity tradeoffs. You’ll facilitate the planning and prioritization rhythms that help teams align on what matters most, who owns the work, what decisions are needed, and where tradeoffs must be made.

This is a role for a highly organized, strategic, and pragmatic operator who understands how marketing works. You’ll work across all Marketing teams and many cross-functional partners throughout the Zocdoc organization. You’ll bring structure to complex work without adding unnecessary process, and help teams move from discussion to clear decisions and action. You’ll also help Marketing improve how work gets done through better processes, technology, and thoughtful applications of AI where they can reduce manual effort, improve decision-making, or increase team effectiveness.

You’ll enjoy this role if you are...

  • Deeply interested in how marketing teams plan, execute, measure, and improve their work.
  • Energized by bringing clarity and momentum to complex, cross-functional work.
  • A systems thinker who can connect strategy, priorities, dependencies, decisions, and execution.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and creating practical structure where none exists.
  • Skilled at facilitating alignment among stakeholders with different goals, incentives, and perspectives.
  • A clear and concise communicator who can make complicated issues easy to understand and is comfortable surfacing risks, conflicts, and tradeoffs with senior leaders.
  • Pragmatic about process, comfortable challenging assumptions, and focused on helping teams get better work done.
  • Someone who understands the realities of marketing work and can connect strategic priorities to the details of campaigns, channels, audiences, creative, content, and measurement.

Your day-to-day is...

  • Leading Marketing’s annual, quarterly, and cross-functional planning and portfolio management rhythms, while maintaining visibility into material commitments, major initiatives, dependencies, and tradeoffs.
  • Managing the integrated Marketing calendar across campaigns, launches, events, content, and other important milestones.
  • Facilitating intake and prioritization for new cross-functional requests, helping teams decide what to commit, sequence, experiment, defer, or decline.
  • Preparing and facilitating decision forums, ensuring that decisions, owners, next steps, and tradeoffs are clear.
  • Identifying risks, blockers, capacity conflicts, and dependency issues before they create delays, and partnering with Marketing leaders to make clear resource allocation and sequencing decisions.
  • Establishing lightweight standards, templates, and operating practices that improve clarity, follow-through, and decision speed without centralizing every decision.
  • Connecting department-level priorities to team roadmaps and execution backlogs.
  • Partnering with Marketing teams to identify where better processes, technology, and practical AI applications can improve planning, execution, measurement, and team effectiveness—and helping turn the most useful ideas into repeatable ways of working.
  • Tracking whether the operating model is improving priority clarity, decision speed, dependency management, and delivery, and communicating progress and areas requiring leadership attention in a clear and actionable way.

You’ll be successful in this role if you have...

  • 7-10 years of experience in Marketing, Marketing Operations, Marketing Strategy, Go-to-Market Operations, or a related marketing function.
  • A strong understanding of how marketing teams plan, launch, measure, and optimize campaigns across channels, audiences, creative, content, and lifecycle programs.
  • Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional programs, including managing timelines, risks, dependencies, competing priorities, and delivery in a fast-moving organization.
  • Experience building or improving planning, prioritization, portfolio management, or operating processes.
  • Sound judgment about when to create structure, when to simplify, and when to let teams work independently.
  • A track record of driving progress without relying on formal authority.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience working with senior stakeholders.
  • The ability to synthesize information from multiple teams and turn it into clear decisions and actions.
  • Comfort working across business, creative, technical, analytical, and operational teams.
  • A bias toward action, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Bonus if you have...

  • Experience working in a marketplace, healthcare, technology, or other complex multi-sided business.
  • Experience supporting AI adoption, workflow automation, or change management.
  • Experience working with marketing technology, planning, workflow, or campaign-management tools.

Benefits

  • Flexible, hybrid work environment at our convenient SoHo location
  • Unlimited vacation
  • 100% paid employee health benefit options, including medical, dental, and vision
  • Commuter benefits
  • 401(k) with employer-funded match
  • Corporate wellness programs with Headspace and Peloton
  • Sabbatical leave for employees with 5+ years of service
  • Competitive paid parental leave and fertility/family planning reimbursement
  • Cell phone reimbursement
  • Catered lunch every day along with beverages and snacks
  • Employee Resource Groups and ZocClubs to promote shared community and belonging
  • Great Place to Work Certified

About us
Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values. Zocdoc is a private company backed by some of the world’s leading investors, and we believe we’re still only scratching the surface of what we plan to accomplish. 

Zocdoc is a mission-driven organization dedicated to building teams as diverse as the patients and providers we aim to serve. jobs.title: Manager, Market Operations
jobs.description:
About Carvana 

At Carvana, we sell cars, but we are not salespeople. We have made it our mission to create a hassle-free way for people to buy and sell cars. We saw a huge problem with how much of a headache it is to buy a car the traditional way, so we committed ourselves to put customer satisfaction at the core of our business, we have built a no-pressure, no-haggle online car buying experience that saves our customers time and money. Customers can search through thousands of vehicles online, see full 360-degree views of both the interior and exterior of the vehicles before deciding to go through the purchasing process. Our Customer Advocates will then either deliver the purchased vehicle to our customer’s driveway using one of our kick-ass one car haulers, or they will meet our customers at one of our amazing coin-operated Vending Machines. 

For more information on Carvana and our mission, sneak a peek at our company introduction video. 

About the team and position 

Carvana’s Market Operation department is known for its team-oriented, fast-paced environment. We expect bright people who are willing to roll up their sleeves, step in wherever needed, mentor and develop team members, and assume additional responsibilities as needed while juggling multiple projects. Don’t forget to bring your personality! We thrive from each unique perspective. Our strength is in our diversity of opinions. 

What you’ll be doing 

Mom’s wear a lot of hats, they manage logistics, inventory quality, scheduling, registration paperwork, customer experience, employee experience, community outreach, and both mentoring and training programs. It can be an autonomous job that requires good decision-making skills, but the growth potential is tremendous and you’ll always have a direct link to leadership at Carvana’s home office in Phoenix. In return for your hard work, you'll have an opportunity to work at one of the fastest-growing and most creative technology companies around, helping us promote a life-changing product and develop a world-class team. Other duties as assigned. 

What you should have 

  • A Bachelor’s degree from an accredited undergraduate institution. 
  • At least five years of relevant experience in team leadership roles managing multiple employees. 
  • Experience handling logistics. 
  • An ability to operate in ambiguity with the grace of a gazelle…not the gazelle being hungrily chased by a lion, but the one bounding effortlessly through an open African savanna.
  •  An appreciation for differences of opinion.
  • The savvy to manage employee and customer experience, as both will get messy at times, and to thrive in these situations by making interactions rewarding for all involved. 
  • The skills to examine processes and develop creative solutions.
  • An understanding that things will change. We need to know you are okay with that.
  • A willingness to roll up your sleeves, take on new assignments, and juggle many things at once. 

In other words, you’re a multitasking wizard! 

What we’ll offer in return 

  • Full-Time Salary Position. Salary Range: $68,000-85,000
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits. 
  • 401K with company match. 
  • A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more.
  • A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy both physically and mentally.
  • Access to opportunities to expand your skill set and share your knowledge with others across the organization.
  • A company culture of promotions from within, with a start-up atmosphere allowing for varied and rapid career development.
  • A seat in one of the fastest-growing companies in the country. 

Other requirements 

To be able to do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you. 

  • Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English. 
  • The ability to walk/stand and sustain physical activity for extended periods of time (8+ hours).
  • Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English.
  • Requires high and low levels of movement with the ability to reach with arms, twist, kneel,crouch, climb, balance, and squat.
  • Requires the grasping, carrying, lifting, pushing, and pulling of items up to 50lbs.
  • Frequent driving requires excellent visual activity and manual dexterity.
  • Requires to work in outdoor weather conditions.
  • Must be able to stay in stationary potions for extended periods of time (when driving) up to 3hours at a time.
  • Frequently communicates with customers and must be able to exchange accurate information. 

Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs. 

Legal stuff 

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Production (Roadrunner)
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Associate Director, Production (Roadrunner) reports to the Deputy Head of Production. Scope spans build plan ownership, rate ramp, supply chain consolidation, and containment recovery, working across engineering, supply chain, manufacturing operations, quality, program management, growth, and finance. 

Up to 25% travel expected. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Production Planning and Rate 

  • Own and maintain the Roadrunner build plan across sites, reconciled against JSOP demand and committed delivery dates
  • Model rate scenarios and quantify unit level impact of schedule changes, supplier slips, and design changes
  • Develop and track recovery plans against production deficits 

Capacity and Staffing 

  • Size labor hours, station throughput, tooling, and headcount against the build plan through ramp and site transition
  • Identify capacity constraints before commitments are made 

Cost and Unit Economics 

  • Own the Roadrunner production cost model and track COGS reduction through the rate ramp
  • Run variance analysis against budget, forecast, and prior period, and lead root cause investigation on divergence
  • Lead tradeoff studies with quantified cost and schedule outcomes, including make versus buy, alternate part qualification, premium freight, capital equipment, and rework versus scrap 

Supply Chain and Clear to Build 

  • Own BOM coverage analysis and clear to build status, escalating shortages ahead of line impact
  • Support supply chain consolidation and supplier transition activity
  • Assess supplier recovery schedules for executability and dependency risk 

Risk and Containment 

  • Bound affected population, exposure, and recovery path for quality escapes, shortages, and containments, including rework scope and completion forecasts
  • Define and track corrective action closure with named owners and dates 

Process and Reporting 

  • Standardize end to end process across Manufacturing Engineering, Manufacturing Operations, Material

jobs.title: Payroll Specialist
jobs.description:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

Position Summary:

The Payroll Specialist V is responsible for the accurate and timely processing of payroll for approximately 1,200 employees across multiple states. The role ensures compliance with federal, state, and local payroll regulations, maintains payroll records, and resolves payroll matters for internal and external stakeholders. The position works independently on complex assignments, recommends process and system improvements, and coordinates with HR, Finance, and Benefits. This is a fully on-site role at LH 2.

Responsibilities

  • Process biweekly and off-cycle payrolls from start to finish, including time and attendance data, earnings, deductions, and adjustments
  • Ensure payroll compliance with federal, state, and local wage and hour laws, tax regulations, and company policies
  • Reconcile payroll reports and accounts, and resolve discrepancies in a timely manner
  • Coordinate payroll changes with HR, Finance, and Benefits, including new hires, terminations, compensation adjustments, and benefits deductions
  • Resolve employee payroll inquiries and support internal and external payroll audits
  • Prepare and distribute year-end tax documents, including W-2s, and maintain payroll records in line with internal policies and legal standards
  • Lead process improvement, automation, and standardization initiatives, including system upgrades, to reduce errors and manual work

Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities

  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field preferred
  • 5+ years of payroll experience, including multi-state payroll processing
  • Working knowledge of federal and state payroll regulations and tax compliance, including changes to payroll laws
  • Experience with payroll systems such as ADP or Workday, Workday preferred
  • Ability to analyze payroll data and resolve discrepancies with accuracy and attention to detail
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including working with large datasets
  • Ability to handle confidential information with discretion
  • Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) designation is a plus

The position is full-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

 

We collect personal information (PI) from you in connection with your application for employment with Redwood Materials, including the following categories of PI: identifiers, personal records, professional or employment information, and inferences drawn from your PI. We collect your PI for our purposes, including performing services and operations related to your potential employment. If you have additional privacy-related questions, please contact us at privacy@redwoodmaterials.com.

jobs.title: Sr. Staff Software Development Engineer
jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role
We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Development Engineer - Java, API to join our team. This is a Santa Clara, CA role, reporting to the Sr. Director, Software Engineering in the Zero Trust Exchange department. We are looking for a dynamic and inspired individual who will support and assist in driving the visionary innovation of Zscaler over the next decade. In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape the future of Zscaler technology, especially with the Zscaler Client Cloud Platform. You will work closely with our executive team and lead a team to drive cutting-edge services into the industry.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Take the Zscaler Client Connector Cloud service to the next level in terms of reliability, availability and scalability
  • Be a key decision-maker for all things related to product architecture
  • Be a great teammate and help us maintain our positive culture
  • Collaborate closely with architects from other product areas on the roadmaps

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You act like an owner, bringing a deep passion for the mission and a strong bias for action while seamlessly navigating between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a problem-solver who is energized by complex challenges and focused on delivering high-impact, elegant solutions.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator who embraces feedback, fosters ongoing candor, and actively drives success for the entire team.
  • You are customer-obsessed, anchoring your engineering decisions in empathy to solve real-world problems for both internal and external users.
  • You are driven by innovation, bringing a natural curiosity to technical challenges and a passion for building secure, highly scalable architectures.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving
  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in application development using Java and a Bachelor degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or similar discipline
  • Technical knowledge of: Enterprise Java, OOP, OOA, systems architecture and RESTful APIs, Kubernetes, Microservices and related frameworks, relational and NoSQL databases, Hibernate, CI/CD (tools and processes)
  • Hands-on experience developing and supporting highly scalable cloud-based solutions like AWS, GCP
  • Must have experience with designing and implementing enterprise-grade Security or Networking products
  • Hands-on experience with JavaScript and jQuery, alongside knowledge of Security, Authentication/Authorization and encryption best practices

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency
  • MS degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering preferred
  • Experience with streaming data processing infrastructure and/or experience with identities and access management systems, like Okta, SAML protocols, and security services, alongside knowledge of OAuth, Privilege Access Management, and React.js

jobs.title: Automotive Rim Repair Technician - San Antonio, TX
jobs.description:
We’re looking for Automotive Rim Repair Technicians with a minimum of 1 year of professional experience in wheel/rim repair to join us at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500.

As an Automotive Rim Repair Technician, you’ll be expected to repair deep wheel damage, use a wheel repair machine, and paint and clear-coat wheels.

At Carvana, you’ll receive a competitive wage and amazing perks – including a 401(k) with Carvana match and even a vehicle purchase discount – all while using state of the art tools in one of our high-tech Inspection Centers (click here to learn more). If you’re joining us in an entry-level position, we offer training programs to make sure your skills and pay progress along with the company.

Other perks of the Job

  • 100% company-paid healthcare premiums
  • Generous paid-time off and your birthday is a holiday!
  • ASE and tool reimbursement programs
  • Tuition reimbursement and student loan repayment

 

Schedule: 

We do everything we can to deliver an exceptional customer experience, and that includes delivering great vehicles when expected. If we're in a pinch, mandatory overtime is one way in which we can follow-through on this commitment to our customers. We're looking for team players who are all in on our mission and are able to work mandatory overtime based on our business needs. 

How To Get Started
Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 690-7853, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM PT (9AM to 7PM ET).

We also have a variety of other automotive roles available in one of our 18 locations across the country – take a look at our Careers site to apply for one of the following roles:

  • Auto Body roles: Paint, Prep/Body work, Wheel Repair, Airbrush, Interior Repair, Glass Repair, and PDR (Paintless Dent Repair) roles
  • Auto Technician/Mechanic roles: Lube and Oil, Inspection, Brake and Tire, Mechanical Repair / Build, and Master Technician roles
  • Entry-Level roles: Detailing, Inventory Associate (Car Porters), Photo, Parts Associate, Inspection, and Coordinator/Administrator roles

General qualifications and requirements

  • Ability to physically operate vehicle equipment and tools - must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently
  • Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Some positions may be subject to an Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check
  • An ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing production environment while sometimes being exposed to excessive weather conditions (heat/cold)
  • Use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment
