jobs.title: Systems Engineer, Ground Maneuver Programs
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril Ground Maneuver is the business line that brings Anduril's sensors, effectors, communications, command and control, and Lattice to military ground vehicles. Our work covers wheeled and tracked platforms, from light tactical vehicles to armored vehicles. Our customers range from Army and Marine Corps program offices to the units that operate these vehicles in the field.

We're hiring a systems engineer to support several of our programs at once. At any given time, some will be building and integrating vehicles with customers, some will be in qualification testing, and some will be moving into production. You'll write and maintain the requirements and test plans for each program, run tests in the lab and in the field, and keep each program's verification evidence complete and current. You'll also work with the business development team to size up new opportunities and shape how we would integrate them.

You'll work closely with mechanical, electrical, software and test engineers, and with the division's safety, reliability and cybersecurity engineers. You'll also spend time with customers at test events and on site. Experience with vehicle integration or vehicle systems is valuable in this role.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Write and maintain system requirements for multiple programs, and keep each one traced to how it will be verified.
  • Write test plans and procedures, run tests, and write the test reports.
  • Plan and support qualification testing (environmental, EMI and safety) at Anduril and outside test labs.
  • Support integration builds in the lab and on vehicles, and work through problems with the mechanical, electrical and software engineers.
  • Work with the division's shared safety, reliability and cybersecurity engineers. Give them the system information they need, and make sure their findings get built into the design.
  • Support proposals and new opportunities: feasibility checks, size, weight and power estimates, integration approaches and technical write-ups.
  • Back up the lead systems engineer on a Program of record
  • Keep program documentation under version control and current as designs change.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • B.S. in Electrical, Mechanical, Systems or Aerospace Engineering, or a related field
  • 3+ years of systems engineering, test or integration engineering experience on hardware
  • Experience writing requirements, test procedures and test reports
  • Hands-on experience in a lab or field environment with hardware integration and test
  • Familiarity with military standards such as MIL-STD-810, MIL-STD-461 and MIL-STD-1275
  • Comfortable switching among several programs and setting priorities without being told
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to travel up to 25% for test events and customer sites
  • Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience integrating systems onto military or commercial vehicles
  • Experience running environmental or EMI qualification tests at an outside test lab
  • Experience supporting proposals or technical volumes for DoD customers
  • Experience with Army or Marine Corps customers and test organizations
  • Python or MATLAB for test data analysis
  • Experience with requirements management tools (Jama, DOORS or similar)
  • Active U.S. Secret security clearance
US Salary Range
$147,000—$182,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

 

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. 

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

 

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/. 

 

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Customer Experience Associate, Prediction Markets
jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Customer Experience team’s mission is to serve as the voice of the customer, helping users understand and navigate our products with clarity and confidence. We are launching a dedicated support desk for Prediction Markets (event contracts) where customers can trade on real-world outcomes. We turn user feedback into actionable platform improvements and collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Risk, Compliance, and Operations partners to deliver an exceptional trading experience!

As a Customer Experience Associate, you will be the first line of support for this fast-moving, high-volume trading experience. In this role, you will help customers understand how event contracts are priced, traded, and settled, while resolving account and transaction issues. You will be a founding member of this desk, helping shape the knowledge base and support procedures as the product grows. By keeping a calm, professional approach during live-event volume spikes, you will de-escalate customer concerns and work closely with Product, Engineering, and Compliance partners.

This role is based in our Westlake, TX office, with in-person attendance expected 5 days per week during the onboarding period. After onboarding, in-person attendance is expected at least 3 days a week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

Shifts Available: 

  • Sun-Wed 1pm-12am ET 
  • Wed-Sat 1pm-12am ET
  • Sun-Wed 10am-9pm ET
  • Wed-Sat 10am-9pm ET 

What you’ll do

  • Support customers across support channels. Respond to customer questions by chat, email, and phone with speed, accuracy, and empathy.
  • Explain event contracts in plain language. Help customers understand how contracts are priced, traded, settled, and paid out, including what happens when an event is resolved, delayed, or disputed.
  • Resolve account and trading issues. Investigate order, position, funding, settlement, and payout questions using internal tools, and resolve them or escalate with detailed notes.
  • Stay calm during live-event spikes. Provide steady support when contact volume rises around major news and live events, and work to de-escalate customer concerns.
  • Collaborate on escalations and feedback. Route complex, technical, or compliance-sensitive issues to internal partners with complete documentation, and highlight product gaps or confusing experiences to improve the platform.

What you bring

  • Experience in support. 1-2+ years of experience in customer support, customer operations, or a related role, preferably in a fintech, brokerage, crypto, trading, or regulated environment.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex financial concepts simply, work through transaction questions accurately, and exercise sound judgment on escalations.
  • Adaptability and tool proficiency. Comfort working in a fast-moving, high-volume environment, calm under pressure, and the ability to learn new internal tools quickly (e.g., CRM, case management, and administrative tools).
  • Schedule flexibility. Availability to work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, to align with live-event windows.
  • Licensing and location requirements. A Series 3 license is preferred (or the ability to obtain it within 30 days of hire).

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.
  • Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.
  • Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. 
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more.
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits.
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

jobs.title: Manager, Life Sciences Partnerships
jobs.description:
Reimagine the infrastructure of cancer care within a community that values integrity, inspires growth, and is uniquely positioned to create a more modern, connected oncology ecosystem. We’re looking for a Manager to help us accomplish our mission to improve and extend lives by learning from the experience of every person with cancer. Are you ready to be the next changemaker in cancer care?

 

What You'll Do

In this role, you'll generate and close business opportunities with our biopharma partners and support them in advancing their research priorities using Flatiron’s real-world evidence and AI  solutions and services. This role is located in New York City. Our technology-first approach has allowed us to build RWE data sets with higher quality, accuracy, recency, and scale than any other cancer data that is available. We have active partnerships with the top 25 oncology biopharma companies and many biotechs, top-tier academic medical centers, the FDA, NICE and other key stakeholders across the oncology care ecosystem, all focused on using data to accelerate the research and treatment of cancer. In this role, you will:

  • Grow revenue at our existing biopharma partners by building upon new and existing relationships, proactively pitching solutions, and negotiating commercial terms 
  • Support development of new business proposals -- directly contributing to Flatiron revenues across the Research business
  • Become a subject matter expert on our biopharma partners portfolio and research priorities to help inform and identify growth opportunities
  • Support Flatiron’s strategic approach to long term partnerships with biopharma users of our research offerings
  • Become a subject matter expert on Flatiron’s offerings and reliably represent our capabilities to advance the research priorities of our biopharma partners
  • Support our partners in their use of Flatiron’s research offerings by facilitating data and analytical onboarding sessions, identifying value-added opportunities for RWE and supporting onsite client meetings to collect feedback and support use cases (anticipated travel: <20%)
  • Support advancement of internal Flatiron initiatives and priorities (e.g., identifying future growth opportunities, optimizing internal ways of working, etc.)
  • Act as the voice of the customer across internal functional groups (product, research clinicians, quantitative science, engineering, business development, legal and finance team members) as a key influencer of go-to-market strategy

Who You Are

You're a kind, passionate and collaborative problem-solver who values the opportunity to think beyond the way things are. In addition, you’re an individual with a deep understanding of the healthcare industry, an analytical approach to problem solving, strong client management and organizational skills. You are highly motivated and bring an eagerness to drive business growth. 

  • You have a B.A. or B.S. (preferred discipline in biological sciences, economics, engineering, biostatistics or similar)
  • You have 4+ years of client-facing experience delivering products, services or analyses to biopharma companies
  • OR; Advanced degree in a biological science (e.g., PhD), applied health (e.g., MPH), or business (e.g., MBA) with 3+ years of strategic client engagement/business development
  • Independently owns book-of-work and/or end-to-end client management for a biopharma account(s) with minimal oversight 
  • At least 1+ years of experience leading/supporting sales of product/services to biopharma
  • Experience leading end-to-end sales of products/services (lead generation, pitching, contract negotiation) 
  • Exposure to project work in oncology
  • Understands biopharma industry dynamics across stages of drug development cycle / value chain and familiar with biopharma org structure
  • Experience working in team or cross-functional settings and has a strong willingness to collaborate
  • Detail oriented with a strong desire to develop content expertise (e.g., RWE, clinical oncology, HEOR)
  • Able to navigate ambiguity

Extra credit (Optional to add extra credit)

  • Exposure to project work using real-world data or evidence

Where you’ll work 

In this hybrid role, you’ll have a defined work location that includes work from home and 3 office days set by you and your team. For more information on our approach to hybrid work, please visit the how we work website. 

 

Life at Flatiron 

At Flatiron Health, we offer a full range of benefits to support you and your loved ones so you can focus your working hours on improving cancer care and accelerating cancer research, and your non-working hours on everything else life has to offer: 

  • Work/life autonomy via flexible work hours and flexible paid time off
  • Comprehensive compensation package
  • 401(k) contribution to help you reach your retirement planning goals
  • Financial health resources including 1:1 financial advice
  • Mental well-being tools and services 
  • Parental benefits and policies including family-building care and generous leave
  • Path to parenthood programs supporting fertility, adoption and surrogacy
  • Travel support for safe healthcare services

In addition to our robust benefit offerings, visit our Life at Flatiron page to learn how we support continuous learning and celebrate inclusion and belonging in the workplace.

jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
​
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join Cloud Signals, the team behind the systems that measure, bill, and talk to our customers across the dbt platform and, more and more, the combined Fivetran + dbt product.

Cloud Signals owns:

  • Billing and usage metering: turning product activity into accurate, auditable usage and billing data, including the integration of Fivetran and dbt billing into one consolidated system.
  • Vortex, our telemetry and event pipeline: high-volume event ingestion that feeds the warehouse, product analytics, and downstream systems.
  • The Notification System: the shared service that sends transactional and product notifications (email, in-app, Slack) for teams across the platform.
  • Usage and admin reporting: giving customers clear visibility into consumption as we move toward consumption-based pricing.

As a Senior engineer you’ll own major features and components of these systems from design to production. You’ll be a go-to technical voice on the team and help shape how we build.

Technologies You’ll Use

  • Python and TypeScript for backend services and APIs (Rust, Go, or Java experience also welcome)
  • Relational databases (PostgreSQL) and cloud data warehouses (Snowflake)
  • Event streaming and messaging systems (Kafka or similar)
  • AWS (plus exposure to GCP or Azure), Docker, and Kubernetes
  • Terraform for infrastructure as code
  • Datadog for observability, alerting, and on-call
  • Third-party billing and payment platforms, plus internal and public REST APIs
  • AI coding assistants and agents (e.g., Claude Code) as part of everyday development

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and run features across billing, usage metering, telemetry, and notifications, writing high-quality, well-tested code that holds up in production.
  • Own technical projects from start to finish: break down requirements, write design docs, estimate and plan the work, and see it through rollout.
  • Help deliver the Fivetran + dbt billing integration, with a focus on correct usage data, reliable pipelines, and smooth migrations.
  • Improve Vortex and the Notification System by onboarding new event types and use cases, making them more reliable, and lowering cost.
  • Work closely with Product, Finance, Data, and partner engineering teams, filling gaps in specs and prototyping to test ideas before you commit.
  • Take part in on-call, investigate and resolve production issues, contribute to postmortems, and improve alerting and runbooks.
  • Mentor early-career engineers, give thoughtful, constructive code reviews, and push for good engineering practices on the team.

Skills We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years building and operating production software, with a passion for solving complex engineering problems
  • Strong experience designing and building backend services and APIs, with attention to correctness, reliability, and data integrity
  • Experience with distributed systems and event-driven architectures; exposure to streaming or messaging systems (e.g., Kafka) is a plus
  • Solid knowledge of relational databases and data modeling; experience with a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake is a plus
  • Ability to independently lead the design of a feature or service to meet project requirements, and to spot and fix design flaws in existing systems
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS preferred) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Familiarity with CI/CD, infrastructure as code (Terraform), and observability tools (Datadog, Grafana, or similar)
  • Experience with code reviews, testing, and troubleshooting, and with being on-call
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including writing design docs and working with cross-functional partners
  • Fluency with AI code assistants and coding agents for building features, fixing bugs, testing, and investigation, and with conversational AI (Claude, ChatGPT, internal chatbots) for researching, writing, and reviewing SDLC artifacts like TDDs, PRDs, postmortems, test plans, and proposals

Bonus Skills

  • Experience with billing, metering, or usage-based pricing systems (e.g., Metronome, Stripe)
  • Experience building telemetry or analytics pipelines (e.g., Snowplow, Iceberg)
  • Experience with notification or messaging platforms (email, in-app, webhooks)
  • Experience with data processing (ETL/ELT), dbt, or other modern data stack tools
  • Experience working on SaaS platforms at scale

#LI-IM1
#LI-HYBRID

 

Perks and Benefits

  • 100% employer-paid medical insurance*
  • Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.
  • RSU stock grants*
  • Professional development and training opportunities
  • Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
  • Monthly cell phone stipend
  • Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.

*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
​
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join Cloud Signals, the team behind the systems that measure, bill, and talk to our customers across the dbt platform and, more and more, the combined Fivetran + dbt product.

Cloud Signals owns:

  • Billing and usage metering: turning product activity into accurate, auditable usage and billing data, including the integration of Fivetran and dbt billing into one consolidated system.
  • Vortex, our telemetry and event pipeline: high-volume event ingestion that feeds the warehouse, product analytics, and downstream systems.
  • The Notification System: the shared service that sends transactional and product notifications (email, in-app, Slack) for teams across the platform.
  • Usage and admin reporting: giving customers clear visibility into consumption as we move toward consumption-based pricing.

  • Python and TypeScript for backend services and APIs (Rust, Go, or Java experience also welcome)
  • Relational databases (PostgreSQL) and cloud data warehouses (Snowflake)
  • Event streaming and messaging systems (Kafka or similar)
  • AWS (plus exposure to GCP or Azure), Docker, and Kubernetes
  • Terraform for infrastructure as code

  • Work closely with Product, Finance, Data, and partner engineering teams, filling gaps in specs and prototyping to test ideas before you commit.

  • Ability to independently lead the design of a feature or service to meet project requirements, and to spot and fix design flaws in existing systems

jobs.description:
About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role

We're looking for a strategic and execution-oriented Lead, Recruiting Process Transformation to lead the evolution of our recruiting ecosystem. This leader will identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate Recruiting processes while ensuring operational excellence across our Recruiting Operations and Candidate Experience teams.

Reporting into the People Operations, Services & Technology (POST) organization, this role sits at the intersection of strategy, technology, and operations. You'll partner across Recruiting, People Tech, Legal, and business leaders to redesign how hiring gets done — from requisition to offer to onboarding handoff — creating scalable experiences for candidates, hiring teams, and Recruiting partners.

In addition to leading enterprise process transformation initiatives for recruiting, you'll oversee the teams responsible for executing our core Recruiting workflows, including Recruiting Operations and Candidate Experience.

What You'll Do

Lead Recruiting Process Transformation

  • Develop and execute a multi-year strategy for transforming recruiting processes.
  • Analyze end-to-end candidate and hiring lifecycle workflows; from requisition intake through offer and onboarding handoff; to identify friction, inefficiencies, redundancies, and opportunities for simplification.
  • Redesign processes using Lean, service design, and automation principles.
  • Consult with technical partners to understand how tooling, AI, and agentic solutions (e.g., InviteOS) can support improved recruiting efficiency.
  • Build business cases that quantify operational impact, candidate/hiring team experience improvements, and ROI.
  • Prioritize transformation initiatives based on organizational impact, scalability, and strategic objectives.
  • Partner with Recruiting leadership to define, track, and report on recruiting metrics
  • Diagnose root causes behind unmet KPIs and drive them to resolution, launching transformation initiatives where applicable.

Drive Technology-Enabled Improvements

  • Partner closely with People Technology to implement technology solutions that improve recruiting operational efficiency, including AI-native recruiting platforms such as InviteOS, our custom recruiting tool.
  • Evaluate opportunities to leverage workflow automation, AI, integrations, self-service capabilities, and system enhancements (Greenhouse, sourcing tools, scheduling tools) to drive prioritization for recruiting technology.
  • Ensure process design and technology decisions work together to create sustainable solutions.
  • Balance configuration, workflow redesign, and policy changes to achieve desired outcomes.

Lead Operational Excellence

Provide leadership for:

Recruiter Operations

  • Own transformation of core recruiting workflows, requisition management, and interview/offer processing.
  • Ensure operational accuracy, compliance, and service level achievement across the hiring pipeline.
  • Continuously improve throughput, quality, and controls across sourcing-to-offer stages.

Candidate Experience

  • Lead the team responsible for candidate-facing support and experience across the hiring journey.
  • Partner with People Tech to evaluate and deploy modern technology solutions or replace current solutions where needed.
  • Improve service delivery through knowledge management, self-service, case management optimization, and interview/scheduling process improvements.
  • Develop candidate experience metrics and continuously improve satisfaction and time-to-fill outcomes.

Establish Operational Governance

  • Define operational standards, process ownership, documentation, and governance across Recruiting operations.
  • Create KPI dashboards measuring efficiency, quality, service levels, cycle times, automation adoption, and candidate experience.
  • Build mechanisms to continuously identify improvement opportunities through operational data (e.g., Greenhouse reporting, PHC-style ticket analysis) and candidate/hiring manager feedback.

Lead and Develop Teams

  • Lead and coach managers and individual contributors across Recruiting Operations and Candidate Experience.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, operational excellence, and candidate-centric thinking.
  • Build organizational capability in process improvement methodologies and change management.

Partner Across the Business

  • Influence senior stakeholders across Recruiting leadership, People Tech, Finance, IT, Security, and Legal.
  • Translate business hiring priorities into operational improvements.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives requiring alignment across multiple organizations.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in Recruiting Operations, Talent Acquisition Operations, Business Operations, Process Excellence, Consulting, or related fields.
  • 5+ years leading managers and operational teams.
  • Demonstrated success leading enterprise-scale process transformation initiatives.
  • Experience managing recruiting operations, candidate experience/support, or similar service organizations.
  • Strong understanding of recruiting technology ecosystems (Greenhouse or comparable ATS, sourcing tools, scheduling/case management platforms).
  • Experience applying Lean, Six Sigma, business process management, or operational excellence methodologies.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to use operational metrics (time-to-fill, pipeline conversion, candidate satisfaction) to drive decisions.
  • Proven ability to influence senior leaders without direct authority.
  • Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in high-growth technology companies.
  • Experience implementing recruiting technology or enterprise workflow platforms.
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled recruiting automation and candidate support technologies.
  • Lean Six Sigma certification or equivalent operational excellence training.
  • Experience leading organizational change and large cross-functional programs.

Success in This Role

Within your first year, you will have:

  • Established a transformation roadmap for Recruiting operations.
  • Identified and delivered measurable improvements in key candidate and hiring lifecycle processes.
  • Reduced manual work through workflow redesign and automation.
  • Improved candidate experience effectiveness and satisfaction.
  • Increased operational visibility through standardized metrics and dashboards.
  • Built a culture where continuous improvement becomes part of day-to-day recruiting operations.

Leadership Competencies

This leader excels at:

  • Strategic systems thinking
  • Operational excellence
  • Candidate obsession
  • Data-driven decision making
  • Organizational influence
  • Change leadership
  • Developing high-performing teams
  • Balancing innovation with operational rigor

Compensation

Our cash compensation amount for this role is $147,000/yr to $190,000/yr in Denver & most major metro locations, and $173,000/yr to $225,000/yr for San Francisco & New York. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate location, experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.

This is a HYBRID role where you will be expected onsite Tuesday and Wednesday in either New York, Denver, San Francisco. 

At Gusto, we don't use titles the traditional way, as a signal of rank or hierarchy. Instead, our titles describe two things at once — your craft (what you do, e.g. Engineering, Design) and your scope of ownership (what you're accountable for) — which is why you'll see something like "Head of X" instead of a rank word like "Director" that tells you neither. Because of this, the title on this posting may look different from what you'd expect based on the scope and seniority of the role, and from how similar roles are typically titled elsewhere. If you have questions about how this role compares to your current title or level, your recruiter can help translate.

Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.

Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas. 

When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees.

Reliable, consistent presence: We expect regular and predictable attendance, whether you're working in-office, hybrid, or fully remote, so that you stay closely connected to your team, customers, and stakeholders in real time and ensure colleagues and customers receive the timely support and responsiveness they deserve.

Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto. 

Gusto is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. jobs.title: Customer Service Delivery Advocate
jobs.description:
We're looking for Customer Advocates with at least 2 years of customer-facing experience to build an exciting career at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500!

Whether it's delivering happiness to customers on the driveway or getting involved in the local community, our Customer Advocates are leading the charge in reintroducing happiness into the car-buying process. Ready to join the 'Hauler-Life'? 

Shift Requirement: The hours for this position are from 1am - 9pm. We ask that team members be available to work 7 days a week. Days off will rotate between weekdays and weekend days.

Unlock Your Earning Potential!

We offer a competitive starting hourly rate of $17/hr with significant growth opportunities based on performance. You can boost your earnings within a short timeframe:

  • Pay Range: $17-$19 hourly
  • Starting Pay: $17/hr
  • At 3 Months: $17.50/hr
  • At 6 Months: $18/hr

In your first year, you can progress from $17/hr to $19/hr through our performance-based Careers Not Jobs program, which provides four merit opportunities annually. As part of this program, eligible team members can enjoy an additional $0.50 increase in their pay every 90 days.

And that's not all! Market Operations may offer other performance-based incentive programs specific to your location, potentially unlocking even greater earnings. 

Benefits + Perks: 
We continually invest in our team members’ success because when our team members grow, we grow. Here is how we invest in you: 

  • Compensation: Competitive, Performance-Based Compensation PLUS 401(k) with Carvana match, opportunity for overtime during busy seasons
  • Fast Track Advancement Opportunities: Stellar performers achieve higher pay rates sooner based on performance. Hard work and stellar performance won't go unnoticed.
  • Health & Wellness: 100% Company Paid Healthcare Premiums plus Dental + Vision benefits. Wellness program to support mental, physical and financial health. We know pets are family too! Benefit from our pet care savings program to keep your furry friends healthy and happy.
  • Time Off & Work-Life Balance: Generous paid time off (13 days for the first year, increases to 20 days thereafter) 
  • Education Support:  We support you depending on where you are at in your education journey - if you are looking to pursue a bachelor's degree, we offer tuition reimbursement. And if you already have your bachelors degree we have a student loan repayment program!
  • Equity: Carvana Shares is something that we grant to our team members on an annual basis where you get to be an ‘owner’ in the company. We also offer an Employee Stock Purchase Plan discount!
  • Professional Development: Extensive internal growth and professional development opportunities
  • And more!

About the Role: 

We're looking for enthusiastic, energetic, and self-motivated team players with at least 2 years of customer-facing experience to:

  • Deliver vehicles straight to customers' doors with our custom car haulers (don't worry - a commercial license is not required to drive the hauler and you will receive ample training)
  • Frequently load/unload vehicles onto the hauler (this part does require getting physical!) and regularly inspect the car-hauler to make sure the vehicle maintains safe to drive
  • Complete customer paperwork and include thorough notes in our customer tracking system
  • Consistently drive safe and maintain a clean driving record in accordance with Carvana's CMV Driver Qualification policy.

* Candidates must have (or be able to obtain) a Notary in your local jurisdiction within the first 90 days of employment (process sponsored by Carvana). This process may involve satisfying state-specific requirements. For further details, candidates can review their local state notary requirements here: State Notary Requirements.

* Candidates must be able to satisfy state-specific requirements related to access DMV/title and registration systems.

* Illinois, Michigan, Louisiana, and Missouri employees must obtain a Chauffeur's license or any other state specialty license within the first two weeks of employment (process sponsored by Carvana).

* California employees must obtain a Vehicle Verifier license within the first 90 days of employment (Process sponsored by Carvana).

* Nevada, Tennessee, and Virginia employees must apply for a Salesperson license within the first two weeks of employment (process sponsored by Carvana). Obtaining this license is a condition of employment; failure to secure it may impact continued employment in this role.

General qualifications and requirements

  • Ability to perform physically demanding tasks like detailing vehicles and loading/unloading vehicles onto our haulers in indoor and outdoor conditions with occasional exposure to inclement/extreme weather (some markets may require deliveries to be made in the snow, while other markets require deliveries to be made in the summer heat).
  • Ability to walk/stand and sustain physical activity for extended periods of time (8+ hours)
  • Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English
  • Requires high and low levels of movement with the ability to reach with arms, twist, kneel, crouch, climb, balance, and squat
  • Requires the grasping, carrying, lifting, pushing, and pulling of items of 50lbs.
  • Frequent driving requires excellent visual acuity and manual dexterity. Reasonable accommodations may be granted to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions

Legal stuff

This job description is not designed to contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. 

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

All applicants must pass a drug test and obtain a DOT Medical Card. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Must be at least 21 years of age and possess a valid driver's license. Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English.”

jobs.title: Senior Battery Test and Validation Engineer
jobs.description:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

Position Summary: 

The Senior Battery Test and Validation Engineer owns and runs Redwood's battery characterization program and serves as the technical authority on what gets tested, how, and why. This is a fully on-site role at 100 Hooper. The role translates open-ended performance, compliance, and system-level questions into test protocols and delivers data-driven answers that inform pack qualification decisions. This role sits at the center of understanding how second-life battery systems for data centers behave across varied cell chemistries, form factors, and usage histories, generating the foundational data that feeds site operating parameters, battery models, and algorithms. This is an on-site role. 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Design test protocols by translating high-level performance and compliance questions into concrete test matrices, channel allocations, and timelines
  • Execute and manage concurrent test and screening campaigns across multiple battery types at the cell, module, and pack level, including cycler programming, test monitoring, and failure root-cause analysis
  • Drive lab infrastructure and equipment strategy, evaluating and recommending cycler and chamber purchases, fixture design, and channel capacity planning as the program scales
  • Analyze, interpret, and present test data to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, turning raw results into clear engineering conclusions that inform qualification decisions and program risk assessment
  • Innovate on test methodology and execution to extract maximum insight from limited channels and time, including smarter test matrix designs, advanced cycler programming, and developing automation scripts
  • Collaborate with the battery software and data engineering team to define, prioritize, and validate software automation of characterization processes 

Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities:  

  • BS or MS in Engineering (Mechanical, Chemical, Materials, Electrical), or a related field
  • Minimum 3 years of experience 
  • Strong intuition for lithium-ion cell behavior, operating limits, cell-level failure modes, and degradation mechanisms
  • Hands-on experience with electrochemical characterization techniques such as HPPC, EIS, dQ/dV analysis, and cycle life testing
  • Proficiency in data analysis and scripting with Python or MATLAB
  • Experience with battery cycler platforms (e.g., Arbin, Maccor, Neware) including test programming and troubleshooting
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with systems engineers, battery algorithms engineers, compliance teams, and program managers to ensure cross-functional stakeholder needs are met
  • Deep drive to automate workflows and reduce manual processes to improve test efficiency and minimize errors
  • Bonus: experience with AI tools, especially coding assistants like Cursor or Claude Code; background in EV battery pack qualification or validation programs; familiarity with battery safety and compliance standards (e.g., UN38.3, UL2580, UL1974) 

In accordance with California pay transparency laws, the salary range for this position is listed below. Actual compensation may vary based on a variety of factors, including experience, education, and skills. 

California Pay Range:
$170,000—$195,000 USD

The position is full-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

 

We collect personal information (PI) from you in connection with your application for employment with Redwood Materials, including the following categories of PI: identifiers, personal records, professional or employment information, and inferences drawn from your PI. We collect your PI for our purposes, including performing services and operations related to your potential employment. If you have additional privacy-related questions, please contact us at privacy@redwoodmaterials.com.

Key responsibilities include translating high-level questions into test matrices, managing test campaigns, analyzing data, and collaborating across teams. Required skills include a degree in engineering, 3+ years of experience, strong understanding of lithium-ion cell behavior, proficiency in data analysis, and experience with electrochemical characterization techniques.

jobs.title: Senior Underwriter, Central
jobs.description:
About us

Coalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes. Founded in 2017, Coalition combines comprehensive insurance coverage and innovative cybersecurity tools to help businesses manage and mitigate potential cyberattacks.   

Opportunities to make an impact with bold thinking are real—and happening daily at Coalition.

About the role

In this role, you will be responsible for driving profitable business from an assigned group of brokers and partnering closely with our Sales organization. You will underwrite and manage products across Coalition’s portfolio, including the enterprise segment, while serving as a trusted partner to brokers and customers. Along the way, you will help clients better understand how to protect their businesses, bringing together underwriting expertise, business acumen and a relationship-first approach.

This is a remote opportunity that can be based anywhere in the Central region of the United States with a strong preference for the Greater Chicago area.

Responsibilities

  • Underwrite new and renewal accounts, including the enterprise segment (accounts with ~$1B+ in revenue), while maintaining alignment to underwriting guidelines, risk appetite, and carrier requirements.
  • Shape overall portfolio strategy through management of the broker relationships responsible for placing Coalition’s largest and most complex accounts.
  • Maintain disciplined underwriting files, documentation, and internal tool usage in line with Coalition’s workflows and governance standards.
  • Lead highly complex negotiations on pricing, terms, structures, and exception requests in line with risk appetite, carrier requirements, and close partnership with CPU.
  • Bring deeper technical underwriting judgment to more complex organizations, including risks involving larger networks, subsidiaries, and differentiated operating-company exposures.
  • Provide mentorship to other underwriters, helping raise the bar on underwriting discipline, broker communication, and deal strategy.
  • Partner with Coalition’s security team, Claims, Product, Actuarial, and CPU to address complex risk issues and translate technical, wording, and portfolio considerations into sound underwriting decisions.
  • Represent Underwriting in cross-functional strategy discussions tied to portfolio optimization, product evolution, and market growth.
  • Help shape local or regional underwriting practices, escalation standards, and process improvements for more sophisticated business.
  • Regular travel required for broker management, client meetings, education, and market-facing activity.

Skills and Qualifications

  • 5+ years of underwriting experience, including experience handling high-complex cyber and Technology E&O risks for large enterprise business (~$1B+ revenue); additional experience in underwriting miscellaneous professional liability is a plus.
  • Expertise in analyzing complex cyber and Technology E&O risks and understanding their impact on underwriting, pricing, and portfolio outcomes..
  • Ability to combine deep underwriting expertise with broker and client needs to craft creative solutions and explain rationale credibly at senior levels.
  • Excellent executive presence, presentation skills, and comfort leading complex broker and client conversations in high-stakes settings.
  • Significant experience mentoring underwriters and influencing underwriting culture, standards, and operating practices.

Compensation

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. The US base salary for this position ranges from $120,000/year in our lowest geographic market up to $150,000/year in our highest geographic market. Consistent with applicable laws, an employee's pay within this range is based on a number of factors, which include but are not limited to relevant education, skills, job-related knowledge, qualifications, work experience, credentials, and/or geographic location. Your recruiter can share more on target salary for your location during the interview process. Coalition, Inc. reserves the right to modify this range as needed.

Perks

  • 100% medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) retirement plan with competitive employer match
  • Flexible PTO
  • Up to 14 weeks of paid leave for birthing parents and 8 weeks of paid parental leave for non-birthing parents
  • Annual home office stipend and WeWork access
  • Mental & physical health wellness programs like One Medical, Headspace, Wellhub, and more!
  • Competitive compensation and opportunity for advancement

Why Coalition? 

Work at Coalition is centered on the joint mission to Protect the Unprotected. We have built a remote-first, highly inclusive culture that welcomes people from diverse backgrounds. We trust each other to take responsibility, share ownership of outcomes, and put in the work together to protect businesses from digital risk. Coalition’s exceptional growth stems from its ability to address real-world problems for organizations of all sizes while remaining true to our founding values of character, humility, responsibility, purpose, authenticity, and inclusion.

We’re always looking for collaborative, inquisitive individuals to join #OurCoalition.

Visit our Newsroom > 

Privacy Notice

Coalition is committed to protecting your privacy and handling your personal information responsibly. We collect, use, and store personal information as necessary for the recruitment process and in compliance with applicable privacy laws and regulations in all regions where we operate. We want you to understand what personal information we collect, how we use it, and your rights regarding access, correction, and deletion of your data where applicable. Information submitted, collected, and processed as part of your application is subject to Coalition's Privacy Policy. For further details, please review our full Privacy Policy or contact us with any questions regarding how your information is handled.

Our Privacy Policy >

jobs.title: Customer Service Delivery Advocate - 4 Day Work Week!
jobs.description:

Whether it's delivering happiness to customers on the driveway or getting involved in the local community, our Customer Advocates are leading the charge in reintroducing happiness into the car-buying process. Ready to join the 'Hauler-Life'? 

Shift Requirement: The hours for this position are from 7am - 5pm, 9am - 7pm or 11am - 9pm. We ask that team members be available to work 7 days a week. Days off will rotate between weekdays and weekend days.

Unlock Your Earning Potential!

We offer a competitive starting hourly rate of $20/hr with significant growth opportunities based on performance. You can boost your earnings within a short timeframe:

  • Pay Range: $20-$22 hourly
  • Starting Pay: $20/hr
  • At 3 Months: $20.50/hr
  • At 6 Months: $21/hr

In your first year, you can progress from $20/hr to $22/hr through our performance-based Careers Not Jobs program, which provides four merit opportunities annually. As part of this program, eligible team members can enjoy an additional $0.50 increase in their pay every 90 days.

And that's not all! Market Operations may offer other performance-based incentive programs specific to your location, potentially unlocking even greater earnings. 

Benefits + Perks:

We continually invest in our team members’ success because when our team members grow, we grow. Here is how we invest in you: 

  • Compensation: Competitive, Performance-Based Compensation PLUS 401(k) with Carvana match, opportunity for overtime during busy seasons
  • Fast Track Advancement Opportunities: Stellar performers achieve higher pay rates sooner based on performance. Hard work and stellar performance won't go unnoticed.
  • Health & Wellness: 100% Company Paid Healthcare Premiums plus Dental + Vision benefits. Wellness program to support mental, physical and financial health. We know pets are family too! Benefit from our pet care savings program to keep your furry friends healthy and happy.
  • Time Off & Work-Life Balance: Generous paid time off (13 days for the first year, increases to 20 days thereafter) 
  • Education Support:  We support you depending on where you are at in your education journey - if you are looking to pursue a bachelor's degree, we offer tuition reimbursement. And if you already have your bachelors degree we have a student loan repayment program!
  • Equity: Carvana Shares is something that we grant to our team members on an annual basis where you get to be an ‘owner’ in the company. We also offer an Employee Stock Purchase Plan discount!
  • Professional Development: Extensive internal growth and professional development opportunities
  • And more!

About the Role: 

We're looking for enthusiastic, energetic, and self-motivated team players with at least 2 years of customer-facing experience to:

  • Deliver vehicles straight to customers' doors with our custom car haulers (don't worry - a commercial license is not required to drive the hauler and you will receive ample training)
  • Frequently load/unload vehicles onto the hauler (this part does require getting physical!) and regularly inspect the car-hauler to make sure the vehicle maintains safe to drive
  • Complete customer paperwork and include thorough notes in our customer tracking system
  • Consistently drive safe and maintain a clean driving record in accordance with Carvana's CMV Driver Qualification policy.

* Candidates must have (or be able to obtain) a Notary in your local jurisdiction within the first 90 days of employment (process sponsored by Carvana). This process may involve satisfying state-specific requirements. For further details, candidates can review their local state notary requirements here: State Notary Requirements.

* Candidates must be able to satisfy state-specific requirements related to access DMV/title and registration systems.

* Illinois, Michigan, Louisiana, and Missouri employees must obtain a Chauffeur's license or any other state specialty license within the first two weeks of employment (process sponsored by Carvana).

* California employees must obtain a Vehicle Verifier license within the first 90 days of employment (Process sponsored by Carvana).

* Nevada, Tennessee, and Virginia employees must apply for a Salesperson license within the first two weeks of employment (process sponsored by Carvana). Obtaining this license is a condition of employment; failure to secure it may impact continued employment in this role.

General qualifications and requirements

  • Ability to perform physically demanding tasks like detailing vehicles and loading/unloading vehicles onto our haulers in indoor and outdoor conditions with occasional exposure to inclement/extreme weather (some markets may require deliveries to be made in the snow, while other markets require deliveries to be made in the summer heat).
  • Ability to walk/stand and sustain physical activity for extended periods of time (8+ hours)
  • Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English
  • Requires high and low levels of movement with the ability to reach with arms, twist, kneel, crouch, climb, balance, and squat
  • Requires the grasping, carrying, lifting, pushing, and pulling of items of 50lbs.
  • Frequent driving requires excellent visual acuity and manual dexterity. Reasonable accommodations may be granted to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions

Legal stuff

This job description is not designed to contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. 

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

All applicants must pass a drug test and obtain a DOT Medical Card. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Must be at least 21 years of age and possess a valid driver's license. Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English.”

jobs.title: Mission Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Team

The Imaging team builds and fields state-of-the-art camera and sensor systems deployed to solve real security challenges for the United States and its allies. We work across the full stack, from bare-metal hardware and firmware to networked services and cloud integrations, and we own our systems all the way through to the field. When something breaks in a deployed environment, we fix it.

About the Role

We're looking for a Mission Software Engineer to join the Imaging Interfaces team. This is not a pure product development role. You will spend meaningful time keeping fielded systems alive, triaging issues across the full stack, and serving as a technical representative for our products in integrations with external teams and customers.

The work is varied and sometimes ambiguous. You might spend a morning extending a gRPC service, an afternoon diagnosing a time sync issue on a deployed device over the phone with a field operator, and a week traveling to support a customer integration. You'll need to be comfortable with that range--and ideally energized by it.

If you want to own your software end-to-end in a fast-moving environment where the stakes are real, this role is built for you.

What You'll Do

Own fielded system success. You are responsible for the health and uptime of deployed imaging systems. When issues arise--whether the root cause is in your code, the firmware, the network, or the hardware--you triage, diagnose, and drive resolution.

Build and maintain production services. You'll develop and extend modular software services that run on edge-compute devices in austere environments. These services need to be reliable, observable, and maintainable by engineers who didn't write them.

Support field operations. You'll work directly with field operators and non-technical users to diagnose and resolve issues on deployed hardware. Clear communication under pressure is part of the job.

Represent the team externally. You'll serve as a subject matter expert in integrations with other products and teams; sometimes remotely, sometimes on-site. You don't need to know everything, but you need to be able to speak credibly across the full system stack and know what you don't know.

Maintain end-to-end system understanding. Our devices sit at the intersection of hardware, firmware, networking, and software. You'll develop broad fluency across that stack over time, and apply it to optimize how our services interact and degrade gracefully when components fail.

Collaborate across teams. You'll plan, build, and test complex functionality alongside firmware, hardware, and platform engineers. You'll need to be effective working across team and organizational boundaries.

Travel expected approximately 25% of the time for field testing and customer integrations.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 3+ years of software development with meaningful production ownership: not just shipping features, but owning systems after they ship (their health, uptime, and behavior once they are in users' hands).
  • Deep proficiency in at least one of C++, TypeScript(node.js/React), or Python, and the ability to work effectively across the stack boundary in a second language (reading, debugging, and modifying code outside your primary). Our work spans a large TypeScript/React operator-facing UI and a growing body of C++ services running on edge hardware, and C++ depth is increasingly central as we expand across our imaging product lines.
  • Comfort ramping quickly into unfamiliar languages, tools, and deployment systems. Our language and tooling mix varies by product and shifts over time; we value engineers who get productive in a new stack rather than staying in one lane.
  • 3+ years working in Linux-based environments, including hands-on work with bare-metal hardware.
  • Demonstrated ability to diagnose and resolve issues across system boundaries (networking, services, hardware interaction) without always having full visibility into every component.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical problems clearly to non-technical audiences, including operators in the field.
  • Eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret clearance.

Preferred

  • Strength with performance-sensitive, real-time, or resource-constrained systems (edge or embedded).
  • Experience with gRPC or similar RPC frameworks.
  • Familiarity with systemd service management and observability practices on Linux.
  • Familiarity with Nix or NixOS: uncommon, but genuinely valuable, and something you will use daily on our stack.
  • Experience supporting fielded or deployed systems, not just development environments.
  • Experience with imaging, EO/IR, ISR, or command-and-control (C2) systems.

What Makes Someone Successful Here

The engineers who thrive in this role share a few traits that don't always show up on a resume:

They close loops. When they pick up a problem they own it until it's resolved, not until it's someone else's problem.

They communicate proactively. They don't wait to be asked for a status update. They document what they find, share what they learn, and keep the people who need to know informed.

They're comfortable with ambiguity at the stack boundary. When a device behaves unexpectedly in the field, the root cause could be anywhere. They have a methodology for narrowing it down systematically rather than guessing or waiting for someone else to have the answer.

They represent the team well externally. In customer integrations and partner engagements, they're the face of what we've built. They take that seriously.

 

US Salary Range
$132,000—$175,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

 

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. 

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to
