Distributor & Global Health Partnerships Manager - Africa

Company Description

Butterfly Network, Inc. (NYSE: BFLY) is driving a digital revolution in ultrasound imaging and sensing with its proprietary Ultrasound-on-Chip™ semiconductor technology and software solutions. Butterfly first proved its technology in the point-of-care ultrasound market – commercializing the world’s first single-probe, whole-body portable ultrasound device, which is now on its best-selling, third-generation: Butterfly iQ3™. The Company combines its advanced hardware with cloud software and AI, an enterprise workflow solution (Compass AI™) and other offerings to drive adoption of affordable, accessible ultrasound. Butterfly also enables third-party development of imaging AI apps through Butterfly Garden™, its software development kit and AI partnership initiative. 

In addition to its medical imaging products, Butterfly Embedded™ is the Company’s Ultrasound-on-Chip™ licensing and co-development program designed to enable a new wave of ultrasound-enabled technologies across non-competitive healthcare markets and beyond. Through Butterfly Embedded™, partners can build and scale novel ultrasound applications powered by Butterfly’s proprietary semiconductor chip and software platform. Butterfly’s innovations have been recognized by Prix Galien USA, Fierce 50, TIME’s Best Inventions and Fast Company’s World Changing Ideas, among other achievements.

We’re a team of bold thinkers, problem-solvers, and innovators ready to shape the future of medical imaging. Let’s build something extraordinary together!

Job Description

Butterfly Network is on a mission to democratize medical imaging. Our handheld, whole-body ultrasound platform — combining Ultrasound-on-Chip™ technology, AI-guided software, and cloud connectivity — is transforming access to diagnostics in some of the world's most underserved healthcare settings. Africa is one of the most important frontiers of that mission.

This is a rare role that combines commercial channel leadership with global health impact. You will own and grow Butterfly's distributor ecosystem across Africa while leading our engagement with Ministries of Health, NGOs, development agencies, and international funders — converting large-scale health system opportunities into sustainable, multi-year programs. You will be both a revenue driver and a market builder.

Distributor Management & Commercial Growth

  • Own commercial performance across your African distributor portfolio: revenue, forecasting, funnel management, and territory planning.
  • Drive accountability through structured business reviews and jointly developed annual business plans, building sustainable repeat-order growth.
  • Identify, evaluate, recruit, and onboard new distributors in priority markets.
  • Expand penetration across public health systems, private hospitals, NGOs, military healthcare, and academic institutions.

Deal Support & Sales Enablement

  • Support partners through the full sales cycle — from opportunity identification to contract closure — including government tenders, RFPs, framework agreements, and donor-funded projects.
  • Lead from the front in customer meetings, executive presentations, workshops, and demonstrations.
  • Coach distributor teams on value-based selling and competitive positioning.

Global Health & Strategic Partnerships

  • Lead Butterfly's engagement with global health stakeholders across Africa: Ministries of Health, international NGOs, development agencies, multilateral institutions, and funders.
  • Develop country-level strategies that position Butterfly within national healthcare transformation and diagnostic access initiatives.
  • Build and advance a robust pipeline of large-scale opportunities — national deployments, consortium partnerships, grants, and competitive tenders — capable of delivering sustainable multi-year revenue.
  • Establish Butterfly as a trusted partner for healthcare capacity building, coordinating cross-functionally with Global Health, Clinical, Regulatory, and Marketing teams.

Clinical Adoption & Market Development

  • Deliver product, clinical, commercial, and competitive training; help partners build clinical champions and KOL networks.
  • Facilitate evaluations, pilots, and proof-of-concept deployments, and grow reference sites and centers of excellence.
  • Drive utilization and adoption beyond initial device placement, targeting high-potential segments including Emergency Medicine, Critical Care, Maternal Health, Primary Care, and EMS.

Operational Excellence

  • Maintain accurate forecasting, pipeline visibility, and demand planning.
  • Monitor partner KPIs, ensure compliance with pricing policies and brand standards, and implement corrective action plans where needed.

Qualifications

Baseline skills/experiences/attributes:

  • 5+ years in medical devices, ultrasound, digital health, diagnostics, imaging, or healthcare technology.
  • Proven track record managing distributors across Africa and achieving revenue targets through channel partners.
  • Hands-on experience with government tenders, public procurement, NGOs, and donor-funded healthcare programs.
  • Strong distributor recruitment, channel development, and business planning skills, including forecasting, funnel reviews, and performance analytics.
  • Fluent English.

Ideally, you also have these skills/experiences/attributes (but it’s ok if you don’t!):

  • French strongly preferred; Portuguese and/or Arabic a significant advantage.
  • Existing relationships within Ministries of Health, global health organizations, or development funders.
  • Clinical, biomedical, or scientific background, or experience in ultrasound/POCUS specifically.

Values

Innovation is what we do. Our values are how we make it happen. Butterflies are and believe in…

  • Patient-Centric Innovators: Our mission is THE mission.
  • Empowered to Impact: Every voice matters.
  • One Team, One Goal: Unity fuels progress.
  • Growth Champions: We embrace challenges.
  • Action-Oriented Achievers: We follow through, every time.

Location

Butterfly offers a hybrid work model for most positions, with team members spending two or more days a week in the office. While flexibility is key, we value in-person connections that spark creativity and teamwork. Our offices are designed for collaboration, with comfortable workspaces, stocked kitchens, and opportunities to connect with peers. 

This role is based in South Africa. Travel is required (75% of the time). 

Note: South Africa is the only country in Africa we offer employment. 

Benefits and Perks

  • Competitive salaried compensation - we value our employees and show it 
  • Equity - we want every employee to be a stakeholder
  • The opportunity to build a revolutionary healthcare product and save millions of lives! 

For this role, we are only considering candidates who are legally authorized to work in the United States and who do not now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status.

Butterfly Network does not accept agency resumes.

Butterfly Network is an E-Verify Company. 

Butterfly Network is an equal opportunity employer.  Regardless of race, traits associated with race, color, ancestry, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or Veteran status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Butterfly requires security adherence responsibilities from all employees. These include:  adhering to all company security policies and procedures, utilize provided company assets securely, and complete all required security awareness training programs. Safeguarding company data and systems from unauthorized access, modification, or destruction, contributing to the overall security posture of the organization. Immediately reporting any suspected or actual security incidents, including phishing attempts, malware infections, or unauthorized access, following the established incident response procedure

jobs.title: Territory Account Executive, SMB - Atlantic City, NJ
jobs.description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

As a Territory Sales Account Executive, you will be part of a team that is transforming the way restaurants operate. Using a consultative approach, you will prospect, build relationships, and sign up new restaurateurs in your local area. By understanding their unique needs, you will develop a customized solution that helps their business thrive. We need your passion and expertise to help us build the Toast brand in your geographic territory. 

This is a field sales opportunity based out of a personal home office. You must live local to your territory (Atlantic City/Ocean City, NJ) or be willing to relocate to the area.

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

  • Generate list of prospective restaurants and manage the entire sales cycle from initial call to close
  • Conduct demos and develop a solution that best meets the prospect’s needs 
  • Partner with teams across the business to ensure that expectations set during the sales process are met in delivery
  • Leverage Salesforce (our CRM) to manage all sales activities
  • Understand the competitive landscape and determine how to best position Toast in the market

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 1+ years of experience in a sourcing or closing sales role, restaurant operations, or a relatable field and industry
  • Since this is a field position, you must have reliable transportation (will reimburse for mileage)
  • Strong communication, organizational and presentation skills with the ability to sell and negotiate at all decision-making levels
  • Proven track record of success in meeting and exceeding goals
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial and team environment
  • Self-motivated, creative, and flexible
  • General technical proficiency with software

What will help you stand out (Nice to Haves/Nonessential Skills)

  • Experience with Salesforce CRM
  • Sandler Sales Training

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.


Our Total Rewards Philosophy

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits.

The estimated Total Targeted Cash compensation range for this role is listed below. Total Targeted Cash for this role includes base salary, commission, and bonus (if eligible). This role qualifies for uncapped commissions. The starting salary will be determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location. In addition to cash compensation, our total rewards components include benefits and equity (if eligible). You can learn more about how we align pay with local labor markets in our Geographic Pay Zone Philosophy.

Total Targeted Cash
$128,000—$205,000 USD

How Toast Uses AI in its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast

People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.

Apply today!

Toast is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive hiring process. As part of this commitment, we strive to provide reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities to enable them to access the hiring process. If you need an accommodation to access the job application or interview process, please contact candidateaccommodations@toasttab.com.

jobs.title: Senior Content Designer, National Impact
jobs.location: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

In 2026, our team built an entirely new category of financial product in partnership with the U.S. Treasury —  investment accounts for every child born in America. The app debuted at #3 in the App Store and #1 in Finance. Now we’re designing what comes next: new platforms and new experiences that will shape how future generations of Americans start building wealth. Getting every child invested early is how we continue to democratize finance for all.

As Senior Content Designer, you'll shape work from early concept through national launch, helping define the design direction for one of Robinhood's most visible product lines. Partnering with senior leadership, engineering, legal, research, data science, and marketing, you'll turn complex requirements into experiences that feel simple and trustworthy.

This role is for a content designer at the top of their craft who wants to make an impact on a national scale. Success looks like a generation of Americans entering adulthood already invested and confident in how money grows.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA and New York, NY offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

  • Craft and refine UI content across new product experiences
  • Own decisions that impact terminology, content patterns, and design interactions
  • Build and maintain scalable systems that support large-scale initiatives
  • Influence product and design direction at the leadership level, including presenting to executives and external stakeholders, while keeping to tight timelines
  • Raise the bar for the broader content and design community through mentorship, reviews, or setting standards
  • Use AI tools to prototype, pressure-test content patterns, and speed up iteration, while applying your own judgment to keep quality high
  • Present rationale for decisions clearly and confidently

What you bring

  • Strong experience in content design, with a track record of building content systems and keeping terminology consistent at scale
  • Experience leading content strategy for a complex, high-visibility product
  • A portfolio that shows your craft and systems thinking 
  • Proficiency in Figma, and comfort working directly in design files alongside product designers
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to partner with many stakeholders
  • Experience working in large, matrixed organizations, including presenting to leadership
  • Attention to detail in both your work and how you present it
  • Comfort with ambiguity and tight timelines, with the confidence to speak up and shape product direction
  • Willingness and curiosity to use AI in your content work
  • Nice to have: experience in finance or education-related products, or 0 to 1 work inside a larger organization
  • This position is restricted to US citizens or lawful permanent residents due to legal requirements.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching
  • Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents
  • Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not.
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process.

jobs.title: Entry-Level Automotive Detailer / Lot Attendant (2nd Shift)
jobs.description:
We’re hiring for entry-level auto roles at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500.

In these entry-level roles, you’ll have a number of positions to choose from:

  • Detailer: detailing vehicles, including washing, interior cleaning, and exterior buffing
  • Lot Attendant: move vehicles from one department to the next in our Inspection Centers
  • Photobooth Associate: take photos of our vehicles so customers can see our vehicles in our spinners
  • Inspection Associate: inspect the interior and exterior of the vehicles and accurately identify any imperfections/defects
  • Pay: Starting pay for this position is: $15.00 - $16.00 hourly (based on level of experience)
  • Schedule: We offer two shifts at this location. Please keep in mind that all locations are subject to mandatory overtime based on business need.
    • First shift: Mon-Fri 6am-3pm
    • Second shift: Mon-Thurs 4pm-3am
  • Location: Our inspection center is located at: 63 Pierce Rd Winder, Georgia, 30680


At Carvana, you’ll receive a competitive wage and amazing perks – including a 401(k) with Carvana match and even a vehicle purchase discount – all while using state of the art tools in one of our high-tech Inspection Centers (click here to learn more). If you’re joining us in an entry-level position, we offer training programs to make sure your skills and pay progress along with the company.

Other perks of the Job

  • 100% company-paid healthcare premiums
  • Generous paid-time off and your birthday is a holiday!
  • ASE and tool reimbursement programs
  • Tuition reimbursement and student loan repayment

 

We do everything we can to deliver an exceptional customer experience, and that includes delivering great vehicles when expected. If we're in a pinch, mandatory overtime is one way in which we can follow-through on this commitment to our customers. We're looking for team players who are all in on our mission and are able to work mandatory overtime based on our business needs. 

How To Get Started - join the Carvana team by applying on this page!

We also have a variety of other automotive roles available in one of our 18 locations across the country – take a look at our Careers site to apply for one of the following roles:

  • Auto Body roles: Paint, Prep/Body work, Wheel Repair, Airbrush, Interior Repair, Glass Repair, and PDR (Paintless Dent Repair) roles
  • Auto Technician/Mechanic roles: Lube and Oil, Inspection, Brake and Tire, Mechanical Repair / Build, and Master Technician roles
  • Entry-Level roles: Detailing, Inventory Associate (Car Porters), Photo, Parts Associate, Inspection, and Coordinator/Administrator roles

General qualifications and requirements

  • Ability to physically operate vehicle equipment and tools - must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently
  • Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Some positions may be subject to an Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check
  • An ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing production environment while sometimes being exposed to excessive weather conditions (heat/cold)
  • Use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment

 

About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Metadata
jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us


Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
​
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

 

About the Role

Fivetran and dbt Labs is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.
We're looking for a senior software engineer to join our Metadata team, which owns the metadata layer of the dbt platform — the discovery API, catalog, lineage, and run history services that let customers understand, trust, and act on what their data is doing.

You'll own the design and delivery of features end to end, working across high-throughput APIs and data models to make them faster, more reliable, and more capable. You'll write and review designs, raise the quality bar in code review, use the latest AI tools, and collaborate closely with product and QE to deliver work that scales.

Technologies You’ll Use

Python, Rust, GraphQL, Postgres, Snowflake, Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, GCP, Datadog

What You’ll Do

  • Design and implement features and performance improvements across the Metadata team's services — discovery API, catalog, lineage, and run history
  • Develop, maintain, and test high-quality, maintainable code, and optimize critical paths for performance
  • Write technical designs for feature-level work, actively seek feedback, and clearly explain the trade-offs of your decisions
  • Participate in and review technical designs and pull requests, providing constructive feedback to the team
  • Improve test coverage with comprehensive unit tests and refactor code to drive down tech debt
  • Troubleshoot and debug production issues, and follow up on incidents with post-mortems and mitigation plans
  • Break features into tasks, structure and execute your own project plans, and contribute to sprint and feature planning
  • Collaborate with product managers, QE, customer support, and peers to deliver the best product with high quality, performance, and scalability
  • Participate periodically in the on-call rotation, and be mindful of security throughout your work
  • Use AI tooling — IDE assistants like GitHub Copilot, coding agents like Claude Code, and conversational AI — to accelerate development and to author and review SDLC artifacts such as TDDs, PRDs, post-mortems, and test plans

 

Skills We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in the software industry with a passion for solving complex software engineering problems, including designing and building backend services and reusable components from the ground up
  • Experience working with distributed systems and cloud computing concepts
  • Demonstrated ability to write well-structured, performant, and well-tested code
  • Ability to independently lead feature-level software and design work that satisfies project requirements, and to clearly explain design trade-offs
  • Can identify design flaws in existing systems and propose improvements
  • Experience with code reviews, design, troubleshooting, and testing
  • Proficiency in a modern backend or systems language such as Python, Java, C++, or C#
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience with continuous integration tooling such as BuildKite, and familiarity with observability tools like Datadog or Grafana is a plus
  • Fluent in using AI code assistants and coding agents to generate and investigate code, and conversational AI (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT) to research, author, review, and synthesize SDLC artifacts

Bonus Skills​

  • Experience in data processing (ETL, ELT) and/or cloud-based data platforms
  • Experience building or working with metadata, catalog, lineage, or discovery/search systems
  • Experience with GraphQL APIs and high-throughput, multi-tenant data services
  • Familiarity with the analytics engineering workflow and the dbt ecosystem

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Metadata
jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us


Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
​
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

 

About the Role

Fivetran and dbt Labs is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.
We're looking for a senior software engineer to join our Metadata team, which owns the metadata layer of the dbt platform — the discovery API, catalog, lineage, and run history services that let customers understand, trust, and act on what their data is doing.

You'll own the design and delivery of features end to end, working across high-throughput APIs and data models to make them faster, more reliable, and more capable. You'll write and review designs, raise the quality bar in code review, use the latest AI tools, and collaborate closely with product and QE to deliver work that scales.

Technologies You’ll Use

Python, Rust, GraphQL, Postgres, Snowflake, Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, GCP, Datadog

What You’ll Do

  • Design and implement features and performance improvements across the Metadata team's services — discovery API, catalog, lineage, and run history
  • Develop, maintain, and test high-quality, maintainable code, and optimize critical paths for performance
  • Write technical designs for feature-level work, actively seek feedback, and clearly explain the trade-offs of your decisions
  • Participate in and review technical designs and pull requests, providing constructive feedback to the team
  • Improve test coverage with comprehensive unit tests and refactor code to drive down tech debt
  • Troubleshoot and debug production issues, and follow up on incidents with post-mortems and mitigation plans
  • Break features into tasks, structure and execute your own project plans, and contribute to sprint and feature planning
  • Collaborate with product managers, QE, customer support, and peers to deliver the best product with high quality, performance, and scalability
  • Participate periodically in the on-call rotation, and be mindful of security throughout your work
  • Use AI tooling — IDE assistants like GitHub Copilot, coding agents like Claude Code, and conversational AI — to accelerate development and to author and review SDLC artifacts such as TDDs, PRDs, post-mortems, and test plans

 

Skills We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in the software industry with a passion for solving complex software engineering problems, including designing and building backend services and reusable components from the ground up
  • Experience working with distributed systems and cloud computing concepts
  • Demonstrated ability to write well-structured, performant, and well-tested code
  • Ability to independently lead feature-level software and design work that satisfies project requirements, and to clearly explain design trade-offs
  • Can identify design flaws in existing systems and propose improvements
  • Experience with code reviews, design, troubleshooting, and testing
  • Proficiency in a modern backend or systems language such as Python, Java, C++, or C#
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience with continuous integration tooling such as BuildKite, and familiarity with observability tools like Datadog or Grafana is a plus
  • Fluent in using AI code assistants and coding agents to generate and investigate code, and conversational AI (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT) to research, author, review, and synthesize SDLC artifacts

Bonus Skills​

  • Experience in data processing (ETL, ELT) and/or cloud-based data platforms
  • Experience building or working with metadata, catalog, lineage, or discovery/search systems
  • Experience with GraphQL APIs and high-throughput, multi-tenant data services
  • Familiarity with the analytics engineering workflow and the dbt ecosystem

jobs.description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.

As a Senior Strategic Program Lead on the Strategic Programs team within Customer Experience, you'll own the customer experience strategy for Coinbase's most critical onboarding journeys: identity verification, account recovery, login, and new-user KYC. This team sits at the intersection of Product and CX, focused on turning customer friction into prioritized product work and measurable improvements. You'll partner directly with Product, Engineering, and Design to influence roadmaps with customer-grounded data, making these first-impression moments seamless.

What you'll do:
  • Own the end-to-end CX strategy and program management for Identity and Onboarding, building and operationalizing long-term plans informed by customer feedback, contact rate analysis, business priorities and market trends.
  • Partner with Identity and Onboarding Product, Design, and Engineering teams to influence roadmaps, ensuring the experience from in-product flows through support is intentional and high-quality.
  • Build and maintain program scorecards tracking contact rates, CSAT, automation effectiveness, and quality guardrails, using them to frame product opportunities with clear impact sizing and prioritized recommendations.
  • Drive launch readiness for Identity and Onboarding product releases, ensuring sad path experiences are fully scoped in partnership with Product, determine instrumentation requirements for our operational teams and leverage AI to build and ship features.
  • Develop and implement strategies to optimize operations through an Eliminate, Automate, Optimize framework in close collaboration with Product, Operations, AI, and Analytics teams.
Required Skills and Experience:
  • 5+ years in product and/or program management, customer experience, or product operations at an enterprise-scale company.
  • Demonstrated ability to use data (contact rates, CSAT, retention metrics, opportunity sizing) to build business cases, influence product roadmaps across Identity, Onboarding, or similarly complex product domains and ship solutions using AI.
  • Track record of partnering with Product, Engineering, Design, and Analytics teams to deliver measurable customer outcomes, including defining KPIs, owning scorecards, and translating metric movements into clear narratives for leadership.
  • Experience leading launch readiness and program execution for broadly defined business objectives without pre-established solutions, including managing cross-functional dependencies across multiple product areas.
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable customer improvements in  efficiency, cost, and quality.

The ideal candidate is creative, operationally-minded, and has a sharp eye for aesthetics. You’ll be responsible for improving shared spaces, owning internal communications like the monthly Experience newsletter, and helping create environments where employees feel inspired and supported.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Support Spaceport Experience operations including onsite events, amenities, wellness activations, and engagement programming
  • Lead the creation and distribution of the monthly experience newsletter, managing content, formatting, and stakeholder coordination
  • Identify and execute improvements across employee-facing spaces, ensuring they are functional, inviting, and aligned with SpaceX’s design aesthetic
  • Support signage updates, space refreshes, and design-forward upgrades in collaboration with Facilities and Development teams
  • Monitor the quality and consistency of employee-facing services, resolving issues and upholding operational standards

jobs.title: Principal HR Business Partner (R&D)
jobs.description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. We're looking for a Principal People Success Partner (more commonly referred to as "HRBP") to serve as the strategic HR partner for Toast's R&D organization — a 2,000+ person community spanning Engineering, Product, and Design. You'll report directly to the Senior Director, PSP and operate as a true thought partner to senior leaders, helping shape how we build, develop, and sustain a world-class product and technology organization.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role for someone who excels at navigating organizational complexity, influencing without authority, and translating people strategy into practical outcomes. The right person is equally comfortable in a room with a SVP discussing org design as they are rolling up their sleeves on a calibration cycle or a difficult performance conversation.

 

Note to applicants: We are prioritizing candidates located near our hubs in Boston, New York City, Toronto, San Francisco, and Omaha. 

 

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

  • Partner with R&D SVPs, VPs and senior directors to design and evolve org structures that scale; Serve as a trusted advisor during reorgs and structural changes, helping leaders navigate people impacts with care and clarity.
  • Lead org design initiatives end-to-end: from diagnosing root causes through to stakeholder alignment, change communication, and implementation.
  • Drive consistent, high-quality performance calibrations across Engineering, PM, and Design — building leader capability and ensuring fair, differentiated outcomes.
  • Champion a culture of clear expectations and candid feedback; help leaders understand what "raising the bar" looks like in practice.
  • Cultivate an AI "Builder" approach by adopting and testing AI solutions to address challenges at scale.
  • Use engagement data, pulse surveys, and qualitative signals to surface org health risks and partner with leaders on action planning.
  • Serve as the R&D voice in the design and rollout of company-wide people programs — ensuring compensation cycles, leveling frameworks, and engagement initiatives land effectively.
  • Bring an analytical lens to your work — using data to shape decisions, measure outcomes, and tell a coherent story to senior stakeholders.



What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 10+ years of HR Business Partner experience.
  • Demonstrated expertise in org design — you've led restructuring initiatives, not just supported them.
  • Experience as a trusted partner to VP- and SVP-level leaders; you're known for your ability to influence and coach.
  • Strong analytical skills — comfortable using AI tools and working with employee data, engagement metrics, and headcount models to shape recommendations. 
  • Excellent judgment: you know when to push, when to listen, and when to escalate.
  • High EQ and the ability to build trust quickly across a diverse, technically-oriented workforce.
  • Experience at a high-growth SaaS or fintech company.
  • Experience supporting a globally distributed R&D org.

 

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.


Our Total Rewards Philosophy

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. jobs.title: Staff AI Research Engineer, Speech Recognition
jobs.description:
Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!

At Duolingo, you’ll join a team that cares about finding innovative solutions to complex technical problems, running countless experiments (300+ at a time!) with our massive user base to make data-driven decisions, and educating our users and employees alike. You’ll have limitless learning opportunities, mentorship and collaboration with world-class minds, and a variety of projects with large scopes — while doing work that’s both fun and meaningful. 

Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world.

About the role

We are looking for an experienced AI Research Engineer to join our Speech team. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record as an AI research engineer, with experience across various machine learning techniques, and a particular focus on speech modeling: ASR, TTS, speech-to-speech models, audio tokenization, and more. They will have experience at all levels of the ML stack, including feature engineering, developing training data, fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, benchmarks and evaluations, deployment, and monitoring. On the Speech team, we’re training custom models to understand the speech of non-native learners, working closely to support product teams working on features like Video Call and the learning path.

  You will...

  • Join a full-stack team of frontend, backend, and other AI Research engineers, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Contribute to the development and training of speech models and large-scale neural network models.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand their needs, to align the models’ outputs with company objectives.
  • Participate in and help drive strategic product and business decision making as a member of the Speech leadership group. 
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest developments in machine learning, particularly in speech models, and apply this knowledge to drive advancements in our projects.
  • Mentor team members, providing guidance and support in their professional development.
  • Ensure the delivery of high-quality, scalable, and efficient machine learning solutions.

 

  You have...

  • Proven experience as an AI research engineer, for example, in speech recognition, TTS, LLMs, or related fields.
  • Strong background in training and fine-tuning large models in an applied setting.
  • Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field with a focus on machine learning or artificial intelligence, or equivalent experience.
  • Excellent leadership and communication skills, with the ability to manage and inspire a team.
  • Deep understanding of machine learning concepts, frameworks, and best practices.

The offered salary is dependent upon several factors, including work experience, skills, and internal peer comparisons. The posted range is subject to change in the future. jobs.title: Launch Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience. 

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

The Launch Quality Engineer supports Quality activities for new vehicle programs at Lucid from product and process development through prototype, pilot, pre-production, Start of Production, and early ramp-up. The role coordinates cross-functional launch Quality deliverables, verifies readiness at key program milestones, supports greenfield plant and manufacturing-line readiness, and drives disciplined issue management. Working with Product Engineering, Program Management, Manufacturing, Manufacturing Quality, Supplier Quality, NPI, Incoming Quality, Logistics, and Operations, the engineer helps ensure vehicles, parts, processes, and Quality systems meet Lucid requirements and customer expectations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute the Launch Quality Plan for assigned vehicle systems, areas, or commodities, including APQP deliverables, Quality gates, readiness metrics, risks, and mitigation actions.
  • Track Quality deliverables from development through Start of Production and early ramp-up and identify gaps that could affect build readiness, vehicle Quality, timing, or customer protection.
  • Support prototype, pilot, and pre-production builds through build-event preparation, issue capture, containment, root cause analysis, corrective action, and effectiveness verification.
  • Coordinate cross-functional completion of design and manufacturing Quality deliverables, including APQP design reviews, DVPR, DFMEA/PFMEA, PPAP/LQP, process validation, Control Plans, inspection standards, measurement readiness, regulatory compliance requirements, and equipment qualification and validation.
  • Assess Clear-to-Build and Quality Operations readiness with Manufacturing, NPI, Manufacturing Quality, Incoming Quality, Supplier Quality, Logistics, Supply Chain, Manufacturing Engineering, and Operations.
  • Verify that new or changed parts, processes, tools, equipment, test systems, gages, work instructions, and reaction plans are validated and ready for launch.
  • Support installation, commissioning, qualification, and validation of production lines and equipment from a Quality-readiness perspective.
  • Develop and maintain launch-specific Quality procedures, launch Control Plans, inspection standards, sampling strategies, escalation paths, and safe-launch controls.
  • Monitor supplier part maturity, PPAP status, incoming Quality performance, and launch issues in coordination with Supplier Quality, Quality Engineering, and Incoming Quality.
  • Lead structured root cause analysis and corrective action for launch, ramp-up, end-of-line, in-station, audit, early field, and warranty issues affecting customer experience.
  • Maintain the launch issue-management process and Single Quality Agenda, ensuring clear ownership, due dates, escalation, supporting evidence, and closure criteria.
  • Track and analyze launch Quality KPIs and build data, identify trends and risks, and prepare concise status, performance, and escalation reports for program and plant leadership.
  • Facilitate cross-functional Quality reviews, maintain action tracking, and drive critical issues to timely closure.
  • Capture lessons learned, benchmarking insights, and process capability improvements and ensure they are integrated into future builds and programs.
  • Support a culture of accountability, collaboration, data-driven decision-making, built-in Quality, and continuous improvement.

Skills

  • Strong working knowledge of APQP, PPAP, DFMEA/PFMEA, DVPR, Control Plans, MSA, SPC, process validation, Quality gates, and structured problem-solving methods.
  • Ability to coordinate complex cross-functional launch deliverables and work effectively across Engineering, Program Management, Manufacturing, Supplier Quality, and plant teams.
  • Hands-on experience supporting vehicle builds, floor-based root cause and corrective action, interim containment, permanent corrective action, and effectiveness validation.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to use data, metrics, and risk assessments to prioritize issues and drive decisions.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering specifications, drawings, validation requirements, and manufacturing Quality documentation.
  • Excellent written, verbal, meeting-facilitation, technical-reporting, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Strong organizational, time-management, and prioritization skills with the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced launch environment.
  • Ability to work effectively within a matrixed, multicultural, and multi-time-zone organization.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and familiarity with PLM, MES, QMS, issue-management, and Quality-data systems.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • 3-5 years of experience in automotive product development, Launch Quality, Program Quality, or related operations.
  • Practical experience with APQP, PPAP, DFMEA/PFMEA, DVPR, Control Plans, process validation, issue management, and automotive Quality tools.
  • Ability to work on the manufacturing floor, support launch schedules and build events, and travel as required by program needs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting new vehicle launches, major product changes, manufacturing operations, or plant launches from pre-production through Start of Production and ramp-up.
  • Experience supporting prototype, pilot, or pre-production builds and driving cross-functional issue resolution.
  • Greenfield plant, EV manufacturing, or major plant expansion experience.
  • Working knowledge of vehicle systems and architecture with the ability to connect part-, system-, and vehicle-level Critical-to-Quality requirements.

Compensation & Benefits: Lucid offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays, paid sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan. Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off.  Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. Incentive and equity awards, if applicable, are determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

jobs.title: eCube Specialist
jobs.description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience. 

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

 

The Metrology Lead supports dimensional confirmation, monitoring, and Quality control for vehicle launch and series production at Lucid AMP-2. Reporting to the Sr. Dimensional Engineer, this role develops, validates, maintains, and monitors eCube measurement schedules and applications, correlates dimensional results with approved reference data, and translates dimensional trends into timely manufacturing feedback. The Metrology Lead works cross-functionally to ensure accurate measurement, effective dimensional monitoring, and timely response to conditions that could affect product or process Quality.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead by example through strict adherence to all Environmental Health and Safety requirements, including mandatory Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) based on workstation requirements.
  • Promote and maintain a safe, clean, and organized work environment in accordance with 6S standards, including support for routine audits and corrective actions.
  • Develop, configure, validate, and maintain eCube measurement applications, feature definitions, alignments, tolerances, and reporting outputs.
  • Validate eCube programs through nominal-data checks, feature verification, repeatability studies, and correlation.
  • Execute eCube measurement and Quality Control checks according to defined measurement plans and schedules.
  • Prepare and review measurement results and reports and communicate findings to cross-functional teams.
  • Manage eCube capacity against measurement requests, production requirements, and launch priorities.
  • Analyze dimensional data using Statistical Process Control (SPC), capability indices, trend analysis, and part or build traceability.
  • Support Quality investigations related to gap, flush, fit, alignment, geometry, sealing, Closures, Body-in-White (BIW), and Vehicle Assembly concerns.
  • Support Engineering Change Requests and supplier part validation through eCube processing and evaluation of initial samples.
  • Maintain program revision control, backups, naming conventions, measurement plans, reaction limits, and technical documentation.
  • Support equipment qualification, Measurement System Analysis (MSA), correlation studies, system-health checks, trial builds, safe launch activities, and engineering changes.
  • Develop dashboards and standardized reports for dimensional trends, process capability, alarms, top contributors, and action status.
  • Train users on eCube operation, data interpretation, reaction plans, and escalation requirements.
  • Maintain eCube equipment and ensure required verification and maintenance activities are completed in accordance with manufacturer recommendations.

Skills

  • Strong knowledge of dimensional metrology, GD&T, datum alignment, coordinate systems, SPC, MSA, and measurement correlation.
  • Hands-on experience with eCube or a comparable inline dimensional monitoring and analysis system.
  • Working knowledge of CMM, ScanBox or optical measurement systems, checking fixtures, master parts, and manual measurement methods.
  • Ability to interpret CAD models, engineering drawings, measurement plans, feature definitions, and automotive body geometry.
  • Understanding of Stamping, BIW, Closures, joining, Tooling, fixtures, and Vehicle Assembly processes.
  • Strong dimensional data analysis, visualization, technical documentation, and reporting skills.
  • Ability to interpret dimensional trends, identify abnormal conditions, and translate measurement results into actionable manufacturing feedback.
  • Strong cross-functional communication, collaboration, organization, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage measurement priorities and capacity in a fast-paced launch and production environment.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Metrology, or a related discipline.
  • 2-5 years of experience in dimensional engineering, metrology, inline measurement, automotive manufacturing Quality, or a related field.
  • Working knowledge of dimensional measurement principles, GD&T, data analysis, and measurement correlation.
  • Ability to support manufacturing-floor, launch, and production priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience developing, configuring, or maintaining eCube or comparable inline measurement applications.
  • Experience with CMM or optical measurement systems, correlation studies, MSA, SPC, and capability analysis.
  • Automotive Stamping, BIW, Closures, Tooling, or Vehicle Assembly experience.

Compensation & Benefits: Lucid offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays, paid sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan. Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off.  Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. Incentive and equity awards, if applicable, are determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.  

Equal Opportunity: At Lucid, we believe diversity strengthens everything we build. Lucid Motors is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing an inclusive workplace for all. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable state or federal laws and regulations. 

Accessibility: Lucid Motors is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need any accommodation to participate in the application process, please contact us at TA-Operations <@> lucidmotors.com. This email address is designated solely for accommodation requests and is not monitored for job applications or resume submissions. To be considered for employment, all applications must be submitted through the Lucid Motors Careers website.

Candidate Data Privacy: By submitting your application, you understand and agree that your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Life Sciences & Payer Sales Leader (U.S.)
jobs.description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers. 

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Life Sciences & Payers Sales Leader (U.S.)

Why We Have This Role

The U.S. Life Sciences & Payers Sales Leader will be responsible for defining and executing the growth strategy for these critical business segments. This leader will drive market expansion, deepen relationships with key enterprise accounts, and accelerate significant net-new Annual Contract Value (ACV) growth across highly complex and regulated healthcare organizations.

This executive will lead a high-performing team of frontline sales leaders and Enterprise Account Executives, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and results. Serving as the senior go-to-market leader for the segment, they will partner closely with Solution Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, Product, and Executive Leadership to deliver an integrated customer strategy that drives measurable business outcomes and long-term client value.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in the U.S. Life Sciences and Payers ecosystem, a proven track record of scaling enterprise sales organizations, and the ability to engage and influence C-suite stakeholders across some of the industry's most influential organizations.

How You’ll Find Success

You will define and execute the go-to-market strategy for one of Qualtrics' most strategic growth segments. Success in this role will be measured by your ability to drive predictable revenue growth, expand executive-level customer relationships, and build a high-performing organization that accelerates market leadership across the healthcare ecosystem.

  • Strategic Market Leadership: Develop and execute a comprehensive go-to-market strategy for the U.S. Life Sciences and Payers vertical, aligning regional priorities with global business objectives. Identify, prioritize, and penetrate high-value accounts and market segments to drive sustainable growth, increased market share, and long-term customer value.
  • Revenue Growth & Business Expansion: Own and exceed annual revenue goals across net-new ACV, expansion revenue, and renewals. Drive market expansion strategies that deepen customer adoption, increase platform utilization, and position Qualtrics as the leading Experience Management partner across payer and life sciences organizations.
  • Executive Selling & Complex Enterprise Execution: Lead a multi-product enterprise sales motion across complex buying centers and stakeholder groups. Navigate sophisticated procurement environments, build strong C-suite relationships, and demonstrate measurable business impact that positions Qualtrics as a strategic transformation partner.
  • Industry Expertise & Thought Leadership: Serve as a trusted advisor to customers and internal stakeholders by bringing deep knowledge of the U.S. Life Sciences & Payers ecosystem, including health plans, PBMs, pharmaceutical, and biotechnology organizations. Stay ahead of industry trends, regulatory developments, and emerging market opportunities to inform strategy and customer engagement.
  • Ecosystem & Partner Development: Build and strengthen strategic partnerships across healthcare consulting firms, systems integrators, technology providers, and industry influencers. Develop joint go-to-market initiatives that expand market reach, accelerate pipeline generation, and increase win rates.
  • People Leadership & Talent Development: Recruit, develop, and retain high-performing sales leaders and Enterprise Account Executives. Foster a culture of accountability, coaching, inclusion, and continuous improvement that drives strong employee engagement, career development, and consistent quota attainment.
  • Operational Excellence & Forecast Accuracy: Establish a disciplined operating rhythm built on data-driven decision-making, forecast accuracy, pipeline health, and performance management. Partner closely with Sales Operations to optimize territory planning, resource allocation, sales productivity, and business outcomes.
  • Cross-Functional Influence & Alignment: Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Solution Engineering teams to deliver a unified customer experience. Advocate for market needs, influence product strategy, and ensure successful customer adoption, retention, and expansion.
  • Customer-Centric Growth: Champion a customer-first approach that strengthens long-term relationships, drives executive sponsorship, and delivers measurable business outcomes. Ensure customers realize value from their Qualtrics investment while creating opportunities for strategic expansion and advocacy.
  • Culture & Organizational Impact: Model Qualtrics' leadership principles and values by fostering collaboration, transparency, innovation, and high performance. Inspire teams to achieve ambitious goals while building an environment where employees can do their best work.

Pivotal Expertise & Business Impact

  • Sales Complexity: Proven mastery of complex, enterprise-wide SaaS sales cycles involving multi-buyer consensus (C-suite, clinical, IT, HR) across large healthcare networks.
  • Ecosystem Expertise: Demonstrated ability to build, negotiate, and leverage partner ecosystem relationships to expand channel reach and co-sell enterprise deals.
  • Growth at Scale: History of leading enterprise sales teams through rapid scaling ($1B to $5B+ corporate trajectories), driving both strategic new-logo acquisition and land-and-expand account growth.
  • Operational Rigor: Exceptional operational discipline leveraging sales analytics, key performance indicators, and structured inspection mechanisms to drive reliable pipeline generation and accurate forecasting.
  • Leadership from the Front: Hands-on executive leader who engages directly in complex sales cycles, coaches teams through high-stakes negotiations, and acts as a force multiplier in key deals.
  • US Healthcare Domain Authority: Deep understanding of the U.S. Life Sciences and Payer ecosystem, including health plans, PBMs, pharmaceutical, and biotechnology organizations, as well as the regulatory environment, reimbursement models, market access strategies, and key executive stakeholders that influence purchasing decisions and strategic partnerships.

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume

  • Enterprise SaaS sales experience, with significant tenure dedicated to leading enterprise sales teams ideally selling directly into the US Life Sciences and/or Payers markets.
  • 2+ years of second-line executive sales leadership experience managing multi-layered teams (sales managers and enterprise account executives) preferred.
  • Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting or exceeding complex vertical revenue targets within rapidly scaling organizations ($1B to $5B+).
  • Expertise in direct selling methods as well as building and co-selling alongside strategic partner networks. 
  • Proven operational success in leading multi-product, enterprise software motions with long, complex decision-making cycles.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer, Marine Corp Vehicles
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril Ground Maneuver is the business line that brings Anduril's sensors, effectors, communications, command and control, and Lattice to military ground vehicles. Our work covers wheeled and tracked platforms, from light tactical vehicles to armored vehicles. Our customers range from Army and Marine Corps program offices to the units that operate these vehicles in the field.

We're hiring the lead systems engineer for a Marine Corps program of record built on Menace-X, Anduril's vehicle-mounted command and control system. You'll own systems engineering under contract, from award through production. You'll turn contract requirements into a design baseline and deliver the engineering data the contract calls for. You'll lead the technical content of formal reviews and show the government, through test and analysis, that the system meets the contract. You'll also run configuration control on the baseline as the design matures and moves into production.

You'll be the main technical contact for your government engineering counterparts and will spend time with them at reviews, test events and on site. You'll work closely with mechanical, electrical, software and test engineers, and with the division's safety, reliability and cybersecurity engineers. Experience on a vehicle program of record is valuable in this role. You'll report to the Ground Maneuver Chief Engineer and work day to day with the program lead.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own systems engineering on the program from contract award through production.
  • Break contract requirements down into system and subsystem requirements, and maintain the requirements verification traceability matrix.
  • Plan and deliver the engineering data the contract requires (CDRLs), including the systems engineering plan, ICDs, test plans and test reports.
  • Lead the technical content of formal reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR and production readiness reviews), and close out the actions they produce.
  • Run configuration management: own the technical baseline, chair or support the change control board, and support configuration audits.
  • Plan and run verification against the contract, and support government developmental and operational testing.
  • Act as the main technical contact for government engineering counterparts.
  • Coordinate the division's shared safety, reliability and cybersecurity engineers to meet the program's safety release, reliability and cybersecurity requirements.
  • Track and manage technical risk with the program lead and chief engineer.
  • Prepare the design for production with manufacturing and supply chain.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • B.S. in Electrical, Mechanical, Systems or Aerospace Engineering, or a related field
  • 7+ years of systems engineering experience, including leading systems engineering on a DoD program under contract
  • Experience delivering CDRLs to a government customer and leading formal design reviews
  • Experience with configuration management and change control on a contracted baseline
  • Experience planning and running verification for government acceptance, including developmental or operational testing
  • Familiarity with MIL-STD-882E, MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-810 and MIL-STD-1275
  • Comfortable as the technical face of a program to a government customer
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to travel up to 25% for test events and customer sites
  • Must hold an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience on Marine Corps programs or with Marine Corps Systems Command
  • Experience with vehicle-mounted command and control, communications or networking systems
  • Experience taking a program from development into production
  • Familiarity with Risk Management Framework and getting a system authorized to operate
  • Familiarity with earned value management
  • Experience with Cameo or another SysML tool
  • Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. Top Secret security clearance
US Salary Range
$167,000—$194,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

 

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. 

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

 

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.
