jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About SimpliSafe

We’re a high-tech home security company that’s passionate about protecting the life you’ve built and our mission of keeping Every Home Secure. And we’ve created a culture here that cares just as deeply about the career you’re building. Ours is a no ego culture of collaboration and innovation where those seeking their next challenge can find big opportunities and make a huge impact on the lives of all those who we protect. We don’t just want you to work here. We want you to grow and thrive here.

We’re embracing a hybrid work model that enables our teams to split their time between office and home. Hybrid for us means we expect our teams to come together in our state-of-the-art office on two core days, typically Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday – working together in person and choosing where they work for the remainder of the week. We all benefit from flexibility and get to use the best of both worlds to get our work done.

Why are we hiring?

Well, we’re growing and thriving. So, we need smart, talented, and humble people who share our values to join us as we disrupt the home security space and relentlessly pursue our mission of keeping Every Home Secure.

The Device Connectivity team owns the cloud services that every SimpliSafe base station and camera connects to. We’re modernizing those services, moving device messaging onto a new event-streaming platform, and building the connectivity for our next generation of devices. All of this has to stay reliable through our busiest seasonal peaks.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and operate the C++ and Go services that provide secure, reliable connections between the cloud and SimpliSafe devices and route their messages to the rest of our platform
  • Contribute to the shared libraries our services are built on, including metrics, tracing, logging, authentication, and concurrency primitives
  • Lead engineering projects end to end, from design doc through staged rollout, zero-downtime production cutover and decommissioning (for example EC2 to Kubernetes, OS upgrades, CI/CD platform changes)
  • Help move device messaging onto an event-streaming platform, including a shared event format, schemas and code generation, and load testing
  • Build cloud-side connectivity for next-generation devices, including new device capabilities, device provisioning, and certificate management
  • Design for reliability at peak load: connection limits, load shedding, connection draining, graceful shutdown, pre-scaling, and multi-region architecture. 
  • Own observability for the services you work on: distributed tracing, metrics, crash detection, and dashboards and alerts managed as code
  • Debug hard production problems across services and AWS infrastructure, lead root-cause analyses, and see the follow-up work through
  • Write design documents, review designs from other teams, and work with other engineering teams on features that span devices and the cloud
  • Keep services secure and current: certificates and CAs, least-privilege IAM, network policy, fixing security scan findings, and regular releases and dependency updates

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience
  • Very comfortable with AWS (EKS, load balancers, Lambda, SQS, S3, IAM), ideally including IoT Core (MQTT, rules, device certificates), or a similar cloud provider
  • Experience managing infrastructure as code with Terraform or OpenTofu
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, ideally with GitHub Actions
  • Experience debugging production systems with traces, metrics, and logs (for example OpenTelemetry and Prometheus-style metrics), and leading root-cause analyses
  • A track record of leading a migration or large project from design doc through production cutover, and of setting a direction other engineers can follow
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Nice to have

  • Strong production experience in modern C++ and/or Go, including async I/O and concurrency
  • Hands-on experience running production services on Kubernetes.
  • Experience with event-streaming platforms such as Kafka or Pulsar, and with schema formats such as Avro or JSON Schema
  • IoT or embedded-adjacent experience, such as device provisioning, PKI for device fleets, or MQTT-based device protocols
  • C++ build and library ecosystem experience, such as CMake, Conan.
  • Experience with Redis in production
  • Experience building networked services that manage many long-lived TCP/TLS connections, including mutual TLS, backpressure, TLS termination
  • Experience writing automated integration and end-to-end tests in Python

What Values You’ll Share

  • Customer Obsessed - Building deep empathy for our customers, putting them at the core of our work, and developing strong, long-term relationships with them.
  • Aim High - Always challenging ourselves and others to raise the bar.
  • No Ego - Maintaining a “no job too small” attitude, and an open, inclusive and humble style.
  • One Team - Taking a highly collaborative approach to achieving success.
  • Lift As We Climb - Investing in developing others and helping others around us succeed.
  • Lean & Nimble - Working with agility and efficiency to experiment in an often ambiguous environment.

What We Offer

  • A mission- and values-driven culture and a safe, inclusive environment where you can build, grow and thrive  
  • A comprehensive total rewards package that supports your wellness and provides security for SimpliSafers and their families (For more information on our total rewards please click here)
  • Free SimpliSafe system and professional monitoring for your home. 
  • Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that bring people together, give opportunities to network, mentor and develop, and advocate for change.

The target annual base pay range for this role is $117,300 - $156,400.

This target annual base pay range represents our good-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role. We use a market-based compensation approach to set our target annual base pay ranges and make adjustments annually. We carefully tailor individual compensation packages, including base pay, taking into consideration employees’ job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and other relevant business factors. 

Beyond base pay, we offer a Total Rewards package that may include participation in our annual bonus program, equity, and other forms of compensation, in addition to a full range of medical, retirement, and lifestyle benefits. More details can be found here.

We’re committed to fair and equitable pay practices, as well as pay transparency. We regularly review our programs to ensure they remain competitive and aligned with our values.

We wholeheartedly embrace and actively seek applications from all individuals, no matter how they identify. We are committed to cultivating a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we believe our work is enriched when we incorporate a multitude of perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences. We want everyone who works here to thrive and contribute to not only our mission of keeping every home secure, but also to making our workplace safe and supportive for others. If a reasonable accommodation may be needed to fully participate in the job application or interview process, to perform the essential functions of a position, or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact careers@simplisafe.com.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Space Special Programs
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM 

In the Space Special Programs team, we build spacecraft and space systems which serve a wide variety of functions in the space architecture. At a time when space superiority can no longer be taken for granted and with space systems proliferating at an incredible rate, the Space Special Programs team provides advanced, mission critical capabilities to our customer base to be able to more effectively operate and survive within this expanding environment with limited personnel. Working across product, engineering, sales, logistics, operations, and mission success, the Space Special Programs team develops, tests, deploys, and operates new, unique, space capabilities to drive mission success in challenging operational environments. 

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our rapidly growing team in Chantilly, VA. In this role, you will be responsible for implementation of the full lifecycle of flight software, ground test software, ground station software at both embedded and application levels. You will work closely with senior engineers to develop software systems across the full range of embedded, host, communication, data storage, computer vision, FPGA-interfacing, and algorithm implementation tasks. You are expected to be a strong individual contributor on the team. Your work will span capabilities including deeply embedded software design, implementation, and debugging, including data protocols, RF communication, machine learning, computer vision, and implementing control algorithms in a computationally-restricted environment; host side software for user interfaces, equipment interfaces, machine-to-machine communication, data analysis, display, compression and extraction to human-useable forms; and interfacing with existing Command and Control software and databases to integrate the spacecraft systems in a simple fashion. The embedded tasking will also include writing code to operate at the intersection of hardware, FPGA, and software. Additionally, you will contribute to system and mission designs & concepts, and have opportunities to learn from and collaborate with experienced team members.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

  • Work with a cross-functional team to design market leading hardware-based products 
  • Drive product maturity through rapid prototyping, design verification, and qualification activities 
  • Apply modern space-flight software design standards and guidelines (e.g. fault detection and recovery, error checking, data redundancy, etc.) to create high-reliability, highly manufacturable systems, and a team which implements them. 
  • Design and develop flight, ground, and payload systems to implement the given mission requirements, and effectively communicate these goals and specific tasks to your team
  • Operate as a member of your team and a resource for them when they are stuck 
  • Understand the mission needs and effectively translate them into software products that are both efficient in implementing but are generic enough to be ultra-reusable for lowest cost future development 
  • Help establishing internal guidelines and best practices for space flight software design, test, manufacture, and operations 
  • Conduct peer-level and cross-discipline design reviews and develop customer-facing system design documentation and presentations 
  • Help drive development, integration and test activities to meet schedule 
  • Work in a fast-paced environment, having to juggle multiple concurrent projects and customers 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, electrical / computer engineering, or similar engineering or technical field 
  • 3-4+ years Software Engineering Experience directly developing a combination of embedded, host, and product-specific software 
  • Experience developing subsystem requirements and interfaces; including mission systems and developing software architectures to meet those requirements with reusable software. 
  • Experience writing embedded C code, device drivers, and implementing algorithms with limited computational & storage resources 
  • Experience writing host level code for GUI, database interaction, and protocol interfaces/translators needed for interfacing different parts of spacecraft systems together (in both cases of having an explicit ICD and having very little information) 
  • Experience on mature spacecraft development programs including operational and environmental testing. 
  • Experience developing various design artifacts, such as: Design Review material (CoDR, SDR, PDR, CDR, TRR, etc), design notes, and other documentation to help assure a team of engineers understands the algorithms and intent of the software they are implementing 
  • Outstanding communication skills to include presentation of developed artifacts 
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen and able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Top Secret security clearance 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

  • M.S. in aerospace, mechanical, computer science or similar engineering or technical field

jobs.title: General Manager, Collibra Public Sector
jobs.description:
Collibra is the Enterprise AI Control Plane. Built over eighteen years of meta-data and ontology engineering, Collibra governs context and control across any data storage system, AI model, and AI agent.  Collibra delivers clarity and context to AI leaders who need data certainty at the speed of AI. A 5x Forrester Wave Leader and 2x Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader, Collibra serves more than 700 customers, including 78 of the Fortune 500, and governs more than 2 billion assets.

Collibra Public Sector LLC is the purpose-built subsidiary that serves US federal government agencies and the Defense Industrial Base. Collibra Public Sector is a FOCI-mitigated entity with a DCSA facility clearance. Collibra Public Sector personnel service clients in some of the most demanding mission organizations. Collibra Public Sector products, people and partners are uniquely positioned to deliver software and services solutions to the US federal market.

Join Collibra Public Sector

Collibra is looking for a proven General Manager to create and execute the overall business strategy to achieve long-term profitable growth that outpaces competitors and peers. Responsibilities include recruiting and leading a high-performing team that integrates sales, consulting services, support, legal, operations, marketing, product management, and product delivery. The General Manager will set the direction for the subsidiary to comply with government-required mandates such as CMMC. The General Manager will identify untapped market areas and build plans to capture those opportunities.

Successful outcomes

  • Operate as a true GM leading sales, services, support that aligns parent-company dependencies into a single, accountable operating rhythm
  • Optimize post-sales execution by driving consistent deployments, adoption, and renewal readiness across Public Sector accounts
  • Manage overall expense to revenue targets
  • Spend the company’s money wisely to invest in new opportunities
  • Work closely with the parent to drive the overall Public Sector product roadmap and align any support needed from the shared services teams
  • Maintain positive evaluations from relevant government agencies such as DCSA

Characteristics

  • Demonstrated ability to manage directly and delegate effectively across all areas of responsibilities
  • Create a culture of trust and accountability within Collibra Public Sector
  • Know when to build consensus and when to maintain autonomy
  • Bold risk-taking based on deep understanding of complex data
  • Politically astute when dealing with diverse stakeholders and conflicting demands

Experience

  • Experience managing a complete public sector subsidiary within a larger organization
  • Extended positions with increasing levels of responsibilities within enterprise software companies
  • Successful execution of business transformations and realignments
  • Bachelor’s degree required, MBA preferred

 

Benefits at Collibra

Collibra recognizes and values that everyone has different needs, interests, and life goals. We built our benefits program with flexibility in mind to support you and your loved ones through a diverse range of circumstances and life events. These flexible offerings sit on a foundation of competitive compensation, health coverage, and time off. Learn more about Collibra’s benefits.

We create inclusion and belonging through how we onboard, meet, connect, engage, and communicate. Learn more about diversity, equity, and inclusion at Collibra.

At Collibra, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We realize the key to creating a company with a world-class culture and employee experience comes from who we hire and creating a workplace that celebrates everyone.

jobs.title: Lead Engineer, Applied AI (Customer Agent)
jobs.description:
At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit klaviyo.com/careers to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.

Lead Engineer, Applied AI (Customer Agent)

About the Team:

Our Engineering team builds the AI systems that power how brands run their businesses on Klaviyo. We move fast, ship in production, and hold a high bar for what "AI-native" actually means: systems that make real judgment calls, not demos.

The Customer Agent team is one of the newest and most ambitious groups in that org, based in Boston and working in-office: we're building a conversational AI system that lets brands serve their own customers at a scale no human support team could match. We're still small enough that one engineer’s work visibly shapes how the whole platform evolves. We're past the demo stage: the team ships changes against live customer traffic, measures quality with real evaluation frameworks, and treats reliability as a product feature, not an afterthought.

About the Role:

As Lead Engineer, you'll set the technical and product direction for a core area of Customer Agent end to end, building a 0-to-1 agentic product with the speed and ownership of a startup, backed by the scale and resources of one of the most innovative tech companies on the East Coast, while staying hands-on with the hardest problems yourself. This is a lead role, with a wide footprint across our agentic product - from orchestration to governance - that grows based on where the product is when you join. We're looking for an engineer who owns complex, ambiguous problems, who has built, scaled, and supported a production agentic system through everything that comes after the demo, and who up-levels the people, process, and technology around them.

How You'll Make an Impact:

  • Set the technical and product direction for a core area of Customer Agent, from architecture through production, and contribute to the direction of the platform overall.
  • Take on the hardest technical problems in your area: orchestration, evaluation, guardrails, memory & context, failure handling for non-deterministic systems.
  • Write and ship code, review designs, and make the hard calls in your area when there’s no obvious right answer.
  • Define patterns that other engineers adopt, and mentor through design reviews rather than direct management.
  • Partner with product, design, data science, and go-to-market leaders to shape what gets built, not just how it’s built.
  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies and bring the ones worth betting on into production.

What We're Looking For:

  • You've built, scaled, and supported production agentic systems, not just prototyped them: real orchestration, evals, guardrails, and non-deterministic failure handling. You've owned your part of one through launch, incidents, and the operational reality after the demo.
  • You've learned the hard lessons that only come from running agents in production: securing them against misuse and abuse, and the operational scar tissue of keeping a non-deterministic system reliable as usage grows.
  • You've owned technical and product direction for a significant area before, not just your own component, and you can point to something you designed and championed that shipped and that other engineers built on.
  • You're hands-on: writing code, reviewing your own and others’ architecture decisions, and debugging production issues yourself, not delegating the hardest problems away.
  • Your patterns and designs are reused by other engineers, and you've unblocked many others’ projects, not just your own.
  • You communicate complex technical trade-offs clearly across engineering and product audiences, and you can turn an undefined problem into a plan others rally behind.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience working on a multi-tenant agent platform at production scale, where external customers configure their own agent behavior on shared infrastructure.
  • Experience building 0-to-1 products or working in startup environments.
  • A track record with production evaluation systems, AI observability, or human-in-the-loop workflows for LLM-powered products.

Boston, MA - In-Office Role

-

Massachusetts Applicants:
It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Our salary range reflects the cost of labor across various U.S. geographic markets. The range displayed below reflects the minimum and maximum target salaries for the position across all our US locations. The base salary offered for this position is determined by several factors, including the applicant’s job-related skills, relevant experience, education or training, and work location.

In addition to base salary, our total compensation package may include participation in the company’s annual cash bonus plan, variable compensation (OTE) for sales and customer success roles, equity, sign-on payments, and a comprehensive range of health, welfare, and wellbeing benefits based on eligibility. 

Your recruiter can provide more details about the specific salary/OTE range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

Base Pay Range For US Locations:
$176,000—$264,000 USD

This role may require up to 10% travel for purposes such as new hire onboarding, client or partner work if applicable, team meetings, and industry events. Travel is coordinated in advance.

Get to Know Klaviyo

We’re Klaviyo (pronounced clay-vee-oh). We empower creators to own their destiny by making first-party data accessible and actionable like never before. We see limitless potential for the technology we’re developing to nurture personalized experiences in ecommerce and beyond. To reach our goals, we need our own crew of remarkable creators—ambitious and collaborative teammates who stay focused on our north star: delighting our customers. If you’re ready to do the best work of your career, where you’ll be welcomed as your whole self from day one and supported with generous benefits, we hope you’ll join us.

AI fluency at Klaviyo includes responsible use of AI (including privacy, security, bias awareness, and human-in-the-loop). We provide accommodations as needed.

jobs.title: Lot Assistant - ADESA Cicero
jobs.description:
Pay range: $18-$20 hourly

Schedule: Monday - Thursday 8:00am-4:30pm; Friday 9:00am-3:00pm

About Us

ADESA, a Carvana-owned company, currently operates in over 50 locations throughout the US. Our auto auctions, some up to 200 acres, provide a wide array of vehicle services, including repair, reconditioning, and auction remarketing, and many of our sites serve as market hub distribution centers. Our inventory comprises hundreds of thousands of vehicles across North America, from retail to commercial, OEM & more.

We work in a service industry and embrace a “we” versus “I” culture – help others, and they will help you. Our industry is fun, fast-paced, and competitive – and filled with the best people who are passionate about what they do.

We’re excited about the future! As an industry leader, ADESA is poised for a multi-year expansion, including huge investments in facilities, massive sales growth, and an ever-increasing inventory of vehicles! We are looking for great people who want to take this journey with us! Get a sneak peek into life at ADESA!

Role and Team

  • Reporting to the Lead Lot Operations or other designated manager, you will assist with outside functions to support lot movements and general operations before, during, and after sale day. In this role, you will assist on the lot, including driving the service truck, lot tow truck (non-DOT), and forklift, to ultimately maintain accurate inventory flow and ensure vehicle readiness. 

Responsibilities

  • Lot Operations Support: Support lot operations by preparing and staging vehicles for sale, including stickering (run and customer stickers), marking vehicles on the spot, moving vehicles using a lot tow truck or forklift, and operating the service truck to support the driver team.
  • Inventory Accuracy: Scan the lot and use electronic devices to record the movement of vehicles on the property.
  • Vehicle Readiness: Assist with vehicle readiness tasks such as jumping vehicles and adding fluids (gas, water, etc), adding air to tires, and verifying vehicle status while maintaining accurate lot organization.
  • Property Management: Handle the removal of personal property from vehicles.
  • Operational Flow: Communicate with shop and operations teams to ensure an efficient flow of inventory from vehicle check-in to the auction sale line.
  • Customer & Admin Support: Provide customer service support and coordinate with administrative teams to ensure efficient execution of sale day activities.
  • Vehicle Identification: Confirm vehicle mileage, make year, and VIN to ensure accurate record-keeping.
  • Safety & Maintenance: Maintain work areas to ensure a safe environment and report any incidents or hazards to the designated manager.
  • General Duties: Perform any other duties assigned by the designated manager.

Skills and Attributes

  • Teamwork: A team player who can collaborate well with multiple departments, customers, and vendors.
  • Customer Focus: Strong customer service skills.
  • Detail-Oriented: Proven ability to multitask while maintaining strict attention to detail.
  • Efficiency: Proven ability to manage deliverables and metrics against aggressive targets and timelines.
  • Adaptability: Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle outside conditions.
  • Communication: Effective interpersonal skills with excellent verbal and written communication.

Qualifications

  • High School diploma or GED preferred
  • Must be 18 years of age and have a valid driver’s license that meets the requirements
  • Able to safely drive a variety of vehicle makes, models, and sizes, including tow trucks, forklifts, and the service truck
  • Automotive or auction experience preferred
  • Proficiency with computer systems and applications
  • Obtain and maintain forklift certification

ADESA Values

  • Our Next Customer May Be Your Mom: Every customer deserves the same level of care and respect one would give to their own mother.
  • We’re All in This Together: The company is unified by the shared goal of providing fantastic customer experiences, achieved through mutual trust, respect, and understanding.
  • There Are No Sidelines: Employees are encouraged to be proactive, work hard, and take ownership of what needs to be done in a fast-paced environment.
  • Be Brave: Employees should not fear taking risks, pushing themselves outside their comfort zones, or being decisive, even if they stumble along the way.
  • Zag Forward: The company empowers creative and passionate thinking to find meaningful ways to be different and deliver amazing experiences.
  • Don’t Be a Richard: A simple guiding principle to act appropriately and professionally.
  • Stay Scrappy: This value rejects mediocrity and "good enough," pushing employees to do more with less to pass savings on to customers.

ADESA Benefits and Perks

Competitive Pay | Quality Benefits | Holiday and Paid Time Off | Education and Equipment Reimbursement Programs | Matching 401(k) | Career Path Opportunities | And More!

Other Requirements

To be able to do your job at ADESA, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you. Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs. 

  • The physical activity requirements of the position range from Light to Medium Physical Work. 
    • Constant - standing, watching, touching, listening, walking, talking
    • Frequent - bending, stooping, kneeling, lifting, grasping, pushing, pulling
    • Potential – running, jumping, yelling, or other rapid or forceful movement in emergencies
  • Visual acuity requirements include color, depth perception, and field of vision comparable to definitions for Clerical, Administrative, and Machine Operators (including inspection) positions. 

Physical Working Conditions

This position is subject to both inside and outside environmental working conditions, including temperature changes, outside weather conditions, slightly elevated ambient noise levels, and minor atmospheric conditions affecting skin or respiratory systems, such as fumes, odors, and dust associated with internal and external service station/convenience food and petroleum dispensing operations.

To be able to do your job at ADESA, you must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English. Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

Legal Stuff

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check.  This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

ADESA is an equal employment opportunity employer.  All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.  ADESA also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Growth team’s mission is to drive the expansion of Robinhood's premium and high-value user segments. We focus on optimizing our web presence, funnel experiences, and custom landing pages to acquire and retain highly active customers. jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer, Space Special Programs
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM 

In the Space Special Programs team, we build spacecraft and space systems which serve a wide variety of functions in the space architecture. At a time when space superiority can no longer be taken for granted and with space systems proliferating at an incredible rate, the Space Special Programs team provides advanced, mission critical capabilities to our customer base to be able to more effectively operate and survive within this expanding environment with limited personnel. Working across product, engineering, sales, logistics, operations, and mission success, the Space Special Programs team develops, tests, deploys, and operates new, unique, space capabilities to drive mission success in challenging operational environments. 

ABOUT THE JOB 

We are looking for Mechanical Engineers to join our rapidly growing team in Chantilly, VA. In this role, you will be responsible for portions of the full cycle design for spacecraft and associated systems including deriving requirements, 3D CAD, modelling (structural, thermal, dynamic, etc), materials selection, supervision of fabrication, initial assembly, test, debug and integration with the system. The designs include deployment mechanisms for spacecraft and subsystems (such as antennas, solar panels, etc), as well as boxes, structures, pressure vessels, and the like. All of these components require rigorous testing including vibration, shock, thermal vacuum, thermal, etc and must be developed to work with very tight tolerances, since the space vehicles themselves are fairly small. The design work also includes designing, building, and testing the MGSE required to integrate, assemble, and test the spacecraft, ultimately in a high-rate manufacturing environment. The engineering team as a whole must span the capabilities of structural, thermal, and dynamic analysis, structure design for spacecraft, spacecraft dispensers, and other components, 3D CAD for all of these designs, design for fabrication and manufacture, as well as building prototypes, flight articles, and taking them through full qualification or acceptance test campaigns. The complement of individuals on the team will be adjusted so that the entire team functions well across all of these areas, with roles that are more analysis-focused, and roles that are more hands-on focused.  

WHAT YOU’LL DO 

  • Work with a cross-functional team to design market leading space flight hardware and associated ground equipment products 
  • Implement product components through rapid prototyping, design verification, and space qualification activities 
  • Learn and apply modern space-flight hardware design standards and guidelines to create high-reliability, highly manufacturable assemblies 
  • Implement a variety of structural components and mechatronics, with associated environmental testing to assure robustness in the context of the various missions as well as to characterize performance envelopes of the hardware 
  • Use rapid prototyping, 3D printing, and hands-on machining as appropriate to iterate quickly and allow for creative “outside-the-box" thinking 
  • Participate in peer-level and cross-discipline design reviews and collaborate with other MEs on your team to improve everyone’s capabilities 
  • Root cause investigation data collection and analysis in support of production operations 
  • Work in a fast-paced environment, having to juggle multiple concurrent projects and changing delivery timelines 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 

  • B.S. in mechanical or aerospace engineering or similar engineering or technical field  
  • 3-8 years of professional experience, in hardware product development 
  • Basic understanding of PCB Layout requirements to meet space flight mechanical, and manufacturing requirements 
  • Experience in ground-up system design and any 3-D CAD  
  • Hands-on assembly, prototyping, testing, and performance characterization of mechanisms designed for 0g but in a 1g environment. 
  • Experience designing and building very small mechanisms, components, and systems.  
  • Familiarity with launch environments, testing for launch environments, range safety, and system integration efforts 
  • Demonstrated creativity and “out of the box thinking” for spacecraft mechanisms with an eye toward simplicity and reliability 
  • Ability to determine manage work assignments based on prioritized direction from management, near-term goals, and day-to-day levels of progress 
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively with others 
  • Ability to work within our company and team culture and take ownership of the tasks assigned to you 
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen and able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Top Secret security clearance

We partner with Global Partnerships, Developer & Platform Solutions, Corporate Strategy, Ad Solutions, Data Science, AdTech, Marketing, and Procurement to structure and close the deals that bring games, creators, and brands to Discord's community. As Associate Commercial Counsel, you'll be a key advisor for integrating Discord's social features into games, enabling in-game commerce and digital collectibles, and building new monetization models alongside some of the biggest names in gaming and entertainment. You will also support our marketing and events teams on creative endeavors that promote Discord in the industry and to users. You'll handle a high volume of deals with real ownership, and you'll help shape how Discord approaches new partnership types at scale. jobs.description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

More broadly, Discord is about empowering people to find belonging in all kinds of communities, and those people trust us to keep their communications safe. Our Platform Security Engineering team protects the systems we use to create Discord, making the "secure way" the "easy way."

We're looking for a Senior Engineer to advance this mission through security expertise, software development, and operational excellence, with a particular focus on identity and access management: who and what can access Discord's systems, how they authenticate, and how access stays scoped to what's actually needed. You'll help identify leveraged opportunities to reduce security risk across Engineering, then design and deliver technical solutions: lovable "paved paths" for managing identities and access, shipping code, configuring cloud infrastructure, and operating services.

If you're a security engineer with a deep interest in identity and access management, who's eager to own technically and socially complex projects, and excited to improve security and privacy at Discord, read on!

This position is based in our San Francisco office. For this role, the Hiring Manager would like folks to be in the office 1-2 days a week.

What you'll do

  • Own software engineering projects end-to-end on a highly autonomous, horizontally integrated team with a lot of leverage. This is a code-forward role!
  • Define what identity means for autonomous agents and other non-human actors at Discord (how they're provisioned, scoped, authenticated, authorized, and audited). As the role of these actors grows, and create primitives to implement that vision.
  • Build and evolve Access, Discord's employee authorization platform, to make permissions discoverable, role-based, least privilege, and self-serve; check out our blog post to learn more!
  • Design and harden our Zero Trust architecture, spanning human and service-to-service auth*n for Discord’s internal tooling.
  • Automate continuous permission right-sizing in the spirit of least privilege.
  • Develop and apply secure baselines for cloud identity, and help secure our software supply chain from the dev environment through CI/CD and into production.
  • Consult on risk assessments, architectural designs, threat models, code reviews, and more, pragmatically balancing security with other business considerations.

Example projects

  • Integrate service-to-service and agent-to-service authentication and authorization as out-of-the-box features in Discord's internal developer platform.
  • Build out service identity provisioning using PKI and mTLS, so services can authenticate each other without shared secrets.
  • Evaluate or extend infrastructure access tooling such as Teleport for short-lived, auditable access to hosts, databases, and internal systems.
  • Improve how secrets are issued, rotated, and scoped across our infrastructure.

What we look for

  • 5+ years of experience building and operating production systems or infrastructure
  • 3+ years of experience writing software in a general-purpose programming language (we mainly use Python, TypeScript, and Rust)
  • 3+ years of experience securing systems with millions of users
  • Experience building or operating identity and access management systems: authentication, authorization, or access control at scale
  • Understanding of modern authentication and authorization concepts (e.g. RBAC, OAuth, OIDC, SSO, Zero Trust network architectures, mTLS, cloud IAM)
  • Experience building in and securing multi-cloud environments (e.g. GCP, Cloudflare, AWS)
  • Experience designing and building software for customers (internal or external) beyond your immediate team

Bonus points if you have…

  • Experience defining and orchestrating containers (e.g. via Kubernetes, Docker, Distroless, OCI)
  • Familiarity with build and CI/CD technologies (e.g. Terraform, Bazel, Buildkite)
  • Provisioned or managed service and workload identity using PKI, including issuing and operating mTLS between services
  • Experience with Zero Trust platforms such as Cloudflare Access and Teleport, for auditable access to apps, hosts, and internal systems
  • Experience with secrets management systems (e.g. Vault, or a cloud KMS or secrets manager), including rotation and least-privilege access to secrets
  • Developed and debugged distributed systems atop GCP, Cloudflare, and/or AWS
  • Led complex migrations or risk management programs across an engineering organization
  • Built or operated a service mesh (e.g. Envoy, Istio)
  • Managed and secured VMs or bare-metal hosts (e.g. Linux, Salt)
  • Practices to discover industry tools and knowledge that can multiply your team's impact

jobs.description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

We're looking for talented Senior Software Engineers to join our Consumer Revenue squads, the teams at the heart of premium experiences at Discord. You’ll be building out a premium Discord for millions of subscribers, focusing on surfaces such as Nitro, shop, boosting, user identity, and more. Your work will be vital in delivering a high-value premium experience, without compromising the core experience for our free users. You’ll be a key driver in generating the revenue that fuels Discord’s mission.

In this product engineering role, you'll collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Data Science, Design, Marketing, and other functions to create best-in-class consumer experiences. Your work will cover the full breadth of the technical stack, from backend data modeling, through business logic in APIs, to polished, user-facing interfaces. You’ll be supported by infrastructure, platform, and product teams on your mission to build the best premium Discord.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Build and improve premium Discord experiences such as Nitro, shop, boosting, user identity, and more.
  • Own projects end to end by partnering with Product to refine requirements, create technical specs, and work closely with Design to execute and deliver best-in-class user experiences.
  • Work with a team of full-stack engineers to ship new features across Web, Android, and iOS.
  • Lead complex initiatives from conception to completion, thriving in ambiguous environments.
  • Rapidly prototype new features and synthesize insights through experimentation.

What you should have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience. You’re a key technical contributor to your team and have led sizable projects which have had a big impact on your team’s roadmap.
  • Full-stack proficiency. You are an expert in React/React Native with a solid grasp of Python backend development. We work primarily in the web (React, TypeScript), mobile (React Native, with a small amount of Kotlin, Objective-C, and Swift), and backend (Python).
  • Product sense. You maintain a high degree of empathy for your internal and external users, and seek feedback from them about your work. You have an eye for what changes can bring a product from good to great.
  • Ownership mentality. You thrive with autonomy, take initiative to drive projects forward, and are comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Pragmatic approach. You find incremental approaches to solving complex problems, enjoy rapidly prototyping solutions, value your autonomy and operate with high integrity.
  • Performance-focused mindset. You have a solid understanding of React performance and client-server performance optimization, and a commitment to maintaining high-performance standards.
  • Growth mindset. You view challenges and mistakes as learning opportunities while building upon your successes. You push yourself and those around you to continuously improve.

Bonus Points

  • Experience working on teams focused on growth, particularly in revenue generation, product monetization, or user engagement systems
  • Strong track record of driving measurable impact through experimentation and data-driven decision making
  • Demonstrated success in attracting new users, driving engagement, sustaining long-term retention, and optimizing consumer-facing features
  • Experience with performance optimization at scale, particularly for consumer-facing applications
  • Interest or passion for the Discord platform

Candidates must reside in or be willing to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area (Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, Napa, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Solano, and Sonoma counties). Relocation assistance may be available. For this role, there is no formal requirement to work from the office.

The base salary range for this full-time position is listed below. This position will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance; a 401(k) plan; life and disability insurance; paid time off; and paid parental leave. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits. Applications for this role are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Base Salary
$196,000—$245,000 USD

Why Discord? 

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!

jobs.title: Senior Staff Brand Designer
jobs.description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there's one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

This is a new role, on a new team. The Brand Team sits alongside Design Systems in Design Foundations and keeps Discord's identity, voice, and visual system consistent across every surface where the brand appears. We run the brand like an internal product: we set its strategy, build and maintain its guidelines and tools, enable other teams to use it on their own, and review brand-facing work across product, marketing, partnerships, and legal. Marketing is a client of Brand: we equip their work with a brand that stays clear and current, while campaigns, ads, and launch messaging stay theirs to run.

You're a brand designer with gaming in your bones who can set the vision and do the work. You think in systems: logo, color, type, iconography, illustration, and motion are parts of one identity, and you know how to write the rules that keep it coherent when hundreds of people use it. You're as comfortable presenting brand architecture to executives as you are refining a wordmark. You're a generous partner who grounds every decision in reasoning rather than taste, and you'd rather teach a team to use the brand well than gatekeep it.

This person will report to the Director of Product Design, Design Foundations.

 

What You'll Be Doing

  • Defining Discord's brand strategy: positioning, brand architecture across the master brand and sub-brands like Nitro (Discord's premium subscription), and the narrative of what Discord stands for and for whom
  • Owning and evolving Discord's visual identity system, including logo, wordmark, color, typography, iconography, illustration, and motion
  • Building and maintaining brand and sub-brand guidelines, including standards for co-branding, partnerships, and third-party integrations, and partnering with Voice & Tone and User Communications to bring the Voice & Writing Guide into the brand system
  • Building templates, design kits, asset libraries, and a self-serve brand portal, and enabling teams to use the brand on their own through office hours, a support channel, onboarding, and workshops
  • Reviewing and approving brand-facing work across marketing, product, and partnerships, and working with Legal on trademark and usage policy
  • Applying the brand directly on core surfaces, including app icons, deck templates, the marketing site design system, office spaces, signage, and merch, and art-directing the external partners who help produce them
  • Running an annual brand audit across every surface, monitoring the competitive landscape, and mentoring future Brand team members

What you should have

  • 10+ years of experience in brand or identity design, including owning a brand system at scale for a gaming or games-adjacent brand
  • A portfolio with exemplary craft across identity, typography, color, iconography, illustration, and motion, applied across digital product, marketing, and physical spaces, with your role on each project clearly shown
  • A track record of brand strategy work, including positioning, brand architecture, and sub-brand systems
  • Experience writing brand guidelines and governance models and running them over time: maintaining them, holding teams accountable to them, and evolving them as they're tested in real use
  • Comfort with ambiguity: you've built a brand practice where there was no playbook, and you're willing to do the hands-on work while setting direction
  • A demonstrated ability to align stakeholders at every level, from executives to individual designers, with clear reasoning and strong presentation skills
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools and agents in brand work, and a clear point of view on where AI helps craft and where it doesn't

Bonus Points

  • Experience standing up a brand function, brand portal, or DAM (digital asset management system) from scratch
  • Experience with co-branding and partnership governance, or trademark and usage compliance
  • Experience working alongside a design systems team, including Figma libraries and variables

jobs.description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord is looking for a Staff Data Engineer to join our Data Engineering team and partner with Consumer Revenue. Our mission is to make it easy for all users to discover, understand, buy, and keep Premium Products on Discord. In this role, you will set technical direction for the data systems that support Nitro, Shop, server monetization and gifting, and other consumer revenue experiences. You will build reliable data foundations that help teams understand performance, run experiments, and make better product and business decisions.

You’ll work closely with Data Science, Product, Finance, Data Platform, and engineering partners. If you’re excited to lead complex data engineering work, raise the quality of shared data products, and help a high-velocity consumer business grow, read on.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Set technical direction for Consumer Revenue data engineering: identify foundational gaps, define scalable architectures and standards, and lead high-impact initiatives from design through adoption.
  • Design and own canonical data models and datasets for consumer monetization, including subscriptions and subscriber states, purchases and payments, Shop, gifting, and Orbs. Make these assets reliable, well-documented, and useful across product analytics, financial reporting, experimentation, and decision-making.
  • Build and evolve production data pipelines that transform source events and transactional data into accurate, trusted data products. Balance freshness, reliability, cost, and maintainability across batch and, where the use case calls for it, lower-latency processing.
  • Partner with Data Science, Product, Finance, and engineering teams to define and operationalize important business metrics—including subscriber, revenue, booking, retention, and product usage measures—and ensure definitions are consistent across reporting and experimentation.
  • Strengthen the data foundations behind high-velocity product work and revenue growth. Translate ambiguous questions into robust models, metrics, and analytical capabilities that help teams size opportunities, evaluate launches, and learn from experiments.

Contribute to AI-assisted analytics workflows where they can make data access more useful and dependable.
  • Work closely with upstream Data Platform and downstream Data Science partners to align on interfaces, data contracts, and operational expectations; communicate trade-offs and risks clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Mentor data engineers through design and code reviews, technical guidance, and ownership of complex projects. Raise the bar for engineering quality and help teams adopt consistent data modeling and documentation practices.

 

What You Should Have

  • 7+ years of experience building and operating production data pipelines and data products, including significant hands-on ownership of architecture and implementation.
  • Expert-level SQL and strong Python skills, with experience writing maintainable, tested production code.
  • A track record of designing robust data models from large-scale event, product, or transactional data and making them usable for analytics, reporting, and experimentation.
  • Experience setting technical direction across complex projects, identifying systemic data problems, and delivering solutions that multiple teams can rely on.
  • Strong data quality instincts, including experience with testing, monitoring, data freshness, documentation, and the investigation of metric discrepancies.
  • Experience with modern data engineering tools and workflows (for example, dbt, BigQuery, Dagster, or equivalent), version control, and CI/CD practices.
  • Experience partnering with Data Science, Product, Finance, and Engineering to turn ambiguous business questions into clear metric definitions and dependable data products.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to build alignment, explain technical trade-offs, and earn trust across teams.

  • Experience with subscription, payments, e-commerce, virtual currency, or other consumer monetization data.

  • Experience with streaming or near-real-time data systems, or improving the reliability and observability of critical pipelines.

Discord's Experimentation Platform puts data at the heart of the company's decision-making and growth - we run hundreds of experiments at any given time, and those results turn directly into business decisions across Discord. 

As a Staff Data Scientist on this team, you will ensure that the statistical underpinnings of our experiments are sound, that experimenters are able to design experiments with high rigor, and that Discord makes the best business decisions on the basis of these experiments.   • Provide statistical expertise, ensuring that experimentation methodologies and frameworks are sound and aligned with best practices in causal inference and experimental design.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Enterprise Platform
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area or Remote (West Coast)
jobs.description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord's Enterprise Technology org is building a software engineering discipline from the ground up, and this is the founding engineering hire. There is no Enterprise Platform team yet. You will not be maintaining a status quo or joining an existing backlog: you will define the discipline, set the technical foundation, and build the platform that lets the internal systems enabling Discordians scale with the company.

Discord's mission is to cultivate belonging, and doing that at scale requires internal systems that move as fast as the product itself. The mission of this role is to turn our enterprise infrastructure into self-service software. Your job is to replace manual consoles and tickets with a platform of reusable primitives, building blocks like "provision a device" or "push an IAM policy or app integration through code," exposed through clean APIs and self-service portals. As a code-forward Staff engineer, you will design abstractions that hide the messy reality of Okta, Jamf, and Terraform (our identity, device management, and infrastructure-as-code tools) behind interfaces people actually want to use, operating with a platform-as-a-product mindset.

What You'll Do

  • Manage the device fleet as code: Move device configuration off consoles and into versioned, API-driven infrastructure for endpoint management and hardware provisioning.
  • Automate the identity layer: Manage identity systems and their connections to downstream apps as code, from SSO and SCIM integrations to account workflows, so changes ship through version control and CI/CD instead of an admin console.
  • Own app delivery and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Build deployment pipelines and provisioning patterns that let internal systems be built and changed safely, establishing CI/CD standards.

jobs.title: Staff, Pricing Strategy Lead
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.

We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you.

We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team.

Our Values

If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.

Who We Are

At Justworks, we help small businesses thrive by making it easier to manage HR, payroll, and benefits. By simplifying the complexities of running a business, we give our customers more time to focus on what matters most – building and growing their companies.

We bring that same focus on simplicity and continuous improvement to how we work. We’re data-driven, entrepreneurial, and always looking for ways to make our products, customer experience, and company better. Our shared values guide how we make decisions, collaborate as a team, and show up for our customers. 

Justworks is a welcoming and supportive place to do meaningful work. We care deeply about our people and offer great benefits and wellness programs, company retreats, and opportunities to learn from leaders across Justworks and the broader startup community.

If you’re excited to help build something meaningful alongside people who care about their work, their customers, and each other, we’d love to hear from you.

Who You Are

The Monetization Strategy team defines how Justworks captures the value we create for our customers, including our pricing and packaging architecture, building the capabilities required to support it, and ensuring our monetization model evolves alongside our platform and customers.

Justworks is at an important point in that evolution. As we grow from product-based plans towards a platform-based model, we need to define not only what our future pricing and packaging model should look like, but also the research, data, technology, and operating mechanisms required to make it successful.

We are seeking a Staff, Pricing Strategy Lead to help architect and operationalize that future state. You will lead the evolution of our pricing and packaging model, build the analytical and operational capabilities required to support it, and take on high-impact monetization initiatives that span packaging, bundling, platform tiering, and the broader product portfolio.

This role is a good fit for someone who combines strategic thinking with analytical and operational rigor.  You should be comfortable defining a future-state packaging strategy, conducting pricing analysis, partnering with Product on billing architecture, evaluating package economics with Finance, and building the measurement systems required to understand whether the strategy is working.

Your Profile

  • Platform Monetization Strategy: Help define Justworks’ future-state pricing and packaging strategy, including leading high-impact pricing and packaging initiatives across products, add-ons, bundles, and platform tiers.
  • Pricing Research & Analytics: Lead pricing research initiatives, including willingness to pay studies, conjoint analysis, and elasticity modeling.
  • Customer & Market Insights: Develop pricing recommendations grounded in customer value, segmentation insights, competitive benchmarking, and financial modeling.
  • Experimentation: Design and & analyze pricing experiments (e.g., packaging variations, promotional tests, bundling strategies) to inform iterations and optimizations.
  • Discounts & Promotions: Partner with Revenue and Finance teams to evaluate discounting trends, customer impact groups, and retention implications of pricing updates.
  • Measurement & Reporting: Define the KPIs and measurement framework for pricing and packaging performance, and partner with Data & Analytics to build the dashboards, reporting, and operating mechanisms required to monitor monetization health.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Work across Product Marketing, Product, Finance, Revenue, Data & Analytics, and leadership to turn our monetization strategy into capabilities and decisions that can be executed across the business.

How You Work

As a Staff, Pricing Strategy Lead how results are achieved is paramount to your success and ultimately our success as an organization. In this role, your foundational knowledge, skills abilities, and personal attributes are anchored in the following competencies:

  • Strategic Thinking: You connect individual pricing initiatives to broader company objectives and growth strategy.
  • Customer-Centric Orientation: You ground recommendations in customer value and market insight – not just internal targets.
  • Analytical Rigor: You are fluent in financial modeling, scenario analysis, and experimentation frameworks, and can turn data into clear recommendations.
  • Operational Excellence: You drive structured execution across multiple workstreams and manage timelines effectively.
  • Collaborative Mindset: You build strong partnerships across Product, Finance, Sales, Revenue Effectiveness, and Marketing.
  • Clear Communication: You translate complex pricing analysis into compelling narratives and actionable decisions.
  • Nimble Learning: You embrace testing and iteration, continuously refining pricing approaches based on results.
  • Results-Driven: You focus on measurable impact, including revenue growth, margin performance, and customer retention.

In addition, all Justworkers focus on aligning their behaviors to our core values known as COGIS. It stands for:

  • Camaraderie: Day to day you can be seen working together toward a higher purpose. You like to have fun. You’re an active listener, treat people respectfully, and strongly desire to know and help others.

jobs.title: OT Network Engineer
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

OT NETWORK ENGINEER

SpaceX is looking for an Operational Technology (OT) Network Engineer with experience in routing, switching, and wireless in industrial network environments. This employee will be a member of the IT Network Engineering team, which is responsible for maintaining a stable, reliable, and diverse network. This network supports the design, manufacturing, and launching of rockets, spacecraft, satellites, and human spaceflight. This position will design and support industrial and OT networks for production, test, site operations, and live data center build environments. The ideal candidate will be a great communicator, able to document work in a ticketing system, excel at multi-tasking, resolve issues to prevent failures, and enjoy a fast-paced high-tech environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design and implement highly available networks, balancing routing and redundancy for production, test, and site requirements.
  • Design and validate resilient, scalable multi-site OT network topologies for critical facilities.
  • Evaluate, procure, and deploy network hardware: switches, firewalls, multiplexing, and SD-WAN appliances.
  • Develop and contribute to network automation tooling, including configuration analysis and scalable deployment.
  • Plan and coordinate network outage windows with stakeholders for software updates, hardware refreshes, and maintenance.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve network issues. Publish root-cause analysis and host retrospective reviews.
  • Provide networking support during launch and test campaigns, including on-call or real-time support as the networking responsible engineer.
  • Tune network monitoring for operational telemetry and issue detection before impact.
  • Create and update network documentation: architecture overviews, design drawings, and operational procedures.
  • Work with cross-functional teams on network designs, including failure modes and redundancy.
  • Perform job walks with customers, vendors, and contractors to gather requirements and create implementation plans.
  • Segment industrial networks from campus and corporate networks. Maintain controls-network segmentation.
  • Author system and network architecture drawings, IP/VLAN schemes, and data flow diagrams.
  • Support on-site deployment, physical network cutovers, and new site commissioning.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or other STEM discipline and 3+ years of professional network engineering experience; OR 5+ years of professional network engineering experience and high school diploma or equivalency certificate in lieu of a degree.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Industrial, utility, or operational technology network engineering experience.
  • Understanding of the OSI model and network standards.
  • Cisco, Arista, and Juniper data center-class switches.
  • Wave Division Multiplexing (WDM) and fiber optics infrastructure.
  • Enterprise and media protocols.
  • Switch port security features, network segmentation, QoS, multicast, and redundancy protocols.
  • Network monitoring tools and layer-1 testing tools.
  • Scripting (Bash, PowerShell, Python) and automation frameworks (Terraform, Ansible).
  • Linux and Windows system administration.
  • GitOps and infrastructure as code, as a user and as a contributor.
  • Layer 2 and Layer 3 design, deployment, and troubleshooting in latency-sensitive or industrial environments.
  • Functional experience with multiple network vendors in production or lab environments.
  • Hands-on configuration of managed industrial switches and routers.
  • Real-time systems, industrial control networks, or OT environments in aerospace, defense, energy, oil and gas, or similar high-reliability industries.
  • Industry-standard certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, JNCIS, or JNCIP.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • This role requires you to be onsite. Hybrid or remote work will not be considered.
  • Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed.
  • Must have a valid driver's license.
  • Ability to lift heavy objects up to 35 lbs. unassisted.
  • Ability to provide 24x7 on-call support in emergency situations and participate in an after-hours on-call rotation.
  • Willingness to occasionally travel to other sites to support new company initiatives.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. jobs.title: Logistics Analyst (Inbound/Outbound)
jobs.description:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

Position Summary The Logistics Analyst, Inbound/Outbound will be a key member of the Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) Logistics Operations team at Redwood Materials. This person will be responsible for coordinating inbound raw material and feedstock freight into BESS operations, ensuring internal stakeholders and supplier requirements are met. The role operates out of the Battery Materials Campus (BMC) in Sparks, Nevada. The Logistics Analyst will plan and optimize inbound flows within a growing logistics network, including international and hazardous material (hazmat) shipping.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare and coordinate inbound/outbound receiving schedules with suppliers and carriers to ensure on-time logistics execution

  • Communicate shipment information to carriers, internal stakeholders, and customers

  • Manage logistics operations through various modes of transportation, interact with Third-Party Logistics (3PL) providers, and collect shipping data in a Transportation Management System (TMS)

  • Prepare pertinent shipping documents, including international transportation and hazardous material (hazmat) shipping documentation

  • Develop reporting tools and track key performance metrics of logistics performance

  • Monitor shipping costs and optimize logistics routing

  • Communicate with internal stakeholders, customers, and Third-Party Logistics (3PL) providers to meet operational demands and creatively solve problems when issues arise

Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities

  • Bachelor’s degree and/or equivalent relevant experience

  • 1-3 years of professional experience in the logistics field required

  • Preference for Supply Chain Management, Finance, or Analytics majors, or Master’s degree

  • Experience with Transportation Management Systems (TMS) and Third-Party Logistics (3PL) coordination preferred

  • Passion for sustainability and making the world a better place

The position is full-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.
