jobs.title: Software Engineer, Web3 Backend
jobs.location: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

As a Software Engineer, you’ll build and own backend services, infrastructure, and data systems that support Robinhood’s next-generation crypto, web3, and wallet offerings. You’ll develop innovative solutions to deliver a best-in-class trading experience for cryptocurrencies and tokenized assets—including perpetual futures—to customers worldwide, while solving complex scalability and correctness challenges in an environment where the systems you build move real customer assets continuously around the clock.

The Robinhood Wallet team’s mission is to democratize access to financial services worldwide by leveraging DeFi protocols and Robinhood Chain. The team builds non-custodial consumer products, self-custody experiences, and seamless cross-chain trading capabilities.

The Tokenization team’s mission is to bring both public and private equity to be tradable 24/7 on decentralized exchanges (DEXs) across the Robinhood Chain. Equity markets have been closed nights and weekends for a century; the team builds the connective tissue between traditional market infrastructure and on-chain systems—issuance, custody, and settlement—to change that.

The Robinhood Chain team designs and scales the underlying decentralized infrastructure across Robinhood. The team continuously improves Robinhood Chain to provide a best-in-class decentralized platform for trading real-world assets, builds specialized smart contracts, and provides infrastructure services for other Robinhood teams that rely on DeFi.

These roles are based in either our Menlo Park, or New York City offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

  • Design, build, test, and deploy scalable backend services and infrastructure across Robinhood Wallet, Tokenization, and Web3 platform systems, with correctness and auditability as hard requirements.
  • Build the connective tissue between traditional market infrastructure (brokerage, ledgers, corporate actions) and on-chain systems, including smart contract integrations, chain indexers, and DEX trade flows.
  • Develop product-facing features and platform enhancements that meet strict correctness and scalability standards.
  • Identify and implement improvements to system performance, engineering productivity, and risk reduction.
  • Collaborate closely with product, compliance, client, platform teams, and external partners to deliver impactful technical solutions.

What you bring

  • 2+ years of experience in software development.
  • Expertise in backend development using languages such as Go, Python, or Java, with a solid grasp of cloud-native architectures.
  • Strong grasp of system design, data modeling, and software engineering fundamentals.
  • Care for correctness-critical systems—idempotency, reconciliation, and reasoning carefully about failure modes when money is at stake.
  • Strong ownership mindset, with a track record of delivering high-quality projects end to end in cross-functional environments and raising team-wide technical standards.
  • Proven ability to simplify complex problems, make sound tradeoffs, and drive alignment across diverse stakeholders.
  • Interest in blockchain fundamentals—EVM, smart contracts, wallets, on-chain settlement—or a strong appetite to go deep quickly.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching
  • Best in class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents
  • Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process.

$166,000—$195,000 USD

$147,000—$172,000 USD

jobs.title: Senior Backend Software Engineer - 2943
jobs.description:
AppsFlyer is known for its massive backend production. At any given moment thousands of servers are consuming 200+ billion mobile app events daily, crunching our users' data, serving requests, and communicating on a massive scale. To achieve such scale, our data & microservice architecture is built with the best and latest cutting-edge technologies such as Node.js, Go, Kafka, GraphQL, Neo4j, Redis, BigQuery, AWS, and many more…

The SaaSLab group is part of the AFOS (AppsFlyer Operating System) unit which owns the SaaS platform and control plane of AppsFlyer — the foundational layer that manages users, accounts, billing, API gateway, authentication, permissions, and business integrations. SaaSLab's systems serve as the backbone for every product and feature at AppsFlyer, handling millions of API calls daily and supporting thousands of enterprise customers worldwide.

We are looking for an exceptional Software Engineer to join the Domain Team within SaaSLab. The Domain Team owns AppsFlyer's core entities — accounts, apps, and users — as well as the onboarding experience. This is a foundational domain that every other product and team at AppsFlyer depends on. You will design, build, and operate the backend systems that power these entities while contributing to the team's ongoing architectural evolution.

The position requires strong backend engineering skills, a solid understanding of distributed systems, and the ability to take ownership of complex technical problems from design through production.

**What You'll Do**
- Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend systems and data flows for AppsFlyer's core entities (accounts, apps, users) and onboarding flows
- Take part in decoupling from legacy data stores, building a resilient domain model, and adopting modern patterns like GraphQL Federation
- Write high-quality, well-tested, production-grade code and take ownership of your features from design through deployment and operation
- Participate in architecture discussions, design reviews, and code reviews, contributing ideas and raising the bar for the team
- Collaborate closely with product managers, team leads, and engineers across SaaSLab and AFOS to define and deliver on the team roadmap
- Help ensure high availability, security, and operational excellence for systems that underpin every AppsFlyer product
- Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve production issues, contributing to on-call rotations as needed
- Stay curious about new tools, technologies, and approaches, and help the team adopt AI-powered tools and modern SDLC practices
- Contribute to a strong engineering culture of ownership, collaboration, quality, and continuous improvement

**What You Have**
-7 years of software development experience, with strong backend engineering skills
- Experience building and operating production-grade distributed systems
- Strong understanding of software design, system architecture, and development best practices
- Experience working with high-scale, cloud-based architectures
- Ability to take ownership of problems and drive them from design through production
- Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with experience working across multiple functions and stakeholders
- Strong sense of ownership and the ability to work with clarity in ambiguous spaces
- Proficiency in written and verbal English
- B.Sc. in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

**Bonus Points**
- Experience with Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles and practices
- Experience with SaaS platform systems — identity, access management, billing, multi-tenancy, API gateways, or similar control-plane domains
- Experience working on core entity systems, identity/account management, or SaaS onboarding flows
- Experience with Node.js, GraphQL, or graph databases (Neo4j)
- Experience with platform/infrastructure teams that serve internal engineering customers
- Experience in the ad-tech ecosystem, preferably with hyper-scale systems
- Recommended by an AppsFlyer employee

jobs.title: Production Scheduler (Starship)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

PRODUCTION SCHEDULER (STARSHIP)

The Production Scheduler for SpaceX's Starship program drives efficient production by developing rate-based schedules, identifying part shortages, projecting long-term departmental needs, and tracking constraints across builds while collaborating with teams to set and execute daily/weekly goals that align with overall rate targets.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Assist in production scheduling for a given production work center, including identifying need dates for all part shortages and projecting long-term high-level rate needs for the department
  • Create a rate-based schedule for your hardware and define/track constraints across your build for the next 6+ missions
  • Use an established schedule to create and generate stakeholder buy-in on various scenarios to determine optimal hardware allocation between new/refurb hardware that take into account customer needs, current mission manifest, and customer quality requirements
  • Work with production teams to set, track, and execute daily and weekly goals for the work center that take into account personnel and equipment constraints but support overall rate targets
  • Build strong relationships with internal suppliers and establish high-accuracy means of communication for both estimated hardware needs and completion dates
  • Manage the scheduling and prioritization of your hardware at shared resources that are common to multiple departments at SpaceX
  • Negotiate with peers in other departments for correct overall priority and seek creative solutions that drive the optimal business outcome
  • Monitor MRP systems and leverage SQL Queries to identify hardware shortages for upcoming builds and lead the charge to pull this hardware into your production area
  • Identify, develop, and implement opportunities for increased scheduling automation across the Starship Ship Engineering department with a focus on reducing the manual operations required to develop, track, and update overall schedules
  • Drive down near-term and future schedule risk by conducting work-center level capacity analysis, identifying model and communication gaps that cause schedule slips, and leading initiatives (reactive and proactive) that mitigate those risks
  • Lead efforts to uncover root-cause and develop permanent resolution on issues found during product builds as required to eliminate internal and external blockers to deliver product on time
  • Drive conversations around assembly-level & integration misalignment
  • Identify and support improvement opportunities for product yield, quality, safety, cost and team efficiency

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree and 1+ years of manufacturing scheduling, planning or operations; OR 3+ years of professional experience with manufacturing scheduling, planning or operations
  • Experience using ERP/MRP systems in a production environment

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Remarkable problem-solving skills with a bias for speed and accuracy
  • Self-motivated, quick learner, and ability to prioritize efforts to meet customer and company goals
  • Ability to develop and maintain strong internal and external supplier/customer relationships in a fast-moving and ever-changing environment
  • Technical knowledge and skills in coding and computer applications (e.g. MS Office Suite, VBA, Smartsheet, SQL, Confluence, JIRA, Power BI, etc.)
  • Strong track record of implementing continuous improvement efforts, ideally using problem solving frameworks including lean principles, six sigma, or Kaizen concepts
  • Experience leading multi-disciplinary and cross-functional teams working on strategic problems
  • Project management professional certification

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be available for all shifts, extended hours, and/or weekends as needed
  • Must be able to lift up to 25 lbs. unassisted
  • Must be able to stand for extended periods - 8 hours minimum

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $85,000.00 - $105,000.00
Level 2: $100,000.00 - $130,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. jobs.title: Principal Engineer, MEP & Building Systems
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM


The Design & Construction team at Anduril delivers the factories, labs, offices, and secure spaces that enable our teams to design, build, and deploy advanced defense technology. Our projects span high-performance manufacturing facilities, mission-critical secure environments, and collaborative workspaces, giving our team exposure to a uniquely wide variety of technical and operational challenges.

More than just delivering buildings, we are literally rebuilding the American defense industrial base. Our work directly accelerates how quickly critical technology moves from concept to production and into the hands of the warfighter.


ABOUT THE JOB


We are looking for a Principal Engineer – MEP & Building Systems to join our rapidly growing team. This position sits within the broader Design & Construction (D&C) team and reports to the Pre-Construction Director. The D&C team is responsible for bringing our various cutting-edge factories, offices, and secure spaces to life. We collaborate with a variety of stakeholders involved in shaping the built environment needed to enable Anduril’s mission—construction managers, architects, industrial engineers, real estate planners, finance analysts, and many more. But, first and foremost, we deeply listen to what our Division Leaders need. Whether it is autonomous submarines, robot fighter jets, or AR headsets, we stay close to our end users to ensure we’re fueling their success.

This role is the resident technical authority for all things mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and building controls across Anduril’s facility portfolio. You will embed with project teams during due diligence and early programming to define existing MEP conditions, evaluate utility capacity, and shape design solutions that meet operational needs without over-engineering. From first site walk through construction closeout, you will lead the definition of engineered system scope to make sure buildings have correct infrastructure, cost-effective designs, and built to support the demanding requirements of advanced manufacturing and defense technology operations. You will also be accountable for on-going plan reviews during progress points of design and help to trouble shoot issues that may arise during construction and turnover. Lastly, you will be looked as the subject matter expert to develop and refine our design guidelines related to M/E/P systems.


WHAT YOU’LL DO


Site Due Diligence & Utility Assessment

  • Participate in due diligence site walks for new project pursuits, evaluating and documenting existing mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection systems, conditions, capacities, and remaining useful life.
  • Assess site-level utility infrastructure—electrical service and capacity, natural gas, domestic and process water, sewer, storm drainage, and telecommunications—and coordinate with local utility providers to confirm available capacity, upgrade lead times, and cost implications.
  • Develop MEP-focused due diligence checklists and evaluation frameworks to standardize assessments across the portfolio.
  • Work closely with the preconstruction team to produce clear, concise MEP feasibility summaries that inform site selection recommendations and go/no-go decisions.
  • Identify infrastructure gaps early and quantify the scope and cost of utility upgrades or new service extensions required to meet program needs based on the specific Anduril Division and Business Line requirements.

Design Review & Value Engineering

  • Review project milestone design packages (programming, schematic design, design development, and construction documents) with a critical eye toward MEP system adequacy, code compliance, constructability, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Steer external A/E design teams toward right-sized, efficient solutions—challenging over-design, unnecessary redundancy, or specification choices that inflate cost without proportional benefit.
  • Provide technical direction on HVAC system selection, electrical distribution strategy, plumbing and process piping layouts, fire protection approaches, and building automation and controls architecture.
  • Partner with D&C project managers and the pre-construction team to align MEP scope with budget targets and identify value-engineering opportunities at each design milestone.
  • Evaluate life-cycle cost implications of MEP system choices and advise project teams on total cost of ownership, not just first cost.

Business Line Integration & Programming Support

  • Engage directly with Division Leaders and business line stakeholders to understand operational requirements—process loads, environmental conditions, power density, cooling needs, exhaust and ventilation demands, and specialty utility requirements.
  • Translate business line operational needs into clear MEP programming criteria and Basis of Design (BOD) narratives that design teams can execute against.
  • Help bridge the gap between what business lines request and what is technically and financially practical, ensuring facilities are built to serve current needs while accommodating reasonable future flexibility.
  • Support early programming and space planning efforts by providing MEP input on equipment clearances, utility routing, and infrastructure zoning.

Design Standards & Basis of Design Development

  • Develop, maintain, and continuously improve Anduril’s internal MEP design standards and Basis of Design (BOD) guidelines that project design teams reference across all facility types.
  • Establish standard guidelines for recurring MEP systems and equipment to drive consistency, reduce design cycle time, and leverage volume procurement opportunities.
  • Stay current on relevant building codes (IBC, IMC, IPC, NEC, NFPA), energy codes (ASHRAE 90.1, Title 24), and industry best practices, and translate updates into actionable guidance for project teams.
  • Document lessons learned from completed projects and integrate findings into updated standards and design guidelines.

Construction Oversight & Commissioning

  • Walk active project sites during construction to verify overhead and in-wall MEP rough-in and finish installations are executed per approved drawings, specifications, and applicable codes.
  • Confirm that adequate clearance and access are maintained for future maintenance, equipment replacement, and serviceability of all MEP systems—flagging installation conflicts before they are covered up.
  • Support and participate in commissioning activities for critical facilities, including functional performance testing of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, and building automation systems.
  • Review commissioning reports, identify deficiencies and punch-list items, and work with contractors and commissioning agents to drive timely resolution prior to substantial completion and occupancy.
  • Advocate for commissioning best practices across the portfolio, helping define commissioning scope and specifications during the design phase to ensure seamless execution during construction.

Troubleshooting & Technical Support

  • Serve as the go-to technical resource when unforeseen MEP system issues arise during construction or post-occupancy—diagnosing problems, identifying root causes, and recommending corrective actions.
  • Support D&C project teams and Facilities Management in triaging system failures, performance complaints, and commissioning deficiencies.
  • Coordinate with MEP contractors, equipment vendors, and commissioning agents to resolve complex technical issues efficiently.
  • Provide field support during critical construction phases, equipment startups, and system commissioning activities.

Stakeholder Coordination

  • Work cross-functionally with non-construction functions—including Security, Network Engineering, Facilities Management, Manufacturing, EHS, and IT—to align MEP design with broader facility requirements.
  • Communicate technical concepts, trade-offs, and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders in a clear and accessible manner.
  • Collaborate with the Strategic Real Estate (SRE) team and D&C leadership to inform site selection decisions with MEP-specific insight.

 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • A Bachelors Degree in Mechanical or Eletrical Engineering
  • Minimum of 12 years of progressive experience in mechanical, electrical, and plumbing engineering, building systems design, or MEP-focused construction management.
  • Deep technical knowledge across multiple MEP disciplines: HVAC, electrical power distribution, plumbing and process piping, fire protection, and building automation/controls.
  • Demonstrated experience reviewing and critiquing A/E design documents at all project phases, with a track record of identifying over-design and driving cost-effective solutions.
  • Strong background in site due diligence and utility infrastructure assessment, including coordination with utility providers and local jurisdictions.
  • Experience translating complex operational requirements into MEP programming criteria and Basis of Design documents.
  • Ability to read and interpret mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and controls drawings at all levels of design development.
  • Working knowledge of relevant codes and standards: IBC, IMC, IPC, NEC, NFPA, ASHRAE 90.1, and applicable state energy codes.
  • Corporate or owner’s-representative experience; comfortable managing relationships with internal business stakeholders, external design consultants, and contractors.
  • The ability to lead stakeholders with all levels of infrastructure systems knowledge and the ability to coalesce different business drivers to solutions that may initially begin as divergent goals
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex technical analysis into clear recommendations for senior leadership.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to support multiple concurrent projects across different geographies and stages.
  • Experience with altnernative energy solutions
  • Willingness to travel up to 30% of the time to support site evaluations, design reviews, construction milestones, and team coordination.

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with advanced manufacturing, industrial, laboratory, or mission-critical facility MEP systems (cleanrooms, high-bay manufacturing, data centers, or test environments) across a geographically diverse portfolio.
  • Familiarity with secure facilities and government construction standards, including ICD-705 and TEMPEST-related requirements.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.
  • Master’s degree

jobs.title: Mission Integration Engineer, Intelligence Systems
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril Intelligence Systems (AIS) is focused on positioning Anduril as a lead provider of specialized engineering and products for Intelligence Community (IC) customers. We work within the IC to understand their requirements, shape their concepts of operation, and deliver exquisite capability across their problem set. We aim to develop and deploy critically needed capabilities that address our customers’ most pressing national security requirements.

ABOUT THE JOB

We’re looking for a highly skilled and versatile Mission Integration Engineer. In this role, you’ll be the go-to person for both the hardware and software aspects of our system, working directly with customers in the field and remotely to ensure seamless integration and operation of all systems.

  • Provide end-to-end support including hardware setup and software configuration.
  • Pre-configure systems and ensure seamless integration with program infrastructure.
  • Troubleshoot issues in real-time, applying analytical thinking and hands-on problem-solving skills.
  • Author training documentation and instructions for end users and internal program usage.
  • Configure and troubleshoot networking environments, including firewalls, routers, switches, access points, and cloud based environments.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Top Secret SCI security clearance.
  • Strong experience with Linux systems configuration and administration.
  • Knowledge of basic DC electrical systems.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently in the field and collaborate with customers and team members.
  • Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent technical experience.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50%.
  • Proficient in working with hands and tools to assemble, repair, and maintain technical hardware in the field.
  • Able to meet health and medical requirements in advance of deployments in accordance with DFARS 252.225-7040, DoDI 3020.41, and/or any additional requirements outlined by region or supporting force, as applicable.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

 

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. 

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

 

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

jobs.location: San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA; New York, NY

About the Role

At DoorDash we are redefining what it means to be a designer. We are building toward a team of makers, builders, and doers. Between 2005 and 2015, "web designer" became "product designer" and the scope widened. The same shift is happening now, as LLMs expand that scope again, toward strategy on one end and direct execution on the other. As a Staff Visual Designer, you'll practice this build-first way of working with real autonomy: using AI-native tools and code to move from idea to shipped work quickly, and owning craft decisions end to end rather than checking each one against a brief.

You'll join Studio Central, a net-new Product Design team sitting at the intersection of product, brand, and innovation. Studio Central is a global team within Studio, DoorDash's Product Design organization, supporting DoorDash, Wolt, Deliveroo, and 7Rooms. We own how brand shows up in the product experience, partnering closely with Marketing and Product teams to shape cohesive, high-quality work and to help define the foundations, vision, and future state of design across our portfolio. Our work spans major brand moments, merchandising, and the systems that connect it all.

Studio Central's systems and standards are still being built, and everyone building here, regardless of level, has real input into what they become. You'll have full ownership over your own craft and projects, and a real voice in the standards, rituals, and craft bar the whole team ends up working from, not reacting to a framework someone else already finished, but helping shape it as it forms.

We operate in a hybrid working model, 1-2 days out of one of our Design Hubs, the rest working from home.

Your primary impact is craft and output: shipping high-quality, on-brand work across the campaigns, seasonal moments, and merchandising pushes Studio Central owns, with less oversight than earlier-career roles and more responsibility for getting it right yourself. Your secondary impact is revenue, in the same way: the work you ship well, and the craft feedback you give to the designers around you, is part of what raises the expression bar across DoorDash, Wolt, Deliveroo, and 7Rooms as a whole.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will...

  • Own end-to-end visual craft on brand moments, campaigns, and merchandising pushes, from concept through shipped, production-ready work, with less oversight than earlier-career roles
  • Mentor other designers as needed, sharing craft feedback and helping them build range, without formal authority over their work
  • Help build and pressure-test the design systems, component libraries, and AI-powered tooling as a team, whether that's proposing the first version or stress-testing someone else's, and speak up early rather than reacting to a finished one
  • Practice influencing without authority: bring a strong point of view into rooms with Product, Marketing, and creative stakeholders, and back it up with working prototypes rather than title
  • Build real range across the full workflow, from rough concept to production-ready execution, and hand off cleanly to engineering so nothing gets lost in translation

We're excited about you because you have...

  • A portfolio that shows strong, considered visual craft, systems thinking, or brand work at a senior level, even if you haven't yet led an org-wide initiative
  • Comfort moving between art-direction tools like Figma and Illustrator and shipping in code, or you're closing that gap quickly
  • A habit of treating a new tool or technique as an experiment worth running, not a decision you need to get right the first time, you'll ship a handful of rough attempts in something you picked up last week before you'd sit through a training on it
  • Experience giving craft feedback to other designers, even informally, and helping them get sharper
  • A track record of shipping ambiguous briefs to a high bar without heavy oversight

jobs.title: Senior Staff AI Enablement Engineer
jobs.description:
Employee Applicant Privacy Notice

Who we are:

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.

We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

About the role

SoFi is scaling how employees and AI agents safely reach the tools they need to do their jobs. We run a centralized MCP (Model Context Protocol) gateway that lets approved AI clients (Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, internal agents) connect to enterprise systems such as Slack, Google Workspace, Jira/Confluence, GitLab, Datadog, Snowflake, Glean, and ServiceNow, with SSO/OAuth brokering, policy enforcement, and full auditability.

As our Sr. Staff AI Enablement Engineer, you'll own the strategy and day-to-day operation of this platform and the customer-facing interfaces employees use to get AI tool access. You'll turn a security-approved control plane into a fast, self-service path to AI productivity across the company. You'll partner closely with Product Security, IAM, Engineering, and business leaders.

What you'll do

  • Own the MCP gateway platform end to end. This covers the catalog and registry of approved MCP servers, onboarding of new connectors, OAuth scope configuration, tool-level enablement and disablement, and lifecycle and hygiene.
  • Design the customer experience for AI tool access. Build intake, request, and provisioning flows (Compass/ServiceNow, Slack, Okta), documentation, and self-service paths that cut time-to-access from weeks to hours.
  • Partner with Product Security and IAM on MCP approval, threat modeling, least-privilege scopes, and incident response. Turn security requirements into operational guardrails that don't block adoption.
  • Run operations for the platform. This includes L1/L2 support models, runbooks, SLAs, monitoring and observability of tool usage, and vendor management (e.g., Cequence and SaaS connector vendors).
  • Drive adoption and measure impact. Define and report adoption, usage, and value metrics by function to IT and SLG leadership, and identify the next high-leverage integrations.
  • Automate access governance. Integrate the gateway with joiner/mover/leaver processes, access reviews, and audit evidence for SOX and regulatory requirements.
  • Set technical direction. Evaluate emerging agent and tool-access standards (MCP, A2A, agent identity), build vs. buy, and the roadmap for internal and customer-facing AI interfaces.
  • Mentor and influence. Guide IC1–IC4 engineers and analysts, and influence function-level decisions with senior ICs and SLG.

What you'll need 

  • Education & Minimum Experience Requirements: Bachelor’s Degree + 4+ Years of Experience OR Master’s Degree + 3+ Years of Experience in software engineering or a related field.
  • Track record of owning complex, companywide programs or platforms and independently handling their planning, execution, and resourcing.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM and agent tooling: MCP servers and clients, API gateways, and AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot.
  • Deep knowledge of identity and access: SSO/SAML, OAuth 2.0/OIDC, SCIM, Okta, and least-privilege and RBAC design.
  • Strong integration and automation skills. That means REST/GraphQL APIs, scripting (Python, TypeScript, or similar), iPaaS (Workato or similar), and ServiceNow workflows.
  • Experience operating in a regulated environment (financial services preferred), including audit, data retention, and change management.
  • Ability to translate between security, engineering, and business stakeholders, and to influence without authority.

Nice to have

  • Experience building or running an AI gateway, API gateway, or developer platform (e.g., Cequence, Kong, Apigee).
  • Experience building Slack bots, deflection bots, or agentic workflows for IT or employee support.
  • Familiarity with AI governance frameworks (NIST AI RMF) and LLM security risks (OWASP LLM Top 10, prompt injection, tool poisoning).

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Circuit Designer, Space Special Programs
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM 

In the Space Special Programs team, we build spacecraft and space systems which serve a wide variety of functions in the space architecture. At a time when space superiority can no longer be taken for granted and with space systems proliferating at an incredible rate, the Space Special Programs team provides advanced, mission critical capabilities to our customer base to be able to more effectively operate and survive within this expanding environment with limited personnel. Working across product, engineering, sales, logistics, operations, and mission success, the Space Special Programs team develops, tests, deploys, and operates new, unique, space capabilities to drive mission success in challenging operational environments. 

ABOUT THE JOB 

We are looking for Circuit Designers to join our rapidly growing team in Chantilly, VA. In this role, you will be responsible for Full Cycle PCB design for spacecraft and associated systems including deriving requirements, schematic design, component selection, supervision or completion of layout, bring-up, test, debug and integration with the system. The engineering team as a whole must span the capabilities of digita-to-analog circuit design, analog circuit design, RF circuit design, digital circuit design (including FPGA, SOC, and MCU implementations), motor control, small power system design, and ultra-low power circuitry, as well as computer engineering basics such as basic embedded software and PC-based tools, and FPGA development in VHDL.  

WHAT YOU’LL DO 

  • Work with a cross-functional team to design market leading space flight hardware and associated ground equipment products 
  • Implement product components through rapid prototyping, design verification, and space qualification activities 
  • Learn and apply modern space-flight hardware design standards and guidelines to create high-reliability, highly manufacturable assemblies 
  • Implement combinations of high-speed digital, precision analog, RF, and ultra low-power designs 
  • Participate in peer-level and cross-discipline design reviews and collaborate with other EEs on your team to improve everyone’s capabilities 
  • Low level firmware development for bring-up and test 
  • Root cause investigation data collection and analysis in support of production operations 
  • Work in a fast-paced environment, having to juggle multiple concurrent projects and changing delivery timelines 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 

  • B.S. in electrical / computer engineering or similar engineering or technical field  
  • 2-8 years of professional experience, in hardware product development 
  • Basic understanding of PCB Layout techniques to meet space flight mechanical, electrical, and manufacturing requirements 
  • Ability to read and interpret schematics and apply best practices appropriate for each design 
  • Familiarity with standard interfaces such as Ethernet, CAN, I2C, SPI, PCIe, MIPI CSI-2, etc 
  • Familiarity with common MCU, CPU, FPGA devices and technologies 
  • Knowledge of modern analog and digital electronics and electronic circuits 
  • Ability to determine manage work assignments based on prioritized direction from management, near-term goals, and day-to-day levels of progress 
  • Experience using Altium Designer or equivalent E-CAD tools 
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively with others 
  • Ability to work within our company and team culture and take ownership of the tasks assigned to you 
  • Willing to listen and learn from experts but still speak up when you have ideas 
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen and able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Top Secret security clearance 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

  • Experience designing, integrating, and flying Cubesat spacecraft meant to operate in LEO through GEO environments is a significant plus 
  • 1+ years of experience working in a classified environment is a plus 
US Salary Range
$132,000—$175,000 USD

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM 

In the Space Special Programs team, we build spacecraft and space systems which serve a wide variety of functions in the space architecture. At a time when space superiority can no longer be taken for granted and with space systems proliferating at an incredible rate, the Space Special Programs team provides advanced, mission critical capabilities to our customer base to be able to more effectively operate and survive within this expanding environment with limited personnel. ABOUT THE JOB

As a Sr. GNC (Guidance, Navigation & Control) Engineer for our Space Special Programs team, you own the understanding and design of all satellite GNC subsystems to include but not limited to hardware sensors and actuators, orbit mechanics, navigation algorithms, flight software implementation, subsystem integration & test (I&T), and vehicle I&T. You'll work closely with related teams, including Systems, Flight Software, Mission Operations, and Ground Software. Additionally, you will lead algorithm design, truth and physics modeling, simulation and analysis for a wide variety of spacecraft and space missions to include but not limited to LEO, MEO, GEO, Reentry, and RPOD (Rendezvous Proximity Operations and Docking). Lastly, you will help lead successful implementation, validation and GNC operations of spacecraft.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Lead spacecraft GNC software and hardware subsystems for various spacecraft efforts in all orbital regimes and work closely with bus providers for successful implementation.
  • Develop modern, software-defined approaches to autonomous spacecraft operations with maneuvering capabilities to successfully accomplish mission objectives.
  • Develop appropriate test plans and procedures to validate the GNC system during ground checkout, on-orbit commissioning and operations.
  • Collaborate across multiple teams to plan, build, and test complex functionality.
  • Coordinate with end-users, other operators and customers to turn needs into features while balancing user experience with engineering constraints.
  • Support challenging schedules during ground testing, launch windows and on-orbit operations of the spacecraft systems.
  • Directly interact with customers to ensure mission success.
  • Design of flight software, algorithms, and simulation products.
  • Development of spacecraft autonomy tools for dynamic space operations
  • Test process development and execution.
  • Define automated fault detection and responses.
  • Provide hardware-in-the-loop and monte-carlo simulation capabilities.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Strong engineering background from industry or school, ideally in areas/fields such as Astrodynamics, Aerospace Engineering, Dynamics and Controls Engineering, Computer Science, or other engineering degree.
  • Experience with MATLAB, Simulink, Python, C++, Go, and/or Linux Systems.
  • Experience conducting spacecraft operations and satellite command and control with an emphasis on system reliability and uptime.
  • Ability to quickly understand and navigate complex systems and detailed requirements.
  • Experience with orbital mechanics and resident space object tracking capabilities.
  • Experience developing 3-DOF simplified and 6-DOF high-fidelity dynamics simulation models used for GNC systems analysis and validation.
  • Familiarity with rendezvous proximity operations and docking, orbital mechanics with propulsive spacecraft, spacecraft attitude determination and controls.
  • Strong knowledge of spacecraft dynamics, orbital mechanics, and control theory.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Top Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • A desire to work on critical software and hardware designs in the space domain.
  • Experience testing propulsion subsystems in laboratory environments that mimic the space environmental constraints.
  • Experience with testing/validation leveraging FlatSats, Hardware-in-the-Loop testbeds and digital spacecraft simulators through nominal and fault scenarios.
  • Experience with computer vision and perception algorithms to support GNC operations.
  • Exposure to US satellite operations policy and constraints for relevant mission threads in all orbits.

$191,000—$254,000 USD

jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern (2027) - London, UK
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations

  • London, UK

Available Terms

  • Winter/Spring (January - May 2027) 
  • Summer (May - September 2027)

About the Role

Anytime we push code, it automatically affects the millions of Internet properties (powering websites, remote teams, APIs, mobile apps, etc.) running on our global network. Cloudflare's network is one of the largest in the world and spans over 330 cities in more than 125 countries. What's more, Cloudflare operates within 50 milliseconds of 95% of the Internet-connected population globally (for context, the blink of an eye is 300-400 milliseconds!). We are passionate about making the Internet more secure, reliable, and faster for everyone.

Cloudflare’s Engineering teams build and run the software that handles the massive amount of traffic that flows through our network. We also have teams that build the UI and control plane for our software, using modern patterns and libraries in a microservices-based architecture. Technologies include: Typescript/Javascript, Go, Rust, C/C++ and Python.

The ideal intern is passionate about making the Internet a better place. You will work alongside experienced engineers. You will push code this internship that touches hundreds of millions of web surfers. We like to get things done, so we are looking for interns who are curious, proactive, and able to complete projects. This is a great opportunity for engineers who want to learn to develop at Internet scale.

You can check out our internship blogs to learn more about our program and hear directly from our past interns.

Responsibilities

  • Ship and deliver projects over 12-14 weeks with autonomy and support.
  • Work cross-functionally with various teams.
  • Work closely with a mentor to guide you through the internship and help with career goals.
  • Build your network across the company through our various in and out of office socials, networking programs, Employee Resource Group (ERG) programs, and Activity Groups.
  • Present your project to the entire company at the end of the internship.
  • Connect and learn from our executives and leadership team including our co-founders.
  • Learn and develop skills through our professional development workshops.
  • Write for our Cloudflare blog and be featured on Cloudflare.tv sessions. 

Desirable Skills, Knowledge and Experience

  • Currently pursuing a degree or program in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or relevant field to the role.
  • Demonstrated critical thinking skills and drive to learn and adapt new technologies.
  • Curiosity, empathy and ability to get things done.
  • Ability to commit to a full-time (40 hours/week Monday - Friday) for a minimum 12 week internship.
  • In office 3-5 days a week in London, UK.

Bonus Points

Demonstrated passion for software development, such as personal projects, open-source contributions, or experience with our developer platform using Cloudflare for Students.

Please note

  • We will be hiring interns on a rolling basis until all roles are filled.
  • We are not considering remote or part-time for either terms. This is a full-time (40hr/week internship) with in-person expectations; standard business hours are typically 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM. You should not be enrolled in classes, which would conflict with full-time commitment.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

jobs.title: Recruiter, Communications
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is looking for a Recruiter to partner with our Communications team. This team tells Anthropic's story across corporate, product, executive, and internal communications. In this role, you will be the team's primary recruiter. You will own searches from intake through offer, and you will advise leaders on where the talent is, what it costs, and how to win it. The best communicators are rarely looking, so finding them is the job. As the team grows, you may also support hiring for Brand and Marketing.

Key responsibilities

  • Have a passion for AI's potential to positively impact the world, and a realistic view of its risks and limitations
  • Have recruited for communications, PR or adjacent roles, and understand what great looks like in that craft
  • Know how to find and engage candidates who are passive through a variety of creative channels
  • Build trust with senior leaders, and have the confidence to push back with data
  • Write clearly and pay close attention to detail, because candidates and comms leaders will notice both
  • Run a tight, high-touch process that respects candidates' time and helps hiring managers decide quickly
  • Turn hiring data into clear recommendations, not just status updates
  • Thrive in a fast-paced environment and handle executive and confidential searches with discretion

Preferred qualifications

  • Have 10+ years of full-lifecycle recruiting experience, with a track record of closing senior, hard-to-fill roles
  • Experience hiring for a high-growth technology company whose public narrative matters
  • A network across media, agency, and in-house communications talent
  • Experience supporting executive hiring
  • Experience using AI tools in your daily work, and are curious about where they can take recruiting next

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$240,000—$295,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

You’ll bring a strong sense of visual storytelling and hands-on knowledge of video production to the scripting process, thinking beyond the words on the page to how a story will come together on screen. Working closely with our video team, motion graphics animators, and technical experts, you’ll develop new topics and formats, translate technical details into compelling stories, and ensure every piece is clear, accurate, and relevant to practitioners.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace, in the office three days per week, to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

jobs.title: IT Support Engineer
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Corporate Technology (CorpTech) Services team is a strategic support partner to all Stripes, in office and remote.  We ensure the successful operation of new hires, account off-boards and critical business systems with a global team. 

We’re looking for a Tier 1 Support Engineer to join the AMER CorpTech Services team to provide in-person, thoughtful and individualized support for all Stripes. Stripe is looking for individuals who can work in a fast paced environment and work autonomously to deliver team oriented results.

What you’ll do

You’ll be responsible for providing technical assistance and support related to computer systems, hardware, and software. Respond to queries, run diagnostic programs, isolate problems, and determine and implement solutions.  In-person support is required as well as setting up desks and managing/auditing peripherals.  

Responsibilities

  • Provide technical support to Stripes, contingent workers, and vendors in person, by email, through Slack, and through the ticketing system, guiding users through troubleshooting and following up to confirm resolution
  • Diagnose and resolve computer hardware, software, and system issues, including troubleshooting scripts, automation, and Stripe-provided macOS, ChromeOS, and iOS devices and peripherals
  • Support and maintain workplace applications, including Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Jira, and Confluence
  • Provision laptops for New Stripe onboarding and fleet upgrades, support vendor and contractor onboarding, and contribute to global account offboarding
  • Maintain office technology, including printers, Zoom Rooms, and room schedulers, and own IT asset management with accurate, actionable equipment records
  • Create and maintain internal and user-facing technology documentation, and contribute to New Stripe onboarding and training materials
  • Promote established IT best practices and escalate issues to the IT Systems and Infrastructure team as needed

Who you are

You have the ability to take initiative on tickets and contribute to project design and implementation. You are skilled at writing, updating and maintaining technical documentation and sending directed communications. You are comfortable working as an individual contributor on a global team that is driving towards a common goal. You will best succeed in this role by leading on things you are passionate about while supporting others in their passion. 

You love problem solving and collaborating with others to provide world class support. Being the best fit for this position means you are both humble and confident. You strive towards excellence but understand your limitations and don’t hesitate to ask for help when needed. 

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • Have at least 2 years of experience delivering IT technical support or help desk services, with extensive expertise in Apple environments and software systems.
  • Demonstrate comprehensive hands-on experience managing SaaS applications including Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Jira, and Confluence.
  • Possess solid familiarity with automation scripts (Bash, Python, or Ruby) alongside endpoint management technologies like FleetDM and Apple DEP.
  • Exhibit the capability to work autonomously, effectively handling support inquiries while coordinating seamlessly with global cross-functional partners.
  • Bring exceptional written communication abilities to author clear IT guides, combined with a customer-centric mindset and strong collaborative spirit

jobs.title: Development Engineering Technician
jobs.description:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

Development Engineering Technician

As a Development Engineering Technician at Redwood Materials, you will have the opportunity to make the world a better place by supporting a wide variety of analytical /metallurgical processes across the Company. Under moderate supervision, a Development Engineering Technician will perform a variety of tasks, including building, monitoring, controlling, and optimizing chemical and metallurgical processes and unit operations in pilot, production, or laboratory environments. This role will aid engineers in starting up and testing new processes and equipment and performing experiments. 

Responsibilities will Include:

  • Desire to be hands-on monitoring and optimizing processes and equipment at the lab-, pilot-, and production-scale.
  • Strong ability to follow technical instructions & standard operating procedures.
  • Skilled in meticulous data collection and observation recording.
  • Demonstrated basic knowledge of math, chemistry and/or computer skills appropriate to the assignment.
  • Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing.
  • Proven track record of safety-consciousness and capable of learning applicable EHS standards and proper chemical handling techniques.
  • Capacity to work independently and safely with minimal supervision.

Desired Qualifications:

  • A.S. or B.S. degree in a related field.
  • Ability to operate, troubleshoot, and maintain relevant processing equipment. 
  • Ability and interest in assembling and fabricating process equipment to support operations.
  • Experience with laboratory sample preparation and analysis.
  • Familiarity of OSHA/MSHA rules and regulations and chemical hazards and industrial safety programs.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Healthcare Data Products)
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help us accomplish our mission to improve and extend lives by learning from the experience of every person with cancer. Are you ready to be the next changemaker in cancer care?

Flatiron Health is a healthtech company using data for good to power smarter care for every person with cancer, around the world. Flatiron partners with cancer centers in the US, Europe and Asia to transform patients’ real-life experiences into real-world evidence and create a more modern, connected oncology ecosystem. Our multidisciplinary teams include oncologists, data scientists, software engineers, epidemiologists, product experts and more. Flatiron Health is an independent affiliate of the Roche Group.

We’re looking for an experienced software engineer to join the Healthcare Data Products team. Our mission is to build scalable pipelines and platforms that transform raw clinical data into actionable insights, and to empower our clients to do the same. Whether it’s managing a 100+ source data lake or architecting Snowflake-native sharing solutions, your work directly impacts how cancer data is utilized across the industry.

What You’ll Do

As a Senior Engineer on the HC Data Products team, you will own the lifecycle of high-scale data applications. From our Snowflake data lake to customer-facing data retrieval interfaces, you will build systems that are robust, compliant, and performant. In addition, you’ll:

  • Architect & Scale: Design and maintain complex data pipelines using Python, PySpark, Prefect, and Airflow to ingest data from hundreds of sources into Snowflake.
  • Innovate Infrastructure: Transition our data delivery models toward modern Snowflake-native data sharing and high-performance Parquet extractions.
  • Full-Stack Ownership: Support our EHR application and data export features by working across the stack, from Python backends to React frontends.
  • Modernize Tooling: Use Terraform (via Spacelift), Docker, and GitLab CI/CD to ensure our infrastructure is code-driven, while leveraging Datadog and Metaplane for end-to-end system and data observability.
  • High-Velocity Dev-Ex: Leverage cutting-edge AI-assisted development tools like Cursor and Claude Code to streamline workflows and focus on solving complex oncology data challenges.
  • Collaborate: Partner with oncologists, product leaders, and data scientists to translate complex product and regulatory requirements into elegant technical solutions.

Who You Are

You're a kind, collaborative, and passionate problem-solver who thrives at the intersection of software engineering and data platform architecture.

  • The Experience: You have 4+ years of professional experience building scalable, production-grade software.
  • The Stack: You are highly proficient in Python and have a deep understanding of relational databases (Snowflake preferred).
  • The Mindset: You have a nose for value and empathy for your internal and external customers. You proactively identify problems that have a high impact on the business. 
  • The Communicator: You can explain complex data flows to non-technical stakeholders and mentor junior engineers on best practices.
  • The Academic: You hold a degree in Computer Science or a related field (or have equivalent foundational experience).

Extra Credit

  • Modern Data Stack: Experience with Airflow, Prefect, PySpark, or Terraform.
  • Front-End Flair: Experience with React or similar JS frameworks for building data-heavy internal tools.
  • Cloud Native: Hands-on experience with AWS services (S3, EMR, EC2).
  • Healthcare Context: Familiarity with healthcare data domains (e.g., Clinical, Financial, or Research) and an understanding of provider workflows within an EHR.
  • Open Source: You contribute to the community or have a passion for building developer tools.

Who We Are

Our people are at the centre of everything we do. We strive to foster a culture where our teammates feel equipped and empowered to make meaningful contributions with confidence, compassion, and clarity.
