jobs.title: Staff Environmental Engineer
jobs.description:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

Position Summary:

The position is responsible for leading and supporting environmental permitting and compliance program execution, covering air, water, and waste media, for Redwood Energy's rapidly growing project development, EPC, and O&M project portfolio. The role partners with Project Development, Engineering, Construction, Operations, and the broader EHS team to build compliance into project design, delivery, and operations. The position determines methods and approaches to new assignments, resolves complex and nuanced regulatory questions, and advises project leaders on environmental requirements and risk. This is a hybrid position – with the candidate ideally based out of our Nevada or San Francisco offices, with travel of up to 30% to Redwood Energy project sites.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Lead environmental permitting strategy and execution for Redwood Energy projects, including applicability determinations, applications, and agency coordination
  • Direct compliance program execution across the PD, EPC, and O&M portfolio, including air, SPCC, stormwater, waste, and land-use or wetlands requirements
  • Integrate environmental requirements into project design, equipment selection, and construction planning through early engagement with Engineering and project teams
  • Scope and oversee biological surveys (threatened/endangered species, migratory birds, bats), wetland delineations, cultural/historic resource surveys, and geotechnical/soils assessments
  • Oversee environmental scope of EPC contractors and consultants, including deliverables, site inspections, and handoff of compliance obligations to operations
  • Stakeholder & public engagement support. Prepare materials for public hearings, respond to comments, coordinate with tribal consultation processes where required
  • Risk & schedule management. Flag permitting risks that could delay interconnection or COD, and coordinate with project development, legal, and engineering teams to de-risk the critical path
  • Track and interpret regulatory changes and translate them into clear operating requirements and change controls
  • Serve as a primary interface with regulators and lead site inspections, audits, and corrective action closure for the portfolio
  • Develop and deliver environmental training, procedures, and program documentation, and advise colleagues on complex compliance matters

Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities:

  • Bachelor's degree in Environmental, Chemical, Civil, or Mechanical Engineering or a related field; advanced degree is a plus.
  • 8+ years of environmental permitting and compliance experience with a bachelor’s degree (6+ with a Master's), or equivalent experience, in industrial, energy, or construction settings.
  • Working knowledge of federal, state, and local environmental requirements applicable to energy and industrial projects, including Clean Air Act permitting (Minor and Major source), SPCC, Clean Water Act (NPDES, SWPPP), and RCRA.
  • Experience supporting projects through development, construction, and operations, including working with EPC contractors and consultants.
  • Ability to travel up to 30% of the time to project sites.
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects and competing deadlines, and lead cross-functional initiatives in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for working with regulators, customers, project teams, and leadership

The position is full-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

Redwood Materials is seeking a Business Development Account Manager to support and grow our partnerships with battery cell manufacturers. jobs.description:
Datadog AI Research — Scholars Program with Carnegie Mellon University

Datadog AI Research (DAIR) is partnering with Carnegie Mellon University to support a small number of PhD students working on open research problems grounded by ongoing efforts at Datadog/DAIR. 

You will frame a problem, run your own experiments, and write up what you find, with compute and data at a scale most academic labs cannot provide.  You will collaborate with colleagues working on the same questions.

 

The Lab And The Research:

DAIR is an industrial research lab motivated by practical challenges in observability and software operation: detecting and diagnosing failures, understanding complex production environments, and helping engineers operate software more effectively. The lab focuses on creating specialized foundation models, post-training and evaluating AI agents, and building frontier-scale machine learning systems. By combining fundamental research with Datadog's large-scale, real-world data and infrastructure, the lab develops new AI capabilities and translates them into practical systems with meaningful impact.

Internship projects are shaped with your DAIR mentor and your CMU faculty advisor. You do not need prior experience with observability, monitoring, or infrastructure.

 

What You'll Do:

  • Own a research project end to end: framing the question, running the experiments, writing it up
  • Work directly with a DAIR mentor engaged in the same problem, and stay connected to your advisor and lab
  • Publish, and use the work toward your dissertation
  • See research reach production, when it works

 

Who You Are:

  • Currently enrolled in a PhD program at Carnegie Mellon in machine learning, computer science, statistics, or a related field
  • Depth in at least one area relevant to the research above
  • Comfort running real experiments — training models, working with GPUs, reading and reimplementing recent papers
  • Evidence you can do research: conference or workshop papers, preprints, open-source contributions, or a lab project you can discuss in depth
  • Research taste. You can explain why a problem matters and what would change if it were solved.
  • Honest empiricism. You report the ablation that didn't work.
  • Support from your faculty advisor.

 

Not Required:

  • A long publication record. How you think matters more than how much you've published.
  • Observability, monitoring, or SRE background.
  • A perfect match to the areas above.

 

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We know not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That’s okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your experience, we encourage you to apply.

 

This job is available in various departments within our company; to conform to US export control regulations, some of these roles may require candidates to be eligible for any required authorizations from the US government.

 

If possible, please apply using your personal email address instead of your university email address.

 

Students can sign up for a free Datadog Pro account to learn more about our platform and products.

jobs.title: Research Scientist, Discovery (Engineering & Applied Sciences)
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Research Scientist, Discovery (Engineering & Applied Sciences)

About the Team

Our team is organized around the north star goal of building an AI scientist – a system capable of solving the long term reasoning challenges and basic capabilities necessary to push the scientific and technological frontier.

About the role

On the Discovery team at Anthropic, we're expanding our work on engineering and the applied sciences. Our goal is to contribute to training Claude to invent, design, and engineer across every discipline and scale, reliably and safely: new manufacturing and experimental techniques, processes, materials, devices, instruments, machines, energy systems, and factories. We want this work to accelerate science and technology and benefit people widely.

To achieve these goals, we're seeking exceptional machine learning researchers with deep expertise in training and evaluating frontier models. In this role, you'll work end to end across the model stack, developing training environments, rewards, data, and evaluations that measure and improve Claude's performance on complex engineering and scientific tasks, and carrying what works into production training runs. You'll collaborate closely with researchers, engineers, and partners across Anthropic and industry to build AI systems that can engage in all phases of research and development, and that learn from real-world feedback. A background in engineering or the sciences is a plus but not required. 

Key responsibilities

  • Design, build, and study reinforcement learning environments, rewards, and training data that improve Claude's capabilities in engineering and the applied sciences
  • Create benchmarks and evaluation frameworks that measure model performance on realistic engineering and scientific workflows
  • Develop simulation-based training environments and verifiers, working with domain experts to validate them against real-world data
  • Develop approaches to long-horizon task completion, multi-agent collaboration, and complex reasoning essential for real engineering and research work
  • Research how models can learn efficiently from experiments and real-world feedback.
  • Study how environments and rewards behave in large-scale training, including robustness, calibration, and generalization, so that training produces models that are both capable and well aligned
  • Scale research ideas from prototype to production training runs
  • Collaborate with domain experts and industry partners to build and test what Claude invents, designs, and engineers, and turn that feedback into training and evaluation signal
  • Help chart how Claude’s engineering capabilities reach real-world use: where they matter most, what stands in the way of adoption, and how that should shape research priorities

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • Proficiency in Python and hands-on experience with a modern machine learning framework such as PyTorch or JAX
  • Hands-on experience training or evaluating machine learning models
  • Track record of machine learning research: forming hypotheses, designing and running experiments, and drawing sound conclusions from the results
  • Ability to implement your own research ideas and diagnose problems in complex systems
  • Ability to learn unfamiliar technical fields quickly and work productively with experts in them
  • Clear communication and a collaborative approach to solving problems
  • Excitement about improving Claude’s scientific capabilities and the downstream impact on science and technology
  • Commitment to developing AI that is safe and beneficial

Strong candidates may also have:

  • Experience with reinforcement learning and pre-training on large language models, including environment and reward design
  • Familiarity with large-scale language model training, evaluation, and inference pipelines
  • Published research or practical experience in AI for science or engineering, or in long-horizon reasoning
  • A degree or work experience in an engineering or applied science discipline, such as mechanical, electrical, materials, chemical, aerospace, systems, or manufacturing engineering, applied physics, or computational simulation
  • Experience building simulators, surrogate models, or simulation-based environments and verifiers, and calibrating and validating them against real-world data
  • Experience with large-scale data pipelines and technical or multimodal datasets
  • Demonstrated ability to work across multiple domains, such as language modeling, systems engineering, and scientific computing

 

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$350,000—$500,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

 

Senior DevOps Engineer 

 

Redwood Materials is looking for motivated and talented DevOps engineers to help architect, build, and deploy infrastructure and applications in a hybrid AWS and Kubernetes environment. These applications will cover use cases from web integrations with auto manufacturers to predictive machine controllers to new battery-based energy products. The ideal candidate is someone experienced with creating, managing, and supporting both AWS infrastructure and Kubernetes (self-hosted and AWS EKS based) using infrastructure-as-code tools. This is an opportunity to join during a critical growth phase and build green field software experiences and capabilities which will have a significant impact on the company’s day-to-day operations and ability to scale.

 

Responsibilities Will Include:

  • Leverage existing in-house AWS architectures and design new ones where needed, using the CDK tool kit to manage and create AWS resources.
  • Operationalize workloads in AWS and Kubernetes, helping to design and implement monitoring solutions and deployment pipelines.
  • Enhance existing and implement new build/test/deploy automated pipelines.
  • Partner with on-prem counterparts to drive hybrid infrastructure projects.
  • Apply industry best practices (automation through infrastructure-as-code, security, etc.)
  • Perform root cause analysis of production errors and resolve technical issues.
  • Author and maintain detailed design documents and system architecture diagrams.

 

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, similar technical field of study, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience as a DevOps engineer or in a similar software engineering role developing solutions in AWS.
  • Similar hands-on experience deploying and managing Kubernetes workloads.
  • Solid knowledge and experience with AWS services: IAM, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, VPC, DynamoDB, etc.
  • Solid knowledge and experience with Kubernetes and containerization: configuring and managing clusters, helm chart development and deployment, building containers, working with docker, etc.
  • Experience automating AWS solutions using infrastructure-as-code tools, such as CDK, Terraform, CloudFormation, etc.
  • Fluency in Python strongly desired.
  • Experience with Linux, Git.
  • An understanding of security best practices, and the experience, to know when and where to apply them.
  • Working knowledge of databases (relational and non-relational) a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage production workloads (debugging, monitoring, alerting).

 

Working Conditions:

  • Infrequent night/weekend work if production systems are down and require immediate attention. (No formal on-call rotation; part of shared team responsibility.)

 

The position is full-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

jobs.title: Political Economist, Rule of Law
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY; Washington, DC
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic has done pioneering work examining the economic impacts of AI. The AI & Rule of Law team takes an analogous approach to a different question: how will AI affect our constitutional democratic institutions?

Increasingly powerful AI systems will put pressure on societal functions at every level — the courts, legislatures, electoral systems, oversight bodies, and the legal frameworks that hold democratic governance together. Our team exists to ask hard questions about those vulnerabilities, and to seek out strategies for protecting democratic freedoms — in the short and long term, through both technical and policy levers.

This is early, high-stakes research. The team is small, the problems are genuinely unsolved, and the work will matter.

We are looking for someone with deep expertise in both AI and at least one of: government, political science, or public policy. The ideal candidate understands the technical landscape well enough to reason about AI capabilities and risks, and understands democratic institutions well enough to see where those risks become structural threats.

Key responsibilities

Projects on this team are illustrative rather than fixed — we expect the research agenda to evolve as both AI capabilities and institutional pressures change. Current and expected focus areas include:

  • Making fundamental contributions to the development and expansion of our public data and research on how people use AI for politics, including regular reports and deep dives on elections and policy topics, and grow into leading this work over time
  • Designing and conduct empirical research on AI’s political effects, drawing on external data sources and the privacy-preserving measurement systems internally
  • Designing, running, and analyzing experiments on systems of many AI agents, testing whether and when tools from political economy (rules, monitoring, voting, dispute resolution) help agents govern themselves and stay under human oversight
  • Developing new methodological approaches for studying AI’s impact on:
  • Developing measurement and causal-inference tooling to help Anthropic evaluate the downstream political consequences of its own training, product, and policy decisions
  • Building and maintaining relationships with academic institutions, policy think tanks, and other research partners, and serve as the point of contact for outside researchers who use our data
  • Working cross-functionally with other technical teams to improve our measurement infrastructure and data collection
  • Translating research insights into actionable recommendations for model training, product decisions, and policy discussions
  • Amplifying external engagement through research publications, policy briefs, convenings, and presentations to diverse stakeholders

Minimum qualifications

  • A primary degree in political science, or a closely related field at the Ph.D. level
  • A computational research background in Political Science, Economics, or a related field
  • Demonstrated ability to produce rigorous, public-facing work — scholarship, policy analysis, government output, or a published body of writing

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience relevant to the study of AI’s impact on politics
  • Track record of empirical research, particularly studies combining novel data sources and game theory or those implementing frontier methods in causal inference
  • Comfort operating with significant autonomy in an environment where the problems are new and the playbook is still being written
  • At least five years of relevant experience in academia, industry, or government

 

Some Examples of Our Recent Work

  • Preparing for the 2026 US midterms

  • Measuring political bias in Claude

  • Clio: Privacy-preserving insights into AI use

  • Introducing The Anthropic Institute

 

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$295,000—$345,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Maneuver Dominance team at Anduril develops operationally relevant, multi-asset autonomy. We are focused on new air vehicle development programs, and making large groups of autonomous systems work effectively together.

Within the Maneuver Dominance team, we are growing an early-stage, undisclosed autonomous air vehicle (AAV) program at our Costa Mesa HQ. This team is chartered with re-inventing an existing platform through heavy modification and integration of advanced autonomy, mission systems, and payloads.

On this team, you will be tackling novel challenges across airframe, structures, avionics, and software from day one. As part of this program, you'll work alongside a tight-knit group of mechanical, structural, electrical, and software engineers, together with Program Leads and the Engineering team, all embedded in a single team driving toward major milestones.

You will work in a lean, high-ownership culture where the entire vehicle team sits side-by-side, iterating quickly and making decisions in real time. Given the early stage of the program, you will have influence over foundational architecture decisions and the opportunity to redefine an existing platform.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril is seeking a Systems Engineer to join our rapid growing team in Costa Mesa, CA. As a Systems Engineer on the Maneuver Dominance team, you’ll be responsible for bringing a next-generation autonomous Group 5 Rotorcraft from concept to reality. You will:

  • Develop System Definition: Own the system end-to-end by defining its behavior, interfaces, and architecture while communicating critical issues/gaps to the broader team and leadership
  • Maintain Technical Baseline(s): Enforce configuration control, requirements traceability, and risk management across the system lifecycle, ensuring the team is always working against a known, controlled technical baseline. Any variant modeling/deviation will need to be captured
  • Help Develop Test Planning, Execution, and Validation: Assist in defining the technical test approach, pass/fail criteria, and test procedures needed to prove the system meets operational requirements, and help make the engineering call on whether results demonstrate readiness
  • Lead Milestone and Gate reviews: Own the technical content and outcome of System Requirements Reviews (SRR), Conceptual Design Reviews (CoDR), Preliminary Design Reviews (PDR), Critical Design Reviews (CDR), and Test Readiness Reviews (TRR), determining whether the system is technically ready to proceed at each stage.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Help deploy right-sized, Agile Systems Engineering governance to enable rapid development while maintaining process discipline.
  • Work with customers and end-users to evolve the Concept of Operations (CONOPS) and define high-level requirements that inform key design decisions.
  • Help develop and manage system requirements baseline, tracing from program-level needs down to subsystem specifications.
  • Actively manage all system interfaces, maintaining Interface Control Documents (ICDs) and leading the change control process across subsystem teams.
  • Help incorporate the execution of a "test-as-a-design-tool" philosophy to mature components, subsystems, and the full vehicle through a structured verification campaign.
  • Define and execute the system verification and validation plan, including the development and maintenance of the requirements verification matrix.
  • Troubleshoot conflicting design requirements and drive technical solutions between engineering teams.
  • Prepare and present the technical data required to successfully pass major design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR, etc.).

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent
  • 3+ years in systems engineering on complex hardware and software vehicles, in civil and defense applications
  • Experience owning requirements and interface baselines across multiple subsystem teams
  • Experience planning and executing verification campaigns on physical hardware
  • Ability to travel to support program and test events (up to 25 percent)
  • U.S. Person status (citizenship or lawful permanent residency) required for ITAR and export controlled work
  • Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Top Secret clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Hands-on experience architecture full-rotorcraft systems incl. hybrid/electric powertrains on high-performance Group4/5 Tactical UAS
  • Familiar with Model-based Product Line Engineering (MBPLE) and ISO 26262
  • Experience and familiar with relevant testing MIL-STDs such as MIL-STD-810H, MIL-STD-461/464
  • Experience and familiar with safety standards MIL-STD-882E, MIL-HDBK-464
  • Experience in defense or aerospace robotic platforms
  • Familiarity with MBSE tooling (SysML v1.X, SysML v2, Cameo Systems Modeler, JAMA Connect, DOORS, DOORS Next Gen, or similar)
  • Experience implementing MBSE Methodologies such as OOSEM, MagicGRID, and other object-oriented approaches

Benefits

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. 

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Support Engineer- Windows & Identity Security
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Senior Technical Support Engineer - Windows & Identity Security, you will be tasked with providing responsive, high-quality technical assistance to enterprise and public sector customers across our growing global customer base, by investigating and resolving technical issues primarily across Windows, Identity, networking, and security environments. Your role will be about more than just responding to tickets: successful Support Engineers at SentinelOne combine technical curiosity, disciplined troubleshooting, customer empathy, and a desire to continuously increase what can be solved at the frontline (e.g. by contributing to the collective knowledge of the Support organization, improving documentation and identifying repeatable solutions).

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Provide customer support (through phone, email, chat, and other Support channels) that meets the established response and resolution service levels.
  • Troubleshoot deep technical issues across SentinelOne products and supported operating environments (including investigating crash dumps).

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. jobs.title: Staff Product Manager
jobs.description:
Joining Collibra’s AI Product Management team

Collibra’s AI Product Management team sets how we build AI into our platform and how we help customers govern and trust their own AI systems. You will work with the Director of AI Engineering to shape our AI strategy and roadmap, and with Product and Engineering leaders to ship AI features customers use. You will report directly to the Vice President, Product Management. This role is needed now because AI is central to Collibra’s strategy, and you will help define what responsible, enterprise-grade AI looks like in data governance.

This is a hybrid role based in our New York office. Our hybrid model means you’ll work from the office at least two days each week. This setup helps us stay connected, work more closely together, and keep making progress as a team.

Staff Product Managers, AI at Collibra are responsible for

  • Defining Collibra’s AI product strategy and 12-month roadmap with the Director of AI Engineering and Product and Engineering leaders, so AI investments stay focused on where customers and the market are heading.
  • Co-authoring customer-facing AI features from problem framing through launch and adoption, working directly with customers on challenges such as data management restrictions and custom AI models, so features solve real problems and get used.
  • Leading evaluation of AI models and approaches with Engineering, for both internal use and the customer platform (central model evaluation, platform AI testing, emerging AI paradigms), so Collibra builds on the most capable and appropriate foundation.
  • Setting responsible AI standards with Engineering, Legal, and Security, including a pre-launch review for AI features, so what we ship meets our standards for quality, transparency, and compliance.

 

You have

  • 5+ years of product management experience.
  • Experience working on AI or ML-powered software, including taking an AI or ML feature from design to launch with engineers.
  • Experience presenting product strategy to senior or executive leadership.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in leveraging AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, Copilot) to solve real-world business challenges, drive measurable outcomes, or streamline workflows.
  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent related working experience.
  • This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

 

You are

  • A product leader with strong AI/ML technical fluency, who weighs model and provider options on cost, latency, quality, and data-handling constraints and questions technical claims directly
  • An owner who defines what “good” means for an AI feature before it is built, including evaluation criteria, guardrails, and applicable data restrictions
  • A problem-first prioritizer who separates real customer problems from impressive demos and is comfortable saying no to AI work that won’t pay off
  • A clear communicator who explains the same tradeoff to Engineers, Legal, Sales, and executives, adjusting the framing while keeping the substance the same
  • A fast mover in a changing field who holds the line on governance and security standards

Measures of success

  • Within your first month, you will learn Collibra’s platform, AI roadmap, and current AI releases, and meet the Director of AI Engineering, Product and Engineering leaders, and Legal and Security partners.
  • Within your third month, you will draft the AI strategy and 12-month roadmap with a named owner for each initiative, and document key platform architecture decisions (such as the MCP gateway and proxy hosting path) with their tradeoffs.
  • Within your sixth month, you will have the AI strategy and roadmap approved by the Executive Committee, in-flight AI features shipping on committed dates or scope, and a pre-launch AI review in place with Legal and Security that every feature released since has passed.

Compensation for this role  

The standard base salary range for this position is $204,000-255,000 per year. This position is not eligible for additional commission-based compensation. Salary offers are based on a combination of factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skills, and location.

In addition to base salary, we offer equity ownership at every level, bonus potential, a Flex Fund monthly stipend, pension/401k plans, and more.

 

 

Benefits at Collibra

Collibra recognizes and values that everyone has different needs, interests, and life goals. We built our benefits program with flexibility in mind to support you and your loved ones through a diverse range of circumstances and life events. These flexible offerings sit on a foundation of competitive compensation, health coverage, and time off. Learn more about Collibra’s benefits.

We create inclusion and belonging through how we onboard, meet, connect, engage, and communicate. Learn more about diversity, equity, and inclusion at Collibra.

At Collibra, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We realize the key to creating a company with a world-class culture and employee experience comes from who we hire and creating a workplace that celebrates everyone.

With this, we proudly consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, sex, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, physical or mental disability, HIV status, registered domestic partner status, caregiver status, marital status, veteran or military status, citizenship status or any other legally protected category. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Agentic Search
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Locations: Austin, Lisbon, San Francisco, NYC, or London

About the Role

Search is being rebuilt around AI. People increasingly get answers from AI instead of a list of links, agents run dozens of searches to answer a single question, and more than half of the traffic reaching sites on Cloudflare is now automated. Search is shifting from a destination to a utility, and Cloudflare is building the search layer for this agentic Internet.

Agentic Search at Cloudflare gives agents everything they need to find information, whether it lives in a customer’s own data or on the open web. It spans two products: AI Search for internal data, and Web Search API for the open web.

AI Search (internal data), now generally available, is the search primitive for applications and agents. It is a fully managed indexing and retrieval pipeline built on Workers AI, Vectorize, R2, and Browser Run. Developers connect a website or R2 bucket, or upload their own files, and query them with natural language through a Workers binding, REST API, or MCP server. Under the hood: continuous indexing, hybrid vector and keyword retrieval, reranking, metadata filtering, native multimodal (image) embeddings, and OCR for scanned documents. We use it to power search on our own blog and developer docs.

Web Search API (external data), now in open beta, gives agents real-time web context with a single API call. It runs on AI Gateway, so every search gets the same logging, analytics, billing, and access controls as model inference. Developers can choose from multiple search providers and always get results back in one normalized format.

Your mission in this role is to make Cloudflare the default place developers and agents go to search, across both their own data and the open web, and eventually in a single call. You’ll also help build a search ecosystem that works for AI companies, site owners, and creators alike.

What You’ll Do

  • Talk directly with developers, AI companies, publishers, and customers every day.
  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for Agentic Search (AI Search and Web Search API), from ingestion and indexing through retrieval, ranking, and answer generation.
  • Define and measure what “good search” means, including relevance, freshness, latency, and cost, and build the evals that improve it with every release.
  • Scale AI Search for the workloads that matter most, like multi-tenant platforms, enterprise agents, and website search, with support for billions of documents, rich media, and built-in observability.
  • Take Web Search API and shape what comes next: provider partnerships, search and page extraction in one call, blending web and private data,
  • Own pricing and packaging, and make our products first-class for agents through MCP, agent-friendly APIs, and templates like NLWeb.
  • Partner with engineering, ML, and product teams across Workers AI, Vectorize, AI Gateway, Browser Run, and AI Crawl Control, as well as Marketing, DevRel, BD, Sales, and Support.
  • Represent Cloudflare at conferences, community events, and customer and partner meetings.

Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

  • Proven experience as a PM, EM, or founder shipping search, information retrieval, data infrastructure, or developer platform products. You’ve led teams to ship before and can point to impact.
  • Deep understanding of how search works end to end: crawling, indexing, chunking, embeddings, hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vector), query rewriting, reranking, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). You understand the tradeoffs between relevance, freshness, latency, and cost.
  • Experience defining and measuring search quality, including offline evals, relevance judgments, metrics like recall, MRR, and NDCG, and online experimentation.
  • Fluency in the modern AI ecosystem: LLMs, text and multimodal embedding models, agents, tool calling, and MCP. You’ve built with them yourself and know where they break.
  • Hands-on ability to write code and use AI and the Internet to learn new things fast. You’ve built a RAG pipeline or an agent that searches the web, and you have opinions about what made it good or bad.
  • Deep empathy for developers and understanding of their workflows, pain points, and how they adopt new tools and platforms.
  • Understanding of the web publishing ecosystem: crawlers, bots, SEO and answer engine optimization (AEO), and the changing economics of AI search for content creators. Comfortable working where technology, business, and policy meet.
  • Experience with usage-based pricing, two-sided marketplaces, or partner and business development relationships, including build-vs-partner decisions, is a plus.

jobs.title: Senior HR Business Partner
jobs.description:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

Position Summary: 

The Senior Human Resources Business Partner (Senior HRBP) is a fully qualified, experienced HR professional who serves as a trusted advisor to leaders and managers. This role applies complete knowledge of HR principles, practices, and employment standards to address a wide range of people and organizational issues. Operating with independence, the Senior HRBP assesses complex and sometimes unusual situations, evaluates identifiable factors, and adapts established HR approaches to deliver practical, sound solutions aligned with business objectives. 

This is a fully on-site role based at 100 Hooper in San Francisco. Work is performed independently, with review at key decision points, and requires strong judgment, influencing skills, and the ability to advise leaders on difficult or sensitive matters. 

Responsibilities 

  • Partner with managers and leaders to support day-to-day people strategy aligned with organizational priorities and operational goals 
  • Apply in-depth knowledge of HR principles, employment practices, and policies to resolve a broad range of employee relations, performance, and workforce issues 
  • Independently devise and implement HR solutions, adapting existing practices to meet evolving business and employee needs, with review at key decision points 
  • Coach and guide leaders on performance management, employee engagement, development, and workplace concerns 
  • Collaborate with internal partners (e.g., Legal, Talent, Total Rewards, HR Ops) to build effective working relationships and deliver integrated solutions 
  • Advise leaders and peers on difficult or sensitive matters, exercising sound judgment and professional discretion 
  • Ensure HR actions, recommendations, and decisions are consistent with company policies, values, and employment obligation

Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities  

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources or a related field, or equivalent experience in lieu of a degree, with 5+ years of relevant experience 
  • Complete knowledge and understanding of Human Resources principles, employment practices, and organizational policies, including strong working knowledge of San Francisco and California employment law 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess complex situations, synthesize information, and determine appropriate courses of action using sound judgment 
  • Demonstrated ability to adapt established approaches when precedent or guidance is limited, working independently and managing priorities with minimal oversight while seeking review at critical points 

In accordance with California pay transparency laws, the salary range for this position is listed below. Actual compensation may vary based on a variety of factors, including experience, education, and skills. 

California Pay Range:
$115,000—$152,500 USD

The position is full-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

Position Summary:

The Lead Abuse Testing Technician IV is a highly skilled lead role responsible for high-voltage battery abuse testing, teardown, and failure analysis. The role performs safety-critical test procedures on battery modules and packs and leads the day-to-day work of the technician team by delegating assignments in JIRA, applying work priorities, and removing blockers. The role partners with engineers and safety teams and coaches with less experienced technicians, with formal supervisory authority. This is a fully on-site role at McCarran, NV.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Leads the daily work of the abuse testing technician team, delegating assignments from JIRA and tracking progress to completion
  • Applies work priorities set by engineering and test leadership to sequence team assignments and adjusts as priorities shift
  • Resolves technical, equipment, and logistical blockers to keep testing and teardown work moving, coaching less experienced technicians and escalating to engineers and safety teams as needed
  • Performs thermal, electrical, and mechanical abuse tests and teardowns on battery modules and packs to analyze internal components, failure modes, and degradation patterns
  • Installs sensors, instrumentation, and harnessing on battery packs and test fixtures and verifies setups for accurate, repeatable testing
  • Documents test results with detailed notes, photos, and reports and supports data collection and analysis for performance and safety evaluations
  • Enforces high-voltage safety protocols and PPE requirements and maintains a clean, organized test lab with tools and equipment properly stored          

Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities 

  • Bachelor’s degree and/or 5+ years of relevant work experience
  • Experience in a managerial, supervisory, or lead role, including delegating and prioritizing work for a technical team, with working knowledge of JIRA or similar work-tracking tools
  • Working knowledge of high-voltage systems, battery modules, or power electronics, with hands-on mechanical assembly, disassembly, and electrical harnessing experience
  • Knowledge of safety procedures and PPE requirements for hazardous materials and high-voltage environments
  • Ability to read and follow technical drawings, schematics, and written test procedures and to record test results accurately
  • Experience with multimeters, oscilloscopes, and other electrical testing equipment; prior battery testing, automotive, aerospace, or energy storage experience preferred

Physical requirements:

  • Ability to lift and work with hand tools for extended periods.

Working conditions: 

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment with shifting priorities.

The position is full-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

jobs.title: Technical Writer II
jobs.description:
Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization.We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey.
  • We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses.
  • We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey.
  • We're designing the future of autonomous marketing, taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do.
And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.

We’re looking for a Technical Writer to join our PX Content Team and help shape a great developer and user experience through clear, consistent, and accessible documentation, written for people and AI systems alike.

You can work from anywhere in Slovakia or the Czech Republic, with offices available in Bratislava, Brno, or Prague. We offer a competitive salary that reflects your expertise and impact. The base salary range for this position is. The pay range actually offered will take into account a variety of potential factors considered in compensation, including but not limited to skills, qualifications, geographic location, accomplishments, experience, credentials, internal equity and business needs, and may vary from the range listed above.

About the role

The PX Content team organizes and maintains knowledge about our product, from feature documentation to business use cases that help clients use Bloomreach independently. Our documentation is the single source of truth for clients, partners, prospects, and internal teams. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Support, Client Services, and Sales in a multinational environment.

You don’t need to know our platform or the ecommerce world on day one. Curiosity and good writing instincts matter most, and you’ll build the rest with the team.

What you'll do

  • Make APIs easy to use: Create and maintain clear documentation for features and guides, with API documentation at the core: references, integration guides, code examples, and release notes. Work from OpenAPI specs and try calls yourself, so the docs reflect how the product really behaves.
  • Walk in the user’s shoes: Run through API setup and integration flows, anticipate users’ questions, and spot where docs, error messages, or naming could make a user’s life easier.
  • Write for people and machines: Create documentation that works for a developer mid-integration and for the AI assistants and search tools that retrieve it. Our AI writing assistant is there to help.
  • Work like our developers do: Author in Markdown and use GitHub pull requests for reviews and publishing.
  • Keep quality high together: Collaborate with teams across the company to improve documentation based on priorities and real-world feedback. 

Why you'll love this role

  • Learn by doing: You’ll build deep product knowledge and explore the ecommerce industry with the support of experienced colleagues.
  • Get close to the tech: You’ll work side by side with engineers and the product, learning how our APIs, integrations, and developer tools fit together.
  • AI in your daily work: You’ll use AI tools every day and help shape how documentation serves both people and AI systems.
  • Consulting-like experience: You’ll work with several teams, grow your influence, and sharpen your problem-solving and structuring skills as you turn complex technical concepts into clear, user-friendly guidance.
  • Visible impact: Your work will be used directly by clients, partners, and Bloomreachers, helping them succeed faster.
  • Collaborative culture: You’ll join a friendly, motivated team that values curiosity, ownership, and clear communication.

What we're looking for

  • Curiosity and initiative: You enjoy learning new things, digging into how things work, and gathering information from colleagues across teams. You’re happy to ask questions along the way.
  • Excellent written English: You explain complex ideas clearly, concisely, and accurately.
  • Collaborative mindset: You’re a team player who works well across functions.
  • Documentation experience: A couple of years writing product documentation, user guides, and release notes for software. 
  • Technical foundations: You can read API documentation, have a basic grasp of REST and JSON, and use Git/GitHub. 
  • Practical AI user: You already use LLMs in your day-to-day work and have a feel for where they help and where they don’t.
  • Attention to detail: You catch inconsistencies and gaps, and you check facts against the product before anything goes out.

#LI-KP1

More things you'll like about Bloomreach:

Culture:

  • A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one. 
  • We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication. 
  • We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style.
  • We work virtual-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents.
  • We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead.
  • We encourage and support our employees to engage in volunteering activities - every Bloomreacher can take 5 paid days off to volunteer*.
  • The Bloomreach Glassdoor page elaborates on our stellar 4.7/5 rating. The Bloomreach Comparably page Culture score is even higher at 4.9/5

Personal Development:

  • We have a People Development Program - participating in personal development workshops on various topics run by experts from inside the company. We are continuously developing & updating competency maps for select functions.
  • Our resident communication coach Ivo Večeřa is available to help navigate work-related communications & decision-making challenges.*
  • Our managers are strongly encouraged to participate in the Leader Development Program to develop in the areas we consider essential for any leader. The program includes regular comprehensive feedback, consultations with a coach and follow-up check-ins.
  • Bloomreachers utilize the $1,500 professional education budget on an annual basis to purchase education products (books, courses, certifications, etc.)*

Well-being:

  • The Employee Assistance Program -- with counselors -- is available for non-work-related challenges.*
  • Subscription to Calm - sleep and meditation app.*
  • We organize ‘DisConnect’ days where Bloomreachers globally enjoy one additional day off each quarter, allowing us to unwind together and focus on activities away from the screen with our loved ones.

jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Dubai, UAE

About the role

The Inside Sales Representative (ISR) is a critical sales role responsible for driving high-volume, high-velocity net new business acquisition sales in a remote selling model within the commercial segment across EMEA. Operating as full-cycle territory owners similar to an AE, ISR manages the end-to-end sales process from self-sourcing pipeline, qualifying opportunities and closing deals in partnership with SE and Partner Organisation

What you'll do

  • Build your own pipeline: Find new business across your assigned territory through high-volume outreach by phone, email, LinkedIn and social selling, using tools like Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo and AI outreach
  • Run the whole sales cycle remotely: Lead discovery and qualification calls using MEDDPIC, give engaging virtual presentations and live product demos, and negotiate and close new business against an ACV quota.
  • Explain the value of Cloudflare's platform: Connect commercial-segment customers' business and technical problems to the right Cloudflare products, such as Application Security and Performance, Zero Trust/SASE and the Developer Platform, and show the value they'd get.
  • Work closely with other teams: Partner with Solutions Engineers on technical validation, and with the Partner Organisation to co-sell and close deals faster. Work with Marketing and BDR teammates on campaigns and events that create pipeline.
  • Run your territory with data: Keep your Salesforce pipeline accurate and your forecasts reliable, track your activity and conversion numbers, and use what you learn to consistently meet or exceed your targets

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:

  • 1 - 3 years of experience in a sales role, preferably in SaaS or tech sales, such as: 
    • BDR/SDR background with strong outbound experience in a high-paced environment
    • SMB or Transactional sales experience with high volume, high velocity sales motion
  • Strong track record of meeting or exceeding quota 
  • Strong discovery and qualification skills using frameworks like BANT, MEDDIC 
  • Excellent presentation and interpersonal communication skills (verbal and written) as well as time management skill
  • Experience using CRM like Salesforce, outbound/prospecting sales tools (e.g. LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Salesforce Sales Engagement Outreach etc)
  • Tech-savvy and technically curious - quick to learn technical products, comfortable to run live demos independently, data-driven mindset  
  • Highly accountable and self-driven, customer-centric individuals
  • Multilingual abilities (depending on the coverage regions)

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.
