jobs.description:
Job Description This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to Warren Global Technical Center or Austin Technical Center three times per week, at minimum [or other frequency dictated by the business if more than 3 days]. The Role We are seeking a highly skilled Staff Privacy by Design engineer to build and operate modern, cloud-native enterprise applications that support critical Data Privacy initiatives. This is a purely individual-contributor role focused on delivering reliable features and services within the team’s roadmap and established technical direction. Strong software engineering is the primary qualification. Data Privacy knowledge is useful, but prior privacy experience is not required. You will work with product managers, Legal, privacy partners, architects, and engineers to understand requirements and implement secure, maintainable solutions. You will own the implementation and operational readiness of your assigned work, contribute to design decisions for the components you build, and collaborate with the team when changes cross service or system boundaries. This role does not include people-management responsibilities or ownership of team-wide architecture or technical strategy. Deliver assigned features and services from requirements clarification and implementation through testing, deployment, observability, and production support. Implement solutions within established architecture, patterns, and team standards; contribute to component-level designs and raise technical tradeoffs or concerns. Work with product, Legal, privacy partners, and teammates to translate Data Privacy and business requirements into clear implementation tasks. Build secure, reliable services using Azure capabilities, container-based workloads, and cloud-native patterns. Apply event-driven architecture and messaging or streaming platforms such as Kafka or Azure Event Hubs. Work with relational and NoSQL databases, selecting suitable data patterns for the feature or service. Write and maintain automated tests, participate in code reviews, and document relevant implementation and operational details. Use CI/CD pipelines, automation, Git-based workflows, and DevOps practices to support reliable delivery. Use logging, metrics, and tracing to monitor the components you own, investigate issues, and identify practical improvements. Apply applicable data-handling, access, retention, and protection requirements in collaboration with the relevant partners. Use AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully while maintaining code quality, security, and engineering judgment. Communicate progress, dependencies, and risks; coordinate with teammates to resolve issues and deliver committed work. Identify and suggest improvements to the code, tooling, and practices used by the team. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical field, or equivalent demonstrable professional software engineering experience. Practical experience with Microsoft Azure, preferably including container-based workloads. Experience with event-driven architectures, messaging, and streaming platforms such as Kafka, Event Hubs, or similar. Experience with Kubernetes (AKS) or similar for container orchestration, deployment, and scaling. Working knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL, Redis, or Cassandra. Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and Git-based workflows. Understanding of cloud-native architectures, distributed systems, resiliency, and scalability patterns. Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments. Hands-on experience with observability tooling, including logging, metrics, and tracing. Demonstrated ability to independently deliver assigned software work, collaborate effectively, and raise risks or dependencies early. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a bias toward action, ownership, and pragmatic delivery. Ability to communicate technical information clearly with engineering teammates and cross-functional partners. Experience designing or operating highly available production systems. Practical experience with security best practices, including OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, and secrets management. Experience modernizing legacy or monolithic applications into microservices and cloud-native architectures. Experience collaborating with Legal, product, security, privacy, or other cross-functional partners. This job may be eligible for relocation benefits. jobs.description:
Job Description The Team: The MSP (Mechatronic Software Platform) organization is responsible for building and operating the common mechatronic software platform that underpins GM’s SDV strategy, and GM Basic Software is a core part of that foundation. General Motors Basic Software (GMBSW) delivered by the MSP group provides a standardized, software foundation that enables reliable integration, deterministic execution, cybersecurity, functional safety, and long-term maintainability across GM’s ECU ecosystem. The Role: The Engineering Group Leader– BSW leads a team of engineers responsible for defining, delivering, evolving, and supporting GMBSW capabilities across the MSP portfolio, including foundational areas such as HWIO/MCAL/RTOS, communication, cyber, diagnostics, data management, programming/boot, RTE, safety, system services, and vehicle/micro moding. This leader aligns BSW strategy and execution with portfolio needs, partners closely with HWIO, integration, validation, and application teams, and ensures GMBSW remains production-ready, reusable, scalable, and fit for current and emerging programs such as MSP-supported MCU platforms. The EGL creates an inclusive, high-performing team culture, develops talent, drives alignment and clear direction, challenges the status quo to improve efficiency and quality, and helps translate MSP portfolio priorities into strong technical execution and dependable customer support. What You'll Do (Responsibilities): People & Team Leadership Lead, coach, and develop a team of BSW engineers, providing clear goals, feedback, and growth opportunities across technical depth, delivery, and leadership behaviors. Build an inclusive, psychologically safe culture that encourages ownership, collaboration, healthy challenge, and continuous learning. Set clear priorities and decision criteria for the team, balancing strategic platform investments, product commitments, and support demands across the MSP portfolio. Model a service-oriented leadership style focused on enabling partner teams and removing obstacles so teams can deliver high-quality software faster. Technical & Product Leadership Own delivery strategy, scope, and execution for assigned GMBSW areas, ensuring alignment to MSP portfolio priorities, ECU roadmaps, and program timing needs. Define and evolve reusable BSW solutions that support GM’s standardized software foundation across domains, programs, and generations. Drive technical direction for BSW components spanning platform infrastructure such as HWIO/MCAL/RTOS, communications, cyber, diagnostics, memory/data services, programming/boot, RTE, safety, and core system services. Ensure BSW solutions are modular, maintainable, production-proven, and architected for reuse rather than one-off program customization. Portfolio & Program Execution Partner with portfolio, architecture, HWIO, integration, validation, and application teams to align BSW delivery with platform and vehicle program needs. Support new platform and program needs by assessing fit, identifying gaps, and shaping pragmatic plans for delivery, reuse, and ownership boundaries. Drive clarity on interfaces and responsibilities across MSP, suppliers, and partner organizations, especially where GMBSW is delivered by MSP while build, integration, or adjacent software ownership sits elsewhere. Balance strategic roadmap work with responsive support for active portfolio initiatives and new builds. Quality, Safety, Cybersecurity, and Release Readiness Ensure BSW products meet expectations for reliability, deterministic behavior, security, safety, and maintainability. Drive strong engineering practices for verification, defect management, issue triage, and root-cause resolution across owned BSW areas. Establish quality gates, readiness criteria, and technical review mechanisms appropriate for foundational platform software used across multiple programs. Use data and technical judgment to make timely tradeoff decisions on scope, risk, quality, and delivery timing. Process Improvement & Operational Excellence Drive continuous improvement in BSW development, configuration, automation, and release workflows to reduce friction and improve speed and quality. Improve reuse, standardization, and scalability of GMBSW solutions across the MSP portfolio. Capture and scale best practices across teams and product areas, and help the organization find the way forward in ambiguous or changing situations. Contribute to long-term BSW strategy, including where to invest in platform capabilities, automation, and support for new initiatives. Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications): Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or related technical field. Significant professional experience (typically 8+ years) in: Automotive or embedded software development, preferably in platform, infrastructure, or basic software domains. AUTOSAR-based systems and foundational ECU software such as drivers, communication stacks, diagnostics, boot/programming, memory, safety, cyber, or system services. Proven experience leading technical teams: Prior people-lead role, technical lead role, or equivalent leadership of cross-functional software efforts. Demonstrated ability to set direction, prioritize work, and deliver on commitments. Strong understanding of: Embedded software architecture, software platform layering, and hardware abstraction concepts. Build, configuration, release, and lifecycle management practices for reusable platform software. At least one systems-level programming language such as C or C++, with familiarity in scripting/automation languages used in engineering workflows. Demonstrated ability to analyze complex technical issues, work across organizational boundaries, and resolve blockers with sound judgment. People Skills: Ownership mindset with strong accountability for product quality, technical direction, and delivery outcomes. Comfortable operating in complex, ambiguous environments and making decisions with imperfect information. Collaborative and inclusive leader who seeks diverse input and builds strong partnerships across functions. Passion for improving engineering systems, reducing friction, and enabling others to succeed through a strong platform foundation. Decisive, data-informed, and willing to challenge the status quo to improve speed, quality, and customer value. What Will Give You A Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications): Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field. Prior experience as an EGL, SWIM, or equivalent line manager in a complex multi-team software organization. Experience within a Software Defined Vehicle or similar large-scale platform environment. Hands-on experience with AUTOSAR BSW domains such as communication, diagnostics, programming/boot, safety, cyber, memory/data services, RTE, and low-level platform software. Experience supporting cross-portfolio platform needs where ownership spans MSP, suppliers, integration teams, and application organizations. Strong track record of driving automation, standardization, and engineering efficiency improvements. The Role We are seeking a highly skilled Privacy by Design Engineer to design, build, and evolve modern, cloud-native enterprise applications that power critical Data Privacy initiatives. This role is for a strong software engineer first; Data Privacy knowledge is valuable, but prior privacy experience is not required. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role for an engineer who can operate as both a technical driver and an architect. You will take ownership of complex initiatives from discovery and technical design through implementation, deployment, and ongoing operation. You will shape architecture and engineering direction, build scalable microservices and secure APIs using Java, Spring Boot, and Microsoft Azure, and partner closely with product managers, Legal, architects, and cross-functional teams to deliver business outcomes. You will lead through technical expertise and execution—not formal people management. You will help teams make sound engineering decisions, raise quality standards, and navigate complex problems in a fast-paced Agile environment. What You’ll Do Own the technical direction and end-to-end delivery of services and initiatives, from requirements and architecture through development, testing, deployment, observability, support, and continuous improvement. Design, develop, and evolve scalable microservices and RESTful APIs using Java and Spring Boot on Microsoft Azure. Make and communicate architecture decisions that balance business needs, security, reliability, scalability, maintainability, and delivery speed. Build secure, resilient services using Azure capabilities, container-based workloads, and cloud-native design patterns. Translate business needs into technical designs, implementation plans, and incremental delivery milestones in partnership with Legal, product teams, architects, and other stakeholders. Drive engineering work across team and organizational boundaries, resolve technical dependencies, and keep complex initiatives moving toward delivery. Apply event-driven architectures, messaging, and streaming platforms such as Kafka or Azure Event Hubs. Use CI/CD pipelines, automation, and DevOps practices to improve deployment quality and operational readiness. Apply relational and NoSQL databases, selecting appropriate technologies and data patterns for the use case. Establish and improve observability using logging, metrics, and tracing; use operational insights to guide continuous improvement. Use AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully to accelerate delivery while maintaining code quality, security, and engineering judgment. Lead technical design discussions, architecture forums, and code reviews; explain tradeoffs and help teams converge on effective solutions. Mentor and support other engineers through technical guidance, pairing, and knowledge sharing, without direct people-management responsibilities. Identify opportunities to improve engineering practices, tooling, and platform capabilities, and drive adoption of effective changes. Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications) 8+ years of professional software development experience building production-grade applications. Experience designing and operating large-scale, highly available systems in a global enterprise environment Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical field, or equivalent demonstrable professional software engineering experience. Demonstrated ability to coach and elevate engineers through technical guidance, mentoring, and pairing. Foster collaboration, psychological safety, and continuous learning through day-to-day technical leadership. Simplify complex problems and present a clear technical perspective to non-technical stakeholders. Strong hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot, including microservices-based architectures. Champion change and drive adoption of tools, patterns, and engineering practices. Proven experience designing, building, and consuming RESTful APIs. Practical experience with Microsoft Azure, preferably including container-based workloads. Strong experience with event-driven architectures, messaging, and streaming platforms such as Kafka, Event Hubs, or similar. Experience with Kubernetes (AKS) or similar for container orchestration, deployment, and scaling Working knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL, Redis, or Cassandra. Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and Git-based workflows. Solid understanding of cloud-native architectures, distributed systems, resiliency, and scalability patterns. Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments. Demonstrated ability to drive complex technical initiatives, lead design discussions, and influence architecture and engineering decisions through hands-on contribution. Hands-on experience with observability tooling, including logging, metrics, and tracing. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a bias toward action, ownership, and pragmatic delivery. Ability to communicate technical concepts and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. What Can Give You a Competitive Advantage (Preferred Qualifications) Data Privacy background or experience is helpful but not required; strong software engineering skills are the priority. Practical experience with security best practices, including OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, and secrets management. Experience modernizing legacy or monolithic applications into microservices and cloud-native architectures. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence across teams and levels. This job may be eligible for relocation benefits. jobs.title: Process Engineer
jobs.location: Romulus, Michigan, United States of America, United States of America
jobs.description:
Job Description The Role: The Process Engineer will develop, implement, and improve manufacturing processes, equipment, tooling, and operations to support safe, efficient production of high-quality parts. The Process Engineer works across manufacturing engineering and plant teams, applying technical judgment and independent problem-solving to improve process capability, material flow, equipment performance, and launch readiness. This role could be placed onto any shift (this is a 3 shift operation). What You'll Do (Responsibilities): Define and improve manufacturing processes, operation sequences, equipment, tooling, and material flow for assigned products, lines, stations, or technologies. Translate product and production requirements into practical process designs, equipment specifications, and implementation plans. Coordinate equipment and process design, build, integration, installation, validation, and launch activities with plant teams, suppliers, and cross-functional partners. Develop and maintain project scope, timing, milestones, risks, and issue-resolution plans; communicate progress and escalate barriers. Analyze production, quality, downtime, and process data to identify root causes and implement sustainable improvements. Apply lean manufacturing and GM manufacturing system principles to reduce waste and improve safety, quality, delivery, and cost. Incorporate human factors, ergonomics, and efficient use of people, materials, machines, and facilities into process decisions. Provide technical direction to suppliers and coordinate their work to meet process, equipment, timing, and quality requirements. Support new product and process launches, production trials, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement. Collaborate with product engineering, plant operations, quality, maintenance, controls, safety, and other manufacturing engineering teams. Document process decisions, requirements, open issues, and lessons learned; share technical knowledge with teammates. Processes and equipment are implemented to plan and meet production, quality, and operational needs. Manufacturing problems are addressed with effective root-cause analysis and lasting corrective actions. Improvements deliver measurable benefits to safety, quality, efficiency, material flow, or cost. Project status, decisions, risks, and technical requirements are clearly communicated. Work is completed with sound judgment, ownership, and collaboration across plant and engineering teams. Your Skills and Abilities (Required Qualifications): 2 years of engineering experience Bachelor's degree in engineering or equivalent experience Demonstrated analytical, problem-solving, communication, and interpersonal skills. Ability to manage assigned projects and deliver results with appropriate independence and accountability. Working knowledge of manufacturing processes, equipment, tooling, and production systems. Ability to build productive relationships with plant customers, engineering partners, and suppliers. MUST be able to work any shift and overtime What Can Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications): Experience working in a manufacturing environment 2+ years of experience as a Process Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer, or Mechanical Engineer Bachelor's degree in Engineering CNC programming experience Understanding of GD&T (Geometrical Dimensioning and Tolerancing)

jobs.title: Lab Group Manager, Manufacturing Research
jobs.location: Warren, Michigan, United States of America, United States of America
jobs.description:
Job Description At General Motors, our product teams are redefining mobility. Through a human-centered design process, we create vehicles and experiences that are designed not just to be seen, but to be felt. We’re turning today’s impossible into tomorrow’s standard —from breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design, intelligent software, and next-generation safety and entertainment features. Every day, our products move millions of people as we aim to make driving safer, smarter, and more connected, shaping the future of transportation on a global scale. As a Lab Group Manager in GM R&D, you’ll lead a team of scientists and engineers to invent and validate the next generation of manufacturing technologies that move us toward GM’s vision of zero crashes, zero emissions and zero congestion. You’ll be at the center of advanced manufacturing innovation, turning bold ideas into scalable solutions in GM’s global factories while growing a world-class team. You’ll partner closely with manufacturing engineering, product engineering and IT to anticipate future factory needs and shape a research portfolio that keeps GM on the leading edge of manufacturing. What you’ll do Set the vision and strategy for advanced manufacturing research in areas multiple disciplines Lead and grow a high-performing team of scientists, building both individual careers and the collective capabilities needed for GM’s future manufacturing systems. Design and oversee experiments and research programs that generate the data needed to validate new concepts and de-risk ambitious manufacturing ideas. Turn insights into impact through high-quality research reports, external publications and invention disclosures that capture new methods, tools and technologies. Build and manage a focused, high-leverage project portfolio that addresses GM’s most important manufacturing challenges while increasing team efficiency and throughput. Orchestrate internal and external capabilities from GM R&D labs to universities, government agencies, vendors and other collaborators to accelerate learning and impact. Champion a strong safety culture in the lab, ensuring hazards are communicated, procedures are followed and protective equipment is in place and effective. Serve as a scientific specialist in your field, leading technical discussions and reviews and communicating results and progress across the organization. Continuously expand your own skills and stay at the state of the art in robotics, automation and related manufacturing technologies. Additional leadership responsibilities Help make GM R&D a workplace of choice by aligning with HR systems and driving a strong culture of people development. Partner closely with the Director and peer leaders to shape and deliver on the broader organizational strategy. Clearly communicate technical challenges, insights and results to R&D leadership and GM executives through reports and presentations. Shape and execute an intellectual property strategy that protects and amplifies GM’s competitive advantage. Track industry and technology trends, provide sharp analysis on where the field is headed and identify new skills and proficiencies the organization will need next. Build influential relationships across GM engineering and represent GM R&D to the broader engineering community to advance strategic objectives. Bring an entrepreneurial mindset and strong execution skills, turning innovative ideas into visible value and results for the company. Requirements PhD in a Science or Engineering discipline, or a master’s degree in a relevant area plus 5–7 years of experience. Proven experience as both a technical leader and a people leader, with a track record of guiding teams through complex, multi-disciplinary challenges. Hands-on innovation management experience, from idea generation through validation and deployment. Deep expertise in manufacturing technology, including design, build and testing in high-volume environments. Ability to drive effective collaboration across diverse teams, peers, customers and external partners. In-depth knowledge of manufacturing with strong critical-thinking skills. If you’re energized by building what’s next in manufacturing and turning cutting-edge research into real-world impact at global scale, this role will put you at the heart of innovation at GM R&D.

jobs.title: Technical Specialist - Propulsion Hydraulics
jobs.location: Warren, Michigan, United States of America, United States of America
jobs.description:
Job Description The Role We are looking for an experienced engineer to lead the virtual development of propulsion hydraulic systems. This person will help hardware teams make better design decisions for engine coolant, oil and lubrication, ventilation and PCV, fuel systems, cam phasers, and transmission hydraulics. The role will use engineering models, test data, and sound engineering judgment to understand how these systems work, why they fail, and what should change. The work will support hardware design, reduce unnecessary physical testing, and provide models and methods for virtual calibration. The specialist will work closely with virtual engineering, test, hardware, controls, and calibration teams. This is a technical leadership role. The successful candidate will set direction for future virtual capabilities, lead difficult technical work, and influence decisions across the organization without needing direct authority over the teams involved. What You’ll Do Use models, test results, and engineering judgment to guide propulsion-hydraulics product design, including engine coolant, oil and lubrication, ventilation and PCV, fuel systems, cam-phaser hydraulics, and transmission hydraulics. Set the direction for future virtual capabilities, including better models, stronger engineering methods, reduced testing, virtual calibration, automation, and reuse across programs. Develop and improve models that capture system behavior, component behavior, and the physical causes of failure; use those models to support requirements, design reviews, and validation. Work with hardware engineering teams on architectures, component sizing, design tradeoffs, operating limits, failure modes, and design changes. Work with test teams to correlate models, plan focused testing, and determine where physical testing can be reduced without increasing product risk. Work with controls and calibration teams to provide models and methods that support virtual calibration and earlier engineering decisions. Bring virtual engineering, test, hardware, controls, and calibration teams together around difficult problems; communicate recommendations clearly, lead projects that improve our engineering methods and tools. Teach and mentor team members and customers on propulsion-hydraulics fundamentals, models, methods, and how to apply the results to product decisions. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent experience. Approximately 10 or more years of engineering experience in propulsion systems, fluid systems, hydraulics, modeling and simulation, design, testing, controls, calibration, or a related field. Strong understanding of propulsion fluid-system physics and experience applying that knowledge to engine, transmission, or vehicle development. Experience developing, using, reviewing, and correlating system-level models for fluid, hydraulic, or propulsion applications. Experience with one or more 1D or system-simulation tools such as GT-SUITE, AMESim, MATLAB/Simulink, Simscape, or equivalent. Experience leading difficult, cross-functional technical work from problem definition through implementation. Ability to explain complex technical issues clearly, make practical recommendations, and influence decisions without direct authority. Experience connecting simulation results with test data and product decisions, including understanding model limitations and uncertainty. Experience improving engineering methods, procedures, or tools and helping others use them consistently. Demonstrated behaviors aligned with Innovate Now, One Team, and Speak Fearlessly. Preferred Qualifications Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Fluid Mechanics, or a related field. Experience across multiple propulsion-hydraulics areas, including two or more of engine coolant, oil and lubrication, ventilation/PCV, fuel systems, cam phasers, and transmission hydraulics. Experience with engine or transmission controls development, calibration, verification, or validation. Experience executing a production vehicle or propulsion-system program. Experience with CFD, reduced-order modeling, co-simulation, controls interfaces, or hardware-in-the-loop / software-in-the-loop methods. Experience with Python, MATLAB scripting, automation, data analysis, or similar engineering productivity tools. Working knowledge of Siemens NX or other CAD tools and the ability to interpret component and system geometry. Experience with SABER or other multidomain modeling tools. DFSS Black Belt certification or equivalent structured problem-solving experience. What Success Looks Like Hardware teams use the analysis and recommendations to make better propulsion-hydraulics design decisions earlier in development. Models explain observed behavior and failure mechanisms well enough to guide design, testing, controls, and calibration decisions. Test teams can focus physical testing where it adds the most value, while well-correlated models support the rest. The team makes measurable progress toward virtual calibration and earlier virtual validation. Virtual, test, hardware, controls, and calibration teams trust one another’s data, methods, and recommendations. Useful models, procedures, and lessons learned are reused across programs instead of being recreated for each project. Other engineers grow their skills through the specialist’s coaching, technical guidance, and example

Through a human-centered design process, we create vehicles and experiences that are designed not just to be seen, but to be felt. We’re turning today’s impossible into tomorrow’s standard —from breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design, intelligent software, and next-generation safety and entertainment features. Every day, our products move millions of people as we aim to make driving safer, smarter, and more connected, shaping the future of transportation on a global scale. Join GM’s Global Propulsion Development & Validation team as a Lead Development & Validation Engineer. Based at the Pontiac Engineering Center, you will plan and execute hardware-level testing for transmission, hybrid, and plug-in hybrid programs; analyze results; and identify opportunities to reduce physical testing through analysis and virtual engineering. Success in this role calls for sound judgment, initiative, and strong collaboration across teams. What you’ll do Serve as the Development & Validation point of contact for assigned transmission, PHEV, or hybrid program teams. Own the Development & Validation portion of the ADV plan, including calibration controls, mechanical, lubrication and venting, oil management, and system-level plans. Align plans and timing with product changes. Initiate and coordinate testing to verify functional hardware requirements and calibrations, prioritizing resources as needed. jobs.title: Manager, AV Evaluation Framework
jobs.location: Sunnyvale, California, United States of America, United States of America
jobs.description:
Job Description Work Arrangement: This role is categorized as Remote/ hybrid . Remote: This role is based remotely but if you live within a 50-mile radius of [Austin, Detroit, Warren, Milford, Sunnyvale, CA ], you are expected to report to that location three times per week, at minimum. General Motors is a global leader in advanced driver assistance . With Super Cruise hands-free technology in more than 500,000 Super Cruise–equipped vehicles on the road and over 700 million hands-free miles driven, GM is proving that automation can be trusted, intuitive, and helpful. GM has the global reach to bring cutting-edge advances to everyday drivers at unprecedented scale. Join us to help deliver the next generation of safe and delightful personal autonomous vehicle experiences. About the Organization The Evaluation organization builds the platforms , frameworks, and engineering systems that enable the development, testing, and validation of GM’s autonomous driving technology. We partner across Autonomy, Simulation, Systems and Test Engineering, Embodied AI, and Release organizations to turn large-scale road and simulation data into actionable insights and confident engineering decisions. The Evaluation Frameworks team develops and operates the analytical frameworks that transform autonomous vehicle data into trustworthy metrics. Our tools support simulation analysis, road-event monitoring, data mining, model and feature evaluation, and release de-risking across the AV development lifecycle. The team owns shared capabilities including metrics authoring APIs, simulation-analysis orchestration, data augmentation and miner frameworks, road and simulation execution pipelines, and health monitoring for the resulting data products. We are focused on making metrics development faster, more reliable, and more accessible to engineering and evaluation teams. We are looking for a Manager to lead the Metrics Frameworks team. This role combines people leadership, technical strategy, and execution ownership. You will set the team’s direction, build a high-performing engineering organization, and guide the design and operation of platforms that are critical to AV evaluation and development. The ideal candidate is an experienced engineering leader who can move comfortably between long-term technical strategy and day-to-day execution. You will work closely with customers and partner teams to understand evolving evaluation needs, make clear tradeoffs, and deliver durable framework capabilities that improve engineering velocity and confidence in AV performance data. What You’ll Do Lead, coach, and grow a high-performing team of software and data engineers through hiring, onboarding, career development, feedback, and performance management. Define and communicate the team’s technical vision, roadmap, priorities, and operating plan in partnership with Evaluation and broader AV leadership. Own delivery of scalable frameworks for creating, executing, and monitoring metrics across simulated and real-world driving data. Ensure the team’s platforms are reliable, observable, performant, maintainable, and easy for internal customers to use. Establish meaningful service-level objectives , health metrics, dashboards, and operational practices for critical data and analysis pipelines. Balance feature delivery, platform modernization, technical debt, operational support, and long-term architecture investments. Partner with both internal and external stakeholders to translate ambiguous needs into clear technical plans and measurable outcomes. Raise the engineering bar through strong architecture, design reviews, testing, code review, documentation, security, and operational excellence. Develop mechanisms that help teams distinguish framework ownership from metric-specific business logic, enabling effective collaboration and clear accountability. Participate in and improve the team’s production-support and incident-response practices for critical metrics and data pipelines. Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications) Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science , Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 8 + years of experience building software, data platforms, analytics infrastructure, or evaluation systems in a production environment. 3 + years of experience directly managing and developing engineers or other technical professionals. Experience setting technical direction and delivering a roadmap for a platform, framework, or infrastructure product used by multiple teams. Experience building or operating scalable data-processing pipelines, workflow systems, developer tooling, or distributed services. Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including system design, testing, code review, observability, and performance tradeoffs. Experience using data and operational metrics to improve reliability, prioritization, and execution. Ability to translate complex technical problems and ambiguous customer needs into clear priorities and decisions. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence across organizational boundaries. What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications) Experience in autonomous vehicles, robotics, simulation, advanced driver-assistance systems, or another safety-critical and data-intensive domain. Experience evaluating complex systems using statistical, numerical, machine learning, or time-series methods. Experience with metrics platforms, data quality systems, experiment analysis, telemetry, or performance monitoring. Proficiency with Python, C++, and SQL in production engineering environments. Experience with large-scale analytical data stores such as BigQuery , Databricks, or similar technologies. Experience with workflow orchestration, batch processing, cloud infrastructure, and data-pipeline operations. Familiarity with simulation, sensor data, road testing, or evaluation of perception , prediction, planning, or control systems. Experience leading platform migrations, reducing technical debt, or consolidating fragmented frameworks. Demonstrated ability to build trust with technical and non-technical partners and create clarity in a rapidly changing environment. Compensation : The compensation information is a good faith estimate only. It is based on what a successful applicant might be paid in accordance with applicable state laws. The compensation may not be representative for positions located outside of the California Bay Area. The salary range for this role is ($218,800 - $335,300). The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position. Bonus Potential: An incentive pay program offers payouts based on company performance, job level, and individual performance. Company Vehicle : Upon successful completion of a motor vehicle report review, you will be eligible to participate in a company vehicle evaluation program, through which you will be assigned a General Motors vehicle to drive and evaluate. This role is eligible for relocation benefits At General Motors, our product teams are redefining mobility. Through a human-centered design process, we create vehicles and experiences that are designed not just to be seen, but to be felt. We’re turning today’s impossible into tomorrow’s standard —from breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design, intelligent software, and next-generation safety and entertainment features. Every day, our products move millions of people as we aim to make driving safer, smarter, and more connected, shaping the future of transportation on a global scale.. About the Role The Senior Transmission and Drive Unit Engineering Designer independently leads the design and integration of complex transmission and drive unit components and subsystems from concept through validation, release, and launch. This role balances performance, safety, customer experience, cost, mass, timing, dimensional robustness, and manufacturing feasibility. The designer works across engineering, manufacturing, safety, CAE, dimensional engineering, suppliers, and program teams to resolve complex design challenges and deliver robust products. Interpret CAE and designer-led analysis using NX Performance Predictor, NX Pre/Post, SimSolid, and Ansys results. Apply vehicle and transmission assembly structures, integration modules, tracking vehicles, and installation assemblies. Share lessons learned with Engineering & plants with similar products to prevent repeat design or build issues. jobs.location: Warren, Michigan, United States of America, United States of America
jobs.description:
Job Description About GM We’re dedicated to achieving our vision of a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions and Zero Congestion. We are looking for people who are passionate about helping us create safer, better and more sustainable solutions for personal mobility. Our bold vision won’t happen overnight, but just as we transformed how the world moved in the last century, we are committed to transforming how we move today and in the future. Why Work for Us Our culture is focused on building inclusive teams, where differences and unique perspectives are embraced so you can contribute to your fullest potential as you pursue your career. Our locations feature a variety of work environments, including open work spaces and virtual connection platforms to inspire productivity and flexible collaboration. And we are proud to support our employees volunteer interests, and make it a priority to join efforts that give back to our communities As we move towards GM’s vision of zero crashes, zero emissions, and zero congestion, we are looking to add creative, dynamic individuals to our ET&E (Engines, Transmissions, and Electrification) team! As a Design Release Engineer in the RESS Thermal Management Product Management Team (PMT), you will head up all activities for the Design, VDDV (Analysis), Development, Validation, and production implementation of cooling components (cold plates, cooling lines (metal and plastic) for one of the GM Products related to Propulsion. This could mean working on Internal Combustion engines or Batteries and Drive Units. By acting as the “CEO” of your parts/systems, your technical and project management skills will be key to the success of our current and future propulsion programs. This position does not require you to be on-site full-time to perform effectively. This role enables you to work at a GM facility and off-site on a 60/40 time split. Job Description Responsible for specifying and balancing requirements, execution and evaluation of designs, analysis, development, testing and validation of major engineering projects where creativity and initiative are involved. Position also requires the ability to work with independent judgment with minimal input from supervisor. The broad scope of responsibilities covers one or more of the following: coolant pumps, coolant control valves, thermostats, and other key thermal components for Drive Units and Internal Combustion Engines. Exercise technical direction and collaboration over other engineers or engineering support personnel to meet specific engineering objectives. Capable of managing projects with high degree of difficulty. Actively engage both internal and supplier teams in issue resolution. Work cohesively with engineering peers responsible for similar components for other applications. Key Responsibilities Lead overall communication, coordination, and consultation with engineering departments and customers Establish designs that meet program performance and timing requirements with compliance to BOM/BOP/BOD and serviceability requirements Balance requirements across systems Analyze designs through design failure modes effects analysis (DFMEA) Plan and implement complex test and/or development programs Demonstrate that designs meet requirements through analysis (VDDV), development and validation processes Represent business unit in vendor and/or customer contacts Release final designs for manufacturing or purchase as appropriate Conduct incident analysis and ensure problem resolution through PRTS+ system Implement engineering changes as required Participate in cost studies, product suggestions and value analysis Define hardware and budget requirements for experimental build programs Actively participate in product management team and leads product development team(s) as appropriate Support supplier quality assurance process Lead warranty issue resolution Participate in work groups with interactive/interfacing hardware/software teams as required Lead the overall execution of new RESS, Drive Unit and Internal Combustion Engine thermal and cooling components throughout the Global Powertrain Development Process (GPDP) Define hardware and budget requirements for experimental build programs Lead warranty issue resolution and cost/quality improvements with suppliers and in-house manufacturing Travel as required, domestic and international Required Skills and Experience Bachelor's degree in Engineering required Minimum 4 years of Engineering experience Knowledge of propulsion systems and basic controls Appropriate interpersonal styles and communication methods to work effectively with business partners to meet mutual goals. Knowledge of computer software as it pertains to engineering High level of social skills to enable effective collaboration within a team environment and with all levels of the organization, both in person and remotely. Preferred Skills and Experience Bachelor's in Mechanical Engineering preferred Master’s degree in Engineering is preferred DFSS Black Belt Certification Design Release experience with Propulsion based components 5 years of Engineering experience Comprehensive understanding of Product Engineering Tools/ Processes (ECM, TWO, GPDP, PRTS, DFMEA/PFMEA, P-Release, etc.) Cross-functional experience in Calibration, Manufacturing, Validation, VDDV, etc., with proven results and outstanding team-based achievements Prior experience in thermal components utilized in Drive Units, Batteries and Internal Combustion Engines

jobs.location: Toledo, Ohio, United States of America, United States of America
jobs.description:
Job Description Industrial Engineering Lead Sponsorship: GM DOES NOT PROVIDE IMMIGRATION-RELATED SPONSORSHIP FOR THIS ROLE. DO NOT APPLY FOR THIS ROLE IF YOU WILL NEED GM IMMIGRATION SPONSORSHIP (e.g., H-1B, TN, STEM OPT, etc.) NOW OR IN THE FUTURE. Onsite: This role is categorized as onsite. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to our Toledo location. This position may offer relocation assistance. The Role: In this role your work will be of a technical nature with decisions made within the limits of general practices, policies and standards. Your work will involve complex manufacturing problems including the need to troubleshoot and follow issues to completion. You will work directly with Production leadership in implementing Lean Manufacturing systems. The main purpose of the Lead Industrial Engineer is to work to eliminate waste of time, money, materials, person-hours, machine time, energy and other resources that do not generate value. The ability to work in a dynamic, fast-paced manufacturing environment is critical to succeed in this role. In this position your use of independent discernment is required. You will use substantial independent judgment in complex or unusual situations. Your responsibility may involve training others and assigning work to a small group of employees. What You'll Do (Responsibilities) : Maintain awareness of quality standards, and communicates department quality Prioritization of workload to enable employees to accomplish all responsibilities Project management for large projects for equipment Creation & maintenance of engineering standardized work Providing technical directions to and oversight of outside vendor sources Providing technical directions and coordination for less experienced industrial Engineers Perform People Leader responsibilities for direct reports including but not limited to: CAP – goal setting, mid-year and year-end reviews, managing results and evaluating/coaching individual performance, compensation planning and communication, training and development planning Support manager with general administrative tasks such as managing budget targets, approving travel requests, expense reports, and purchasing requests, & planning vacation schedules Direct the design, development, and/or improvement of manufacturing processes for assigned area You will provide technical support for specific plant operations You will interact on a regular basis with production, finance, and manufacturing engineering staff. You will evaluate or monitor expenditure for processes and/or equipment You will handle engineering projects with plants and/or Manufacturing Engineering Staffs Implement common Industrial Engineering business practices and processes. Design work operations that meet safety, quality, and efficiency requirements with high integrity. Maintain accurate time studies through motion analysis and application of standard time data. Maintain accurate routings of parts to their assembly location. Maintain accurate workstation layouts using computer aided drafting software (AutoCAD). Drive Continuous Improvement efforts in assigned areas through elimination of waste. Evaluate bottleneck areas and support throughput and productivity improvements in assigned areas. Support change management projects by developing line balance plans and participating in production trials. Reduce total cost by improving productivity metrics related to operator work loading and value-added percent. Participate in lean manufacturing through implementation of GM’s Global Manufacturing System. Support implementation and training for standardized work development. Become a coach and teacher of lean manufacturing principles to the production floor team members. Drive problem solving efforts. Work collaboratively as one team with all levels of the organization. Develop relationships with Production department and related personnel and influence cross-functional partners. Your Skills and Abilities (Required Qualifications): Bachelor’s degree with major in Industrial Engineering or equivalent experience Competencies: Proven ability to design work operations that meet safety, quality, and efficiency requirements. Knowledge of Standardized Work (STDS), Assembly Line Balance (APS), Benchmark Calculator (BMC), Simulations, Man-Machine Charts, Indirect Labor Studies, Purchasing Planning & Financial Tracking, and Throughput Improvement Process (TIP) Manufacturing Engineering or Plant IE experience with a minimum of 5 years What Can Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications): Continuous Improvement, Manufacturing Line optimizations, Project Management and Part Presentation Experience Working on multiple products and processes while collaborating with cross functional teams that are in multiple places.

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer – AV Cloud Engineering
jobs.location: Sunnyvale, California, United States of America, United States of America
jobs.description:
Job Description We are hiring a Senior Platform Engineer to join the Autonomous Vehicle (AV) Cloud Engineering team within AV Core Infrastructure. AV Cloud Engineering owns core IaaS and PaaS capabilities that support autonomous vehicle development and runtime environments. This role is for an engineer who treats cloud infrastructure as a product and is motivated by building a reliable, easy-to- consume platform that helps AV engineers build, test, and run faster with less operational friction. You will work on the platform capabilities, abstractions, and self-service workflows that power AV workloads at scale. You should be comfortable turning broad infrastructure problems into durable engineering solutions and improving developer velocity through software, automation, and thoughtful platform design. What You’ll Do Build and evolve internal platform capabilities, self-service workflows, APIs, and automation that make the right path the easiest path for AV engineering teams. Design clean abstractions that allow product and research teams to consume complex infrastructure, including specialized hardware such as GPUs, without deep infrastructure expertise . Improve platform primitives across traffic, service mesh, runtime configuration, and connectivity for distributed AV workloads. Reduce toil and improve reliability through reusable platform tooling, declarative automation, strong service ownership, observability, and SLIs/SLOs. Take ownership of complex platform initiatives from problem definition through design, implementation, and adoption. Partner with adjacent AV infrastructure teams to reduce developer friction and improve the reliability of the platform AV engineers depend on. Contribute to a healthy engineering culture through design reviews, code reviews, mentorship, and clear technical communication. Skills & Abilities: Required: Fully qualified proficiency in Kubernetes (GKE) and the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) ecosystem, including VPC, IAM, etc. Required: Hands-on experience implementing high-availability systems and managing the lifecycle of production-grade clusters. Required: Strong proficiency in software engineering and DevOps principles, specifically using Golang/Python and Terraform. Required: Ability to operate independently in an ambiguous environment and translate high-level requirements into clear technical tasks. Required: A "Growth-based Mindset" with a commitment to continuous upskilling and a belief that team capacities are developed through effort and coaching. Required: Professional experience managing the trade-offs between hardware-level performance (GPU passthrough) and clean cloud abstractions. Preferred: Experience with Service Mesh (Istio) and managing large-scale DNS/Traffic configurations in a global environment. Minimum Qualifications (Must-Have) 5+ years of experience or proven record of defining and executing technical strategy that required coordination across multiple teams, senior executives, and front-line engineers Bachelors Degree in Computer Science or related field OR equivalent work experience Hands-on experience with Kubernetes in production and strong familiarity with at least one major cloud ecosystem such as GCP, AWS, or Azure. Strong software engineering skills in Go, Python, or similar languages, with the ability to build reusable automation, services, APIs, or controllers. Experience designing, implementing, and operating large-scale, high-availability distributed systems in production. Preferred Qualifications Experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio and large-scale DNS or traffic management. Experience with GKE and the broader GCP ecosystem, including networking and IAM; equivalent experience with EKS/AWS or AKS/Azure is also valuable. Experience supporting AI/ML workloads or working with ML platforms and related tooling ecosystems. Experience owning or influencing platform SLOs and availability targets in production. Experience driving technical strategy or cross-functional alignment across multiple teams. Additional Context This role is best suited for engineers who want to build an internal platform product for other engineers. It is less suited to candidates whose background is primarily ticket-driven infrastructure support or one-off environment operations. Hybrid: This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to the Sunnyvale or Austin office three times per week, at minimum. Compensation: The compensation information is a good faith estimate only. It is based on what a successful applicant might be paid in accordance with applicable state laws. The compensation may not be representative for positions located outside of New York, Colorado, California, or Washington. The salary range for this role: is $170,000 to $230,000. The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position. Bonus Potential: An incentive pay program offers payouts based on company performance, job level, and individual performance. Benefits: GM offers a variety of health and wellbeing benefit programs. Benefit options include medical, dental, vision, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Accounts, retirement savings plan, sickness and accident benefits, life insurance, paid vacation & holidays, tuition assistance programs, employee assistance program, GM vehicle discounts and more.

Prepare costing and profitability analysis for management decision-making process when business needs. jobs.title: Sr. Partner Onboarding & Success Manager
jobs.description:
The Role

You'll build and scale our partner enablement engine, turning newly signed partners into technically and operationally capable allies ready to transact and serve their customers. Rather than treating partner ramp as a single training event, you'll own the end-to-end readiness journey—aligning cross-functional resources across Business Development, Solutions Architecture, Implementation, and Support to build long-term partner self-sufficiency.

This is a full-time, exempt position based in our Oakland, CA office with a hybrid work schedule: in office M/W/Th with the option to work from home on Tu/Fr.

What you'll do

  • Own the post-signature partner onboarding and readiness journey, coordinating cross-functionally with BD Account Directors, Implementation, Solutions Architecture, Support, and Account Managers while maintaining clear ownership boundaries across teams.
  • Build structured readiness tracks—including technical setup, customer onboarding workflows, sales process execution, and operational enablement—tailored to distinct partner types like resellers, MSPs, and service providers.
  • Guide partners through operational transaction steps, including setting up customer organizations and sub-organizations, ingesting data, submitting orders, and registering opportunities.
  • Serve as a practical, trusted advisor to partner teams, verifying their operational capability and establishing clear escalation paths through Everlaw's documented support systems.
  • Track onboarding milestones, partner capability demonstrations, and friction points, maintaining clear documentation and handoff evidence to ensure seamless long-term account transitions.
  • Identify recurring operational or technical friction for partners, surfacing structured feedback and evidence to internal product and process owners to improve the broader partner experience.

About You

  • You have at least 8+ years of experience in partner onboarding, technical customer success, implementation coordination, or partner success in B2B technology.
  • You've guided external organizations through complex software platforms, building their internal capability to use, support, and sell technical products.
  • You bring clear, practical communication skills, with a track record of explaining technical workflows to users with varying levels of technical depth.
  • You excel at cross-functional coordination across internal teams—such as Sales, Support, Solutions Engineering, and Product—while maintaining clear boundaries and accountability.
  • You have a diagnostic approach to problem-solving, with the ability to determine whether a partner blocker is technical, operational, commercial, or training-related, and route it effectively.
  • You are authorized to work in the United States. Please note that at this time, Everlaw is not sponsoring U.S. employment visas for this role.

Bonus points

  • Experience in legal technology, litigation support, investigations, or regulated B2B software environments.
  • Experience onboarding service providers, system integrators, MSPs, or reseller partners.
  • Experience designing partner readiness frameworks, milestone tracking, and transition criteria in platforms like Salesforce or partner portals.

Think you're missing some of the skills and are hesitant to apply? We do not believe in the 'perfect' candidate and encourage you to apply if you feel you can bring value to our team. We often revisit candidates who may have applied for a different role if something comes up that's a better fit.

The Team — Business Development

The Business Development team builds and grows the network of partners who extend Everlaw's reach into the market. By identifying, recruiting, and supporting partners across the ecosystem, the team creates relationships that open new paths to customers and reinforce Everlaw's position in the industry. This work turns strong partnerships into a durable channel for growth, helping more organizations discover Everlaw through partners they already trust.

Total Rewards & Benefits

The expected salary range for this role is between $183,000 and $231,000. The final offered salary will be dependent upon many factors including the candidate’s experience and skills. The role's compensation is subject to change in the future.

Health & well-being

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Flexible Spending Accounts for health and dependent care expenses
  • Membership to Modern Health to support mental health and wellness
  • Paid parental leave
  • Company-sponsored life and disability insurance

Financial rewards

  • Competitive equity grants, so you share in Everlaw's long-term growth
  • 401(k) plan with company matching of up to 4% of eligible annual compensation

Growth & everyday perks

  • 17 paid vacation days, 11 federal holidays, and paid sick leave
  • Four "Everlawlidays" (additional paid company-wide days off) per year
  • Annual allocation for learning & development and relevant professional membership dues
  • Hybrid work with regular work-from-home days and flexibility for life's logistics
  • Monthly home internet reimbursement, plus a stipend for your desk setup
  • Catered lunch each workday, plus snacks and company-wide events in our offices

About Everlaw

When a lawsuit or investigation happens, teams must comb through vast amounts of electronic evidence — emails, documents, chats, files — to find what matters. That work is not a side task but the case itself, and where most of the time and money in litigation goes. Everlaw is the litigation and investigation management platform changing that, using AI to turn mountains of messy data into the handful of facts that win or lose a case, compressing weeks of work into hours.

We're the kind of place that's ranked #1 on G2 in our category and named a Great Place to Work™ by our own team. So if you want a front row seat to an industry in transformation, career-defining work you'll be proud to tell people about, and real upside at a company in control of its own destiny, we'd love to get to know you.

  • #LI-BL1
  • #LI-Hybrid
 
​​About Everlaw

At Everlaw, you'll shape how AI re-wires the legal industry, at a category-leading business built on a mission to illuminate the truth.

Everlaw is an equal opportunity employer. We pride ourselves on having a diverse workforce and we do not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law. We respect the gender, gender identity and gender expression of our applicants and employees, and we honor requests for pronouns. It is our policy to comply with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity, including the California Equal Pay Act.  Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
 
We collect and process the personal information you provided along with your job application in accordance with our Applicants Privacy Notice and Notice at Collection.
 
When preparing to engage with Everlaw as a candidate, you may use AI tools for research, polishing application materials, and interview prep. However, any assessments (unless explicitly stated), remote interviews or live interviews must be completed independently without AI support. By submitting your application, you agree to adhere to these rules. Here's the link to our full policy, and please reach out with any questions!

Certain features of the platform may qualify it as an Automated Employment Decision Tool (AEDT) under applicable regulations. For positions in New York City, our use of Gem complies with NYC Local Law 144. We began using Gem in April 2026.

jobs.title: Global Alliance Lead, Capgemini
jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the role

The Global Alliance Lead is one of the most strategically important roles in our Ecosystem. You will own our relationship with one of the world's leading technology and transformation partners end-to-end — from C-suite engagement through to practitioner enablement and joint pipeline creation. You will be the architect of how the GSI and NewCo go to market together, ensuring our platform becomes the trusted data foundation inside the GSI’s agentic AI delivery practice globally.

This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the Global Head of GSI Relationships. You will orchestrate across sales, partner solution architecture, marketing, and partner operations — bringing the full weight of the organisation to bear on one of our highest-leverage commercial relationships.

What You'll Do

Relationship strategy and executive engagement

  • Own the global GSI relationship at partner and C-suite level, building trusted relationships with Capgemini, practice and delivery team leads.
  • Define and execute a multi-year joint strategy that positions dbt + Fivetran as the default open data infrastructure layer within the GSI’s enterprise AI and agentic workflow delivery
  • Represent NewCo at GSI’s internal forums, client briefings, and industry events — articulating a compelling narrative around open data infrastructure and its relevance to the GSI’s strategy. 

Platform integration and practitioner adoption

  • Drive adoption of the dbt + Fivetran platform within GSI delivery teams — ensuring practitioners, solution architects and practice leads are certified, confident, and actively recommending the platform in client engagements
  • Work with GSI's practice leadership to embed NewCo's platform into their business groups, standard delivery architectures, RFP responses and client proposals — with particular focus on GSI's Data & AI practices

Enablement and go-to-market

  • Design and execute a frictionless enablement programme for GSI practitioners globally — certifications, reference architectures, use case playbooks, and joint delivery assets
  • Partner with GSI's marketing and alliances teams to develop joint go-to-market campaigns anchored to open data infrastructure, trusted AI delivery, and closing the gap between AI POC and production
  • Support GSI in building and positioning client-facing agentic AI value accelerators — with NewCo platform as the foundational data layer — the "NewCo inside" model

Pipeline and opportunity development

  • Source and develop new pipeline opportunities through the GSI relationship — identifying client situations where open data infrastructure creates measurable value.
  • Drive co-sell motions alongside GSI account teams, ensuring NewCo is present and influential at the point of client opportunity
  • Maintain a rigorous view of GSI-engaged pipeline — tracking opportunity sourcing, progression, and closed business attributed to the alliance

Telemetry and performance

  • Define and track the signals that indicate a healthy, high-performing GSI relationship: certifications, sourced opportunities, platform deployments, practitioner engagement, and joint wins
  • Report regularly to the Global Head of GSI Relationships on alliance health, pipeline contribution, and strategic progress
  • Identify risks and gaps in the relationship early and mobilise internal resources to address them

What you will bring

  • 15+ years of experience in strategic alliances, enterprise sales, or partner management within the data, cloud, or enterprise software industry
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, global relationships with major consulting firms or global system integrators at a senior level
  • Deep understanding of the modern data stack and the business value of open data infrastructure — dbt, Fivetran, or equivalent experience strongly preferred
  • Ability to engage credibly at C-suite and partner level within a global consulting organisation — understanding how GSIs make decisions, build practices, and go to market
  • Strong commercial instincts — able to identify, thoroughly qualify and develop joint pipeline opportunities, not just manage existing relationships
  • Track record of operating as a cross-functional orchestrator — influencing without direct authority across sales, engineering, marketing, and operations
  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills — able to translate technical platform capabilities into compelling business narratives for consulting and enterprise audiences
  • Familiarity with AI, agentic workflows, and the data governance landscape is a strong advantage + strong knowledge of GSI's operating model and contacts within. 
  • Willingness to travel globally to engage GSI leadership and teams across regions

What Success Looks Like in Year One

  • A clearly defined joint strategy with GSI signed off at partner Executive level and on track to primary Global Strategic Practice.
  • Material increase in GSI practitioner certifications and active platform deployments across Data & AI and Insights & Data practices
  • GSI-sourced pipeline contributing measurably to NewCo's revenue
  • At least two joint go-to-market campaigns live in the market delivering pipeline — anchored to GSI's agentic AI and trusted data agenda
  • First client-facing agentic value accelerators built on NewCo platform delivered with GSI — positioning NewCo as the trusted data infrastructure inside GSI's AI delivery
  • A telemetry framework in place tracking alliance health and pipeline influence

Why This Role

This is a rare opportunity to own a marquee relationship at a defining moment for both companies. GSI’s are publicly committing to capturing the full value of the agentic AI revolution for customers  — and the merged dbt + Fivetran platform is the trusted data infrastructure that makes AI production-ready. The person who builds this alliance well will sit at the intersection of the two most important forces in enterprise technology right now: the scale of a global systems integrator and the open infrastructure that makes AI trustworthy enough to deploy at scale.

This position qualifies for Fivetran’s incentive plan, and it’s common for employees in this role to achieve the total on-target earnings.

jobs.description:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

Controls Engineer

We are seeking an experienced Controls Engineer who is passionate about pushing beyond the cutting edge of the industry to design, build, and debug best-in-class controls systems for Redwood’s battery recycling operations. This engineer will play a critical role in designing, commissioning, scaling, and supporting all of Redwood’s recycling facilities working at the intersection of chemical process engineering, industrial automation, and software development.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Designing and implementing real‑time control software in C++ for embedded and industrial systems
  • Developing automation tools, diagnostics, and orchestration scripts in Python
  • Writing, optimizing, and troubleshooting Structured Text (IEC 61131‑3) for PLCs and industrial controllers
  • Building deterministic control loops, state machines, and safety‑critical routines
  • Integrating software with sensors, actuators, drives, and industrial communication networks
  • Debugging complex issues involving timing, concurrency, hardware interfaces, and industrial protocols
  • Leading system architecture decisions for control platforms and distributed automation systems
  • Conducting root‑cause analysis for field issues and implementing long‑term fixes
  • Collaborating with controls, electrical, and product teams to translate requirements into robust software designs
  • Mentoring engineers in real‑time programming, PLC development, and industrial best practices

Qualifications:

  • 2–5 years of hands-on experience in controls engineering, industrial automation, or system integration within a high-volume manufacturing environment
  • Proficiency in modern C++ for real‑time or embedded systems
  • Solid experience with Python for automation, tooling, or data processing
  • Hands‑on experience writing Structured Text for PLCs or industrial controllers
  • Deep understanding of deterministic execution, concurrency, and hardware‑software interaction
  • Experience with industrial protocols such as Modbus, EtherNet/IP, OPC UA, or PROFINET
  • Proven ability to lead complex engineering efforts while contributing significant hands‑on code
  • Strong debugging skills across software, hardware, and network layers
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with motion control, robotics, or process automation
  • Familiarity with embedded Linux, RTOS environments, or microcontroller development
  • Knowledge of industrial cybersecurity standards or best practices
  • Experience with simulation tools, digital twins, or hardware‑in‑the‑loop testing
  • Background integrating C++ runtimes with PLC or SCADA systems

The position is full-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.
