The position exercises independent judgment on methods and evaluation criteria for first-of-a-kind processes where data is incomplete, and its recommendations determine which flowsheets Redwood deploys at commercial scale. This is a strategic individual contributor role with regular interaction with Redwood's CTO and CEO, and success depends on driving innovation and plant deployment at an exceptional pace.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Serves as Redwood's senior technical authority on extractive metallurgy, owning the metallurgical basis of design for recycling and refining flowsheets from feedstock through refined product
  • Leads evaluation and selection of competing flowsheet options, translating bench and pilot data into defensible recommendations for commercial deployment
  • Owns the metallurgical basis for intermediate and final product quality specifications, diagnosing impurity deportment across unit operations and driving issues to root cause
  • Directs strategy for mineral processing and mechanical separation of heterogeneous feedstocks, including comminution, liberation, classification, and physical concentration
  • Guides scale-up from bench through pilot to commercial operation, including mass and energy balances, equipment selection, and vendor test campaigns
  • Partners with Business Development to define process pathways and pricing for new feedstocks and to identify offtake markets and their value drivers
  • Advises operations and process engineering teams on recovery, yield, and reliability shortfalls at commissioned plants, and raises metallurgical rigor across the engineering organization through technical review and mentorship

Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities

  • Bachelor's or advanced degree in Metallurgical Engineering, Extractive Metallurgy, Mining Engineering, Mineral Processing, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline
  • 15+ years of experience in extractive metallurgy, mineral processing, or metals process engineering, or equivalent depth of expertise
  • Demonstrated ownership of deploying a flowsheet from pilot scale through commercial operation, with accountability for the plant's technical performance
  • Deep industrial-scale experience in pyrometallurgy or hydrometallurgy; experience across both preferred
  • Hands-on experience in an operating plant environment such as a smelter, refinery, or concentrator, with ability to travel to plant sites as required
  • Experience with comminution and physical separation of variable, heterogeneous feedstocks

The position is full-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

jobs.title: Electrical Hardware Engineer, AI Satellites (Starmind)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

ELECTRICAL HARDWARE ENGINEER, AI SATELLITES (STARMIND)

SpaceX is leveraging its experience deploying and operating the world’s largest satellite constellation to develop Starmind, a new constellation of satellites capturing solar energy in space to power low-cost, high-performance AI compute for Earth. Realizing this vision demands highly reliable, high performance electrical hardware ranging from power electronics, high speed digital systems, mixed signal designs, robust avionics, networking, and custom compute electronics. These systems must operate in the extreme environment of space while delivering the connectivity, control, power distribution, and processing needed for orbital AI inference.

We are seeking best-in-class Electrical Hardware Engineers to own the full lifecycle of the electronics that make Starmind possible. You’ll apply deep electrical engineering skill sets at the intersection of power conversion and distribution, high-speed digital communications, analog design, network integration, thermal management, signal integrity, and on-orbit compute to create the hardware backbone for next-generation space-based AI infrastructure.

We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system. Your work sits at the intersection of electrical, mechanical, thermal analysis, software, and networking engineering that enables orbital compute capability. Challenges range from high-speed digital communications, analog, network system integration, power electronics, RF/optical devices, and high-performance compute electronics for space. Your work will include everything from system design and schematic capture to PCB layout oversight; as well as hardware troubleshooting to driving requirements for the underlying silicon and complete product production and test. This also includes driving successful business outcomes across interdisciplinary subsystems of the satellite, inclusive of mechanical and software engineering peers among other engineering disciplines. Sub-teams include:

Avionics: The backbone of Starmind satellites are the bus avionics systems which control the vehicle, convert and distribute kilowatts of power, route high-speed vehicle and user/compute traffic, and connect satellites to each other via our state-of-the-art Space Lasers! The team is responsible for the design, development, and ultimate success of these avionics systems from concept to grave.

Payload: The Payload team is responsible for the design of custom AI compute electronics that push the forefront of AI chip performance, interconnectivity, and cluster size. Everything from high-power AI chips to high throughput network switching to high density storage conversion. The team owns the design, development, and ultimate success of this hardware from concept to grave.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Rapidly develop high-reliability electronics for satellites and spacecraft.
  • Drive system trades, requirements capture, component selection, analysis, schematic capture, PCB layout, prototyping, hardware bring-up, debugging, documentation, manufacturing, test, and on-orbit performance of complex electrical designs

  • 2+ years of professional experience rapidly designing and delivering highly reliable products
  • 2+ years of electronic product experience designing hardware from concept through production; strong emphasis on full life-cycle development of new hardware products and not small incremental updates to legacy hardware
  • 2+ years of experience designing and implementing mixed-signal circuit boards from concept through production using processors, FPGAs, Ethernet, multi-GHz Serdes, DRAM interfaces (DDR4), I2C, SPI, operational amplifiers, analog to digital and digital to analog converters, and power supply components

  • Experience developing process documents and procedures

  • Experience in high-volume manufacturing setting

Ready to take the next step in your sales career and make an impact at a global fintech leader? Apply now and join us in shaping the future of payments.

jobs.title: Webflow Guru/Website Manager
jobs.description:
Looking for an innovative, high-growth, multi-award-winning company in one of the hottest segments of the security market? Look no further than Veracode! 

Veracode is a global leader in Application Risk Management for the AI era. Powered by trillions of lines of code scans and a proprietary AI-generated remediation engine, the Veracode platform is trusted by organizations worldwide to build and maintain secure software from code creation to cloud deployment.

Learn more at www.veracode.com, on the Veracode blog, and on LinkedIn and Twitter. 

 

 

Veracode is looking for someone who KNOWS Webflow inside out and knows how to make a large B2B website work harder for the business.
 
Must be equally comfortable building a reusable component, debugging custom JavaScript, improving a page’s visual hierarchy, and using conversion data to decide what to build next. You have the technical depth to solve problems yourself and the experience to own a website’s strategy, operations, and ongoing growth.
 
At Veracode, you’ll help bring a modern enterprise Webflow website to life and lead its continued evolution as a marketing and sales engine. Working closely with our Creative Director and partners across marketing, you’ll create experiences that express our brand, help buyers understand our value, and turn interest into qualified demand.
This is a hands-on website ownership role. Deep, recent Webflow design and development experience is required. General CMS experience or experience managing website projects alone will not meet the needs of this position. Building, troubleshooting, and improving the site yourself will be a regular part of your work.
 
What you’ll own
  • Hands-on Webflow development. Build and refine responsive pages, CMS collections, reusable components, templates, and interactions. Maintain clear structure and styling conventions so the site can scale without becoming difficult to manage.
  • Design execution and brand quality. Translate Figma designs into polished Webflow experiences. Bring a strong eye for typography, spacing, layout, imagery, motion, and responsive behavior, working with the Creative Director to extend the brand thoughtfully.
  • Website strategy and priorities. Own the roadmap and daily website function. Turn marketing and sales goals into a practical plan, balance campaign needs with longer-term improvements, and follow work through implementation and measurement.
  • Migration and launch quality. Take ownership of the in-progress WordPress-to-Webflow migration alongside internal teams and agency partners. Validate CMS structure, content migration, redirects, search visibility, tracking, forms, integrations, and launch readiness, then resolve issues after launch.
  • Conversion and buyer journeys. Improve how visitors discover content, understand our products, and take the next step. Develop and test improvements to navigation, landing pages, calls to action, forms, and conversion paths.
  • Analytics and actionable insights. Use GA4, Google Tag Manager, search data, heatmaps, and testing tools to identify opportunities. Explain what the data means, recommend changes, implement them, and measure their effect on qualified conversions and pipeline with marketing operations.
  • SEO and evolving discovery. Partner with SEO and content teams on technical SEO, site architecture, crawlability, metadata, structured data, and content discoverability across traditional and AI-powered search.
  • Integrations and technical performance. Build and troubleshoot custom HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and third-party integrations. Partner with marketing operations on Marketo forms, Salesforce lead flow, and reliable tracking. Improve accessibility, page speed, and Core Web Vitals.
  • AI and emerging tools. Stay active in the Webflow ecosystem and evaluate new capabilities, AI-assisted development workflows, automation, personalization, and experimentation tools. Turn promising ideas into tested improvements that serve our visitors and business.
  • Enterprise website operations. Maintain publishing standards, permissions, documentation, QA, and content governance. Set clear requirements for agency partners and evaluate their work directly in Webflow and custom code.
What you bring
  • Advanced, recent Webflow expertise. You have personally built and maintained sophisticated production websites and can explain your decisions around CMS architecture, components, responsive layouts, interactions, custom code, and maintainability.
  • Experience owning large B2B websites. You have managed websites with hundreds of pages, multiple stakeholders, ongoing campaigns, and complex content and integration needs. You understand the responsibility that continues after launch.
  • Strong design and development skills. Your portfolio demonstrates modern visual craft and careful execution. You can extend a design system, build new layouts, and write and debug HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
  • Migration experience. You have played a substantial hands-on role in a large website migration, including redirects, content validation, SEO preservation, integrations, and launch QA.
  • Marketing and commercial judgment. You understand B2B buyer journeys, lead generation, conversion optimization, and how website decisions support marketing and sales outcomes.

jobs.title: Director, HR Business Partner & Talent Management
jobs.description:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

At Redwood, we are building the foundation for a more sustainable future. As we continue to scale, we are seeking a strategic, hands-on HR leader who thrives at the intersection of business strategy, organizational effectiveness, talent development, and operational execution.

Reporting to the Chief People Officer, this role serves as the primary HR Business Partner to our Chief Operating Officer and Chief Commercial Officer and their leadership teams. This leader will help shape the people, organization, and talent strategies that enable Redwood's manufacturing, operations, supply chain, commercial, and business development organizations to scale effectively.

The Director will oversee HR Business Partner support for our manufacturing operations, lead a small team of HR Business Partners, and partner closely with a peer Director HRBP supporting our technology and corporate functions. Together, these leaders will help build the talent infrastructure required for Redwood's next phase of growth.

Success in this role requires the ability to move seamlessly between frontline realities and enterprise strategy, influencing executive decisions while maintaining a deep understanding of employee and operational needs. We are looking for a builder who is energized by creating scalable programs, processes, and capabilities from the ground up while remaining willing to roll up their sleeves and drive execution.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the strategic People partner to the Chief Operating Officer, Chief Commercial Officer, and their leadership teams, helping shape organizational strategy, workforce planning, leadership effectiveness, and talent priorities.
  • Partner directly with executives and senior leaders to align people strategies with business objectives and support organizational growth, performance, and workforce effectiveness.
  • Act as a trusted advisor and coach, providing guidance on organizational design, leadership development, succession planning, change management, employee relations, and team effectiveness.
  • Lead and develop a small team of HR Business Partners supporting our Nevada and South Carolina manufacturing facilities and partner closely with the HR leader supporting our Germany manufacturing operations. Together, ensure consistent people practices, talent strategies, and leadership support across Redwood's manufacturing footprint while balancing local business and regulatory needs.
  • Build strong relationships across all levels of the organization, from executive leaders to frontline employees, ensuring people strategies remain grounded in operational realities.
  • Partner with leaders to assess organizational capabilities, identify workforce risks and opportunities, and develop plans that support long-term business objectives.

  • Lead complex organizational and talent initiatives, balancing strategic thinking with practical execution in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Talent Management & Leadership Development

In partnership with a peer HRBP leader, this role will help design and build Redwood's talent management capability from the ground up.

  • Design and implement leadership development programs that strengthen capabilities from frontline supervisors through executive leaders.
  • Build career pathing and development frameworks for individual contributors across manufacturing, operations, commercial, technical, and corporate functions.
  • Establish talent review processes that provide visibility into organizational capability, critical talent, and future leadership needs.
  • Identify high-potential talent and develop succession plans for key leadership and technical positions across the company.
  • Partner with executives and business leaders to assess organizational capability and build talent strategies that support Redwood's long-term growth.
  • Develop scalable approaches to performance management, employee development, and leadership effectiveness.
  • Assess current and future workforce capabilities and create strategies to address organizational and talent gaps.
  • Create solutions that help employees grow their careers while ensuring Redwood has the talent required to achieve its long-term business goals.

What We're Looking For

  • Proven success serving as a strategic advisor to senior executives in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to translate business strategy into talent and organizational solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience building leadership development, succession planning, career development, and talent management programs.
  • Experience partnering effectively across Recruiting, Total Rewards, HR Operations, People Analytics, and other People functions to deliver business outcomes and inform decision-making through data and insights.
  • Experience supporting manufacturing, operations, industrial, energy, or similarly complex workforce environments.

The ideal candidate is a builder, strategist, and operator who can partner credibly with C-suite leaders, develop exceptional leaders and teams, and create the talent systems that will help Redwood scale for years to come.

jobs.location: McCarran, NV; San Francisco, California, United States
jobs.description:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

Position Summary

Redwood's sourcers do not work the easy reqs. They work the roles that are highest leverage for the business and hardest to fill in the market: senior process and chemical engineers, controls and automation leads, plant and construction leadership, and specialized scientific and supply chain roles. These are searches where the passive candidate pool is small, the competing offers are strong, and the difference between a filled req and a stalled one is the quality of the outreach and the depth of the market map.

You will own the top of the funnel for a defined set of critical reqs across the entirety of Redwood Materials spanning ESS and EPC. You will partner with a recruiter and hiring manager on each, build the search strategy, run the outreach, and hand off engaged, qualified candidates. You will be measured on qualified submittals, response rates, and the share of hires that came from your pipeline.

 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Own search strategy on critical reqs
    • Run intake with the recruiter and hiring manager to define the ideal profile, the competitor and adjacent-industry target list, and the pitch
    • Build market maps for each search: target companies, org structures, and named prospects
    • Set weekly sourcing goals per req and report against them
  • Find and engage passive candidates
    • Run multi-channel sourcing: LinkedIn Recruiter, Juicebox, GitHub and technical communities where relevant, conference and patent data, referrals, and competitor org mapping
    • Write outreach that gets replies from people who are not looking. Personalized, specific to the role and the person, and honest about the work
    • Run first-touch screens and hand off warm candidates to the recruiter with a clear summary
  • Keep the pipeline honest
    • Log every prospect and touch in Greenhouse so the pipeline is visible to the recruiter and hiring manager
    • Track response and conversion rates by channel and message and adjust
    • Flag reqs where the market is telling us the profile, comp, or location is wrong, and bring data to the conversation
  • Raise the bar for the team
    • Share sourcing strings, market maps, and outreach templates with the pod
    • Help calibrate what "qualified" means with hiring managers so submittals stop bouncing

 

Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities 

  • What we are looking for
    • You have sourced for hard technical and operational roles in manufacturing, hardware, energy, chemicals, automotive, or construction, and you can talk credibly with a chemical engineer or a plant GM about what they do
    • You have a portfolio of hires that came from your outreach, not from inbound applicants
    • You build market maps before you start messaging, and you can show one
    • Your outreach reply rates are well above the industry average and you know what they are
    • You are fluent in Boolean and structured search across LinkedIn Recruiter and at least one AI-assisted sourcing tool (Juicebox, SeekOut, HireEZ, or similar)
    • You work cleanly in Greenhouse and keep your pipeline current without being asked
    • You can carry 6 to 10 critical reqs at once and tell the recruiter which ones are stuck and why
    • You are comfortable working across time zones with hiring managers on the ground in Nevada and South Carolina
  • Nice to have
    • Experience sourcing for Energy, Battery, Power, EPC, construction, or industrial project roles
    • Experience sourcing internationally, including candidates who may need visa sponsorship
    • Experience building talent pools and nurture campaigns, not just req-by-req sourcing

Veracode is seeking a Senior Website Manager to own the strategy, governance, performance, and ongoing evolution of Veracode.com. Reporting to the VP of Product Marketing and working closely with the Creative Director, this role will lead the website roadmap, improve operational excellence, and turn business priorities into high-performing digital experiences that increase traffic, engagement, lead generation, and conversions.

You will own the web roadmap, lead the migration from WordPress to Webflow through launch and partner with marketing, creative, demand generation, operations, IT, and agency teams to translate business needs into scalable website experiences. You will oversee site infrastructure, reusable templates, page builds, campaign support, content publishing, and continuous optimization for speed, security, accessibility, SEO, GEO, and user experience.

The Senior Website Manager will improve the full digital journey, from organic discovery and campaign landing pages to content engagement, form conversion, personalization, and post-click experiences aligned to priority personas.

This role balances strategic ownership with hands-on execution. The Senior Website Manager should be comfortable setting priorities, managing stakeholders, improving governance, and jumping into the details of site updates, QA, analytics, campaign launches, and CMS operations when needed. This is a hands-on role. The manager will build and edit pages in Webflow, troubleshoot tracking and form issues, and review agency work in the code and configuration, not just in screenshots.

Key Responsibilities

  • Migration Ownership — Take ownership of Veracode’s in-flight migration from WordPress to Webflow and drive it through launch and post launch stabilization. Align stakeholders, leadership, and agency partners on scope, timelines, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and success criteria. Validate and lead work on content and URL audits, redirect mapping, SEO/GEO/AEO preservation, analytics, integration testing and launch planning.

As a security company, our site is held to a high bar for security hygiene, accessibility and privacy.
  • Performance Optimization — Use Core Web Vitals monitoring, A/B and multivariate testing, heatmaps, and performance insights to balance rich visual experiences with site speed and continuously improve funnel performance.
  • Reporting and Executive Visibility — Establish recurring website performance reporting, dashboards, insights, and recommendations that connect website activity to pipeline, campaign impact, SEO performance, conversion trends, and business priorities.
  • SEO, GEO and Growth Management — Lead technical SEO, GEO, keyword strategy, and content performance to improve organic visibility across traditional and generative search experiences.

Scope projects, manage timelines and deliverables, conduct quality reviews, and ensure external teams align with Veracode standards, brand guidelines, accessibility expectations, and strategic objectives. Hold agencies accountable to defined acceptance criteria and evaluate their technical work independently.
  • Marketing Automation Integration — Work with marketing ops to ensure seamless ties with Marketo forms, lead capture, and CRM (Salesforce).
  • This role gathers business, technical, design, campaign, and content requirements to deliver high-performing website experiences. You will administer infrastructure, manage CMS operations, build scalable templates and interactive experiences, publish content, improve governance, and continuously optimize site performance.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 8–10+ years in web management, digital marketing, or web program management, with strong emphasis on strategy, design oversight, and growth.

SpaceX is leveraging our experience building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s largest satellite constellation and most advanced broadband internet system. We provide reliable and fast internet to millions of users worldwide, including populations with little or no connectivity, rural communities, aircraft, watercraft, and places where existing services are unreliable, too expensive, or disconnected by natural disasters. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system, thousands of satellites and consumer antennae that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing. OPTICAL TEST ENGINEER, AI SATELLITES (STARMIND) 

SpaceX is leveraging its experience deploying and operating the world’s largest satellite constellation to develop Starmind, a new constellation of satellites capturing solar energy in space to power low-cost, high-performance AI compute for Earth. Realizing this vision demands highly reliable, high performance electrical hardware ranging from power electronics, high speed digital systems, mixed signal designs, robust avionics, networking, and custom compute electronics. These systems must operate in the extreme environment of space while delivering the connectivity, control, power distribution, and processing needed for orbital AI inference. As we continue to upgrade and expand the constellation, we’re looking for best-in-class engineers to join the team. 

As an Optical Test Engineer you will be responsible for designing, building, and operating optical metrology equipment to validate optical flight hardware. This role will interface closely with the design and production teams to validate that hardware meets the design intent. In this role, you will need to automate test procedures and data collection for high volume products, as well as train other team members on the operation of optical test and metrology equipment. 

RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Design, build, and operate optical metrology and test systems 
  • Use test data to troubleshoot issues with optical flight hardware 
  • Automate optical test equipment and data collection 
  • Instruct technicians on operation of test equipment

MANAGER, SUPPLIER DEVELOPMENT ENGINEERING

This manager will lead Supplier Development Engineering for Starship pads and launch sites and for Falcon/Dragon flight hardware, including the non-flight hardware those programs depend on. The role owns the engineering organization that removes reliability risk before it reaches the launch site or the vehicle, builds a supply chain that scales with flight rate, and develops a vendor base that sustains process stability and part conformance.

The work sits at the intersection of design, manufacturing, and supply chain. Success depends on early technical influence: locking requirements that suppliers can build to, stabilizing supplier processes for quality, throughput, and delivery, and keeping downstream operations free of escaped risk and undue delay. The manager will set a clear reliability vision, align it with cross-functional leadership, and turn that vision into goals the team can execute quickly.

This is a hands-on leadership role. The manager will build and direct complex, multi-disciplinary teams, develop engineers from entry level through seasoned staff, and move ambiguous problems to a decision the team can act on. The position also carries program-level scope alongside Starship and Falcon leadership: shaping supply-base strategy, driving cost out of the chain, and standing up the processes that let non-flight and flight hardware scale with technical excellence.

About this role

We are looking for an accountable, self-driven Benefits Analyst to take end-to-end ownership of U.S. and Canada benefits data and compliance responsibilities, with additional opportunities to support global initiatives. In this role, you will independently manage recurring deliverables including data reconciliations, vendor billing, compliance audits, and statutory filings. You will take full accountability for clear employee communications, vendor oversight, and driving process improvements through automation to deliver an exceptional employee experience.

What You’ll Do

Benefits Operations, Reconciliation & Audit

  • Manage employee benefit inquiries, enrollment corrections, qualifying life events, dependent changes, and routine Workday transactions.

  • Monitor eligibility files, identify discrepancies, reconcile enrollment and payroll deductions, coordinate corrections with vendors, and maintain exception logs.

  • Own routine follow-ups with benefits vendors, escalating decisions when needed.

  • Maintain process documentation, controls, and audit trails; recommend and implement process improvements and automation.

  • Conduct systematic testing and configuration validation within the benefits administration system to ensure accurate rules setup and seamless system performance.

  • Drive continuous process improvement to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and overall employee experience.

Compliance & Regulatory Support

  • Assist with required reporting and filings, such as Form 5500, ACA reporting, nondiscrimination testing, and SPD/SMM and notice distribution.

  • Support internal team benefits governance activities.

  • Gather documentation and respond to internal and external audit requests; track and close out findings.

  • Partner with Benefits colleagues, Legal, Finance, and external advisors to stay current on regulatory changes and assess their impact on our programs.

Communications

  • Draft, review, and maintain employee-facing benefits communications, including plan summaries, FAQs, intranet content, enrollment guides, and required notices, so they are accurate, comprehensive, and clear.

  • Verify communications against plan documents, vendor materials, and current regulations before release.

  • Serve as an escalation point for complex employee benefits questions and identify trends that inform communication improvements.

Vendor Management

  • Act as a day-to-day contact for certain benefits carriers, brokers, and third-party administrators; monitor service levels and resolve issues.

  • Contribute to vendor performance reviews, renewals, and RFP/vendor selection activities.

  • Ensure accurate, timely data exchange with vendors, including testing and monitoring of eligibility and payroll feeds.

  • Manage invoice payment processing, purchase order setup, and related financial workflows.

Growth & Continuous Improvement

  • As part of a small and lean team, take advantage of numerous opportunities to stretch, expand your skills, and take ownership of various benefit programs.

  • Drive continuous improvement across processes and workflows, leveraging AI and new technology solutions to optimize and automate operations.

  • Contribute to or lead special projects, including annual open enrollment, vendor reviews, system implementations, and data analytics.

  • Demonstrated professional knowledge in benefits administration

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to assess complex situations

  • Hands-on experience with data reconciliation and audits, payroll, or invoice data.

jobs.title: Sr. Full Stack Engineer, Fight Software
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. FULL STACK ENGINEER, FIGHT SOFTWARE

The application software team is the central nervous system of SpaceX – we create mission critical applications that are used throughout SpaceX to accelerate launch vehicle production and flight as well as systems that allow Starlink to grow into a worldwide fast, reliable Internet service. We are looking for engineers who treat fellow teammates with fairness, respect, and support.

Our team is currently creating and evolving systems to enable rapid build and reuse of Starship as well as designing the next generation manufacturing software that will be used in high throughput factories for Starlink. Other applications range from platforms that support concurrent streams of data from many always-on assets to manage the world’s largest satellite constellation to public facing systems where customers can join our Starlink network globally. We work closely with engineers throughout the company to create and update our systems with respect to crewed launches, Starship flights, changes to the Starlink network and much more.

Aerospace experience is not required to be successful here - rather we look for smart, motivated, respectful, collaborative engineers who love solving problems and want to make an impact on a super inspiring mission. You will have full ownership of challenging problems, working with a team of enthusiastic engineers with diverse perspectives to design and produce solutions that enable SpaceX to move towards our goals at a rapid pace. The success of the missions at SpaceX depends on the software that you and your team produce.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop highly reliable software solutions that are used across SpaceX
  • Create new applications that improve how SpaceX operates
  • Build prototypes to prove out key design concepts and quantify technical constraints
  • Own all aspects of software engineering and product development
  • Deep dive into your users’ problems to find and create efficient solutions
  • Bring your voice to the table in team collaborations on architecture, design, and code reviews

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, math, or scientific discipline and 5+ years of professional experience in software development; OR 7+ years of professional experience building software in lieu of a degree
  • 3+ years of professional experience in full stack development

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Programming experience in Python, C#.NET, Go, Scala, Java, or similar object-oriented language
  • 1+ years of rigorous experience building single page web applications
  • Experience with version control, continuous integration, and continuous delivery concepts
  • Expertise in designing software systems
  • Deep understanding of testing, continuous integration, build, deployment & monitoring
  • Expertise in profiling and improving application performance
  • Experience with build systems (Make, Bazel/Pants/Buck, Gradle) and package management tools (pip, npm)
  • Experience with UNIX-like operating systems and tools like Terraform, Ansible, Puppet for managing them
  • Experience working with in-stream data processing using Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, or similar technologies
  • Production experience with Docker and Kubernetes
  • Front-end experience in Angular, React, or similar JavaScript framework
  • Database experience with PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or similar database technologies

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • You may be asked to work extended hours/weekends dependent on launch cadence

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Sr. Software Engineer: $165,000.00 - $230,000.00/per year

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock, stock options, or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. jobs.title: Business Development Manager, Agentic Commerce
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

What you’ll do

In this role, you will help build and execute Stripe’s strategy for agentic commerce. You will identify and launch lighthouse partnerships across AI agents, merchants, commerce platforms, marketplaces, and technology providers; move early opportunities from exploration to production; and turn market learning into repeatable go-to-market motions. You will work across Product, Engineering, Sales, Solutions Architecture, Product Marketing, Legal, and Finance to position Stripe as critical infrastructure for agent-led commerce.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute Stripe’s go-to-market and ecosystem strategy for agentic commerce.
  • Build trusted relationships across AI companies and agent developers, merchants and brands, commerce platforms, marketplaces, and technology partners, creating mutually reinforcing adoption across the ecosystem.
  • Identify, cultivate, and launch lighthouse opportunities, moving partners from early exploration through technical validation, commercial alignment, production launch, and scaled adoption.
  • Develop a deep understanding of the distinct needs of buyers, agents, sellers, and ecosystem partners, and translate emerging use cases into viable technical and commercial solutions.
  • Shape and articulate Stripe’s agentic commerce narrative for technical, commercial, and executive audiences, including how Stripe enables secure checkout, identity and permissions, payment credentials, risk management, product discovery, and monetization.

  • Represent Stripe with customers, partners, and industry audiences through EBCs, Sessions, Tours, and other strategic forums, helping establish Stripe as a leader in agentic commerce.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply.

  • 8+ years of experience in business development, partnerships, product commercialization, or enterprise go-to-market, with meaningful experience in AI, developer platforms, commerce, fintech, or payments.

  • Excellent executive communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts and earn credibility with founders, product and engineering leaders, and enterprise executives.
  • Ability to operate effectively amid ambiguity, rapid product evolution, and incomplete market structure, and to lead cross-functional work without relying on formal authority.

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT ANDURIL

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril Frontier Systems (AFS) is Anduril's largest division, with the broadest portfolio of established and new products across the Department of War and Intelligence Community. You'll join a high-impact Divisional Operations team acting as the strategic nerve center for AFS's growth and operational engine, partnering directly with senior Business Line and Division leaders on the strategy, data, and special projects that drive the Division's growth and operating decisions.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Drive special projects that span the full breadth of the business, from market assessment to data analytics to pricing to production, surging onto new workstreams as priorities emerge. Examples of work include:
    • Analyze pipeline and top-line data to identify business trends, surface insights, and enable data-backed pursuit decisions
    • Support the translation of business demand into short- and long-term planning across Operations, Production, and Real Estate
    • Partner with Facilities and Real Estate on space planning, forecasting seat/lab/production needs as the Division scales and helping stand up or expand sites
    • Support pricing strategy work by synthesizing market data, cost models, and competitive positioning into clear recommendations
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reporting automation that reduce manual effort and increase analytical throughput, leveraging AI tools to rethink existing processes rather than just digitizing them
  • Contribute to Long-Range Planning (LRP) and QBR cadence materials, partnering with Ops leadership, Corporate Operations, and Finance
  • Work deeply within data and systems. Become intimately familiar with how our business systems (ERP, CRM etc.) function, and leverage data from them to execute scrappy analyses on short timelines, equipping divisional and business teams with insights and tools to measure and improve their processes.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Strong agency and judgment to operate independently. Mature enough to make calls in the moment with imperfect information, and mature enough not to go rogue. You know when to decide and when to escalate.
  • Builds trust and relationships across BLs and seniority levels, including knowing how to work closely with partner functions like Finance to get things done.
  • A strong communicator comfortable partnering with engineers, finance partners, external counterparts, and executives.
  • Comfortable constantly moving between big-picture strategy, fine details, and execution, sometimes all in the same day. You can shape Anduril's approach to a new market and also negotiate lease terms or source a local supplier.
  • High ownership with the horsepower to juggle multiple (2-3+) projects in parallel, at a rapid pace, reporting out progress regularly without dropping balls.
  • You have 3+ years of experience in a management consulting, investment banking, internal strategy & operations, or business analyst role.
  • Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Fluent with modern AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) as part of your everyday workflow. You use them to accelerate analysis, drafting, and reporting, not just as a novelty.
  • Undergraduate degree in a STEM major and/or an MBA.
US Salary Range
$124,000—$164,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

 

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. 

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

 

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/. 

 

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Technical Marketing Engineer
jobs.description:
About The Role

Most of what makes Together AI so valuable for customers is invisible from the outside. Optimizing kernels, scheduling, quantization, speculative decoding, and more create an industry-leading platform for inference and post-training at scale. As a technical marketing engineer, you are the conduit between the engineering and research work and the developers who should know about it. You go deep with product, engineering, research, and CX to learn the platform at the level of nuanced technical detail, then decide which details matter to an AI builder and build content that makes them care.

This is a creator role. You are a technical storyteller. You'll produce social-native posts, technical blogs, performance benchmarks, demo and explainer videos, and thought leadership, all aimed at one outcome: building Together’s credibility with developers. You'll also own our technical communities on X, YouTube, Discord, Linkedin and the engagement metrics for developer content company-wide, including amplifying the work of engineers and researchers who publish under their own names.

Responsibilities

External

  • Partner with product, engineering, DevRel, research, and CX to learn new capabilities in technical depth, then extract the most meaningful aspects for a developer audience.
  • Create the content strategy based on deep understanding of our company’s differentiation and marries that with an understanding of the content that would resonate.
  • Build technical content across formats: blogs, videos, benchmark reports, podcasts, and short-form posts that drive engagement with developers and preference for Together.
  • Monitor real-time news and announcements related to AI infrastructure and lead timely responses working with product and engineering
  • Replies to social media comments, bringing expert understanding of the technology
  • Own Together's presence in technical communities, primarily X, Discord, LinkedIn, and Youtube. Track engagement metrics, what lands, what doesn't, and adjust.
  • Drive amplification of engineering and research work across social channels.
  • Be the heartbeat of the Together AI technical community - understanding the developers and researchers who follow us and enabling them to be successful
  • Experiment and test new ideas to see what resonates with the community
  • While the role involved mainly online engagement (80%), there is an aspect of translating their deep understanding to deliver highly engaging in-person meet ups and events (20%) in collaboration with Events/ DevRel teams

Internal

  • Be the bridge between research and engineering with the field team
  • Deploy models, benchmark new capabilities (e.g. the compiler, speculative decoding) across models and workloads, and turn results into practical field guidance: when to use it, when not to, and what to expect.
  • Enable SAs and FDEs on every launch. Create technical briefs and run sessions covering how it works, where it sits in the inference serving stack, how to deploy it for customers
  • Go to implementation depth for FDEs: which workload and model shapes a capability fits, how to configure it, and how to implement it.
  • Build the technical foundations curriculum for field onboarding
  • Create field-ready technical assets: reference architectures, benchmark summaries, POC guidance, competitive technical comparisons, and FAQs for deep customer conversations.
  • Close the loop. Bring what SAs and FDEs learn from POCs and deployments, and customer questions from sales calls (with PMM), back into internal and external content.

Requirements 

  • 3+ years of product, technical or developer marketing
  • Either hands-on GPU/AI infrastructure experience or a portfolio of in-depth technical content for engineers (links required).
  • Experience creating content for infrastructure or technical systems, not user-facing SaaS applications. You've explained how something works under the hood.
  • Loves building social community presence, posting, engaging, monitoring with technical audiences, with experience managing channels
  • Technical depth sufficient to hold a real conversation with engineers about architecture, performance, and tradeoffs, and to write about it accurately (partnering with SMEs).
  • A portfolio of technical content you created with the metrics that show engagement.
  • Familiarity with AI infrastructure: inference, fine-tuning, GPU compute, model serving, or adjacent systems (including databases, data infrastructure, or storage infrastructure).
  • Hands-on experience running and interpreting performance benchmarks.
  • Fluency with developer communities on social platforms, and judgment about what earns engagement there versus what gets ignored.
  • Innate curiosity about how things work, and the instinct to show the market what you find.
  • Strong ownership mindset and ability to build something from ground up
  • Data-driven and ideas person - always thinking of new experiments and content

About Together AI

Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high-performance inference that scales reliably, reinforcement learning to create specialized models, and pre-training for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves over 400 trillion tokens a month.

Compensation

We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance and other competitive benefits. The US base salary range for this full-time position is: $200K-230K + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job-related knowledge. This is a hybrid role based in the Bay Area.  

Application Policy

Please read each role carefully and apply to the position best suited to you. Candidates are limited to 6 applications within a 90-day period, and applications beyond that limit will be automatically rejected. You may apply to additional roles 90 days after your last application.

Equal Opportunity

Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more.

Please see our privacy policy at https://www.together.ai/privacy

jobs.title: Principal Site Reliability Engineer (Vehicle Engineering)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

PRINCIPAL SITE RELIABILITY ENGINEER (VEHICLE ENGINEERING)

SpaceX HPC is a shared compute platform used across the company — vehicle and structures simulation, machine learning, AI inference, and more. We support every program at SpaceX to design and operate the worlds most advanced rockets and satellites. This role exists to put a real Site Reliability Engineer operating model on these capabilities and accelerating the world class engineering at SpaceX: toil reduction, automation, observability, and a sustainable incident process.

We are looking for a Principal Site Reliability Engineer who wants to own everything from Linux machines and our Infrastructure as Code, storage, and user facing applications – the whole ecosystem as a product, not as a ticket queue. You do not need a prior HPC title. You do need production instincts — you have operated real infrastructure, you write code to delete toil, and you care about whether users can actually get work done, not just whether nodes ping. You’ll work alongside HPC systems engineers who design and commission clusters to help make them more reliable and provide world class services for world class engineers.

Aerospace experience is not required. We value engineers who treat teammates with fairness and respect, who are self-critical, and who will take ownership of hard production problems.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Participate in the team's on-call rotation; practice sustainable incident response and blameless postmortems
  • Manage node lifecycle with infrastructure as code: OS images, firmware, configuration management, kernel and driver stack
  • Build observability for both HPC administrators and end users — cluster, node, and storage health for operators, and job/workflow-level signal for the people running work on the platform
  • Reduce toil with automation; split time between operating production systems and writing the software that makes that work smaller
  • Sustainably manage resources, including compute and storage
  • Lead capacity planning with users across the company: understand what they will need next, and turn that into a concrete picture of tomorrow's compute and storage
  • Collaborate with HPC systems engineers and with engineers across all disciplines across the company on operable, maintainable infrastructure

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, math, or a scientific discipline; OR 2+ years of professional experience operating production infrastructure in lieu of a degree
  • 8+ years of experience with Linux operating systems in production
  • 8+ years of experience operating production infrastructure (servers, services, or networks), including monitoring, debugging, and repairing what you own

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • 8+ years of professional experience in SRE, DevOps, or production infrastructure engineering

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Accounting Platform (Product Minded Auditor)
jobs.description:
BitGo (NYSE: BTGO) is the digital asset infrastructure company delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since 2013, BitGo has focused on accelerating the transition of the financial system to a digital asset economy. BitGo maintains a global presence and multiple regulated entities, including BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association, the first federally chartered digital asset trust bank owned by a publicly traded company. Today, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, financial institutions, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of investors worldwide. For more information, visit www.bitgo.com.

This role requires being full-time onsite at our NY, NY office to support collaborative team dynamics and innovative problem-solving. 

If you have spent your career in SOX, internal controls, audit, controllership, or financial close, and you want to build the systems that fix what you find instead of only testing them, this role is for you.

Why this role exists 

Every product BitGo ships eventually becomes a number: a balance, a fee, a statement, a journal entry, a regulatory filing. As a public company and a federally chartered trust bank, we have to prove those numbers are right every period, across many products, legal entities, and jurisdictions. 

You will own the product strategy for the financial and accounting platform that makes those numbers right by construction, as we add products, entities, and asset types. You will turn accounting requirements into scalable, auditable, self-service platform capabilities that product, engineering, finance, and compliance can build on. 

Digital assets make this harder, and more interesting, than it is at a traditional bank. On chain activity, custody structures, staking, tokenized assets, and settlement each move through our systems differently, and each has to land correctly on the books. The industry is still writing the playbook for much of this. You will help write it. 

Level 

We are hiring at Senior or Principal level, depending on experience. The core scope is the same at both. At Principal, you have already set platform strategy, led accounting systems, or established control standards that multiple teams adopted, and you will own the crossproduct standards and the working relationship with finance and audit leadership with more independence from day one.

Two paths to this role 

There is more than one way to be great at this job. You may come from product management and built financial compliance platforms. You may come from audit, controllership, or accounting systems and have spent years finding where numbers break, and then built the thing that fixed it. We are just as interested in the second group. If you are an auditor or accountant with a builder mindset, you will be evaluated on the same scope and the same bar as a product manager. What matters is that you have shipped: tools, automation, control frameworks, or systems that other teams adopted and kept using.

What you will own 

  • The financial data and accounting platform roadmap: Define and deliver the shared capabilities that make financial data trustworthy by construction: ledger and sub-ledger integrity, balance and activity reconciliation, fee and revenue calculation, client reporting, and the feeds into the general ledger and the financial close. 
  • Controls built into the product: Partner with finance, internal audit, and external auditors to turn SOX and internal control requirements into product capabilities instead of manual procedures. When a control needs a build, you own the requirements, the plan, and the timeline, delivered in step with the audit calendar. 
  • Platform standards across products and entities: Make sure new products, new asset types, new legal entities, and acquisitions plug into the platform instead of creating bespoke accounting workarounds. You set the standards, interfaces, and data contracts that product teams build against. 
  • Regulatory and audit readiness: Work with compliance, legal, and risk so the platform supports regulatory reporting, books-and-records requirements, and examiner and auditor requests. You run dated plans against external deadlines and flag early when a timeline is at risk. 
  • Close, reporting, and operational efficiency: Reduce the manual effort, elapsed time, and risk in month-end and quarter-end close. Establish the metrics that show whether the platform is working: reconciliation breaks, close duration, audit adjustments, manual journal volume, and time to onboard a new product. 

What success looks like in the first two quarters 

  • A documented map of how each major product's financial activity reaches the general ledger, with manual steps and gaps identified and prioritized. 
  • A dated platform roadmap agreed with finance, engineering, and compliance, with external deadlines (audit, regulatory, and reporting) built into the plan. 
  • One high-impact capability shipped end to end, such as automated reconciliation for a key product, that measurably reduces manual work or control risk. 

Who you will partner with 

  • Finance and Accounting leadership own accounting policy and judgment. You translate their requirements into platform capabilities and make the product the system of record. 
  • Engineering leadership owns architecture, estimates, and delivery. You partner on sequencing, platform design, and tradeoffs without positional authority. Product Managers across Custody, Trading, Staking, and Financing need the platform to support their products without becoming a bottleneck. 
  • Compliance, Legal, and Risk own regulatory judgment. You build the delivery process behind it. 
  • Internal and external audit rely on you to plan control-related work clearly and deliver it on schedule. 
  • Commercial and client teams need accurate statements, reporting, and billing that clients can trust. 

What we're looking for 

  • 6+ years of experience (typically 9+ for Principal) building or scaling systems, platforms, tooling, or control frameworks that multiple internal or external teams relied on, including 3+ years as the owner. You might have done this as a product manager, or from audit, controllership, or accounting systems. At Principal, you have set strategy or standards that other teams adopted.
  • An accounting or finance foundation: a CPA or equivalent, an accounting degree, or hands-on experience in financial reporting, audit, controllership, or accounting systems. You can read a trial balance, follow a journal entry through a ledger, and discuss revenue recognition or reconciliation with a controller without a translator.
  • Experience building scalable platforms such as ledgers, billing, payments, reporting, data infrastructure, reconciliation tooling, or controls automation. You think in data models, interfaces, and reuse, and you know when a one-off fix will cost us later. If you come from audit or accounting, this may look like automating reconciliations, building controls into a system, or designing data models and tooling with engineers, rather than a formal product title.
  • Experience in a regulated financial environment. You have worked with auditors, examiners, SOX controls, or control programs, and you understand how public company obligations change how products are built and shipped.
  • Technical credibility with Engineers. You can follow an architecture discussion, pressure-test an estimate, and write precise requirements for data-heavy systems. Familiarity with SQL and financial data pipelines is a plus.
  • Crypto or digital-asset experience is a requirement. If you do not have professional experience, passion projects with breadth and depth across digital assets could be a good fit.
  • A writing-first approach: your default artifacts are clear specs, data flow maps, and decision documents.

What will make you fail here 

  • Building bespoke solutions for each product or blockchain instead of platform capabilities that scale. 
  • Needing positional authority to get things done. Engineering, finance, and compliance sit on separate reporting lines, and you will coordinate across all three every day. You need to find ways to unblock yourself. 
  • Optimizing for process over outcomes. We have little patience for ceremony. Here, a control built into the product is an outcome; a new manual review step usually isn't. 

Why Join BitGo?

Disrupting an industry takes vision, innovation, passion, technical chops, drive to deliver, collaboration, and execution. Join a team of great people who strive for excellence and personify our corporate values of ownership, craftsmanship, and open communication. We are looking for new colleagues who bring innovative ways of thinking and problem-solving, and who want risks to be part of the team that changes the world’s financial markets.

  • Competitive base salary, bonus, and stock options
  • 100% company-paid health insurance for employee, partner, and dependents
  • Up to 4% 401k company match
  • Paid parental leave, Paid vacation
  • Free commuter/parking pass
  • Free custom lunches and snacks
  • Computer equipment and workplace furniture to suit your needs
  • Great colleagues and an inspiring environment

Benefits may vary based on location.

Pay Transparency Notice:

Depending upon your leveling and location, the compensation for this role averages between $230,000 and $260,000 USD base salary. Equity, an annual performance bonus, and the benefits outlined above are also part of this role’s package.

Cryptocurrencies are the most disruptive change the financial services industry has seen in years. Join us and you'll be able to look back and say you were part of the team that transformed investing.

jobs.title: White Space Manager, Network & Data Halls
jobs.description:
About the Team

OpenAI, in close collaboration with our capital and delivery partners, is building the infrastructure required to support frontier AI systems. The Data Center Engineering team defines repeatable technical standards and carries them through design, construction, commissioning, and operational readiness. The team works across data center facilities, power generation, compute infrastructure, construction, procurement, and operations to deliver reliable capacity at unprecedented scale and speed.

About the Role

We are seeking a White Space Manager to own the planning, coordination, and readiness of data center white-space environments. You will connect facility delivery with compute deployment by coordinating rack layouts, electrical distribution, liquid and air cooling, structured cabling, containment, material flow, installation sequencing, and acceptance. This role is accountable for turning completed building infrastructure into safe, usable, operations-ready data halls that can receive and activate high-density AI systems.

Travel: 50% 

Responsibilities

 - Own white-space planning and readiness from design development through rack installation, testing, activation, and handoff to operations.

 - Coordinate rack elevations, floor layouts, service clearances, containment, busway or RPP distribution, cabling pathways, and cooling connections.

 - Translate compute deployment forecasts into space, power, cooling, network, labor, tooling, and material requirements.

 - Develop installation sequences, readiness gates, turnover criteria, punch-list processes, and escalation paths across multiple workstreams.

 - Partner with design, construction, commissioning, networking, hardware operations, safety, logistics, and vendors to resolve cross-system constraints.

 - Verify field conditions against approved designs and maintain accurate as-built, capacity, asset, and readiness records.

 - Identify risks to safe installation, energization, cooling availability, network readiness, or schedule and drive mitigations to closure.

 - Create repeatable white-space standards, checklists, metrics, and operating mechanisms that scale across campuses.

Qualifications

 - 8+ years of experience delivering or operating data center white space, critical facilities, compute deployments, or mission-critical fit-outs.

 - Strong understanding of racks, power distribution, structured cabling, airflow management, liquid cooling, controls interfaces, and deployment sequencing.

 - Demonstrated ownership of installation readiness, field coordination, quality, safety, and handoff across several technical disciplines.

 - Experience interpreting construction documents, rack layouts, one-lines, mechanical diagrams, schedules, and commissioning records.

 - Ability to manage competing dependencies and make sound decisions in an active construction or production environment.

 - Strong communication with engineers, contractors, vendors, deployment teams, and operations leaders.

 - Willingness to travel regularly and spend sustained time at active project sites.

Preferred Skills

 - Experience with high-density GPU or AI infrastructure and direct-to-chip liquid cooling.

 - Experience with DCIM, asset-management, commissioning, or deployment-readiness systems.

 - Background in data center construction, commissioning, hardware deployment, or facilities operations.

 - Bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, operations, or a related technical field.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. 

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf.

For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.
